You, a poor soul caught in the Sultan's Game.

2000005.title: Bharat
strings: Bharat
Foreign Merchant

A merchant of exotic goods, currently renting a shop under your name. It is said that before coming to this city, he had journeyed through the desert and visited many a distant land. Children flock to him for his tales of long forgotten mysteries. Yet, when asked about his past, he would only say that he is a man without a home.

2000006.title: Maggie
strings: Maggie
Your Wife

Your wife, a wise and respectable woman. While your marriage – arranged by your late parents when you were still young – lacks passion, it has proven to be a source of stability and peace. She has been steadfast as ever, even after this deadly game has caught you in its snares, never once expressing a desire to leave you. Though occasionally, you hear her sigh.

2000008.title: Ansuya
strings: Ansuya
Princess of a Fallen Kingdom

A tribe once implored the Sultan for protection from its neighbors' raids. The Sultan graciously received its gift of its princess and deployed his iron army to march on the tribe, conquering it before its neighbors could. The princess who lost everything saw through the Sultan's capriciousness and never would she again place her hopes in him. The Sultan soon tired of this frigid consort. She is forgotten in a quiet corner of the harem. In silence, she wilts.

2000009.title: Sadani
strings: Sadani
Once-Favored Consort

A captivating beauty, she was once the Sultan's undisputed favorite. But there will always someone younger, someone fairer. Sadani refuses to accept the inconstancy of her lord and will do anything she can to wrest back that heart of stone. As it happens, her madness is a delicacy the Sultan relishes.

2000010.title: Zazie
strings: Zazie
Sultan's Favorite

The monarch's favor has swept away all memory of Zazie's humble origin. She rides the tides of adulation arrogantly, imperiously, and without worry. After all, her youth and beauty have already fetched her a price ten thousand times more than she could even dream in the House of Delights. As for what tomorrow may bring, she does not care.

2000011.title: Samir
strings: Samir
Court Physician

Samir has served the court for over ten years. He is a skilled physician, well-dressed, and avoids the touch of women. After all, more often than not, it is the delicate female members of the harem that requires his treatment, instead of the robust Sultan. It is said that the monarch once gifted him a male concubine. The two share a harmonious companionship till this day.

2000012.title: Seliman
strings: Seliman
Royal Guard Captain

One of the four esteemed individuals granted the honor of serving as the Sultan's personal guard, permitted to bear arms in the Sultan's presence. Entrusted with the safety of the court and harem, he enjoys the Sultan's trust and is renowned as one of the finest swordsmen in the realm.

2000013.title: Roaming Swordsman
strings: Roaming Swordsman

As the most well recognized mercenary swordsman in Dark Alley, he refuses to reveal his name. What marks him – other than his gleaming golden sword, is his libertine attitude: the overflowing goblet, the beauties in his arms, and the coins he can never keep.

2000014.title: Habib
strings: Habib
Handy Chef

A chef highly skilled in both culinary arts and knife work. He excels in everything from butchering livestock, stewing pilaf that feeds an army, to arranging fruits into beautiful ornaments that delight the ladies. If you can provide Habib with inspiration or high quality ingredients, he will serve up a feast anytime.

2000018.title: Peddler
strings: Peddler
Unused

2000019.title: Jenna
strings: Jenna
Jeweler
The Jeweler can accumulate Inspirations by attending The Grand Game, News in the Bathhouse, and Bookstore Business. She can design accessories for you by consuming Inspirations in Methinks.

2000021.title: Iman
strings: Iman
Priest of the True Faith
A priest who has served God since childhood. Might even the most unyielding devotion conceal fractures?

2000022.title: Badriyyah
strings: Badriyyah
Occultist

The path to transcendence is revealed, not unearthed. And thus, all who delve into the arcane or divine might be branded occultists - at least in theory. But you know this woman to be something else. Beneath her tattooed skin coils an alluring darkness...

2000023.title: Talal
strings: Talal
Unused
Court Painter

2000024.title: The Sultan
strings: The Sultan
Ruler of All
He was once a ruler of wisdom, cunning, and strength. Yet beneath it all lies cruelty, madness, and a chilling indifference: not the work of the Cards, but the unyielding essence of his nature.

2000028.title: Khulaifi
strings: Khulaifi
Unused

This ever-smiling man commands nearly seventy percent of the continent’s trade routes, transforming his camels' footprints into trails of endless gold. This gold he uses to purchase the Sultan's leniency and favor, to conceal the true breadth of his astounding fortune. He claims no friends; profit is his only companion. He acknowledges no enemies; profit spawns them in legions.

2000029.title: Gold Coin
strings: Gold Coin
Currency
Some say that gold can buy anything. You used to scoff at that. Now, you know it to be true.

2000050.title: Influence
strings: Influence
Unused

Power is a shadow, and the Sultan's shadow stretches long and deep. Believe in it, and it stirs to life, weaving itself into the actions of all. This is a valuable resource that can assist in many specific Rituals related to nobles.

2000051.title: Stigma
strings: Stigma
Unused

2000054.title: Jabal
strings: Jabal
Adventure Enthusiast

One of the four esteemed individuals granted the honor of serving as the Sultan's personal guard, permitted to bear arms in the Sultan's presence. An affable man oft ridiculed for his passion for adventure stories and ancient heroics, he steadfastly upholds the ideals of the very paragons he admires.

2000055.title: Nayla
strings: Nayla
Vain Noblewoman

Born of a venerable bloodline and blessed with a frail husband, Nayla is unafraid to be immodest. Flitting through the court's glittering intrigues, she has amassed many admirers, yet few catch her favor... For who can truly sate her insatiable vanity?

2000056.title: Qais
strings: Qais
Forthright Courtier
You have rescued the Righteous Noble Prisoner and restored his honor. He once more stands in the Sultan's court, clinging to his ridiculous integrity, making himself a thorn in the Sultan's side.

2000057.title: Jawad
strings: Jawad
Greedy Courtier
You have rescued the Obese Noble Prisoner and restored his honor. He once more strolls the Sultan's court, flaunting his exceptional art of amassing wealth.

2000058.title: Silent Warrior
strings: Silent Warrior
Unused

(This npc has been removed or character design pending modification) A lower Noble with nomadic blood, will become your Ally in the Khan line. Dispatching him to the nomadic oasis will yield extra rewards. He is the brother of the (Nomadic Khan).

2000059.title: Emane
strings: Emane
Theologian

The words of the divine are laws, and Emane is their interpreter. Each morn, she preaches to her flock. With each hymn and prayer, her path grows clearer, her resolve unshaken. She believes in the truth of her words – for who could be closer to that vast and awe-inspiring presence than one who lives and breathes its guidance?

2000060.title: Sultan's Sister
strings: Sultan's Sister
Unused

2000061.title: Adila
strings: Adila
Warrioress
She refuses to walk the path her family chose for her and wishes to prove herself through combat. A girl with a pure heart, admirable in her folly.
Regardless of the outcome, she enjoyed the combat.

2000062.title: Fatuna
strings: Fatuna
Wealthy Widow
Her husband passed away recently, and her only son still young... Now, like vultures, her relatives close in on her.

2000063.title: Zaki
strings: Zaki
Young Noble
Fatuna's son. He is a remarkable youth, an uncut gem. Pure, unpolished, and blissfully ignorant of the world's cruelties.

2000064.title: Nabhani
strings: Nabhani
Playboy

One of the four esteemed individuals granted the honor of serving as the Sultan's personal guard, permitted to bear arms in the Sultan's presence. The best swordsman in the capital, yet too handsome to guard the harem and too clever to serve the army. Instead, he lingers in the House of Delights, befriending prostitutes and artists.

2000065.title: Faris
strings: Faris
Captain of the Cavalry

One of the four esteemed individuals granted the honor of serving as the Sultan's personal guard, permitted to bear arms in the Sultan's presence. He is the best horseman in the capital and oversees all the Sultan's steeds and cavalry. However, he much prefers the company of horses to people.

2000066.title: Amir
strings: Amir
Unused

As an ally, he can help you build and upgrade houses. Good and evil hold no sway over him. All he cares about is raising increasingly bizarre architectures. An eccentric, he would demand lavish work benefits (such as fine wine, good food, and women). You would need him to construct special buildings like cultic temples.

2000067.title: Adil
strings: Adil
High Constable
A High Constable who only answers to the Sultan. He is responsible for crimes involving the nobility. As a clever man with a sense of justice, serving the Sultan is an arduous life.

2000068.title: Registrar
strings: Registrar
Unused

2000069.title: Manar
strings: Manar
Cartographer

Manar spent half her life recording every mountain range, valley, and oasis she traveled to with her paintbrush. She documented the migration of community and the trails of merchants. Eventually, she compiled all of her painstaking work into a meticulously drawn map. Some marveled at it, some questioned it. Unbeknownst to her, the ruler of this kingdom has also developed a unique interest in it...

2000070.title: Old Noble
strings: Old Noble
Unused

2000071.title: Dispatched Soldier
strings: Dispatched Soldier
Unused
A troop, acquired from a Reckless General, lasts for one round.

2000072.title: Dispatched Soldier
strings: Dispatched Soldier
Unused
A troop with higher attributes, acquired from a Reckless General, lasts for one round.

2000077.title: Torture Tools
strings: Torture Tools
Unused

2000080.title: Junah
strings: Junah
Popular Prostitute

Junah is beautiful, but lacks a certain poise. This means she cannot charge as much, which, for many patrons, works just fine. The other prostitutes think she is wasting her potential, but they do not know what she wants.

2000081.title: Jalila
strings: Jalila
Queen of the Whip

Jalila has meticulously crafted her unapproachable persona. Many clients spend enough on her to buy several farms, and their only reward is a chance to kneel and kiss her toes – perhaps that is exactly what they want.

2000082.title: Shama
strings: Shama
Social Butterfly

Some say Shama is the illegitimate daughter of a noble lord. Her refined speech lends credence to such rumors. She might just be the city's finest fixer, when it comes to unsavory matters that require a delicate touch – pleasures of the bedchamber are merely a sweetener to her real service.

2000083.title: Wife's Resentment
strings: Wife's Resentment
Resentment
Your wife is holding a grudge... not surprising, considering what you have done. These accumulated resentment will bring you misfortune.

2000091.title: Luxurious Feast
strings: Luxurious Feast
Unused
Banquet Catering

2000092.title: Infamy
strings: Infamy
Unused
Some are things you have done, others are what people believe you have done. The rumors always sound worse than what really happened. These accumulated resentment will bring you misfortune.

2000098.title: Injured
strings: Injured
Status
A wound that will reduce your physical attributes.

2000100.title: Fear of the Sultan
strings: Fear of the Sultan
Conviction

Admitting your fear of the Sultan is an interesting thing. All should fear their monarch, but not to show it... unless the Sultan has gone mad and has begun taking pleasure in being feared. Acknowledgement of truth is the first step towards rebellion.

2000111.title: Nedam
strings: Nedam
Unused
Once gripped by the horrors of starvation, his body learned a grim lesson: to extract every last ounce of sustenance from whatever it consumes.

2000112.title: Iyas
strings: Iyas
Unused
All that is left of him is skin and bones, making it easy to overlook his large frame and build.

2000113.title: Alim
strings: Alim
Head Thief
He might have picked your pocket before, but you cannot remember his face for the life of you. In the blink of an eye, he is gone, just another face is the crowd.

2000114.title: Gullis
strings: Gullis
Nomad Leader
The nomad has chosen to stay and repay your kindness. Words are not his strength, but his archery possesses an uncanny, almost supernatural precision.

2000115.title: Sharp-Eyed Slave
strings: Sharp-Eyed Slave
A Sacrifice?
Owning nomad slaves is a novelty amongst nobles, something of a status symbol. Despite it being illegal, they delight in taming these strong, hirsute slaves.

2000116.title: Jignak
strings: Jignak
Unused
Power and wealth are deceptions. Hence only a swindler knows how to use them best.

2000117.title: Usama
strings: Usama
Unused
He used to stake his fist in the Dark Alley brawls, but now he finds the game you are playing far more thrilling.

2000118.title: Nur
strings: Nur
Unused
Her hair is the color of red copper. Her gaze is so hot it could burn your chest. Her hearty laughter lets out small sparks around her.

2000119.title: Adventurer Captain
strings: Adventurer Captain
Unused
Only the captain – alive and well – can claim the bounty. Such is the rule of the trade.

2000120.title: Adventurer Squad
strings: Adventurer Squad
Unused
A mob, but at least they know how to act collectively. They are the most ruthless and cheap military force you can find.

2000121.title: Blacksmith
strings: Blacksmith
Unused
Can craft and upgrade equipment, no hiring required, functional NPC. Randomly spawns in the Dark Alley.

2000122.title: Killer
strings: Killer
Unused

2000123.title: Lumera
strings: Lumera
Bookworm Girl
Many people can read, but she reads with a merciless efficiency, and lives out the teachings with no regard of morality or difficulty. (She ignores any prerequisites there may be for reading a book.)
Lumera is thoughtful.

2000124.title: Zyaullah
strings: Zyaullah
Unused
Translator

2000125.title: Corpse Thief
strings: Corpse Thief
Unused
Pervert

2000126.title: Alara
strings: Alara
Unused

(Ugly duckling/Cinderella story base) An ugly girl afflicted with a terrible disease, covered in sores. She can be adopted and healed, and once healed, she will be a highly Charismatic ally. (Influence/Treasure/Item can raise her Rarity).

2000127.title: Foul-Smelling Beggar
strings: Foul-Smelling Beggar
Unused
The beggar is covered in sores and exudes a foul stench, clearly suffering from a terrible disease. Passersby do not even want to look at her, let alone pity her.

2000128.title: Free Musician
strings: Free Musician
Unused

2000129.title: Arzuna
strings: Arzuna
Dancer

Up till now, you’d only seen the name—which sounds somewhat like yours—in your father’s will. But now the dancer herself stands before you. Her striking beauty must have come from the woman who once seduced your father. Only her eyes bear the faintest resemblance to your own.

2000130.title: Stolen Goods Merchant
strings: Stolen Goods Merchant
Unused
A black market merchant, appearing at random. You can purchase random loot boxes from him.

2000137.title: Valid Evidence
strings: Valid Evidence
Item
You now have irrefutable evidence proving the Judge to be the real culprit. What will you do next?

2000156.title: Hidden Dagger
strings: Hidden Dagger
Unused
Special item with the Stealth attribute, useful for certain Rituals of assassination (such as Bathhouse Assassination). Cannot be equipped.

2000157.title: Volcanic Rock of Doom
strings: Volcanic Rock of Doom
Unused
A trophy from slaying the Great Dragon on Mount Doom. Taking it to the Bathhouse would provide significantly bonuses. Very useful for exfoliation, not much else.

2000158.title: Essential Oil
strings: Essential Oil
Unused
Single-use item that boosts Charisma in the Bathhouse.

2000159.title: Roast Turkey
strings: Roast Turkey
Unused
Test Food

2000160.title: Compound Bow
strings: Compound Bow
Weapon
Compound bow made with wood and bone, more powerful than the average longbow.

2000161.title: Ragged Girl
strings: Ragged Girl
Poverty and hunger have marred her flesh, but her innocent eyes are like two deep pools – luring fools to pour out their desires, inviting the wise to impart wisdom.

2000162.title: Unidentified Stolen Property
strings: Unidentified Stolen Property
Used to trigger The Fence.

2000163.title: Curse
strings: Curse
Status
Hard lumps writhing under the skin. Fleeting shadows out of the corner of the eyes. Sharp cries from empty street corners. The effulgent fluid you wake up with every morn, dripping down your lips.

2000164.title: Amur
strings: Amur
Old Judge
He handles lawsuits between commoners. Many respect him, but more fear him.

2000165.title: Mirror
strings: Mirror
Unused

strings: Haunted House Rumors
Unused

strings: Judge's Death Certificate
Unused

2000168.title: Slander
strings: Slander
Accumulated slander will prompt the Sultan to issue additional orders to you. Rest assured, they will not be merciful.

2000169.title: Sultan's Rule
strings: Sultan's Rule
Conviction
Sultan's Rule is a fate most people accept as inevitable.

2000170.title: Sultan's Patience
strings: Sultan's Patience
Countdown
The Sultan rarely has patience, other than for certain, special individuals.

2000171.title: Intent to Rebel
strings: Intent to Rebel
Conviction
Once this notion is challenged, people begin to obsess day and night about how to assassinate their sovereign and dismantle the state—as if doing so would solve all of life's problems.

2000172.title: Regicide Plot
strings: Regicide Plot
Conviction
You've already worked out exactly how to kill the Sultan. You replay it over and over in your mind, a thousand times in your dreams.

2000173.title: Fadia
strings: Fadia
Sultan's Slave
In the Sultan’s harem are countless nameless, forgotten slave girls whose lives and deaths mean less than nothing. Fadia is the luckiest among them.

2000174.title: Sadani's Secret
strings: Sadani's Secret
Clue
Sadani is pregnant. This is a secret she will do anything to protect.

2000175.title: Managing the Estate
strings: Managing the Estate
Unused

2000176.title: Sadani's Maid
strings: Sadani's Maid
Deeply trusted by Sadani, she is entrusted with tasks that Sadani would rather not handle personally.

2000177.title: Seliman's Head
strings: Seliman's Head
Item
Seliman is dead. This bloody head is the proof.

2000178.title: Temporary Shelter
strings: Temporary Shelter
Residence
Because you chose to burn down your own house to please the Sultan, you now have to live in a tent.

2000179.title: Luxurious Residence
strings: Luxurious Residence
Residence
You have pleased the Sultan, and this luxurious residence is a gift from him. Living in this house produces 3 extra Gold Coins every 3 rounds.

2000180.title: Slightly Renovated Residence
strings: Slightly Renovated Residence
Residence
You have slightly renovated your residence. It produces 1 extra Gold Coin every 3 rounds.

2000181.title: Thoroughly Renovated Residence
strings: Thoroughly Renovated Residence
Residence
You have thoroughly renovated your residence. It produces 2 extra Gold Coins every 5 rounds.

2000182.title: Expanded Residence
strings: Expanded Residence
Residence
Your residence has undergone large-scale expansion. It produces 3 extra Gold Coins every 3 rounds.

2000183.title: Wonder
strings: Wonder
Residence
Your house is more luxurious than even the Sultan's residence. It produces 5 extra Gold Coins every 3 rounds.

2000184.title: Double-Headed Dragon
strings: Double-Headed Dragon
Item
An unambiguous sex toy. It may lead to increased enjoyment when used in the right context, but might be disastrous if brought out in the wrong one.

2000185.title: Traces of Black Magic
strings: Traces of Black Magic
Clue
Be careful when looking at these marks: they may pierce your eyes at any moment.

2000186.title: Old Judge's Head
strings: Old Judge's Head
Item
There is no blood in his neck. Lurid green worms of various sizes hide in the drained cavities.

2000187.title: White Honey Amber Orb
strings: White Honey Amber Orb
Item
A sacred gem of great purity, possessing the power to dispel evil. Can only be used once.

2000188.title: The Undying
strings: The Undying
Abomination
Someone who desperately seeks immortality has finally achieved his goal, once and for all.

2000189.title: Badriyyah's Head
strings: Badriyyah's Head
Item
Listen closely. The Occultist's lips yet murmur of hidden mysteries, but it is not her voice...

2000190.title: Captured Cultist
strings: Captured Cultist
Captured
As her limbs go numb, she lets out a moan from the depths of her throat, a sound that makes your legs weak...

2000191.title: Dark Alley Reputation
strings: Dark Alley Reputation
Unused
No noble has ever earned the recognition of the Dark Alley dwellers – only the destitute and vicious can command the rogues. You have fulfilled that condition, perhaps...

2000192.title: Signs of Carnality - Bathhouse
strings: Signs of Carnality - Bathhouse
Signs of Carnality
Someone snuck into the Bathhouse at night and carved a buttocks-shaped groove - right where the two of you had been. Heaven knows how he got your butt size right.

2000193.title: Rain Child · Volume II
strings: Rain Child · Volume II
Special Book

A fantasy novel by the famed poet Seldi, the story is simple and classical, but contains a captivating narrative voice and exceptionally beautiful metaphors. Banned for its contentious religious themes, it is rather hard to acquire. You have Volume I at home. It is one of your wife's favorite books.

2000194.title: Sickness
strings: Sickness
Status
When you are sick, it is hard to get anything done.

2000195.title: Raed
strings: Raed
Leader of the Vagrants

With her messy hair, crooked teeth, and lack of sophistication, one could argue she is nowhere near conventionally attractive. But her crooked smile and the mace in her hand make one overlook these flaws.

2000196.title: Jemor
strings: Jemor
Elder Sand Pirate Brother
Jemor is cynical, forever discontent.

2000197.title: Hamar
strings: Hamar
Younger Sand Pirate Brother
Hamar is crude, brutal, and tireless.

2000198.title: Depression
strings: Depression
Unused
Sometimes, your wife's resentment punishes you. Other times, she tortures herself.

2000199.title: Asal
strings: Asal
Bookstore Owner
His ancestors were once chroniclers for another king. It is said that he remembers every book he has read, allowing him to sell them without any qualms.

2000200.title: Signs of Carnality - Bookstore
strings: Signs of Carnality - Bookstore
Signs of Carnality
The Bookstore Owner found dozens of erotic stories and sex manuals from the warehouse and placed them on the bookshelf the two of you had knocked over.

2000201.title: Stallion
strings: Stallion
Animal
A jet black stallion of divine speed, it is said that it chooses its own master.

2000202.title: Mountain Lion
strings: Mountain Lion
Beast
An exiled male, driven from its pride, ventures dangerously close to the city in the dry season, desperate for prey.

2000281.title: Ring of Inevitability
strings: Ring of Inevitability
Sultan's Signet Ring

Legend has it that only the ruler of the empire can wear this ring, and the owner of this magic ring need only raise his hand to take a life. This is the source of the Sultan's power... You fumble with the ring, finding it impossible to fit any of your fingers in. However, inside the ring, inscriptions burn like flames with the flow of magic – ALL SHALL FADE. With a single glance, it scorches your soul, leaving an indelible mark in your vision. It seems this ring may also lie at the source of the Sultan's madness. Do these words torture him, he whose reign knows no bounds? Do all his possessions lose their luster under this burning verdict? Regardless, a glimmer of hope sprouts from your dark life as you peer through this ring.

2000346.title: Jawad
strings: Jawad
Obese Noble Prisoner
This prisoner is held here for the crime of greed. Though he is now in prison, he maintains his noble pride and pomp. Why not? He will soon leave this hellhole, maybe tomorrow, maybe the day after.

2000347.title: Qais
strings: Qais
Righteous Noble Prisoner
This prisoner is held here for the crime of insubordination. A stone that refuses to smoothen its edges suits not a magnificent palace, but a lowly cell.

2000348.title: Tarquin
strings: Tarquin
Unused
This prisoner is imprisoned for the crime of treason. Ragged and scarred, he is a plaything to the jailers. They have few sources of entertainment, and this one is about to be executed anyway.

2000349.title: Abdul
strings: Abdul
Sultan's Vizier
Everything Abdul enjoys as the vizier – wealth, status, privileges – stems from his diligent service to his master. He is the sharpest blade in the Sultan's arsenal and the court’s most eager jester.

2000350.title: Fardak
strings: Fardak
Royal Hostage from a Vassal Tribe

Fardak comes from a vassal tribe. He was sent by his father to demonstrate the tribe's loyalty to the Sultan. His face still carries traces of a young man's barely concealed resentment – a look the Sultan adores, for it marks him as a perfect plaything.

2000351.title: Ziad
strings: Ziad
Tax Collector

Ziad works diligently and meticulously. Driven by the abundant energy and vigor of youth, he is always trying to understand the causes of the tax anomalies and how to rectify them, rather than, like a seasoned tax collector, manipulating numbers to produce a pleasing report.

2000352.title: Mahir
strings: Mahir
Eccentric Artisan

At banquets, Mahir is often the butt of her fellow noble's jokes. Neurotic and naive, she has no grasp of household affairs and shuts herself away from people, obsessing over absurd and useless studies. How ludicrous, she has debased herself into a mere craftswoman! But what is left unspoken is this: it is exactly those who mock her that have carved up her inheritance to the last scrap.

2000353.title: Ensa
strings: Ensa
Unused

Ensa is an envoy from a distant land, bringing rich and exotic specialties to the Sultan. She is filled with curiosity about this land and spends much of her time wandering its streets, listening to others' stories and giving appropriate responses. She effortlessly blends in with officials, commoners, and merchants alike. After all, who can refuse a warm and generous guest?

2000354.title: Hussain
strings: Hussain
Unused

Hussain is the most renowned court painter in the city, skillful and adept. It is said that his brush was blessed by god. How else could one create such rich and vivid artworks in three short days, while never missing a single banquet?

2000355.title: Kamali
strings: Kamali
Unused

This handsome and humble nobleman was a prince of a long-fallen kingdom. The Sultan spared his life, allowed him to retain his nobility, and gave permission for him to attend his court. People praise the Sultan's benevolence, yet never mention that it was by the Sultan's hand that kingdom fell.

2000356.title: Murtaz
strings: Murtaz
Coward Who Resents the Sultan

No one likes the shady Murtaz. Now that the miserable rat has lost his family and fortune, even more so: people in court avoid him like the plague. But the Sultan enjoys his presence. That is the sole reason Murtaz must continue to attend court: to parade his feeble, impotent hatred for his master's amusement.

2000357.title: Fayda
strings: Fayda
Unused

Fayda comes from an ancient noble line. It is said that his ancestors established their family estate over a thousand years ago, and only moved to this city twenty years ago due to changes in land and climate. But Fayda and his family do not pride themselves on this long history. They treat people with modesty and kindness and rarely voices any opinion in court.

2000358.title: Tarquin
strings: Tarquin
Unused
You have rescued the treacherous noble, but it is best not to let him return to the Sultan's palace. An oasis nomad will find no friends there, only enemies.

2000366.title: China
strings: China
Legendary Land

Manar has found a paradise far beyond the Sultan's control. It is powerful, wealthy, and peaceful. For the first time in a long while, she saw genuine smiles on people's faces. If you wish to escape the Sultan's Game for good, this is your best choice. Keep this secret from the Sultan.

The righteous who are dissatisfied with the tyranny of the Sultan, the overburdened peasants, and the displaced herdsmen have gathered together to form an army. They are willing to serve you after hearing of your good name.

2000377.title: Rebel Troop
strings: Rebel Troop

The oppressed have risen up.

2000378.title: Noble's Corpse
strings: Noble's Corpse

A corpse of a noble.

strings: Noble Family's Warrior

A warrior in service to a noble family, here to avenge the dead.

2000380.title: Mirror of Stars

A precise instrument made by Mahir, capable of peering into the depths of the distant starry sky, capturing those dim yet eternal glimmers of light.

2000381.title: Crystal Lens

2000382.title: Water of Life

2000384.title: Heretic's Head

You claim this is the head of a heretic, and the holy judgment on this heretic is not yet complete.

2000385.title: Big Bomb
strings: Big Bomb

A big bomb lovingly crafted by Mahir. Powerful enough to blow through the city walls with ease.

2000386.title: Flamethrower
strings: Flamethrower

A weapon lovingly crafted by Mahir that sprays flames and catches people off guard.

2000387.title: Mechanical Horse

A mount lovingly crafted by Mahir. Looks rather ridiculous, but – against all odds – it moves.

2000388.title: Hot Air Balloon
strings: Hot Air Balloon

2000667.title: Dragonslaying Supplies

2000668.title: Dragon's Eye

2000669.title: Charred Armor
