Armor destroyed by dragon's breath. The metal was melted in blazing flames and cast with scorching blood, resulting in this charred, shapeless thing.

2000670.title: Beauty Ointment
strings: Beauty Ointment
Consumable
A salve Maggie prepared for Adila, with a spare casually handed to you. For scar removal, she says... Such a convenient thing, why was it not offered sooner?

2000671.title: Book of Dragonslaying
strings: Book of Dragonslaying
Book
A book passed down through Adila's family, said to hold secrets about the dragonkind.

2000672.title: Sultan's Suspicion
strings: Sultan's Suspicion
Special

2000673.title: Army's Approval
strings: Army's Approval
Special
Since your policies benefit them, they naturally favor you.

2000674.title: Commoner's Approval
strings: Commoner's Approval
Special
Since your policies benefit them, they naturally favor you.

2000675.title: Nobility's Approval
strings: Nobility's Approval
Special
Since your policies benefit them, they naturally favor you.

2000676.title: Budget Deficit
strings: Budget Deficit
Deficit
The hole seems bottomless.

2000677.title: Army's Support
strings: Army's Support
Special
For the army sworn to protect the Sultan to remain neutral, that is already the greatest support to you.

2000678.title: Commoner's Support
strings: Commoner's Support
Special
When the common people side with you, you gain eyes and ears everywhere.

2000679.title: Nobility's Support
strings: Nobility's Support
Special
The ruling class sides with you. You are now above reproach.

2000680.title: The Sultan's Suspicion
strings: The Sultan's Suspicion
Suspicion
You should find a way to eliminate it within 7 days. You do not want to know what the Sultan will do once his patience is exhausted.

2000681.title: Rumor of Impotence
strings: Rumor of Impotence
Status
A rumor that reached the Sultan's ears.

2000682.title: Sickly Appearance
strings: Sickly Appearance
Seamstress' Styling
As if aged thirty years in a day.

2000683.title: Vacant Mansion
strings: Vacant Mansion
Location
Property seized after dealing with the madam of the Dark Alley Brothel.

2000684.title: Abusive Man
strings: Abusive Man
Neighbor
Your neighbor, a fallen noble. The sounds of violent quarrels and a woman's helpless cries can often be heard from his home.

2000685.title: Common Astronomical Phenomenon A
strings: Common Astronomical Phenomenon A
Unused
A common astronomical phenomenon.

2000686.title: Common Astronomical Phenomenon B
strings: Common Astronomical Phenomenon B
Unused
A common astronomical phenomenon.

2000687.title: Rare Astronomical Phenomenon A
strings: Rare Astronomical Phenomenon A
Unused
A rare astronomical phenomenon, seems to carry some omen.

2000688.title: Rare Astronomical Phenomenon B
strings: Rare Astronomical Phenomenon B
Unused
A rare astronomical phenomenon, seems to carry some omen.

2000689.title: Sense of Happiness
strings: Sense of Happiness
Status
Maggie remembers a time when you made her feel happy, safe. The echo of happiness lingers in her heart, leaving it unguarded and tender.

2000690.title: Flowers of the Empire
strings: Flowers of the Empire
Special

A popular list of the empire's most beautiful women, with Nayla ranked seventh. Beside her portrait, the names of men rumored to have shared a night with her are listed, filling an entire page. The names of the women ahead of her have been scratched out with nails, and a series of vicious curses are scrawled in bright red ink beside them.

2000691.title: Flowers of the Empire (Tattered Page)
strings: Flowers of the Empire (Tattered Page)
Material

This tattered page still holds a portrait of your wife, smiling gently. Perhaps the Jeweler could find a way to restore it. Using this page in a corresponding attribute check grants +2 Sociability and provides 2 reroll opportunities.

2000692.title: Draconic Dialogue
strings: Draconic Dialogue
Special
You conversed with a dragon, once upon a dream.

2000693.title: Silver Pendant
strings: Silver Pendant
Accessory
A silver pendant exquisitely crafted by The Jeweler, which opens to reveal Maggie's smiling face. Perhaps you are imagining things, but every time you see it, your heart finds momentary peace.

2000694.title: Double Dragon
strings: Double Dragon
Weapon
A novel weapon born from an accident, still marked by the fights it had seen.

2000695.title: Expensive Spices
strings: Expensive Spices
Consumable
An expensive spice with remarkable effects, works wonders if used in the right place.

2000696.title: Blood Drop Earrings
strings: Blood Drop Earrings
Accessory
Earrings made from an enormous ruby. When light hits it, you can almost see blood coursing within.

2000697.title: Lustrous Silk
strings: Lustrous Silk
Material
A material of singular quality. Merchants who trade across nations might prize it, though keeping it for your own use is equally tempting.

2000698.title: Nayla's Resentment
strings: Nayla's Resentment
Resentment
You failed to satisfy Nayla's request. She is rather displeased.

2000699.title: Old Slave Woman
strings: Old Slave Woman
Slave
You bought her back out of momentary kindness. Sickly and frail, she looks like she has one foot in the grave already.

2000700.title: More Educated Servant
strings: More Educated Servant
Special
The Old Slave Woman has trained your servants and improved their skilled. They can now provide more assistance to you during Managing the Estate.

2000701.title: Silver Ring
strings: Silver Ring
Accessory
A plain silver ring with an inscription inside: "May you grow up healthy and happy."

2000702.title: Nayla's Joy List
strings: Nayla's Joy List
Special
This scented parchment bears an array of wildly imaginative names. Some have already been delicately crossed out.

2000703.title: Gem of Purification
strings: Gem of Purification
Consumable
Can instantly remove a Cursed effect, single-use.

2000704.title: True Warriors of the Empire, Ranked
strings: True Warriors of the Empire, Ranked
Book
Penned by Nayla from her firsthand experience, this volume brims with sharp critiques and scandalous secrets. Unsuitable for minors – and ill-advised for reading in the presence of one’s spouse.

2000705.title: True Warriors of the Empire, Ranked
strings: True Warriors of the Empire, Ranked
Book
Penned by Nayla from her firsthand experience, this volume brims with sharp critiques and scandalous secrets. Unsuitable for minors – and ill-advised for reading in the presence of one’s spouse.

2000706.title: True Warriors of the Empire, Ranked
strings: True Warriors of the Empire, Ranked
Book
Penned by Nayla from her firsthand experience, this volume brims with sharp critiques and scandalous secrets. Unsuitable for minors – and ill-advised for reading in the presence of one’s spouse.

2000707.title: Behind the Veil of Sand
strings: Behind the Veil of Sand
Book
The tale of a pilgrim's journey through the desert. First time reading this book grants you Wisdom +1. Reading it triggers the Boundless Sands adventure.

2000708.title: Wuthering Winds
strings: Wuthering Winds
Book
The story of a storm-ridden canyon. First time reading this book grants you Survival +1. Reading it triggers the Canyon of Gales adventure.

2000709.title: Treasure Raiders
strings: Treasure Raiders
Book
The story of adventurers breaching a temple in search of treasures. First time reading this book grants you Stealth +1. Reading it triggers The Umbrous Temple adventure.

2000710.title: In the Land of the Jinns
strings: In the Land of the Jinns
Book

The fairy tale of how a woodcutter who lost his ways deep in the forest encountered jinns. First time reading this book grants you Sociability +1. Reading it triggers the Forest of the Jinn adventure.

2000711.title: Giant Wolf's Head
strings: Giant Wolf's Head
Trophy
A hunting trophy, proof of a conquest. Put it in Methinks.

2000712.title: Fierce Giant Wolf
strings: Fierce Giant Wolf
Beast
A ferocious giant wolf wandering around the city.

2000713.title: Rhythms of Change
strings: Rhythms of Change
Consumable
The moon wanes and waxes, and the world shifts in accordance. Used as Intelligence, it can provide +5 Magic, +5 Stealth, and 3 reroll opportunities. You can also think more on its potential use.

2000714.title: Paths Eternal
strings: Paths Eternal
Consumable
A record of the sun's movements, charting the paths of the zodiac and other astral patterns. Contains potent mystic powers. Unlock its use in Methinks.

2000715.title: The Sun's Companion
strings: The Sun's Companion
Consumable
Recordings of variations in Mercury's movements and aetheric tremors. Used as Intelligence, it can provide +5 Magic and 8 reroll opportunities. You can also think more on its potential use.

2000716.title: Morning Star
strings: Morning Star
Consumable
The star that signals the coming of dawn, records of its rising and setting. Used as Intelligence, it can provide +5 Intellect. You can also think more on its potential use.

2000717.title: Malefic Flares
strings: Malefic Flares
Consumable

Conjectures on the correlation between earthly affairs and the movements of the baleful Mars. Used as Intelligence, it can provide +5 Combat and 1 reroll opportunity. You can also think more on its potential use.

2000718.title: Trajectory of Time
strings: Trajectory of Time
Consumable

Record of a bright star appearing and disappearing in different celestial spheres. Used as Intelligence, it can provide +4 Magic, +4 Intellect, and 2 reroll opportunities. You can also think more on its potential use.

2000719.title: The Measurements of Heaven
strings: The Measurements of Heaven
Consumable
Record of a star whose orbit is as precise as a clock. Used as Intelligence, it can provide +4 Sociability and +4 Survival. You can also think more on its potential use.

2000720.title: Sunless Sky
strings: Sunless Sky
Consumable
It is traditional for solar eclipses to serve as warnings to the monarch against slanders and rumormongers. You can also unlock its potentials in Methinks.

2000721.title: Night without Light
strings: Night without Light
Consumable
It is traditional for lunar eclipses to serve as warnings to the monarch against slanders and rumormongers. You can also unlock its potentials in Methinks.

2000722.title: Portents of Madness
strings: Portents of Madness
Consumable
Observational records of an inauspicious star, radiating malice. Used as Intelligence, it can provide +6 Magic and 3 reroll opportunities. You can also think more on its potential use.

2000723.title: Rationality
strings: Rationality
Consumable

The human mind, compared to the world, to higher powers, is as an island in an endless ocean. Insignificant, weak, to be devoured by some disaster at any moment. Even so, a lighthouse stands erect on this island: rationality.

2000724.title: Impure Thoughts
strings: Impure Thoughts
Conviction

A pitch-black dried-up well, a bowl of worm-infested fruit, a strangely shaped swaying tree shadow, some impure thoughts. You can proselytize through Methinks, then synthesize more advanced Conviction during the Headless Dragons.

2000725.title: Pure Thoughts
strings: Pure Thoughts
Conviction

Nothing exists here; this is purity. This is the Primitive Conviction of the True Faith. The Righteous Path needs no proselytizing from you, but after accumulating 3 Pieties, you can upgrade the True Faith through Methinks.

2000726.title: Divine Touch
strings: Divine Touch
Conviction

A single touch can dispel much impurity. This is the Foundational Conviction of the True Faith. The True Faith needs no proselytizing from you, but after accumulating 3 Pieties, you can upgrade the True Faith through Methinks.

2000727.title: Pledge of Atonement
strings: Pledge of Atonement
Conviction

Humans innately desire to replicate themselves; this is original sin. The True Faith needs no proselytizing from you, but after accumulating 3 Pieties, you can upgrade the True Faith through Methinks.

2000728.title: As Above, So Below
strings: As Above, So Below
Conviction
Before being blessed by the Immaculate Purity, you had no concept of perfection.

2000729.title: Wolf Head Scarf
strings: Wolf Head Scarf
Accessory
A scarf made by Jenna from the wolf's head. Absolutely terrifying.

2000730.title: Familiar Fighting Style
strings: Familiar Fighting Style
Clue
This person's fighting style feels very familiar to you. You may have fought them before.

2000731.title: Pugilist's Proof
strings: Pugilist's Proof
Clue
Shocking! You won’t believe what the Sultan’s personal guard does in secret!!! Decide how to handle this in Methinks.

2000732.title: Stone Lunchbox
strings: Stone Lunchbox
Weapon
When you picked it up, you did not think it would be such a handy weapon.

2000733.title: General's Sword
strings: General's Sword
Weapon
Jabal's sword. Not a trophy from the battlefield or a gift from a friend, nor does it bear any enemy's hatred.

2000734.title: Fine Camel Bone Flute
strings: Fine Camel Bone Flute
Accessory
A fine, ancient bone flute inscribed with a script you do not recognize.

2000735.title: A Crowd of Radicals
strings: A Crowd of Radicals
Passerby
The young ones, aflame with their own youth, declaim and pontificate about politics with reckless fervor.

2000736.title: Radical Noble
strings: Radical Noble
Noble
The nobles gather in their salons, their murmured conversations laced with the scent of treason.

2000737.title: Troop of Radicals
strings: Troop of Radicals
Army
There is no doubt – your words have shaped them. Their blades thirst for the heat of battle and blood. Raise your banner, and they will follow, seeking not glory, but change.

2000738.title: Cocksure Noble
strings: Cocksure Noble
Ladies' Man?
A rat-faced, shifty-eyed noble who fancies himself a match for Nabhani in terms of charm, prone to making unwelcome advances toward women.

2000739.title: Dust-Clad Blade
strings: Dust-Clad Blade
Weapon
An heirloom of the Qais family. An ancient sword, its once-noble edge dulled by neglect. Whatever glory it once bore has long since faded.

2000740.title: Fate of the Qais Title?
strings: Fate of the Qais Title?
Clue
The Qais family's hereditary rank has been revoked. Was it cast into obscurity, or does a path remain to reclaim it? You might glean whispers of its fate in The Grand Game, by asking your colleagues.

2000741.title: Qais Family Hereditary Title
strings: Qais Family Hereditary Title
Special
Only with this can the ancient glory of the Qais name be passed down through generations.

2000742.title: Ancient Ring
strings: Ancient Ring
Accessory
An ancient ring that has seen the death of mountains, and the rising of fertile fields from where there once was a sea.

2000743.title: Reclusive Noble
strings: Reclusive Noble
Noble
A noble distressed by the Sultan's tyranny. To fund his journey away from this city, he is selling his own title.

2000744.title: Troop of Radicals
strings: Troop of Radicals
Army
There is no doubt – your words have shaped them. Their blades thirst for the heat of battle and blood. Raise your banner, and they will follow, seeking not glory, but change.

2000745.title: Troop of Fanatics
strings: Troop of Fanatics
Army
There is no doubt – your words have shaped them. They raise their blades to justice and hope, but in truth, they fight for Darkness, for you.

2000746.title: Troop of Fanatics
strings: Troop of Fanatics
Army
There is no doubt – your words have shaped them. They raise their blades to justice and hope, but in truth, they fight for Darkness, for you.

2000747.title: Amber Pendant
strings: Amber Pendant
Accessory
Faraj's gift. If the sun could weep, this amber would be its tear.

2000748.title: Radical Noble
strings: Radical Noble
Noble
The young crowd the salons, restless as floodwaters straining against a dam. They do not seek reform. They seek ruin – for a world that has never been fair to them.

2000749.title: Cape of Spring
strings: Cape of Spring
Attire
A cape with golden embroidered scenes of coitus, unsuitable for any respectable social occasion.

2000750.title: Ceremonial Saber
strings: Ceremonial Saber
Weapon
Primarily decorative.

2000751.title: Resolve
strings: Resolve
Mettle
You cut down Nabhani's friend in the name of a Bloodshed Card. Now, he comes in vengeance.

2000752.title: Nabhani's Sword
strings: Nabhani's Sword
Weapon
Nabhani's treasured blade. It has been a long time since it was last drawn.

2000753.title: Note within a Book
strings: Note within a Book
Clue
On it is a remote and suspicious address...

2000754.title: Futile Charity
strings: Futile Charity
Clue
A question Nawfal left with you, worth pondering over, even though it may not have a solution.

2000755.title: Deadline for an Answer
strings: Deadline for an Answer
Countdown
A deadline you set for yourself, knowing that endless contemplation is the path to madness...

2000756.title: Forgotten Ritual
strings: Forgotten Ritual
Book
Knowledge possessed by the oldest noble houses. Qais, who has served the Sultan for many long years, comes from one of such families.

2000757.title: Ritual of Harvest
strings: Ritual of Harvest
Cult Ritual
Inside the scroll is some sort of strange sacrificial ritual. Only the oldest noble houses would have knowledge pertaining to such things.

2000758.title: Ritual of the Hearth
strings: Ritual of the Hearth
Cult Ritual
Inside the scroll is some sort of strange sacrificial ritual. Only the oldest noble houses would have knowledge pertaining to such things.

2000759.title: Ritual of Sword and Shield
strings: Ritual of Sword and Shield
Cult Ritual
Inside the scroll is some sort of strange sacrificial ritual. Only the oldest noble houses would have knowledge pertaining to such things.

2000760.title: Blessing of Harvest
strings: Blessing of Harvest
Special
An ancient blessing, can be placed in Managing the Estate to increase Gold Coin production.

2000761.title: Wooden Apple
strings: Wooden Apple
Special
A rough wood carving, a token of gratitude from the children.

2000762.title: King of Flames
strings: King of Flames
Special

A legend of your own design and making… Of course, when left to gather dust, it’s little more than a costume to fool children. Only when it runs through the night do human fear and hope together bestow upon it a divine glow.

2000763.title: King of Flames' Army
strings: King of Flames' Army
Army
A group of farmers and slaves gathered under the banner of the King of Flames.

2000764.title: Young Noble
strings: Young Noble
Noble
One of the nobles attending Nawfal's banquet. Passionate and eloquent, prone to grandiose speeches.

2000765.title: Ample Noble
strings: Ample Noble
Noble
One of the nobles attending Nawfal's banquet. Ample in wealth and physique.

2000766.title: Elderly Noble
strings: Elderly Noble
Noble
One of the nobles attending Nawfal's banquet. Sorrow and age have carved deep lines on his face.

2000767.title: Unnamed Cellar Reserve
strings: Unnamed Cellar Reserve
Fine Liquor
Gift from Nawfal. A fine wine with a complex, lingering fruitwood aroma, uncommon in this city.

2000768.title: Tidbits on the Vizier
strings: Tidbits on the Vizier
Evidence
Scoop of the Vizier consorting with male prostitute, witnessed by over a dozen nobles, guaranteed to be true.

2000769.title: A Cut Rope
strings: A Cut Rope
Special
May we break free from our bindings, you and I both. Looking at it, recalling the words shared and interrogation answered, even the most troubled mind will find peace in the storm.

2000770.title: Barbarian Slave
strings: Barbarian Slave
Slave on Offer

Her hands are shackled tight behind her back, yet she still lashes out, kicking at the slaver who holds her chain. Her eyes are those of a jackal roaming the wastes – uneasy, feral, and brimming with menace.

2000771.title: Riel
strings: Riel
Barbarian War Maiden
She has the eyes of a jackal prowling the wilderness, filled with unease and peril. No one has ever made her known submission. No one ever will.

2000772.title: Salwiyah
strings: Salwiyah
The Cuckoo
She wields her voice, her tears, and her beauty like a blade – to pry open a man’s heart and take whatever she desires.

2000773.title: Habunah
strings: Habunah
The Weaver
Her hands are deft, her craft exquisite. Fortune flows through her looms in an endless stream of silk and gold – inspiring, inspiring envy.

2000774.title: Arumina
strings: Arumina
Jawad's daughter.
The prideful and willful Arumina is the light of Jawad's life.

2000775.title: A Little Vial
strings: A Little Vial
Consumable
A vial of mysterious potion from Nabhani, its effects need not be said... Use in Methinks to give +1 Physique to a male Character.

2000776.title: Expensive Gold Veil
strings: Expensive Gold Veil
Accessory
Miss Arumina's veil. Costly.

2000777.title: Gladiator
strings: Gladiator
Enemy
Jawad paid good money for this gladiator. He will serve as Jawad's champion in any duel.

2000778.title: Elegant Blue Gauze
strings: Elegant Blue Gauze
Material
A beautiful gauze woven by Habunah's own hands, a liquid-like light flows down its dark surface. One of a kind. You may gift it to an ally in Methinks, or ask Jenna to craft it into an Accessory.

2000779.title: Azure Scarf
strings: Azure Scarf
Accessory
A scarf Jenna made from the elegant blue gauze, its flowing light reminiscent of endless sea waves – halcyon, carefree, carrying all your worries away.

2000780.title: Blue Turban Army
strings: Blue Turban Army
Army
They all wear a blue scarf, be it from Habunah's shop, or made from the most common fabric. They support you. They support freedom.

2000781.title: Jawad's Henchmen
strings: Jawad's Henchmen
Enemy
Jawad's henchmen. They are loyal to money and money alone, but that is fine by Jawad – even here in the capital, few can name a price higher than his.

2000782.title: Corrupt Officials
strings: Corrupt Officials
Enemy
Corrupt officials in the Sultan's court. They have long been colluding with Jawad, causing rampant bribery.

2000783.title: Jawad's Advantage
strings: Jawad's Advantage
Advantage
This means he's started spending money to deal with you.

2000784.title: Dark Alley Warrior
strings: Dark Alley Warrior
Challenger
A warrior from the Dark Alley. He will defeat you to prove who's boss.

2000785.title: Martial Master
strings: Martial Master
Challenger
A warrior incited by Nabhani to challenge you. He has a well honed body – it would be better if he is clothed.

2000786.title: Spellblade
strings: Spellblade
Challenger
A spellblade from a foreign land, challenging you for a prostitute's hand.

2000787.title: Familiar
strings: Familiar
Challenger
Your challenger claims that this horrid monster is part of his power. If you are afraid, surrender.

2000789.title: Luscious Prostitute
strings: Luscious Prostitute
Challenger?
To make it here, beauty alone is not enough.

2000790.title: Indulgence Necklace
strings: Indulgence Necklace
Accessory
A gold necklace crafted from a copious amount of gold, with a small inscription: To my pearl, Arumina.

2000791.title: Masked Libertine
strings: Masked Libertine
Guest at the House of Delights
A masked person, nothing special other than that.

2000792.title: Buthayna
strings: Buthayna
Madam of the House of Delights

The still-radiant Madam Buthayna is the ostensible mistress of the House of Delights. Whispers claim that in her youth, she was so breathtaking that even the late Sultan sought her company beneath her silken canopy.

2000793.title: Gem-Studded Dagger
strings: Gem-Studded Dagger
Weapon
A dagger with a gemstone-inlaid hilt, evidently costly, more decorative than utilitarian.

2000794.title: Murad Tus
strings: Murad Tus
Arumina's Husband
He was once your slave Zephyr. Now he is a noble.

2000795.title: Zephyr's Wife
strings: Zephyr's Wife
Your Slave
She was once a noble lady. Now she is a humble slave.

2000796.title: The Sultan's Fury
strings: The Sultan's Fury
Unused
The Sultan's unprompted fury.

2000797.title: The Old Garden
strings: The Old Garden
Book

A book of lyrical poetry. In tottering steps, the poet ponders through a garden of lost splendors, reminiscing on the wonders of youth. After reading this book, you gain Charisma +2 and Stealth +1. You need at least 3 in Wisdom to read it.

2000798.title: The Book of Kings
strings: The Book of Kings
Book
How this land remembers its monarchs. To avoid unwanted attention, some names have been blotted out. After reading this book, you gain Wisdom +1 and Sociability +1.

2000799.title: Long Overdue
strings: Long Overdue
Book

A collection sharp and poised as its heroine. It recounts how the poetess, far from home, found courage in hatred, and strength in solitude. After reading this book, you gain Stealth +1 and Combat +1.

2000800.title: An Immortal's Kiss
strings: An Immortal's Kiss
Book

A strange book. Its pages are empty but for the tiny burnt holes. If you align the holes, the pages curl into strange shapes... Codes left behind by occultists of yore, perhaps. After reading this book, you gain Stealth +1 and Magic +1. You need at least 4 in Wisdom to read it.

2000801.title: Jungle! Jungle!
strings: Jungle! Jungle!
Book

Adventure stories from some placed called "Jungle". Apparently it is a land strangled by trees, where monkeys outnumber people... Pure fabrications, surely? After reading this book, you gain Survival +1 and Stealth +1.

2000802.title: The Madame's Gold Slipper
strings: The Madame's Gold Slipper
Book

A romance novel popular decades back, about how a noble lady "lost" her slipper, in order to seduce a young officer. How lavish of her. After reading this book, you gain After reading this book, you gain Charisma +1.

2000803.title: Book of the Wild
strings: Book of the Wild
Book
Those who dwell in the wilderness survive only by surrendering their fate to nature. It contains many recipes utilizing the simplest ingredients. After reading this book, you gain Survival +3.

2000804.title: White Weasels Court
strings: White Weasels Court
Book

Some farce about how a colony of white weasels took over the court and elected the biggest weasel as Sultan... How is this book not banned already? After reading this book, you gain Wisdom +2, Sociability +1.

2000805.title: A Game of Marbles
strings: A Game of Marbles
Book

A fantasy novel about a meritocratic nation, where the only measurement of merit is how well one plays marbles. The better one plays, the higher one climbs... You remember playing marbles as a child. After reading this book, you gain Magic +1 and Wisdom +1.

2000806.title: L.O.Q.U.A.C.I.O.U.S. 100
strings: L.O.Q.U.A.C.I.O.U.S. 100
Book

Its full title is Logical Overview of 100 Questions Underpinning Abstract Concepts in Intellectual and Ontological Understanding of Scholarship – a synopsis is presumed to be redundant. After reading this book, you gain Wisdom +4. You need at least 5 in Wisdom to read it.

2000807.title: Do Not Stare at the Stars
strings: Do Not Stare at the Stars
Book

A strange book. The entire book consists of a single sentence, repeated over and over and over again. "Do not stare at the stars." From how the book is bound, it must be old – perhaps from the era when the Star-souled were still widely worshiped? After reading this book, you gain Magic +3 and Insight +1.

2000808.title: The Little Spider's Web
strings: The Little Spider's Web
Book
A children's book about how a little spider spent the last moments of its finite life creating fond memories for its friends. The only book suitable for children in the entire bookstore, probably.

2000809.title: Classic Terrace Buffet
strings: Classic Terrace Buffet
Unused

2000810.title: Smoked Game with Sorrel
strings: Smoked Game with Sorrel
Unused

2000811.title: Sweet Rice with Lingonberries
strings: Sweet Rice with Lingonberries
Unused

2000812.title: Herb-Braised Rabbit
strings: Herb-Braised Rabbit
Unused

2000813.title: Gold Coin
strings: Gold Coin
Currency
Jawad has promised 20 Gold Coins in exchange for Zephyr. A lucrative offer.

2000814.title: Gilded Bronze Slippers
strings: Gilded Bronze Slippers
Attire
Though the Sultan has strictly forbidden the fashions and jewels of the former Sultan's reign from flourishing within his empire, beauty attracts.

2000815.title: Engraved Comb
strings: Engraved Comb
Accessory

A hair comb engraved with abstruse runes and astrological signs. Perhaps it was a ritual implement, once upon a time. But under the current Sultan's reign, it is just another piece of decoration for elaborate hairstyles.

2000816.title: Silver Incense Burner
strings: Silver Incense Burner
Accessory
A little incense burner to be carried on the belt. Intricately designed with a double-layered silver net, it can hold and burn incense inside it, without the worry of spillage.

2000817.title: Cape of an Ancient Weave
strings: Cape of an Ancient Weave
Attire

This ancient fabric of meticulously woven silk once featured the profile of an ancient deity. However, the creator of the cloak deliberately severed the deity’s head, leaving only the majestic body. Perhaps this was done to avoid drawing attention from the Sultan and the clergy to the wearer, or perhaps it was born of a deeper, more personal hatred for the deity itself.

2000818.title: Gold Drinking Horn
strings: Gold Drinking Horn
Accessory
Once rewarded only to the most outstanding warriors during the Sultan's father's time, this drinking horn overflows with pride and glory. How did it end up here?

2000819.title: Soldier's Protective Charm
strings: Soldier's Protective Charm
Accessory
A tiny silver box, lined with red velvet. Within which is a piece of tightly folded paper that read: "Though hundreds may die, let it not be my love. If only one lives, let it be my love."

2000820.title: Jade Arm Ring
strings: Jade Arm Ring
Accessory
A beautiful jade circlet. An arm ring for the slim, but for the strong, it barely fits as a bracelet.

2000821.title: Pomegranate Garden
strings: Pomegranate Garden
Accessory

A beautiful circlet wrought by a talented craftswoman. A noble by birth, she was forced into hiding after her family's downfall. But thanks to the friendship of an influential courtier, she found her way back to the forge. This piece was inspired by of dream of hers. In the dream, she was back in the garden of the old estate: pomegranates were in full bloom, the water fountain sang, and people laughed...

2000822.title: Guardian Beast Bracelet
strings: Guardian Beast Bracelet
Accessory
The fierce guardian beast will protect its wearer from hardship – at least that is the hope.

2000823.title: Ring of the Lovebirds
strings: Ring of the Lovebirds
Accessory

A pair of lovebirds looking away from each other. Tiny mechanisms hide beneath their delicate heads. With a flick, their heads will turn to look at each other and the compartment hidden in the underside of the ring will open up. It is filled with poison. Words inscribed on the inner side read: You are my doom, and I am willing.

2000824.title: Delicate Gold Earrings
strings: Delicate Gold Earrings
Accessory
For a noble lady, to leave the house without jewelries amounts to the same as running around naked.

2000825.title: Golden Ram Earrings
strings: Golden Ram Earrings
Accessory
A pair of ancient earrings. Under the ram on the left is carved "The Eternal Watcher". There are similar carvings on the right, but only the word for "poetry" remains legible.

2000826.title: Chariot Necklace
strings: Chariot Necklace
Accessory
Generals wear such heavy necklaces to war. If they do not return, their chariots will be buried with them.

2000827.title: Noble Cavalry's Saber
strings: Noble Cavalry's Saber
Weapon

A noble cavalryman's treasured saber, with full enamel decorations and a hilt shaped like a warhorse and its rider who is just about to embark. It is no easy task to balance such intricate craftsmanship and durability of the weapon. No warrior can refuse such a blade.

2000828.title: Standard Military Scimitar
strings: Standard Military Scimitar
Weapon
Standard issue of the Sultan's army, its wrought steel blade conquered nations after nations.

2000829.title: Full Moon Scimitar
strings: Full Moon Scimitar
Weapon
Deadliest on the days when the moon is as full as the curves of its blade.

2000830.title: Dagger of Chaste
strings: Dagger of Chaste
Weapon

Every princess of the lost kingdom would receive a curved dagger upon her coming of age. If her purity is under threat, she should use it to end her life. The truth remains that it is mostly used to pierce the offender's throat.

2000831.title: Ikar and Husam
strings: Ikar and Husam
Weapon

The final work of a famed pair of swordsmiths. The male blade gleams gold, while its counterpart is silver chased with emerald. When the two sink into flesh together, they sing with a low, exultant hum.

2000832.title: Winged Pauldron
strings: Winged Pauldron
Attire
Exaggerated pauldrons worn by the cavalry and the honor guards. Particular training is required to maintain balance in them.

2000833.title: Monarch's Armor
strings: Monarch's Armor
Attire

...You did not name this thing. You have no intention of claiming such a grandiose title. The name is literally inscribed on the inside of this beautiful suit of armor – which is indeed befitting of a monarch.

2000834.title: Shield and Helmet
strings: Shield and Helmet
Attire
A set of high quality protective gears that are both durable and light. On a battlefield, they will save your life. Additionally, a helmet stand is included in the set. Beautiful craftsmanship.

2000835.title: Shield of Abbara
strings: Shield of Abbara
Accessory

The surface of this round shield is etched with a masterful depiction of the Sultan’s triumph at the Gorge of Abbara, where the armies of the previous Sultan was crushed. Of course, there are seditious whispers – that the Sultan did not conquer the capital through war, but traitorous treachery... The official tale remains official: a hard-fought victory, a triumphant return, and the severed head of a fallen monarch raised high as the faithful roared their the name of their Sultan.

2000836.title: The Smiling Helmet
strings: The Smiling Helmet
Attire
It keeps smiling. So will you.

2000837.title: Executioner's Axe
strings: Executioner's Axe
Weapon
Originally the executioner's instrument of trade, now occasional seen in street fights.

2000838.title: Lunar Breastplate
strings: Lunar Breastplate
Attire

Gilded lunar phases adorn this breastplate, tracing the silent passage of time. An inscription reads: The moon our ancestors once saw has waned. It has been aged by the loneliness of those who came after.

2000839.title: Crystal Dagger
strings: Crystal Dagger
Weapon
A thin layer of blue glaze covers the blade. Those who fall victim to its sharpness oft mistake it for crystal.

2000840.title: Captured Cultist
strings: Captured Cultist
Captured
Cultists who worship the Stone Deity have been captured by you.

2000841.title: Malum in se?
strings: Malum in se?
A manifestation of the True God.
Wanting to survive, to feel joy, to be safe and carefree... these desires all lead to evil acts, so should we abandon life, happiness, and security?

2000842.title: The Calling From Afar
strings: The Calling From Afar
A manifestation of the True God.
Indistinct voices, at first like whispers, upon closer listening becoming music, and if you close your eyes and listen with your heart, you hear nothing at all.

2000843.title: The Creator
strings: The Creator
A manifestation of the True God.
To create within chaos, combining all possible materials, revealing infinite possibilities... this is the authority I bestow upon you.

2000844.title: The Creeping Rot
strings: The Creeping Rot
A manifestation of the True God.
Ah... warm decay, intimate maggots, come, come, come to my side...

2000845.title: Bonum in se?
strings: Bonum in se?
A manifestation of the True God.
Wanting to share joy, to help others, to preserve beauty... these desires lead to good deeds, but are sharing, helping, and protecting necessarily right?

2000846.title: The Voice from Above
strings: The Voice from Above
A manifestation of the True God.
Noble voices, at first like chanting, upon closer listening becoming music, and if you close your eyes and listen with your heart, it sounds like metal scraping against metal.

2000847.title: The Immaculate Purity
strings: The Immaculate Purity
A manifestation of the True God.
To sleep in purity, allowing body and mind to enter the void, free from all troubles... this is the authority I bestow upon you.

2000848.title: The Destroyer
strings: The Destroyer
A manifestation of the True God.
Destroy. Purge. Return to emptiness. You cannot resist. Destroy. Now.

2000849.title: Rumormonger
strings: Rumormonger
Enemy
He actively approached you, wanting to cut open your chest. What a joke?!

2000850.title: Reputation
strings: Reputation
Special
More fragile than power, more direct than words, more precious than life.

2000851.title: Fragile Slave Girl
strings: Fragile Slave Girl
Slave on Offer
This frail and thin girl has the most extraordinary violet eyes, full of tears and words unsaid, it takes a heart of stone to ignore them.

2000852.title: Talented Slave Girl
strings: Talented Slave Girl
Slave on Offer
She appears unremarkable, but her silence and quiet endurance suggest a spirit far stronger than the brittle grass that blows in the wind.

2000853.title: Perilous Trail
strings: Perilous Trail
Location
Records of a forgotten trail leading to distant lands. With discretion, one may establish a quiet trade with them in Managing the Estate.

2000854.title: Kaplan's End
strings: Kaplan's End
Weapon
A cold blade to the throat: this is how many a noble bloodline ends.

2000855.title: Desert Warfare
strings: Desert Warfare
Book
After reading this book, you gain Combat +3.

2000856.title: Stone's Spark
strings: Stone's Spark
Book
After reading this book, you gain Magic +3.

2000857.title: Back and Forth
strings: Back and Forth
Book
After reading this book, you gain Wisdom +3.

2000858.title: Crown of Morning Dews
strings: Crown of Morning Dews
Accessory
Pearls so full and bright, they gleam like morning dews. Nothing gold can stay, unless someone treasures it with all their heart.

2000859.title: Refugee Army
strings: Refugee Army
Army
Fardak and his loyal general gathered those who have lost their homes to the drought and trained them into a hardy troop.

2000860.title: Mysterious Stranger
strings: Mysterious Stranger
Refugee
A mysterious man that walks with Fardak, addressed by him as "General".
The Chosen One
You, a poor soul caught in the Sultan's Game.

2000862.title: A Cover of Renown
strings: A Cover of Renown
Special
Your good name will cover you as you prepare for an escape.

2000863.title: A Cover of Influence
strings: A Cover of Influence
Special
Your influence will cover you as you prepare for an escape.

2000864.title: A Cover of Notoriety
strings: A Cover of Notoriety
Special
Your notoriety will cover you as you prepare for an escape.

2000865.title: A Cover of Insight
strings: A Cover of Insight
Special
Your insight will cover you as you prepare for an escape.

2000866.title: Packed Valuables
strings: Packed Valuables
Special
Your wealth, a reliable asset in foreign lands.

2000867.title: Slum Orphans
strings: Slum Orphans
Orphan
The orphans Nawfal brought, bearing hopes of the future.

2000868.title: Compassion
strings: Compassion
Virtue
One day, these children will grow up. They will embrace their siblings, their loved ones, their friends like how Maggie embraced them. Whenever life is hard, they will remember Maggie and her ways.

2000869.title: Fairness
strings: Fairness
Virtue

Faris is not good with children, but he taught them how to take care of stray dogs. From the puppies, to the mothers, to when age claims them. It is a fair exchange. Children take care of their pets, and their pets teach them the journey of life.

2000870.title: Individuality
strings: Individuality
Virtue

Be your own master, Jalila would tell the children again and again, never hand yourself over to another... A little extreme, perhaps. Most children still chose to find partners in life. But a select few truly heard her words and accomplished great things.

2000871.title: Idealism
strings: Idealism
Virtue

Dreams are fragile. Too few possessed the combination of fortune and strength to reach the mountaintops they once aspired to. But even those who failed to scale their respective mountains would remember Master Adila's words. Those words opened their eyes and propelled them forward. Those words reshaped their lives.

2000872.title: Idol
strings: Idol
Virtue
Idol worship takes many forms. Some dedicate their lives to follow their heroes' footsteps. Some attempt to become heroes themselves. Some give their hearts to you – their first, and greatest savior.

2000873.title: Rationality
strings: Rationality
Virtue

Few has the rationality to trust the unadulterated truth, let alone to make use of that knowledge in their lives. Only the greatest minds are able to know the world through reason and strength of will, and they are the ones who change the world... But amongst these children, almost half show such promises. Perhaps it is Lumera's influence?

2000874.title: Culture
strings: Culture
Virtue
It is said that Shama would make large donations to help these children in their endeavors, and they would take on Shama's taste and wisdom – at least some of them.

2000875.title: Prosperity
strings: Prosperity
Virtue

No matter how hard they try, the chance of these children making as much money as Jawad is astronomical... But looking on the bright side, they are unlike to be as corrupt as Jawad, right? When a few of them became wealthy, they would reinvest that wealth to do good.

2000876.title: Harmony
strings: Harmony
Virtue

How many truly grasp the delicate balance of seasoning a dish – or living a good life? Fewer still have had the chance to govern a nation as one might cook a fine seafood stew. But one thing is certain: those who mastered the culinary arts of Habib would find the most excellent spouses.

2000877.title: Kindness
strings: Kindness
Virtue
Shameless bastard – Nawfal would nitpick literally everything and everyone and wears a face like the universe owes him money, yet he preaches kindness?

2000878.title: Romanticism
strings: Romanticism
Virtue
Nabhani is only half right, as everyone's story, everyone's romance is different. But amongst these children, some truly lived out their own romances, and became legends as great as Nabhani himself.

2000879.title: Desire
strings: Desire
Virtue

Probably should have kept Nayla away from children, but there is one thing she is right about: we must not raise them like slaves and servant. Their eyes must be opened to the opulence of the upper class, of the world that hangs above them, even if such knowledge brings more pain than joy (so says Nawfal).

2000880.title: Creativity
strings: Creativity
Virtue
Mahir knows what she is doing and will not teach the children anything inappropriate. Those who learned metal work and cartography from her would enjoy their benefits for the rest of their lives.

2000881.title: Freedom
strings: Freedom
Virtue
Alim would oft come to teach the children. What exactly did he teach? Some understood it as liberty, some understood it as survival... They all learned well.

2000882.title: Mastery
strings: Mastery
Virtue

Jabal never lied. In the pursuit of victory, in the trials of conquest, so long as you claim that one, fateful battle as your own – regardless of if it ends in triumph or defeat – you will always walk away with exuberance.

2000883.title: The Gardeners
strings: The Gardeners
Army
They fight for hope.

2000884.title: Blueprint of Revolution
strings: Blueprint of Revolution
Conviction

Hazy visions born from you and Nawfal, this idea is a dream-forged blade – pure, sharp, ephemeral, fragile... It is not yet complete, but should you find a vessel for it in the waking world, it will tear open the heavens and earth, then a new dawn will rise over the land.

2000885.title: Hemir
strings: Hemir
Pickpocket
He is just a kid.

2000886.title: White-Belly
strings: White-Belly
Dark Alley Scoundrel
A Dark Alley kingpin with a singular trade – turning children into beggars.

2000887.title: Beggers
strings: Beggers
Orphan
You need to do something about White-Belly's urchins. Use [Methinks] to weigh your options. First things first, go feed them.

2000888.title: Alim's Followers
strings: Alim's Followers
Army
These little thieves running about, some are quite skilled at their craft.

2000889.title: Street Urchins
strings: Street Urchins
Orphan
Once, they scavenged scraps behind your guesthouse. Now, they follow you, gathering knowledge and thought instead.

2000890.title: Troop of Commoners
strings: Troop of Commoners
Army
They fight for hope.

2000891.title: Troop of Commoners
strings: Troop of Commoners
Army
They fight for hope.

2000892.title: Reinforced Cellar Hatch
strings: Reinforced Cellar Hatch
Defense Line
The entrance to the beggar's den. White-Belly reinforced it with scraps of wood and iron.

2000893.title: Pickpocket's Whistle
strings: Pickpocket's Whistle
Special
A crude wooden whistle made by Hemir himself.

2000894.title: Vacant Mansion
strings: Vacant Mansion
Location
White-Belly used this place to hold his urchins. Now empty.

2000895.title: Dark Alley Dough
strings: Dark Alley Dough
Food
Hemir's dough paste: unremarkable in taste, but stubbornly filling.

2000896.title: The Bound
strings: The Bound
Special
Impossible to tell who it is under the cocoon of silk.

2000897.title: Abdul's Shield
strings: Abdul's Shield
Enemy
The strongest warrior at Abdul's side.

2000898.title: Abdul's Sword
strings: Abdul's Sword
Enemy
The strongest warrior at Abdul's side.

2000899.title: Little Safaa
strings: Little Safaa
Orphan
A gravely ill child, fervently worshiping the King of Flames.

2000900.title: Gazelle
strings: Gazelle
Animal
A graceful and agile antelope that has traversed the rocky paths countless times.

2000901.title: The Iron Crest
strings: The Iron Crest
Legions of the Sultan
These soldiers are mostly conscripts drawn from the common folk. They endure harsh training for no greater cause than a full stomach.

2000902.title: The Bronze Shield
strings: The Bronze Shield
Legions of the Sultan
These soldiers wield heavy shields, and when they form ranks, they are like an impenetrable wall.

2000903.title: The Warriors of Steel
strings: The Warriors of Steel
Legions of the Sultan
These well-trained soldiers wield long swords of gleaming steel, their armor shining bright and polished. Inhumanly disciplined, they oft overwhelm their opponents with sheer presence.

2000904.title: The Storm-Riders
strings: The Storm-Riders
Legions of the Sultan
Camel riders with formidable polearms, when they charge through the battlefield, they are as devastating and terrifying as a sandstorm.

2000905.title: The Pit Vipers
strings: The Pit Vipers
Legions of the Sultan

Their standard issue longswords are but decorative. When the Pit Vipers bear their fangs, it is the whip-blades around their waists that unfurl to dance. With these snake-like blades, a single Pit Viper can rival ten soldiers.

2000906.title: The Croc Guards
strings: The Croc Guards
Legions of the Sultan
Each of these soldiers wears a crocodile helm – a grim sight for sure. They say each of the Croc Guards slay their own beast to adorn their crest.

2000907.title: The Gold Blade
strings: The Gold Blade
Legions of the Sultan
These soldiers ride beneath the Sultan’s gilded blade. Noble born, schooled in steel and scripture alike, they need only amass enough victories to rise to a commander's post.

2000908.title: The Winged Cavalry
strings: The Winged Cavalry
Legions of the Sultan
These knights are each highly skilled in archery and riding; they are raiders on the battlefield, coming and going like the wind, their arrows falling like rain.

2000909.title: The Lion-Riders
strings: The Lion-Riders
Legions of the Sultan
No one knows how they tamed these ferocious beasts. They are the heralds of assured victories and painful deaths.

2000910.title: Road Map of Revolution
strings: Road Map of Revolution
Conviction
The flame has been kindled. A workable plan has taken shape in your mind.

2000911.title: Divine Mandate
strings: Divine Mandate
Conviction
In the name of God.

2000912.title: Eternal Covenant
strings: Eternal Covenant
Conviction
In Their name.

2000913.title: Testaments to Bygone Oaths
strings: Testaments to Bygone Oaths
Conviction

On the worthless scraps of the old dynasty, ancient and broken oaths are recorded. You can explore its use in [Methinks], and in Headless Dragons it can be specially synthesized with the Conviction of Rebellion.

2000914.title: The Time is Now
strings: The Time is Now
Countdown
You must rally your troops before the Sultan reacts.

2000915.title: Overwhelming Presence
strings: Overwhelming Presence
Magic
The interplay of light and shadow magnifies the man on the throne into something great, inscrutable, terrifying.

2000916.title: The Kingslayer
strings: The Kingslayer
Weapon
Years have gone by without this sward having met a worthy foe.

2000917.title: Golden Armor
strings: Golden Armor
Attire
Luxuriously decorated golden armor, majestic.

2000918.title: Slayer
strings: Slayer
Weapon
A thin and sharp scimitar, made to flay, debone, and carve out the heart.

2000919.title: Ikar and Husam
strings: Ikar and Husam
Weapon

A boon from the monarch, they are the final work of a famed pair of swordsmiths. The male blade gleams gold, while its counterpart is silver chased with emerald. When the two sink into flesh together, they sing with a low, exultant hum.

2000920.title: Executioner's Axe
strings: Executioner's Axe
Weapon
A reward from the monarch after a grueling battle that broke a thousand blades. Henceforth, it accompanied the general's every conquest, paving his way with the fallen heads of his enemies.

2000921.title: Lapis Edge
strings: Lapis Edge
Weapon
A boon from the monarch, this dagger is suited only for the pure of heart, for in the blue glaze on its back is reflected even the slightest hint of malice in those nearby.

2000922.title: Noble Cavalry's Saber
strings: Noble Cavalry's Saber
Weapon
Striking engravings in gold and enamel cover this long blade. Those decapitated die admiring its glory.

2000923.title: Honor Guard
strings: Honor Guard
A guard temporarily elevated by the Sultan following Nabhani's unexpected death.

2000924.title: Honor Guard
strings: Honor Guard
One of the four esteemed individuals granted the honor of serving as the Sultan's personal guard, permitted to bear arms in the Sultan's presence.

2000925.title: Honor Guard
strings: Honor Guard
A guard temporarily elevated by the Sultan following Jabal's unexpected death.

2000926.title: Honor Guard
strings: Honor Guard
A guard temporarily elevated by the Sultan following Faris's unexpected death.

2000927.title: Honor Guards
strings: Honor Guards
Army
These soldiers are well-drilled warriors dedicated since birth to one noble task: guarding the Sultan.

2000928.title: Nawfal's Poisoned Arrows
strings: Nawfal's Poisoned Arrows
Accessory
Poisoned arrows. Their long shafts are covered by etchings of names: a spell, or perhaps a curse.

2000929.title: Knight Revenant
strings: Knight Revenant
Army
Undyingly loyal, restless in his shame.

2000930.title: Undead Army
strings: Undead Army
Army
An army of accursed oath-breakers, denied rest even in death.

2000931.title: Disorderly Crowd
strings: Disorderly Crowd
Passerby
Freeloaders, queue jumpers, and those who lost their seat or food are quarreling in your guesthouse.

2000932.title: Dark Alley Mob
strings: Dark Alley Mob
Passerby
Delicacies made by Habib, tantalizing not only the retainers in your guesthouse, but also nearby residents.

2000933.title: Troublemaking Brute
strings: Troublemaking Brute
Rioter
This person must have been bought off, but refuses to confess.

2000934.title: Jealous Minister
strings: Jealous Minister
This person is jealous of your thriving business and unmatched reputation in the Dark Alley.

2000935.title: Vagrant Beggar
strings: Vagrant Beggar
Vagrants
The hungry people, scavenging for food in the garbage heap behind your guesthouse.

2000936.title: Street Urchins
strings: Street Urchins
Unused
This entrance seems to have been abandoned.

2000937.title: Siyama
strings: Siyama
Strange Prostitute
She is wrapped tightly in sheer gauze, like she's trying to conceal something... But her graceful figure is still discernible.

2000938.title: Goddess of Stench and Sickness
strings: Goddess of Stench and Sickness
Special
He governs the world's unspeakable hidden pain. Unveil the luxurious silk and see, everyone's body is marred with fetid wounds.

2000939.title: Special Cuisine
strings: Special Cuisine
Feast
To secure the guesthouse job, Habib put his effort into preparing the cuisine.

2000940.title: Marvelous Mush
strings: Marvelous Mush
Feast
Habib's mishmash... Ahem, made from leftover scraps and unusual ingredients, incredibly appetizing, believe it or not.

2000941.title: A Jar of Candied Fruits
strings: A Jar of Candied Fruits
Feast
A jar of men's exclusive preserves. With this, stop snatching Maggie's share.

2000942.title: Rare Jerky
strings: Rare Jerky
Feast
Dried meat made from the game caught by retainer hunters, requiring serious chewing power, a small piece lasts for a long time...

2000943.title: Corrupt List
strings: Corrupt List
Evidence
Nawfal hopes you'll take the opportunity of entertaining the Sultan at the guesthouse to reveal this list.

2000944.title: Fabricated Charges List
strings: Fabricated Charges List
Evidence
Abdul hopes you'll take the opportunity of entertaining the Sultan at the guesthouse to reveal this list.

2000945.title: A Mercenary's Journal
strings: A Mercenary's Journal
Book
Books filled with the adventures of mercenaries. After reading this book, you gain Physique +1, Survival +1, Combat +1.

2000946.title: Souls Under the Sword
strings: Souls Under the Sword
The Dead
Beheaded by a blade filled with anger, unable to rest in peace.

2000947.title: Fury
strings: Fury
Mettle
Roaming Swordsman is enraged, their power surging.

2000948.title: Mercenary Adventurer
strings: Mercenary Adventurer
Army
The mercenaries who drink, boast, and brawl in the adventurers' tavern.

2000949.title: Fire Dragon Scales
strings: Fire Dragon Scales
Material
Scales of the Fire Dragon, seemingly still imbued with magic. Place in Methinks to craft an item.

2000950.title: Dragonscale Shield
strings: Dragonscale Shield
Accessory
A shield made from Fire Dragon Scales. Solid as a rock.

2000951.title: Dragonscale Helm
strings: Dragonscale Helm
Accessory
Helmet crafted from Fire Dragon Scales. Imposing.

2000952.title: Dragonscale Armor
strings: Dragonscale Armor
Attire
Armor made from Fire Dragon Scales. Imprevious to the enemy's blade.

2000953.title: Dragonscale Blade
strings: Dragonscale Blade
Weapon
Sword crafted from Fire Dragon Scales. It cuts through the irons easily.

2000954.title: Fire Dragon Head
strings: Fire Dragon Head
Special
The severed Fire Dragon’s head, its dim eyes seem to still gaze upon this world.

2000955.title: The Sultan's Remains
strings: The Sultan's Remains
Corpse
Oh, a worthless corpse.

2000956.title: The Sultan Imprisoned
strings: The Sultan Imprisoned
Trophy
How pathetic.

2000957.title: The Sultan Exiled
strings: The Sultan Exiled
Trophy
Begone!

2000958.title: The Sultan in Shame
strings: The Sultan in Shame
Trophy
Um?

2000959.title: Sword of the Sun
strings: Sword of the Sun
Weapon
A divine sword imbued with the power of a certain faith.

2000960.title: Eye of Light
strings: Eye of Light
Trophy
Upon being imbued by the glory of the True, the Dragon's Eye changed its form. It contains immense destructive power.

2000961.title: Eye of Darkness
strings: Eye of Darkness
Trophy
Upon being imbued by the malice of the Other, the Dragon's Eye changed its form. It contains immense destructive power.

2000962.title: Conservative Noble A
strings: Conservative Noble A
Unused
Scratched

2000963.title: Conservative Noble B
strings: Conservative Noble B
Unused
Scratched

2000964.title: Guards of the Noble territory
strings: Guards of the Noble territory
Army
Troops mustered in haste. No expense has been spared in the name of survival.

2000965.title: Mud Crawlers
strings: Mud Crawlers
Army
Those gathered under Riel have long been accustomed to rolling in the mud, struggling for survival.

2000966.title: Alley Jackals
strings: Alley Jackals
Army
Hooligans from the Jackals, now under Riel's rule. Oh well, no matter who the boss is, life goes on.

2000967.title: Gun Maidens
strings: Gun Maidens
Army
The rescued barbarian sisters by Riel, wielding long spears and painted with blood marks, extraordinarily heroic.

2000968.title: Blade Winds
strings: Blade Winds
Army
The nomads found and rescued by you and Riel, skilled in horseback combat, coming and going like the wind.

2000969.title: Soul Hunters
strings: Soul Hunters
Army
The barbarians found and rescued by you and Riel, with indomitable combat spirit flowing in their veins.

2000970.title: Paper Shredders
strings: Paper Shredders
Army
The freedmen found and rescued by you and Riel, their identity papers are already shattered.

2000971.title: Slave Hunter
strings: Slave Hunter
Slave Hunters' Chief
He could almost pass for a merchant – were it not for the glint of banditry in his gaze and the sharp cunning behind his smile.

2000972.title: Mansion Guard
strings: Mansion Guard
Army
The sentries are visible. But more deadly are the blades in the shadow...
