Now you’ll never have to worry about someone stabbing you in the back aga... Sadly, this cloak’s side effect is that you’ll always worry someone will.

2001138.title: White Rhino
strings: White Rhino
Beast
You once conquered this massive beast. The twisted game has frozen that moment in time as a reward to you for breaking all rules.

2001139.title: Cursed Rhino Hide
strings: Cursed Rhino Hide
Special
You practically tore it off yourself… And now it’s stained with the game’s dark power.

2001140.title: Dark Sword
strings: Dark Sword
Weapon
Black magic is also a kind of weapon. As with any weapon, what matters is who wields it.

2001141.title: Renown Card
strings: Renown Card
Special
Before the game began, Maggie made a hefty donation to the Purist Order in your name. You can remind people of that anytime. Through Methinks, this card will boost your Renown

2001142.title: Infamy Card
strings: Infamy Card
Special

Many creatures survive by mimicking the bright, the poisonous, or the terrifying to scare off predators. Whether it’s real or just an act doesn’t matter, what's important is staying alive. Through Methinks, this card will boost your Infamy.

2001143.title: Notoriety Card
strings: Notoriety Card
Special

In your younger days, you had friends and connections all across the land. You might be out of the game now, but the stories about you are still making the rounds. Through Methinks, this card will boost your Notoriety.

2001144.title: Influence Card
strings: Influence Card
Special
Of course you’re the Sultan’s favorite. Why else would you be the one playing this game? Just because of bad luck? Yeah, right. Through Methinks, this card will boost your Influence.

2001145.title: Insight Card
strings: Insight Card
Special

You’ve been able to see those creepy, otherworldly things for as long as you can remember. You just kept pretending not to, doing your best to act like everything was normal. Through Methinks, this card will boost your Insight.

2001146.title: Sultan's Nipple Chains
strings: Sultan's Nipple Chains
Special

This treasure was generously sponsored by <color=#74E0C5>糖贰</color>. The resemblance to our Sultan's own chest piece is uncanny - save for those telltale bloodstains in the intricate work. You almost wonder if they might be one and the same... but surely not?
After fierce battle, wounds from the nipple chain bled again.

2001147.title: Ring of Eternal Oath
strings: Ring of Eternal Oath
Special

This treasure was generously sponsored by <color=#74E0C5>溯<cspace=-0.6em>氵云</cspace></color>. Your sacred oaths now rest beside the Ring of Inevitability's ancient inscriptions. When you chose to restore power to the people who built this nation, the ancient curse on kingship simply... faded away.

2001148.title: Cursed person
strings: Cursed person
Unused

2001149.title: Taming Bridoon
strings: Taming Bridoon
Special

This treasure was generously sponsored by <color=#74E0C5>色孽神父</color>. This masterwork gold bridoon subdues even the wildest beasts. Though something about those engravings sends chills down your spine.

2001150.title: "Unwavering Loyalty"
strings: "Unwavering Loyalty"
Book
Tales of loyalty twisted into betrayal, seasoned with historical flavor but clearly more fiction than fact.

2001151.title: Thornbind Ring
strings: Thornbind Ring
Special
This treasure was generously sponsored by <color=#74E0C5>林塞天下第一</color>. Gift, contract, and seed rolled into one - magic scholars call such triple-natured things "Curses".

2001152.title: Scholar's Insignia
strings: Scholar's Insignia
Special
This treasure was commissioned by Scholar member <color=#74E0C5>氡</color>. For those who dwell among dusty tomes - not seeking hollow flattery, but gathering wisdom that actually serves a purpose.

2001153.title: Mountain Father's Blood
strings: Mountain Father's Blood
Unused

2001154.title: Stone Scale
strings: Stone Scale
Special

This treasure was generously sponsored by <color=#74E0C5>阿达梅洛大列巴</color>. This stone heart flickers with inner flame, and through some unknown weighing, this relic abandoned by the gods has marked you as its chosen.

2001155.title: Heart of Life
strings: Heart of Life
Special
This treasure was generously sponsored by <color=#74E0C5>阿达梅洛大列巴</color>. Tempered by longing and devotion, the Stone Scale stirs with resurrection's promise.

2001156.title: Heart of Eternity
strings: Heart of Eternity
Special
This treasure was generously sponsored by <color=#74E0C5>阿达梅洛大列巴</color>. Through sheer force of will, you've drawn forth the Stone Scale's impossible vitality and bent it to your command.

2001157.title: Maggie's Memorial
strings: Maggie's Memorial
Special
Here lies your beloved - slain by your hand, yet who died for your sake.

2001158.title: Nabhani's Memorial
strings: Nabhani's Memorial
Special
Here lies a swordsman of grace, cut down before his time.

2001159.title: Nawfal's Memorial
strings: Nawfal's Memorial
Special
Here lies your greatest adversary.

2001160.title: Iman's Memorial
strings: Iman's Memorial
Special
Here lies a soul of true faith.

2001161.title: Soul Imprint Pestle
strings: Soul Imprint Pestle
Special

This treasure was generously sponsored by <color=#74E0C5>839</color>. Once sacred, used in worship - until followers perished and gods fell silent. Now only this corroded relic endures, forever thirsting for fresh offerings of blood and spirit.
The Soul Imprint Pestle's consumed spiritual power was exhausted, returning to its original dim appearance.

2001162.title: Serpent's Veil
strings: Serpent's Veil
Unused

2001163.title: Philosophical Man
strings: Philosophical Man
Special
This peculiar figure haunts the shadows of his cell, supposedly once a legendary chieftain of some formidable tribe.

2001164.title: Dark Fantasies
strings: Dark Fantasies
Special

This treasure was generously sponsored by <color=#74E0C5>wzj</color>. Part of the Dungeon Lord's regalia - after indulging in carnality and conquest, tempered by warning, praise, and mercy, the deep philosophical darkness within gradually stirs to life.
Dark♂Will slowly revived within you.

2001165.title: "Valley of Serpents"
strings: "Valley of Serpents"
Book
Grants Charisma +1 upon reading. First reading unlocks the Viper Temple adventure.

2001166.title: Viper's Chain
strings: Viper's Chain
Attire

This treasure was generously sponsored by <color=#74E0C5>川治汐Ciaochan</color>. Ancient kingdoms once fed adulterous nobles to vipers as punishment - later, revolutionaries adopted serpentine jewelry to mock such laws and flaunt their own transgressions.

2001167.title: Lust Serpent's Veil
strings: Lust Serpent's Veil
Attire

This treasure was generously sponsored by <color=#74E0C5>川治汐Ciaochan</color>. It still bears the enchantment to record carnal sins, though whether this marks shame, pride, or mere sport remains unclear.

The Lust Serpent's Veil became your symbol - people visited you discreetly, just to glimpse shadows and phantoms in that black silk.
Eventually, in different people's mouths, these illusions became different stories... bringing you ever-changing reputation.

2001168.title: Veil of Purity
strings: Veil of Purity
Attire
This treasure was generously sponsored by <color=#74E0C5>川治汐Ciaochan</color>. Purists may cleanse the stains of vice, but the appetite beneath remains untouched.

2001169.title: Ring of Eternal Oath
strings: Ring of Eternal Oath
Special

This treasure was generously sponsored by <color=#74E0C5>溯<cspace=-0.6em>氵云</cspace></color>. The Ring of Inevitability's old inscriptions have been scraped away. No longer does it mourn fallen dynasties - now it serves you alone, child of undying stars.

2001170.title: "Blood of the Longhorn Beetle"
strings: "Blood of the Longhorn Beetle"
Book

This ancient text preserves a primordial legend: somewhere in the mountain heights, a deity once wielded mysterious power to restore their beloved to life. First reading grants Physique +1 and unlocks the Mountain Depths adventure.

2001171.title: Shama's Memorial
strings: Shama's Memorial
Special
Here lies the beauty claimed by fate too soon.

2001172.title: Junah's Memorial
strings: Junah's Memorial
Special
Here lies the beauty claimed by fate too soon.

2001173.title: Jalila's Memorial
strings: Jalila's Memorial
Special
Here lies the beauty claimed by fate too soon.

2001174.title: Maggie?
strings: Maggie?
Special
You tell yourself this is Maggie, despite its silence, despite its inability to return your love.

2001175.title: Nabhani?
strings: Nabhani?
Special
You tell yourself this is Nabhani - at last, truly at your beck and call.

2001176.title: Nawfal?
strings: Nawfal?
Special
You tell yourself this is Nawfal, though he'll never again challenge you in the court.

2001177.title: Iman?
strings: Iman?
Special
You tell yourself this is Iman. You bathe him daily in jasmine water, hoping to mask what shouldn't be there.

2001178.title: Shama?
strings: Shama?
Special
You tell yourself this is Shama. And why not? See how perfectly it captures her essence - neither fully man nor woman, but somehow both.

2001179.title: Junah?
strings: Junah?
Special
You tell yourself this is Junah, finally receiving the love you never gave her. But does she even want it now?

2001180.title: Jalila?
strings: Jalila?
Special
You tell yourself this is Jalila, though she'll never raise her whip against you again.

2001181.title: Thorn Blade
strings: Thorn Blade
Special
The heart it once guarded has crystallized to gem, while tender vines have hardened into killing steel.

2001182.title: The Ancient Mirror
strings: The Ancient Mirror
Special
It has slumbered in your home for years untold. How many secrets has it reflected?

2001183.title: Golden Cat Spirit
strings: Golden Cat Spirit
Special
The warrior-cat's soul has found a vessel far more noble and vital than cold stone.

2001184.title: Silver-Edged Dagger
strings: Silver-Edged Dagger
Special
The shattered mirror means the fractured reality—its edge keener than any blade forged in mortal fire.

2001185.title: Phantom Coin
strings: Phantom Coin
"Currency"
This coin bears no outward difference from any other... save that sometimes, the face upon it tilts its ear—or smiles back at you.

2001186.title: The Bewitched Troop
strings: The Bewitched Troop
Army
Their minds seeded with false convictions, they march with fervor for a leader who never exist.

2001187.title: Border Lord
strings: Border Lord
Noble
A lord so insignificant, none would notice if he were... replaced.

2001188.title: The Lord's Troop
strings: The Lord's Troop
Army
A hasty levy of men, sent to bleed for noble squabbles before they even grasp what war they fight.

2001189.title: That Shore
strings: That Shore
Book
A madman's tome filled with visions of the far bank—its letters twisted, its words fit to break wise men. Requires Wisdom ≤3 to read. Grants Magic +3 upon reading.

2001190.title: "Gold Coin"
strings: "Gold Coin"
"Currency"
To most people, these coins are indistinguishable from real gold—so for all practical purposes, they are as good as the real thing.

2001191.title: Hairbound Oath Ring
strings: Hairbound Oath Ring
Special
Wrought of golden threads entwined with silken strands—hair whose hue recalls a certain comely figure at the Sultan's side... Inside the band, words are etched: “Cruelty of fate tore us asunder."

2001192.title: Homestyle Delicacies
strings: Homestyle Delicacies
Feast
Braised Chicken Thigh; Hot-Oil–Doused Pork; Steamed Beef Tripe; Poached Meatballs; Stewed Flatbread; Slow-Braised Peas; Yuan-yang Braise; Smoked Zebra; Candied Braised Fruit; Fried Lily Bulbs...

2001193.title: Anita
strings: Anita
Homeland's Lost Blood
A girl entrusted to you by a dying elder; diligent, literate, and seemingly gifted in medicine.

2001194.title: Kapar
strings: Kapar
Samir's male consort.
A "gift" from the Sultan. He has stayed by Samir's side for years, living quietly and contentedly.

2001195.title: Carefully Compounded Wound Salve
strings: Carefully Compounded Wound Salve
Medicine
A salve mixed by Court Physician Samir.

2001196.title: Imitation of the Water of Life
strings: Imitation of the Water of Life
Medicine
A replica of the Water of Life. It should have comparable wound-healing effects.

2001197.title: The Uncanny Order Parcel
strings: The Uncanny Order Parcel
Special
Crystal vials stacked and packed with care—the "night visitors" requested a batch of imitation Water of Life from Samir.

2001198.title: Tattoo Patterns
strings: Tattoo Patterns
Book
Each page shows a strange tattoo patterns. After reading this book, you gain Insight +2.

2001199.title: Midnight Crystal
strings: Midnight Crystal
Special
A return gift from the abomination; they were very pleased with the potions.

2001200.title: Folded List
strings: Folded List
Token
Samir's slip listing a string of names sharing the same ancestral surname from the fallen kingdom.

2001201.title: Symbolism-Thieves
strings: Symbolism-Thieves
Abomination
They store stolen inspirations and memories in the subconscious of fools and madmen—hence their shocking flashes of truth.

2001202.title: Garbled Messengers
strings: Garbled Messengers
Abomination
Look closely: their bodies are woven from ambiguous misspellings.

2001203.title: Baneful Toads
strings: Baneful Toads
Abomination
When a mind sinks into filth, its thoughts become their tadpoles.

2001204.title: Symbolism-Thieves
strings: Symbolism-Thieves
Abomination
They store stolen inspirations and memories in the subconscious of fools and madmen—hence their shocking flashes of truth.

2001205.title: Garbled Messengers
strings: Garbled Messengers
Abomination
Look closely: their bodies are woven from ambiguous misspellings.

2001206.title: Baneful Toads
strings: Baneful Toads
Abomination
When a mind sinks into filth, its thoughts become their tadpoles.

2001207.title: Court Incense
strings: Court Incense
Special
A coveted palace incense in high demand. A consumable that aids estate management.

2001208.title: Anomalous Presence
strings: Anomalous Presence
Special
Musings on an uncanny being—I'll mull it over.

2001209.title: Fate Poetry Scroll
strings: Fate Poetry Scroll
Reading Material
Fragments of odd verse tied to dreams and mutterings; the more you collect, the stronger it grows.

2001210.title: Samir's Confession
strings: Samir's Confession
Evidence
A written admission of "guilt" so you won't be dragged down with Samir.

2001211.title: Countdown
strings: Countdown
You must report to the Sultan before the deadline.

2001212.title: Ironclad Frame-Up Evidence
strings: Ironclad Frame-Up Evidence
Evidence
Present this in the court inquiry to the Sultan. A tidy outcome for all: it proves your ability, Samir's loyalty, the consorts' innocence, and the Sultan's wisdom.

2001213.title: The Ancient Mirror
strings: The Ancient Mirror
The Mirror Spirit
It has slumbered in your home for years untold. How many secrets has it reflected?

2001214.title: The Lute of Mirror
strings: The Lute of Mirror
The Mirror Spirit
Forged from an eternal thing once bent to your will, the lute's strings shimmer with silvered light—like frozen moonlight on still water.

2001215.title: The Shield of Mirror
strings: The Shield of Mirror
The Mirror Spirit
Forged from an eternal thing once bent to your will, the shield gleams mirror-bright. In certain moments, you fancy it still watches you

2001216.title: The Crown of Mirror
strings: The Crown of Mirror
The Mirror Spirit
Forged from an eternal thing once bent to your will, it gazes now with ruler's eyes—upon the world, and into the dark corners of your soul.

2001217.title: The Mirror Spirit
strings: The Mirror Spirit
This mysterious mirror-spirit could freely shift its form and gender… much like a reflection in glass, shaped only by what you showed it.

2001218.title: Medical Codex
strings: Medical Codex
Special
Compiled by Samir—an authoritative reference of treatments and potent remedies.

2001219.title: Tonic of Vitality
strings: Tonic of Vitality
Medicine
A physician's gift. Use in Let Me Mull It Over to enhance the user's physique.

2001220.title: The Crystal of Sealing
strings: The Crystal of Sealing
Accessory
Inspired by a foreign incantation she'd once stumbled upon, Jenna used a special technique to link together the Midnight Crystals, crafting them into a bracelet.

2001221.title: Drink of the Night
strings: Drink of the Night
Feast
Habib brewed the Midnight Crystal into a wine… Is it truly drinkable? Let's hope it doesn't end badly.

2001222.title: Vagrants Troop
strings: Vagrants Troop
Army
They fought for their homes, their status, and their future.

2001223.title: Vagrants
strings: Vagrants

People who, for many reasons, had no papers, could not settle, and enjoyed no protection under the law—outcasts in the eyes of religion as well. Even slaves were protected as property; vagrants were treated like mud at the roadside.

2001224.title: The Doubter
strings: The Doubter
Passerby
A noble who questioned Princess Raedina's identity.

2001225.title: The Rival Beauty
strings: The Rival Beauty
Passerby
A woman determined to outshine Princess Raedina.

2001226.title: The Suitor
strings: The Suitor
Passerby
An ardent playboy.

2001227.title: Golden Bracelet
strings: Golden Bracelet
Accessory

On the inner rim are the words: "Daughter of Gosa… Our—". In principle it signified Raed's claim to the throne. Yet far more names score the gold—blessings from the countless vagrants you aided. The late Sultan's formula is lost among those of smiths, grooms, laundresses, and hunters.

2001228.title: Clue to the Mysterious Lady
strings: Clue to the Mysterious Lady
Clue
What was Raed's connection to that enigmatic noblewoman? Can be placed in "Methinks" for further inquiry.

2001229.title: The Vagrants' Labor
strings: The Vagrants' Labor
Special
At your word, the vagrants would gather, eat your food, and do anything—expected or not. Usable in "Methinks".

2001230.title: Ambiguities
strings: Ambiguities
Book
A treatise on the archaic cults and journeys of the spirit—curiously, legible only to you.

2001231.title: The Secret Passage
strings: The Secret Passage
Path
A secret passage out of the city, built in secret by Faraj for unforeseen need.

2001232.title: Roll of the Mortal
strings: Roll of the Mortal
Special
Names of those devoured by the Lord of the Revels. Call them at the right moment to weaken that being.

2001233.title: The Vagrants' Labor
strings: The Vagrants' Labor
Special
At your word, the vagrants would gather, eat your food, and do anything—expected or not. Usable in "Methinks".

2001234.title: The Rope's Tempering
strings: The Rope's Tempering
Book
Dense and sigil-marked to purge malign power from the text. After reading this book, you gain Magic +2.

2001235.title: Acknowledgments
strings: Acknowledgments
Special
"This work owes its existence to Lady Maggie and her husband." Outrageous—no mention of you. Petty retribution, surely.

2001236.title: Chapter of the Dragon's Eye
strings: Chapter of the Dragon's Eye
Special
Extensive notes on the Fire-Dragon's eye, as compiled in Asal's encyclopedia.

2001237.title: Chapter of the Game
strings: Chapter of the Game
Special
Extensive notes on the rules of Sultan's Game, as compiled in Asal's encyclopedia.

2001238.title: Chapter of the Departed
strings: Chapter of the Departed
Special
Extensive notes on the Ring of Doom, as compiled in Asal's encyclopedia.

2001239.title: Chapter of the Gods
strings: Chapter of the Gods
Special
Extensive notes on fallen deities, as compiled in Asal's encyclopedia.

2001240.title: Chapter of the Ancient Mirror
strings: Chapter of the Ancient Mirror
Special
Extensive notes on dwellers in the glass, as compiled in Asal's encyclopedia.

2001241.title: Chapter of Devices
strings: Chapter of Devices
Special
Asal wished to omit it, but—alas. A technical entry on a high-speed, telescoping golden phallus.

2001242.title: Chapter of the Mediocre
strings: Chapter of the Mediocre
Special
Extensive notes on the birth and spread of intellectual fashions, as compiled in Asal's encyclopedia.

2001243.title: Chapter of Cats
strings: Chapter of Cats
Special
Extensive notes on a great and adorable feline noble—illustrations irresistibly cute.

2001244.title: Chapter of Medicine
strings: Chapter of Medicine
Special
Recommends a medical masterwork worthy of the ages.

2001245.title: Chapter of the Tribe
strings: Chapter of the Tribe
Special
Extensive notes on the history and lifeways of a single tribe, as compiled in Asal's encyclopedia.

2001246.title: A Consort's Resolve
strings: A Consort's Resolve
Weapon
A small, court-pattern dagger—an emblem the sultan gifted favored consorts, reminding them to guard their chastity with their lives.

2001247.title: Hidden Among the Many
strings: Hidden Among the Many
Book
A lively survey of famed bibliophiles and the fates of legendary rarities. After reading this book, you gain Stealth +2, Wisdom +1.

2001248.title: Errant Thoughts
strings: Errant Thoughts
Book
On constitutions, orthodox and debased; on royal authority, rightful and warped. After reading this book, you gain Sociability +1, Stealth +2.

2001249.title: The Art of the Printing
strings: The Art of the Printing
Book
A brief on casting type with clay molds and how printing entered the Empire. After reading this book, you gain Wisdom +1.

2001250.title: Mercenary Guards
strings: Mercenary Guards
Army
Hired by Zaki with his ill-gotten wealth, now he has given you command.

2001251.title: Of Flesh and Bone Dust
strings: Of Flesh and Bone Dust
Book
A vignette of a slum mother crafting a "noble's feast" for her child. Reading grants Survival +2.

2001252.title: The Heart of the Labyrinth
strings: The Heart of the Labyrinth
Book
A survey of famous mazes with intricate hand maps—and how to walk them. After reading this book, you gain Survival +1, Magic +1.

2001253.title: A Place Unknown
strings: A Place Unknown
Book
An anthology by anonymous amateurs with heavy day jobs. After reading this book, you gain Sociability +1, Survival +1.

2001254.title: Little Star
strings: Little Star
Book
Seemed to be written by the above authors' children who wrote A Place Unknown. After reading this book, you gain Wisdom +1+1, Charm +1.

2001255.title: On the Measure of Criticism
strings: On the Measure of Criticism
Book
A historical inquiry into the bounds of official power and public will. After reading this book, you gain Wisdom +1, Social +2.

2001256.title: The Expedition of Isar
strings: The Expedition of Isar
Book
A prince's rash campaign for honor and plunder; his captivity, his weeping lady, his upright father—and his escape. After reading this book, you gain Combat +2, Charm +1.

2001257.title: Tales of the Mountain Home
strings: Tales of the Mountain Home
Book
A noble matron's memoir of a house rising and falling with dynasties. After reading this book, you gain Sociability +2.

2001258.title: The Angler and Me
strings: The Angler and Me
Book
Asr's memoir—why and how he opened a bookshop. Reading grants Social +1, Physique +1.

2001259.title: On the Craft of Printing
strings: On the Craft of Printing
Book
Printing, Explained Building on the classic Printing Strategies: advances and innovations. Reading grants Survival +2, Wisdom +1.

2001260.title: Strings of the Cosmos
strings: Strings of the Cosmos
Book
Strings of the Cosmos Madman's murmur: the world is not elements and aether but invisible "strings." Reading grants Magic +3, Wisdom +1.

2001261.title: Small Agate
strings: Small Agate
Gem

A small piece of agate cut from the raw stone. Such common gemstones are affordable even to the poorest Lady of Delights, though their humble beauty still surpasses that of stained glass or polished pebbles.

2001262.title: Small Red Carnelian
strings: Small Red Carnelian
Gem
A small piece of red carnelian cut from the raw stone. This popular soft gem is prized for its flowing patterns and rich hue, often worn by daughters of common families as bridal ornaments.

2001263.title: Small Amethyst
strings: Small Amethyst
Gem

A small piece of amethyst cut from the raw stone. Mysterious, noble, and graceful, it is the aristocrat among gemstones. Though merely the entry level of the high-grade sequence, it already lies far beyond the reach of ordinary households.

2001264.title: Small Emeral
strings: Small Emeral
Gem

A small piece of emerald cut from the raw stone. With its calm, deep, and crystal-clear glow, it is the cherished favorite of noble ladies—especially those with green eyes, who would feel disgraced to be seen without a few emeralds on them.

2001265.title: Small Ruby
strings: Small Ruby
Gem

A small piece of ruby cut from the raw stone. It is as if a lover's heart were sealed within crystal—fire, blood, and rose entwined. Many cheap glass jewels try to imitate its glow, yet true connoisseurs can tell the difference from several steps away.

2001266.title: Small Sapphire
strings: Small Sapphire
Gem

A small piece of sapphire cut from the raw stone. It gleams on the robes of lords, the coronets of viziers, and the ears of the most elegant noblewomen. For commoners, even catching a glimpse of such a gem from afar is a rare privilege.

2001267.title: Small Diamond
strings: Small Diamond
Gem
A small piece of diamond cut from the raw stone. "Diamond" has become a word for all things beautiful, precious, and eternal. It is the jewel of kings—and the king of jewels.

2001268.title: Large Agate
strings: Large Agate
Gem
A large piece of agate cut from the raw stone. Though such gemstones are common enough that even the poorest Lady of Delights can wear them, one of this size and clarity is a true rarity.

2001269.title: Large Red Carnelian
strings: Large Red Carnelian
Gem

A large piece of carnelian cut from the raw stone. This soft gem, admired for its graceful veins and vibrant color, would make any common girl a bride envied by all if she wore such a large piece on her wedding day.

2001270.title: Large Amethyst
strings: Large Amethyst
Gem

A large piece of amethyst cut from the raw stone. Mysterious, noble, and elegant—what could be more fitting for the vizier or the sultan of the gem world? Even among high-grade gemstones, few could rival its brilliance.

2001271.title: Large Emerald
strings: Large Emerald
Gem
A large piece of emerald cut from the raw stone. Its sheen is calm yet profound, clear beyond belief. A gem of such perfect quality would drive noble ladies into a frenzy of desire.

2001272.title: Large Ruby
strings: Large Ruby
Gem

A large piece of ruby cut from the raw stone. You have never seen such a pure, vivid red—no stained glass could ever imitate its glow. It embodies nobility, beauty, and love itself. Jenna thought up the advertisement line the moment she saw it.

2001273.title: Large Sapphire
strings: Large Sapphire
Gem

A large piece of sapphire cut from the raw stone. To call it the vizier of the gem world would be no exaggeration; only diamonds could vie with its splendor. Even the Sultan would take pride in owning the largest sapphire in the Empire—yet Jenna suspects this one might not be any less brilliant.

2001274.title: Large Diamond
strings: Large Diamond
Gem
A large piece of diamond cut from the raw stone. Given that all diamond veins are monopolized by the royal family, obtaining such a massive stone is an almost unthinkable symbol of wealth and power.

2001275.title: Ox Bone
strings: Ox Bone
Gem

A so-called "gem" you and Jenna managed to inflate into a high-priced sensation. Once dismissed as worthless, it has now become something the wealthy covet and the masses chase—proof enough of human folly and desire.

2001276.title: Alim's Suspicion
strings: Alim's Suspicion
Special
Regarding that sneaky gem merchant and the frequent kidnappings in the Dark Alley, old Alim has formed quite a few theories of his own...

2001277.title: Raed's Vigilance
strings: Raed's Vigilance
Special
Concerning that shady gem merchant and the wave of abductions across the backstreets, Raed has uncovered a number of solid leads through her investigation.

2001278.title: Bloodstained Diamond Pit
strings: Bloodstained Diamond Pit
Location
Every diamond mined from this place is soaked with human blood.

2001279.title: Mine Owner
strings: Mine Owner
Passerby
This man discovered a diamond vein but never reported it to the sultan. Instead, he secretly seized it and began private excavation.

2001280.title: Mine Overseers
strings: Mine Overseers
Army
Their whips are ever ready to lash across the bent backs of the laborers.

2001281.title: Mine Guards
strings: Mine Guards
Army
Their blades are ever drawn, watching for slaves who might attempt escape, and for outsiders who stray too near.

2001282.title: Mining Slave
strings: Mining Slave
Slave
This person has no other choice but to toil in the pit for you until death.

2001283.title: Fat Pigeon
strings: Fat Pigeon
Ingredient
A plump pigeon delivered by a butcher's apprentice, heavy in the hand—almost suspiciously so. You can bring it to Habib to be roasted into a fine meal.

2001284.title: Roast Pigeon
strings: Roast Pigeon
Feast
Echo of kindness made this plump roast pigeon even more fragrant!

2001285.title: Golden Leaf from the Crown
strings: Golden Leaf from the Crown
Accessory
A gold leaf plucked from the Sultan's crown and casually bestowed upon you. Such enviable favor—people instinctively bow and yield before it.

2001286.title: Shield of Gilded Crystal Spikes
strings: Shield of Gilded Crystal Spikes
Accessory
A gold-sheathed shield set with sharp gem studs—beautiful, heavy, and truly sturdy.

2001287.title: The Thinking Figure
strings: The Thinking Figure
Special
He pondered why he was himself, and why he was not himself.

2001288.title: Poet
strings: Poet
Passerby
Drawn by Princess Raedina's beauty.

2001289.title: The Suitor
strings: The Suitor
Passerby
Drawn by Princess Raedina's beauty.

2001290.title: Merchant
strings: Merchant
Passerby
Drawn by Princess Raedina's beauty.

2001291.title: Monk
strings: Monk
Passerby
Drawn by Princess Raedina's beauty.

2001292.title: Rose Essence Oil
strings: Rose Essence Oil
Special
Rich rose aroma, like rain-wet petals. Use to increase Charisma.

2001293.title: On Your Own Faith
strings: On Your Own Faith
Unused
Your personal statement of faith.

2001294.title: Old Rose Garland
strings: Old Rose Garland
Accessory
A thank-offering from the slave girls: fresh, dewy boughs from the old rose garden, each thorn carefully stripped.

2001295.title: Beneath the Gem Banner
strings: Beneath the Gem Banner
Army
When this banner rose with the sun atop the walls, people gathered behind you, certain the rightful sovereign had arrived.

2001296.title: Encyclopaedia Table of Contents
strings: Encyclopaedia Table of Contents
Special
Asal's gift—a symbol of wisdom and rationality. So thick, and yet only the table of contents.

2001297.title: Calling the Dishes
strings: Calling the Dishes
Special
An old poet reels off every beloved homestyle dish he's eaten—practically a rhymed recipe list.

2001298.title: Study of Makeup
strings: Study of Makeup
Special

You can introduce some suitable people to Malkina through Methinks, so that she can see more profound faces. However, this demands that your Renown or Infamy spread far and wide, and that you hold considerable Influence in court or in the Dark Alley.

2001299.title: Clay Key
strings: Clay Key
Special
A key to open a new world.

2001300.title: Perfect Dragon's Eye
strings: Perfect Dragon's Eye
Special
A flawless dragon's eye.

2001301.title: Wild Game
strings: Wild Game
Ingredient
Various freshly hunted birds and beasts.

2001302.title: The Grand Hunt Feast
strings: The Grand Hunt Feast
Feast
A mix of dozens of meats and wild greens, wrapped in a freshly baked flatbread. The smell alone is mouthwatering beyond words.

2001303.title: Stag Head Mount
strings: Stag Head Mount
Special
A perfect stag's head for mounting—usable in managing the estate.

2001304.title: Perfect Tiger Skin
strings: Perfect Tiger Skin
Special
Only the Sultan is worthy of so perfect a tiger skin.

2001305.title: Massive Animal Bone
strings: Massive Animal Bone
Special
Its sheer size hints at the beast's immense bulk in life.

2001306.title: Serpent King's Scale
strings: Serpent King's Scale
Special
Only the oldest venomous snakes, those that have shed their skin countless times, bear scales this dazzling.

2001307.title: Dancer's Resolve
strings: Dancer's Resolve
Mettle
Arzuna hates you.

2001308.title: Torso of Stone
strings: Torso of Stone
Special
Roughly hewn, it hints at a female torso. Some primal life seems to slumber within it...

2001309.title: Bear-Etched Bracelet
strings: Bear-Etched Bracelet
Accessory

Made only of silver-gilt and not especially rare, the bracelet nonetheless carries exquisitely fine carving: a mother bear and her cub frolicking around berries, rendered so vividly that any mother who sees it would soften into a smile.

2001310.title: Pride of the Serpent King
strings: Pride of the Serpent King
Accessory
A perfect accessory that also serves as perfect protection.

2001311.title: Serpent King's Disguise
strings: Serpent King's Disguise
Unused
Its variegated hues seem to let the wearer vanish into the surroundings.

2001312.title: Fried River Fish
strings: Fried River Fish
Feast
No secret recipe—just hot oil and courage. Most nobles wouldn't wait by a riverside, and most commoners couldn't afford that much oil.

2001313.title: Salt-Roasted Ox Heart
strings: Salt-Roasted Ox Heart
Feast
A massive heart, coated in coarse salt and clay and roasted whole. A dish nomadic peoples reserve for their most honored guests.

2001314.title: Exquisite Leather Boots
strings: Exquisite Leather Boots
Accessory
Beautifully crafted leather boots, so comfortable you could walk in them for days without fatigue.

2001315.title: Dried Flowers
strings: Dried Flowers
Accessory
These flowers seem forever frozen at their peak bloom, their delicate fragrance lingering on through time.

2001316.title: Fine-Dried Fish
strings: Fine-Dried Fish
Feast
A sea fish personally caught and dried by Arzuna herself. She had it delivered to you from a thousand miles away.

2001317.title: Endry's Quest Timer
strings: Endry's Quest Timer
Countdown
You still have time to Carnality once to meet Endry's demand.

2001318.title: Epoch of Reincarnation
strings: Epoch of Reincarnation
Conviction
You have ascended to godhood, destined to lead the world into a new age.

2001319.title: Golden Bone Cage
strings: Golden Bone Cage
Special
A skeletal relic from a mysterious tomb. The Jinn claim it possesses a unique nature, existing simultaneously in the past, present, and future, making it a perfect cage for the Queen of Jinn.

2001320.title: Golden Flower
strings: Golden Flower
Special
A flower kindled by a Jinn's flame, blooming eternally at a crossroads. When every path is covered with these flowers, you may be able to summon the Queen of Jinn.

2001321.title: Purple Flower
strings: Purple Flower
Special
A flower kindled by a Jinn's flame, blooming eternally at a crossroads. When every path is covered with these flowers, you may be able to summon the Queen of Jinn.

2001322.title: Green Flower
strings: Green Flower
Special
A flower kindled by a Jinn's flame, blooming eternally at a crossroads. When every path is covered with these flowers, you may be able to summon the Queen of Jinn.

2001323.title: Warrior of the Stars
strings: Warrior of the Stars
Army
Stars witnessed contracts of the fallen kingdom. By your divine power, the fallen shall be reforged into the mightiest of warriors.

2001324.title: Veesa the Cow
strings: Veesa the Cow
Animal
It will be reborn time and again into your household, to labor as a beast of burden, or to await as provisions.

2001325.title: Endry the Chicken
strings: Endry the Chicken
Animal
It will be reborn time and again into your household, to labor as a beast of burden, or to await as provisions.

2001326.title: Iliona the Donkey
strings: Iliona the Donkey
Animal
It will be reborn time and again into your household, to labor as a beast of burden, or to await as provisions.

2001327.title: Jinn Queen's Lantern
strings: Jinn Queen's Lantern
Accessory
Within that cage lies flame, or hope, or a peerless beauty, or endless gold and jewels... It becomes whatever you wish to see.

2001328.title: Spring-Water Beef
strings: Spring-Water Beef
Feast
This ox is massive and robust, yet its flesh is as tender as the finest veal.

2001329.title: Spicy Diced Chicken
strings: Spicy Diced Chicken
Feast
Rich in flavour like an old hen, tender and smooth like a young one—an ideal ingredient.

2001330.title: Donkey-Meat Flatbread
strings: Donkey-Meat Flatbread
Feast
Like biting into fat, lean, and jelly all at once, each mouthful transforms in texture.

2001331.title: Fatigued
strings: Fatigued
Countdown
While fatigued, the Queen cannot bestow blessings.

2001332.title: Shattered Throne
strings: Shattered Throne
Special
This seat of human authority has been shattered by your divine power—and the monarchs of ages to come shall rule from naught but its gilded ruins.

2001333.title: Royal Night-Blend Tea
strings: Royal Night-Blend Tea
Feast
Usually enjoyed during the evening pleasures, its expensive ingredients and secret preparation ensure it won't harm the drinker.

2001334.title: Secrets of Palace Walls
strings: Secrets of Palace Walls
Special
These blueprints reveal a hidden mechanism in the high walls of the Sultan's palace—perhaps used by eunuchs to smuggle items forbidden in the harem. Your army, of course, can make use of it too.

2001335.title: Eyeball Flatbread
strings: Eyeball Flatbread
Feast
If the eyeballs on top stare at you, you won't be able to bite into it. The trick is to wave a fork to distract them, then strike from the other side. Each eyeball tastes different.

2001336.title: Murder Fizz
strings: Murder Fizz
Feast

A delicious soda loaded with salt and sugar, perfect for hot weather. Drinking it will make you let out enormous burps that sound eerily like different people screaming in their final moments—hence the name.

2001337.title: Spicy Snake Neck
strings: Spicy Snake Neck
Feast
Fried until even the bones can be chewed, this makes a perfect snack with drinks—provided you don't mind it wriggling while you eat.

2001338.title: Mystery Meat Shell
strings: Mystery Meat Shell
Feast
No matter what meat you put inside, it transforms into a uniquely delicious flavor... though exactly what kind of meat, no one can say.

2001339.title: Biting Bread
strings: Biting Bread
Feast
Don't worry about the sharp teeth. They're extremely crisp, like fried fat, adding a crunchy texture. Just... watch your tongue.

2001340.title: Skeleton-Aged Spirit
strings: Skeleton-Aged Spirit
Feast
Any alcohol poured in gains fifty years of flavor. If you get drunk, you might glimpse a random event fifty years in the future—but it's entirely unpredictable, so not very useful.

2001341.title: Succubus Milk Tea
strings: Succubus Milk Tea
Feast
Each straw offers a different flavor. One, in particular, carries the thrilling, tingling sensation of a lover's kiss.

2001342.title: Rhino of Eight Treasures
strings: Rhino of Eight Treasures
Feast
A supreme delicacy: a rhino, tamed by you, is stuffed with chicken, lamb, beef, camel hump, pine nuts, dates, and cheese, then roasted for a full day and night.

2001343.title: Lamblet
strings: Lamblet
A manifestation of the True God.

The great beings who once took part in the creation of the world have been more or less influenced by some mortal things. At first, They were merely abstract concepts; later on, They learned to clothe themselves in concrete forms.

2001344.title: The Time is Now
strings: The Time is Now
Countdown
No one knows how long Lamblet has been plotting these steps—they do not make a single misstep, and you must rely on your own intuition.

2001345.title: Revocation of Existence
strings: Revocation of Existence
Fatal Problem
Is this a lie or a spell? Ah, you know, at the dawn of creation, there was little difference between the two.

2001346.title: Ladder of Ascension
strings: Ladder of Ascension
Power of Ascension
This item is forged from two core materials: a noble spirit, and unwavering trust in you.

2001347.title: Void Shield
strings: Void Shield
Power of Ascension
A life force strong enough to fend off the void time after time for a lifetime.

2001348.title: Tools of Creation
strings: Tools of Creation
Power of Ascension
The world is written in words, so the power of creation manifests itself in divine terms and storytelling metaphors.

2001349.title: The First Cause
strings: The First Cause
Power of Ascension
Philosophers have argued about this for millennia, and there will never be an answer—for they have not witnessed this moment.

3300002.title: Diamond is Unbreakable
strings: Diamond is Unbreakable

A noblewoman who once partnered with you in the jewelry design business. You knew her to be skillful with both her hands and her heart, but you never expected that, even in times of peril, she would remain true to this partnership.

3300003.title: Gratitude of the Seamstress
strings: Gratitude of the Seamstress

Your family once supported a slave's career, making her a free woman. Now her daughter has come to repay the kindness... Seeing how downcast your house is looking, she says that this will not do, and whips out her makeup box.

3300004.title: Blood is Thicker than Water
strings: Blood is Thicker than Water

Your father mentioned this woman in his will. You know this beautiful dancer inherited a family estate, but because of your mother's and wife's disdain, you have not been close. Now, in your time of great need, she comes to your aid voluntarily.

3300005.title: The Final Fair-Weather Friend
strings: The Final Fair-Weather Friend
Once you had many, many friends; your wife called them all fair-weather friends. Now you can proudly hold your head high, for at least one of them remains by your side.

3300006.title: The Chosen One
strings: The Chosen One
His standing is higher than yours. As the Sultan's cherished little kitten, each generation of Lady Becky is free to choose his own "owner".

3300007.title: Old Habits Die Hard
strings: Old Habits Die Hard
You swore if you touched his "Lucky Boxes" again, you would cut off your own hands. Clearly, you failed to keep to your resolution.

3300009.title: Strength Training
strings: Strength Training
You used to weightlift a hundred times per day. It has paid off. Physique +2

3300010.title: Beauty on the Outside
strings: Beauty on the Outside
You used to worry that your beauty would overshadow your talents. Now you realize that your beauty is the only thing you can rely on. Charisma +2

3300011.title: Overthinker
strings: Overthinker

Wisdom is a curse, especially in dark times. The clearer your mind, the more acute your suffering. Fortunately, you have been forced into such depths of despair, the time has come for your mind to calm and find a way forward. Wisdom +2

3300012.title: Socialite
strings: Socialite
You have always been popular ever since you were a child. Now, you desperately need to maintain that popularity. Sociability +2

3300013.title: Looking for Trouble
strings: Looking for Trouble
In the past, you had the bad habit of looking for trouble. Now, trouble has come looking for you. Combat +2

3300014.title: Dark Alley Libertine
strings: Dark Alley Libertine
You used to skirt the edge of law and made some questionable friends. Now the time has come to really commit. Stealth +2

3300015.title: Man vs. Wild
strings: Man vs. Wild
You have always loved the wilderness more than the court. Now it dawns on you that the Sultan's palace, too, is a jungle. Survival +2

3300016.title: Blue Blood
strings: Blue Blood

Your wife's family is very prestigious, but she has put all that pomp and ceremony aside since marrying you. Now the circumstances have changed, she is prepared to give it her all, to use every ounce of her presence to help you overcome this trial.

3300017.title: Noble Bloodline
strings: Noble Bloodline

It is said that your wife's family once married into the royal house. As time passed, this has become nothing but a vain joke. Now, you burn the midnight oil studying the genealogy for anything that can be turned to your advantage.

3300018.title: A Fortune
strings: A Fortune
Adds another 5 Gold Coins to your starting hand.

3300019.title: A Fortune +
strings: A Fortune +
Adds another 5 Gold Coins to your starting hand.

3300020.title: A Fortune ++
strings: A Fortune ++
Adds another 5 Gold Coins to your starting hand.

3300021.title: A Fortune +++
strings: A Fortune +++
Adds another 5 Gold Coins to your starting hand.

3300022.title: Lucky Amulet
strings: Lucky Amulet
The Character equipped with this accessory gains reroll +1 (once per every check).

3300023.title: Regeneration Amulet
strings: Regeneration Amulet
The Character equipped with this accessory automatically heals wounds after each Ritual.

3300024.title: Charming Amulet
strings: Charming Amulet
The Character equipped with this accessory needs only attend The Grand Game once per week to ensure the Sultan's approval.

3300025.title: Improved Admirer
strings: Improved Admirer
You knew that he was of extraordinary origin, but you did not expect him to be the son of a lord...

3300026.title: Stronger Devotee+
strings: Stronger Devotee+
To help your cause, he is willing to make a dangerous move, publicly flaunting his thin royal bloodline.

3300027.title: Uniquely Talented Slave
strings: Uniquely Talented Slave
After hearing about your ordeal, Aziz immediately smashed through a large stone using his forehead – his only trick... (Aziz‘s Combat +2, Physique +1).

3300028.title: Uniquely Talented Slave +
strings: Uniquely Talented Slave +
After hearing about your ordeal, Zephyr did not say anything, but you can tell that he is ever so faster when delivering letters (Zephyr's Stealth +1, Survival +2).

3300029.title: Uniquely Talented Slave ++
strings: Uniquely Talented Slave ++

Following your wife's instructions, Inal has started to dress up. With the amount of tasks flooding you each day, a dignified maid is much more useful than a humble slave (Inal's Charisma +1, Sociability +1).

3300030.title: Bath VIP Card
strings: Bath VIP Card

Wow, you and your wife really love to bathe. The balance on this card could last a lifetime – especially if your game ends poorly. Use the card to bathe for free. It also allows non-noble allies to bathe.

3300031.title: Book Rental Club Card
strings: Book Rental Club Card

The Bookstore Owner only gives these club cards to true book lovers – just return the book after reading. 
Use this card to buy books at the Bookstore for free.

3300032.title: Ancestral Armor Upgrade
strings: Ancestral Armor Upgrade
You prayed to your ancestral armor. To your surprise, it actually responded.

3300033.title: Ancestral Armor Upgrade+
strings: Ancestral Armor Upgrade+
You prayed to your ancestral armor. To your surprise, it actually responded.

3300034.title: The Magician's Boon
strings: The Magician's Boon
You've played this game so many times... occasionally the Magician will let you secretly replace one of the Sultan's Cards—he won't remember anyway. (5 additional times per game)

3300035.title: Blessing of the Stars
strings: Blessing of the Stars

The stars have watched your games countless times... occasionally, the constellations will turn back time for you. You receive 5 additional chances to return to the previous turn per game. (No effect on Easy difficulty)

3300036.title: Secret Twin
strings: Secret Twin

You were born in a time of turmoil. For certain considerations, your parents hid the fact that they had given birth to a pair of twins. Everyone thinks that you are one person, and for all intents and purposes, you are: united in mind and soul, bound in life and fate.

3300037.title: Additional Properties
strings: Additional Properties
Those who inherit vast estates always live more comfortably... would you like to be such a person?

3300038.title: Stone Sultan Cards+
strings: Stone Sultan Cards+
4 extra Sultan Cards of the Stone tier are added to the Magician's box: Bloodshed, Carnality, Extravagance, and Conquest... she knew you would fall in love with this game.

3300039.title: Bronze Sultan Cards+
strings: Bronze Sultan Cards+
4 extra Sultan Cards of the Bronze tier are added to the Magician's box: Bloodshed, Carnality, Extravagance, and Conquest... you want just the Carnality card? Dream on.

3300040.title: Silver Sultan Card+
strings: Silver Sultan Card+
4 extra Sultan Cards of the Silver tier are added to the Magician's box: Bloodshed, Carnality, Extravagance, and Conquest... my, do take care of your health.

3300041.title: Gold Sultan Card+
strings: Gold Sultan Card+
4 extra Sultan Cards of the Gold tier are added to the Magician's box: Bloodshed, Carnality, Extravagance, and Conquest... permit me to call you a true Master of the Game.

3300042.title: Glimpse of God
strings: Glimpse of God

Now you can see the God—this is both a stairway to ascend and a curse leading to infinite madness. (Unlocks hidden stories and additional endings related to the God. Activating this feature ramps up both complexity and difficulty. Toggle at your discretion.)

3300043.title: Renown Card
strings: Renown Card
Before the game began, Maggie made a hefty donation to the Purist Order in your name. You can remind people of that anytime. Gain an item that grants +10 Renown through Methinks

3300044.title: Infamy Card
strings: Infamy Card

Many creatures survive by mimicking the bright, the poisonous, or the terrifying to scare off predators. Whether it’s real or just an act doesn’t matter, what's important is staying alive. Gain an item that grants +10 Infamy through Methinks

3300045.title: Notoriety Card
strings: Notoriety Card

In your younger days, you had friends and connections all across the land. You might be out of the game now, but the stories about you are still making the rounds. Gain an item that grants +10 Notoriety through Methinks

3300046.title: Influence Card
strings: Influence Card
Of course you’re the Sultan’s favorite. Why else would you be the one playing this game? Just because of bad luck? Yeah, right. Gain an item that grants +10 Influence through Methinks

3300047.title: Insight Card
strings: Insight Card

You’ve been able to see those creepy, otherworldly things for as long as you can remember. You just kept pretending not to, doing your best to act like everything was normal. Gain an item that grants +10 Insight through Methinks

3300048.title: Sultan's Nipple Chains
strings: Sultan's Nipple Chains
A trophy miraculously preserved, granting power while reminding you this game never ends. Your first drawn Sultan Card will always be Gold Extravagance.

3300049.title: Clay Key
strings: Clay Key
Once you find it, you'll find it countless times—the point is, how you choose to use it.

3300050.title: Veesa the Cow
strings: Veesa the Cow
It will serve you for all eternity, isn't that agreed?

3300051.title: Endry the Chicken
strings: Endry the Chicken
It will serve you for all eternity, isn't that agreed?

3300052.title: Iliona the Donkey
strings: Iliona the Donkey
It will serve you for all eternity, isn't that agreed?

5000001.title: Managing the Estate
strings: Managing the Estate
People are still willing to come under your roof and share words, promises, and opportunities.
You need a Noble to take care of things.
Anyone who can assist.
Use Methinks to upgrade your house and gain extra effects.
Try putting an item or location in. May prove useful.
This takes place automatically every turn. The higher the resulting value, the more Gold Coins are earned.
You can use an Extravagance Card via Methinks in the lower left corner to refurbish the house to increase your income.
If you get a card with the Location tag, you can try to put it in.
A nod, a word shared, a handshake. Nobles need not labor to make a living...
Your Wisdom and Sociability determine your full dice count.
3 Successes will yield the highest returns.
Meow?
Hmm... Today's menu...
The dishes for entertaining guests are ready.
I'll take care of the household. Don't worry.
Got it. Go do what you gotta do.
Don't worry, I know what my guests like.
I'll have a good chat with the guests.
Bring the best camel milk!
I will try my best.
Me? There should be someone more suitable, right?
Leave it to me!
That's exactly what I'm good at!
Everyone, please cheer up and don't make any mistakes during the feast.
How can I help you?
I promise this will be the best feast in the city.
Cheer up, don't make mistakes at the feast.
I promise that every silver cup will sparkle!
At your command, my lord.
Yes, my lord.
The house doesn't have enough space.
All will be well.
A good night's sleep, perhaps?
Hope I can save enough money soon and leave this dog-eat-dog hellhole...
Smile, dear.
I did well, no?
Would it please you to offer me a word of praise today?
See that? I’ve had ‘em wrapped around my finger, all smiles and satisfied~
All will be well, right?
Don't worry. We still have enough money to make it through.
I always feel like I can do better, so I’ll make another detailed list!

Something noteworthy has happened.

However, as you climb the statue and gaze at the gathered guests below, a revelation courses through your soul. You see the truth hidden beneath their fine clothes and painted faces – they are nothing but maggots, shameless and vile creatures writhing in the filth of this corrupted world. So, with great delight, you pull down your pants and drop the maggots' favorite food to them.

This absurd scandal shocks both the court and the public. The Sultan, however, bursts into laughter, completely forgetting all his previous suspicions and hatred toward you. He even has a pure silver chamber pot delivered to your home by his eunuch... which fits perfectly.
Instantly, the room is filled with an unusual fragrance.

You feel puzzled, so you try to read it.

This is the next volume that my wife has been looking for, and perhaps it can be used to deal with her resentment.

This booklet records a ranking of beauties spread among the folks, ahead of Nayla are two concubines reportedly most favored by the Sultan, a mysterious witch hiding in the Dark Alley, the wife of a dignitary chosen to play some grand card game, and two prostitutes viewed as unattainable by the author.
Nayla grumbles by this ranking and promises to thank you if you could use some special methods to elevate her standing.
You know my grievances, you know what I want.

Although you have done it before, Nayla seems to want to know if you have improved during this time.
As for the others… some you might easily invite to your house for a match, while others might require alternative strategies...
A simple ritual can remove curse.
You'd always be curious.
You'd always be curious about what position you rank in this list.
You came up with a plan to establish a safe house by exploiting your notoriety.
You received a strange old book, Qais seems to recognize it, let's see what he'll say.
Let's wait until Qais is free before opening the blueprints.
No matter how much you try, you can't seem to concentrate on what's written, it seems you won't be able to read this book for some time.
Bharat wordlessly put down the purse and took the silk. You tried not to wonder whether you sold it too cheaply as you watched his straightforward demeanor.
Who would not love such fine silk? You realized you could just as well give it to your companions—or keep it for yourself.
Could this truly be just simple jewelry? What does this strange flame within stone signify?
Revive! My...
Your longing for the dead cannot sketch their features.
Just consume it - yes, simply embed it in your chest, and you shall gain eternal life!
From these scattered clues, you've distilled useful information. This is a nomad-hunting band, with clear leadership and location. You can dispatch forces to eliminate them at any time.
From these scattered clues, you've distilled useful information. This is a barbarian-hunting band, with clear leadership and location. You can dispatch forces to eliminate them at any time.

From these scattered clues, you've distilled useful information. Surprisingly, this hunting band's targets are the nation's own wanderers - freemen! They burn their identity papers and sell them as slaves, which is completely illegal! 
Fortunately, the band's leadership and location are very clear. You can dispatch forces to eliminate them at any time.
I understand everything!
The world is divided into countless layers, agape only by the moonlight.
So, you need to gather some wise people, at least those who won't miscalculate.
In mystery, you bound a part of your fate to the sun's trajectory.
Now, many things once hidden are no longer secret to you.
The starlight was like a sword, severing some of your ties with the mysterious world... perhaps it's also a blessing.
People were terrified by the ominous sign! But at your suggestion, they seemed to remember the source of their fear.
You see an error that would occur in the future.
You see three different futures for you to choose from.
In the depths of darkness, there is something darker than darkness itself.

In a secluded place away from the world's membranes... you saw the Magician. She lay naked on an ancient rock, using two massive emeralds to cover her eyes, stretching limbs, letting starlight sculpt her skin. After a long while, she sensed your gaze and sent a distant kiss, along with some rewards.
You gazed long upon the star, seeing a vision within its flickering – a giant, corrupt being from the depths of the earth, countless in tongues and claws...
Pretend it abandoned? Or use it in the Managing the Estate, perhaps House of Delights?

You sent people to investigate the address on this note, and they took some time before realizing that, hidden behind some twists and turns, the remote mansion actually belongs to Nawfal.

...You feel a slight stir – was leaving this note a negligence, a coincidence, or... a bait for the willing? 
You might watch Nawfal’s movements these days, maybe he really will...
With good wine before you, you can choose to drink alone or share with your followers.
You can enjoy this delicacy with Alim or call in a follower to share.
Faris's whistle allows its user to become skilled at communicating with animals
You can enjoy this delicacy alone or call in a follower to share.
These special petals are perfect for tea, and you should enjoy them with your consort.
This weapon screams in your ear - it needs souls! Needs more... more souls!

How will you resolve Zazie's nightmare?
I'd never drink them myself... of all people.
A rational person would do this
You begin examining your devotion.
You look at this painting, becoming lost in thought.
This details Nawfal's transformation from loyal subject to potential rebel.
The egg in your hand begins to cry.
The egg in your hands is as quiet as a child who's full and fast asleep.
White Honey Amber Orb can be used to dispel curses
You study this precious magical compass and discover a ritual that can deceive the Sultan Card's timing.
Why not try imitating your monarch, wearing it on your chest?

Have you decided how to use this bridoon?
You rub the suspicious Gold Coin between your fingers. Maybe it should be checked by someone.
There's something off about those people... I can feel it.
Who shall I gift this lovely favor to?
Take them and give them away.

On the note Samir gave you are the names of the fallen kingdom, all sharing a surname, once living in mansions near the palace—clearly nobles of rank.
Physicians, you realized. You recalled they were royal physicians serving the fallen kingdom, like Samir today. Their name was bound to "healing" and "hope". It was said their hands, wrought of crystal and gold, could banish disease wherever they touched.
Now, per your old friend's request, it's time to seek their traces at the old residence.
Said to have tonic properties.
A replica of Water of Life. It should be useful for treating wounds.
Perhaps... You should let Samir handle? After all, he made those draughts.
You go to Jenna, hoping she can embed gems into your equipment.
A replica of Water of Life. It may hurt, but it heals wounds.

You flicked the imprisoned Queen with your finger. She responded with a lazy, disgusted, yet faintly tempting gaze... You shook the cage, and the wishes she had hidden drifted free—like neon powder, floating into someone's dreams and turning them into reality...
No matter how you shook the cage, no wish-powder came out. It seemed she had nothing left to give for now.
You didn't find the right way to open this book.

5000003.title: Carnality at Home
strings: Carnality at Home

Here in your own territory, you may unleash your desires. Your wife is willing, as are those who harbor passion for you. Then again, under the rules of the Sultan's Game, coercion is always a choice, immortal though it may be...
A Carnality Card. You must find a woman worthy of its tier, or...
You have to do it yourself.
The object of carnality must match the Carnality Card's tier. Bedding anyone other than your wife is considered immoral, especially taking someone against their will.
Perhaps something that enhances pleasure may be of assistance.
A follower forced to endure such an act will leave you.
In general, choosing a follower that carries Passion will not result in too bad an outcome.
Your wife generally will not refuse.
The tier of the object of carnality cannot be lower than that of the Sultan Card.
This is a low tier Carnality Card. There is no need to focus on your own people. Solving it is not as difficult as you might first imagine – you come up with an idea.
Garden's Heart
Well Prepared
She Fought You like a Wild Beast
Shape of Heart

That's why you bought her, for this.
Dark Communion

The cat will do.
She also wants to try the Rod of Life.
We should share everything...
This is your right as the husband.
Under the cover of night
You violated an unwilling ally...

She Tried to Trust You
Thousand and One Hugs

You command [s3.name] to undress for the Sultan's mad game... and it opens willingly. You dive into [s3.name]'s layered beauty like a bee into blossoms, savoring its essence... then giving more in passionate embrace.
Later, thorn-scratches mark your back while deeper transformations take root - in you, in [s3.name]...
The Magician whispers to the Sultan, both giggling... but why worry? You seek only to survive today, whatever the cost.

An absurd scene unfolded in the capital when two disheveled figures burst from [player.name]'s mansion - himself and his cook.
According to witnesses, [player.name] had a meat cleaver lodged in his head, bleeding profusely, yet still furiously swinging a rolling pin while pursuing his fleeing cook. The cook, Habib, was reportedly bleeding heavily from his backside, evidently wounded by the rolling pin.
Such vulgar gossip hardly concerns you - what matters is presenting that blood-stained implement as evidence to the Sultan in the Lapis Lazuli Hall! You certainly drove it in! This Carnality Card must be broken!
After a desperate struggle, all you were left with was a savage bite mark... She fled—perhaps never to return to your side again...

[xiaochou.name] was ready. With a knowing smile, it slipped into the great bed before you, laughter like a siren’s call. Shadows danced across the curtains, shifting forms, bathed in an azure glow as the ocean beckoned you deeper.
You drifted, weightless, caught between dream and flesh. [xiaochou.name] yielded to your touch, letting you explore, climb, caress... You knew these intoxicating feet—the teasing brush of a noblewoman beneath the table. These strong calves—the stride of a soldier returning victorious. This taut belly—the trembling dance of virgins at the harvest feast...
When your lips met it’s chest, where skin shimmered like liquid under your tongue. As you traced the spine, where the voice rose and fell in a melody of sighs. You recognized every hue, every texture, every kiss, every way it molded to your desire...
Yet still, you did not know the shape of it’s heart. Just as you had never truly known your own.
When the heat of flesh blazed brightest—did you hear it’s whisper of love? Or was it only the echo of your own longing? With every shuddering gasp, every known face it became... but the shape of its heart remained a mystery.

For the first time, Shama controls you with neither words nor glances. She simply removes her garments and the ornate jewelry you commanded her to wear. With each item shed, her posture grows more submissive, her expression more humble - until finally, she yields completely beneath you.
This is a conqueror's sweetest privilege - consuming another's fate. As master, you partake of her body, her life, her destiny, witnessing her entire journey - from noble's daughter to scholar, from poet to wanderer, from courtesan to slave... Each descent has enriched her essence, and this is her final destination, exquisitely complete.

Her gaze betrayed interest, but could such a Jinn truly engage in carnal pleasures? With her lower half dissolving into swirling mist and wind... what sensations might that bring? Curiosity alone made the opportunity irresistible.
Indeed, your expectations were shattered. The Jinn Swordswoman possessed three invisible hands - capable with blades, yet equally adept at intimate artistry. Her tongue carried the taste of ancient rivers and cold metal, each touch electrifying your senses.
You exerted yourself fully in this duel of passion, defending mortal dignity against her otherworldly techniques, like two master strategists maneuvering across a battlefield of pleasure.
In her final gambit, her cyclonic lower form enveloped you completely...
Later, when the Sultan inquired, you dismissed the experience as unremarkable, like embracing formless mist... thankfully, he believed your deception.

Salwiyah will undoubtedly serve you wholeheartedly with all the skills she learned from the brothel and from her mother. Perhaps because of her astonishing beauty, her flattery seems more endearing than degrading. You might even find yourself unable to resist the thought of dressing her as a hostess, a lady, an exotic queen, and then to subjugate her—what a delight that would be. Still, she tenderly kisses you repeatedly, with a hint of insincerity and a bit of self-contradictory urgent desire to grasp something.

What matters more than pleasure? What concerns us more than desire?
In your passionate embrace, revelation pierces through the veil that has long troubled you - life is merely deception, a meaningless arrangement of endless toil. The god who once guided our pleasures was banished, and the faithful yearn for its return to end this world's eternal suffering!
When the forbidden name escapes simultaneously from your lips and Badriyyah's, you both reach ecstatic heights.
As the Sultan Card breaks, through the unholy stains, a sublime vision appears - pure devotees kneeling before truth. In ancient times, a deity was condemned for daring to embellish the world - now, through your vision, Their name shall be sanctified again, returning to glory.

What matters more than pleasure? What concerns us more than desire? In your passionate embrace, revelation pierces through the veil that has long troubled you—life is merely deception, a meaningless arrangement of endless toil. The god who once guided our pleasures was banished, and the faithful yearn for its return to end this world's eternal suffering! When the Cultic name escapes simultaneously from your lips and Badriyyah's, you both reach ecstatic heights.

She is a harmless target, isn't she? After all, you have done far more ridiculous things... so doing one more wouldn't hurt, as long as it means breaking this damn card.

With this thought in mind, you slip into her room under the cover of the night and lift her frail, naked body from the sheets and robes.

To your surprise, the old woman neither panics nor resists. Her arms cling tightly to your back, her breath is hot, and her tears flow like a spring – not from pain, but from loneliness and the long-forgotten sensation of a strong, warm body.

A sudden sense of pity rises in your heart. Setting aside your recklessness, you begin to gently caress her body, kissing her from her parched lips down to every wrinkle on her skin – even the most withered, desiccated depths of her body.

Before the sun rises, the old woman has already left the bed you shared, as silent as the breaking of dawn, vanishing along with the darkness.

Even so, when you recount this story to the Sultan, its sheer absurdity leaves everyone speechless. No one questions your action of breaking the card.

Lady Becky is an understanding little kitty. Blessed be her ancestors, who vanquished wicked vipers; and her, who comprehends the neededness of her assistance to her masters. The whole process is unexpectedly gentle and delightful – you’ve heard of Courtesans using cat fur to arouse their guests, and it feels quite pleasant... Without injuring any life, you break the Carnality Card, and she enjoys the chicken strips you keep on feeding her with one hand.
 It didn't really dawn on you until later that Lady Becky is less of a lady and more of a lord, which adds a touch of madness to your actions... Whenever Lady Becky struts down the street, whether servants or socialites, none can’t help but whisper...

You pushed her onto the floor, as she demanded to be turned over.
 “Only in this position can I see clearly my masterpiece...” She stared obsessively at the object, “Oh, what mastercraft! No foreplay, no sweet nothings – it's already spry and buckling. How wonderful!”
 Then, she accepted the masterpiece with her body.
 Following her instructions, you manipulated the various functions of the Rod of Life, and soon, it is as though the state of Divinity is all but within your euphoric moans.
 At this point, she suddenly seized the control button of the staff and pressed some combinations that she had never told you about – the rod of life started glowing intensely, illuminating her flesh and skin as if connecting both of you with a sun...
 Mahir tightly pressed her lower abdomen, caressing the glowing miracle. The light grew even more intense, piercing through both of your bodies. In the dark capital, your bedroom became a beacon that attracted people's attention...
Everything was perfect; save aside the rapturous vulgarity oozing from your lips, which promptly alarmed your wife...
 The Sultan heard about your fascinating story of Carnality and specifically summoned you to the throne. He ordered you to take off your clothes and carefully examined your fake member. He even poked and weighed it with his hand, asking how you felt.
 While he was doing this, the entire palace stretched their necks to watch you both, everyone wanting to poke it themselves. Afterward, even when you were just walking, drinking water, or having a normal conversation, everyone’s eyes would only be fixed on your crotch. For a long time, your high-speed rotating brass phallus was more famous than you.

You invite Fatuna to rekindle the earthly joys a man may share with a woman, but is faced with a stern refusal. Just as you are about to leave in embarrassment, thinking you have misunderstood your interactions, she shyly grabs your coat.

"I think, Maggie, your wife, and I are the best of friends. Have you heard of sororal polygyny? Em, I mean, what I mean is..."

You understand what she means, and to be honest, it is not a bad idea. Who would not want to be blessed with the company of two wonderful women? The only things is... You are briefly lost in thought.
Forget it. She is Maggie's friend, after all.

You have finally made Fatuna completely yours.

You got her all by yourself, and now she is fully yours – legally, fairly – or so you keep telling yourself. Her reaction also shows you that, despite everything you've been through, her desire for you has always been there. Your union, driven purely by instinct, is so smooth and natural.

Suddenly, it occurs to you that tomorrow you will stand in the lapis lazuli hall and explain to the Sultan how you completed the Carnality Card. You will share every detail with the entire court – the way she stretched her legs, the feel of her breasts in your hands, and the patterns of moonlight and silk curtains reflected beside her lashes. Even the path of sweat sliding through the forest between her thighs will not be left untold.

Like two inseparable sides of human nature, this thought sometimes excites you, yet other times, it drains all your strength. However, tonight you can bury your face between Fatuna's breasts, letting her damp braids brush against your cheeks. After all, this is your right as her husband.

You surrender to passion and desire, your bodies pressed together, and your breaths softly intertwine.. Before you overwhelm him with the pain of swelling, he has already endured countless moments of emotional torment. And before you bring him unspeakable pleasure, he has long since replayed every fleeting moment you have shared in his mind.

If Faraj has long grown accustomed to living in your shadow, then at this moment, he can finally meet your gaze and see you for who you truly are – that the one he admires also has moments of moral failing, that the person he reveres carries blemishes in his soul.

But isn’t it exactly what lies hidden in the dark that he has been yearning for all along? Isn’t it that faint glimmer in the night – the small, fleeting light he has always dreamed of calling his own?

That night, neither of you speaks of love. And yet, later, when you talk about this affair in the lapis lazuli palace in front of the gathered crowd, breaking the card of Carnality with ease, Faraj does not leave.

You have betrayed your followers and resorted to dirty tricks to disgrace someone who placed their trust in you—someone who is not just any person, but your very own sister! Everyone will despise you, except for the Sultan, who is obviously pleased.

She surrendered herself willingly, forbidden desires kindling an uncontrolled passion that created fleeting illusions of genuine intimacy. In that stolen moment, you glimpsed understanding of your father's choices...
By dawn, your bed lay empty, and as morning mist evaporated, even your wife remained oblivious to the night's transgressions.

But from the moment you drew that card—when your eyes, without your knowing, began to betray that worldly desire—you never realized how sharply a girl can sense the taint of lust in a man's gaze. From that instant, her trust was broken.
So when you pushed open the little room Maggie had prepared for her, and lifted the blanket only to find a few pillows in disguise, you understood she had fled—decisively, without a trace of hesitation. She had cast aside the life of silk and finery, tearing through the grace once bestowed upon her, the grace you had secretly priced in your heart. Perhaps she would return to the old man, or find her own way to survive. Her days would be hard, and yet, in a way, that too was her fortune.

In intercourse, you see death; in embrace, you see life. Maggie's Love was so wonderful, while the Sultan's game was so frightful — and so instead you see fate.
You see yourself die numerous times in the game, beheaded by the Sultan, poisoned by Maggie, killed in battle, assassinated, committing suicide...
You also see yourself embrace Maggie time and time again.
The stars twinkle like the eyes of gods, shamelessly, tirelessly watching your carnal bodies connect...
The next day, you truthfully recount this marvelous experience in court, making the Sultan laugh heartily, asking what drug you took to experience such wonderful visions, while the magician gazes at you ambiguously from the side.

You would have thought it was awkward to hug your wife for the Sultan's game, and you might even have worried that you would collapse from fear. But in fact, the two of you were quite madness that night, as if the love between husband and wife, which had been dormant for a long time, was rekindled. Your wife also let go of her reserve and praised your bravery loudly, so much so that the next day these words were sung in the streets and even in the palace.
People say that the Sultan's cards have the magic power to restore people's virility, and you know that the most powerful aphrodisiac is death hovering over you.

Word of your affair soon spread throughout the palace, but you didn't care about that. What really bothered you was that it seems to have slipped your mind that the house was not just your domain, but was that of another woman as well, whose dignity you humiliated in her own residence...
You have betrayed your followers and dishonored a man who trusted you with dirty tricks. Everyone will despise you, except the Sultan who is very happy.

You went to the study, ostensibly to discuss the artistic value of the astonishing poem...
 When the moon rose high, the idle talk of words on paper had become dull and tiring. You finally gave up pretense and pleaded for[s3.name]'s help in dealing with the Carnality Card...
 Maybe it was the charm of art, or perhaps they pitied your situation, but you two ultimately became intimate...
 The next morning,[s3.name]quietly slipped out of your room, as if nothing ever happened... Regardless, you could explain to the Sultan and your wife that it was all due to the poem's charm.
You have betrayed your followers and dishonored a man who trusted you with violent tricks. Everyone will despise you, except the Sultan who is very happy.
The one bore the Signs of Carnality, and the Sultan would not allow that this ordinary sort to offset another.
