Time arrives - having once shattered [s3.name]'s mind, now its flesh serves you again. On command, it bares its chest, body unfurling like petals, revealing that intoxicating fragrance and the vital channels to its heart... Your blade severs them, causing immediate withering into dead wood and fallen leaves, as though this victim never existed... Presenting this debris as proof of your Bloodshed Card at court, the Magician whispers to the Sultan while they mock the withered ring of skin on your finger - when did that appear?
You dismiss such concerns. Survival matters more than curses or poisons compared to the game itself...

At last, at last... It has come to this.
You hold one shaking hand with another, and pull out the cold, sharp dagger. Maggie watches you, her eyes tender, not a trace of fear. She smiles and embraces you one final time. She accepts it as if she has long foreseen this day. 
"Come now, darling," she whispers, "I have always been ready to give my life to you."
With tears in your eyes, you cling to the fading warmth in your arms, as if trying to catch the sun as it sinks into eternal night.
It's ridiculous that instead of blaming the rule-makers, people just blame you for not choosing the more honorable way to complete the game.

Badriyyah lunges toward your blade with rapturous joy. Blood sprays from her severed neck, unfurling like angel wings.
Yes, yes, this is right! In the chaos, understanding dawns—[s3.name]'s death is sacred, the necessary path toward liberation from this stagnant world!

Badriyyah welcomes your blade with ecstatic fervor. Her blood spreads across the floor, tracing patterns like arcane symbols. Black mist surges like a tide, consuming her body until dawn, when every trace of her existence has vanished completely.

Iman welcomed death with a smile, as though eager to discover what ultimate pain might reveal from the divine. 
Innocent blood dripped upon the card's fracture, creating a strange sensation. Mysteriously, a shackle had been broken - this card now carried a burden of sin.
Iman welcomed death with a smile, as though eager to discover what ultimate pain might reveal from the divine.
Iman welcomed death with a smile, as though this represented the ultimate destination for all impurity - his final homecoming.

When you raised your blade to [xiaochou.name], it smiled. The mirror spirit let your steel pierce the human heart—and with it, the pact between you shattered. It gained its freedom, and you gained the breaking of that damned Bloodshed Card.

[player.name], what's the matter? Have you not eaten?

Maggie laughed while critiquing your brushwork, pointing out numerous areas for improvement.
Naturally, she allowed no opportunity for corrections—immediately commanding her servant to hang the painting prominently in the great hall. Such fastidious attention to household aesthetics was rarely seen from her!

There are neither seas too safe, nor clouds too clear... The key is, do we still have the desire to set sail?
At least today, we persevered... No matter where you steer the wheel, Maggie still hoisted the sails for you.

You explained your plan to Maggie: you would play the role of a henpecked coward, beaten bloody by your wife, then suffer ridicule before the court, reducing the Sultan's suspicions of you... For this to work, she needed to stay with her parents for a few days, maintaining the appearance of a genuine quarrel...
The plan went smoothly, though Maggie was perhaps too fluid in her violence... That pot flying past your head gave you a genuine fright, though she repeatedly assured you she intentionally missed - only after leaving an enormous handprint on your face, of course.

Your wife is shocked by your change, and almost immediately raises her voice, now shrill with anger, rebuking you for turning yourself into this monstrous abomination. To stop her lecture, holding her tight, you quickly activate the switch. In the hums of its rotations, her complaints soon ceased.
Pleasure slowly surges from the device – much slower than with the original, but it means better control for your body. You can enjoy yourself while adjusting your moves in response to her euphoric expressions, all while manually switching the modes as the female artisan taught you.
Time stretches and evaporates. As the resonance between your mind and the aether within the machine reached its peak, what is usually brief like a flash of lightning became a firework show of colors and explosions lasting tens of minutes...
You are spent. In the afterglow, your wife, drenched in sweat, lies on top of you, still mumbling, "what the hell is this..." But the way her fingertips still linger upon your chest, tracing circles in the sweat, clearly suggests she was well pleased...
A bold thought crosses your mind. If she were to grow resentful of you at some point, this might be a good way of consoling her...

Of course your wife knows what you are doing, but she is exhausted from this game, and why wallow in that misery, when she can enjoy the great Rod of Life instead?
She would caress your cheeks and brush away the drops of sweat glistening in your brows. She would praise you for how handsome you are as you wield the rod with focus and intention.
Her phrasing makes you feel odd, as if the rod is not part of your own body, but as the aether tide roars through your nerves, such distractions are drowned by pleasure...

Before entering, she repeatedly assures you that the actual act is unimportant, what matters is your sincerity – the sincertiy to make up for your wrongdoings by surrendering your dignity and sticking up your butt... First, you feel the cool gel. Then, a pounding as violent as an ocean storm... Through your body, you feel her love for you, her hatred for you, and the grief this cruel game has caused her – all the things that words cannot say.
Afterwards, it is painful to get out of bed. But you count it a small price to pay for the release of these tempestuous emotions.

This carefully selected set of jewelry has completely changed your wife. She has never craved a life of excess and never urged you to seek power. But look at her now, absolutely rejuvenated! You should pursue status. You should pursue wealth! Give your woman hope. Give your woman the life she deserves.

Sitting under a thick wool blanket, by the gently swaying lamp, you read to your wife. At every plot twist, she would lean closer, her feet – how cold they are – pressed against your skin. Slowly, your voice grows quieter, and the shroud of sleep descends upon you both. Come morning, you seem to recall confessions of loyalty and love, exchanged in a half-dreaming haze. But you cannot determine if that was not merely a dream.

After hearing your troubles, Nabhani confidently promises a solution. He prepares a bath for Maggie filled with fresh rose petals. Yet he remains dissatisfied - the flowers aren't beautiful enough, not fragrant enough, not red enough... After intense deliberation, he brings in a street beggar, using the child's blood to fill the tub...
Strangely, Maggie never realizes it's blood... More disturbing still, from that moment on, she develops a taste for these baths.

"You're the smoothest talker in the whole city," you said to Nabhani, "so help me, before my wife slips poison into my tea."
Having said that, when the two really closed the bedroom door, you still felt a pang of pain: half for being the cuckold, and half in regret for all the ridiculous things you have done.
Soon, laughter drifted out from the room—not the kind born of lust, but of lively conversation.
A couple of times Nabhani stepped out to fetch some food; their clothes were perfectly in place.
Whatever they said in there, at least your wife seemed to hate you a little less now.

Your wife has no love for Jalila, but when you suggested this, she spent a whole afternoon behind closed doors, conversing with your new concubine.

Nightfall. With strong ropes, the two tie you to the bed and blindfold you... In the darkness, the whipping and insults you steeled yourself for do not materialize. Instead, you hear giggling.

The ladies turn every single part of your body into some sort of treat or toy. They tease and tickle and lick and bite – you never knew how ticklish your body was, and in so many places; you never expected just being pinched between their teeth could be so electrifying.

As they make you their plaything, you lose your ground, you twist and turn, you struggle and laugh and scream until your throat goes hoarse.

When they release you from the bondage, you are on the verge of fainting. But your mistresses are well pleased.
The greatest love comes from understanding, from forgiveness. Your poetry comforts your wife.

When Maggie was bathing, you stepped into the room with a bottle of fragrant essential oil—dressed in a short tunic, looking almost like a bathhouse attendant. Perhaps it was the scent of the oil, or the comfort of the warm water, that eased her mood, and so you worked gently along her skin—from arms, to back, to calves, to the arches of her feet.
She let out a few quiet murmurs of pleasure, and for a fleeting moment, the mistakes you had made—curse this damned game—seemed to be washed away with the water flowing down her body.
This has grown stale. Your wife's attitude has not improved.

strings: Room to Rent
You posted a rental notice, and soon a Foreign Merchant came to take your offer.
Foreign Merchant
Vacant rooms for rent

The foreign merchant named Bharat scrutinizes this vacant house, some time saying the lighting is poor, other times saying it’s not sturdy enough. You are well aware of these flaws; otherwise, why wouldn’t you live there yourself? 
You make concessions on the rent, agreeing that you will come to collect rent every 5 days at 1 gold coin, and he finally agrees.

The foreign merchant named Bharat scrutinizes this vacant house, sometimes saying the lighting is poor, other times saying it’s not sturdy enough, but it's all just for bargaining! You firmly state that this price is already very affordable, and if he doesn’t believe it, he can check around the city. He hesitates and bites his lip, but in the end, he agrees. You agree that you will come to collect rent every 5 days at 2 gold coins.

The foreign merchant named Bharat is instantly captivated by this spacious and exquisite mansion; he reaches an agreement with you without even haggling. Henceforth, you can come every 5 days to collect rent at 3 gold coins.

Such a luxurious house makes even the merchant Bharat somewhat apprehensive!
But you cheerfully reassure him, not everyone has the privilege to be protected by a statesman like you; doing business here ensures no riffraff will come for ruckus. Think about it, the noble people who enter and exit your mansion—his costly crafts will certainly have buyers among them... After a moment of pondering, something strikes him, and finally, he agrees with gritted teeth. Henceforth, you can come every 5 days to collect rent at 4 gold coins.

Refreshing Transformation

Thanks to Malkina's talent, your hair has become dull and dry, streaked with gray, with patches of baldness barely concealed by the styling. Your cheeks have sunken in like those of a beggar – one who might be suffering from consumption, or simply someone who has lost all desire to eat. Your eyes are puffy and lifeless, showing no interest in the world around you. The Sultan's wish was granted – one he was very pleased with. He even offers you a few words of comfort, as insincere as it always is.
But this time it won't work!

Malkina crafted a better-fitting mask and bodysuit for the Masked Swordsman - she thoroughly enjoyed caressing such muscles, giggling continuously.

This wandering rogue strongly resisted Malkina's touch... They played a brief game of chase around the room until he finally allowed her to adjust his belt and coat... After mere minutes, the swordsman fell in love with this new style.
She rebraided Habib's hair and taught him a new method to care for his hands' skin.

After lengthy discussion, Malkina decided to design jewelry and accessories that would remind people of you. Thus, whenever people saw Jenna's ornaments, they would recall the Sultan's Game - and the fact that you still suffer.
Malkina admired his scars and suggested treating them as decorative elements... Iman accepted some of her designs.

Hmm... Jabal clearly needed a bath first. You never realized Malkina possessed such a cutting tongue when disciplining a man. Indeed, after thorough cleansing and proper beard grooming, Jabal emerged completely transformed.

Malkina invested considerable patience explaining a principle to Nayla: sometimes more modest attire creates greater allure - if that's Nayla's intention. 
After witnessing these women's day-long battle of wills, you must admit the results impressed you, though you wisely refrained from direct commentary.
Qais fiercely resisted such embellishments and grooming, yet after Malkina worked her magic, his mother's astonished praise finally convinced him to accept her changes with grudging appreciation.

What a genuine challenge! Especially with Jawad stubbornly refusing to slim down first... Malkina employed countless techniques to reshape his rounded features - transforming them into something resolute and trustworthy! Jawad was absolutely delighted, hurrying home to show his daughter his new appearance.

Malkina reimagined Adila's wardrobe - feminine attires restricted her movement too severely, while masculine attire rarely fit properly. Now she moved with newfound freedom, cutting a more dashing figure.
Fatuna perpetually wore her widow's veil - Malkina refined its design to cloak her sorrow with greater elegance.
Zaki perpetually strived to appear mature, while Malkina taught him instead to embrace and leverage his youthful advantages.

Nabhani absolutely adored Malkina. The two could spend entire days joyfully mixing and matching outfits, showering each other with compliments. In time, he became increasingly obsessed with his looks, often bringing along several sets of accessories to swap depending on the occasion...

Faris exuded an overwhelming canine scent - Malkina discovered a perfume that masked the odor without distressing his dogs. Additionally, she crafted fashionable gold chains allowing him to secure important items to his belt, preventing his notorious tendency to misplace possessions.

For Junah, Malkina simply selected standard noblewoman's attire - garments she would never dare don even after purchasing her freedom. Under Malkina's gentle insistence, Junah appeared utterly transformed.
Malkina designed scholarly women's attires for Jalila - wearing them to a bookshop once attracted scores of former clients arriving in carriages seeking conversation.
Malkina thoughtfully prepared several masculine attires for Shama... even Maggie couldn't resist stealing several glances.
The original Alim became completely unrecognizable. Wearing these new clothes, he circulated throughout the Sultan's court delivering an address - remarkably, nobody detected anything unusual.

Gullis refused any modifications to his cherished braids, yet adorned his body with precious metals and gemstones more naturally than you anticipated... as though he once lived such an opulent lifestyle.
Malkina crafted new robes for Lumera - more magnificent than before, yet cleverly designed to conceal two volumes within their folds.

Malkina gave Fardak a local makeover and transformed his hometown attire into a refined robe with intricate embroidery reminiscent of local nobility, allowing him to blend in seamlessly while still subtly hinting at his origins.
At Asal's request, his robe was specially designed to hold numerous books without giving away...
Malkina outfitted Badriyyah in a semi-transparent ensemble to showcase every detail of her tattoos! However, gazing too intently might leave one feeling a bit dizzy...

Salwiyah has a talent for appearing innocent, but sometimes this facade edges towards tastelessness. Therefore, Malkina used makeup favored by scholars and priests on her, adjusting her attire to be less revealing... Now, simply sitting there and feigning interest is enough for Salwiyah to captivate any man who fancies himself as educated.

Even though she's parted ways with her silk and jewels, old habits die hard. Her cloak needs to be shortened, the sleeves and waistline adjusted... Maybe that'll help her carry things better now? And, of course, we need to make sure her lovely figure is well-covered—we don't want any trouble knocking on our door! Still... It's a shame I have to bid farewell to those charming curls...

"You need to look wealthy enough to avoid appearing like a fake, but not so wealthy that you attract unwanted attention!" Hence, Malkina adjusted Bharat's disguise, helping him blend more seamlessly into the Sultan's city...
"Safety over style for now, right? And don't you worry! When you're a bit older, I'll style a much more appealing hairstyle for you!"

Raed insisted on maintaining her "modest" appearance to better connect with those requiring her assistance. Respecting her wishes, Malkina fashioned sturdy, practical trousers better suited for her demanding work.

Raed had her own taste when it came to noble attire. With Malkina accompanying her to select jewelry and veils, and chatting about all sorts of gossip among the noble ladies, the day passed pleasantly. By the end of it, Raed had gained a deeper understanding and confidence in the social circle she had been absent from for years.

You certainly presented Malkina with a challenge! Nevertheless, she skillfully employed cosmetic techniques to render Jemor truly frightening... transforming ordinary unpleasantness into genuine terror. Jemor was absolutely thrilled - this embodied the powerful image he'd fantasized about his entire life!

You certainly presented Malkina with a challenge! Nevertheless, she skillfully employed cosmetic techniques to render Hamar truly frightening... transforming ordinary unpleasantness into genuine terror. Hamar was absolutely thrilled - this embodied the powerful image he'd fantasized about his entire life!

Mahir neither wanted nor required anything. However, Malkina crafted specialized ear and eye coverings - now she could sleep undisturbed in her laboratory! For scholars, quality rest proves virtually priceless!
Faraj hoped to imitate your sartorial habits, but Malkina offered more practical guidance - he's now learned to wear colors complementary to yours, which seems somewhat concerning.
Hassan's taste proved so abysmal that Malkina eventually surrendered, simply adding some decorative bells to the mutton stove's ensemble.

Lady Becky is absolutely adorable! He deserves proper adornment! Malkina promised to individually craft every garment and accessory specifically for Lady Becky, ensuring even cats could enjoy gilded splendor.
Malkina admired Aziz's impressive physique, designing sturdier, more attractive and functional robes that accentuated his natural strength.
Inal felt uncomfortable with excessive ornamentation but enthusiastically discussed skincare formulations with Malkina... revealing remarkable aptitude in this domain.
Malkina created a distinctive hairstyle and neckerchief for Zephyr, ensuring he would be instantly recognizable from great distances as [player.name]'s personal messenger.
Oh! Master, your requirements are truly extensive... You shoulder... such burdens. I shall assist you to the utmost of my capabilities!
Malkina evidently distinguishes between you two - though she consistently pretends otherwise. This proves remarkably amusing.

Although Arzuna is somewhat resistant, Malkina insisted on her trying more noble garments and outfits... When a noblewoman dances the exotic dances for guests, the scene nearly spirals out of control, with someone almost proposing immediately.

Though [xiaochou.name] did not understand why humans toiled over appearances, as a mirror, it did not spurn adornment—gold, silver, or jewels suited it just as well. Magic spared the need for tailoring. No sooner did Malkina conceive a design than the mirror shaped itself to her will. Such convenience proved intoxicating. She could not stop playing dress it up.
Malkina devoted her complete attention to grooming [s2.name], thoroughly revitalizing [s2.gender(his,her)] spirits.

Without God, we're all incomplete. Malkina paints [s2.name]'s face with several strokes, then together with [s2.name] softly repeats the Cultic God's name, again and again.

Initially, you just wanted to test it. You had Aziz open his mouth to hold the bridoon, and the magic activated. He knelt on hands and knees like a true horse... Studying him, you felt you lacked only a whip. Perhaps you should take him out? The noble ladies would surely love this new toy.

When giving the bridoon to Zephyr, you wondered if it was necessary - after all, many ordinary horses can't match Zephyr's speed!
As if responding to your regret, the magical runes activated... Now you have a horse as fast as Zephyr, though the riding method is rather ridiculous...

Lady Becky seems to love this bridoon. He hugged the jingling stick, rolling and gnawing on the ground, kicking it with his hind legs until you lost track of where it went - you only saw Lady Becky contentedly grooming his smooth fur, purring with satisfaction.
Just a little study reveals the bridoon's function completely - see, how simple!
You were about to summon [s2.name] when it suddenly dawned on you - doesn't [s2.name] already possess this skill? No point in such unnecessary effort.

5000202.title: Curse Lifted
strings: Curse Lifted
Finally, the bridoon's curse gradually lost power over time. Turns out it was single-use - thankfully it was single-use.
The Tamed
Did Help?
Infinite Terror
Thank the Heavens.
Verification

Galloping is often used as a metaphor for freedom, but what is freedom to horses?
This night, the pet curled by your bedside finally broke free from magical bonds and quietly left your room. You tactfully didn't ask Nabhani about his experience, and he pretended nothing happened, not mentioning it once.

When you finally removed his bridoon and explained it was truly an accident, Iman's expression remained calm even after breaking free from the magic's momentary confusion. "If you must apologize, I forgive you. But truly, I don't mind." He bowed slightly. "My body is the part I can control."
Facing this question after long silence, you stroked his damp hair and praised him without reservation.

What was it like wearing the bridoon for seven days? Junah smiled and told you it was a kind of joy: abandoning human form, thought, future, life, death... Her voice was infinitely light, mixed with overlooked sadness.

Nobles willingly kneel before Jalila's whip, enjoying this disordered game, letting her trample their dignity because they know they can stop it anytime. But Jalila, controlled by the bridoon for seven days, didn't know when it would end... In infinite terror and despair, in incredible redemption and comfort, her tears first dampened your shoulder.
Shama quickly returned to her usual self... as if these days were just a dream - mentioned lightly, no need for deliberate forgetting. Nothing more.

You frantically removed the damaged bridoon, patted Mahir's cheek, asking what this was, what that was, if she recognized you, if she remembered owing you bottles of Aether... She finally recovered, weakly grasping your hand: "Who owes you... Come, to the Order..."
Excellent, still the Mahir you know!

When the magic lifted, no one noticed until the loose bridoon fell and shattered on the ground. Only when someone pulled Aziz up did his flushed face show momentary clarity after confusion. But he remained silent, awaiting your judgment.
Such a pity there isn't a second bridoon like this!
Zephyr was exhausted to near-collapse during this time. Both of you learned that with human anatomy, four legs don't necessarily run faster than two - human evolution has its reasons...

5000203.title: Mortal Ways
strings: Mortal Ways
The only person you can think of with sufficient passion, wisdom, and inspiration to explore the unknown with you - who wouldn't sell you out immediately after getting a magic ring - is Mahir.
Ring of Inevitability as material
Mahir as hammer
Aether as filler
You as anvil
What you consider eternal as mold
7 Gold Coins as payment
Mortals Immortal
Stars Immortal

You completely cannot modify this ring protected by powerful magic. After much effort, you couldn't even scratch it... As you and Mahir pondered desperately, nearly giving up one night, you suddenly grasped a fleeting insight...
All things pass, all things pass - this is surely a curse for kings, but how can it not be a blessing for countless common people? Winter passes, torment passes, suffering passes, tyrannical rule passes... All things pass, except the poor who toil between sky and earth - they are immortal!
If you're not a king, what's frightening about the Ring of Inevitability's curse? If no kings exist in this world, what could the Ring of Inevitability protect?
You woke Mahir that very night, having her help engrave your oath to the people on the ring's inner surface... Skeptically, she took the smallest engraving tool, pouring the last bit of Aether onto the Ring of Inevitability. This time, the ring's vast magic fell silent, and she successfully carved new inscription beside the curse.
Now it belongs to you.

You completely cannot modify this ring protected by powerful magic. After much effort, you couldn't even scratch it... As you and Mahir pondered desperately, nearly giving up one night, a massive star suddenly visited your dreams...
You'd seen it in Mahir's Mirror of Stars and glimpsed its shadow in dreams, but never faced its transcendent true form... This was a blazing, magnificent flame that had illuminated your grain-of-sand homeland since ancient times, stirring earth's tides. Ten thousand years hence, its flame burns eternal, regardless of belief! How could you not worship this existence beyond mortal scale, this greatness that warps time and space?
When you finally awoke with tears streaming, the Ring of Inevitability bore obvious burn marks. You had Mahir seize the opportunity to erase the old inscription and carve an oath you made to the Star upon it.No longer does it mourn fallen dynasties - now it serves you alone, child of undying stars.

5000204.title: Unwavering Loyalty
strings: Unwavering Loyalty
Many folk tales of chastity and fidelity, half-true and half-false, all carry indescribable eeriness.
Currently Reading
The reader.
Tower's Phantom
From these stories, you can learn some dignified speaking methods...

After reading this book, that night a vision appeared in [s2.name]'s dreams... It was a ruined tower in the desert, unnaturally blooming with flowers - upon awakening, [s2.name] suddenly knew this place's location.
If you quickly organize an expedition, you might solve this mystery before shifting sands change its position.

5000205.title: Thorn and Tower
strings: Thorn and Tower
From afar, you can see this green, broken tower... But is that a mirage or real landmark?
A guide, with at least 4 in Survival or Wisdom.
An adventurer with at least 4 in Stealth or Physique.
A puzzle-solver with at least 4 in Wisdom or Magic.
A negotiator with at least 4 in Charisma or Sociability.
You must spend 5 Gold Coins to fund the expedition.
These will yet prove its uses within your adventures.
The Beginning of Adventure
The journey will take a long time. Please be prepared.
As adventure deepens, difficulty gradually increases. Please be prepared.
Break the vision of mirages
Holding breath, pinched a flower
Repaire the broken archway
Take the ring from the princess's hand

[s2.name]'s Stealth and Physique determine your full dice count.
[s3.name]'s Wisdom and Magic determine your full dice count.
[s4.name]'s Charisma and Sociability determine your full dice count.

You need at least 4 Success to break through the trap.

You wandered endlessly, finding only a dried riverbed strewn with ancient stones and withered leaves - the tower may exist somewhere, but you chose the wrong path entirely this time.

[s1.name] calculated cloud heights and mirage distances with instruments. Finally, [s1.name] pointed toward an almost opposite direction - the clouds had been reflecting the tower's image from there.
With anxious hearts, you trekked through desert sands until the tower materialized beyond distant dunes - it, along with those impossible desert blooms and fruits, truly existed.

This tower stands wrapped in dense vines - their water source and nourishment remain a complete mystery.
Beyond the ruins, countless thorns form towering barriers... Blue luminescent flowers command these brambles through visible rhythmic pulses - sadly, [s2.name]'s repeated attempts to pluck the controlling blooms failed, leaving [s2.name] bloodied by countless wounds.
With supplies exhausted, you had no choice but to retreat empty-handed.

This tower stands wrapped in dense vines - their water source and nourishment remain a complete mystery.
Beyond the ruins, countless thorns form towering barriers... Blue luminescent flowers command these brambles through visible rhythmic pulses - holding your breath, carefully avoiding the barbs, you delicately pluck that azure rose... Under its ethereal glow, the thorns parted reverently, even displaying submission - you couldn't help wondering what secrets and power lay hidden within this tower.

Whatever once stood here has been claimed by time's passage. Rich magical energies drift through empty rubble - this was once a gateway linking our world to distant realms... It might have led to vast territories or hidden vaults, but you lack the means to restore such miracles... This adventure yields wonder but no treasure.

Whatever once stood here has been claimed by time's passage. Rich magical energies drift through empty rubble - this was once a gateway linking our world to distant realms...
[s3.name] sifted through the debris, methodically reconstructing the shattered archway... then sealed the final bindings with [s3.gender(his,her)] own hair and blood.
All scattered enchantments reconvened - though lasting mere moments - the mysterious realm concealed within the tower opened its doors to you.

This is a garden alive with blossoms. An elegantly attired, noble lady tends her botanical charges. She might be a specter, some mighty otherworldly entity... or perhaps a legendary sorceress.
Nevertheless, [s4.name] summoned courage to approach, expressing goodwill and admiring this magnificent garden.
As if answering these praises, she gracefully twisted [s4.name]'s head from its shoulders, positioning it atop a flower bud - during your panicked escape, you could still hear [s4.gender(his,her)] anguished cries echoing from the branches.

This is a garden alive with blossoms. An elegantly attired, noble lady tends her botanical charges. She might be a specter, some mighty otherworldly entity... or perhaps a legendary sorceress.
Nevertheless, [s4.name] summoned courage to approach, expressing goodwill and admiring this magnificent garden.
[s4.name]'s refined manners and eloquent words clearly delighted this lady... She slipped a ring from her finger, placing it in [s4.name]'s palm - through this artifact, you can cultivate your own garden within the mortal realm.

5000206.title: Exotic Garden
strings: Exotic Garden
You allow thorns to establish roots, permit that alluring fragrance to drift... An unwary soul might wander into this garden, where you could ensnare them.
Intoxicated Victim
You must personally venture forth to capture prey
You can take this to use a Bloodshed Sultan Card with matching tier
It is hidden in the deepest part of the garden.
This event randomly captures a target each occurrence
If you don't go yourself, the target remains unharmed
Personal intervention enables permanent bodily control of the target
Once controlled, the ring merges with them and becomes unusable
This action counts as a Bloodshed
Empty Garden
Releasing [s1.name]
Taking Root
Today, both blooms and you exist in solitude, yet this need not be unfortunate.
[s1.name] proves unsuitable, or the moment hasn't arrived. Today, under the fragrance's influence, [s1.name] will dream pleasantly and forget this encounter entirely.

[s1.name] becomes entranced by the garden's perfume. [s1.name] gazes vacantly at a prismatic flower, completely oblivious to your approach...
You disturb that most beautiful blossom, releasing dancing pollen, and [s1.name]'s expression turns blank. From the flower's core, you extract the ring - it throbs with captured essence...
The instant you slip it onto [s1.name]'s finger, the ring begins sprouting roots and melding with [s1.name]...
Finally, you witness those tendrils spreading beneath [s1.gender(his,her)] neck skin, writhing, growing all the way to the brain - even [s1.gender(his,her)] eyes and nostrils display faint verdant traces! This form that was once [s1.name] spasms several times as flower buds emerge from [s1.gender(his,her)] mouth and bloom - it no longer requires questioning or independent thought: ancient sorcery has crafted for you a devoted slave, pet, lover, plaything - whatever you desire.
The Unrooted

Will [s1.name] become entranced by the garden's perfume? [xiaochou.gender] gazes vacantly at a prismatic flower, completely oblivious to your approach...
You disturb that most beautiful blossom, releasing dancing pollen, and [s1.name]'s expression turns blank. From the flower's core, you extract the ring - it throbs with captured essence...
The instant you slip it onto [s1.name]'s finger, the ring begins sprouting roots and melding with [s1.gender(him,her)]...
"Hahahaha!" [xiaochou.name] suddenly discards [xiaochou.gender(his,her)] disguise, fixing you with a scornful gaze as thorns sprout and blossom from within [xiaochou.gender(his,her)] body. [xiaochou.gender] relishes this unusual moment, plucking thorny branches one by one from [xiaochou.gender(his,her)] hands, chest, and ears. Afterward, [xiaochou.name] dusts off [xiaochou.gender(his,her)] backside, pulls the ring of the hunt out from within, and hurls it back into your hands along with a tangled cluster of thorns.
Fear Magic
Sultan's Flowers
Supernatural Control
They all claim you went mad from the Sultan's Game, forging pacts with demons or worse... that you'll slaughter everyone eventually - even the Sultan has caught wind of these rumors.

Later, you brought that mute puppet [s1.name] to the Sultan's court for exhibition - regrettably, it obeys only you, and the Sultan wouldn't claim your game prize.
Out of curiosity, the Sultan plucked several flowers from your garden - each deeply rooted in [s1.name]'s throat, and this process provided the Sultan considerable amusement.
Now your will can reach this servant and other domesticated creatures... they're fundamentally identical, aren't they?
The Sultan adds an Iron Guard.

5000301.title: The Uncanny Mirror
strings: The Uncanny Mirror
That old warehouse—untouched for a decade—now hums with whispers and flickers with eerie blue light. Something stirs where nothing should.
How long has it been in your home?
Take someone with you to see what stirs.
Haven't there been enough strange occurrences since this damned game began? You paid them no mind, and sure enough, after a few days—whether ghost or prank—the disturbances ceased.
A Peculiar Thing to Mimic
Shaped by the Reflection

Under cover of night, you and [s2.name] ventured into the old warehouse, drawn by its secrets...
The eerie blue light pulsed again, matching your footsteps. Beneath a dust-laden cloth lay a flat, glowing object—your own reflections shimmering faintly through the fabric. A mirror?
Compelled, you tore the cloth aside. The mirror showed not just your face, but everything—your home, your life, your fumbling first steps into the game. The mirror had watched and remembered. Just as its depths threatened to swallow you whole, [s2.name] stepped forward, casting [s2.gender(his,her)] reflection into the mirror—
[s2.name] gripped your shoulder. The world lurched. You were back. But something had followed. A crystalline figure, naked and glowing, its liquid form rippling as it shaped itself to match [s2.name]’s silhouette.
You watched, stunned, as its hands explored the peculiar duality between its thighs. Amusement struck you before the shock could take root.

Under cover of night, you and [s2.name] ventured into the old warehouse, drawn by its secrets...
The eerie blue light pulsed again, matching your footsteps. Beneath a dust-laden cloth lay a flat, glowing object—your own reflections shimmering faintly through the fabric. A mirror?
Compelled, you tore the cloth aside. The mirror showed not just your face, but everything—your home, your life, your fumbling first steps into the game. The mirror had watched and remembered. Just as its depths threatened to swallow you whole, [s2.name] stepped forward, casting [s2.gender(his,her)] reflection into the mirror—
[s2.name] gripped your shoulder. The world lurched. You were back. But something had followed. A crystalline figure, naked and glowing, its liquid form rippling as it shaped itself to match [s2.name]’s silhouette.
But the face remained unfinished—shifting, uncertain. Perhaps it needed more than mimicry. Perhaps it needed to learn?
The Mirror-born
Freshly stepped into human’s world, it clumsily apes the shapes of human... and things less than human.

5000302.title: Reflection
strings: Reflection
The creature from the mirror hungers—for more reflections, more forms, more knowledge. You feel its yearning like a weight in the air.
It hungers for more
An inspiring character
let an ally touch this being if you will.
Their presence may shape the creature’s nature.
It needs the right one to mimic.

Knowing the unknown dangers, you forbade others from further contact with that unnatural creature. Deprived of reflections to feed upon, its glow dimmed... until at last, your storeroom held only a silent mirror. You ordered it shrouded in thick carpets and sealed within an iron chest—lest its mischief stir anew.
This one's face casts no reflection in the mirror
This monster's face casts no reflection in the mirror
This one may serve as the Mirror’s reference
The Perfect Lifeform
No Mask in the Mirror
Swords and Stars
He Itched for the Challenge
Adila is Ready for Battle
Faris Came with All His Dogs
She Carried a “Sword”
Body as Bow, Will as Arrow
Foolish and Expendable
Innocent, Naive, and Powerless
Butcher's Insight
Scars Shattered the Mirror
Beware the Cursed thing, My Master
Mutual Curiosity
Mutual Fascination
Inal Polished It to a Shine
It Rejected Her Filth, Yet Embraced Her Taste
Bharat Likes Peculiar Antiques
Beyond the Written Word
Hospitable Hostess
She Demands the Treasure
Fardak Keeps Secrets
Qais Lost Composure When Mirrored
Let Jawad Taste the Danger
Fatuna Would Find This Intriguing

Don't Smash it!

Merely Who You Might Have Been
