5000550.title: Perjury of Love
strings: Perjury of Love
You must hunt down the ferocious beasts causing chaos outside the city to prove your bravery and worth to Consort Sadani.
You must take the beast's head as trophy to prove your bravery.
If not completed within the time limit, you will be executed.

The deadline has arrived, yet you still haven't killed the beast. Trembling, you kneel on the palace's cold stone floor, begging for mercy and forgiveness. 
However, all you receive is a sneer: "Forgiveness? Is that necessary? Your Majesty, he's simply an incompetent coward!" Sadani leans languidly against the Sultan, her voice sharp and cutting. "I request you immediately execute this person who dares covet what belongs to you - at the very least, gouge out those wandering, overly active eyes!" 
No, no, no... Pleas, promises, despair, curses... these things float lightly through the palace like poorly burned incense, only making the air more foul. The Sultan waves his hand in disgust, no longer wanting to speak. Your game ends here.
You present the Beast's Head

The smell of blood made Sadani nauseous, but perhaps she dared not lose her composure in the court. She just covered her pale lips with an embroidered handkerchief and tried her best to endure.

Your test has been completed, but hers has not – and for what cause?

She couldn't help but think of the time when she and the Sultan first met, it was in the royal hunting ground. He was so strong and powerful. The cold scimitar swung down ruthlessly, and the blood of the beasts she trapped instantly gushed out from the wounds and splashed on her fair cheeks.

God... At that moment, her mind was completely occupied by the panic of death, and there was only one thought left, to marry him and become the bride of this warrior...

Sadani stroked the cold fur of the wolf king in a trance, and her fingertips could not feel a trace of temperature. The Sultan had exhausted his remaining patience for this long silence. He spoke reluctantly and told the consort who looked confused: "Do you know what to do, Sadani?"

What was the Sultan reminding her? No... not, her Sultan... her husband clearly still remember those past events, their sweet and romantic times! He... he must still love her, yes, he did this only because of his position as ruler, because of... because of that damn card!

Sadani suddenly looked at you, her eyes full of resentment, as if all the contempt, insult, misfortune and failure she suffered were blamed on you.

She will take revenge on you, as long as she catches you; she will use all the means she can think until you drown in an unreturnable abyss, until you pay the price for her lost love!

5000551.title: Proof of Valor
strings: Proof of Valor

You must hunt down the beasts that are causing chaos outside the city within a certain time limit to prove your bravery and win the favor of Consort Sadani. But the Sultan has not told you what the beasts are, or where they are located. It looks like a trap. The hunter is waiting for you to step into it as a bloody sacrifice, and you have no choice but to do so.
You must prove your bravery yourself.
You can bring some items that will help you hunt.
This is a ferocious beast. Be cautious.

You spend several days searching for a quarry worthy of being called a "ferocious beast" – a wolf king who has only just assumed command of his pack. His domain is vast, his loyal throng numerous, and the hunt to fall him fraught with peril.
Your Physique and Combat determine your full dice count.
You need at least 3 Success to get a kill.

Through precarious calculations and a thrilling struggle, overcoming a trial of physical prowess and endurance, you finally decapitate the wolf king.
Panting, you lift the head, dripping with hot blood. You estimate it is worth at least one Silver Card – the same quality as Consort Sadani.
Good heavens, how commendable! You have learned to compartmentalize matters around you so adeptly. Stone, Bronze, Silver, and those worthy of Gold... Keep at it. Your world will soon become simpler. The Sultan's Game will become your everything.

After a harrowing blend of cunning stratagem and fierce combat – a dual trial of strength and endurance – you finally sever the beast king’s head. 

You withstand the agony of your wounds as you scrutinize this hard-won trophy, and deduce that it merits at least a Silver Card – the same quality as that of Consort Sadani. 

By the heavens, how commendable! You have grown so adept at classifying the world around you, sorting everything into Stone, Bronze, Silver, and Gold... Press on, for soon your world will be made plain. The Sultan’s Game shall govern all that you are.

Your hunt yields an unforeseen mishap; fortunately, this little “accident” has not claimed your life. Yet the time you have left dwindles. Whether you perish at the wolf king’s jaws or beneath the Sultan’s blade, what difference does it make?

5000552.title: Sadani's Visit
strings: Sadani's Visit

Consort Sadani arrives at your estate, stirring up quite the commotion.
Even your most trusted and meticulous servants cannot help but grumble about this rare guest’s unparalleled finickiness – she complains as if every object in your household is actively defying her.
Upon seeing you, she repels your approach with her customary pride, yet you notice her fingers, tightly clasped at the table’s edge, blanch with strain. She is as nervous as a startled fawn, as taut as a drawn bowstring.
Perhaps it is no mere apprehension, but also a hidden loneliness, a timidity beneath her bluster. Do you wish to expose it, or perhaps… harness it? It is time to make a decision.
Sadani arrives as promised
You choose to indulge with her
You choose to talk to her
You need to choose carefully
Sadani seems to be afraid of something.
You choose to exercise your earned rights
You order Maggie to pleasure her
You ask your wife to talk to her
You decide to do nothing

You press the posturing woman onto the rough carpet.
The golden decorations on her gauze dress chime and rustle. Her curses soon turn into tearful pleas: "I am with child... the Sultan's child... You can't do this to me, please..."
Such broken words ring hollow to those in the pursuit of ecstasy. You ravage the land of milk and honey, reveling in the euphoria of being the conqueror, being above it all. It is intoxicating to hold the reins. It blinds you to the deep wounds hidden beneath the silk and gold. Is the Sultan any different? Is his wine cup not overflowing with blood?
Filled with hatred and desire, you drink Sadani's tears and blood until cockcrow. You fall asleep, stroking her pallid face, untroubled by pity. There is too much to worry about. You will leave them for tomorrow.

You were expecting a luscious display between your wife and the consort, but things turn out differently.

Sadani whispers something to Maggie with a pleading look on her face. Maggie looks back at you coldly, then drives you out of the room without you getting a say. Through the door, you hear low murmurs between the women, which soon turn into suppressed sobs and soft solace.

Slowly, it becomes quiet inside. Maggie closes the door and studies you. After a while, she says, "You know, she's pregnant." She relaxes a little when she sees that your surprise is genuine. It is late at night, and the pervasive cold makes Maggie wrap her woolen shawl around her tightly. With an inscrutable look, she shakes her head and looks away.

You are both silent. When she stares into the night, you know she is looking back at that one night, many years ago, where in pain and struggle she lost her child... your child.

You could not help but reach out and hold Maggie in your arms. Tears, warm and cold, flow under the clear moonlight.

"So long as you give me a reason." You offer her an almost saintly clemency. Sadani bites her lip, her eyes flickering as different thoughts war within her, wondering if she should trust you. But she has no other choice.

Finally, the woman lowers her metaphorical quills. All the haughtiness and elegance, gone. When she lowers her eyes, she looks dejected.

After a long silence, she speaks: "I'm pregnant..." she clenches the silver cup in her hand in despair, the already cold tea in it providing her no comfort, "A child of the Sultan. The Sultan won't let him be born! Please... Please keep it as a secret, please. ”

"Child of the Sultan..." You cannot help but repeat the phrase as you reach out to touch the woman's abdomen. There is only a slight bulge, and a new life lays dormant under the protection of its mother, not knowing what a cruel fate would befall it.

"The Sultan's heir." You murmur. You can almost visualize it: the son usurping his father's crown, as every Sultan has done before him.

The curse of power runs through its veins, and you realize that if you want no part of that power, you must find someone who is qualified to bear it, or if that is your wish, you have to kill this child.

And the child's mother knows nothing of what thoughts are turning in your mind. In tears she implores you. Suddenly, in her beautiful eyes, you see the reflections of thousands of lowly, desperate mothers... Their gaze strikes you like an unstoppable sword.

You think of Maggie, of the babe you and Maggie lost, and the pain floods you. You close your eyes and realize that this is not a night for decisions. You flee Sadani's room.

You have no interest in defiling the king's consort – it is but a way to break the Sultan's Card without having to betray Maggie, nothing more.

You confess the whole story to Maggie, asking her to forgive your recklessness at the court meeting. Maggie gently strokes your cheek and softly sighs that it was not your fault. "The consort is not in a good mood. For a convincing act, you need her cooperation... I'll go talk to her."

Through the door, you hear low murmurs between the women, which soon turn into suppressed sobs and soft solace. Slowly, it becomes quiet inside. Maggie closes the door and gestures you to keep your voice down. "She's asleep now." Yet she does not move or speak for a long time, then – "You know, she's pregnant." 

You look at her in surprise, and Maggie bites her lip lightly and looks away. When she stares into the night, you know she is looking back at that one night, many years ago, where in pain and struggle she lost her child – your child. A chill creeps up every inch of your skin, and you cannot help but reach out to hold Maggie in your arms, hoping to share a little warmth with her.

Tears, warm and cold, flow under the clear moonlight.

You cast her a final glance before leaving the poor woman in the room. She looks at you disappearing through the closing door in disbelief. After a while, she collapses to the ground, covering her face as tears of relief stream down her face.

She could not have known that you have no desire for defiling the Sultan's consort or take vengeance on the haughty looks she used to cast you. You merely need another way to break that damn card with its depiction of a pair of loving couple. You still remember the day you wedded Maggie. You swore an oath of loyalty to her. You will never have her shed a single tear for you.

It is strange that after so many years, your chest still warms when you think of Maggie's eyes, so full of affection, of love. 

You cannot help knocking on Maggie's door. Taking her into your arms, you kiss her. You know not how long this love you share can sustain you in this terrible game. But at least in this very moment, it still beats in your hearts, alive and strong.

5000553.title: The Price of Pleasure
strings: The Price of Pleasure

Sadani almost died under your roof. The physician works through the night, diagnosing, staunching the blood, but when he emerges, his wears a face of resignation. "The child is lost."
The child? …So the woman spoke the truth. The child…
A sharp, ringing slap breaks through your daze. You look up to see Maggie standing before you, her face a portrait of sorrow and bitter disappointment. You realize, with chilling clarity, that you have committed the gravest sin imaginable. But before you can explain, before you can do something, anything, the Sultan’s envoy arrives.Above you, the crows of death begin to circle.
The Sultan has heard about this
You are under arrest
A gold tier Bloodshed Card can help you get away with it
If you cannot escape the crime, then death is the only thing waiting for you.
You were sentenced to death
You succeeded in getting away with it

You were executed for deliberately plotting the Crown Prince’s assassination.
No one was willing to listen to your defense, no one dared provoke the Sultan at the critical moment of his loss. Soon, you were on the rack, the executioner sharpening his cold blade beside you. As you squinted against the bright sunlight for one last glimpse of the world, you saw that the Sultan's face lacked even the pretense of grief.

You were going to be killed for deliberately murdering the crown prince, but fortunately, you had prepared a way out before being brought to the palace: a gold-quality Bloodshed Card should be enough to offset the crime you committed.
You have never been so grateful for this set of cards. While depriving you of your humanity, it seems to have given you a ray of hope.
The Sultan weighed the thin card with a gloomy face. He could easily break it with just a slight force. However, at this moment, monarch with absolute power felt the taste of his authority being challenged for the first time.
The golden edge reflected the bright sunlight, deeply hurting his eyes.
In the end, you were acquitted. However, you are still confused as to why the Sultan's envoy came so quickly, as if he had expected this. You seem to be involved in a conspiracy, and a darker and more dangerous storm is brewing.

The handmaiden seems unsurprised. Coldly, she slips a few coins from her sleeve and presses them into your palm, demanding a promise in return. But you deflect, evade. Next time, you assure her. Next time, she will have what she desires.

With something so damning, how could you not squeeze her a little?

Your silence is worth more. Sadani's maid holds back her anger as she hands you the money. Yet still, you refuse to give her your words so easily. You would be a fool to give up such an easy source of income.

With something so damning, how could you not squeeze her a little?

Sadani's maid almost throws the coins in the face. She leaves without even asking for your promise. Perhaps she has lost all hope.

You decline the handmaiden’s payment with practiced grace, assuring her that the consort’s secret is safe with you.

She is taken aback by such a display of nobility. Then, after a moment’s hesitation, she makes a request. The consort wishes to keep her secret buried, and who better to handle such a delicate task than one who already knows too much? By chance, Sadani has learned that on the night the Sultan visited her chambers, the Chamberlain, through negligence or intent, omitted several critical details from the logs. An oversight that, left uncorrected, could be the death of her unborn child.

strings: Infiltration and Forgery
You attempt to infiltrate the palace and correct the logs for Consort Sadani.
You can infiltrate the records office and tamper with the logs yourself, or send a follower.
Anything to help with the stealth mission.
If you rouse suspicion, you will not be able to make another attempt.

Your Stealth and Wisdom determine your full dice count.
You need at least 3 Success.
You successfully infiltrated the palace

You took advantage of the guard change to sneak into the Chamberlain's archive.
He records the king's daily life in great detail, from conquests and sentencing to dining and drinking. The volumes are many, but fortunately the classification is clear. You spend some time to find the volume where the date mentioned by Consort Sadani is located, and slowly recall that during that period, the Sultan has just led his army to conquer a small country, returning triumphantly, holding feasts in the palace.
The Chamberlain records all of the dishes in detail, even including the fact that the Sultan drank three more cups of foreign spiced wine. But, would such a careful archivist really remiss to mention the beauty who was by the Sultan's side that night?
Imitating the Chamberlain's handwriting, you forge a record that the Sultan had visited Consort Sadani that night, doubt growing in your heart.

You are overconfident in your stealth and alerted the guards changing shifts. You hurt yourself while making your escape. Though your identity is not exposed, the guards at the record office would surely be more vigilant from now on. You have to find another way.

You overestimated [s1.name]'s skills in infiltration. [s1.name] alerted the guards changing shifts and failed to escape, and is now imprisoned. After such an incident, the guards at the record office would surely be more vigilant. You have to find another way.

5000560.title: Bribing the Chamberlain
strings: Bribing the Chamberlain
Consort Sadani wants you to correct the royal ledger that records the Sultan's daily movements. You plan to find the Chamberlain Lazag, in hope he agrees to do you this small favor...
He is the keeper of the daily logs.
To impress him, you need at least 15 Gold Coins.
Money talks.
You bribed Lazag

Hearing that you question the correctness of his record, Lazag almost jumps up to scold you. You quickly placate him and seamlessly stuff the purse full of Gold Coins into his hands. He is a little relieved. "All that mess in the harem... I know, I understand. But you can't go around claiming my records are incomplete or wrong! I can't be!" He mutters angrily while taking you into the house of knowledge that he is so proud of. He navigates the vast archive with ease and pulls out the right record based on date. "This one, right?"
You look at the document that details the Sultan's daily routine. These words trigger some memories -during that time, the Sultan has just led his army to conquer a small country, returning triumphantly, holding feasts in the palace. The Chamberlain records all of the dishes in detail, even including the fact that the Sultan drank three more cups of foreign spiced wine - would such a careful archivist really remiss to mention the beauty who was by the Sultan's side that night?
You frown slightly, unable to suppress a little suspicion in your heart. But seeing the Chamberlain casually adding notes to the end of the scroll as you dictated, you sense that everything here is malleable and not so credible after all.

5000561.title: Eliminate Hidden Dangers
strings: Eliminate Hidden Dangers

Sadani said that on the day the Sultan visited her, due to the negligence of the Chamberlain, several crucial details were intentionally or unintentionally omitted from the Sultan's daily logs. These errors could be the death of her unborn child. She hopes that you can help her correct them, so her child's legitimacy would not be called into question.
You may inform Sadani's maid of your reply at any time.
You must put in "Proof of Alteration"
You deliver what you promised

You have corrected the Sultan's daily logs for Sadani as promised, and she no longer has to worry about anyone questioning her child's bloodline.

You receive a generous reward. You did not help her for the reward. You intention has always been the same: to convince her to join your plot of regicide. But such words are not for the ear of a maid.

5000562.title: The True Reward
strings: The True Reward
You hope to convince Sadani to join your regicide plot. It is better to conspire of such things in person. You decide to take the risk and sneak into the palace to meet Sadani.
Consort Sadani is quietly resting in her palace.
You can handle this yourself, or send certain followers.
You can either pay 10 Gold Coins to bribe the guard, or utilize the prepared Harem Secret Passage.
Some items can help with infiltration or persuasion.
Maybe there is an easy way to sneak into the harem.
Although your have friends who frequent the harem, for this particular matter, it is best if you go in person.

You already have an "arrangement" with the harem guards, but upon hearing your request, a rare look of unease creep up their brows. Not long after, the Royal Guard Captain, who has caught wind of the matter, hurries over. He does not seem pleased. You need to persuade him to let you pass, somehow...
It's obviously difficult to get into the Sultan's harem, but you don't have any better option. Pray... Pray that you can succeed.
Your Charisma and Sociability determine your full dice count.
Your Stealth and Physique determine your full dice count.
You need at least 3 Successes to convince the guard.
You need at least 1 Success to have a chance of getting the information.
Cold-shouldered, as expected
You failed to convince them
You notice something strange...
You Sneak into the Palace
You failed

Taking advantage of his position, the Court Physician Samir pays a visit to Consort Sadani. But she turns down your request for a meeting outside the palace, excusing herself saying she does not want to draw further attention. She hands Samir some money for you, hoping that it is enough to settle the matter.

The Jeweler visits the consorts as usual, and sees Consort Sadani. But Sadani turns down your request for a meeting outside the palace, excusing herself saying she does not want to draw further attention. She hands the Jeweler some money for you, hoping that it is enough to settle the matter.

The Royal Guard Captain, Seliman, seems to be in a bad mood today. He interrupts your flattery and even pushes away the bag of coins you try to sneak him. He states flatly that Consort Sadani is unwell and unfit to receive visitors; you are not to disturb her again.

How odd. Did Consort Sadani specifically order them to stop you? After all that she has done for her, how dare she be so cold?

There is something strange going on. But there is nothing to be done here today. Perhaps next time you will learn something.

Captain Seliman of the Royal Guards seem to be in a poor mood today. He abruptly interrupts your flatteries, even refusing the purse you try to bribe him with. He states flatly that Consort Sadani is unwell today and not in a state to receive visitors, that you should leave her in peace.
You detect a hint of something unusual in his eyes – the hostility of lion whose territory has been threatened.
It dawns on you. Pulling him aside, you whisper: "I know the relationship between you and Consort Sadani. Worry not, I have no intentions on her. It's just that the Consort had tasked me with this errand..."
"Sadani told you?" Seliman looks at you in surprise, and when he sees the shrewd satisfaction on your face, he falls silent.
You smile. "No wonder Consort Sadani asked me to 'correct' the royal records... Well, less correction, more fabrication, right, Captain Seliman? Please take your hand off the hilt. We are friends, aren't we?" You pat his shoulder.
At this point, it is no longer necessary for you to meet with Sadani today. You can wait and see which of you, Seliman and her can best keep your composure. You know you can wait, unlike them.

You sneak into the palace by the secret passage. It takes you some time to find Consort Sadani's abode.

As night drapes its velvet shroud over the palace, you scale the garden wall in silence, only to halt in surprise at the sight before you. Sadani stands among the blooming desert roses, her gaze lowered as a man in gilded armor plucks a blossom and tucks it behind her ear. A gesture far too intimate. And yet, she does not pull away. Beneath the lantern’s glow, her glassy, jewel-like eyes shimmer with complex emotions.

Before you can decipher the look in those eyes, the man lifts his head, as if sensing something amiss. You flee before they find you, but you have seen enough. You know his face. Seliman, the Royal Guard Captain, one of the Sultan’s most trusted Champions, the only four men permitted to bear arms in his presence.

You find a way and sneak into the harem. It takes you some time to find Consort Sadani's abode.
As night drapes its velvet shroud over the palace, you scale the garden wall in silence, only to halt in surprise at the sight before you. Sadani stands among the blooming desert roses, her gaze lowered as a man in gilded armor plucks a blossom and tucks it behind her ear. A gesture far too intimate.
And yet, she does not pull away. Beneath the lantern’s glow, her glassy, jewel-like eyes shimmer with complex emotions.
Alas, before you can decipher the look in those eyes, the man lifts his head, as if sensing something amiss. You flee before they find you, but you have seen enough. You know his face. Seliman, the Royal Guard Captain, one of the Sultan’s most trusted Champions, the only four men permitted to bear arms in his presence.

You hid in a carriage carrying supplies at night and tried to sneak into the harem, but unfortunately failed.
You took great pains to escape the siege of the guards, but they still left a lot of wounds on you... You must find a trustworthy doctor to heal you as soon as possible, otherwise your life will be in danger.

5000563.title: The Façade of Harmony
strings: The Façade of Harmony
Consort Sadani wishes to see you.
Sadani has lost patience.
You must attend the appointment in person.
You meet with Sadani

Someone has paved the way for you. Under the cover of night, you slip into the harem undetected.

Sadani dismisses her attendants and approaches you, slow and deliberate. The flickering lamplight stretches her shadow thin against the cavernous hall, cold and spectral. She studies your eyes for a long moment before she finally speaks. "You know already, don’t you?" Tonight, she wears no rouge to mask her weariness. Her pallor makes her look fragile, almost pitiable. She sighs. "It was a mistake."

Her gaze drifts to the rippling surface of her tea, then, suddenly says: "You mean to use my child, don’t you? He has to be the Sultan’s son to be of any use, no?" She bites her lower lip, then lifts her eyes to meet yours. Those entrancing eyes glisten like gemstones on a dagger’s hilt. "Kill Seliman for me. Besides us, he is the only one who knows the truth."

This, you did not expect. The words come out before you could stop them: "What? But you are –"

Her brows furrow. For a moment, she is lost in some thought. Then, with a sharp clatter, she sets the tea cup down, her voice bored. "I told you. It was a mistake." She composes herself once more. "Listen. Tomorrow at dusk, I will summon him here." She dips a fingertip into the tea and sketches a crude map onto the table, tapping a single point. "Have your men in place. Kill him on sight. End it." Her words are ruthless. She has made her decision. "I care not what you want from me, but after this, you will have it, whatever it is. The divine can be my witness."

You hold her gaze. At last, you nod and step away, leaving her in her cold, tomb-like palace.

5000564.title: Affair and Betrayal (Abandoned)
strings: Affair and Betrayal (Abandoned)

It is almost time. The stone cliffs burn like fire in the sunset. A rivulet shimmers through swaying reeds and the shadows cast by the palm groves. The vegetation hides your figure well. You have laid your trap for Seliman, though there is yet a decision to make...
The Royal Guard Captain is on his way.
You have to face him in person.
Seliman is the Honor Guard. To remove him is like to remove a limb from the Sultan.
You decide to kill Seliman

You are determined to remove a major obstacle to your regicide plot, and all that is left is to wait until Seliman falls into your trap. But it is better not to kill a man who has done nothing to deserve death, even if he might become your enemy one day. Or perhaps, a man of his rank and skill would be far more useful alive, bent to your cause? You decide to wait here and talk to Seliman once he arrives, to give him a chance.

5000565.title: No Loose Ends
strings: No Loose Ends
The Royal Guard Captain steps obliviously into your snare.
Seliman was unprepared
You can do this yourself or send any of your followers to do it.
You can place a Bloodshed Card of a tier no higher than the Royal Guard Captain's.
It's time!
You killed Seliman

Unexpectedly, Seliman didn't even put up any resistance.
His brows were entangled with pain, but his eyes were relaxed: "Did Sadani ask you to do this?" He asked this question with his last bit of strength, but he didn't need to get an answer from you.
He closed his eyes and fell down in the sharp and soft embrace of the reeds, as if this was the last thing he could do for Sadani.
You have used a Bloodshed Card
The Sultan doesn’t seem to care about Seliman's death.
Your actions inevitably left traces.

5000566.title: A Chance for Survival
strings: A Chance for Survival

Seliman arrives at the appointed place, unguarded, unaware. And yet, he has done nothing to deserve death, here and now, even though he may become your enemy one day. Or perhaps, a man of his rank and skill would be far more useful alive, bent to your cause?
Seliman was unprepared
You can do this yourself or send any of your followers to do it.
An appropriate Conviction can help you persuade Seliman effectively.
Anything to make you more persuasive.
You are suddenly uncertain. Can you really convince someone in love?
Your Charisma and Sociability determine your full dice count.
You need at least 5 Successes to have a chance of convincing him.

The moment you step out from the shadows, Seliman's sharp gaze finds you. Seeing it is you, he does not flinch, does not startle. "Did Sadani send you?" he asks. "Why haven’t you done it yet?"

"You knew?"

"She's an anxious girl." His voice carries an unfamiliar gentleness as he turns his gaze to the dying light on the horizon. "As long as I live, she will never feel safe."

"So you would die for her?" Surprised, you search his face for the telltale signs of a man stalling for time. You find none. He smiles, faintly, and does not answer. But you already understand.
You urge Seliman to rebel
Death's Edge
You convince Seliman
You failed

You are silent for a long moment. Then, you switch the subject. "I have a plan. To kill the Sultan."
Seliman stiffens, but you raise a hand, forestalling his protest. "Don’t be so quick to dismiss me, Seliman. And spare me your speeches on loyalty. You put a child in his consort's belly. Think about it, if the Sultan dies..." you ponder for a moment, "if the Sultan dies, Sadani would be free."
You press him, your voice smooth as a serpent’s whisper: "Think about it. Do you really believe he will allow the child to be born? Even if he believes it to be his own blood? The Sultan will never raise a son who might one day challenge him. Sadani must tell herself he will welcome the child, but you know better than anyone, Seliman. You know what the Sultan truly is."
You lower your voice further and cast the lure: "As long as the Sultan lives, he is a curse upon Sadani that she can never escape from. Would you not see her child blessed instead of condemned? Would you not see her smile again?"
You see the war raging in Seliman's eyes. "But you... You truly believe you can kill him? You have no idea how powerful he is. His Signet Ring, his guards, his armies. That cursed wizard at his side. And on top of that, he is a formidable warrior..."
"And that, is why I need you, Seliman. It's not like you have anyone else to turn to in this. No one else in this entire empire dares to dream of such a thing. But I do. And I have a plan."
You reveal to him just enough of your progress. He weighs the options, and at last, he nods. Together, you fake his death. As Seliman is no more, a mask warrior emerges to stand by your side, one who answers only to you.

The moment someone resolves to end their life is when they come closest to the Cultic God - abandoning life's toil, embracing hope after death, nothing more, nothing less.
The blade Seliman holds against his throat slowly lowers. From this day forward, he will serve through another identity... another method, continuing to love the one he loves, with fervor like Cultic God worship.

"I have never seen a greater fool." Since kind words are of little use to someone like him, you decide to take the opposite approach and sneer at him sharply: "It's easy for you to die. But what about Consort Sadani?"

"What about her...?"

"You really think the Sultan will allow the child to be born? Even if he believes it to be his own blood? The Sultan will never raise a son who might one day challenge him. Sadani must tell herself he will welcome the child, but you know better than anyone, Seliman. You know what the Sultan truly is," you lower your voice further and cast the lure, "if you die, when Consort Sadani is in danger, who will help her? Who would... die for her?"

"..." Saliman is shaken. He can almost imagine how helpless his beloved would feel when she is surrounded by enemies, when she is... executed. He clenches his fists, trying to suppress his emotions, and asks, "Then what should I do...?"

"I can forge your death. It will be enough to trick the consort. As for you... why don't you stay with me for the time being? The consort and I are on the same boat, so you need not worry about my allegiance."

Seliman hesitates, but finally nods.

Your words are sweet, but Seliman grows impatient.

He wants no more of this conversation and draws his sword. You step back in surprise, preparing for combat. 

But it is not you for whom the blade is drawn. 

Too late. A gush of crimson spills out the artery, as vibrant as the sunset, and twice as cruel. You watch him closing his eyes and falling to the reeds, their edges sharp, their embrace soft. This is the last thing he could do for Sadani.

5000567.title: The Final Madness
strings: The Final Madness
Sadani is waiting. You must bring her news of Seliman's death.
Sadani is waiting for your news.
Proof of the Royal Guard Captain's death. A fake will also work.
You must bring her news of Seliman's death, or fake it.
You must bring news of Seliman's death to Sadani.

You brought the evidence of Seliman's death, but there was no joy on Sadani's face.

"He's dead!" Consort Sadani stared at it and murmured to herself, "Good, he's dead..."
She seemed to be relieved, but also like she had lost her soul, tears flowed down her cheeks involuntarily. She wiped it away, embarrassed, then looked up and asked you: "Okay, you can ask me for a favor, what do you want?"

"I want to support your child and make him the next Sultan." You said it lightly, but Sadani was almost speechless, "You, you want to commit regicide? On the Sultan?! How dare you...? No, I don't allow... you..."

You stared at this confused woman indifferently, words bereft. You saw her tears welling up again. For so many years, she had never thought that there was such a way – that the Sultan could die, and he could pay the price for his mistakes and negligence!

For so many years... For so many years! She couldn't figure it out. The Sultan and she were clearly in love, and she was clearly favored, but the Sultan was seduced by one woman, one woman, after another, after another... until she was no longer. She tried her best to murder countless favored women, but she was unable to stop more and more new faces from appearing by his side. She always wanted the Sultan's eyes to fall back on her for a moment – even if it was only a moment, but what came of it?

How talented the Sultan! In hurting hearts! How did he think of setting a test with the plot of their first meeting, just to give her to another man as if a commodity? And she actually thought that he remembered everything in the past, and fantasized that he still loved her!

Love... He never even said this word...
Sadani bowed her head and covered her face in resignation. She thought of that man... that brave man who always looked at her... How dare he say "I love you" on behalf of the Sultan? That phantom, that dream that should have been shattered long ago...

"That was a mistake..." Sadani almost laughed out loud. She raised her hand to wipe away her tears, but there was no way to stop more tears from washing away her delicate makeup, making her look so miserable. "I know, I'll help you... I can help you. This is a token of the Royal Guard Captain. It can open the palace gate for you, no matter how many army you have... Haha..." She has done too many irreversible madness things, and she doesn't care about one more! She slapped the small card related to the safety of the palace into your palm with force, and held your hand tightly. Her sharp nails almost pierced your wrist. Her expression was distorted, but she smiled, making her beautiful face look extremely hideous, "Kill... Let them all in and kill!”

5000568.title: The Price of Pleasure
strings: The Price of Pleasure

Sadani almost loses her life in your home. The doctor stays up all night diagnosing and stopping the bleeding. But when he comes out, he appears helpless, "The child couldn't be saved."
A Child?... What the woman said – it is true… A child….
Stunned, you feel like you've been slapped. In the bright daylight, you suddenly, after so long, think of Maggie, think of the child that you and Maggie never got to meet... You realize, in that moment, the terrible wrong you have done. And yet, how utterly useless remorse can be.
The Sultan's envoy has arrived. The cawing of death circles above your head. It is all too late.
The Sultan has heard about this
You are under arrest
A gold tier Bloodshed Card can help you get away with it
If you cannot escape the crime, then death is the only thing waiting for you.
You were sentenced to death
You succeeded in getting away with it

You were executed for deliberately plotting the Crown Prince’s assassination.
No one was willing to listen to your defense, no one dared provoke the Sultan at the critical moment of his loss. Soon, you were on the rack, the executioner sharpening his cold blade beside you. As you squinted against the bright sunlight for one last glimpse of the world, you saw that the Sultan's face lacked even the pretense of grief.

You were going to be killed for deliberately murdering the crown prince, but fortunately, you had prepared a way out before being brought to the palace: a gold-quality Bloodshed Card should be enough to offset the crime you committed.
You have never been so grateful for this set of cards. While depriving you of your humanity, it seems to have given you a ray of hope.
The Sultan weighed the thin card with a gloomy face. He could easily break it with just a slight force. However, at this moment, monarch with absolute power felt the taste of his authority being challenged for the first time.
The golden edge reflected the bright sunlight, deeply hurting his eyes.
In the end, you were acquitted. However, you are still confused as to why the Sultan's envoy came so quickly, as if he had expected this. You seem to be involved in a conspiracy, and a darker and more dangerous storm is brewing.

5000569.title: A Woman of Gold
strings: A Woman of Gold
At last, you understand where the Sultan squanders his wealth - this woman's desire is truly a bottomless pit.
Zazie
30 Gold Coins
Equipment with at least 3 Charisma
A Treasure
Make haste; the Sultan's execution awaits the careless

Every day Zazie waited expectantly for a gift while her patience waned, she spoke ill of you to the Sultan... Finally, after a week, the Sultan grew tired. He decided to execute you and let Zazie play this game instead...
Zazie remains unmoved - clearly this amount of Gold Coin isn't enough
Musical Pleasure
Adorned Beauty
Coveted Prize
Zazie commands you to pour coins from your pockets onto the palace floor - she adores this sound.
You present [s3.name], which Zazie immediately adorns herself with. As her fingers glide across the jewelry, caressing her jade-like skin, the entire court holds its breath.
Zazie circles [s4.name] with childlike curiosity. Her laughter mesmerizes you - no wonder the Sultan takes such pleasure in lavishing gifts upon her.

5000570.title: Receiving Zazie
strings: Receiving Zazie

Your front door is completely congested. Zazie has brought at least twelve eunuchs and six female slaves, all carrying everything she needs for a night out: golden basins, gold-lined towels, soap with gold flecks, golden essential oils... She herself sits in a gilded ebony sedan chair, laboriously carried by eight slaves from the palace. On the road, onlookers follow her palanquin, discussing busily. When they finally stop at your gate, Zazie doesn’t immediately alight, seemingly waiting for you to send someone to welcome her...
Zazie
Her host
Be warned, this Sultan's favorite has quite the ego. If she feels slighted, her revenge could be severe.
You didn't truly welcome the Sultan's favorite concubine. Some call it negligence, others loyalty and propriety. Either way, the matter is forgotten.
Is this meant to insult me?
Supreme Favor
A Meeting of Equals
Golden Demeanor
Brittle Pride

You personally arrive at the door, bowing deeply in greeting to Zazie. After a while, she lifts the golden screen of the sedan chair, showing a densely beautiful visage that takes the surrounding crowd's breath away. As if to flaunt her beauty all around, then, a eunuch raised his hand to catch her barefoot, allowing her to walk down onto his hand. “You are a wise and understanding minister,” Zazie smiles and states, “Now, will you take me to your bedroom?” Entering the door with her, the observing crowd lingers instead, discussing how a minister is so favored, as the monarch shares such a jewel with him...

Maggie arrives proudly at the door, adorned in her most luxurious jewelry, hair soaked in thick rose oil, with makeup far more exquisite than usual. Maggie loudly requests the 'most noble lady' to appear, declaring that she has expertly prepared the perfect feast for this lady. Her words are flawless, leaving no gap or negligence. The golden curtain on the palanquin reluctantly moves. A eunuch approaches and opens his palm, where Zazie's bare feet rest. Then, the eunuch lifts Zazie, taking her out of the palanquin and placing her before Maggie. Zazie's intense and bewitching beauty stirs admiration, but Maggie smiles gently, uttering a chain of polite remarks – she behaves as a distinguished noble matron, a dignified, respectable 'person' regardless of gender. Though Zazie felt uncomfortable, she still held her composure, accompanying Maggie into the mansion. This event fueled discussions amongst the onlookers for quite some time, all saying [player.name] indeed married the most respected wife.

Your assigned person waits long at the golden palanquin for Zazie until she leisurely lifts her curtain when an ample crowd gathers. Just one glance, and her coquettish appearance amazes the onlookers. Then she thrusts forth a foot clad in gold-speckled slippers, a eunuch instantly laying out his hand to catch it, raising her from the palanquin.
This was all akin to a meticulously crafted performance – every turn, every impatient smirk, every sway of jewelry and hems, unfolded like a script. It’s no wonder how she carved a path through the Sultan’s harem. Entering the estate, she left behind a fragrant breeze accompanied by several days of discussions and praises among the onlookers.

The golden screen of the sedan trembles, Zazie peers at the person you sent to welcome her... “How powerless!” she exclaims,
“How despicable – sending a slave to greet me! Don’t think I don’t know your thoughts – oh! You are the vilest of men!”
Then she erupts into a torrent of dirty words through her sultry lips, shocking the onlookers... then she angrily orders the palanquin bearers to turn back to the palace.
Thus she left! Later, you learn from a tantalizing eunuch mouth that Zazie was originally a slave girl in a brothel – liberated by the Sultan’s delight... it turns out you severely offended this prized consort.

5000571.title: Desire or ambition
strings: Desire or ambition

Once inside your residence, Zazie dismisses her attendants and reclines languidly upon cushions, sizing you up. "Your Carnality Card has been broken, and I suppose one night of pleasure isn't strictly necessary, is it? I could certainly tell the Sultan how weak, impotent, and insignificant you are. I could say many things to put his mind at ease about both you and me..." She crawls toward you like a lioness, then raises her head, gazing directly into your eyes. "Or perhaps you'd prefer to discuss matters unrelated to bedroom activities, something beneficial to us both...?"
Zazie
Possess her
Chat with her
Face of God seen in a dream
Respond to Zazie quickly.
Only you can respond to Zazie
Your hesitation disappoints Zazie. She leaves, and the matter ends here.
Men are all the same...
Let's not rush, let's talk first
Let's Talk
Royal Gaze
Unveiled Truth
A More Terrible God

Zazie studies you while relating her story: 
One day, while inspecting a small courtyard the Sultan had given her, Zazie pricked her finger on a rose thorn. It was once the rose garden of a previous dynasty's queen, still harboring ancient vines. Since then, she began seeing a god in her dreams who called himself "the Highlord of the Highlands." The Highlord promised to fulfill a woman's every dream, so Zazie made a wish - "I will never reveal what wish I made, and I hope you have no curiosity about it." 
The Highlord told her that to fulfill this wish, many offerings and sacrifices were needed. Zazie initially thought this reasonable and fair, so she offered slave lives, gold and silver treasures, and relief carvings bearing the Highlord's likeness as instructed... but the Highlord demanded more. 
"Now he wants, um... he wants the Sultan's seed. He wants me to collect a handful of semen to his altar... but I can't do it. After each night with the Sultan, the eunuchs immediately wash me thoroughly, leaving nothing behind... You have no idea how hateful those eunuchs are! The Sultan dislikes offspring because royal law allows princes to kill their fathers to ascend the throne - that's how he became Sultan himself." 
Thus, the Highlord became displeased and began tormenting Zazie; every night, every dream filled with her worst fears. Whenever she closes her eyes, she sees herself locked in a cage with hungry dogs prowling outside... yet even so, she cannot obtain the Sultan's seed. "I need someone to help me solve this problem. If you succeed, you'll have the wholehearted support of a royal favorite." 
She looks at you with neither flattery nor seduction, but with an appraising gaze...

Zazie shakes her head, her pure gold hair ornaments chiming pleasantly against each other. "Ah, I know, I'm deadly poison to men... So you're not the right person either, but that's fine," she shrugs, "there are plenty of men; someone else will serve my purpose." She embraces you, then writhes, seeking downward... "Has any other woman done this to you? Here... oh... you're trembling, how sweet... Other women surely haven't explored this deeply, have they? If I do this... yes... how delightful..." You revel in each other's company tirelessly through the night. The Sultan must have experienced this as well... Zazie is truly as precious as gold. The next morning, while you still sleep, Zazie has already departed with her entourage of eunuchs and slave girls. The matter seems concluded... You try not to dwell on what opportunity you might have missed, and work harder to dispel that unsettling feeling of being watched throughout the night.

The moment your eyes meet hers, you see through this outwardly strong but inwardly fragile woman. Her soul is cursed, marked by some powerful entity - she suffers madness similar to yours, but more helplessly... like a slave caged, waiting for her god to open the bars just slightly, allowing the malevolence outside - her sins and memories - to tear her mind to shreds like ravenous hounds. 
Softly, you whisper these key words in her ear, and the haughty concubine cowers like a slave truly trapped in a small cage. 
You possess her this way - not nearly as pleasurable as the Sultan often boasts! But during your coupling, she can no longer conceal the truth from you: 
One day, while inspecting a small courtyard the Sultan had given her, Zazie pricked her finger on a rose thorn. It was once the rose garden of a previous dynasty's queen, still harboring ancient vines. Since then, she began seeing a god in her dreams who called himself "the Highlord of the Highlands." The Highlord promised to fulfill a woman's every dream, so Zazie made a wish - driven by her insatiable greed and ambition. 
The Highlord began demanding many offerings and sacrifices. Zazie initially thought this reasonable and fair, so she offered slave lives, gold and silver treasures, and relief carvings bearing the Highlord's likeness as instructed... but the Highlord demanded more. 
"Now he wants, um... he wants the Sultan's seed. He wants me to collect a handful of semen to his altar... but I can't do it. After each night with the Sultan, the eunuchs immediately wash me thoroughly, leaving nothing behind... You have no idea how hateful those eunuchs are! The Sultan dislikes offspring because royal law allows princes to kill their fathers to ascend the throne - that's how he became Sultan himself." 
Thus, the Highlord became displeased and began tormenting Zazie; every night, every dream filled with her worst fears. Whenever she closes her eyes, she sees herself locked in a cage with hungry dogs prowling outside... yet even so, she cannot obtain the Sultan's seed. 
Having heard her story, you guide Zazie's breathing - just as you do daily, clearing your mind, fighting madness... The iron cage and vicious dogs gradually recede, and in this momentary peace, you both find joy - when she turns to cleanse you afterward, her upward gaze reflects expectation...

Grabbing Zazie's wrist like iron clamps, you cause her pain. Unable to break free, she's held not only by you, but also by the god in your heart—flesh, desire, ambition, and fear are mere conduits between them. On Zazie's end, you find prey. Within was a dim star—it had thirsted for dreams long denied by mankind? No wonder it pressured Zazie so tightly and tricked her with such ridiculous contracts... Embracing Zazie, as you enter, along too goes the god within you, through Zazie's soul, tracing the waning starlight it swallows whole. That evening, under twinkling stars, thunder roared across the clear sky, wilting all of the capital's roses, and many citizens secretly loyal to the previous dynasty perished in fright by nightmares, while Polaris dimmed by threefold. Afterwards, Zazie, puzzledly caressing your chest—partly disbelieving her curse was resolved so easily—realized how much harsher your pain must be... After promising countless rewards and assistance, she fled you in fear.

5000572.title: Golden Experience
strings: Golden Experience

Your eyes lock with Zazie's, and in that moment, a vision passes between you. She sees how you shattered the Highlord's effigy, while you glimpse the terrors that haunted her nights - iron cages closing in, ravenous hounds circling, all now fading like morning mist as the idol's power breaks. Without even knowing it, you've freed the Sultan's prized jewel from her torment.
Zazie
Your exclusive domain

Her gratitude promises rewards beyond imagination.
She wanted to thank you, but your neglect wounded her pride as well.
Don't ask anything...
Transcendent Union

Without a word, Zazie draws you close. Her touch speaks volumes as she guides you into intimacy. As your bodies join, something deeper merges - your spirits intertwining. Through this connection, her past unfolds before you like a tapestry: her terror under the god's influence, her blind ambition driving her to make offerings to powers unknown, her calculated seduction of the Sultan, her cunning manipulation of nobles who visited brothels, her strategic display of beauty in slave markets, her desperate escape from her father's chambers... 
Through her, you taste the forbidden pleasures previously known only to the most powerful men in the empire - the Sultan himself, his Vizier, the fighters of brothel, slave traders, and even her own father. You realize each man was merely another rung on her ladder to power, each conquest making her more sophisticated, more irresistible, more complete. Together, you reach heights of ecstasy that few mortals have ever known.
Sublime Oblivion

For one precious night, all your burdens dissolve. You've tasted an elixir distilled from the essence of mortal desire and fantasy - a sacred wine potent enough to soothe even the troubled spirits of gods themselves.

Zazie's messenger brings a hastily written letter. You barely register surprise at her literacy before the contents shock you.
Zazie reveals her orchestration of an old eunuch's execution - the very man who ritually cleansed her with icy water after the Sultan's visits, washing away the royal "essence." The aged eunuch performed this duty with sadistic pleasure, inflicting needless pain on the women. Seizing her chance, Zazie arranged for several of his victims to voice complaints to the Sultan. Playing her part masterfully, she feigned defense of the old servant while casually dropping a poisonous suggestion: "But my lord, old Baru was your wet nurse, was he not? I've heard tales of you at his breast..." Disgusted, the Sultan ordered Baru's execution that very night.
Between her calculated revelations, she urges swift action, as the Highlord's nightmares grow more vicious with each passing night... Folding the letter, you find yourself reassessing the woman entirely. The court sees a mere gold-adorned plaything vying for royal favor, but you now glimpse something far more dangerous - a mind so sharp and ruthless it sends a chill down your spine.

Your network of informants quickly yields results. A younger eunuch named Savasar has assumed old Baru's duties. This pale-skinned man seems a stark contrast to his predecessor - thoughtful and composed where Baru was venomous and cruel. The challenge lies not in finding him but in convincing such a measured individual to commit treason against the Sultan himself. After greasing a few more palms, you uncover a potential weakness: Savasar harbors an insatiable passion for literature.

Court legends speak of the Sultan's unique disposal method for executed servants - no burial honors for them, but rather a one-way journey into the palace drainage channels. There, they say, lurks an ancient crocodile of monstrous proportions, grown fat on a steady diet of royal discards.

Of course - how could you forget? The whispered rumors say these cleansing eunuchs eventually lose their tongues, ensuring the Sultan's most intimate secrets die with them. This grim ritual isn't performed individually but rather in scheduled ceremonies where the royal executioner attends to multiple servants at once. If calculations serve you right, Savasar might still possess his voice for a while longer.

strings: Sultan's Private Life

The Sultan's appetite for pleasure is legendary - a voracious hunter claiming numerous conquests. Surely his cleansing eunuchs can't extend to every encounter... If his seed is truly so precious to him, he must employ alternative methods when bedding concubines, noblewomen, or common harlots away from the palace. Such a matter requires careful exploration.

A painting arrives from Zazie's messenger—her handiwork! This sketch offers a one-to-one ratio depiction of a crystal bottle, with color and texture notes. According to Zazie's letter, during outdoor proceedings, the Sultan retrieves a scented, oily sheath from one of such bottles—to capture his precious seed. As for its nature and further fate, these are secrets even a concubine can't inquire.

Your discreet inquiries quickly bear fruit. The device is made from processed sheep intestines - more commonplace than you'd expect among the nobility. Many high-ranking nobles employ similar methods... You manage to obtain basic instructions for creating a passable imitation.

Whispers among courtesans tell a chilling story: a beautiful woman once captured the affection of a powerful figure who would visit the House of Delights in disguise, seeking forbidden pleasures. 
Consumed by ambition, she plotted to bear his child and secure her position. 
One night, she stole a golden box where her patron had stored his essence (now you understand he likely used one of these intestine sheaths). 
When she attempted to use its contents, a terrible curse befell her - agonizing pain like liquid fire coursed through her body for three days without relief. 
Driven mad by suffering, she leapt to her death, leaving only this grim tale behind. 
It seems the Sultan not only collects his seed but renders it unusable with chili or other caustic substances - a remarkably thorough precaution.

Armed with Zazie's detailed specifications and whispers gathered from various servants... you've determined the exact spice blend the Sultan adds to the oils used for the sheaths... Now comes the delicate work of experimentation.

The eunuch had browsed through poetry collections with visible hunger in his eyes. When you interrupted him, he had shown no surprise at your outrageous proposal to "preserve some of the Sultan's essence for Lady Zazie." With perfect composure, he simply asked: "Why would I risk everything for your schemes or Lady Zazie's ambitions? What could a eunuch possibly gain?" You had explained that afterward, Zazie would feign outrage and have her guards "execute" him, his body cast into the palace canals. The meaning had not been lost on him, though he had hesitated momentarily. "Time isn't on your side," you reminded him. "The Sultan's executioner arrives to perform his duties in seven days. After that, no matter how beautiful the verses, your mouth will only produce inarticulate screams." With newfound resolve, he accepted, gambling his life for a chance at freedom: "Seven days. Remember this well. You have only that long for the Sultan to favor Queen Zazie. Let us hope the rumors of your influence over our sovereign's desires prove true."

The eunuch stands tall and thin, his unnaturally pale skin bearing the distinctive lustre unique to his kind. 
When you first approach, he completely ignores you, until you mention his name: "Swasar, isn't it?" He closes his book abruptly. 
"Indeed, I am Savasar, and I can guess who sent you. Lady Zazie, that golden viper. I witnessed how she orchestrated old Baru's downfall. I'll have no part in her schemes - save your breath. I may be merely a eunuch while you command great power, but if I were to inform the Sultan of your secret dealings with Lady Zazie... My head would roll, certainly, but your suffering would last years. A worthwhile exchange, wouldn't you agree, my lord?" 
After delivering this speech, he offers a perfunctory bow and returns to his reading, dismissing you entirely.

The Testament to Bygone Oaths works like a balm on the agitated god, rekindling memories of Their golden age when countless worshippers knelt before Him. Human devotion and desire act like an intoxicating poison to divine beings - destructive yet irresistibly addictive. 
The Highlord now ceases tormenting Zazie, willing to wait for the grand feast you've promised Him. 
Forget the Sultan's precious seed! In her gratitude, Zazie has eagerly offered a more private tribute of your own essence... Who knows? Perhaps these seeds will one day grow into something royal.

Knowing how to defeat a god. In an intimate encounter, revealing to Zazie's deity the god inside your heart—desire, ambition, and fear mere links among them. Compared to your illusion, the Highlord seemed weak—a dim star—how long since it drank mortal's dreams? No surprise it pressured Zazie so. Embracing, entering Zazie, the god inside you pursues through her soul, consuming the weakened astral spirit. That night, under twinkling stars, thunder roared over clear skies, causing roses throughout the capital to wither, former dynasty loyalists dying from nightmarish fright, Polaris dimming substantially. Afterwards, Zazie curious, felt on your chest—half doubting her curse's resolution—realizing your harsher torment... After pledging rewards and assistance, she fled in anxiety.

Badriyyah's eyes ignite with excitement at your words. 
"The Highlord of the Highlands! For millennia He ruled as supreme god before the Purists drove Him away. I knew He would seek return... What if we summon Him only to destroy Him?" 
...Deicide? 
You hesitate momentarily. "Don't falter now," she urges with growing intensity. "The Highlord is merely a Star-Souled - an exceptionally powerful star, yes, but still just a star! No one knows which precisely. My masters in the darkness will aid us in this hunt. Imagine the power we could extract from His pretentious skull... The Master will reward us generously, perhaps even hasten His coming!"

Iman raises a skeptical eyebrow as he examines you. 
"You claim the Highlord has infiltrated the Sultan's harem? Ah... those ancient rose gardens that recently bloomed - now it makes sense. The Purist and his faithful will cleanse this false god with all our strength; it is our sacred duty." 
When you inquire about purifying something so intangible, he explains: "Each Star-Souled corresponds to a specific star. By tracking its earthly manifestations, we can calculate its celestial position. Once located, the God of Immaculate Purity himself will cleanse this wayward star with divine flame. 
"You find yourself wondering how many celestial entities the Purists have blocked from reaching our world through such methods, but... Iman's expression makes it clear he has no desire to discuss the matter further.

Iman makes a shallow cut across Zazie's foot. This ritualistic punishment serves as treatment, temporarily weakening the Highlord's influence within her. However, he warns that until this heretical god is permanently banished, the concubine's nightmares will persist...

With practiced precision, Badriyyah tattoos a tiny sigil behind Zazie's left ear - the only place she can conceal it from the Sultan's scrutiny. This offers merely temporary protection; meanwhile, Badriyyah repeatedly presses Zazie to reveal the god's true name. Her unusual interest in this particular god hasn't escaped your notice.
Zazie kneels reverently before the Highlord's damaged bust... Through this act of worship, she temporarily regains a measure of the god's favor - though this merely postpones the inevitable.

Your strategy awakens the Highlord's memories of the Sultan's family - those who allied with the Purist Order to overthrow Their favored dynasty! During that kingdom's fall, the overwhelming surge of devotion, desire and madness poisoned Him so severely They could neither ascend to the stars nor fully manifest on earth. For now, at least, Zazie's nightmares have transformed into visions of the Sultan's torture - almost a pleasant dream for her.

The Testament to Bygone Oaths works like a balm on the agitated god, rekindling memories of Their golden age when countless worshippers knelt before Him. Human devotion and desire act like an intoxicating poison to divine beings - destructive yet irresistibly addictive... But your covenant remains incomplete; many former worshippers have yet to pledge themselves. Hurry! The god's patience wanes with each passing moment!
The matter is resolved; no further action necessary.

Your first meeting dissolves into heated arguments about the approach. 
Some advocate creating pre-filled fake sheaths to switch after use but before the Sultan destroys them - though concealing such items presents obvious difficulties. Others suggest creating sheaths with imperceptible holes, allowing the essence to escape naturally during use - but the Sultan would surely notice. Another faction recommends creating harmless fake chili powder that wouldn't damage the captured essence - but how to test such a concoction? Volunteer yourself? 
After endless circular debates over these absurd, headache-inducing proposals, you decide to simply create everything and determine the best approach later.

First, you need ample supplies of clean, uniform sheep intestines of the highest quality. Not daring to purchase such quantities openly, you host extravagant lamb feasts daily, much to your household's confusion.

You produce crystal vials identical to Zazie's specifications, blend aromatic oils that maintain the intestines' necessary elasticity, and meticulously copy the finest examples available. Using the most delicate silk threads and precise stitching techniques, you create sheaths that fit perfectly with watertight sealing. Your crowning achievement: a convincing substitute fluid made from flour, oils and whey that even courtesans from House of Delights couldn't distinguish from the real thing.
Your toolkit is complete - substitute fluid, perfectly replicated sheaths, and compact vials for transport. One crucial question remains: who will risk everything to execute this dangerous deception?

The most delicate portion of sheep intestine must be used, treated with medicinal solutions from the beginning of the process. Otherwise, the result would be uncomfortably rough. Don't inquire how we confirmed this.
"This could work underneath! We need finer thread! Find a better tailor to attempt this stitch pattern!"
This venture carries mortal consequences. Those creating the tools must anticipate every possible complication - the person using them has one life and one chance for success.

You fought beyond mortal boundaries. Once stubborn disbelievers, tonight you faced the undeniable presence of divinity. 
The North Star answered Their rage by transforming into a spear, leading countless celestial bodies in their descent. You battled against heaven's light, earth's winds, and cosmic darkness simultaneously. Yet They remain a fallen god in a realm that no longer acknowledges Him, Their powers caught between reality and illusion. 
Through sheer determination, you pierce the veil of Their realm, driving your blades into Their luminous form - that body rebuilt from stolen mortal flesh. 
In Their final moment, this weakened god regains a flash of clarity... You've destroyed not just Their earthly manifestation, but the mind corrupted by human desires. The North Star flickers with renewed brilliance in the night sky; unexpectedly, sweet rain falls from cloudless heavens, refreshing your exhausted forms... A great Star-Souled returns at last to its rightful domain.

The Highlord battles with starlight, darkness, and moist winds, but Their maddened shrieks prove most terrifying. 
Now you understand - this is a god poisoned by mortal desires. They absorbed too much to return to the heavens, yet remains too ravenous to fully manifest on earth. Those collective hungers and thoughts now crawl beneath your skin like venomous insects, sharing in the god's torment.
In battle with the divine, you realize that certain notions, fantasies, or faiths within your heart... remain feeble and useless against truly sacred entities.

In battle with the god, you invoked the Truth's name, praying for punishment of heresy... Of course, it had absolutely no effect, but your loud scripture recitation appeared heroic, earning high praise from the Purist Order.

After much arguing, complaining, cursing, persuading, deceiving... The luminous Highlord attempts to summon powers - wind, starlight, darkness - all severed by your ritual. They begin desperate flickering and shrieking, intent on shredding your sacrilegious souls with Their madness. 
Only now do you understand - this god, poisoned by human desires, once absorbed too much to return to Their realm yet remains too hungry to fully manifest in the mortal world. The collective desires and thoughts crawl beneath your skin like venomous insects, sharing the god's suffering - but the ritual hasn't failed! Hold fast!

[s6.name] skewered through the just-puffed, baby-sized Highlord, [s6.gender]'s move was precise and deadly, like filleting a fish flawlessly, without a scale hindering the blade, nor giving the prey undue pain. This between-real-and-mirage Body shriveled away; every deity must know this cost — becoming mortal, they lose immortality, can be killed, just as any life can die.

[s6.name] cut [s2.name]'s throat precisely, the smooth wound, the divine power just infused into [s2.gender]'s Body flows as azure Aether... All deities must know this cost — becoming mortal, they lose immortality, can die, just like most life dies, died insignificantly.

The sacred incarnation Ritual caused [s6.name] panic. [s6.gender]'s knife-hand trembled, the first stab missed the vital point, then the Highlord's struggle forced [s6.gender] to thrust repeatedly... The Highlord perished, but divine power dissipated in such struggle... All deities must know this cost — becoming mortal, they lose immortality, will die, as most life dies, meaningless and in vain.

As the final drop of divine blood drains, you swiftly pour Water of Life into [s2.name]'s open throat. Thanks to the perfect incision, flesh heals flawlessly - the god's remarkable journey through this vessel bestows [s2.gender(him,her)] with special gifts.
As the final drop of divine blood drains, [s2.name]'s throat remains open - we knew from the beginning [s2.gender(he,she)] wouldn't survive, didn't we? At least [s2.gender] completed their purpose.

As the card snaps, through the messy stains, you glimpse an exalted vision - a crown destined for the King of Kings, the world-ruling God. Earthly affairs mirror stellar movements, allowing us to locate hidden star spirits through stellar trajectories. 
After days of calculations, Purist monks chant a secret coordinate to their great god - not a star's position nor earthly location, but the crevice where the false Highlord wanders between realms. 
Just as They once helped the Sultan's ancestors overthrow the highland empire, the Immaculate Purity again raises holy flames against these failures. 
Night stars dim as if hiding from invisible sunlight; the North Star stubbornly flickers thrice before settling, permanently dimmed. 
The next day, all capital roses bow toward the Purist temple, ancient family descendants weep blood while kowtowing, and lightning obliterates a farmhouse - the lingering, decaying star spirit finally subdued by the only true god, the people-saving Immaculate Purity.

You've orchestrated a god's downfall... the Sultan's Game witnesses this achievement. As the card snaps, a painless, bloodless scar appears on your chest, transmitting ecstatic joy - in this game, the sin of world-rending stands absolved, even when potentially committed by a god.

Risking discovery by the Sultan, you meet secretly at a residence arranged by Zazie.
Without a word, Zazie draws you close. Her touch speaks volumes as she guides you into intimacy. As your bodies join, something deeper merges - your spirits intertwining. Through this connection, her past unfolds before you like a tapestry: her terror under the god's influence, her blind ambition driving her to make offerings to powers unknown, her calculated seduction of the Sultan, her cunning manipulation of nobles who visited brothels, her strategic display of beauty in slave markets, her desperate escape from her father's chambers...
Through her, you taste the forbidden pleasures previously known only to the most powerful men in the empire - the Sultan himself, his Vizier, the fighters of brothel, slave traders, and even her own father. You realize each man was merely another rung on her ladder to power, each conquest making her more sophisticated, more irresistible, more complete. Together, you reach heights of ecstasy that few mortals have ever known.
Sublime Oblivion

For one precious night, all your burdens dissolve. You've tasted an elixir distilled from the essence of mortal desire and fantasy - a sacred wine potent enough to soothe even the troubled spirits of gods themselves.

Their force is nothing compared to yours. You easily drive them away. Such a heroic rescue was certainly worthy of a Conquest Card. 
The carriage curtain is lifted, and a pale lady comes out. Clutching her sleeves tightly, she gives you a gentle nod in gratitude. "I am Fatuna," she says, her countenance strangely calm.

You take your eyes off the fight for just one moment – and a club strikes your skull with bone-rattling force. Dizzy, reeling, you watch as the attackers drag the desperate lady from the carriage and vanish. Who was she? Alas, no word of her ever reaches you again.

She studies you for a moment, then recognition flickers in her gaze. The one who plays the Sultan’s Game. Her speech is measured, thoughtful. She knows where the villains have fled – they have taken over a noble estate. If you remove this thorn from her side, she will pay you handsomely. Besides, is this not a fine opportunity to rid yourself of a Sultan’s Card?

You nod in agreement. Clearly, helping a helpless lady may yield far more than coin.

Word spreads quickly, however, of a rogue laying claim to a vineyard that was never his. No one cares for your reasons. The nobility care only that estates are no longer safe, that what was seized once may be seized again. Their complaints against your unjust action reach the court.

The next day, you recount your deeds to the Sultan and ask to break a card. The nobles breathe quiet sighs of relief. Thankfully, it is not their lands that have been chosen, not their fortunes bound to your game.

5000602.title: Ownership of the Winery
strings: Ownership of the Winery
Someone comes to your door, claiming to be the owner of the vineyard you attacked that day. He wants to talk... He does not appear to bear you ill will.
The former owner of the vineyard.

As soon as Zaki enters, the winery owner bursts into hearty laughter. "Well, if it isn't Zaki! What brings you here, my boy?"

Before Zaki can react, an enthusiastic arm lands on his shoulders. The teenager lowers his head slightly, looking a little uncomfortable. "Teacher has to go out today, so he asked me to help receive guests... Uncle, is there something you need to talk to him about? I can pass along the message."

"Haha, Zaki, you've really grown up," the winery owner says with a chuckle. He raises his wine cup with an unreadable smile. After exchanging a few more words, he waves goodbye."I'll come back again. Just let your teacher know that."
This gloomy man is not here to assign blame. He introduces himself as the brother of Lady Fatuna’s late husband. And with her husband’s sudden passing, the widow has inherited a fortune…

"Those properties rightfully shouldn't belong to her..." He fidgets with the ring on his thumb while giving you a meaningful look. He proposes collaboration: using Fatuna's trust in you to lure her out and kidnap her... Afterward, you would receive half the property – an exceedingly generous reward.

Greed flares up in your mind. The man narrows his eyes, pleased, and sets a small vial of sleeping draught upon your table. “A simple thing for you, isn’t it?” he coos. “She trusts you.”

And she does. Fatuna trusts you. Oh how she trusts you... Your conscience stirs uncomfortably...

You bring news of the vineyard owner's death to Fatuna. The shadow that has loomed over her for so long finally dissipates. She exhales, slow and deep, and a relieved smile flickers across her lips. She thanks you and pays you handsomely.

Fatuna steps closer. Her fingers brush against your armor, wiping away a smear of blood. She asks you softly if you are hurt. You lower your gaze and tell her the blood is not yours, that you are well. Yet she does not release your wrist. Something unspoken coils between you... You wonder if you should allow it to grow.

Words of the commotion at the House of Delights quickly spreads among the nobles. You pull out a Bloodshed Card before they could utter more words of condemnation. They immediately shut up. Thank the poor unfortunate guy! He died so others may live.

The commotion at the House of Delights spreads through the noble circles like wildfire. The nobles murmur, disapproving of your crude interference in their affairs. Fatuna stands before them, fearless, denouncing her brother-in-law’s insolence and praising your righteous aid. But the crowd sees only the curve of her lips, the weight of her wealth. As for the man who sought to ruin her? Well. He has only done what any men would have done in his place.

The vineyard owner staggers from the House of Delights. Drunk on rage and wine, he gathers his men and storms to Fatuna’s doorstep, voice raw with fury. That woman! She dares to make an attempt on the life of her husband’s own brother! He only wanted a little money... And besides, why shouldn't his bother's woman also be his? 

Fatuna watches this foaming joke of a man, her face impassive. She lets him rant, lets him unravel. And so, by the time the sun rises, the whole street has learned of what this ludicrous man has done. For goodness' sake, there is of course nothing shameful about what he has done, but how could he speak of these things in the open? 

Having lost face like that, the man soon leaves the city. An acceptable outcome, all in all. Though the nobles still glance at Fatuna with knowing smiles, she does not care. She remains grateful for your help.
