It is drinking at the riverside, with a long, bleeding wound on its side. The wound seems deep, likely made by a sharp blade. You ponder. A well-aimed harpoon through the wound could slay it while causing the least damage to the beautiful hide...

Thanks to your perfect physique and combat prowess, you thrust the harpoon right into the white rhino's wound. The rhino's roars are deafening as it struggles madly, dashing across the fields, trying to shake off the painful blade, raising clouds of dust in its trail. At last, it falls prone from blood loss, lifeless. After ensuring its death, you wipe the sweat from your brows and quickly take your bloody trophy before the hyenas are drawn.
The harpoon plunges into the water, startling the wary beast. The large white rhino raises its head and looks towards your position. It seems a tough battle awaits.

With your excellent physique and combat skills, you ultimately won. The white rhino gave a sorrowful cry and fell, raising a cloud of dust, and made no more sound. You wiped your sweat and quickly took your loots before the scent of blood drew hyenas.

It was a balanced combat, the roles of prey and predator constantly shifting, but in the end, you won. The white rhino gave a sorrowful cry and fell, raising a cloud of dust, and made no more sound. You and your companion supported each other, hastily dealt with your wounds. Time was tight; before the scent of blood attracted hyenas, you had to quickly take your loots away.
The White Rhino rampages between you, ultimately escaping through brute force and a strong will to live. You are left battered, discouraged, but still alive... You have lost track of the White Rhino.
As soon as you approach, you alert the wary beast. The large white rhino raises its head and looks in your direction. It seems a tough battle awaits.

To pull off this absurd and over-the-top method of completing the Carnality Card, you went to great lengths—including convincing the royal keeper to procure a bottle of male rhino urine just for you. The scent messed with the rhino’s senses, whether you were trying to get close... or even closer. Sigh. All that just to avoid hurting a human in this wicked game—and maybe, just maybe, to earn a smile from the Sultan. You really went above and beyond.  
Anyway, thanks to that god-awful stench, you managed to approach the white rhino. Just like the rumors said, it was wounded, tense, and wary. But now, the overpowering male rhino scent pouring off you left it confused...

A bold leap! Before the rhino even realized what was happening, you were already behind it, securing yourself in just the right spot.
All of this clearly shattered the rhino’s understanding of how the world worked. You could feel its tension, its helplessness... and maybe even a flicker of excitement.
And so, with nothing but your body, you rode that raw, untamed force across the wilds until both of you were utterly spent. When you led the white rhino into the royal court to present your triumph, it stood calm and regal while the courtiers exchanged uneasy, baffled glances. The Sultan, meanwhile, laughed so hard he could barely breathe.

From that day on, animals could smell the scent of power clinging to you... and they would yield to you.
That being said, humans probably couldn’t smell it. ...Right?

The white rhino is often said to possess a kind of sacred magic in many old tales. Now, it seemed those stories weren’t wrong. The wounded beast dodged your first leap, clearly enraged, and let out a thunderous roar. At the same time, the Carnality Card in your arms flared with a burst of dark energy... This game—this twisted force that defiled, recorded, and toyed with the world—was thrilled. It was about to gain a collectible unlike any it had ever known.

In the end, the white rhino collapsed. But the dark power behind you, born from the twisted game, wasn’t done yet.
It dragged your weary body forward, step by step, toward the beast’s pure white corpse... To carry out a desecration the game had never seen before.
By the time you regained control, that cursed energy had already burned a jet-black mark into the rhino’s hide.

The white rhino slammed you to the ground. One more step, and it would have ended you. But the twisted force behind you still wasn’t satisfied, still hungry to add one more prize to its collection... It stirred the scent clinging to your body, sent dark visions rippling through the air, trying to lure the beast’s soul... In the end, maybe that darkness was what finally scared the rhino. It backed off and turned away, disappearing into the distance, putting this desecrated land far behind it.

As soon as she sees you, Adila gives you an angry rant. That rhino was her prey. She has been tracking it for months, and when she finally, finally managed to wound it, you swooped in, and claimed the trophy. She is deeply upset.

You try to talk to her, but she wants none of your excuses. She will solve this the warrior's way. She proposes a competition over a powerful lion outside the city. Whoever hunts down the prey first wins. If you lose, she wants you to return the White Rhino Skin to her. Her family sword is just in need of a beautiful rhino hide sheath.
"But if you win…" She tilts her chin up, pride gleaming in her eyes. Clearly, she finds the notion absurd. "Hmph. Then I will acknowledge defeat, and you may do with me as you wish!"
As you wish... Ha. You glance at the Sultan Card in your hand, perhaps...

The moment she saw you, Adila start venting. That rhino had been her mark for months. She’d spent months tracking it, managed to wound it after a tremendous effort. Then you showed up and stole the final kill. She was not happy. You tried to explain, but she wasn’t having it. Everyone was saying you only brought the beast down using some cursed magic from a Sultan Card. She told you there’s a fierce lion roaming just outside the city. The two of you should race to see who can take it down first. If you lose, she wants the rhino hide back—it would make a perfect sheath for her family’s heirloom sword. And this time, you’re not allowed to use Sultan Cards. But should she lose, she’ll let you use a Sultan Card on her, no complaints. Not that it’ll come to that, of course. You delayed facing this warrior's challenge, making Adila furious. She widely broadcasted her disdain for your cowardice and untrustworthiness. You'd better pray not to meet this woman again; otherwise, she will surely taunt you harshly.

You open yourself to the vast wilderness, feeling the land as it breathes. The way the grass bends, the half-faded claw marks in the dust, the distant, wavering echoes of a beast’s call… Your knowledge and experience guide your steps. You are the first to find a lion patrolling the borders of its domain. Across the plain, hidden among the tall grass, Adila watches you with quiet surprise. 

She had not expected to lose the first move. Yet, rather than deter her, the realization sets her alight. She is wholly thrilled by the hunt – just as other ladies might be by their finest afternoon tea.

Tracking a lion in the vast and desolate wilderness is no small feat. You search the plains, nearly losing yourself in the endless expanse. Then, a whisper of movement. Adila gestures for you to come closer, a knowing smirk playing at her lips. "Well? Not so easy, is it?" She tilts her head toward the horizon, voice low in order to avoid alerting the lion, "I found it already... Right over there. It’s patrolling its border. Come on, you got to keep up." She smile, the fire in her eyes is unmistakable. She is wholly thrilled by the hunt – just as other ladies might be by their finest afternoon tea.

Exchanging a glance with Adila, you both charge at the lion. The fierce, vigorous lion has never been so provoked by mere humans before. It lunges at you both, but you dodge its powerful swipe with precision and thrust a dagger into its left eye.
The lion roars in pain, thrashing wildly. Adila seizes the opportunity, her elegant blade mercilessly slashing open the beast’s belly. Hot blood pours out, splattering across Adila’s stern features, more resplendent than any makeup you have ever seen.
Roaring, the lion throws both of you off and tries to flee into the distance. Adila pivots skillfully, landing beside you. "What are you waiting for? Give chase!"

After exchanging a glance with Adila, you charge toward the lion. The powerful lion, unchallenged by mere humans, lunges at you with immense strength. You drop to the ground, narrowly avoiding a deadly strike. Adila, however, deftly spins out of the beast's bloodthirsty maw and drives her sharp blade deep into its left eye.

The lion roars in pain, thrashing wildly. Seizing the opportunity, you thrust your weapon into its belly. It roars and tosses you both away, allowing Adila to leap back to your side, blood dripping from her sword. There is not a moment to lose. "After it!" She shouts.

You are almost stunned...

After an intense chase and fierce combat, the battered lion finally loses its strength and will.

strings: Deal with Adila
The victor has the right to do as they please with the loser. Such is the warriors' code of honor.

Adila does not resist. You take her life with ease. Her family clearly expected the demise of this rebellious girl. The fate of this young maverick becomes nothing more than a passing amusement in the Sultan’s court...

Such is the most primal form of conquest, such is how the victor claim his prize. You derive immense pleasure from such an act.
Adila, a warrior strong and dexterous, is nothing like the other women. Neither frail nor dainty, she lies beneath you like a young lion. She appears inexperienced, yet swallows her pain. You wrap your hand around her clenched fist soothingly, and pace the pleasures you give her, all so strange and new to her.
What a pleasant night, at least for you.

"What is the meaning of this?" She stares at you, startled, unwilling to accept. You insist: "Forget about the bet, Adila. We are friends, aren't we? Giving a gift to a friend requires no reason. Besides, its color matches your sword. Let it accompany you in war. I think that's a much better fate for it than to gather dust in my warehouse."
Adila's eyes sparkle. She solemnly accepts the rhino hide, then bows to you. "Please allow me to follow you, [player.name]. Let this sword belong to both of us." She proclaims, reintroducing herself, "My name is Adila, I am a warrior. You will need me."

Adila looks at you in astonishment. "You are letting me go, just like this? For nothing?" 
You laugh heartily, pat her shoulder, and reply, "We’ve hunted together – faced death side by side, haven’t we? We're friends. Now, go back, wipe your face clean, and rest. Today has been long enough.'"
She opens her mouth. "That won’t do – didn’t we agree? A warrior must stand by her words."
After a long moment, she grits her teeth and unfastens the sword at her waist. "I have nothing else of value – only this blade, which is as dear to me as my own life…"
She tenderly caresses its edge, upon which light dances like ripples, then places it squarely on your table. "Worry not. I will acquire another weapon for myself, though it won't hold up to this one... You must cherish it, understand? I’ve labored long and hard to get it." 
With that, she bows hurriedly to you and departs without a backward glance, rushing off before regret catches up with her.

Clearly, the rhino hide was no longer what Adila had once known. It radiated a dark energy, more like something ripped from a monster than a beast of this world. She hesitated, uncertain of your intentions...
You told her that in a game this twisted, survival meant using whatever you had at your disposal, dark forces included. The ends justified the means.
Whether you meant it or were just saying what she needed to hear, it struck a chord with her. Adila took the cursed hide and forged it into an even stronger weapon. Then she joined your game, determined to see how your story ends.

5000634.title: A Gift, a Curse
strings: A Gift, a Curse

Because of that broken Carnality Card, tales abound in the streets of how you conquered a woman who pretended to be haughty. Some even claim that the House of Delights now employs armored, weapon-wielding prostitutes – imagine the thrill of that spectacle! Of course, a full set of armor is expensive, so the prostitutes would make savings on the material, haha… And just as the gossip reaches a fever pitch, Adila’s family comes to pay their visit...

Along with the news of Adila's death, a long parcel arrives. Her family, stone-faced, place it on your table as if it was not their child who died.
Perhaps they already foresaw that this sword-wielding girl would die young; maybe they had long since stopped considering her family. And now, more than ever, they want to distance themselves with her. 
Regardless, this is the final gift Adila left to the world, to you. 
You open the parcel and are surprised to find her beautiful sword. Upon the water-clear edge, a smudge of red remains. Her family coldly informs you that is Adila's blood. This is the sword she took her life with.
Beneath the sword, you find a note. Her handwriting has the same edge as her blade. "Isn't this sword beautiful? Remember, it is also sharp. Through it, I guard my last honor as a warrior – forever unsullied. You, trapped in this game, shall one day need it, just as I do now."

The victor can do with the loser as they wish, such is the code of honor of the warriors of the past... And Adila's stubborn conviction. It is unclear if she truly understands its implications.
Adila
You may deal with her using either a Bloodshed Card or a Carnality Card.
You may use either a Bloodshed Card or a Carnality Card to deal with her, or do nothing at all.
You break a Bloodshed Card with her life.
You break a Carnality Card with her.
Faced with death, her young eyes could not help but show a hint of fear. She closes her eyes, then forces them open, pretending to be strong. "I am willing to die as a warrior."

Such is the most primal form of conquest, such is how the victor claim his prize. You derive immense pleasure from such an act.
Adila, a warrior strong and dexterous, is nothing like the other women. Neither frail nor dainty, she lies beneath you like a young lion. She appears inexperienced, yet swallows her pain. You wrap your hand around her fist, clenched in bitterness, and pace the strange and humiliating pleasures you give her.
What a pleasant night, at least for you.

Adila looks at you in astonishment. "You are letting me go, just like this? For nothing?" 
You shake your head and tell her, not every fight has to be a fight to the bitter end. A true warrior must experience many a failure before they achieve greatness.
She opens her mouth and counters, "That won’t do – didn’t we agree? A warrior must stand by her words."
After a long moment, she grits her teeth and unfastens the sword at her waist. "I have nothing else of value – only this blade, which is as dear to me as my own life…"
She tenderly caresses its edge, upon which light dances like ripples, then places it squarely on your table. "Worry not. I will acquire another weapon for myself, though it won't hold up to this one... You must cherish it, understand? I’ve labored long and hard to get it."
With that, she bows hurriedly to you and departs without a backward glance, rushing off before regret catches up with her.

5000640.title: Visiting Nawfal
strings: Visiting Nawfal

Nawfal's gates are shut, a silent declaration that unwelcome guests will find no entry. Of course, he has no intention of receiving you. And in any other circumstance, you would have no intention of gracing the doorsteps of an enemy. But that pointed, knowing look lingers in your mind. Nawfal is not afraid of you. Or… wait. Is he? He should be. After all the public humiliations he has put you through, has he forgotten that you can now kill him without consequence? Yes. I can kill him. The thought slides into your mind. All you need is the right Bloodshed Card and a few trusted hands... If you bring a gift, coax him into lowering his defenses, then, one strike, clean and final. Or, if not that, at least you can get an answer out of him: what, exactly, did he mean by that look?
Nawfal
To show your sincerity, you must meet him in person.
You must bring a gift he likes, a reading material of Bronze tier or higher.
You remember that Nawfal is a book lover. You can buy a book of Bronze tier or higher as a gift.
Nawfal waited for you for two weeks, unwilling to give up a glimmer of hope even if it meant abandoning appearances to face fear. But in the end, you never came.

Nawfal seems to anticipate your visit, though your gift surprises you. He pauses for a moment before taking [s3.name], and then suggests going to a quiet place to talk. He has something to say to you.

5000641.title: Private Meeting
strings: Private Meeting
This mansion, isolated from the bustle of the city, stands in a silence that feels like no man's land. Beneath the eaves and tree shadows, Nawfal sits alone reading, no servants by his sight.
You must attend the appointment in person.
A Note in a Book.
Nawfal seems to be waiting for you.
You may place a Bloodshed Card or Carnality Card of Nawfal’s tier or lower.
The result will vary depending on the Sultan Card you place.
You can also choose not to place any Sultan Cards and converse with him as equals.
Nawfal waited for you for two weeks. But in the end, you never came.
A Golden Opportunity

Your arrival didn't surprise him. He simply nodded at you.

You casually talked with him, when he stood up and led you to the house, you easily slipped a dagger into his unguarded heart – yet he only but looked into your eyes, neither surprised nor resisting.

"Am I the first to die from this deck of cards? That I know not, but I know I won't be the last," he sighed and closed his eyes forever.

As you break the Sultan Card with your blood-soaked hand, you distinctly felt that perhaps you missed something.

Under the shadow of trees, it seems suitable to do such carnal things.
"Has this deck of cards granted you the sovereignty and audacity to humiliate me?" He asks, as you pin his hands above his head. Anger flashes in his eyes, then fades within the blink of an eye. "... I pity you." He closes his eyes wearily, refusing to confront your desire.
Yet in that moment, you vaguely caught something – there was a hope hidden in his glance towards you, now forever lost... What was it?
You suddenly want to know what he originally intended to say to you by bringing you here, but his lips are now forever sealed.

Your arrival does not surprise him. He simply nods at you.He leads you in, then proceeds to speak: "This is a disaster..." Pouring you a mint-infused tea, his voice is low and certain, "Everyone will be dragged into a whirlpool of fear and distrust, a life worse than death. Especially you... [s1.name], to survive this game, you will betray your own morals – killing friends, squandering fortune, trampling faraway lands, disheartening your very wife... Yet, when the game is over, what will you have? The title of Vizier? We both know the Sultan has no need for a wise courtier."
Pushing the cup towards you, Nawfal adds in a hushed tone, "Don't you want to end this game early?"
"Do you have a plan?" You ask involuntarily.
"Should we sever the roots of this calamity..."
"You mean, the Sultan?...Wait, you're plotting regicide?!"
Despite your candid words, Nawfal calmly and earnestly nods. "It's not easy, but it's our only respite from the Sultan's rule."
Speechless for a time, you finally question, "How do you plan to do it?"
"It's not 'I', but 'us'... maybe even 'you' - only you have the hope to achieve it, given the powers the Sultan has bestowed upon you," Nawfal explains, "We need an army, a means to open the city gates, and a chance to seize the Sultan's magic ring..." He articulates the plan in thorough detail, his gaze steady, it feels like the whole plan is haunting in his mind for times immemorable.
You suddenly recall your first meeting with him many years ago, when he was just a cynical, headstrong youth who repeatedly faced rejection yet refused to temper his approach. Gradually, Nawfal's household grew increasingly isolated, with no one willing to associate with him.
You often heard colleagues complaining about him at feasts, mocking him, until eventually, they stopped mentioning him altogether. No one could change the Sultan or his rule, and without this voice of opposition, the court was left with only the same, terrible, unspoken silence.
You don't know when he became completely disillusioned with the Sultan, when he began to concoct this almost impossible plan, but you can see that what is hidden in his dark eyes looking at you at this moment is surprisingly hopeful.
Ha... Hope... What a word...
"But why? Why do you tell me these? Don't you think I will report it to the Sultan?"
"You have chance to use these cards to me, don't you?" Nawfal gives a wry smile, speaks frankly, "I was merely gambling on the idea that you had not yet submitted to the game.”
As such, you discuss some details until the moon rises. Nawfal waves a goodbye to you, his words lingering guilt, "I'm sorry, I can't help you in public, lest I bid a steadfast investigation into us. Should you need something, send someone towards me to make an arrangement here."
You nod in understanding, and so, under the moonlit night, a hidden covenant is signed as your hands are clasped. Perhaps it is from this night that the path of destiny begins to turn to another ending.

5000650.title: Vanity, Vanity
strings: Vanity, Vanity

Nayla’s vanity is as renowned as her charm. She sends you a message suggesting you use a Sultan Card on her... This way, she can return to being the center of palace gossip – and you, in the process, may gain immense pleasure.
She waits for you behind the translucent silk canopy.
You must attend the appointment in person.
Carnality or... Bloodshed
She obviously thinks Carnality is the only option, but you know better.
Your indifference completely infuriated her. It is said that she called your name aloud while killing two male slaves in rage.

When you pull out the shiny Sultan Card, she excitedly grabs it, admiring the magical flowing patterns.

But, "Why is there a picture of a woman taking her own life?" she asks while undressing, revealing her body adorned with gold threads and embroidery.

Because love breeds life, and death takes them. Ultimately, they are but two sides of the same coin – you explain, caressing her breasts before the crimson nectar of life splurged from her chest, splattering on the knife's handle as you remove it from her.

She eagerly pulls the Sultan Card and your hand between her thighs.
As rumor goes, her ardor is much like the tides and reefs: turbulent, complex, inescapable...
The next day, the whole city has learned of your affair with her. She even praises the boundless passion and pleasure the card brought her in court. The Sultan enjoyed the story. The same cannot be said for your wife.

5000651.title: A Makeup in Blood
strings: A Makeup in Blood
Nayla has thought of a new game – she invites you to use a Bloodshed Card to execute her most defiant slave. This will be immensely fun for both of you.
The Lady.
The Sharp-eyed Slave.
You have to attend in person.
A Bloodshed Card... but which tier should it be?
A Stone Bloodshed Card can kill a slave, while a Silver one can...
She sent you a beautifully written and provocative letter along with the nomad's head, but you understood that meeting her again would be disastrous.

She seems like a nun; humble and holy, she remove your garment, she hold your hand, and she slit open the robust and hairy chest of that slave with a golden knife. The incision is smooth and beautiful, like a divine sacrifice.

She scoops up the blood to sketch makeup and clothing on her body, then took out the still-beating heart, stand on tiptoe, and raises it above your head as if anointing a crowned king.

Blood flows down your forehead, blurring your eyes. All you can hear is the squishing sound of the heart being squeezed, and all you can feel is the friction of her breasts and breath against your skin.

This is a Bloodshed Card worthy of you, you tell her as you take the golden knife from her hand and put a chain around her neck.
Then, you untie the nomad slave, leaving him with the weapon and time.

When you come to your senses, you are both panting, lying exhausted amidst guts and blood...

She gently licks away the blood clots in your ear and whispers: "I think I'm a little in love with you."

Surprisingly, after a long time, no more sound came from the room...
Just when you were getting impatient, the slave opened the door, threw the blood-stained scimitar on the ground, and told you that he needed a handy bow and arrow to better serve you.

5000652.title: The Gift of Gold
strings: The Gift of Gold

Nayla writes to you – her discontent grows. She can no longer bear being merely a Silver. "My love," she pleads, "bring me a wonder beyond compare. Let the palace witness my glory, and you shall burn a Gold Sultan Card in the process."
Nayla's ambition grows.
She will only meet with you.
A Gold Tier Treasure or Accessory
A display of extravagance, or death.
A Gold Treasure will allow for the use of a Gold Sultan Card.
Of course, you can also end this relationship with a Silver Bloodshed Card.
She no longer wrote letters nor wanted to see you. In the palace, she called you a man who can't achieve great things.

To receive your gift, she tears down an entire wall of her estate, fashioning a grand passageway vast enough to accommodate half the court’s nobility, so that they may witness the treasure carried in on the backs of slaves. The spectacle is garish, the expense obscene.
But you cannot deny it. The way they look at you both has changed. Nayla is now truly a lady of the first rank.
Even the Sultan has to admit this display of extravagance is of the highest order.
After the feast, her handmaid delivers a token of her gratitude –along with a message laced with invitation, an expectation of your next formal visit.

To welcome the Treasures you sent, she knocked down an entire wall to make space large enough to accommodate half of the palace dignitaries, allowing them to watch the Treasures being carried into her mansion by the slaves.
Despite the extravagance and wastefulness of these displays, the look on the guests' faces when you cut her throat was very satisfying.
The Sultan greatly appreciated the performance, allowing you to break this Gold Bloodshed Card. And Nayla finally got her wish—becoming a woman worthy of the Gold Sultan Card.

You lie. You tell her the gift is ready, with only a few details remain...

She receives you in her chambers, draped in sheer silk. And so, with a smooth motion, you take the curtain cord beside you and pull it taut around her throat. It complements the color of her robe beautifully.

5000653.title: Impatience
strings: Impatience
You have expanded this lady's imagination to the limit. Now, she yearns to follow you – to witness stranger, more terrible wonders.
Nayla
Protagonist
You put in an ideological trend that might move her.
She will react differently depending on the Conviction you place.
If left unattended, she will eventually turn into an ordinary supporter.
The Conviction will not be consumed.
If your Influence is greater or equal to 8, she will become your ally.
For now, Nayla is satisfied with everything. Maybe there will be more interesting things in the future, but at least for now, she will be a powerful supporter in the palace.
She is already wet before you even finish your words.
What she desires most is influence, and no influence in this world surpasses that of the divine.

You can barely recall what happened last night. Nayla was too excited, too enthusiastic... It seems like you two talked about something about jewelry for the royal family, like there was a queen? Wait... what kind of queen...? Well, no harm in letting her dreams run wild until they come true.
You've shared your thoughts with her, had a few drinks, and by the time you left, she was already immersed in your ideas.
This is Dull
She also wants to do as she pleases
Your influence enthralls her
She has no patience for the things you fear — for Nayla, these are all a matter of course... For sure, she still hopes to always be on the side of the Victor.
You feel like she hasn't yet understood what you're trying to express, but... After all, the monster is on our side, so let it be.

You can't clearly recall what happened last night. Nayla was too excited, too enthusiastic... It seems like you two talked about something about jewelry for the royal family, like there was a queen? Wait... what kind of queen...? Well, no harm in letting her dreams run wild until they come true.

All night long, noble Nayla serves you like a slave. Her skin, tongue, and words are all there for your comfort. You look down at her, enjoying seeing your own image in her eyes, reflected back like some dark, sculpted symbol of power.
You just simply chatted, nothing more.

5000654.title: Her Husband
strings: Her Husband

Nayla's wealth and status come from her husband's family – though he himself has been chronically ill and almost forgotten by the palace... Now, she begs you to ensure that he is forgotten for good, so she can share her everything with you.
Nayla is waiting for you at home...
This poor man, wreaked by sickness...
You have to handle this yourself.
Place a Bloodshed Card here, and you can kill Nayla.
Place a Bloodshed Card here, and you can kill her husband.
What a dreadful choice, but you can do it.
You can choose to kill either Nayla or her husband.
In either case, you can choose to use an extra Carnality Card, as long as you are bold enough.
If you keep stalling, Nayla will grow to resent you.
You must choose whom to slay
This story is long, but he listens patiently. Nayla's corpse lays at your feet, never before so silent.
It appears he wasn't surprised by the outcome. He did not resist when your blade sliced him; instead, he gave his wife a longing gaze...
Tonight, this place will be a secret chamber. Tomorrow, you and only you alone will tell the tale – of how a couple so scornful of one another died in each other's arms.
He thanks you for your mercy and wisdom. Although he is too frail to be of service to you, he will lend you support in the court...

Finally, as you two gaze upon Nayla's corpse, you can't help but loosen your tongue – what a beautiful and enchanting woman she was. Her beauty gave her the privilege to commit evils, didn't it? Weren't it not us who were too weak to bear such beauty...?
As these memories come back, your skin twitches as if reliving her touch... Not just you, but even her husband's sickly, withered body is stirred by these memories... It seems your desires have been awaken. 
This is a crime, he mutters to himself: "This is blasphemy... Oh God, forgive my madness...” Until you pull out the Carnality Card that exonerates all the madness perpetrated...

You are certain that Nayla would have loved this way of honoring her.
“From now on, I belong to you,” Nayla whispers in your ear. The corpse of her previous husband watch as you embrace her, his eyes unclosing...

The unfortunate man’s eyes remain wide open.

Under his unblinking gaze, Nayla’s passion burns. She takes your knife hand, guiding it with breathless hunger. “There are other things,” she whispers, “awaiting your penetration…”

Blasphemous. Obscene. And yet, the Sultan approves of your madness. He grants you the indulgence of breaking a Carnality Card.
You take all the coins you can find. It is the least that you deserve. And you need the money.

Perhaps you did not do anything in that room. Did you really commit the blasphemous acts you are rumored to have done? You cannot remember.

As you think back on Nayla's body, the scenes of carnality are chaotic, cacophonous. In these visions, her body would always turn stone cold at the most unexpected moment. And her husband – whose eyes you always in the corner of your memories – sometimes red as fury, sometimes pallid as pity.

Only now do you realize, stories do not belong to those who tell them. They grow, they change, they even start to erode the narrator's memories.

We can never return to the truth. We can only approximate a narrative of our own choosing.

5000660.title: Explore the Unknown Oasis
strings: Explore the Unknown Oasis

The cartographer Manar brings you her latest discovery – tracks, faint but unmistakable, hinting at an uncharted oasis. She found the signs too late; her supplies were already spent. She could not go further. Regret and excitement war in her voice as she urges you to sponsor – or even join – her expedition. She swears the rewards will surpass your wildest imaginings.
Cartographer Manar is looking forward to your help.
Manar hopes you can sponsor her with at least 3 Gold Coins.
You can join the expedition in person, or send someone to join in your stead.
Certain consumables might help during the expedition.
This expedition requires at least 3 Gold Coins.
Manar will not give up easily. Even if she fails, she will set out again when she is ready.
In these vast expanses, can you find the tracks covered by wind and sand?
Your Physique and Survival determine your full dice count.
You need at least 3 Successes to see results.
Your sponsorship compensates for her last shortcoming
You have lost the trail...

Just when despair threatens to take hold, a hint of green emerges on the golden horizon. You would mistake it for a mirage, if not for the distant murmur of water – it is a miracle. Manar clings to you in exhilaration before breaking away, racing toward the unknown oasis. A small clan dwells here. They welcome you with open arms, offering their strongest spirits and their finest lambs. You return home with laughter in your throat and blessings at your back. Before long, the tale of your journey spreads across the city.

East is no different from west. North and south yield no clues. The oasis remains a legend, nothing more. With supplies dwindling, you are forced to turn back. Manar’s disappointment is plain, but so is the quiet defiance in her dust-worn features. She is not a woman who gives up easily. She will take to the roads again.

5000661.title: Undertow
strings: Undertow

The oasis discovered by you and Cartographer Manar seems to have aroused the interest of the Sultan. Shadowy machinations are at work, pushing everything into the abyss, and you are powerless to stop them.
The oasis you discovered is now known to the Sultan.
Maybe you can use a Conquest Card, but...
You can act preemptively or ignore it, but in any case, nobody can change the Sultan's mind.
You decide to use the Conquest Card
You did not take advantage of the situation

You have observed the movements of the army. The Sultan has already sent troops to the oasis. Its destruction is irreversible, so why not make the most of it?
You take out a card depicting royal power and implore the Sultan for a chance to expand his territory. The Sultan agrees with a hearty laugh. Thus, you lead the army in slaughter, plundering all the oasis has to offer. Thus, you make it worthy of the word “Conquest”.
And the trampled land left behind? Erased from the map, desolate and worthless.

You wait in endless torment, until the news reach you: the Sultan's army flattened the new oasis and brought back endless wealth.
In celebration, the Sultan is throwing a feast in his golden palace for all his courtiers. Amidst the festivities, you spot Manar. Her face bears a bitter smile. With an almost sobbing voice, she says, 'I didn't know it would turn out this way.'
No one can fathom the Sultan's savagery. You are thrown back to that cold, winter night of your adventure. It is as if you are again stranded on that empty moor, stalked by night predators, with only the two of you guarding the fire, huddling for warmth.

5000662.title: A Lone Journey into the Unknown
strings: A Lone Journey into the Unknown

You hear that Manar has set out once again. The Sultan commands her to cross the desert in search of a fabled city hidden in the mountains. She seeks no sponsors. She departs with nothing but a camel.
Manar has left.
She will travel alone, what fate awaits her?

You hear that the cartographer has disappeared. Perhaps she got lost in the vast desert. Perhaps she is already dead. The Sultan bemoans her failure, but his attention soon shifts to other things – more beautiful women, more novel games, more wealth to seize... Manar's name is soon forgotten. No one will ever know what drove her to journey on.

5000663.title: Journey into the Unknown
strings: Journey into the Unknown

Menar’s talents have caught the Sultan’s attention. She petitions him for permission to explore beyond the great Sea of Sand – to seek a legendary stronghold hidden in distant peaks. A journey of great peril. This time, she does not come to you for aid.
Manar does not want to drag you into this.
You can assist her in this tough expedition yourself or send someone to help her.
It would be best to prepare some consumables, just in case.
This is an extremely dangerous expedition. Manar does not want to drag you into it.
If she ventures out alone, what awaits her is almost certain death.
No matter what thoughts weigh on the explorer's mind, the shadow of death already sways in the wild wind and sand.
Your Physique and Survival determine your full dice count.
You need at least 5 Successes to see results.
You send no one
Since then, you never hear of Manar again. She must have died in this expedition, but you have a feeling... It was her choice. It was her defiance.
You overcome the trials and tribulations
You could not change anything

Manar doesn't expect you would come. She looks very downcast, no longer showing the excitement like her first adventure.

She tells you that her dream was to explore the world and record it faithfully on her map – that corrected parchment where the location of the oasis you found has been burned into a scorched hole. Manar shakes her head sadly, saying she never thought she would only bring disaster to them. With a forced smile, she says, "Actually, I never thought of coming back... but you came... perhaps this is fate..."

You want to comfort her, tell her it's not her fault, but what can you say?

You trudge through the choking haze of sand and smoke in silent determination. The deathlands do not claim you. The mountains rise, red as dried blood. A valley, long and narrow, cut through the land like the scar left by a god’s blade. And at its end – a city.

The streets teem with traders. Orderly. Prosperous. A place of wealth and law. You wander through its markets, dazzled, unable to resist a few exotic indulgences. As you leave, Manar lingers, murmuring to the valley’s jagged walls. "Easily defensible... isn’t it?" Then, shaking her head with a rueful smile, she turns to you. "No matter. Thank you."

The storm was merciless. You have never looked death in the face so clearly. But when you wake, all is still. The merchant who saved you says he followed the sound of camel bells and found you – only you.

Yes. You remember now. When all was lost, Manar pressed the last of the supplies into your hands and smiled. Peaceful. Resigned. As though she had foreseen this moment. As though she had always been waiting for it...

You carry news of her death back to the city. The Sultan expresses great regret for her failure to fulfill her mission. Then his attention drifts to brighter things: fairer women, newer diversions, treasures more worthy of plunder... Manar's name fade from memory.

5000664.title: Undertow
strings: Undertow
Manar found the legendary city, and it has aroused the interest of the Sultan. Shadowy machinations are at work, pushing everything into the abyss. You are powerless to stop them.
The Prosperous City.
Maybe you can use a Conquest Card, but...
You can act preemptively or ignore it, but in any case, nobody can change the Sultan's mind.
You decide to use the Conquest Card
You did not take advantage of the situation

You have already noticed the troop's movements and know that the Sultan has dispatched forces to the city. Destruction is now irreversible; why not allow it to serve its last purpose?

You present a card inscribed with royal power, humbly asking the Sultan for an opportunity to expand his territories. The Sultan laughs heartily and agrees.

As the commander, you obtain the map that Manar gave to the Sultan — you suddenly notice that the locations marked on the map are incorrect, but it's not a problem for you, who personally experienced the expedition. You order the troops to besiege the stubborn city until its supplements are completely depleted, then eventually breaking through. In revenge for wasting your time, you massacre the citizens and loot all their possessions. This trampled land no longer holds any value marked on the map.

You had heard that the Sultan's army had set out, but after countless hardships, when they finally found the city and infiltrated its walls, it had already been abandoned.
The prosperity you once witnessed now seemed nothing more than a mirage.
You suddenly recalled that Manar had spoken at length with the merchants before the expedition.
A near-impossible conjecture began to swirl in your mind... perhaps, before long, it would be confirmed.

5000665.title: Manar’s Farewell
strings: Manar’s Farewell

Manar decides to leave.
Her laments as she bids you farewell. She cannot bear to have her talents exploited by the Sultan any longer. She will journey to find a place untouched by the Sultan's Influence, never to return again.
You. You are her only cherished companion. She smiles, "Wish me luck. If I find such a paradise, I will write to you."
No matter how you loath to say goodbye, the time for parting has come. This journey will surely be difficult. Maybe you can help her one last time...
Manar is about to depart.
You can give her 5 Gold Coins to fund her travel.
She will travel alone, what fate awaits her?
You just give her a hug.
You give her your final sponsorship.

She will always cherish your adventures together. Those are her most treasured memories of this land. You watch her silhouette disappearing into the distance, knowing this might be the last time you see each other in this life.
You never hear from Manar again. Did she forget about you? Or did she... No, you would rather believe she has found that faraway utopia, free from evil, free from the shadow of fear...

Manar gratefully accepts the funds you offered. She will always cherish your adventures together. Those are her most treasured memories of this land. You watch her silhouette disappearing into the distance, knowing this might be the last time you see each other in this life. But you believe that someday you will receive a letter. She will passionately recount the details of her travel, the unknown treasures of distant lands, and invite you to that distant utopia. Perhaps that letter will arrive next month, or maybe next year... one day.

5000666.title: Distant Paradise
strings: Distant Paradise
A well-travelled courier knocks on your door.
You need 1 Gold Coin for a tip.
You must give the courier some money before he will give you the letter.
You paid the courier.

You recognize Manar’s handwriting on the envelope.
In her letter, she says she has found a safe haven, far from the Sultan's rule, with lush vegetation and mild climate. The ruler there is wise and kind, the people prosperous and friendly... The envelope contains a map, detailing the route to that paradise, along with necessary instructions and annotations.
You know that if you tire of this game, if you decide to leave, this will be your final way out. Keep it safe, away from the Sultan's eyes.

5000667.title: The Sultan’s Prank
strings: The Sultan’s Prank
The great and kind Sultan has given you an opportunity – to break a Sultan Card with ease and efficiency.
The poor young man has no idea what is about to befall him.
You must stand in the Sultan's court in person.
You must use a Sultan Card not higher than Fardak in tier.
You have 7 days to decide which Sultan Card to use.
You decided to use a Bloodshed Card
You decide to use the Carnality Card
You decide to use the Extravagance Card
You decide to use the Conquest Card

You present a card etched with sacrifice. The Sultan nods, intrigued. He permits you a duel in his court. A young man, bewildered, takes the dagger from a servant’s hands. He has no time to understand. You drive the blade into his heart. The blood of this nameless youth flows over gold and marble. The Sultan laughs, delighted, as though he has witnessed the most amusing thing in the world.

You present a card depicting lovers. The Sultan smiles. He allows you to openly take pleasure in his court.

The young man does not yet understand. You press him to the ground. Laughter drowns out his struggles. His dignity peels away beneath hungry gazes. Only the trembling remains, as he endures the unsought for onslaught.

The Sultan laughs, delighted, as though he has witnessed the most amusing thing in the world. Then, descending from his golden dais, he takes the young man’s chin between his fingers and commands him to speak his name.

Between shuddering breaths and broken moans, comes a name. A family name once spoken with pride and love. A name, now, too shameful to bear.

"Fardak, is it..." The Sultan straightens, satisfied. He looks down at him, his tone inscrutable, "I grant you a reprieve. Your tribute may wait until autumn. But until then – you will remain in the capital."

The young man closes his eyes in shame. It is not over yet. He bows, low and deep. With a heart heavy with fear for the future, he whispers words of gratitude.

You present a card depicting charity. The Sultan narrows his eyes. "A dull choice," he remarks, displeased. Then, after a pause, he smiles.

"Very well," he says, "he may delay his tribute until autumn. But the son of a governor cannot sleep in an inn like a common traveler, can he? I expect you to build him a palace. One worthy of his station. If you fail…"

His voice trails off, leaving a void: a deep, hungry abyss, brimming with malice.

You present a card depicting kingship. The Sultan smiles at you knowingly, satisfied. His soldiers long to drink the blood of the weak.

The young man waits in the cold palace halls, restless, helpless. Then – news arrives. His homeland, where the tribute has run dry. The governor, who has failed at his duties. All crushed beneath iron hooves. The Sultan is never merciful.

The palace echoes with the Sultan's laughter as the young man inherits his father's title and a debt too vast to pay. The next morning, you hear that he slit his throat, standing by a frost-bitten window in the stage station.

5000668.title: Building Underground Channels
strings: Building Underground Channels

You know that a great method to deal with drought is to build underground channels to draw from aquifers, and the most important and challenging part is finding the right water source. You decide to dispatch scholars and craftsmen to verify your idea. Although it will take a long time, it will be worth it for the sake of stabilizing the people's lives.
You can accomplish this great feat yourself or send a follower.
This task requires at least 8 Gold Coins for funding.
Building underground channels will take at least 7 rounds to complete, so choose the participants carefully.
To withstand the harsh environment, the team you send must have at least 1 person, and at least 10 in Survival in total.
Your team's Survival attribute is not enough to carry out this task.

With ample experience, expertise, patience, and fortitude, you and your followers traverse the local mountains and rivers, seeking traces of alluvial fans and digging out vertical shafts like ant barrows. They meticulously examine the depth and gradient of the subterranean channels, and through their hard work, an extremely complex system takes shape. This god-forsaken, parched land finally sees rain: a rain that comes from deep underground, from hundreds of meters below. People praise your wisdom, grateful for your benevolence. Your name is engraved on the stone bricks of the channels, kissed by the cool night breeze passing through the channels for a thousand years to come.

5000669.title: Rain Prayer Sacrifice
strings: Rain Prayer Sacrifice

The abnormal drought is an omen. God has turned Their back on this land. So, you make a suggestion to Fardak: pray to the devil instead. Desperation dulls hesitation. He agrees to the ritual without much thought. If the skies will weep again, if his people will be spared, he will forsake all else.
The ritual's host must possess sufficient Black Art.
You can officiate personally or assign a follower to assist in this ritual.
You can offer a sacrifice to the deity.
Consumables filled with ample Magic will be helpful.
The person conducting this evil ritual must possess the Black Art trait.
This ritual requires a living sacrifice. If you are unwilling to provide one, the conductor will choose one from the locals.
At least 5 in Magic are needed to initiate this ritual.
Can you summon the power from the darkness?
Your Magic determines your full dice count.
You need at least 2 Successes to see results.
The team's Magic attribute is insufficient to support the ritual's consumption.
Last Chance
You did not prepare enough sacrifices
You personally prepared the sacrifice

The scorching sun burns your back, and the pure blood of the sacrifice dries in your palm, yet, on the dark altar, there is still – still no response. People begin to whisper, their glances at you filled with doubt. You have failed once again, worse still, you realize they no longer believe in the god you serve, and you are powerless.

[s1.name] requisitions several pure and pretty children as ritual sacrifices.
Innocent blood floods the dark altar, sketching mysterious primal patterns. In a trembling voice, [s1.name] calls out the Master's name, praying for a glance of mercy.
Soon, clouds gather over the parched land, forming a massive, swirling eye. Under its cold, evil gaze, people prostrate on the ground, daring not to make a sound beyond prayers and pleas.
Ah... such sweet and fervent faith. From deep beneath the clouds, deep within the void, that which cannot be gazed upon extends Its tendrils in satisfaction. A heavy rain tinged with the color of blood pours down, bringing forth twisted shoots from countless seeds.
People cry out and dance with ecstasy, offering up their unreserved devotion. You know, you have all become 'family'.

[s1.name] requisitioned several clean and pretty children as sacrifices and performed the ritual locally. The pure blood dried on the dark altar, but there was no response from the sky. People hesitated in their prayers, suspecting they were not devout enough and had not prepared gifts pleasing to the god.

The pure blood of the sacrifice flowed freely on the dark altar, tracing primitive and mysterious patterns. [s1.name] called out the master's divine name in a trembling voice, praying for their merciful glance.
Soon, the dark clouds gather over the arid land, transforming into a giant, rolling eye. Under the cold and evil gaze, everyone prostrates themselves, daring not to make any sound other than prayers and supplications.
Ah... such sweet and intense faith. Hidden deep within the clouds, hidden deep within the void, the inscrutable being extends His tentacles with satisfaction. A torrential rain tinged with light blood pours down, causing countless seeds to sprout into twisted new shoots.
People fanatically shout, dance, and offer their piety without reservation. You know, you have become 'family.'
Innocent blood dries on the dark altar, but the sky remains silent. People hesitate in their prayers, doubting their devotion, wondering if god was displeased with their offering.

5000670.title: Building the Palace
strings: Building the Palace
Your trivial use of the Extravagance Card on Fardak has bored the Sultan. He decides to punish your lack of tact and orders you to build a luxurious and extravagant palace for Fardak.
The Sultan requires you to spend at least 10 Gold Coins.
You must raise enough money within the deadline, or face execution.

You deliver the Sultan’s demanded tribute on time. The sum is vast –far beyond what the Sultan Card should command. But if it will soothe the monarch's wrath, who would dare say it was not worth the price?

Fardak, unlucky son of an unlucky governor, offers you a bitter smile. He tells you that the cost of building the palace was, by chance, nearly the same as his province’s taxes. And now, that wealth has been squandered on the most useless thing in the world: a golden cage, trapping him in the capital.

He shakes his head. He does not fight it. He accepts his fate.

5000672.title: The Law of Iron and Lash
strings: The Law of Iron and Lash

For these wretched peasants that dare to flee, you draft a decree – harsh, precise, unavoidable. You summon scholars of the law, pore over the scrolls, and unleash the storm. The fugitives will be hunted, their punishment a warning to those who might follow in their footsteps.
The drafter of the laws needs at least 5 in Wisdom
The enforcer of the laws needs at least 5 in Physique
You dispatched experts to handle these matters

Under your guidance, jurists gather in great halls, their voices rising and falling in heated debate. The verdict comes swiftly.
A new system of identification is tested upon the land. A sweep of the nameless and the rootless is unleashed. The runaway peasant, once caught, is flogged, branded, fined, and returned to their original place. Those who shelter them are punished. Those who report them are rewarded.

And so, they are captured in droves. With no other path remaining, they kneel before the nobility, land deeds in trembling hands, pleading for protection. The nobles are pleased. They shower you with gifts. After all, you have proven to been a loyal friend to them.

5000673.title: Promise of Mercy
strings: Promise of Mercy

Everyone knows why the peasants flee. The taxes are too heavy, the burden unbearable. Convince the nobles to ease their grip, even a little, and the peasants will return to their lands. But the nobles will not yield so easily. The Sultan grants them tax rights for only a handful of years. They do not think beyond them. This will cost you a lot more than you first imagined.
To persuade the nobles requires at least 5 in Charisma.
Achieving this requires at least 5 Gold Coins.
You dispatched experts to handle these matters

[s1.name] is a clever, skillful, and articulate speaker, having charmed the local nobles into a daze. Eventually, you collectively introduced some welfare policies, combined with deliberately arranged sermons and speeches. The farmers, full of hope, returned to their land. This has greatly boosted your reputation; some praise your generosity and kindness, others mock your foolish acts. But you do not care about these opinions; for in your eyes, a farmer well-fed is a fact most natural.

5000674.title: Facilitate Negotiation
strings: Facilitate Negotiation

With their swift horses and familiarity with the terrain, the bandits are hard to subdue by force. But the reason why they rob the caravans is there is no farmland in the mountains to meet their needs. You decide to send your approved 'diplomat' to negotiate with them.
The person negotiating with the mountain bandits needs at least 6 in Sociability.
To smooth things over, 6 Gold Coins are required.
To ensure success, the person negotiating with the bandits needs at least 6 points in Sociability.
Greasing the right palms requires at least 6 Gold Coins.
You arranged for the negotiation

Gold paves the way to a meeting between the leaders of the merchant guild and the desert raiders.
Your skillful negotiation bridge their differences. A compromise is struck: the merchants will pay tribute to the raiders in coin and goods, and the raiders, in return, will offer protection and guidance, ensuring safe passage.
The eastern trade route thrives. In time, your deeds become a local legend.

5000675.title: Forceful Expulsion
strings: Forceful Expulsion
Clearly, the locals have failed to eliminate the bandits due to gross incompetence. If you are to lead the assault personally, things will be different!
Participants in this extermination operation need at least 6 points in Combat.
To ensure a successful operation, participants must have at least 6 in Combat.
You will exterminate the bandits

[s1.name] and [s2.name] join force and drive the bandits from the hills. The rabble scatter in fear. The merchants rejoice, showering you with gifts, praising your justice. But peace is a short-lived. The desperate have no choice. If a man cannot till the land, he must take to the road, blade in hand. So long as the Sultan’s tyranny continues, the mountains will always breed outlaws.

5000676.title: Check for vulnerabilities
strings: Check for vulnerabilities

The issue of cultists taking advantage of conversion to commit tax evasion is a deep-rooted and complicated one. Something must be done, but you cannot do it alone. You summon advisors from different walks of life to chart a path forward.
The host of the meeting needs at least 8 in Wisdom to work through the intricacies.
You can assign a persuasive assistant to the host.
Certain items can grant you a distinct advantage in negotiations.
You need enough Wisdom to unravel the intricacies, and Sociability is essential in negotiations.
You will be obstructed by the True Faith. The check suffers a -5 penalty.
You need at least 2 in Influence to call for a meeting.
You can keep trying.
At the meeting, the factions argue endlessly, especially the priests, who insist on maintaining the sacred privileges believers enjoy, completely ignoring your words...
The number of dice provided by your Wisdom and Sociability is reduced by 5 points due to resistance of the True Faith.
You need at least 3 Successes to win.
Your Influence cannot be less than 2.
You successfully convinced everyone
You are overwhelmed by endless disputes

You wrestle with the obstinate priests. You assure them – no, you are not here to strip them of their power, merely to shift the weight of taxation from faith to land itself.

The matter of classification – what is tithe land, what is tribute land – is left to the assembled voices. And the final judgment is left to the Sultan's supreme wisdom.

And so, it is done. The law is written. No cultist convert in the distant hinterlands will escape their dues again. At the bottom of the decree, your name is written as a humble footnote, remembered by scholars in ages come.
The meeting ends in exhaustion. Hours of debate, no resolution. No matter. You tell yourself gently. There will be another chance.

5000677.title: Holy Judgment
strings: Holy Judgment

You are struck by the sheer shamelessness of these cultists. They abandon their gods for a handful of coins. Worse, they defile yours in the process! The True Faith will not stand for this. You shall bring holy judgment upon them. No cost too great.
The commander of the Justiciars must be a Walker of the True Faith or have at least 8 in Magic.
You rain down judgment

There is no debate, no trials. The false converts are seized, sentenced, and executed. Their lands are sold to noble houses as compensation for the taxes they dared to deny. Terror follows in the wake of this purge. No one dares speak against you. Good. They have learned their lesson.

5000678.title: The Sultan's Suspicion
strings: The Sultan's Suspicion
Your fame has spread through the realm. People praise you so much that the Sultan, a suspicious ruler, summons you to verify your loyalty to him.
You must go to the palace in person to meet the Sultan.
8 Gold Coins may satisfy the Sultan.
You must dispel the Sultan's doubts within a limited number of rounds, or you will be executed.
A tribute in gold

You kneel, offering riches and reverence in equal measure. Does the Sultan believe your feigned devotion? Perhaps not. But he is satisfied with your show of deference. For now, his doubts are laid to rest.

5000679.title: Rebellion Everywhere
strings: Rebellion Everywhere
The overburdened people rise up. With your infamy known through the empire, their anger turns to you first. They want to teach you a painful lesson.
Rebellious Mobs
You can choose to place a Stone Conquest Card or the Intent to Rebel.
Followers with strong Physique and Combat skills are better suited for the battlefield.
If you have any troops, you can assemble them.
Certain consumables can come in handy in combat.
You can place a Conquest Card, place a Conviction of rebellion, or do nothing, each leading to a different outcome.
Failure of the Ritual will not result in death, but if left unaddressed, you will be executed by the Sultan.
Can you quell this rebellion?
The number of dice provided by your Combat and Physique is affected by the enemy's Combat.
You need at least 3 Successes to win.
You suffer a crushing defeat
You easily exterminate them
You secretly negotiate with them

Their rage and hatred propel them, ferocious, unstoppable. They crash against your forces, scattering your men, forcing you to gather what remains of your troops and scramble back toward the nearest city.

Fortunately, the garrison is alerted and intervenes, cutting a path through the chaos. You live, barely.

In the months that follow, people watch you differently. There is mockery in their eyes.
No matter how much those mobs hated you, they were just a band of mob. You quelled this insignificant rebellion, slaughtering the peasants who refused to behave, and broke a Stone Conquest Card.

You crushed the rebellious mob and captured their leader alive.
You explained to them how difficult your recent time had been and that all you did was out of necessity. More importantly, you now share a common goal: overthrowing the Sultan's rule.
He is skeptical of your words but aware that his cause is lost. If you truly intend to rebel, he is willing to join you.
Unfortunately, they refused surrender, forcing you to eliminate them completely.

5000680.title: Fardak's Friendship
strings: Fardak's Friendship
Your support has earned you the friendship of Fardak, who is determined to follow you. Before that, you can discuss your Convictions with him.
Fardak wants to follow in your footsteps.
You can share your Convictions with him.
You can choose to insert a Conviction related to rebellion or the Cult.
Even if you do nothing and talk about nothing, the Royal Hostage will become your ally.
Share Fear
Share Aspiration
Share Risk
Share Achievement
And the Cost?

You share your Fear of the Sultan with Fardak, who deeply resonates with it. Because of a prank by the Sultan, he almost lost his life on his first day at court! Fortunately, you were merciful and generous, and helped solve the problems in his territory. Now, he is willing to become your Follower, carrying out your commands until the end of his days.

You tell Fardak that we might need to rid ourselves of the Sultan... He resonates deeply with this. Due to the Sultan's whimsiness, he nearly lost his life the very first day he was presented! Fortunately, in your mercy and generosity, you helped solve the dilemmas of his territory. Now, he is willing to become your follower, ready for your command, with unwavering loyalty rued only be death.

You share your treasonous intentions with Fardak, who strongly approves of it. Because of a prank by the Sultan, he almost lost his life on his first day at court! Fortunately, you were merciful and generous, and helped solve the problems in his territory. Now, he is willing to become your Follower, fighting for your cause until the end of his days.

You inform Fardak of your regicide plot, who strongly approves of it. Because of a prank by the Sultan, he almost lost his life on his first day at court! Fortunately, you were merciful and generous, and helped solve the problems in his territory. Now, he is willing to become your Follower, helping you perfect the plan to slay the mad tyrant.
You promised Fardak the possibility of saving his people with divine power, defeating the Sultan, and attaining happiness... He accepted the Darkness you unleashed without much hesitation.
You shared your beliefs with Fardak, but he seems slightly distracted. Nevertheless, he is determined to be your follower, to repay your previous assistance.

strings: Building Underground Channels

5000683.title: Silent Departure
strings: Silent Departure
You hear that Manar set out again... This time without seeking any sponsorship, leaving with nothing but a camel.
Manar has left.
Manar left alone.

You hear no more of Manar. Perhaps she is dead. Perhaps she has found a way to break free, to rebel against all of this. Do you still think of her in the restless hours before dawn – the girl who once walked at your side through adventures and perils? Or will you, like all the others, distracted by fairer women, stranger games, wealth more worth seizing, and finally, forget her name?

5000684.title: Testing the Blade
strings: Testing the Blade
Since Qais is courting death, you might as well oblige him.
Qais is waiting for you to prove yourself.
You must use a Bloodshed card of Silver tier or lower to absolve yourself.
You must place a Bloodshed Card of Silver tier or lower.
After waiting for three days, Qais did not encounter your blade. He mocked your incompetence, and people gossiped about it. For a long time, no one took your words seriously.
You kill Qais

Without any resistance, Qais watched as your blade pierced his chest, as if he had understood everything. He had long known how deeply this game would twist a person's heart.

You informed the Sultan of your decision and publicly break the Bloodshed Card. The Sultan laughed heartily, praising you, 'Good, very good! You've drawn the card that suits him for me!'

5000685.title: Field Investigation
strings: Field Investigation

The maid has given you a lead. You begin your investigation. First, you must trace the path the tax collector’s wife and child took on their journey home. Where did they go? Where did they vanish? You decide to send your people to walk the same road, to conduct a field investigation.
You can investigate personally or send a follower.You can conduct the investigation yourself or send a follower
Some consumables might come in handy during the investigation
This tracking investigation will last for 7 days. Please choose your investigators carefully.
If failed, the investigation may be restarted. But there is a possibility of alerting the culprit and losing the lead for good.
[s1.name] unfolds the map, hoping to find clues to the lady's whereabouts...
Your Survival determines your full dice count.
You need at least 2 Successes to gain something.
The maid who sought your help waited for three days, hoping you would take action, but she was destined to be disappointed.
Given our current [Survival] abilities, let’s not waste time.
If we have the support of [Intelligence], we will have a better chance of winning.
Mission accomplished
Next time for sure!
There's no more chance.
Discovery
You look around in confusion

Through a relentless investigation, [s1.name] discovers records of the Tax Collector’s wife and children passing through a way station – the station is very close to her parents’ city. After that, they vanished. It seems she left the city safely. If the Tax Collector had murdered her, he would have done it earlier, before she was so far out of the city...
Nothing is found. Try again next time.
Nothing is found. It has been too long... You can no longer find any clue of value.

5000686.title: Preliminary Investigation
strings: Preliminary Investigation
The lady must have returned to her hometown after leaving the way station. That much is certain. But why has no one seen her? You decide to take your investigation to the city.
You can investigate personally or send a follower.You can conduct the investigation yourself or send a follower
You can assist in the investigation personally or send a follower.
3 Gold Coins to fund the investigation.
Some consumables might come in handy during the investigation
Even if you fail, you can try again
No one admits to seeing the lady. Some even flee your questions like startled prey. But you notice the flickering of glances... They are hiding something.
Your Sociability and Charisma determine your full dice count.
You need at least 5 Successes to gain something.
With our current [Sociability] and [Charisma] abilities, it's a waste of time.
With our current abilities, trying to get results will rely solely on luck.
If we have the support of [Intelligence], we will have a better chance of winning.
Mission accomplished
They must be hiding something...
Excellent communication skills pay off
It seems the people here do not trust outsiders

Finally, [s1.name] pries information out of an urchin. Squatting indifferently in the corner, the urchin says, "I saw the lady come back, yeah, with a little one ‘bout yay high, right? Lives up in the Governor’s mansion, she does. I even heard ‘em at it that night, arguin’ loud. Next thing I know, the Governor says no one’s to breathe a word of it. See, most folk round here can’t so much as lift a finger without his say-so – everyone’s dependin’ on him for their bread. But me? I got nothin’ to lose. Ain’t had a proper bite in days..." he shrugs and asks you, "you from the big city, ain’t ya? Could you boot ‘im out, maybe? That Governor’s right harsh. Folk ‘round here’s barely better off than me, farmin’ just to go hungry."
[s1.name] buys him some buns in appreciation. It seems a new suspect has emerged in this case.

[s1.name] keeps pressing for answers. Eventually, it reaches the point where [s1.gender] needs only to step forward, and the crowd falls quiet and scatters. Something is clearly wrong. Something is up here.

5000687.title: In Depth Investigation
strings: In Depth Investigation

Qais accompanies you to the governor's mansion in the city. He takes out the search warrant prepared in advance, demanding an investigation. However, the aged governor firmly states that you have no right to search their mansion on such ridiculous grounds, while the old lady tearfully rebukes Qais, lamenting that she has already lost her daughter, and instead of catching the criminal, incompetent officials come bother the innocent. She is the victim's mother!

Qais, unable to handle such a scene, looks at you helplessly. You sigh. It seems that you a Conquest Card: an irrefutable proof to your rights to act as you please, granted by the Sultan himself.
Qais is willing to assist you in the investigation.
You can delve deeper into the investigation yourself, or send a follower.
You can assist in the investigation personally or send a follower.
Some consumables may come in handy during the investigation.
You must use a Conquest Card to prove you have the right to interfere.
Even if you fail, you can try again
You need to prepare a Conquest Card of Silver quality or lower.

The two elders stare at the card in your hand, depicting royal power. They look at each other, then, at last, they sink back into their seats, hands trembling, eyes full of reluctant understanding. They cannot stop you now. You give Qais a slight nod. Now, the interrogation begins. Can you uncover the truth?
Your Sociability and Wisdom provide you with the full dice count.
You need at least 5 Successes to uncover the truth.
Given our current [Sociability] and [Wisdom], let's not waste time.
With our current abilities, trying to get results will rely solely on luck.
If we have the support of [Intelligence], we will have a better chance of winning.
Thanks to you...
We'll just have to come back next time
Your collaboration has uncovered the truth
The people here are fearful of something

At first, the servants cower before their master’s shadow. But you soothe them, and at last, truth spills forth.

With their help, you find the boy first – hidden in a cellar, pale and numb, his eyes hollowed by fear. Then, in the garden, you find the woman’s body, buried deep. Irrefutable evidence. The elders attempt to protest, but in the end, they crumble.

It began as a quarrel. The daughter, fresh from her journey, refused to surrender her dowry to prop up the family’s failing ventures. Heated words were exchanged. Then threats. She swore she would tell her husband, the tax collector. Her father’s fury flared. He pushed her. She fell. Her temple hit the corner of the table...

"Leave the rest to me." Qais gathers the poor boy in his arms, holding him close for some time, and finally murmurs, "Thank you."
The servants refuse to speak, fearful of their master's might. You search every inch of the estate, yet find nothing.

5000688.title: Inspiring Qais
strings: Inspiring Qais

Qais visits you again, seemingly eager to confide in you. He has arrested the true culprit, reuniting the man with his child. Through the investigation, he acknowledges his narrow-mindedness and believes that you are still the same: upright and kindhearted. Even though you are a player in the Sultan’s Game, he trusts that you will use your position for good rather than harm. Thus, he is willing to serve you with devotion.
Qais
Appropriate Convictions, or do nothing
Placing the appropriate Convictions can change some details.
Revealing His True Concern
Perhaps You Don't Have to Suffer
The Sultan Deserves Death
You Have Planned Everything
Unexpected Blueprint
The Time Hasn't Come
He Swore to Follow You
He admits to you that he cannot respect his Sultan at all... only fear. You smile and assured him of how similarly you feel.
Why be a suffering advisor? Why not be a joyful rebel instead? Qais is amused by this alluring temptation.
After you finished speaking, he was startled, but then he thought carefully... Finally, he nodded emphatically: you are right.
Qais is eager to be part of the plan, even at the cost of his life!
You articulated a magnificent vision - a future shaped by common people rather than capricious monarchs. Qais found himself profoundly moved...

You discuss familiar topics with him: the Court, precedents, laws... However, when trying to steer the conversation towards deeper darkness, his eyebrows knit in caution, eyeing you suspiciously. 
You laugh it off as a joke. Seems now is not the time.
You exchanged vows, fine wine, unleavened bread, and salt. This tradition has fallen out of favor, but Qais' belief in such practice yet remains.

5000701.title: Impulse of Adventure
strings: Impulse of Adventure
Jabal, a warrior under the Sultan, is obsessed with the treasures and adventures depicted in ancient maps. He is an eccentric among nobles. Now, he comes to your home, seeking a companion.
The Reckless General.
Accept
Mock him.
Reject
Receive him with an Ally, but you can only trigger one option.
Please give a clear response.

His dreams of adventuring are reckless, expensive, and fraught with peril. But they are also one of the few ways you can shift your gaze beyond this city.

To flee its tangled web of power and hunger, to chase the unknown – what better choice could there be?
His smile is unclouded. His dreams stretch farther than the horizon, bright and searing as the sun. They hurt to look at. So you do your best – to mock his ambitions and scorn his family’s legacy.
You no longer have the energy for such unrealistic adventures... Dreams are for the fortunate, and you are struggling just to survive.

5000702.title: Boundless Sands
strings: Boundless Sands

According to the ancient maps passed down through Jabal's family, there is a fertile oasis in the middle of the great desert, untouched by civilization. To venture deeper into the unknown, it is necessary to stop by this oasis, with its lush forest and gentle lake, for supply.
Will the adventurous general come here this time?
The party's guide, needs at least 4 in Survival.
Warrior to deal with beasts and bandits, needs at least 4 in Combat.
A sage capable of map charting, constellations reading, and distinguishing ancient sites, requires Wisdom of 4 or higher.
You must spend 5 Gold Coins to fund the expedition.
These will yet prove its uses within your adventures.
The Beginning of Adventure
It will take a long time. Please be prepared.
Each position requires different Attributes, but the expedition's success depends on Survival and Physique.
Cross the desert. Establish a base.
Your Physique and Survival determine your full dice count.
You need at least 10 Successes to reach the destination.
Success!
The expedition fails to reach its goal

The adventure party has returned. They encountered sand raiders, giant scorpions, terrifying quicksand, wolf packs... not to mention the scorching heat by day and the bone-chilling cold by night, along with hunger and thirst...

But it was all worth it. They describe the sweet spring water, the verdant forest, and the golden morning sunlight... a sacred and beautiful sanctuary that can be passed down to the generations to come, unknown to the Sultan, far away from his tyranny.

The expedition exhausted their water and food supplies to march towards the very edge of the desert... to find no oasis at all. Perhaps it never existed? Could there truly be a land of such bliss in the world?

5000703.title: Canyon of Gales
strings: Canyon of Gales

Ancient people used magic and terrain to shape the ruins here. It is perpetually windy, and the entrance of the canyon is filled with flying sand and pebbles. Statues of griffins and snakes flank the canyon, suggesting the challenges adventurers will face...
After hearty discussion, you decide to cooperate to escort Jabal to the treasure site at the end of the canyon... if his ancestral notes are not lying, there will be a treasure.
Will the adventurous general come here this time?
You need at least 5 in Magic to part the storm and protect the expedition.
An archer, to handle lurking beasts.
A crafty adventurer with at least 4 in Survival, to handle unexpected dangers.
Someone strong enough to endure the storm, with at least 4 in Physique.
Consumable
The Beginning of Adventure
Failure may lead to death.
Requires a variety of talents.
Magic to part the storm.
Combat prowess to shoot down the griffin.
A sacrifice to distract the snake swarm.
To barge through the storm.

[s4.name]'s Wisdom and Survival determine your full dice count.
