It is a fair price, and you agree.

5000759.title: Expected Buyer
strings: Expected Buyer
Jabal visits

Jabal comes to you, laughing loudly, with the carefully cleaned and preserved giant wolf head in his hand.

"Bharat came to me trying to sell this thing, saying it was your kill. Who would've thought it'd end up back in my hands? This is just too funny! But no worries, I like the head; I've already prepared a marble wall in my house, just for this head!"

He doesn't reveal how much Bharat made from the deal... but all in all, he seems quite pleased with his new collection.

5000760.title: A pugilist in the dark alley?
strings: A pugilist in the dark alley?

In the unregulated dark alley, bloody brawls take place every day. On the streets, the stakes are lives, but here, in the underground fighting pit, the air is thick with the clash of gold coins and scams.
You must attend the appointment in person.
Carrying a few things just in case is always wise.
If you ever fought him...
You try to identify this pugilist.
In the dark alleys, you believe you are following him unnoticed...
Your Sociability and Wisdom provide you with the full dice count.
Your Stealth determines your full dice count.
You need 3 Successes to identify him.
You need 2 Successes to track him.
You missed today's match, but you can watch next time.
You arrive at this underground fighting arena.
You simply can't figure out who he is.
It's HIM!
You gave yourself away.
The pugilist doesn't discover you.

As you step through the door, the crowd erupts in thunderous cheers. A new pugilist is pounding his opponent into the ground, each strike brutal yet precise, displaying raw, beautiful power.

You fold your arms to watch, but find yourself straightening up almost instantly. There's good reason – something about the pugilist's form seems strangely familiar...

A flash of insight crosses your mind, but slips away before you can grasp it. While you're lost in thought, the pugilist slips away from the arena amid the cheers, disappearing into the shadows... It looks like you'll have to try your luck next time.

Though he hides most of his face behind a mask and wears tattered clothes, the sheen of fine oil on his skin, his gait, and his fighting style... all betray his identity. You are certain – this man is one of the Sultan's Iron Guards! But why would he be here, fighting in the dark alley?

Lost in thought, you watch as the fighter leaves among the cheers, and you quietly follow him.

The fighter suddenly turns into a side alley, and you hurry after him. 
However, the moment you step into a dark lane, something strikes you hard from behind...
"You think you can follow me? You're far too green for that!" That is the last thing you hear before everything goes black.

He passes through the dirty, muddy slums and slips past a few bustling brothels, but the women fail to slow him down.
You keep following him, step by step, until he reaches the edge of the noble district...
To avoid drawing attention, perhaps, he has his carriage waiting for him nearby. The carriage, far too luxurious for the dark alley, would have caused a sensation if seen there. Then you see him remove the mask from his face and accept a silk robe handed to him by a servant.
Hidden in the shadows, you watch as the Captain of the Sultan's Iron Guard, the empire's general, the illustrious Lord Jabal, steps into the carriage.
As the carriage rolls away, you pick up the mask he has left behind. A perfect leverage, something worth exploiting... you realize this instantly.

5000761.title: You wouldn’t want anyone else to know, would you?
strings: You wouldn’t want anyone else to know, would you?
You hold Jabal’s leftover mask, ready to have a serious talk with him.
Jabal still doesn’t know why you’re looking for him.
You plan to demand money from him.
You hope he publicly supports you.
You hope he becomes your ally.
Inserting Pugilist's Proof into certain slot to select corresponding route.
You must choose a way to handle it.
You suddenly remembered something for today, so forget it, spare him for now.
You hold this mask and demand a hefty sum from him.
You hold this mask, hoping he publicly supports you.
You hold this mask, hoping he becomes your ally.

"This is the simplest way to settle things," he laughs, unbuckling his sword and tossing it to you. "I'll take the mask. That fighting arena was great fun, but it seems I won't be able to go back there anymore."

He turns and walks away, leaving you holding the sword, weighing whether it had all been worth it.

"I'm not very good at scheming in front of the Sultan, but..." he scratches his head. "If this is what you ask of me, I'll do my best to support you."

"Well then, I'll take the mask. That fighting arena was great fun, but it seems I won't be able to go back there anymore." With a trace of regret in his eyes, he gives you a nod before turning to leave.

Jabal seems a little bit surprised by your request.

"A companion? Me? I'm a general, after all, and the head of the Sultan's Iron Guard..."

He scratches his head awkwardly.

"Still, well, alright. If you can use me, I could certainly use an ally in the court." He extends his calloused hand and shakes yours firmly.

"If I visit the fighting arena again, do me a favor and pretend you don't see me. Serving the Sultan isn't exactly a cheerful job... I need some harmless distractions, don't I? And if something more thrilling than fighting comes along, I might even promise never to return there."

He suddenly smiles and gives your shoulder a hearty pat.

"If we meet there next time, I'll be your 'companion.'"

5000762.title: Public Brawl
strings: Public Brawl
If you still remember your promise with Jabal, you should find him in the underground fighting arena, despite the suffocating smoke, the raw violence, and the crude clamor that fills the place.
Jabal should be here, right?
You must do it yourself.
Some intelligence could help in combats.
It will be a fair fight. Only Intelligence will help you.
If you miss this opportunity, Jabal will no longer join your team.
You step forward to accept this fight.
The number of dice that your Physique and Combat provide you with in battle is affected by Jabal.
You need 3 in Success to defeat Jabal in the fight.

Lately, you've been exhausted from running around, always feeling like you've forgotten something – until you met Jabal again in the court, and he gave you a slow, sly smile.
Damn, you don't have another mask to blackmail him with now!
You showed up as promised.
You won
You lost

When you push through the crowd, he is on the stage, beating his opponent into a bloody pulp and tossing him to the ground like a rag.Spotting you instantly, he suddenly shouts in your direction,
"Hey, you over there! Want to fight me? If you win, I'll double the prize and give it all to you!"
Ha... This guy must have been itching to fight you for a while.

You knock Jabal to the ground and throw a punch, as if you are about to end his life – he closes his eyes, resigned to his fate – only for you to pull him up, laughing as you pat his shoulder.

Jabal's bloody face freezes for a moment, then he bursts into laughter as well.

The two of you slap each other and tell crude jokes, while the audience applauds.

From this moment on, you have truly become Jabal's "ally."

He slams you to the ground and vents his frustration by landing several punches squarely on your face. Only when the referee pulls him off does he finally let you go, satisfied.
"Looks like I'm still the better fighter!" he boasts, twisting his wrist with a smug grin.
Holding your nose, you nod in defeat and slink back home. Your servants barely recognize you. Just when you think Jabal has completely humiliated you, he appears unexpectedly under your roof, gives you a nod, and says, "Alright tell me what you need me to do."
It seems, after all, he has become your "ally."

5000763.title: Making a name in the dark alley
strings: Making a name in the dark alley
Getting famous is easy! Just claim you killed the famous fighter!
Pugilist's Proof
Really?
People stare at the mask in your hand with suspicion. But in the end, the fighter never returns... and your reputation soars to new heights!

5000764.title: Someone is preparing to challenge you
strings: Someone is preparing to challenge you
A prostitute was killed by you in the House of Pleasure, and her lover, her confidant – and also the most dashing swordsman in the capital: Nabhani – is determined to avenge her.
Nabhani is preparing
Resolve of Revenge
After 5 rounds, he'll formally propose a duel to you.
By then, his resolve and himself will become one.
He makes up his mind and draws his dust-covered sword, coming to you.

5000765.title: Guardian
strings: Guardian

You fell an insignificant wench – still, although the rules of the Sultan's Game protect you, Nabhani mourns her still. He demands a duel to the death with God as witness, vowing revenge for his friend.
You've seen fools dueling for a prostitute's body or favor, but this is the first time you've seen someone duel for a prostitute's life.
You may fight the battle yourself, or choose a noble follower to fight on your behalf.
You can take this to break a Bloodshed Card that matches the Challenger's tier
Certain items can be useful in combats.
You can send a agent to duel for you.
If you fail, either you or your agent will be killed
Placing a Bloodshed Card means you will kill Nabhani too.
If no Sultan Card is placed, it usually means sparing his life
Sometimes, evading is also an option
Draw your sword.
The number of dice provided by your Physique and Combat is affected by the enemy's corresponding attributes.
You need at least 3 Successes to win the duel.
You should realize that with your current [Physique] and [Combat], it's nothing but suicide.
If we have the support of [Intelligence], we will have a better chance of winning.
You should realize that with your current [Physique] and [Combat] abilities, you are simply seeking death.
The most handsome swordsman in the capital has died, his eyes full of resentment. But his last words were: I pity your soul, poor friend.
The most handsome swordsman in the capital has died, his eyes full of resentment, looking in your direction, whispering... The onlookers are too noisy, you can't hear...

You strike his sword from his hand and corner him in the arena. The crowd roars – half shouting for you to kill him, half begging him to surrender. 

“However you wish to mourn her, it ends here.” you tell Nabhani. “She might be pleased to see you fight for her, but if you die here, she will still weep.” 

Thus, you turn your back to the avenger...
And as you reach the edge of the arena, he admits his defeat.

Your fighter placed the blade against Nabhani's neck, a neck longed for by countless noblewomen... The spectators are shouting, they crave romantic blood, and this unparalleled swordsman should die for love in the arena.
But you always love to go against the tide, you raised your hands in a gesture of forgiveness and left the scene amid everyone's surprised gazes.
His blade pierced through your heart, you saw sympathy in his eyes, you heard him praying for your soul, you heard the crowd cheering... but everything became blurred.

He killed your warrior, instantly turning away, apparently abhorring the crowd. 
At least for you, it's over, though from now, you've lost a friend and gained an enemy in the court.
Nabhani spits on you, people despise you, and from now on, in the palace, you lose a friend and gain an enemy.

You listed Nabhani's various misdeeds with venomous words, forcibly arguing that the death of the Lady of Delights was also tied to him. If they were truly friends, why was she still serving clients at the House of Delights?

Nabhani was briefly stunned by your words, and you seized this fleeting flaw to pierce his pitiful heart. It seems that even in death, the self-doubt and disdain in his eyes did not fade.

You listed Nabhani's various misdeeds with venomous words, forcibly arguing that the death of the Lady of Delights was also tied to him. If they were truly friends, why was she still serving clients at the House of Delights? Nabhani was briefly stunned by your words, and you seized this fleeting flaw to hit him down, stepped on his chest, announced your own victory.
The loser didn't notice you, his eyes were full of self-doubt and disdain, he was speakless...

You have applied poison to your weapon. With that, only a small cut is needed, and then it's just a matter of time!
Men will speak of Nabhani's death with pity. To die for a lowborn whore, and by such dishonorable means... what a disgrace to his noble name.

Even though you didn't want to kill him, a poisoned weapon does not give you a chance to hesitate! The noble guard died for a prostitute under such despicable means, but will there be any prostitute to offer him a bouquet of flowers?

5000766.title: Lie Low
strings: Lie Low
Although Nabhani does not think he did anything wrong, under the current circumstances, he has no choice but to stay home and lay low.
Nabhani
He will be back in a few days.
After a few days, Nabhani is active in the city again. Of course, before that, he first comes to your doorstep to see if there's anything you need help with.

5000767.title: Exhibition of Flesh
strings: Exhibition of Flesh
Three female slaves are tied behind the slaver, standing in a row for customers to choose from. You can join Nabhani's pastime, pay half the price, select one to buy, and then set her free.
The skin of this female slave is marked with the tattoos of a barbarian warrior, painting upon her a defiant look.
The female slave's large violet eyes are filled with tears, garnering a banquet of opinions: beautiful, delicate, and pitiful.
This female slave has a calm expression. Her calloused hands as though a bard: telling the tale of her timeless toils working as a craftsman.
Nabhani is enthusiastic
You can use this opportunity to break an Extravagance Card of no higher than the Slave tier
Purchase a barbarian slave girl for 3 Gold Coins, or place in 6 Gold Coins to break an Extravagance Card
Purchase a fragile slave girl for 3 Gold Coins, or place in 6 Gold Coins to break an Extravagance Card
Purchase a talented slave girl for 3 Gold Coins, or place in 6 Gold Coins to break an Extravagance Card
Purchase one for 3 Gold Coins, or place in 6 Gold Coins to break an Extravagance Card.
You can buy only one. Of course, you might choose not to place any Gold Coins, refusing the transaction.
You casually agreed, then forgot about it, leaving Nabhani behind, which made him a bit angry.
You propose buying the barbarian female slave.
You propose buying the fragile slave girl
You bought the female artisan.

After a hand-to-hand exchange, the female slave is brought before you both. Even as her owners, her gaze remains defiant, like a wild wolf.

"You are free," Nabhani says. "The gentleman and I have bought you, and we plan to set you free."

"If you need a job, you can also come to me," you add, observing her sturdy muscles. Hearing this, Nabhani laughs heartily and playfully bumps you: "A job? Women don’t need jobs; you want her to find you to take another wife?"

You look speaklessly at his handsome, privileged profile, and his prestigious attire that attracts attention yet nobody dares question. Nabhani has his own definition of kindness; perhaps the good intentions he spreads to girls are genuine, but...

While you talk, the barbarian girl hesitates no longer, decisively turning to escape, vanishing into the crowd in an instant.

"What will she do? Meet someone, then marry and have a child?" Nabhani smiles with interest. "I hope I won’t see her in a brothel — I've indeed seen ladies I rescued there."

The slaver smiles as he unties the ropes binding the girl's hands, keeping praising: "You have such excellent taste! She was born in a brothel and has been trained in the full range of skills since childhood – you know what I mean! You've really gotten yourself a bargain this time!"

Nabhani is always especially gentle with such frail and beautiful girls. "My dear, you are free now," he says, personally removing her shackles. "I'll burn your slave papers and restore your status as a free person. You're free to live as you wish."

"But… but…" The girl's wide, desperate eyes seem to tremble as she kneels on the ground, clutching his robes with trembling hands. "Please, don't abandon me… I...I don't want a free life… I want you to own me! Let me serve you! I… I beg you!"

Nabhani looks a bit awkward, clearly uncomfortable. He glances at the slave girl you both paid for, then at you: "What do you think?"

You pay the money, and then Nabhani tears the slave papers to pieces right in front of the craftswoman.
"From now on, you're your own master, my dear…" He glances at the name written on the torn pieces of the slave papers. "Habunah, this esteemed [player.name] and I have bought you for one purpose – to set you free."
Habunah's eyes widen as she stares at the two of you in shock. Then, she smiles with relief, her expression brimming with joy and ease.
"This is wonderful… it's unimaginable luck! Freedom – oh, heavens, I'm free again!"
She drops to her knees, pressing fervent kisses to your feet in gratitude.
"If it pleases you both, I'd like to start anew right away. I'll find a shop that offers credit, and then get some fabric and thread…" Habunah speaks quickly, already planning her future.
Both of you gladly give her blessings.
I hate this kind of deal.

You shake your head in disgust, telling him that you hate this kind of deal. Treating people like pieces of meat in the market is truly revolting. 

He lets out a mocking laugh. "Such hypocrisy! Your own mansion runs on slave labor. Or have you forgotten the women who scrub your marble floors on their hands and knees?"

He gestures to the palest-skinned slave and counts out his coins. This little pastime isn't exactly enjoyable, but it does deepen your understanding of each other.
You tell Nabhani you'll pay the full amount, he smiles at your Extravagance Card, not preventing your generosity.

5000768.title: Slave Trade
strings: Slave Trade
You choose the delicate pretty girl.
Delicate Pretty Girl
3 gold coins sufficient, placing 6 can break an extravagance card.
You can use this opportunity to break an Extravagance Card of no higher than the Slave tier
You casually agreed, then forgot about it, leaving Nabhani behind, which made him a bit angry.
You bought the delicate pretty girl.

"My dear, you're free now," Nabhani says gently, unfastening her shackles. "I'll burn your slave papers and restore your status as a free person."

"But... but..." The girl's eyes widen in horror. "I don't want a free life – I want you to buy me! I want to serve you! Please... don't abandon me!"

The slaver explains that the girl was born in a brothel somewhere and had been trained in the ways of the Girl of Delight since childhood. It was her own mother who handed her over to the slaver...

Nabhani seems a bit embarrassed. He glances at you, then back at the girl.
You tell Nabhani you'll pay the full amount, he smiles at your Extravagance Card, not preventing your generosity.

5000769.title: Slave Trade
strings: Slave Trade
You choose the female artisan.
Delicate Pretty Girl
3 gold coins sufficient, placing 6 can break an extravagance card.
You can use this opportunity to break an Extravagance Card of no higher than the Slave tier
You casually agreed, then forgot about it, leaving Nabhani behind, which made him a bit angry.
You bought the female artisan.

After you pay the money, Nabhani tears the slave papers to pieces in front of the craftswoman.
"You don't need a master anymore, my dear..." He glances at the torn pieces of paper. "Habunah, [player.name] and I bought you just to set you free."
Habunah's eyes widen as she looks at the two of you in shock. Then, she smiles with relief, her expression filled with joy and liberation.
"This is wonderful... I can't believe my luck. Freedom – oh heavens, I'm free!"
She kneels down and kisses both of your feet in turn.
"Now, if you'll permit me, I'd like to leave. I need to find a shop willing to extend me credit, then get some fabric and thread..." Habunah says quickly, already planning her next steps.
You both give her your blessing.
You tell Nabhani you'll pay the full amount, he smiles at your Extravagance Card, not preventing your generosity.

5000770.title: Midnight Visitor
strings: Midnight Visitor

Midnight commotion erupted in your courtyard - investigating, you discovered your guards restraining a struggling slave girl. Her tattered wrappings showed fire damage, while strange barbarian markings covered her dirt and blood-stained ebony skin. Those exhausted yet defiant eyes revealed untamed spirit. Yet questions remained - whose property was she, what caused her injuries, and why had she sought refuge in your estate?
The Escaped Slave Girl
How do you want to deal with her?
You may provide her with herbal healing or some coin to resolve her troubles
Or perhaps, you can use her to resolve the Sultan Card...
The barbarian slave girl wounded your guard during your hesitation and vanished instantly.
Gave Her Medicine
Seize Her

Her identity and past seemed irrelevant - before you stood simply a wounded soul requiring assistance. 
"Release her," you commanded, pulling your robes tighter against the night chill. "Provide her healing ointment; she clearly needs it." 
The woman violently broke free from the guards' grip, studied your face intently, then vanished swiftly into darkness. 
Stifling a yawn, you dismissed the incident as inconsequential, expecting nothing further from this brief encounter.

Runaway slaves find no paths in this city. You instruct guards to place her near the servants' quarters with clean water and food. 
"Stay until you choose to leave," you yawn. "If you wish to work for me, we'll discuss tomorrow." 
She wipes barely-dried blood from her face, raising her proud head: "Ha, work... I should thank you indeed." Despite her words, her eyes betray barely-concealed contempt. 
Predictably, by morning the guard reports her quiet departure before dawn. She used water, took food, and chopped kitchen firewood for three days - payment for your momentary shelter.

You've mastered this routine. 
A gesture commands your guards to bind and confine the person while you break a Sultan Card. Shortly thereafter, a guard hurriedly apologizes - the woman escaped. Nobody knows how she freed herself, picked locks, evaded guards and servants, vanishing completely like a water droplet in sin's ocean.

You've mastered this routine. 
A gesture commands your guards to bind and confine the person while you break a Sultan Card. Shortly thereafter, a guard hurriedly apologizes - the woman escaped. Nobody knows how she freed herself, picked locks, evaded guards and servants, vanishing completely like a water droplet in sin's ocean. 
No matter. This guard replaces the escaped slave - now everyone understands the importance of diligent service.

5000771.title: The Wanderer's Thoughts
strings: The Wanderer's Thoughts
Nabhani pondered thoughtfully...
Nabhani
Yourself
You actually dared to...

Nabhani sighed intermittently until, slightly intoxicated, he finally spoke. "I never imagined she would truly attempt something so brazen... Utterly inconceivable. I wouldn't dare express this in her presence, lest she threaten to devour my liver..." He gazed at you with uncharacteristic vulnerability, "[player.name], what drives such a woman? And what compels you to risk everything assisting her?" 
You recognized he meant Riel. His question prompted a smile: "You question my motives? What of yours? Haven't you provided equal support?" 
He frustratedly raked fingers through his meticulously groomed curls, exhaling deeply, "Precisely what confounds me. That woman embodies everything contrary to my preferences - too savage, too unrefined - what man could possibly desire such a creature? Yet I participate in your madness. Why? WHY?" He discarded his wine vessel, reclined against luxurious carpets, contemplating the moon and wind-stirred foliage in extended silence. 
Intelligence was never lacking in him - he understood the answer. Riel represented something profound: a warrior willing to sacrifice everything for freedom, embracing death without regret if necessary. Freedom... that concept that perpetually mocked and tormented him whispered contemptuous judgments through his consciousness. With sudden resolve, he unsheathed his blade, caressed its cold edge, and executed an impressive display of swordsmanship beneath moonlight. Finally, releasing a primal howl, he collapsed into wine-induced slumber. The following days marked transformation - never again did he fabricate excuses to abandon your company for solitary pleasures.

5000772.title: That Woman
strings: That Woman
As you step through the doors of the House of Delights, you bump into Nabhani on his way out. Upon seeing you, he looks slightly uncomfortable, which is rare.
Salwiyah, the girl with violet eyes
Nabhani

"Hey, remember that girl last time? The pretty one with violet eyes?" He looks at you, then sighs and gestures inside. "If you're interested, you can go spend some time with her."

You ask him, surprise indisguisable, of how a girl from his household ended up in the House of Delights.

"Ah... that girl wanted far too much. If I didn't buy her gold necklaces and silk dresses, she'd throw tantrums and cry all day..." He shakes his head helplessly. "I told her, 'You're a free woman now. If you want those things, find a job that can afford them.' And, well, she asked me to bring her here. Then, uh, she sold herself to the House of Delights. She's a slave again now."

The two of you both fall silent.

"This counts as kindness, doesn't it? It should, right? After all, she's living the life she wanted," Nabhani says, a bit confused. "It seems some people just hate freedom."

You have nothing to say, so you suggest having a drink together.

5000773.title: Dead Drunk
strings: Dead Drunk
To console Nabhani, you suggest to buy him a drink. Hearing this, he immediately requests to go to the best tavern in the city for a hearty drink.
Disheartened Nabhani
10 Gold Coins for buying drink
You forgot about it, and Nabhani no longer come looking for you.
Is there anything a good liquor can't fix?

You invited Nabhani to drink until both of you were thoroughly drunk, forgetting all gloom and displeasure. When the bill arrived the next day, you realized that all those fine drinks were so expensive!!!

You complained half-heartedly to Nabhani about it, and he rubbed his hungover face, swearing that he would definitely try his best to help you...

Your wallet can only hope he follow through with his word.

5000774.title: A New Girl to the House of Delights
strings: A New Girl to the House of Delights

It is said that there is a newcomer in the House of Delights, rumored to be charming, beautiful, delicate, with violet eyes forever filled with tears. Additionally, she is skilled in thirty gestures, each pose enjoyable...
New Lady of Delights

Nabhani wouldn't miss such a thing. He already found out before you that the newcomer is the girl you once bought and set free, named Salwiyah, and as you can see, she has sold herself into slavery again.

"This counts as kindness, doesn't it? It should, right? After all, she's living the life she wanted," Nabhani says, frowning and somewhat confused. "It seems some people just hate freedom."

He pauses and sighs again. "Well, it's not uncommon."

5000775.title: The Wanderer's Thoughts
strings: The Wanderer's Thoughts
Nabhani rarely shows a serious expression. He tells you he wants to have a serious talk with you about something.
Nabhani is deep in thought
You must receive him personally
The Meaning of Freedom

The matter of Salwiyah has lingered in Nabhani's mind. Despite often encountering similar situations before: rescued girls soon becoming Lady of Delights again, returning to that miserable, exploited state.

“But why is it like this?” he frowned, perplexed.

You sighed, telling Nabhani that perhaps they simply don't understand what freedom truly means, or how to live freely once they have it. What work can they do, how can they support themselves, how can they protect themselves and their belongings? If our city does not provide these securities, so-called freedom is merely a castle in the air, vulnerable to collapse at any moment. Think, if a delicate, beautiful girl falls to the streets, kidnapped by villains... her fate might be worse than it is now.

Nabhani pondered, mulling over this for a while before sighing. “It seems I haven’t done enough, far from enough...” He looked at you, clinked glasses without saying much, but from then on, he came to your door every day, no longer finding excuses to indulge himself frivolously.

5000776.title: Not on Purpose
strings: Not on Purpose
The incident of you scolding Salwiyah to tears quickly spread among the servants...
Perhaps your wife once resented you

Soon, Maggie also heard about it. She casually asks you about the incident. You quickly swear and declare your loyalty, saying you only bring her home because she seems pitiful and you are short-handed, and you absolutely have no improper thoughts... The indulgence at home was truly a last resort. In your heart, Maggie is the best! That's beyond doubt!
You continue with a heap of reassuring words, and your wife listens indifferently, not knowing if she believes you. But at least she is less resentful.

5000777.title: Luxurious Joy
strings: Luxurious Joy
Salwiyah cheers and hugs your neck tightly, eagerly anticipating the expensive gift made of gold that you promised her.
Salwiyah wants to dress herself up well
A large sum of money: at least 15 Gold Coins

She looks quite upset, the pitiful look from the slave market vanished, now resembling that of a hungry snake.

Perhaps she is already planning something else in her mind.
You fulfilled her demands

After getting the coins, Salwiyah excitedly summons a large number of silk and jewelry merchants. One side of your mansion is a hot shopping session, the other side... or rather all the other women, from the wife, to the maids, are quite cold to you.

Salwiyah doesn't care about any of that, nor does she care much about you. She only cares if her nails look good, if her eye makeup is the trendiest, and if her jewels are larger than any other woman's.

What's undeniable is that she indeed becomes more beautiful.

5000778.title: Things have settled down at last
strings: Things have settled down at last
At last, things have settled down at home.
Wife's Resentment
Your wife's furrowed brows have finally relaxed lately.

5000779.title: Unfulfilled Desires
strings: Unfulfilled Desires
Salwiyah requests you to prepare a separate courtyard for her so that she can become the real mistress there, and do everything she wants. She is done with living with your wife.
Salwiyah wants more... more...
Salwiyah wants you to offer her a separated courtyard
You can take this opportunity to break a Extravagance Card up to the tier of Vacant House
You failed to satisfy Salwiyah's needs, and she no longer wishes to serve you, an incompetent person.
You prepared a mansion for Salwiyah

She flutters happily through the empty mansion like a butterfly, directing the servants to help her make the place comfortable and luxurious. Finally, she tenderly kisses your cheek and pulls you into the bedchamber... Without the bothersome mistress around, she has never moaned with such passion, such volume.

Giving a precious courtyard to a slave girl – well, a bought-back slave, is such an absurd thing! Many people inquired about the address of it from you, wanting to know just how beautiful this woman is to deserve such a generous reward. Since you broke a Sultan Card for this, it's only natural that this matter reached Maggie's ears...

5000780.title: Another Way Out
strings: Another Way Out
Salwiyah has left your home, determined to find another path – she is a free person, and you cannot change her decision.
Salwiyah is gone without a trace

You ask the guards in detail and find out she sold herself to the House of Delights. She is not a free person anymore; she chooses to become a slave once again.

This outcome is quite sigh-inducing and leaves you feeling a helplessness almost bottomless.

5000781.title: You Know The Drill
strings: You Know The Drill
Passion, persuasion, pleasantry. The holy trinity of a man.
Aphrodisiac
Who to take It?
Actually, anyone can take it, it's good for heath.
It seems [s2.name] becomes stronger.

5000782.title: Split with
strings: Split with
A Bloodshed Card placed you and Nabhani at opposite ends of life and death. When he drew his sword, his face showed reluctance.
Nabhani
You may fight the battle yourself, or choose a noble follower to fight on your behalf.
You showed a Bloodshed Card to Nabhani
Certain items can be useful in combats.
You can dispatch an agent to duel for you.
If you fail, either you or your agent will be killed.
This is a fight to the death.
Draw your sword.
The number of dice provided by your Physique and Combat is affected by the enemy's corresponding attributes.
You need at least 3 Successes to win the duel.
You should realize that with your current [Physique] and [Combat], it's nothing but suicide.
If we have the support of [Intelligence], we will have a better chance of winning.
You should realize that with your current [Physique] and [Combat] abilities, you are simply seeking death.
The most handsome swordsman in the capital has died. His eyes, devoid of spirit, show neither joy nor sorrow, not even the slightest hint of regret.

The most handsome swordsman of the capital has died... You hear the sorrowful cries of women nearby. One can imagine his grave will not lack beautiful bouquets, so this journey to hell will surely not be a lonely one.
His blade pierced through your heart, you saw sympathy in his eyes, you heard him praying for your soul, you heard the crowd cheering... but everything became blurred.

He killed your fighter, then instantly turning away, apparently the time you two spend is a long-forgotten dream.
At least, for you, this matter is over, though from now on, you have one less friend and one more enemy in the court.

You listed Nabhani's various misdeeds with venomous words, inciting the onlookers to denounce this young Iron Guard as well. Amidst the rising tide of volume, you seized the fleeting moment of his attempted defense to fell him with a single strike. Poor fool, enjoy your time in hell.
You applied venom to your weapon; just a small cut is needed, and then victory is simply a matter of time! Poor fellow, to die by such a despicable way.

5000783.title: Hidden Jewel in the Golden House
strings: Hidden Jewel in the Golden House
Salwiyah lives in a not-so-secret property under your name, enjoying a comfortable and carefree life – of course, all thanks to the sum of money you give to her every day like a hand-me-down.
Salwiyah
You must provide 3 Gold Coins for her weekly expenses.
Every seven days, she will take 3 Gold Coins from you and provide you with 1 Notoriety.
If gold coins are not provided several times, she will leave the residence.
Salwiyah happily lives in her own house. Perhaps it's an illusion, but several times you seem to have seen strange men coming and going.
Seeing that you were unwilling to support her lavish lifestyle, Salwiyah naturally went to seek another way.

"Come on! All I need is just 3 Gold Coins!"
Salwiyah is very dissatisfied that you didn't support her.

5000784.title: Minor Trouble
strings: Minor Trouble
In your spare time, you occasionally think of the female slave you and Nabhani saved – ah, right, she is a free person now – wondering how she is living with her own skills?
Habunah is striving to maintain her life.
You can personally solve any potential problems that may arise for her, or send a follower
Certain consumables can be helpful
With sufficient Influence or Notoriety, you can resolve the issue directly.
Nobles rely on Influence, while commoners need Notoriety.
Solve the problem with Influence
Solve the problem with force
Your Sociability determines your full dice count.
Your Combat determines your full dice count.
You need at least 3 Successes to drive away the harasser.
By the time you remember Habunah after dealing with other matters, you've utterly lost contact with her.
Your influence is enough to deter rogues
[s2.name], brimming with confidence, speaking with a silver tongue
The bastard harassing her isn't buying your act at all
Your reputation in the Dark Alley is enough to deter rogues
[s2.name] Rises to Fame in a Single Battle
The bastard harassing her don't give a damn about you

A young woman trying to make a living on her own is inevitably subjected to covetous glances. However, [s2.name] uses noble authority to declare that Habunah is under your protection, and [s2.gender] tells her that if she encounters trouble, she can use your name and tell others she is working for you.

Habunah kneels again to thank you for your kindness. She presents you with a fine piece of fabric she has woven by herself. With such skills and your protection, no one would doubt her ability to gain a foothold in this neighborhood and live well.
[s2.name] announced in the name of noble authority that Habunah accepted your protection, but it lacks conviction. On a later night, Habunah disappeared, and you lost all contact with her.

You have many friends in the alleys beyond the reach of the Sultan's power. You gave Habunah some names and also told her some codes and passwords. Following these leads, those people would arrange a convenient house for her and ensure her safety.

Habunah is more than grateful to you. She presents you with a fine piece of fabric she has woven herself. With such skills, as long as she has safety and freedom, she has all it takes to obtain everything else she needs.

[s2.name] subdued several thugs who tried to harass Habunah and warned them that if they dared to come back again, it wouldn't be as simple as a few broken bones!
[s2.gender] also arranged a convenient house for Habunah and promised to protect her in your name.
Habunah is more than grateful to you. She presents you with a fine piece of fabric she has woven herself. With such skills, as long as she has safety and freedom, she has all it takes to obtain everything else she needs.

[s2.name] announced in your name that Habunah accepted your protection, but [s2.name] was knocked to the ground by the harassers. By the time you arrived with your people, Habunah was nowhere to be found.
One day in the future

After visiting Habunah, Nabhani excitedly comes to share his thoughts with you.

"She's rather ordinary-looking, but have you seen her hands? They're rough from work, yet beautiful in their own way. Oh, don't get me wrong – I've helped many women before, but something about her brings me such joy. Not the romantic kind, mind you, just pure happiness. Though there is one small problem–" Nabhani dramatically sweeps back his curls, a playful grin spreading across his face. "She didn't spare even a glance at my handsome face! Ah, never mind! Let's get a drink – it's on me today!"

5000785.title: Delicate Gift
strings: Delicate Gift
Such an Elegant Blue Gauze – who should you give it to?
Elegant Blue Gauze
You can give it to anyone
It can improve the recipient's Charisma by 1 point.
He didn't accept your gift

You keep this exquisite fabric for yourself and wrap it around your arm. Fashion-conscious people often stop you to inquire of its origin, and to make sure you don't walk away empty-handed, they also shared insight into things you didn't know.

Maggie is so delighted that she almost shouts.
"I’ve heard my neighbor’s wife talking about the finest silk in the world… And then my husband gives it to me! Oh, what could be more wonderful than this?"
Humming, she starts sewing clothes with the silk.
Nabhani hilariously tells you that Habunah also gave him a piece of equally fine fabric.
Even if you keep showing it off, it won't do any good, after all, it's a treasure that both of us have, says Nabhani.
[s2.name] thanked you for your gift and praised your generosity.

5000786.title: Freedom in Flames
strings: Freedom in Flames
A raging fire is devouring everything mercilessly – dreams, freedom, hope... everything...
Habunah is stuck in the fire
You can fight against the fire yourself, or send someone to do it
Firefighting assistant
Certain consumables can be helpful
To save people, you need to perform a Physique and Survival check.
Nabhani must be very concerned about this matter, as Habunah resides here.
To fight the fire is to save lives.
Your Physique and Survival determine your full dice count.
You need at least 5 Successes to extinguish the fire.
By the time you arrived, Habunah and many civilians had turned to ashes scattered by the wind.
Nabhani Charges Into the Flames
Calm in Command

The place on fire was Habunah's residence; lavish and grand一but whether fabric tents or golden courts, it is all the same to the fire. There is no exceptions. It mercilessly engulfed large areas of nearby low-rise housing. People running out scantily-clad and wailing, unknown blood splattering across the cherubic faces of children. Mothers futilely protecting their kins with burnt limbs, men roaring as they struggled for how little the water they are supplied with, and dogs huddled together shivering in the mud.
In the chaos, you calmly directed people to fight the fire, as everyone frantically rushed left and right, upward and down. The flames slowly died down. At this moment, Nabhani finally dashed out of the fire carrying Habunah on his back. His handsome face was smeared with soot, and much of his cherished long hair was scorched, lending him a dishelved look that blended him distraughtingly well into the background of this disasterous cacophony. Yet his eyes glowed with an unusual, furious fierceness, like a leopard – its rage an inferno a thousand time worse than the hell it just walked out of.
"I'll take her back for care; it's impossible to recuperate here peacefully," he nodded to you and said nothing more. You saw him carrying the unconscious unfortunate woman, her proud, life-bearing hands burnt to a crisp...

The place on fire was Habunah's residence; lavish and grand一but whether fabric tents or golden courts, it is all the same to the fire. There is no exceptions. It mercilessly engulfed large areas of nearby low-rise housing. People running out scantily-clad and wailing, unknown blood splattering across the cherubic faces of children. Mothers futilely protecting their kins with burnt limbs, men roaring as they struggled for how little the water they are supplied with, and dogs huddled together shivering in the mud.
In the chaos, you calmly directed people to fight the fire, as everyone frantically rushed left and right, upward and down. The flames slowly died down, and [s2.name] finally rescued the unconscious Habunah. The poor woman had already passed out, her proud, life-lorn hands were burnt to a crisp...
The fire was too fierce, and by the time it burned out, many people had vanished without a trace.

5000787.title: Visit
strings: Visit
The fire destroyed Habunah's residence and also damaged her hands... Now she is placed at Nabhani's residence, allowing you to visit her when time allows.
Habunah is recovering from her injuries
Nabhani is meticulously caring for Habunah
You must visit her in person
You can communicate certain Convictions to him
Habunah is currently under Nabhani's care, go and see her.
Here, Conviction is very useful.
You don't care about Habunah’s fate, and Nabhani never mentions her to you again.
You came to visit Habunah

Habunah lies all day in a dark room, refusing to see anyone, even refusing to eat. This poor craftswoman has lost her nimble fingers, no different than to a bird losing its wings. She no longer carry any hope to continue living.

Nabhani has already figured out the ins and outs of the accident. The fire was set by jealous neighbors envious of her business and earnings – because of Habunah, he was already on the brink of bankruptcy. It was ironic that the fire did nothing to save him, as his shop and home were on the same street destroyed by the blaze. The day after the fire was extinguished, he drowned himself in the river.
What else can one blame him for?

As Nabhani and you left Habunah's room, he gravely tells you that the Sultan had asked about Habunah a couple of days ago, curious about what kind of woman can make his Iron Guard so reckless.

"My heart is not for Habunah; yet I still find it so regrettable," Nabhani says. "She is a good woman who, with her own hands, could have lived well. We all think so, don't we? But, neither you nor I can protect her. Instead, our care put her in a more dangerous situation... where did it all go wrong?"
You couldn't give him an answer
You gave him your answer
You took the chance to manipulate him

Why are freedom and happiness so difficult to obtain and maintain? You feel sorrow so vast for the woman, her fate so wretched. But there is nothing you could say, only being able to pat Nabhani on the shoulder.

After a long silence, Nabhani shakes his head and sighed lightly, forcing a joke: "Well, at least we tried our best... It's just that I dare not wear that blue gauze belt to the court again." He put his arm around your shoulder, guiding you out the door, seemingly relaxed, "If anything comes up, just let me know. I’m not in the mood for hanging out and playing around anyway."

Why are freedom and happiness so difficult to obtain and maintain? Accompanying a piece of identity paper for free person is merely a lie of freedom – in this country, everyone is at each other's throats, tearing at one another. It is as though that is a necessity for survival here.
Even powerful courtiers and the Iron Guard like you have no freedom in front of the Sultan. Do you? You cautiously gauge his expressions, afraid to show preference for anything lest the Sultan takes it away, lest a single misstep leads to the ruin of your family. How are you different from Habunah? Aren’t the freedom and hope you have also so easily taken away?
You expressionlessly pour your thoughts onto the Sultan’s Iron Guard, even saying, "If you think I'm too presumptuous, you can just kill me here."
But the loyal guardian of the Sultan remains silent. After a while, he bitterly smiles and admits, "You're right. This country is bad, and our master is no different. Making freedom and happiness a childish and faraway dream for all, as if only such things would bring him joy." He seems to finally abandon his fantasy, abandoning his pledged vow, abandoning the self of his youth, "I once ran far away, thinking I could avoid all this, only to end up achieving nothing. Maybe trying things your way wouldn't be so bad, [player.name]. Show me what you can do."

All noble warriors undergo comprehensive training against black magic, and their practices even include building resistance to illusions, poisons, and the extremes of fire and ice... Under normal circumstances, no matter what kind of tricks you employ, Nabhani's sword would unerringly pierce your throat.

But today, he is nothing more than a mortal, bleeding from the heart. Indulgence, pleasure, and alcohol have yet to numb the pain in his soul.

Guided by your words and drawn to the purity of this noble warrior's soul, the dark power flows like fine liquor, filling Nabhani's cup. 

Out of hatred for this world and trust in you, he empties the cursed in a single draught.

5000788.title: What You Can Do
strings: What You Can Do

Habunah lay all day in a dark room, refusing to see anyone, even refusing to eat. This poor craftswoman has lost her nimble fingers, no different than to a bird losing its wings. She no longer carry any hope to continue living. You are powerless to help; perhaps only a woman can console another woman.
Habunah has fallen into despair
Who can understand her pain and bring her solace?
Habunah is now under your care, and only a woman can truly comfort another woman.
Nabhani must be very concerned about this issue.
With her last bit of strength, Habunah hanged herself.
Nabhani Knows Women Better Than They Know Themselves
Women Gather Around Habunah

Upon hearing about Habunah’s plight, Nabhani carefully held her heavily bandaged hand, nearly bursting into tears.
He constantly blamed himself – how could he not be by her side during her suffering and hardship?! Why did the Heavens punish an innocent woman instead of him? It was all his fault... He granted Habunah Freedom, encouraged her to run a fabric business, and flaunted with a blue gauze belt, almost drawing the Sultan's attention...
His heart-wrenching manner made Habunah instead try to comfort him in a panic, speaking incoherently until she burst into tears.
All the accumulated regret, frustration, and grievance were finally released in the torrent of tears.
Nabhani gently stroked her back, soothingly reassuring her that everything would pass. Even if she could no longer weave, she would surely find her other value because every woman is unique in this world.
He gave Habunah lots of support and consolation, and finally, a faint gleam returned to her eyes. In the darkness of utter despair, she saw a glimmer of perhaps achievable hope. Just like when she encountered you and Nabhani while sinking into slavery.
After this, Nabhani finally restrains his playful nature, saying that the pursuit of freedom is painful. He can not remain stagnant after encouraging Habunah.

As soon as they entered, they chased you out, and you couldn't hear a word of their chattering private conversation inside. You only knew Habunah had a good cry inside. After a few days of recuperation, the once-female weaver found you, surrounded by the women, to thank you for your care and shelter. Her hands were still bandaged, yet her eyes reignited with light, faint yet resolute, like unnoticeable yet never again extinguishable stars in the night.

The women said they promised to buy Habunah another empty house together, encouraging her to teach weaving to the servants, willing women, and even female slaves. They kept praising Habunah's excellent craftsmanship and vast experience—despite her fingers not being nimble anymore, she would undoubtedly find her own way.

You genuinely feel happy for her.

5000789.title: Weaving Classroom
strings: Weaving Classroom
Habunah has rekindled hope, resolving to open a weaving class to impart her extraordinary skills. But one person’s strength is limited. You can lend her a hand.
Habunah
An ally with Wisdom no less than 4
Running such an operation still requires the help of an ally.

More and more women come to Habunah’s weaving room, where their skills grow increasingly adept, creating ever more exquisite fabrics. They cut some flawed trial pieces or unsellable edge trims into thin strips, tying them around their waists or braiding them into their hair. They recognize each other as fellow learners easily, and people readily recognize their exceptional craftsmanship.

With the assistance of [s2.name], many hesitant girls unsure if this is a scam take their first step into the weaving room.

Habunah selflessly shares her knowledge and skills, and those girls learn and weave with all their might. You personally witness the fabrics from that classroom becoming fine and orderly, silently radiating a glow like the freedom and hope people always try to grasp but can't.

Nabhani has a way of carrying off the most flamboyant fabrics with perfect elegance – though his handsome face does most of the work. The nobles couldn't care less about that detail, eagerly copying his style all the same, and well, that's more gold flowing into your purse.

5000790.title: Blue Scarf
strings: Blue Scarf

Habunah has become a skilled teacher, and her weaving room can now run without your support – sustaining countless impoverished women and their families. These women weave the fabric into their braids and tie them on their belts, making it easy to recognize their friends among the crowd, known as Habunah’s students. It seems to give you a hint of Inspiration...
Habunah has become a skilled teacher
You need to handle this in person
Appropriate Conviction.
Maybe you didn't really care about this matter, and then you missed it.
Your Blue Color, the Blue of Freedom and Hope

Under your instruction, a batch of inexpensive blue gauze spread among the commoners, accompanied by some unspoken rumors. You can often see people tied with blue gauze in the slums meeting by chance, exchanging friendly words, exchanging messages. They occasionally appear near your residence, mostly dispersed across the city, like drops of water coming together to form a blue ocean that quietly coalesce into a tsunami.

5000791.title: Dark Alley Warrior Campaign
strings: Dark Alley Warrior Campaign

Your residence is surrounded by a bustling crowd, shouting for you to come out and fight like a man. Apparently, Nabhani declared on his usual street that you were the most powerful man he had ever seen, in many respects... This aroused the competitive spirit of the hooligans.
Dark Alley Warrior, he wants to prove he's the best—in every aspect.
You must do it yourself.
Certain consumables can be helpful
This combat tests not just force but also street wisdom...
You must fight, otherwise you will die.
Just as you were exchanging introductions, the other party suddenly throw a handful of sand at your eyes.
The real battle has just begun!
Your Wisdom provides you with the full dice count
The number of dice provided by your Combat and Physique will be affected by the opponent.
The number of dice provided by your combat and physique is affected by the opponent and dirty tricks.
You need at least 1 Success to see through his tricks.
You need at least 2 Successes to win.
Breaking the Sultan Card and wanting to go back? You are dead.
I can tell what you're up to before you even start
Damn it, you're playing dirty?!
The real battle is already over
That's for using dirty tricks!
I won't accept this!!
I won't accept this...
This little trick is completely transparent to you; you easily dodge the handful of sand and take advantage of the chaos to kick him.
Your eyes are in severe pain, and you can't see anything for a moment. While you're crying with blurred vision and covering your face, the opponent kicks you several times mercilessly.
Just like that, effortlessly, you deal with this defiant little thug until he's begging for mercy. The onlookers dare not approach you, fearing they might witness how "others" can be fierce.

Fortunately, you quickly calm down, grab the opponent's foot and slam him to the ground, making him beg for mercy. The onlookers fell silent, not knowing what to make of your tearful pummeling. In any case... you've finally resolved this matter.

Faced with your opponent's relentless flurry of punches and kicks, you have no chance to fight back. The crowd, seeing you weakness, rushes forward for their share of violence. They rain down kicks and punches, mocking how you ever dared to claim the title of the Dark Alleys' greatest warrior.

Even the Sultan is drawn by the commotion. His guards surround the Dark Alley warriors who try to flee the scene, commanding them to keep fighting until only one remains standing. The Sultan, after all, is thoroughly enjoying the show! And so… the ground in front of your home is soaked in blood – theirs, and yours.

You can't stop the tears streaming down your face, completely helpless against the barrage of punches and kicks. The crowd, seeing you weakness, rushes forward for their share of violence. They rain down kicks and punches, mocking how you ever dared to claim the title of the Dark Alleys' greatest warrior.

Even the Sultan is drawn by the commotion. His guards surround the Dark Alley warriors who try to flee the scene, commanding them to keep fighting until only one remains standing. The Sultan, after all, is thoroughly enjoying the show! And so… the ground in front of your home is soaked in blood – theirs, and yours.

5000792.title: Capital Dojo Conquest Battle
strings: Capital Dojo Conquest Battle

Your mansion is surrounded by a huge crowd, with a naked man standing at your door flaunting his muscles and calling you out to fight—fair and square. It turns out, Nabhani suddenly appeared at an unfriendly gathering yesterday, toying with those who disdained his ways, and dismissively said that they were no warriors, no fighters; you were the strongest, most valiant man he had ever seen...
Martial Master, very confident in his muscles
You must personally fight, and you cannot wear any Equipment.
Some intelligence can help
A fair and square contest of hand-to-hand combat – no equipment is allowed.
You must fight, otherwise you will die.
The battle begins!
The number of dice provided by your Combat and Physique is affected by your opponent.
You need at least 4 Successes to win.
Breaking the Sultan Card and wanting to go back? You are dead.
Strong Body! Amazing!
Not What I Wanted, Either

Eliminating all differences in background, title, and equipment, this is purely a clash of fists against flesh! You conquered this officer in combat. The officer, beaten black and blue, follows you asking for your name and if you're single and such, which you hurriedly dismiss before locking your door. You'd better put on some clothes.

Eliminating all differences in background, title, and equipment, you were beaten and ran for cover. My god, this scene is a wonder; even the Sultan came upon hearing it. Well, now he can only mercilessly kill you, though there was a bit of reluctance...

5000793.title: World Martial Arts Validation Battle
strings: World Martial Arts Validation Battle

Your mansion is surrounded by a huge crowd; it turns out Nabhani had given a lousy idea to a beautiful courtesan trying to raise her hiring price. She challenged all warriors on your behalf, stating whoever defeats you could enjoy a night with her... Thus, her admirers has come to challenge you, but a foreign spellblade defeated them before they could see you. He now stands at your door with a terrifying monster, demanding you come out for a showdown.
A foreign swordsman skilled in using magic
The monster beside the spellblade seems to be tamed
You must do it yourself.
Nabhani has come to assist you!
Certain consumables can be helpful
Combat compares Magic first; failing against an opponent results in immediate defeat, followed by a Magic check that applies penalties if failed.
You must fight, otherwise you will die.
If you cannot break through the opponent's strong magic defense, failure is only a matter of time
A fierce battle awaits you
The real battle has just begun!
The number of dice provided by your Magic is affected by the opponent
The number of dice provided by your Physique, Combat and Magic is affected by the opponent's attributes and failure of Magic resistance.
The number of dice provided by your combat and physique is affected by the opponent.
You need at least 3 Successes to avoid Combat penalties.
You need at least 2 Successes to win.
Breaking the Sultan Card and wanting to go back? You are dead.
This isn't fair at all!
Your Blades Are Nothing Against His Magic
You barely broke through his magical defenses
Is this really your strength?
You lost again.
Whose Summon Is Stronger?
The Victory Was Yours, Effortlessly

The beast accompanying this challenger has a fierce glare and drools profusely, making it appear extremely difficult to handle. No wonder this swordsman was unbeaten throughout the city.

You attempt to reason with him, claiming that such a beast in combat is unfair: "Do you even bring it to bed with a wench?"
"Why not?"

...It seems you'll have to win this fight for the safety of the prostitute you've never met.
At this moment, someone jumps to your side. "Well then, you wouldn't mind if he has a summoned beast too, right?" Nabhani nods at your opponent, then winks at you, mimicking a howling sound.

This son of a! You couldn't help but roll your eyes at the trouble he's caused you!

You and Nabhani's full-force attacks couldn't budge the opponent at all. He mocks you by maintaining a damned shield until you are exhausted, then waves his hand for the terrifying beast to devour you.
Even so, the strength of your and Nabhani's swords are greatly reduced as they slash toward the opponent. Without a doubt, a trial by combat most revere awaits.
With a single slash, you shatter the opponent's shield, and before he can regather their magic, Nabhani’s longsword strikes first.

The foreign spellblade manipulated the beast to tear open your stomachs, intestines tangled. The savage scene almost made the spectators vomit. Before dying, you wished the prostitute well, hoping she won't believe a handsome man's sweet words in her next life. Also, if given a choice next life, you'd never show this man that damned Conquest Card again.

After a fierce battle, the terrifying beast falls to the ground with a final wail. You pin the challenger beneath your foot, pressing your blade against his throat. "Now, tell me – whose summon is stronger?"

Nabhani lets out a laugh. He gives a playful howl and nudges your shoulder.

Any lingering resentment you had for him vanishes. Of course, it would be even better if he didn't take seven days to answer your summons.

5000794.title: World Martial Arts Validation Battle?
strings: World Martial Arts Validation Battle?
You defeated the challenger, and the prostitute, as per her one-sided agreement, invited you...
The famous prostitute
Why are you here?
You must do it yourself

Martial Arts Validation!
Your Physique, Charisma, and Sociability determine your full dice count.
You need at least 3 Successes to achieve "victory"
No, no, let's forget it. You persuade the prostitute to directly approach Nabhani, as he is also the victor of the challenge.
Merrier the More, Triple Fun That Way
A Little Too Much Excitement for You

The beautiful prostitute invited you and Nabhani to sit down, whispering charming and sweet words, leaving no room for awkwardness. The atmosphere was so elevated that neither of you left her chamber that night.
It's said that night, the prostitute and the world's two strongest warriors performed a meticulous examination of all forms of martial arts, trying out all kinds of moves... In any case, among the prostitutes of Dark Alley and their influential patrons... You became distinctly famous.

The beautiful prostitute invited you and Nabhani to sit down, whispering charming and sweet words, leaving no room for awkwardness. The atmosphere was so elevated that neither of you left her chamber that night.
Before this, you had never tried it with three people, especially with the other two being enthusiastic and deep in love...
It's said that night, the prostitute and the world's two strongest warriors performed a meticulous examination of all forms of martial arts, trying out all kinds of moves... Whenever this affair is mentioned, she always covers her mouth with a smile, creating ambiguity, which only makes people more curious about you. Lately, there seem to be more loafers wandering near your place...

5000795.title: The Most Popular Man
strings: The Most Popular Man
After showing Nabhani a carnal card, he mysteriously told you to dress up well and meet him at the House of Delights that day.
The mysterious masked guest
Well-groomed Nabhani
You must attend in person, and it's best to dress up splendidly
Certain consumables can be helpful
Less than 5 Charisma will disqualify you from this event
Who is the most handsome guest here?
You scrutinize the masked guest...
The number of dice, determined by your Wisdom and Stealth, is influenced by the masked man’s Stealth.
You need at least 3 Successes to see through his identity.
You stand up Nabhani. It’s okay, he goes to play alone, indifferent to your broken rendezvous.
Today's House of Delights Seems a Little Different
Now You See the Truth...
The mask he wears covers his entire face
Beauties Flock to the Masked Guest
You're the One Surrounded by the Most Girls
Nabhani is surrounded by girls, leaving no space for a fly to get through

The patrons are dressed brightly and elaborately, with the men's hair covered in rose water and shining longswords encrusted in ancestral jewels, while the Ladies of Delights sit behind veils, concealing their faces like noblewomen.

A man lies on the ground, his face deathly pale, yet his eyes burn with an unnatural fervor. He gazes at Badriyyah with a mix of greed and reverence – or perhaps, through her, at something far more distant and decayed. Badriyyah straddles him, lost in ecstatic moans. At last, the man shudders violently, cries out in praise of something, and collapses unconscious. Badriyyah turns to you with a satisfied smile, her crimson lips beckoning you closer. She steps forward, her cold nails brushing through your hair like dull little blades. Beyond the walls, the sounds of clinking glasses, laughter, and passion are muffled, as if veiled by a thin gauze – much like the barrier of faith that separates you from ordinary people. In this cramped, shadowy room, in this chaotic and ignorant world, only the two of you are kindred spirits. You are meant to unite – for the sake of your shared master of darkness.

With her humble origins, [s6.name] can hardly refuse such invitations to pleasure; nor should she, when such desire await. Let go of society's chains and surrender to the moment. Among life's many pursuits, only in pleasure do all stand truly equal.

Whenever, wherever, no one can restrain a noble, elegant, and charming cat. Paying no heed to anyone's reactions, he kicks over unpleasant incense burners, tastes the warm pool water, scratches anyone who dares approach, and shreds the comfortable plush rugs into tassels. There are always couples in throes of passion finding themselves at the mercy of his mischief – his tail sweeping across their sensitive soles, his claws catching their sheer silks and glittering jewels... Consider yourself lucky! At least your face has been spared from his claws.

It causes a brief panic among the crowd, but soon, they believe it is merely your well-prepared entertainment performance. They let the cold, serpentine scales slither up their calves and curl gently around their necks. Lost in the haze of desire, they are barely aware of what is happening...

Neither man nor woman could resist its sinister spell. Under its influence, their eyes grow vacant, and their mouths fail to utter words of reason. They become vessels of primal desire, bound in an endless ritual until exhaustion claims them. Their flesh remains entangled, trembling in savage union...

But you can feel it – a familiar gaze lingering on your back, faint yet constant, observing your every move. If only you could meet that gaze, you'd see beyond the passion, lust, and desire, to find something far more profound – pain.
Through the tangle of flesh and desire...

You find Aziz and Inal naked and nestled together, sharing the lavish feast abandoned by others. Aziz's brow furrows as he speaks, each word measured and sincere: "Your cooking is far superior to this."

You see Jabal chase away the crowd around Adila, and then their tactless heads draw close together. you can hear something like dragon-slaying, adventure, swords... Forget it, you decide not to get closer – no need to let those two ruin your mood. Because of this, you miss the moment when silence suddenly falls between them. They lock eyes for a brief second before awkwardly looking away.

You see Zephyr's wife yelling at him while he softly pleads for her forgiveness, even offering up his scarred and battered arm. It's as if he's the only one in the world who still sees her as the noble, proud Arumina she once was. She pouts, then throws herself into his arms, bursting into tears.
You see Adila finally wave away the crowd in front of her, impatience written all over her face. She glances around as if expecting someone to show up – or perhaps hoping she won't...

You see Junah, Jalila, and Shama reunited under one roof – a rare occasion indeed. At his special moment, they sit together on the same carpet, whispering softly as they console one another, speaking of things that have nothing to do with desire or men.

She leans back against the soft cushions, with Habib fussing over her – pouring tea, offering timely snacks and candied fruits. Maggie lifts her eyelids briefly; maybe she notices you, maybe she doesn't. Either way, you can't help but feel a little out of place.
But does it matter? After all, you're at a decadent party – everyone can do whatever they want.

She leans back against the soft cushions, with Habib fussing over her – pouring tea, offering timely snacks and candied fruits. Damn it, you didn't invite this annoying man! It must have been Maggie... Maggie lifts her eyelids briefly; maybe she notices you, maybe she doesn't. Either way, you can't help but feel a little out of place.
Ugh, it doesn't matter at all! You're at a decadent party – everyone can do whatever they want!

She sits upright at the far end of the room, quietly sipping tea – as if she were at home.

You walk toward her, kneeling on one knee, and take her hands in yours, trying to say something – but Maggie holds your hands in return. When you look up, her gaze holds an unusual serenity, and you realize there's no need – you invited her, and because of that, she chooses to trust you.

A hidden tenderness stirs in your chest. You kiss her, reaching across time to a moment before all the sadness, pain, and regret ever happened – to when the roses in her garden were in full bloom. In the front yard, your parents and hers were discussing something; here, the two of you held hands gently, saying nothing at all.

You should never forget. You must never forget.

She is terrified by the monsters you brought, and it takes you a long time to calm her down before helping her onto a carriage to be escorted home.

But – why wasn't she tempted? You can't figure it out.

The heavy tapestries block out every sliver of light, and the next day, you wake up in darkness.
The music and laughter have long since faded – nothing remains here but the sound of breathing. With a pounding headache, you push aside an arm draped over you – you don't even know whose it is – and untangle yourself from stray limbs and hair. No one notices your departure, and no one calls you back. The desires you thought had been sated stir once more, like a beast honing its savage fangs in your chest, urging you to do something... but you don't know what to do and where to go. You thought the surging waves of pleasure would bring you endless fulfillment and joy. But you were wrong – when the tide recedes, all you're left with is a ceaseless, unrelenting emptiness.

The heavy tapestries block out every sliver of light. The next day, when you wake up, the music and laughter have long since faded. A single candle burns softly by the bedside in the stillness. Maggie sits beside you, chin propped on her hand, gently turning the pages of her book. You wrap your arms around her waist from behind, and she turns to look at you, whispering, "Did I disturb you?"

You simply shake your head and give her a gentle good morning kiss. She may never know what a comfort she is after such a dark, suffocating night.

As you recount this grueling, all-consuming, day-and-night "conquest," your legs are still trembling uncontrollably... The courtiers listen in awe, and even the Sultan has no choice but to allow you to break the card. However, his expression darkens considerably – How dare you exclude him? This is an act of treason!

By the time you conquered your third, your limbs had grown weak, and by the fifth, you had nearly lost your mind... Thankfully, everyone present was a trusted friend who would keep silent about it.

However, you still feel ashamed.
Thus breaking the Carnality Card seems so natural, nobody can object it. However, the Sultan's expression darkens considerably – how dare you exclude him? This is an act of treason!

You did spend lavishly on this feast – extravagant art pieces, ornaments, jewelry, and precious gems... some of which still remain inside certain guests! Who could say this wasn't a perfect display of extravagance?

However, the Sultan's expression darkens considerably – how dare you exclude him? This is an act of treason!
As a party favor for the lavish feast, this bloody gift failed to please the Sultan – you didn't invite him! You forget what you promised; this is an act of treason!

At such a debauched feast, who is left uninvited? Maggie can barely maintain her polite smile. Once she finishes what she's doing, she packs her things and gets on her carriage. She obviously doesn't want to see you for a while.

Bribing garbage-transporting slaves provides cover to recover the Sultan's precious life essence. He consumed several such sheaths, all discarded into a chili powder box - one of which you replaced with a near-perfect counterfeit.

5000799.title: Master of Revels
strings: Master of Revels

The grand orgy you hosted rippled among all men and women; during this time, rumors and imaginations about the party were the hottest topic, making those who attended head over heels in pride and those who didn't continuously probing Buthayna about the next time... Underneath all this frenzy, Nabhani comes under your roof.

Master of Pleasure

Without any expression, Nabhani places a fine bottle of liquor on your table. You immediately recognize it – the same bottle he took during his first visit to your home. Its crimson color, dark as blood, brings back memories of that night's cruel indulgence.

"Now, I owe you nothing," Nabhani says, his eyes cold as ice, before turning away without another word.

Nabhani brings you a fine bottle of liquor, chuckling as he admires your elegant, sophisticated indulgences.
"You're truly a master of pleasure," he says with a playful wink. "It seems I still have much to learn from you."
Tipsy, you don't take his words seriously. But from that day on, Nabhani never again leaves you alone or slips away to pursue his pleasures.
