Slippers embroidered with gold thread step on your shoulder as the Sultan descended down from the carriage, entering the garden of earthly delights you prepared. He inspects the arrangements and the guests you've gathered with great interest, a slight smile on his lips. Now, he is the master here, and everyone revolves around his pleasure.
[s2.name] kneels naked at his feet, her beautiful and smooth back supporting the golden tray and wine on the table, trembling slightly, but not daring to spill a drop of the wine

[s3.name] lies on the carpet before the Sultan, holding a scroll with both hands, struggling to restrain herself, frowning and reading out the nonsense written on it, yet unable to suppress the rolling breath in her throat

Under the veil, [s4.name] is bound on the rack, elegant whip marks on his chest. Slave girls teased his body with feathers, while he keeps his brow tight, shouts eyes enduring, as the master did not allow him to release
[s5.name] kneels by the banquet table, the only neatly dressed lady, yet beneath the loose robe, you can see her desperately enduring something, maybe pain, maybe desire

This peculiarity sparks some interest in the Sultan, but not much. His sullen gaze weighs on Buthayna, making her obediently kneel, not daring to lift her head. 

How uninteresting! He was long past the need to prove his authority with his father's possessions, and even the throne had become unpleasant after sitting too long. Let alone an outdated woman! However... he smiles again. The Sultan leans forward and nods at you, "I like this gift, my loyal subject," he says, "So, I have decided to bestow this opportunity upon you."

Despite being well-maintained, time still left traces of looseness on Buthayna. Yet, the illusion of power is an excellent aphrodisiac. While riding her, you seems possessed by a dark ghost, the air filled with a murky and stale scent of blood, brushing you with broken sentences like a curse. You can't make out what it is saying, but you can feel the fear and sadness of approaching the end. However, when your senses return, all you see is the Sultan's sullen face.
You kneel before the Sultan. The musty scent from the floor fills your senses while a heavy air of desire hangs above, making you afraid to raise your eyes.

The Sultan laughs heartily at your madness. Even if you were truly deluded by what just happened, have you forgotten the fate of the former king?

Very well, as a reward, your corpse becomes the most popular toy at the gathering – your head is gloriously placed on the throne to witness it all.

How naturally you break this card. But the feast of desire isn't over. As silks slip from your body, you lose yourself in the women's soft caresses, the wine-sweet taste of their lips, the raw passion in men's touch. Your mind drowns in pure pleasure, your soul dissolving into a sticky puddle, drying and wetting, over and over agian.

Fine liquor, exquisite dishes, and a collection of rare and curious trinkets – you present them to the Sultan, calling them a token of your humble regard. The Sultan is pleased with you. From the array of dazzling trinkets, he selects the most intriguing one and rewards you with it – slicing your skin with his golden blade and piercing it through your flesh.

What does the Sultan love most if not blood? He laughs, pointing casually at someone. And you, you give him a performance like no other.
You embrace the chosen one with seeming tenderness – soft caresses and gentle kisses belied by your strong arms. With a thin, razor-sharp blade, you carve intricate patterns across bare flesh. Every shudder, every gasping breath, every desperate struggle, and every plea becomes part of this canvas of despair. You are the cold executioner, alone in your deadly dance.
As blood drips steadily, you finally release the fading soul, presenting the blade to the Sultan. With a hearty laugh, he drives it into the victim's lower body, destroying what little life remains. Then he orders the skin flayed whole – this masterpiece, he declares, must be preserved forever.

Time stands frozen, as if the sun and moon have abandoned their eternal course, waiting for the master of the world to grow bored. With a yawn, the Sultan carelessly kicks aside the perfumed beauty curled against him. He strides across the scattered chaos of the floor, leaving with languid grace.
Only then does the wind stir in this chamber thick with desire. Only then do you slowly recall your own name, at last aware that you're still breathing.

Very well, the Sultan is not here. Now, you can be the master of this feast! Your friends once gather beneath your roof, each with their own reasons. But now, behind these layers of shimmering bead curtains, they gather for only one reason: desire.

Junah approaches, helping you remove your outer garments while delicate silk slides from her shoulders.
"You have no idea how I've missed you," she whispers in your ear, her flattery reminding you of when you first met at the House of Delights. She seems to hint that you can treat her the same way as before. As if only that could befit such a feast of ultimate desire.
However, when your fingers touch her smooth neck, her lowered eyelashes gently tremble. You know she is truly different now – she has something she can't lose.
You smile and give her a breathtaking kiss, leading her into the depths of the room.

When Junah sees you, she seems a little bit nervous. It's as if she has never worn such luxurious silk before; she also dreads finding even the slightest trace of disappointment in your expression. She clutches the silk tightly around her body and kneels before you, pleading for you to pull the leather cord hanging on the wall – without someone holding the cord, she is not allowed to move, and, of course, She must never touch the cord herself.
With the cord in your hand, you guide her forward as she crawls on all fours, joyfully following you – finally, she has a master in this feast.
You smile slightly, not taking the leather cord, and instead, give her a breathtaking kiss. Her body trembles slightly, partly from joy, partly from fear.

You hear Jalila laughing in the distance. You see her removing a string of jewels and tossing it your way – it happens to land right on your foot. As you stoop to pick it up, a bare foot gently presses against the back of your hand. Lady Jalila tilts your chin up with the handle of her whip, smiling. "Look at this handsome face... I permit you to have it." Her laughter echoes and fades as she walks away – you wonder if she's laughing at you, or at her past self.

Jalila sits proudly in the most conspicuous spot in the room, a whip in her hand, sharply critiquing the men and women gathered around her. Who is worthy of her performance? Who deserves this reward of pain and sweetness intertwined? Until she sees you. Her whip flicks lightly, its tip slithering across your chest like a venomous snake. The wound blooms like a petal as she steps toward you, pressing the handle of her whip against your chin. "Kneel," she says. "Kneel. I grant you permission to submit."

You submit to her willingly, letting her pull open your collar. The sharp crack of the whip and the wetness of a tongue, the sting of harsh slaps, and the softness of tender caresses alternately torment your body. In a moment when the lash and the pleasure blur your senses, a vision boils over in your mind: the true master you've endured for so long might be nothing more than a whore, just like this woman before you.

And you just smile, opening your palm to her, revealing a crystal orb lying in your hand.

Jalila lets out a soft scoff. "Do you think I'm a little girl, [player.name]?" She takes the orb, examining its hazy patterns with disdain as if appraising some inferior gemstone. You gesture for her to put it in her mouth.

Assuming it is just some trinket, she shoots you a skeptical look before popping it into her mouth. But it is sweet. It is candy. For a second, Jalila's expression goes blank, then quickly resumes her haughty demeanor. "Don't treat me like a little girl!"

She whirls away, whip in hand, searching for her next target among the crowd.

Wisps of elegant incense dance around Shama, creating an illusion that this place has somehow escaped the encroaching debauchery. As you approach, your fingers find a stray lock of her hair. Shama smiles as she shows you her newly acquired poetry collection. As she reads these love poems, you savor how her scholarly recitation melts into wanton sighs.

Shama's figure emerges faintly through the dim, almost suggestive haze of incense and candlelight. You notice her masculine part beneath the gossamer, adorned and bound with jewels and gold. Oddly enough, it does make you feel a bit more at ease.

She beckons to you, and you walk toward her. She takes your hand, pulling you close to her side. Then she cups your face, gazing into your eyes for a moment before giving you a gentle kiss.

It almost gives you a sense of love, so pure, and precious. For a moment, in her eyes, you glimpse someone else's. But Shama is always gentle, always safe – you can immerse yourself in this love's embrace, free from all concerns.

It almost gives you a sense of love, so pure and precious. For a moment, in her eyes, you glimpse someone else's. So you tear yourself from this love's embrace, seeking the one whose eyes occasionally turn cold as winter frost.

Zaki protests indignantly, attempting to prove himself with a few words, before leading them into the layered silk drapes.

You have no idea where Faraj appeared from – perhaps from the moment you walked in, his eyes had already found you, as if guided by some innate instinct that you could never possess.

You move closer and join this wet and passionate game. The scalding water makes your skin more sensitive – it's hard to tell what exactly makes him so disoriented, yet so passionate.

You've actually seen him forced to kneel at a woman's feet before. Did Nayla ever truly get her hands on him? Or was it because she failed that she came to you, seeking a Bloodshed Card?

Amused by the thought, you grab a few bottles of liquor and sit down next to him. When you're both a bit drunk, you nudge him under the table with your foot. Gullis pauses mid-toast but then drinks as if nothing happened.

You can clearly hear his breathing becomes heavier.

You walk toward her, kneeling on one knee, and take her hands in yours, trying to say something – but Maggie holds your hands in return. When you look up, her gaze holds an unusual serenity, and you realize there's no need – you invited her, and because of that, she chooses to trust you.

A hidden tenderness stirs in your chest. You kiss her, reaching across time to a moment before all the sadness, pain, and regret ever happened – to when the roses in her garden were in full bloom. In the front yard, your parents and hers were discussing something; here, the two of you held hands gently, saying nothing at all.

You should never forget. You must never forget.

She is terrified by the monsters you brought, and it takes you a long time to calm her down before helping her onto a carriage to be escorted home.

But – why wasn't she tempted? You can't figure it out.

The heavy tapestries block out every sliver of light, and the next day, you wake up in darkness.
The music and laughter have long since faded – nothing remains here but the sound of breathing. With a pounding headache, you push aside an arm draped over you – you don't even know whose it is – and untangle yourself from stray limbs and hair. No one notices your departure, and no one calls you back. The desires you thought had been sated stir once more, like a beast honing its savage fangs in your chest, urging you to do something... but you don't know what to do and where to go. You thought the surging waves of pleasure would bring you endless fulfillment and joy. But you were wrong – when the tide recedes, all you're left with is a ceaseless, unrelenting emptiness.

5000805.title: The Grief of the Prodigal
strings: The Grief of the Prodigal
Overnight, Nabhani changed. His ever-affectionate eyes are now saturated with deep melancholy.
The Forlorn Drunkard
You must meet him in person
Appropriate Conviction.
Maybe you didn't really care about this matter, and then you missed it.
Drink with Him, All Night
Speechless in Silence
No Guts
You took the chance to manipulate him

One cup after another, you drink until nearly dawn, until the faint morning light reddened his eyes. 
"She is dead." Nabhani says quietly, "...by my hand, she is dead." He takes another swig from the jug, swaying while standing up, "I'm leaving now, [player.name], thank you for staying with me." 
You quickly grab him, urging him not to act rashly, though he looked at you confused, "Rashly?" He laughs, tears welling in his eyes, "What can I do?"

He also smiles and pushes your hand away, hiding any peculiar color in his eyes quite well, "Don’t worry, I’m fine."
After saying this, his figure disappears wobblingly with his jug around the corner, more dishevels than the drunks who had died in the dark alley.

You stare at him, your gaze like a piercing sword: "You know full well under whose sword they died. Nabhani, you used to be a man who would draw a sword for a Lady of Delights. What, do you not dare to anymore? Does your sword only strike to the weaker?" 

He freezes, countless complex emotions flash in his eyes instantly, finally turning into a long sigh. He sit back at the table, silently drinking from the jug in his arms. 

The Sultan's most loyal guard, this handsome noble who distanced himself from court struggles, embraced the garden of earthly delights, everyone forgot he once had ambition. He once knelt with earnestness, swearing loyalty to earn a promised future. However, time cruelly changes everything. 

After draining the last of the wine, he seemed to finally abandon illusions, forsake his sworn promises, leaving behind that youthful self, "Back then I fled far, thinking I could avoid it all, yet it led to this – no one may possess anything of their own in the Sultan’s domain – not even a sliver of freedom and joy. You're right, [player.name], it can’t continue like this. What can I do for you? You must have a plan if you dare to say this." 

You nod at him, explaining your intentions. Gradually, a sincere, complex smile appeares on the young Iron Guard's face. However, he doesn't swear to you, just shake your hand, indicating he will stand by you. Because this time, his sword shall draw for what he deems righteous, not for mutable person anymore.

All noble warriors undergo comprehensive training against black magic, and their practices even include building resistance to illusions, poisons, and the extremes of fire and ice... Under normal circumstances, no matter what kind of tricks you employ, Nabhani's sword would unerringly pierce your throat.

But today, he is nothing more than a mortal, bleeding from the heart. Indulgence, pleasure, and alcohol have yet to numb the pain in his soul.

Guided by your words and drawn to the purity of this noble warrior's soul, the dark power flows like fine liquor, filling Nabhani's cup. 

Out of hatred for this world and trust in you, he empties the cursed in a single draught.

5000810.title: Gang Rivalry
strings: Gang Rivalry

Your influence penetrates the Dark Alleys, requiring a spokesperson. The Alley Jackals hold traditional power, while Riel - a recently appeared barbarian woman - leads opposition. Whom will you support?
Riel
Riel's outlaw gang
You can offer Riel with some useful supplies
You can offer Riel with some gold coins
You can offer Riel with some gmanpower
A gang entrenched in the Dark Alley
You can offer the Jackals with some useful supplies
You can offer the Jackals with some gold coins
You can offer the Jackals with some gmanpower
Invest in your preferred faction
Right and wrong ceased mattering long ago
The dice count provided by Riel's gang Combat is affected by the Jackals

Why concern yourself with Dark Alley gang conflicts? You choose to stand aside. Later, casual conversation reveals the presumptuous barbarian woman died in a firefight, her influence naturally crumbling.
Passive Observer
Bread Vendetta
Mud's Dignity
Thanks!
Know Your Station
Good Judgment
Why concern yourself with Dark Alley gang conflicts? Later, casual conversation reveals the presumptuous barbarian woman died in a firefight, her influence naturally crumbling.
Nobody can pinpoint how such trivial matters sparked this turmoil, but by your notice, it had evolved into life-or-death warfare between old and new Dark Alley powers.

That woman is utterly deranged - hacking people, extracting livers, consuming them steaming and bloody while shouting incomprehensible words. The Jackals flee in terror, their leader cursing furiously until becoming the barbarian woman's nourishment. Who dares provoke the Mud Gang now? Better count your livers first.

After her legendary victory, Riel finds you. "I owe you another favor!" She generously slaps your shoulder, casually introducing you to her thin but fierce underlings, ensuring they memorize your face - clearly conveying that "Big Sis has your back."

The Jackals' deeply-rooted neighborhood influence means Riel's movements remain transparent, her attacks consistently ineffective. Eventually, her followers are systematically eliminated while she, exhausted, is captured alive - the aftermath needs no explanation.
Although the Jackals' leader believes your assistance minimally impacted the conflict, he expresses gratitude: "If opportunity arises, I look forward to future collaboration."

The Jackals

As agreed

The Jackals' leader personally visits, his underling depositing a mysterious large sack in your courtyard. "This scoundrel is yours to use," he smiles kindly. "Someone considered scum even by our kind is truly rare."
A Jackal thug delivers a money pouch alongside marketplace gossip.
Given your inability to control local miscreants, the Jackals consider bribing you utterly pointless.

5000812.title: Riel's Gang
strings: Riel's Gang
Riel's headquarters stands completely open to you. Her subordinates, mostly humble-born but extraordinarily skilled, offer much worth learning.
Riel's Subordinate
Select above gang for training

If trouble breaks out in the territory, Riel will withdraw her subordinates, and all training will end immediately... Don't even think about getting your money back - that's how gangs operate, after all.
Followers cannot receive the same training multiple times
Gang mobilization in progress, training unavailable
People must appear
Parched Throats
Little Moon's Visit
After circling thrice, you find everyone sunbathing against mud walls, lazily claiming insufficient drinking money saps motivation. Next time, certainly next time.

What an adorable puppy! 
Riel's underlings bring it while collecting protection money, absolutely refusing your payment. 
Running wild through bustling Dark Alleys delights Little Moon immensely.
Survival Paramount
Endurance Paramount
Unique Excellence
If I'd Had a Horse
Fight me!
Keeping Quiet

Riel's first followers articulated no grand principles - simply cornered by rival gangs, making desperate stands. They teach [s7.name] survival wisdom, blessing [s7.name] to never require such knowledge.

Victory belongs to our fiercest fighter? Our silver-tongued second? Neither - it's me, the brother absorbing most hits! 
The Alley Jackals grin proudly, eagerly sharing with [s8.name] which body parts suffer least when struck.

Barbarian women apologetically explain their ancestral magic invocations cannot be shared. They demonstrate war-paint application and ritual performance in detail, yet no matter your precision, that special blessing eludes you. Though you ultimately surrender, those fierce decorations grant [s9.name] intimidating presence.
Nomads rescued by Riel, having nowhere else to go, remain at her camp, completely imparting their horsemanship - greatly benefiting [s10.name].
Barbarians rescued by Riel grow excited at fighting's mere mention. Let's be clear - this is practice only; defeating [s11.name] doesn't permit consuming [s11.gender(his,her)] liver!
Rescued vagrants consistently warn that the prettiest and most articulate become first targets - no advantage there. Under their guidance, [s12.name] masters inconspicuous techniques.
Time passes swiftly.

strings: Hunting the Jackals

Riel

Even without your help, Riel successfully eliminates the Jackals' remnants.

You'll Pay for This
At first they cursed this barbarian woman for her merciless pursuit. Riel just laughed heartily - no matter, once they've bled out, the cursing will stop.

The Jackals have grown wiser, no longer confronting Riel head-on. They fight while retreating, leaving a few corpses behind, but their main force quickly vanishes into the complex maze of alleyways. 
They likely won't dare stir up trouble for quite some time, but Riel still spits out a few barbarian curses, clearly unsatisfied with the hunt.
They Can Still Be Useful

You persuade Riel to spare the Jackals members who have completely lost the will to fight and are begging for mercy. Riel despises their fear of death, but she can't deny that after annexing such a large territory from the Jackals, she's currently short-handed.

Though gang skirmishes themselves aren't particularly interesting, you vividly describe Riel's gruesome liver-eating scenes for quite some time. The Sultan agrees to let you break this Conquest Card, which wasn't of high tier anyway.

5000814.title: Heart and Liver
strings: Heart and Liver
Riel invites you to sample a steaming fresh liver. She claims it's good for your health, though who knows if that's true...
Riel is very pleased
You must eat it yourself
You can bring one companion to share in the... experience
While you weren't paying attention, Riel resolved everything.
Fresh Kill Query
Savage Delicacy

Without a word, Habib takes the liver, carefully washing away the blood while muttering about how to prepare it. Riel desperately tries to stop him, but the kitchen is Habib's territory... 
She glares at you with immense regret and resentment until Habib brings the dish to the table - thinly sliced fresh liver enveloped in the aroma of roasting, making Riel immediately stop cursing and nearly drool. 
In the end, she eats more of this meal than usual.

You ask Riel how to eat it, and without a word, she cuts it into three pieces and forces them into your mouth and your companion's... 
It takes all your self-control - mainly because Riel is staring at you - not to spit it out. Riel grins and asks if it tastes good. Damn barbarian.

5000815.title: To the House of Delights!
strings: To the House of Delights!
To save her tribeswomen from becoming courtesans, Riel wants to infiltrate an auction at the House of Delights. Do you have any good ideas?
Riel
Riel's Subordinate
You can help Riel... or who else might help?
Spending 20 Gold Coins can directly solve the problem
Gold Solves Everything

After receiving no response from you, Riel couldn't wait. That night, the barbarian woman and all her followers made a desperate raid on the House of Delights, leaving countless bodies in their wake. 
You heard she actually found her violated sisters there, distributing weapons to them. Together they killed with these blades, ultimately taking their own lives while surrounded. 
And so it ended.
A Fish Among Pearls
Infiltration Denied
Gentleman's Disguise

"Ha, a woman infiltrating the House of Delights? That's simple!" Nabhani confidently agrees after hearing your plan. 
Unsurprisingly, when he meets the female bandit leader, his smug smile freezes: "You've grown up to be... quite... uh... healthy." Nabhani examines Riel's muscular arms and scarred body before managing a comment, "Healthy to the point of hardly resembling a woman." 
"Only you city folk prefer those sickly skinny women," Riel snorts. "Women are people, and people should be strong. I only like weakness in one case - when it's my enemy." 
Nabhani confusedly sips his tea in silence. Before Riel's patience runs out, you quickly explain his plan: the simplest way for her to infiltrate is to disguise herself as a Lady of Delights - before you can finish, Riel nearly smashes your skull with her fist, luckily Nabhani pulls her back with all his might... 
You quickly adopt a "this is the only way" expression, and Nabhani repeatedly agrees. Grudgingly, she resigns herself to Nabhani immersing her in a bath, carefully washing away the "war paint" made with blood, then shaving her armpits, applying perfume, intricately braiding her wild hair, and finally dressing her in a silk gown she could tear to shreds with one hand to conceal her muscular contours: "This is called hiding the tiger..." 
Before the candle burns out, a transformed Riel stands before you uncomfortably, now resembling a curvaceous Lady of Delights, except for her tightly clenched fists and eyes flashing the murderous light of "if this plan fails, I'll kill you all."

"Who are you? You're a renowned power in this city. Who would dare not welcome you? Who would dare question anyone you bring?" 
You tell Riel you can simply escort her through the front door - if anyone asks, she's your bodyguard. 
She laughs heartily, slapping your shoulder forcefully, saying she knew she was right about you. 
You try not to wince from the pain, which would undermine your confident demeanor.

You examine Riel for quite some time, irritating her, unable to imagine how disastrous she would look in a dress. 
After much deliberation, you find her some of your old clothes to wear - at least better than a dress... 
You agree that she'll pose as your friend, a rebellious young nobleman seeking pleasure - she can glare at people with her man-eating eyes all she wants, and you'll handle the rest. Hopefully, all goes well.
Money talks.
Not My Concern

"What's the big deal? We'll just buy them outright!" 
The chest of gold you produce makes Riel's eyes widen. A few days later, armed with an invitation procured from somewhere, she strides confidently into the House of Delights, outbids several clients with gold coins, and successfully purchases her imprisoned sisters.

You coldly refuse Riel. She curses you in disappointment before storming off. 
You hear that night the barbarian woman and all her followers made a desperate raid on the House of Delights, leaving countless bodies in their wake. 
In the chaos, Riel found her humiliated sisters and distributed weapons among them. Together they killed with these blades, ultimately taking their own lives while surrounded. 
And so it ended.

5000816.title: The Great Sister Heist
strings: The Great Sister Heist

The House of Delights has received a new batch of slave girls, and tonight they're holding an auction for their first night. You've naturally obtained Buthayna's invitation in advance, and the disguised Riel arrives at your side as agreed, eyes flashing dangerously: "My people are already positioned nearby. If all else fails, I'll rescue my sisters by force if necessary."
Riel in disguise
Riel's Subordinate
You can go yourself, or dispatch any follower to help with this operation
Useful consumables
A Sultan Card might prove miraculous, but must be lower than Silver tier

Meanwhile, you find yourselves surrounded by the House of Delights' guards...
Will Riel's subordinates infiltrate successfully?
Your Combat and Physique determine your full dice count.

Riel charges in recklessly and dies inside.

Buyer's Judgment
Just What I Wanted
No Play, No Break
Breaking Point
Riel's Rampage
Bloody Legacy
According to Plan
Guards! Guards!

After repeatedly warning Riel against acting rashly, you escort her into the House of Delights. The auction has already begun, with Madame Buthayna making a show of walking out, holding a thick rope that binds four barbarian girls. They all share Riel's tattoos, white hair, defiant eyes, and fierce tendency to spit at the audience. 
"These are the purest barbarian maidens, freshly captured from outside the city," Buthayna stops before a tall girl, casually stroking her bare skin while the girl angrily shouts but cannot break free. 
"I know these aren't the goods our esteemed guests typically seek, but everyone gathered here today represents the House of Delights' most noble clients... clients with the finest taste. Strong men should embrace strong women - don't you want to conquer these firm breasts? Don't you want to try these sturdy thighs? Their taste is unlike any other, tighter, more exquisite. I guarantee every client who's experienced them comes back for more - but such pleasure isn't common, as barbarian women often commit suicide after being dishonored, so enjoy them while you can!" 
Riel trembles with rage, using all her strength not to forget your warnings and charge up to bash Buthayna's head in.

Next, Buthayna's gaze catches you in the crowd. 
"Oh my, Lord [player.name], you're here too!" She laughs behind her hand, pulling you onto the stage and grabbing your hand, making you squeeze the girls' breasts. 
The full, supple, elastic sensation travels from your fingertips, while Riel's knife-like gaze simultaneously stabs into your back... 
Buthayna continues chattering: "Aren't you interested in them? They could help you break a Carnality Card, an Extravagance Card, and perhaps even satisfy a Conquest Card! I hear those cards give you quite a headache!"

Seeing the card you produce, Buthayna's eyes narrow into slits with delight. She orders the barbarian girls taken downstairs to the most luxurious, spacious private room, and the guests present raise no objections - after all, no one would be tactless enough to compete with the Sultan's Game for priority... 
While the auction continues fervently downstairs, hidden behind layers of red gauze, you personally cut the ropes binding the barbarian girls, then call Riel in...

Under Riel's watchful glare, you certainly dare not say "let me break this card first..." 
After finally understanding what's happening, the girls excitedly embrace each other, then fiercely hug Riel. After thanking you, they quickly vanish into the night.

Seeing the card you produce, Buthayna's eyes narrow into slits with delight. She orders the barbarian girls taken downstairs to the most luxurious, spacious private room, and the guests present raise no objections - after all, no one would be tactless enough to compete with the Sultan's Game for priority... 
While the auction continues fervently downstairs, hidden behind layers of red gauze, you personally cut the ropes binding the barbarian girls, then call Riel in... 
After finally understanding what's happening, the girls excitedly embrace each other, then fiercely hug Riel. After thanking you, they quickly vanish into the night. 
As for you, you must stay behind waiting for Buthayna to collect payment - how else would you break this Extravagance Card?

You feel your pocket, which indeed contains a card, but the image on it is neither of charity nor of lovers. Riel can't help asking what it is, and you smile, saying it's a license to kill... 
"Since when does killing need a license? You city folk and your complications." Riel laughs heartily, tears off her disguise, and pulls a barbarian dagger from the belt at her thigh, lunging toward Buthayna on the stage - she's had enough! 
The madam screams and dodges, while Riel quickly cuts the ropes binding the slave girls. True to their barbarian nature, these girls are stunned for barely half a second before helping each other remove their shackles and ropes.

Together you kill all the guards. Riel and her sisters methodically cut open their bellies, removing their fresh livers. 
She devours them ravenously while her four sisters sing war songs loudly, dancing primitive dances around her. 
Buthayna trembles with fear, begging you repeatedly: "I want nothing, no compensation - just take them away, heavens, what are these creatures - take them away, please!" 
And so, you lead Riel and her sisters proudly out of the House of Delights.

The conflict inevitably affects many innocent customers, whether killed by you or by Riel's frenzy. What matters is that people remember you and grow to hate you. 
Afterward, the House of Delights never opens its doors again, and of course, no one dares to patronize it anymore.

Riel leads her followers in a killing spree like a madwoman, slaughtering both the House's guards and clients who draw weapons in self-defense... Blood splashes carelessly on the vibrant carpets, as if it were the least valuable thing in the world. 
In the end, everyone dies... Riel, Riel's followers, Riel's sisters. Only you survive, seemingly politely escorted out of the House of Delights by Buthayna's guards. 
Her eyes are cold, filled with hatred. You can imagine that from now on, the House of Delights will never welcome you again.
The conflict inevitably affects many innocent customers, whether killed by you or by Riel's frenzy. What matters is that people remember you and grow to hate you.

You hesitate, appearing troubled, while Buthayna tirelessly turns to promote the girls to another client. Soon the girls find a buyer, and Buthayna pushes them down from the stage, delivering them to a fat old man. The girls shout and struggle desperately, biting the old man's face and knocking over servants carrying drinks... It's time. 
You signal Riel with a glance, then pretend to mediate the chaos, walking to Buthayna's side.

The fat client angrily calls for his bodyguards while Buthayna hurriedly explains and appeases him. In the midst of this chaos, suddenly! Someone knocks over the lamps in the House of Delights, plunging everything into darkness... 
Women scream, men curse, many are inexplicably stabbed, others disappear. 
When Buthayna frantically relights the lamps, you stand like the most innocent of guests, your face alarmed as you grab her and demand to know what happened. She is both embarrassed and angry but must apologize to you. 
The four girls and Riel have vanished. A perfect evening.

The fat client angrily calls for his bodyguards while Buthayna hurriedly explains and appeases him. In the midst of this chaos, suddenly! Someone knocks over the lamps in the House of Delights, plunging everything into darkness... 
Women scream, men curse, many are inexplicably stabbed, others flee in disarray. 
When Buthayna regains control and orders the lamps relit, you discover the carpet beneath your feet soaked in blood, with Riel and the four girls lying dead nearby, their eyes still open. 
The only consolation is that Riel tore off her disguise before the fighting began, and when you question Buthayna with your most innocent, shaken expression about what happened, no one suspects your involvement in the conflict.

5000817.title: I, Freeloader
strings: I, Freeloader
Soon, Buthayna discovers the four girls are missing. She confronts you at your room's doorway with several guards, demanding to know what happened.
Buthayna comes to demand answers
Someone must provide an explanation
Or pay to make it go away? 20 Gold Coins are enough.
You can break an Extravagance Card of Silver tier or lower
Deceive Buthayna
The dice count provided by your Sociability and Charisma is affected by Buthayna
You need 3 Successto deceive Buthayna.

You ignored Buthayna, walking straight away. Buthayna can do nothing about this, but she won't give up. She complains about you everywhere, inciting nobles to speak against you at court... 
Tsk. This troublesome woman.
"Do You Know Who I Am?"
"What Did You Say?"
"I'll Pay, of Course"
Turn the Tables
Still Denying?

You leisurely straighten your sleeves, calmly drinking tea, keeping Buthayna waiting. 
Her expression changes slightly. Soon she calms down - offending a powerful minister like you over a few slave girls and gold coins isn't worth it, especially when she lacks concrete evidence... 
The anger vanishes from her face. Buthayna takes a deep breath and politely sees you out, pretending nothing happened.

You narrow your eyes slightly, set down your teacup, and ask her to repeat herself. 
Buthayna's expression changes slightly. Soon she calms down - offending you over a few slave girls and gold coins isn't worth it... not if she wants to continue operating in the Dark Alley. 
The anger vanishes from her face. Buthayna takes a deep breath and politely sees you out, pretending nothing happened.

You take out your money - twenty gold coins in total. 
Honestly, it's not enough, but Buthayna's face darkens as she decides not to pursue the matter further - after all, business requires maintaining goodwill. And so the matter passes.

Before she can make accusations, you turn the tables, berating her fiercely. 
You insist that when you entered the room, the four slave girls were already gone, and now what about your Sultan Card? Every day delayed brings you closer to your Execution Day - who will compensate for your lost time, your lost life? 
Buthayna's fury instantly subsides. She softens her stance, trying to appease you, promising various benefits. You reluctantly agree to let the matter drop, secretly delighted.

You insist you have nothing to do with this, but Buthayna doesn't believe you. Moreover, many clients saw you following the slave girls into the private room... 
Although no one dares stop you when you angrily leave, Buthayna can't swallow this insult. She complains to everyone, inciting nobles to speak ill of you at court... 
Tsk. This troublesome woman.
A Setup?

Buying four slave girls only to have them escape before you could enjoy them - laughable. 
After breaking this card, gossipers linger outside your home for days, observing closely whether you've secretly brought those legendary barbarian slave girls home...

5000818.title: Hunting the Hunters
strings: Hunting the Hunters
Riel cannot find those damned slave hunters on her own, so it's time for you to step in again.
Riel

Riel's actions attract attention... Not long after, she's found dead in some dark corner. Her underlings try to avenge her, but lacking leadership, they ultimately scatter.

He Probably Knows

Nabhani warmly receives you and Riel, serving pomegranate tea mixed with honey, plates of pastries and preserved fruits. 
Riel eats and drinks without restraint, completely disregarding appearances. She downs an entire jug of wine like water, wipes her mouth, and says: "I remember you - you and [player.name] bought me from slave traders. I'm grateful for your rescue and all your help, but to prevent more of my people from needing your 'rescue,' let's solve the problem at its root." Her eyes flash dangerously, saying viciously: "Let me be clear: I want to eat those slave hunters' livers." 
Nabhani pauses, as if never considering this an issue, then contemplates, "You want to catch them? Hmm... these hunters hide behind layers of transactions, likely part of a vast organization - some specialize in capturing barbarian girls, others in skilled rtisansa... but ultimately, they all report to the same 'boss.'" 
Here, Nabhani suspiciously hesitates, looking toward you, seemingly troubled: "I do know someone... who frequently hosts these slave girl sampling parties..." 
Before you can understand his hesitation, Riel's fury ignites. Nabhani desperately waves his hands to clarify: "Wait, I've never attended, I prefer mutual consent, I never engage in rape - hey, [player.name], back me up!" 
Uh... vouching for this seems somehow wrong, but you guarantee Nabhani's respect for women. Riel coldly draws the dagger from her waist, licks the blade, then forcefully stabs it into the floor. 
"I must kill these people. My sisters cannot be slaves." She struggles to suppress her rage, saying fiercely, "Please continue, I said please, noble sir." 
As the Sultan's Iron Guard and darling of noble ladies, Nabhani rarely looks so helpless... but seeing your determination, he reveals everything he knows, giving you an invitation to that sampling party before you leave...

You spend a large sum, discreetly seeking to purchase "the freshest, most special slave girls," preferably virgins... Under this aggressive financial assault, someone soon takes the bait, secretly slipping you a suspicious invitation...
With your help, Riel successfully obtains a suspicious invitation claiming that slave hunters have brought back a fresh batch of slave girls, to be revealed at this secret tea-party...
Smokescreens everywhere, false information everywhere. You're exhausted but have nothing to show for it.

Behind thick, expensive tapestries, a gathering is in full swing. 
You walk confidently into the banquet hall with your invitation. Every guest is richly dressed, affecting an air of refinement. You recognize each face from court meetings. Now, these seemingly upright faces all have naked slave girls kneeling beside them, either shy or humiliated - either way, pleasing to the men. 
Perhaps you stare too long, drawing more attention. Silence quickly spreads as these familiar associates eye you with suspicion and scrutiny, as you're an untrusted newcomer to this gathering.

You tell them you heard this place sells special slaves, and you need one to break this card. 
The crowd quickly relaxes - ha, who doesn't know about the unfortunate soul struggling with this problem? 
The party revives. An ordinary-looking man squeezes through the crowd to your side, exchanging pleasantries before asking: "What kind of slave would you like?" 
Ah, he must be the slave hunter you're looking for. You engage him, eloquently listing numerous requirements, creating an opportunity for your infiltrator...

You tell them you heard this place sells special slaves, as you're a player commanded to play the Sultan's Game, always needing someone to break those cursed cards. 
The crowd exchanges glances, then quickly relaxes - ha, who doesn't know about the unfortunate soul struggling with this problem? 
The party revives. An ordinary-looking man squeezes through the crowd to your side, exchanging pleasantries before asking: "What kind of slave would you like?" 
Ah, he must be the slave hunter you're looking for. You engage him, eloquently listing numerous requirements, creating an opportunity for your infiltrator...
You try explaining your intentions, but the crowd's eyes grow increasingly cold. The silence is broken only by the unmistakable sound of blades being drawn from their sheaths.

Your diversion works perfectly. While all eyes focus on you, [s3.name] slips into the mansion's depths, discovering a hidden chamber filled with ledgers and correspondence. The evidence is damning - detailed records of where slaves are captured and to whom they're sold. [s3.gender] gasps upon finding Vizier Abdul's signature throughout these documents. The second most powerful man in the realm is the puppet master behind this entire operation. Mission accomplished. With the evidence secured, [s3.gender(he,she)] signals you. 
A slight nod in return is all you need to execute the next phase of your plan...

[s3.name] squanders this perfect chance! Guards discover [s3.gender(him,her)], and instantly the atmosphere shifts. Everyone, including the slave hunter mid-conversation with you, regards you with cold suspicion. 
The silence is broken only by the unmistakable sound of blades being drawn from their sheaths.

This slave hunter is far from weak. Danger radiates from him, along with shrewd caution. Despite being in his own territory, his hand never strays from the ornate dagger at his waist. 
That blade - potentially poisoned, razor-sharp, or even enchanted - never gets the chance to strike. 
[s5.name] materializes like a phantom during your conversation, while everyone drinks at ease, and subdues him in one swift move! 
Guards immediately draw weapons but halt at the pale-faced slave hunter's command. Scanning the startled crowd, you offer a slight smile: "Perhaps we should continue our discussion somewhere more private." 
What he doesn't realize is that the moment he follows you to the chamber, Riel's fighters eliminate every guard who surrendered their weapons. Not that knowing would change anything - he has no choice.

[s5.name] fails! 
[s5.gender] underestimated this slave hunter - a dangerous man with the wariness of a veteran criminal. Even in his own sanctuary, while engaging with you, he remained vigilant, hand resting on his decorative but deadly dagger - which now gleams in the light! 
The blade clashes against [s5.name]'s curved sword. With one shout from the slave hunter, weapons throughout the hall are drawn, and every arrow points directly at you!

The hall fills with screams, wails, and death rattles. In the chaos, corpses lie beside platters of food, blood mingles with spilled wine. The slave hunter pleads desperately, incoherently offering wealth and women if you spare him. But Riel's blade is too swift. You watch as the barbarian expressionlessly cuts open his belly - while he still lives - pulling the quivering liver from amid fat and organs... 
You cannot bear to watch anymore. Though you failed to capture him alive, allowing Riel her personal vengeance isn't such a bad outcome. 
Regardless, you rescue numerous slaves who weep with gratitude to you and Riel. Word spreads quickly, earning you admiration among common folk - though the nobility is less pleased, especially those secretly supporting the slave hunters...

The hall fills with screams, wails, and death rattles. In the chaos, corpses lie beside platters of food, blood mingles with spilled wine. Despite your efforts, enemies continue pouring in like an endless tide. Finally, you reluctantly order a withdrawal. 
Fortunately, the slave hunter doesn't dare kill you to silence witnesses. You escape with your wounded companions, though both you and Riel clearly sense you'll never have another chance to capture these damned bastards.
[s4.gender] informs you about valuable clues [s4.gender(he,she)] gathered during conversations with one of the slaves.
Unfortunately, [s4.name], who infiltrated as a servant to chat with the slaves, brings back no valuable information.
A chaotic day ends. Not entirely fruitless.
This incident has made you too many enemies! Even knowing you're in the right, you can't avoid impeachment and accusations.

At the next court meeting, you calmly report to the Sultan how you disciplined the slaver after taking him to a hidden chamber: whatever he did to those poor slave girls, you did to him - of course, the intelligence he revealed while begging for mercy need not be mentioned here. 
The entire process wasn't erotic, rather quite cruel, but because your victim of excess was such a man, it added a certain comedy... 
For a moment, only your voice echoes through the Lapis Lazuli Palace, all courtiers keeping their heads down, none daring to speak, let alone impeach you. They simply can't match your audacity...

Although the slaver has been left in that state by Riel... you still closed your eyes and went through with it to break this card. 
The next day at court, you calmly report to the Sultan what you did. The process wasn't erotic - rather quite cruel, quite bloody, quite... Finally, someone can't help but vomit... 
The Sultan laughs heartily, pardoning his crime in good spirits. Of course, you successfully break this Carnality Card...

The next day you bring the slaver's severed head to the Lapis Lazuli Palace, naturally breaking this Bloodshed Card. 
The only thing worth mentioning is that Riel highly praises the liver of someone killed by a Bloodshed Card.

The next day at court, you find the owner of the blood-stained mansion and casually inform him that you've "cleared out" his tenants and now wish to purchase the property. The man trembles in fear, not daring to ask for payment. 
The Sultan laughs heartily and, considering all the bloodshed, allows you to break this Extravagance Card in this manner.

The next day at court, you respectfully report the details of this minor war to the Sultan. He looks with interest toward a certain courtier - though you dare not raise your head to see who - and you successfully break this Conquest Card. The Sultan, in particularly good spirits, even grants you the blood-stained mansion. 
No one dares raise any objection.

You meet his gaze with wide-eyed confusion, skillfully evading his probes before making a graceful exit. In the days that follow, Abdul's allies mount a coordinated campaign against you, poisoning the Sultan's ear with carefully crafted rumors. 
Let them scheme. Those responsible for such depravity will face justice eventually, no matter their station.

The mounted nomads arrive first, seeking revenge for past raids by slave hunters. They harass the city with guerrilla tactics, relying on their superior horsemanship. These tall warriors have sown unrest throughout the city.

The nomad slaves you and Riel rescued secretly left the city, using special methods to contact the band and find their kin. The nomads realized that you - who seemed reluctant to deploy forces against them despite their raids - are their ally. 
They swiftly dispersed on horseback, appearing to withdraw but perhaps seeking their true enemies. As thanks, they sent you an exquisitely crafted silver saddle.

You know these nomads have done no wrong; they've simply lost too much... but royal commands cannot be ignored. 
You prevailed, though victory has never tasted so bitter.
Your forces chase shadows, exhausting themselves without ever catching sight of the enemy... Your defeat is humiliating.
Anxious vagrants flood toward the capital, fearing enslavement and loss of their freeman status. They demand the king punish those responsible for their suffering.

You send those sheltered by Riel - who obtained identity papers with your help - to negotiate, promising to banish this darkness plaguing them. 
The troubled vagrants gradually disperse; war was never their intention. In this harsh land, survival is their only desire. 
Later, someone secretly informs you these previously enslaved freemen discovered a remote oasis where they've built their own paradise - a place that will always welcome you.

You know these vagrants have done no wrong; they simply fear losing more... but royal commands cannot be ignored. 
You prevailed, though victory has never tasted so bitter.

Inspired by these vagrants, many oppressed freemen within the city join their cause. You cannot bring yourself to eliminate them entirely and find yourself hindered, while they show no mercy - "Why pretend?" they challenge, "Aren't you just another self-righteous noble?"

The barbarian forces aren't the most numerous but they are the fiercest. Each warrior fights with the strength of ten and resists until death - traits evident in Riel's temperament. These formidable enemies now gather ominously, advancing toward the city...

Even as barbarian warriors drape a fur around your neck, you remain confused. 
Beside you, Riel smiles with delight: "When I returned with our rescued kin, they thought I was a hero. But I told them I am merely the hero's hand. The true hero is a city-dweller they dismiss, named [player.name]."

These barbarians pillage and murder along their path. Each conquered village becomes a site for bonfires, ritual dances, and feasts of bloody organs... 
For the safety of the surrounding populace, you must eliminate and drive them away. Regarding this matter, Riel maintains an uncharacteristic silence.

These barbarians pillage and murder along their path. Each conquered village becomes a site for bonfires, ritual dances, and feasts of bloody organs - from villagers and slain soldiers alike. The horror drains all fighting spirit from your troops; they scatter in retreat, and you are powerless to stop them.
Crushing a rebellion certainly merits a Conquest Card.
You successfully suppressed the uprising and returned triumphant. Now it's time to settle accounts with the true villain - Vizier Abdul.

You failed! How could you allow a rabble of insurgents to defeat you, damaging his people, buildings, wealth, and lands?! 
The Sultan burns with fury. He kicks you aside, dons his armor, and personally leads his guards across the battlefield, killing indiscriminately! The land becomes a scene of devastation, flowing with blood... All perish - yes, all - those who betrayed him deserve death, as do those who failed him! 
Your only consolation is that Vizier Abdul bears primary responsibility for this rebellion... If you keep your head down for a while, the Sultan might spare your life... perhaps...

Just for this reason alone, it's worth trying, isn't it? He's arrogant, off guard, and drunk - perhaps there won't be a better opportunity... 
Unexpectedly, your blade pierces his chest, skewering his heart together with a courtesan's hand. 
The tavern erupts in screams and chaos. Your ruthlessness and brutality spread throughout the kingdom, from the Sultan's halls to the slums' gutters. 
Yet when you report this to the Sultan, his mood unexpectedly lifts, repeatedly emitting mocking chuckles: "Well done, Lord [player.name], you've slain a lowly mercenary. Yes, let the records show exactly that." Perhaps unwittingly, you've done your sovereign a great service.

A golden warrior? Such figures rarely appear outside the Sultan's court. As a prostitute strokes his cheek, you seize the moment to drive your blade toward his eye. 
Your strike only manages to slice off the prostitute's fingertips and part of his scalp. The man flees, wildly swinging his golden sword that slices through metal with terrifying ease. A disappointing outcome, but at least the matter is settled.

Tales spread of a mysterious swordsman whose golden blade cuts iron like silk and moves faster than sight. Those who ambush him find themselves ambushed; those who surround him end up surrounded by corpses. He appears and vanishes like desert wind, and when his sword strikes flesh, people say the gods themselves sigh in pity.

Before you stand two men - a dishonorable silver-ranked schemer and a gold-ranked drunken brute. This game's hierarchy clearly values the wrong things. 
In this moment where honor plays no part, you cut the nobleman's throat from behind, letting blood pool across the table while toasting the golden swordsman. 
Your ruthlessness impresses the mercenary. He drains his cup, wipes his hands across a courtesan's bosom, and reaches toward you - he wants to join your next venture.

They must have belonged to someone of noble birth who had removed them on this hill, folding each piece carefully... What happened after, we can only guess.
Like a man possessed, the swordsman fled with these seemingly worthless relics, running beneath the night sky and wailing like a child... No one could catch him.

Black fragments from the burning grass and spirits danced wildly across the plains, sparks flying through the air like some terrible ceremony. 
The nameless Roaming Swordsman had been watching silently with your expedition when suddenly - the starlight flickered through smoke and ash, revealing truths only he could see - he snapped. Cursing and weeping, he charged sword-drawn into the flames... 
No one could stop him in time, nor did anyone dare follow him into that inferno... You all simply watched as he vanished into the wild dance of fire and ash.

The connection to the Homeland piqued the Sultan's interest somewhat... though he clearly scorned these spirits. After all, no matter how they haunt these plains, they could never harm their true enemy - the exalted Sultan himself.

She sneers, delivering a thorough whipping. While not entirely unpleasant... you know she had planned to teach you something far more interesting.

Clients come and go throughout the day... Eventually you collapse on stage, utterly spent, filthy and sticky with various fluids, clothes torn to rags. You look like a discarded plaything while everyone watching appears more dignified than you. The physical abuse would be bad enough, but having your pride repeatedly ground beneath their heels is worse. Your former self could never have imagined such torment - yet for the women who work here, this suffering is merely routine. 
Jalila stands over you, lightly flicking her whip across your skin. From your feeble response, she determines you can "work" no more. 
"That concludes our entertainment for today! Distinguished guests and worthless dogs alike - did you enjoy yourselves?" 
The audience roars with approval.
You drift into unconsciousness from exhaustion... When you awaken, you're in your mansion bedroom, thoroughly cleaned, with your "earnings" placed beside you. 
By unspoken agreement, no one ever mentions this game again.

As her final skeleton collapses and dissolves in the pool, the formerly sapphire-clear water has become pitch-black, churning with foul bubbles... You'd better flee quickly, before the god realizes someone has spat in its refreshing treat.

All the absurdity of endless debates and debacles has left the Sultan thoroughly exhausted, so he will probably relieve himself from the court for a few days.
Palace intrigues have made the Sultan somewhat weary.

You notice today that the position beside the Sultan is not vacant. 
The woman sitting beside him has ashen-pale skin and hair bright as sand. She silently, expressionlessly listens to the courtiers' clamor, serene as if from another world. 
Such astonishing beauty, you think, like a stone in a flattering palace. She shouldn't be here, but rather stand in an undying river or an unmelting snowy peak, serving a god who looks down once in a ten millennia. 
Yet here she is. 
You understand why the Sultan brought her – for this discordant sensation. He enjoys forcing someone into a misfit mold, watching them break. A strange empathy grips you. 
You are suddenly seized by an unfamiliar urge, as if you hover above, observing that beautiful heart, this land's ruler stripped of armor, roaming outside a heart's gate. In front of this bleeding heart, in this universally bitter rejection, you find yourself half her, half the Sultan's shadow. 
A chasm splits your heart and soul. Respectfully, you offer the Carnality Card, seeking closeness to her. 
You dare not raise your head, knowing full well the Sultan's black gaze brews rage, but Ansuya's tranquility fills your heart. You wish only for a rare glint of surprise in her eyes before welcoming the Sultan’s storm. 
However, no storm arrives. You hear the Sultan's strange, low chuckle. He toys with your card, "My dear Ansuya is worth a Bronze Card indeed." 
The Sultan admires Ansuya’s paleness, snapping the card with a crisp sound: "I permit this, but..." His cold gaze wraps your throat like a serpent. Smiling, he continues, "Ansuya, from which tribe? Balham or Tyria? Tyria's artisans excel in idol crafting. [s5.name], bring Tyria's statue for Ansuya to ease homesickness. Then she'll accompany you." 
You agree with no choice, but Ansuya shows neither gratitude nor scorn under the Sultan’s wild laughter, thanking stoically, more still than stonework. Only you see her fist clench, white as a jade blade.

You notice that the position beside the Sultan is not vacant today. 

Sadani, long absent from court, sits on where she was confidently again, scanning the courtiers with a look of mingled haughtiness and ostentation, whose repulsive gaze only became tender when it fell upon the Sultan. She gently peeled off the thin skins of the grapes with her delicate fingers, and placed one of the glistening fruits on a golden plate in the Sultan's hand.

The contrasting pride and humility met in her young face, and how similar it was to that of the courtiers who filled the hall! Who has not endeavored to please the Sultan with the power he has bestowed upon him? Yet none display such "love," so nauseatingly insincere.

You make your mind to uncover the facade, the Carnality Card sears inside you. You politely hold it to the Sultan, seeking closeness with Sadani.

But without even so much as a glance towards the card, the Sultan take it and throw it away, his grin wide, "That's fine, Sadani, accompany him."

"Impossible!" she bursts out, yet instantly regrets. How can the Sultan allow defiance? Her beautiful face with decent makeup drains of color as she kneels, pleading, her voice mixes fear, resentment, and reluctant coquettishness, "Your Majesty... [s5.name] brazenly entreats Your favor so openly. He is but a bug under your heel – unworthy of Your attention!"

"Haha... Seems Sadani isn't fond of you." The Sultan laughs deeply, yet as relief flits Sadani's face, he adds, unhurried, "I've heard of a beast troubling outside the city. Chop off its head; Sadani will rejoice."

"Your Majesty!" the consort pleads, but her eyes waver, hints of breaking, almost falling. The Sultan swats away her trembling hand, leaving the audience hall. As his robe brushed by casually, the grape-filled platter spills, fruit scattering over marble, their juice colorless and cold.

The Sultan regarded his companion, fingers idly manipulating the golden chains adorning her waist—each representing nights of exemplary service. "I shall accompany him, my sovereign," Zazie declared with arrogant confidence, "merely to demonstrate no man surpasses your excellence. I shall make your courtier kneel before me, confessing his presumption in approaching battlefields you've already conquered." The Sultan laughed appreciatively, casually caressing Zazie's buttocks before adding: "Ensure Zazie receives appropriate gifts to secure her favor before claiming her company."

"Ah, Fadia... not entirely impossible..." 
The Sultan smiled indulgently toward the slave girl beside him, her head bowed so deeply her expression vanished in shadow. 
"Without dear Fadia, my household might lack certain specialized services. My excellent Fadia possesses remarkable talents, doesn't she? Demonstrate your particular skills for my courtiers." 
The slave girl knelt gracefully, pouring fragrant ointment from her golden vessel onto her exposed chest, then meticulously cleansing the Sultan's feet with her anointed breasts, ensuring thorough application between toes using her nipples – performing these intimate services without hesitation or reluctance. 
"Observe – certain services other concubines refuse without severe punishment, Fadia performs without complaint. My proposition: I shall grant you temporary access to Fadia, provided you contribute equivalently talented slaves to my household. Reasonable, yes?" 
This statement constituted imperial command rather than negotiation. 
Both you and Fadia knelt in ceremonial acceptance.

You try to ask the Sultan for Arzuna, but—"No." The Sultan smiles as he refuses you, his eyes narrowing with a dangerous gleam. "I'm not tired of playing with her yet, my dear minister."
Well, then. You can only sulkily tuck away that card you've been holding.
You wish to use the Carnality Card on my woman; only one of exactly matching tier will suffice.

When you reveal the card of Bloodshed in the Sultan's court, everyone holds their breath.

After a moment of peace, you choose the one who just spoke on stage, Vizier Abdul. Facing the trembling Abdul, the Sultan permits him to call for help – it's more entertaining that way.

When you reveal the card of Bloodshed in the Sultan's palace, everyone stops breathing.
After enjoying the moment of silence, you point to the individual who just gave a speech. The courtiers buzz like a swarm of bees, while the Sultan smiles like a beekeeper:
He announces that the two of you will duel to the death in front of the throne tomorrow.

You place one foot on the steps of the Sultan's throne and show him the card with a coronation pattern. Now, you exercise the power granted to you by the game rules, and you aim to conquer the center of power...
Then, everything spins, and you see your beheaded body spurting blood, which gets absorbed by the crimson carpet as if falling into a void.

To the consort besides the Sultan, your words was something even in a milennia she could not expect. That mask of condescension and calmness goes stiff, then shattered like glasses after. She almost jumps, pointing at you with trembling fingers, try to organize a sentence but in vain.

"Cr..crazy...words...what...What are you talking about? Your majesty, please... I... He... He is a madman! Yes! He is a madman driven by the card game... Your MAJESTY!"

Hapless Sadani kneels at his feet, pallor on her panic-stricken face. The Sultan gazes down gently, caressing her soft, pale cheek, oh so beautiful as ever, lacking only a drop of blood embellishment. He smiles, "I'll investigate, nothing to worry about, Sadani."

Trembling harder, she knows his kindness never reaches the living... Despair-stricken, she stands abruptly, rushing the guard's side to wield a scimitar against you.

You narrowly dodge, chaos erupts. From his high throne, the Sultan looks on, amused by the spectacle. At last, Sadani collapses, she has left only screams and curses, filling the air until she was pulled away. The crying of women dissapears, alongside it something everyone can imagine. An expected disappearance – your goal achieved. Tidying yourself, you present the card painted with sacrifice.

The Sultan, impressed by your nerve, stares at you while breaking the card, the sound of its snap akin to a broken bone.

The Sultan toys with it, but stares at you. "How do you know I would definitely kill her?"

You bow low respectfully, "Your majesty is so powerful that everyone submits to you. Why would you need an heir to share your power?"

The Sultan nods thoughtfully, "Very well, then personally give this dagger to the her."

You have no choice but to comply. You carry the accompanying guards through the wide and intricate stone path of the harem, arriving in front of Sadani's palace. The consort looks at you in surprise, unable to believe what she heard: "You're betraying me? At such a time... Ha! Men... Very well, very well!" She slowly pulls out the gold dagger from the tray, then suddenly attacks you.

You, catch off guard and forgetting to dodge, have the blade stopped by Royal Guard Captain Seliman. He looked at the consort and shook his head almost imperceptibly, and then looked at you. "Sir, please wait here. Sadani the consort is, after all, a royal figure. She need not do anything in public." His dark, steadfast eyes are particularly convincing to you in your state of shock. You watch him lead the consort into the room, and after a while, the door opens again, and only Seliman comes out. He places the blood-stained dagger back on the gold tray expressionlessly.

You return it to the Sultan, who doesn't take a second glance and happily breaks the card.

To the consort besides the Sultan, your words was something even in a milennia she could not expect. That mask of condescension and calmness goes stiff, then shattered like glasses after. She almost jumps, pointing at you with trembling fingers, try to organize a sentence but in vain.

"Cr..crazy...words...what...What are you talking about? Your majesty, please... I... He... He is a madman! Yes! He is a madman driven by the card game... Your MAJESTY!"

Hapless Sadani kneels at his feet, pallor on her panic-stricken face. The Sultan gazes down gently, caressing her soft, pale cheek, oh so beautiful as ever, lacking only a drop of blood embellishment. He smiles, "I'll investigate, nothing to worry about, Sadani."

Trembling harder, she knows his kindness never reaches the living... Despair-stricken, she stands abruptly, rushing the guard's side to wield a scimitar against you.

You narrowly dodge, chaos erupts. From his high throne, the Sultan looks on, amused by the spectacle. At last, Sadani collapses, she has left only screams and curses, filling the air until she was pulled away. The crying of women dissapears, alongside it something everyone can imagine. An expected disappearance. 

Your work is done.

You reported Sadani's secret to the Sultan, but the Sultan reacted indifferently, 'Is that so? I see.' He tapped the armrest of the throne lightly, saying no more. A few days later, you heard that a woman’s corpse, with its abdomen hollowed out, was found outside the city, possibly chewed by wild dogs.
You recount the assassination of the Royal Guard Captain to the Sultan and hoped to break a Bloodshed Card. The Sultan agrees.

You presented conclusive evidence of his crimes to the Sultan, castigating him for his atrocities against humanity and disdain for life.
'Indeed? How many died?'
'Seventy-seven slave girls.'
'Were they beautiful?'
'Well... I don't know.'
The Sultan's interest immediately waned, as he leaned back against the throne, idly twirling his gem ring.
How simple was the logic. Humans are not born equal, how do seventy-seven corpses compare to a useful tool? You felt a chill, but you did not intend to retreat. You bowed again to the Sultan. 'I request your permission for this trial to offset a card from your great hand.'
The Sultan stared at you for a while, then finally smiled. He waved his hand and granted you permission.

Nawfal vehemently opposed everything you said and did. He even proposed ending this chaotic game to the Sultan, but was rejected. you are admittedly the protagonist of a game of stolen power, but isn't that the Sultan's game as well? Until the Sultan grows weary, you still have a chance.
Arzuna no longer bothers to veil her malice toward you. With her whispering in the Sultan's ear, he is more than happy to go along, adding fresh torments, new pressures, just for you.
Sending someone there has at least one benefit – you can receive useful intelligence in real-time.
Lady Becky sometimes unexpectedly gets rewarded for doing something herself.
Being far from the center of the whirlpool of power often makes it easier to be drawn into the abyss.
There was nothing new about the way you used the Bloodshed Card, so the Sultan rejected it.

Your action of taking out the Card of Carnality surprises the Sultan, but he soon laughs. He appreciates your audacity, but refuses to share this toy with you; he hasn't finished with it yet – accompanied by the master's words, the thing wrapped in golden chains lets out an eerie whimper.
The Sultan gracefully accepted your offering; he was pleased to see your loyalty.
The Sultan gracefully accepted your offering, but your humility didn't conclude this game. You realized that perhaps these things needed to be placed in more useful areas.
The luxurious attire of the nobles provided Jenna with jewelry design inspiration.
The Sultan expresses considerable interest in your "exceptionally beautiful sister." He eagerly accepts your offering and pledges to elevate her to concubine status.
The Sultan is very satisfied!
You charmed the Sultan, and for some time, the Sultan will support you.

Walking in the Sultan's palace feels like breaking through cobwebs, moving through the gaze of the ministers. In this game, more and more things entangle you...
