Before court is dismissed, you bring up what Adila once mentioned about the dragon's curse. The Sultan doesn’t even lift an eyelid at your words.
“Of course, I know about this,” he says. “The former king even married one of their women. But if the dragon’s curse means they can’t bear sons, what use is a concubine who can’t produce an heir to the throne?”
He waves his hand dismissively. The topic clearly fails to spark his interest.

The Sultan is deeply satisfied with your devotion – he couldn’t be more pleased!

He pardons all your crimes and even grants you the extraordinary privilege of breaking a Sultan Card. The task on the card? He will personally take care of it.

Such a magnificent gift – never before seen.

With effortless grace, Shagi convinced the Sultan of your clownish inadequacy – particularly emphasizing your bedroom shortcomings. What threat could such an emasculated figure possibly present? Consequently, transgressions normally provoking royal wrath received surprising dismissal.
You crawl to the center of the lapis lazuli hall, fabricating your own crimes, without surprise; the Sultan offers you a cruel opportunity... at least it will dissipate some of his accumulated anger.
You crawl to the center of the lapis lazuli hall, confessing your crimes. The Sultan laughs: "We must punish you properly."

Jabal stares at you in disbelief, his face quickly turning ashen.
The Sultan seems to relish his despair and dejection. The great ruler casually gestures with his hand, then makes another ambiguous motion.
While you are still trying to decipher the Sultan’s intentions, Jabal lets out a heavy sigh and steps forward to face you.
“It was you who exposed me, so I think this is fair,” he says. “The Sultan has ordered me to challenge someone to a duel in court. If I win, my punishment for secretly participating in underground fights will be lifted…”
He assumes a combat stance.
“Draw your weapon. I, Jabal, will not fight an unarmed opponent.”

The Sultan holds the scale with two fingers, glances towards your prostrate position, and lightly throws it away. The scale spins over in an arc, finally embedding in the palace beams, you notice a blood streak cut across your cheek. "Everything in the world is my property. You dared to take without permission and let that creature escape? Such a waste! This punishment is but a fraction of what I should rightfully mette, now get out!" 

The next day, stories of you leading a team to defeat the Fire Dragon begin to spread in the city.

An old hereditary right, which isn’t a topic the Sultan is most interested in. You can only approach it from other topics, saying you wish to buy a hereditary noble title for a capable assistant as a reward...

The Sultan listened with uncharacteristic attention before inexplicably smiling. 
While confusion clouded your thoughts, he languidly explained that all nobles – both their lives and authority – constitute royal property, and years prior, he had transferred this particular title to Jawad – indeed, the same individual creating recent complications. 
He observed your reaction with predatory interest, eyes gleaming with dangerous amusement – clearly communicating that reclaiming Qais's identity paper from Jawad necessitates eliminating this adversary – the Sultan eagerly anticipates your response.

He listens attentively for a while, then waves his hand, telling you it is not feasible.
All the nobles – their lives and their authority – are the Sultan’s Property. A few years ago, he already sold this title to a noble, apparently buying it for his daughter.

With the situation as it is, you can only bow and leave, thinking of another way to help Qais.

He impatiently orders you to silence, the courtiers; scared like cicadas in winter, are fearful that the Sultan's fury will affect them. Their resentful eyes pin you from behind, cursing the trouble you've caused! And you know, you'll never have the chance to inquire about it again, lest you wish to lose your head.
Before his anger erupts, you wisely step back... The gazes of the court fall upon your sweat-soaked back, as if mocking you.

Clinging to his last hope, Fardak gathers his courage and kneels before the Sultan just as the court draws to a close. He pleads to return home to his aging parents. But as expected, the Sultan dismisses his request with lazy indifference.

The poor youth begs, promises, and weeps – all in vain. Such displays never fail to amuse the Sultan. The more sincere Fardak's desperation, the more his sovereign relishes the torment - for these are emotions the Sultan has never felt, nor could he understand.
The few gold coins that the blessing brings mean nothing to the Sultan, yet he relishes your practiced flattery.

When others whisper that the Sultan's misdeeds have brought the eclipse, you boldly claim that while eclipses may occur naturally, only the ruler's magnificence can command the sun's return. Though this notion is utterly ridiculous, you have formulas, observation records, and complex calculations. Who would dare deny the Sultan possesses such a grand character?

When the others whispered that the Sultan's misdeeds had summoned a lunar eclipse, you smiled and said, “Even the moon knows to bathe itself in blood to offer the Sultan a spectacle worthy of his favor.” No one dared contradict you—after all, not everyone's head can vanish and reappear like the moon.

The one dressed in costume isn't a true rebel, but a fool meant to amuse the Sultan with bizarre folklore – or at least, that was the plan.

But now, the King of Flames emerges in the center of the Lapis Palace. Through its crude mask, it locks eyes with the Sultan, neither kneeling nor speaking. The strange tension spreads through the hall, and the murmurs of the court fade into silence. Whispers give way to unease as a dark smile creeps across the Sultan's face.

The blazing sun outside is suddenly obscured by dark clouds. Within this momentary darkness, Shadows writhe across the walls. The tyrant's ravenous aura envelops the palace with shapes of bestial madness. And as if provoked by this overwhelming malevolence, the King of Flames begins to convulse. It shakes its red mane, made of tattered rags, and lets out a low, leonine roar – a voice you no longer recognize.

Just as you prepare to intervene, the King of Flames draws a sword – a weapon that the Sultan's Iron Guards had carefully inspected, meant to be nothing more than a piece of broken wood. But now, it gleams with a terrifying, icy radiance, transformed into a divine blade sharp enough to cut through anything. The Sultan's eyes light up with unbridled joy. His laughter echoes through the hall, shaking the beams above and sending his guards retreating. The Warrior King would face this supernatural challenger himself.

As the first rays of sunlight pierce the dark clouds and light up the grand hall once more, the King of Flames's sword and body ignite in holy fire. This is a power granted by the heavens and the earth, by the tormented masses and the extinguished souls of the damned – a force meant to challenge the evils of this world. With great strides, it charges up the Sultan's golden steps, scorching the carpet, shattering the tiles, and swings its sword with all its might at the Sultan – only to have it parried by the Sultan's short blade.

The Warrior King and the burning figure intertwine in lethal combat, locked in a grotesque yet magnificent dance of death. Around them, slaves and servants scream as they are torn apart by the whirlwind of steel and flames, leaving nothing but bloody ruin. The nobles cower in the corners, watching as the Sultan's maniacal laughter mingles with the furious roars of the King of Flames.

At last, as if the dance has abruptly ended, the head of King of Flames soars into the air, its defiant, writhing body collapsing to the ground in a heap of ashes.

Today, the Sultan seems reborn, invigorated by the battle, while the court is reminded of memories buried under years of prosperity. The Sultan rewards you with a single gold coin for the brutal spectacle.

Not long after, you hear that the beauty you gifted to the Sultan met a tragic end in a dispute. She had dared to steal the concubine's jeweled slippers and was caught red-handed by the eunuch. She was then swiftly cut in half on the spot. The Sultan watched the entire spectacle with great delight. 

Be grateful – neither the concubine nor the Sultan chose to vent their anger on you... this time...

When you release the succubus in the palace center, letting dark, sweet-coppery power flow unrestrained, everyone falls into momentary hallucinations - except the Sultan. 
He observes his courtiers' infatuated states with subtle cruelty. Intrigued, he beckons you to bring the creature before him, wanting to touch its oil-like skin and discover what generates such power beneath its mist-shrouded face.
The Sultan graciously accepts the gauze you present to him, though, of course, he will not pay for it.

On your advice, Fardak and Lumera come before the Sultan, kneel, and request the Sultan's permission to return home and hold another wedding as per tradition.

After hearing their request, the Sultan's first command is for Lumera to raise her head. His sinister gaze lingers over the bride as he makes some lewd remarks. Suddenly, a cunning idea crosses his mind, and he grants their request with a nod.

"However," he wags a finger at Fardak, "you must return within a week – of course, I wouldn't mind if she came instead. My court simply cannot do without you... I like you so much, haha!" He laughs.

Fardak turns pale, knowing all too well the Sultan's will is as unyielding as steel. As they retreat from the cold lapis lazuli palace, Lumera's comforting hand on his shoulder, they pretend not to feel the Sultan's amused yet menacing gaze following their every step.

You know this evidence insufficient to topple the esteemed Vizier, yet you proceed anyway, determined he should face some consequence, however minor, for those poor slave girls. 
Thus begins a prolonged verbal war at court. You and the Vizier's faction engage in fierce debate until exhaustion as slander and schemes against you multiply endlessly. You persist almost purely on principle. 
Until one day, amid your heated exchange, Nawfal kneels before the Sultan, presenting incontrovertible physical evidence... 
You're astonished - no wonder he's been so quiet lately, secretly building a case while the Vizier focused on countering you. The Sultan smiles, casually examining the thick dossier before his gaze briefly passes over Nawfal to settle on Abdul's ashen face. 
"You've grown old, Abdul." This gentle statement alone terrifies the Vizier, who instantly prostrates himself, neither daring to defend nor beg mercy, like a trembling lamb awaiting slaughter. 
"Why such fear? Aren't you my most beloved Vizier? Lord [player.name], help him up." The Sultan commands, and you naturally obey. Whatever price Abdul later paid remains unknown - he keeps his position as Vizier, while Nawfal continues his cold disdain toward you... Outwardly nothing changes, yet something in the unseen currents has shifted direction.

You eloquently denounce former Vizier Abdul's misdeeds in the Lapis Lazuli Palace, with no one defending his memory. Then, respectfully kneeling, you suggest his grave offenses shouldn't be dismissed merely because of his death. The Sultan readily grants your request to confiscate his estate. 
Though the gold never reaches your purse, your sense of justice feels satisfied.

"Ah... the Highland Realm's Oath of Gilded Blood! My father never obtained this sword, leaving certain fools resistant to his rule... But now I possess it! My most loyal subject has presented it to me!" 
He eagerly draws the treasured blade, effortlessly sinking it into a guard's skull and slowly pulling through. Amid what might be the sword's or the man's lament, the Sultan rewards you handsomely.
The Sultan smiles coldly while examining this parchment filled with rebels' names... You truly are his favorite courtier, providing such an extensive killing list!

"Such outdated fashion... only ancient women from the previous dynasty would wear this. Ah, I recall one who did... As a child, I watched my father enjoy her services." He giggles before carelessly tossing the gold-embroidered garments to a eunuch. "Place these in the eunuchs' latrine - their appropriate location." He dismisses the matter with a wave. Nevertheless, your actions again demonstrate your loyalty.

You could have removed a Carnality Card of Silver tier at most, but you brought none. 
The Sultan shows extraordinary interest in this artwork. His unconcealed appreciation and delight are obvious - offering an actual beauty might not please him this much! 
However, others viewing the painting appear shocked and alarmed. You overhear whispers in the Lapis Lazuli Palace - something about wounds, blood, nails, and ropes?

The Sultan shows extraordinary interest in this artwork. His unconcealed appreciation and delight are obvious - offering an actual beauty might not please him this much! 
However, others viewing the painting appear shocked and alarmed. You overhear whispers in the Lapis Lazuli Palace - something about wounds, blood, nails, and ropes? 
You completely fail to understand how this relates to your creation. Regardless, both the Sultan and the female magician acknowledge it as an excellent expression of desire.

The Sultan shows extraordinary interest in this artwork. His unconcealed appreciation and delight are obvious - only another king's severed head could bring him such joy! 
He lavishly praises how you've portrayed him as divine and majestic, seemingly blessed by legendary wise kings and heroes, yet maintaining a warrior's vigor - clearly only you understand his true essence! 
Naturally, the courtiers and royal painters find the artwork less impressive, but who would interrupt the Sultan's pleasure? Who would dare suggest they see anything inauspicious?

When rumors of your impotence circulate through court, the Sultan's gaze toward you softens notably. Occasionally, he interrupts topics to tease you - one of his rare jokes that doesn't result in someone's death. The courtiers appear shocked, then enlightened - apparently, impotence is a courtier's true blessing!

The Sultan finds your boldness amusing. He scolds your disrespectful behavior, ordering the scribe to record Lord [player.name]'s shameful deed in imperial chronicles... Yet everyone sees the Sultan hasn't been this delighted in ages, and he discreetly accepts your offering of pleasure-enhancing items.

The Sultan, unusually cheerful, speaks with you longer after court. Every noble wishing to maintain position deliberately slows their departure, straining to overhear. You flatter him endlessly, making him laugh by mocking yourself, then subtly mention Zazie... "Ah, yes, Zazie mentioned your inadequacies - finishing before even beginning, ha... The thought alone amuses me. You always know how to entertain me, my lord." He chuckles before suddenly recalling something. "Actually, Zazie has been particularly charming lately... Arrange my palanquin - I'm visiting the Old Rose Garden." You sigh with relief; the rest depends on the favorite's own talents.

The Sultan laughs heartily at your pleasure aids: What true sovereign needs artificial assistance with women? His own magnificence suffices! However, his gaze shifts, "Ah, yes, Zazie mentioned your trinkets... but your own inadequacies - finishing before even beginning, ha... Just recalling it amuses me. You always know how to entertain me, my lord." He chuckles before suddenly remembering, "Actually, Zazie has been particularly charming lately... Arrange my palanquin - I'm visiting the Old Rose Garden." - Taking your recently presented items, naturally... The rest depends on the favorite's own talents.

You know the two most beautiful women in the harem are locked in their fiercest struggle yet. And isn't this precisely Zazie's chance to accomplish something else? You merely glance her way, and she understands at once. Those things she could never quite conceal during the nights when she alone held the Sultan's favor... well, if another woman happens to be right there by the bed, drawing his attention away? That makes things far simpler.
Zazie flashes you a smile. Sweet, seductive. She has a plan now.

You watch Arzuna curl up beside the Sultan, all charm and allure, draped in pure gold. And it strikes you: the two most beautiful women in the harem are locked in their fiercest struggle yet. Which means... isn't this precisely Zazie's chance to accomplish something else?
Seems Zazie doesn't need your help after all to solve that problem that's been plaguing her. Those things she could never quite hide when she alone held the Sultan's favor? Well. If another woman happens to be right there by the bed, drawing his attention away... that makes things far simpler.
Having pieced it together, you send word to the favored one in the palace. The rest is up to her.

The Sultan dismisses you with a scornful laugh. Listen to yourself - asking the great Sultan to support a weak little god who dares not show their face after being crushed by the Purist, whom his ancestors have worshipped for generations?

[s4.name]'s careless gesture exposed the secret upon his chest - a nipple chain identical to the Sultan's.
Before any entreaty could be voiced, his head fell amid the sovereign's eerie laughter.

[s5.name]'s careless gesture exposed the secret upon his chest - a nipple chain identical to the Sultan's.
Before any entreaty could be voiced, his head fell amid the sovereign's eerie laughter.

When silk was lifted to reveal your offering, the Sultan laughed peculiarly. After brief commendation, he gestured for its removal. The following day, you learned the Sultan's court jewelers had been executed - every single one.

You presented this seemingly mundane stone to the Sultan, but just as you began expounding its marvels, you discovered with horror that the inner flame had died! Yet you certainly couldn't admit this was merely a worthless mountain rock! You frantically improvised stirring legends and fantastical tales, claiming it could bestow longevity and eternal dominion... Eventually, the Sultan's face showed a subtle smile. He languidly dismissed you - considering your entertaining speech, he overlooked this worthless stone's deception.

Unusually, the supreme sovereign remarked upon [s4.name]'s court attire—a terrifying distinction indeed! He spoke with fascination about that vanished kingdom's customs, primarily concerning sacred prostitutes and forbidden ceremonies... The attending nobles matched the Sultan's mood with cruder jests, praising the sovereign's erudition and wisdom, while [s4.name] became a helpless specimen until their entertainment concluded... Naturally, many regard such manipulation by the Sultan as enviable favor.

Unusually, the supreme sovereign remarked upon [s5.name]'s court attire—a terrifying distinction indeed! He spoke with fascination about that vanished kingdom's customs, primarily concerning sacred prostitutes and forbidden ceremonies... The attending nobles matched the Sultan's mood with cruder jests, praising the sovereign's erudition and wisdom, while [s5.name] became a helpless specimen until their entertainment concluded... Naturally, many regard such manipulation by the Sultan as enviable favor.

Astonishingly, the Sultan knew the history behind this serpent chain. He inquired about your temple expedition and specifically whether you witnessed the legendary sacred prostitute's appearance.
Then he seized this tribute and hurled it at an attending noblewoman - at the supreme Sultan's command, this malevolent magical artifact immediately began coiling, piercing, tormenting, and stimulating this defenseless woman... Her moans and screams proved quite memorable.

Unusually, the supreme sovereign remarked upon [s4.name]'s court attire—a terrifying distinction indeed! He spoke with fascination about that vanished kingdom's customs, primarily concerning sacred prostitutes and forbidden ceremonies... The attending nobles matched the Sultan's mood with cruder jests, praising the sovereign's erudition and wisdom, while [s4.name] became a helpless specimen until their entertainment concluded... The Sultan also ordered his men to approach [s4.name] and examine the lewd illusions closely... Naturally, many regard such manipulation by the Sultan as enviable favor.

Unusually, the supreme sovereign remarked upon [s5.name]'s court attire—a terrifying distinction indeed! He spoke with fascination about that vanished kingdom's customs, primarily concerning sacred prostitutes and forbidden ceremonies... The attending nobles matched the Sultan's mood with cruder jests, praising the sovereign's erudition and wisdom, while [s5.name] became a helpless specimen until their entertainment concluded... The Sultan also ordered his men to approach [s5.name] and examine the lewd illusions closely... Naturally, many regard such manipulation by the Sultan as enviable favor.

If it can eliminate even [player.name]'s lustful traces, could the Purist restore my harem's debauched women to pure maidenhood? What delightful entertainment that would provide!
[s4.name] quickly prostrated, promising the Sultan various miracles of the Immaculate Purity... until the Sultan tired of laughing and this undignified audience concluded.

If it can eliminate even [player.name]'s lustful traces, could the Purist restore my harem's debauched women to pure maidenhood? What delightful entertainment that would provide!
[s5.name] quickly prostrated, promising the Sultan various miracles of the Immaculate Purity... until the Sultan tired of laughing and this undignified audience concluded.

This sacred artifact deserves to praise the sovereign's virtue, symbolizing the Purist's mercy and wisdom... Before you finished speaking, the serpent chain began writhing strangely under the Sultan's manipulation, and the once-purified lewd visions reappeared faintly throughout the Lapis Lazuli Hall... Fortunately, the Sultan possesses his own peculiar humor - he lavishly praised [player.name]'s religious leader wisdom and accepted this gift into the harem.

As you requested, [xiaochou.name] went to see the Sultan... Of course, no one saw through its guise. Like any highborn lord, [xiaochou.name] stood in the hall of lapis lazuli, lost among the crowd, bowing before the Sultan’s majesty.
And so [xiaochou.name] saw—in the mirror-smooth floor polished by countless knees, in the trembling eyes of the courtiers, in the blood-scented spears of the guards, in the dark shadows of that cursed crown... the beast called Sultan, driven to frenzy by an insatiable hunger for conquest.
“What pitiful creatures humans are! Always placing such ravenous ambition upon the throne! And when that ambition cannot be sated, they themselves become the king’s morsels...” Upon returning from court, [xiaochou.name] shared this verdict with you—and hoped you never send it back to that wretched place again.

You report this secret pamphlet to the Sultan, denouncing its heretical ideas with fiery words. But your speech merely draws a great yawn. With a bored wave, the Sultan orders you to handle the matter yourself, then ends the audience.
Yet his indifference leaves you uneasy. How can you still win his satisfaction?

Poison from the fallen kingdom! A sister left unpurged! Double fortune! The Sultan rewards you so lavishly that your carriage sags under the weight of treasure, the horses straining to pull it. Wedged among your Gold Coins, you sway homeward, praying it was all worth the cost.

Poison from the fallen kingdom! A sister left unpurged! Double fortune! The Sultan is delighted... But then he notices your name etched on the bracelet—your name, scrawled by countless commoners atop the names of royalty. An abomination, an unforgivable trespass! [player.name], you...
With a cold smile, he orders the eunuchs to pour you a cup of wine—an honor you cannot refuse.

The Sultan turns it over in his hand, then studies you in silence, as though deciding whether to have you executed.
You hurriedly explain: the coin is filled with lead, proof that someone seeks to undermine his realm.
The Sultan's wrath flares. He hurls the coin at a tax collector, splitting his brow, then orders you to find the culprit and bring him back in chains—or his head, without trial.
The court falls silent under a pall of dread. You withdraw with the bloodstained coin.

The Sultan turns it over in his hand, then studies you in silence, as though deciding whether to have you executed.
You hurriedly explain: the coin is filled with lead, proof that someone seeks to undermine his realm.
The Sultan's wrath flares. He hurls the coin at a tax collector, splitting his brow, then orders you to find the culprit and bring him back in chains—or his head, without trial.
The court falls silent under a pall of dread. You withdraw with the bloodstained coin, already aware this will become yet another unsolved case.

The Sultan has expected your so-called "poison from the fallen kingdom" to be something intriguing. Instead, you present a frail child...
"This can't feed a lion for a single meal," he scoffs. "Half a meal, at best."
That evening, the court lion proves him right: along with Anita, it devoured an entire lamb!

As the audience nears its end, nobles bow their heads, guards stand rigid, slave girls and eunuchs prostrate themselves, all eager to vanish from the Sultan's sight. A trembling eunuch creeps forward on his knees. He offers a bundle. Inside lies a shapeless mass of flesh: the corpse of a premature infant, a placenta, a smear of blood and soil.
Instinctively, you raise your eyes toward the master on the golden throne... and, unfortunately, he notices your glance.
"Ah, my faithful one, [player.name]." the Sultan says with a cold smile. "Just in time. I have a task for a capable servant." His voice moves slowly, each word striking the spine of everyone present. "A woman in my harem has secretly rid herself of a child. Curious, isn't it? Only recently, I heard whispers of women seeking abortive potions. And now, this morning—ha—an actual dead child. What a surprise. I have not been surprised in a long time. Don't you agree, my loyal one?"
Sweat runs down your temple as he continues. "Today I plan to execute the court physician. Of course, the mother will soon join her child. This matter is yours to investigate."
You lift your face, forcing an expression of honest devotion. Whomever the child belonged to, you must find a way to win time for Samir.

You kneel and beg the Sultan to spare the physician. He is the only lead in this case, the only suspected supplier of the abortive potion. Without him, must you dare to enter the harem and question his women one by one? Such insolence would mean your death.
Your trembling, tear-choked pleas almost amuse him. You quickly declare your loyalty and swear to pry open the physician's lips and expose the woman who defiled the harem—a woman who deserves death ten thousand times over.
The Sultan listens, watching your performance. At last he curls his lips into a faint smile. "Very well, my loyal one. Five days. Satisfy me, or die with him."
He rises from the throne and departs. The audience ends. Courtiers ebb away like the sea. You wipe the sweat from your brow; at least for today, both you and Samir still live...

You beg the Sultan to spare Samir, but his mind is set. If you must rely on this physician to uncover the truth, then you are weak. With a dismissive wave, he assigns the investigation to another servant—a thankless, perilous task that may cost its holder's head. Is this a stroke of luck for you? For Samir it is not...
The audience ends. Courtiers ebb away like the sea, leaving you kneeling on the lapis lazuli tiled floor, and you're like a stranded fish on the sand.

The Sultan laughs aloud, even deigning to step down from the golden stair and clap you on the shoulder. "Excellent! Excellent!" he proclaims, showering you with praise before leading the court to inspect his newly won treasures. For a moment, you stand in the very center of favor.

You present a diamond, explaining that you acquired it from foreign merchants trading on your estates. The Sultan listens absently, examining the stone, then nods.
He clearly does not believe your tale of merchants... but at least he is pleased with the gift.

When the audience ends and people file out, they see Jenna—resplendent in jewels—waiting respectfully before your litter. At your subtle signal, several courtiers strain their memories for her name and begin praising her work. Of course, they have no idea what she has made before. But the jewels she holds, wears, and has prepared for you are beautiful enough.
Everyone murmurs that they make you seem young, formidable, and full of power. Yet you know their thoughts: perhaps, if they too wore such jewels, they might hold their heads as high as you do before the court.
That very night, nobles already start asking about "the woman who crafts jewels for Lord [player.name]."

This day you notice a bold ruby necklace on the pale neck of Consort Ansuya. Its design is unmistakably Jenna's. The jewel suits her poorly, yet whenever you glance at her, she lightly strokes it... Could it be that the "consort" order Jenna once received came from Ansuya herself?
After the audience, you question a eunuch who owes you a favor. He tells you a story whispered through the palace:
A woman once briefly favored by the Sultan has passed her prime yet dreams of returning to his bed. She commissions a jewel from the city's famed artisan, claiming to be a royal consort...
The artisan sees through the lie and gives her only a ruby necklace. It is beautiful and brilliant enough to recall a trace of her faded youth. Before a mirror she gazes at herself—ruby at her throat, crimson gown about her body—and suddenly bursts into tears. Perhaps she recalls the days when she first arrived in this empire as the dowry slave of Ansuya—the radiant princess in her wedding robes, and herself, a few years older, who had grown up at the princess's side. In those days she strives to protect her little princess, as though she were both sister and mother to her. What happened after? Why now this desperate longing for the Sultan's favor? A single drunken night with him nearly destroyed what she truly cherished... At last, her empty dream runs out with her tears.
She presents the necklace to Consort Ansuya, wipes off her heavy paint, and returns to the consort's apartments as a servant once more.
The tale leaves you thoughtful.

This day you notice Consort Sadani displaying a fine bracelet set with sapphire... That's Jenna's work! Could she be the mysterious "consort" who placed the order?
After the audience, you question a eunuch who owes you a favor. He tells you a story whispered through the palace:
A woman once briefly favored by the Sultan has passed her prime yet dreams of returning to his bed. She commissions a jewel from the city's famed artisan, claiming to be a royal consort...
The artisan fashions a piece with a splendid sapphire... The woman hurries to adorn herself and go to the Sultan, but first she meets Consort Sadani.
Sadani listens, then gives a cold smile: if she dances before the Sultan so attired she may lose her life... Has she forgotten where Zazie's jewels came from? That spider-woman loves nothing more than taking other women's treasures.
Shaken, the woman thanks Consort Sadani through tears and throws herself at her feet, begging something you cannot guess... In the end she gives the bracelet to Sadani. No one sees her again. In the harem, women too old and unseen by the Sultan are as transparent as air... Perhaps she has been sent away from the palace. Hmm, just a guess!
The story leaves you pensive.

Today you notice a diamond ring on [s3.name]'s finger, so large it verges on the "outrageous." It is unmistakably one of Jenna's recent creations. The favored consort seems in excellent spirits. Could it be that the mysterious order "from a certain consort" actually came from [s3.name]?
With this thought in mind, you question a eunuch who owes you a favor after the audience. He tells you a story whispered through the palace:
A woman once briefly favored by the Sultan has passed her prime yet dreams of returning to his bed. She commissions a jewel from the city's famed artisan, claiming to be a royal consort...
The artisan actually believes her and fashions a piece with an enormous diamond... Overjoyed, the woman hurries to flaunt it before the Sultan. Yet the Sultan decides that such a magnificent treasure, if not his own, should at least adorn the woman who currently pleases him most.
[s3.name]'s collection gains a new gem. As for that woman, she vanishes without a trace.
The story leaves you silent for a long time.
The Sultan is pleased with your gift. As for the other "tiger treasure," he receives them gladly as well.
The Sultan is pleased with your gift and receives it gladly.

One secret pulls out another secret, and in the exploration process, you're not sure if you're closer to or further from the truth.
The inner philosophy of things is mostly universal; you've peered through to deeper mysteries.
No one can win always, but you now have confidence in catching more leaves when the wind blows.
Suddenly, you realize what's behind those secretive glances and smiles.
The murmured exchanges among colleagues dissolve into holy silence, and flashes of the future flicker before your eyes, but upon deep thought, they remain a blur.
Your past battle experience and knowledge slowly integrate through conversations with colleagues.
The splendid stories are inevitably wrapped in lies and fabrications, adding an air of mystery.
All fear will find an exit – those oppressed can't help but ask, "how can we gain freedom?"
All questions will have their answers, like how a stream naturally becomes a river as it flows.
More and more people gather around you, uneasy and restless, daggers in hand thirst for the unjust ruler's blood.
A few strands of Impure Thoughts tempt people, drawing them to you, leading you all into mysterious and dangerous darkness.
Certain corners of the court are perpetually sunless, where ancient God's words are quietly etched.
The gullible are skeptical while nobles bide their time, waiting for better terms – only you've heard it, that alluring yet hoarse whisper in your mind of the New World's promise.
When we prevail, no more tyrants shall rise. The future belongs to us.
The old Sultan would never have treated us this way.
If bloodshed is all it takes to be Sultan...
We shall restore order and reform the broken legal system.

"Now I'm innocent!" exclaims the Prisoner, patting your shoulder and showering you with words of gratitude, but never once mentioning money. He loudly demands the guard's attention, and leaves with the cold-faced guard, never to return. When you inquire about him later, you learn that he has been cleared of his charges and is allowed to go home.

"Did you bring what I asked for?" the Prisoner asked eagerly, seeing your empty hands, he was disappointed. "Please, I will thank you after I get out. Otherwise, what do you expect me to talk about here? I am not in the mood for poetry and fun right now..."
You had nothing to say in return, so you left for now.

"Hey, you come just in time!" A prisoner, jailed for embezzling a large fortune, has a friendly smile, not losing his noble affectation even in prison. "Listen, I’m truly innocent, and I have proof! Can you do me a little favor?"

He gives you a name, entrusting you to find this person in the Dark Alley, where there's evidence that can clear him. "Rest assured, I won't let you go on this trip for nothing. Once the task is complete, I'll give you 10 Gold Coins as a reward, I swear on my ancestor's honor."

You lured the man close, suddenly reached through the bars, grabbed his head and slammed it against the bars, then drew a dagger and stabbed his neck. When the panicked guard opened the cell, the man was already dead. Afterward, you used the Bloodshed Card to clear yourself, but your reckless actions earned you Infamy, and you are temporarily banned from entering this place.

The guard opened the cell door, and the tortured Prisoner had no strength to say anything to you. Fearing the Sultan might change his mind, the Prisoner's mother, after expressing endless gratitude to you, hurriedly took her son away.
This emaciated prisoner sits alone in the corner of the prison, unwilling to acknowledge you.

This emaciated prisoner sits alone in the corner of the prison, unwilling to acknowledge you. Before you leave, you happen to meet his family, here for a visit. His mother, wiping her tears, tells you that he was imprisoned for speaking out when the Sultan was playing that grand game of his...
Not unlike yourself.
"He's just too young, young and hot-tempered... he doesn't understand... I told him to apologize to the Sultan but he..." She looks sorrowful and weary. After nervously twisting her fingers for a while, she hesitantly asks if you could speak for him before the Holy One, gauge the Sultan's attitude. After all, much time has passed, and the Sultan is no longer playing the game...
You promise to help her, though no one could decide the Sultan's thoughts for him. The poor woman gratefully grabs your hand, tears streaming down her face.

You lure this person close, then suddenly reach through the bars, grab his head and slam it into the bars. Taking advantage of the momentum, you pull out a dagger and stab it through his neck. When the panicked guard opens the cell, the person is already thoroughly dead.
Lumera is no longer here, let him die in this cell.
You need to give an explanation to Lumera, you can’t just let this go.
Not even worth a stone Bloodshed Card
...Maybe Lumera should take a look.
Lumera silently watched her emaciated father as the repugnant man cursed madly, without saying a word. It seems that the time hasn't come yet.

Lumera silently watches her scrawny, repugnant father plead and threaten her, her expression unchanging. The man is cowed by her cold, emotionless gaze. He falls silent, swallowing heavily. "W-what are you gonna do, daughter..."
Lumera does not respond. She summons the jailer and gives her instructions. The prisoner instantly understands and begins hurling obscenities, cursing Lumera and her whore mother. Lumera casts him a disgusted glance and leaves without looking back.
A few days later, news arrive of the old gambler's death. The jailer has discarded the shriveled corpse into the wildness, with nothing but some linen to wrap it in. No one collected the remains.

Lumera silently watches her scrawny, repugnant father plead and threaten her, her expression unchanging. The man is cowed by her cold, emotionless gaze. He falls silent, swallowing heavily. "W-what are you gonna do, daughter..."
Lumera does not respond. She summons the jailer and gives her instructions. The prisoner instantly understands and begins hurling obscenities, cursing Lumera and her whore mother. Lumera casts him a disgusted glance and leaves without looking back.
A few days later, news arrive from the prison that a prisoner has gone mad, laughing day and night. The jailers, tired of his endless ravings, threw him into the Depths of the Black Prison, where the villains imprisoned there are always in dire need of entertainment. He would survive for quite some time. The jailers told him in malice that Lumera would save him. Surely no daughter would ignore her father's plight!...Would she? Haha, who knows.

Lumera silently watches her scrawny, repugnant father plead and threaten her, her expression unchanging. The man is cowed by her cold, emotionless gaze. He falls silent, swallowing heavily. "W-what are you gonna do, daughter..."
Lumera does not respond. She summons the jailer and gives her instructions. The prisoner instantly understands and begins hurling obscenities, cursing Lumera and her whore mother. Lumera casts him a disgusted glance and leaves without looking back.
A few days later, news arrive from the prison about a mysterious fire, that was somehow limited to the old gambler's cell. Not even a proper corpse was left. People say God has completely purged this sinner from the face of the earth. The jailers sweep the cell clean, and that is the end of that.

A familiar jailer brought you in front of a cell reeking of a heavy stench, telling you about a recent strange event. First, all the jailers were knocked out, and when they woke up, the old gambler in this cell had disappeared. The walls were covered in a mix of blood and flesh, perhaps even bone and organs, who knows...
"We all think it could be that man's remains smeared on the walls, but who knows..." The jailer shrugged. "Since the prisoner was sent by you, I thought you should know."
You turned your head and looked at Lumera standing off to the side. Her face was pale, but her gaze was resolute.
"Thank you," she said, "Now I know what revenge feels like."
You paid for his release.

You found Asal in prison. He looked far better than you had expected—he had not been thrown into the water cell, his clothes were still intact, and before him sat a few pieces of dry bread and a bowl of clear water.
"This is the punishment I deserve," he said gloomily. "Just as a mousetrap is the grave a mouse deserves. That lord values his collection of books above all else, as a father treasures his beautiful daughter. Naturally, a thief who dares to plunder such treasures must be taught a lesson."
He spoke so, yet the moment the guard opened the cell at your signal, he darted out faster than anyone else could.
Once outside, he seized your hand, tears of gratitude welling in his eyes. "Just as Lord Nawfal predicted—you would surely come to save me! Thank you, my lord [player.name]. I shall never forget your kindness!"
"Wait," you said. "What else did Nawfal tell you?"
"That lord! Ah, what a man—so generous, so noble, so refined! Even after I committed such a crime, he never truly wished me to rot here. He even, as if by accident, reminded me that some passages in Errant Thoughts might best be revised before republication—lest they bring me trouble."
A vein throbbed on your forehead as you struggled to contain your anger. You reminded him sharply that you were the one who had paid for his release. It was you!
Asal laughed, soothing you with raised hands. "Of course, of course, my lord—I never meant to suggest your taste was any less refined! Enough talk—I must hurry and prepare the new edition of that book, the one that vanished from the market a hundred years ago. I have a feeling it will be quite the success!"
He bowed deeply, then turned and dashed toward his bookstore without a moment’s pause.
Ah... how you longed to throw him back into the cage!
You suddenly discover in the dungeon's depths, in a cell adjacent to an empty one, a strange, powerful man... He examined you thoroughly, muscles swelling as if issuing challenge...

After a series of bizarre wrestling contests, you emerged victorious. This oddly garbed man laughed and vanished before your eyes, acknowledging you as his heir - the profound dark forces of imagination have chosen you!
Several guards drawn by the strange cries witnessed everything with peculiar expressions. Intimidated by your presence, they exchanged uncertain glances, none daring to approach.

You inexplicably assaulted empty air and rolled about wildly. Guards summoned by your outcries attempted restraint, yet none dared approach... Eventually, they summoned priests for exorcism, gradually freeing you from madness... Er, you can't explain what occurred, but those guards insisted that cell contained absolutely no prisoners.

She is unruly in the cell—fighting, biting... Had you not come, the guards might have killed this madwoman within days... Now everyone knows what kind of game you are playing, and that those who fall into your hands seldom meet a gentle fate...
Ignoring the whispers behind your back, you unlock her chains. The woman studies you for a long moment, then decides to leave the hopeless prison in your company.

strings: The Sultan's Pleasure

She holds no grudge against you for offering her to the Sultan. In fact, she eagerly pulls you aside to share her extraordinary experience.

"Honestly, what woman hasn’t dreamed of becoming his concubines?" she says, covering her mouth with a cheerful laugh. "Our king – both strength and size – is absolutely top-notch! The only issue, well..."

She tilts her head slightly, glancing around before leaning in to whisper, "He doesn’t care about how I feel at all... Of course, he’s the Sultan – why would he care? But if he could just see me as a person instead of a piece of meat, the pleasure would be so much greater."

"Of course, our king doesn’t need to consider anyone’s feelings, so just one experience like this is enough for me. Thank goodness I’m not one of his concubines!"Saying this, Nayla goes on to share some palace secrets she overheard. Before leaving, she slips you a handful of coins, probably hoping you’ll help her find her next prey.
The Sultan always has little patience for people or things that fail to surprise him. Thus, it comes as no surprise when Nayla, frail and broken, is escorted out of the palace gates by the eunuchs.

Later, [s2.name] tells you that deep in the Lion's throat, [s2.gender] heard a cacophony of distorted death cries... You tell [s2.gender] never to mention this to anyone.

As the lion opened its bloodstained jaws, ready to tear out its prey's throat, you seized the moment and, with arms like steel, pried apart its jaws. The bloody struggle dragged on for what felt like an eternity – until, at last, you tore the lion's head apart.

Afterward, you recall hearing twisted screams echoing from deep within the lion's throat... You decide not to let anyone else know about this.
The lion tore you apart, leaving nothing but scattered remains too shattered to ever reassemble.

5001022.title: Duel with the Giant
strings: Duel with the Giant

This giant comes from deep within the mountains. The masons found him in an abandoned cave... He has suffered through abuse and torment, refuses to or cannot speak the human tongue, and is filled with rage towards everything.
This Giant, tormented for ages, couldn't quell its wrath.
The fighter has already been chosen by you.
You can still provide items for this battle to slightly increase your chances of victory.
This is a fight to the death.
Can you win this duel?
The number of dice provided by your Combat and Physique is affected by the Giant's corresponding attributes.
You need at least 3 Successes to survive.
Victory!
Failure

The Giant's body is like stone, unfazed by pain and possessing immense strength. [s2.name] is driven to a dead end. Having lost all weapons, [s2.name] ignites a cloak with a torch and wraps it around the Giant's face...
The frenzied Giant breaks through the stone wall and is eventually shot dead by soldiers with bows and arrows.
The Giant's strength was something Humans could not contend with. He ruthlessly pounded [s2.name], turning him into a bloody mess.

5001023.title: Change of Dynasty
strings: Change of Dynasty

The Sultan has the army, a powerful Magic ring—and he himself is said to be an almost invincible warrior. You certainly need a strong army, swords, and Magic to oppose him, but to end the old dynasty and create a new one... such task must always be achieved by Convictions.
Sultan's Army
Your Resolve. At least a Gold tier Conviction of Rebellion or Conquest Card
You need to find ways to collect or upgrade those Convictions that can Oppose the Sultan
In the worst case, you can use the Gold Conquest Card to challenge the Sultan
Choose your Convictions carefully, as these will become the foundation of a new future, and cannot be changed
You need a Conviction or Conquest Card no less than Gold tier
You are ready to assassinate the Sultan
In the Name of God, I shall be your new Sultan
You shall all be reborn

Protect Sirshana. Even if he himself has no wish to be the Sultan, he is still the prince of the Homeland, the living banner your rebellion rallies behind. If anything happens to him, these supporters of yours will scatter like birds, like beasts.

5001024.title: Investigate Evidence
strings: Investigate Evidence
High Constable Adil is searching for your evidence... You need to do something, or he might really put you on trial – when obviously when it’s all clearly the Sultan’s fault!
High Constable Adil
Your Evidence
Ally to Apply Pressure
Ally to Plan the Attack
Consumables to Assist
Use Sociability and Wisdom to apply pressure, forcing the investigation to fail
Use Combat and Physique to assault the High Constable, making him pause the investigation
High Renown and Notoriety aid this check
You can try to destroy the evidence in the Methinks feature
Apply pressure
Resolve the person raising concerns
Your Sociability and Wisdom provide you with the full dice count.
The number of dice provided by your Physique and Combat is affected by Adil's corresponding attributes.
You need at least 2 Successes, or 1 Success if Renown is greater than 5.
You need at least 1 Success to injure Adil.
You took Adil lightly. Now, he has found evidence against you and has begun proceedings for prosecution.
You didn't intervene in this matter
Adil won't show you any mercy, and soon you'll receive notice of the trial.
The investigation against you is facing significant resistance.
Adil is under heavy criticism
You couldn't stop him
Attack Successful
Attack Failed
Acting with impunity
Everyone knows you are playing a dangerous game with the Sultan, so discussing law now is not very wise.

Everyone knows your good reputation, especially since you are already dealing with the Sultan's game. His opportunistic investigation is both unpopular and futile. He has no choice but to back off for now.
Adil has found what he wanted, and soon you'll receive notice of the trial.
Adil was stabbed several times in the dark alley. It's a miracle he didn't die. At least he won't investigate you for a while.
The assassin you sent almost got caught by Adil... He knows it was your person, and it's not over yet.
Adil has survived your assassination attempt, but with your spies everywhere, he hasn’t been able to gather any evidence or testimonies.

5001025.title: Destroy Evidence
strings: Destroy Evidence
You think perhaps it’s best to get rid of the evidence in your hands as soon as possible.
A piece of evidence against you
Ally to Destroy Evidence
Operational Funds: 1 Gold Coin
Consumables to Assist

Perform a Stealth and Wit check. 3 Successes will allow you to destroy the evidence. If your Power is 5 or higher, only 2 Successes are required. If it’s 10 or higher, only 1 Success is required. Failure has no consequences.
Your Stealth and Wisdom determine your full dice count.
You need at least 3 Successes, the higher the Influence, the lower the requirement.
You successfully destroyed the evidence.
Oh no, caught red-handed!

5001026.title: Charges and Defense
strings: Charges and Defense

The judges under the Sultan's command are known for their perfect parallel thinking. On the one hand, they turn a blind eye to the atrocities committed by the supreme ruler... On the other hand, they enforce the law on others with the strictest and most mechanical standards. This way, they can still claim to uphold the dignity of the law.
Your Evidence
Your Noble Defendant
Consumables to Assist
Litigation Funds
Ally to take the fall for your crimes
You can stop the trial through defense.
Litigation funds provide additional dice
Accumulated evidence will impose penalties
You can also directly let an ally take the death penalty instead
Trial Debate
The number of dice provided by your Wisdom, Sociability, and gold coins is affected by the evidence.
You need at least 1 Success to stop the trial. With more Successes, you can turn the tables and eliminate 1 piece of evidence. The number of successes required varies depending on your Influence.
Scapegoat
A Successful Defense
Defense Failed
[s5.name] confesses to all the crimes on your behalf and is sentenced to death, executed immediately.
Your defender's smooth words successfully stop the judge's verdict. But you know the High Constable will not let this go so easily.
No matter how eloquent your defender may be, they had already decided to sentence you to death from the very beginning. Now, it all depends on the Sultan’s will.
Most of the officials side with you, and the trial is hastily concluded.
Distort the Truth
Reversal!
Under your terrifying glare, the judge not only fails to convict you, but is forced to declare a key piece of evidence inadmissible. So this is what power tastes like?
The judge not only fails to convict you, but stumbles during the debate, forced to declare a key piece of evidence inadmissible.

5001027.title: Pay for atonement
strings: Pay for atonement

he Sultan declares that you can save your own head with its weight in gold.

For this matter, five craftsmen and sixteen scholars are summoned before the Sultan. They argue endlessly, using ropes, basins, massive livestock scales, and gallows hooks to measure you for an entire day and night. They even kill two slaves of your height in the process… but eventually arrive at a few conclusions that aren't too far apart.

To prove to the great Sultan that their respective methods are the correct ones, they prepare detailed illustrated boards and diagrams. However, the Sultan simply chooses the heaviest result.
40 Gold Coins Fine
Pay a fine of 40 Gold Coins within 5 turns, otherwise be executed.
The Sultan weighs your head and the gold coins over and over again

He orders you to relax your neck as much as possible, finally deciding that the gold is indeed just a bit heavier. Satisfied, he waves his hand and instructs Adil to pardon your crimes.

At the very least, Adil’s expression somewhat soothes the sting of losing your gold.

5001028.title: Presenting One's Wife and Concubine
strings: Presenting One's Wife and Concubine

"I’ve heard of your recklessness and lawlessness, yet your grotesque wife is what you fear..." The Sultan’s tone carries an unmistakable excitement, remarking about your wife as though another object of entertainment, not worthy of being called a who. "Obedient women are plentiful here – send her to me, and I'll have a taste of her myself." The implication is clear: this is the price for sparing you from your crimes – but you don’t dare confirm it outright.
Wife or Concubine
Present one of your wives or concubines within 5 turns; otherwise, be executed.
Isn't this better than dying?

You bring [s1.name] to the court. The Sultan is so delighted. Usually, only conquering a kingdom or abducting their royal women satisfies the Sultan so much... He laughs heartily, pinching [s1.name]'s cheek to check her teeth. With a dismissive wave, he pardons your crimes......

5001029.title: Palace Duel
strings: Palace Duel
Yesterday, you presented a Bloodshed Card in court. Today is the day you and your opponent must settle this fight to the death.
Abdul
Abdul's Guard
You can fight the battle yourself, or choose a noble follower to fight on your behalf.
Certain items can be useful in combats.
The loses of the duel will die.
To be fair, the Sultan allows you to bring someone with you.
As the duel starts, you dash towards Abdul
You attempt to break free from Abdul's Shield
The Sword Surround You
Abdul falls to the ground in fear
Faced with being surrounded
The number of dice provided by your Physique and Combat is affected by the enemy's Physique and Combat.
The number of dice provided by your Physique is affected by the opponent's Physique.
The number of dice provided by your Combat is affected by the opponent's Combat.
The number of dice provided by your Physique and Combat is affected by the enemy's Physique and Combat. Being Injured will reduce your dice count.
You need at least 8 Successes to reach Abdul directly.
You need at least 5 Successes to break free.
You need at least 5 Successes to achieve victory.
You need at least 1 Success to win.
You cursed your opponent right to death with vicious language! You've won!
You have applied poison to your weapon, and you only need to make a small cut, and then you can wait for victory! With that stratagem, you've won!

Despite the guards' desperate attempt to stop you, your fluid, lightning-fast movements slip you past them, straight to Abdul. His frail hands tremble around the knife – you cut him down without a second thought. The sight of blood delights the Sultan as the crowd chants your name.
Abdul's Shield Blocked Your Attack
With sheer force and superior skill, you smash through Abdul's Shield.

You parry the guard's weapon and slam your head into his, dropping him stunned to the ground. Following through with a mighty slash, you cleave his head clean off. Blood fountains from his neck like a geyser, instantly igniting the arena's atmosphere as the crowd chants your name.
You approach Abdul and cut him down mercilessly. The Sultan is clearly pleased with the duel.

Abdul falls to the ground in fear, and as you savor your moment of triumph, you raise your weapon high, basking in the audience's cheers. Abdul unexpectedly attacks you and succeeds beyond his own expectations. Watching the sword tip suddenly protrude from your chest, you slump to the ground unwillingly – your moment of victory turning to dust...
You are driven back by the sword guard's attack, as Abdul's shield guards close in around you
The tide turns against you, forcing desperate measures... In a brutal exchange of blows, you strike down Abdul's guard – but you pay the price.
Caught between two guards' sudden assault, a single misstep seals your fate.
The shield guard's imposing frame and iron defense leave you hopeless, while more sword guards close in around you.
The tide turns increasingly against you, forcing you into desperate trades. In a brutal exchange of blows, you succeed in striking down Abdul's guard– but you pay the price.

5001100.title: Palace Intrigue
strings: Palace Intrigue
After much trouble, someone brought you a message – Arzuna wants to see you, as soon as possible.
The dancer longs to meet you.
You must meet her yourself
You can either pay 10 Gold Coins to bribe the guard, or utilize the prepared Harem Secret Passage.
Certain items can be useful during the infiltration
You need to bribe or use the previously discovered secrets to enter the harem, otherwise, you will need to conduct Stealth and Physique checks.
It's obviously difficult to get into the Sultan's harem, but you don't have any better option. Pray... Pray that you can succeed.
Your Stealth and Physique determine your full dice count.
You need at least 1 Success to sneak successfully.
You ignored the Arzuna's request, and she no longer cares for past affections.

You navigated hidden passages into the palace, successfully reaching Arzuna.
Haggard exhaustion marked her features, anxiety evident in every movement. Grasping your hands with unexpected intensity, she spoke of the Sultan's murderous intentions—"Not only against me but targeting you as well... We cannot passively await execution!"
Such preposterous claims confounded you—she had only recently entered royal service, receiving abundant treasures and unprecedented favor—why would the Sultan eliminate her? Moreover, you had committed no significant transgressions recently...
Bewilderment clouded your thoughts as you attempted reassurance, suggesting her fears represented mere paranoia, particularly considering the multitude of women within the royal harem rendering her relatively insignificant!
Arzuna regarded you with complex emotions, seemingly poised to reveal critical information before ultimately shaking her head in resignation. "I implore you, [player.name], prepare yourself while opportunity remains."

You orchestrated elaborate arrangements, securing cooperation from Guards through strategic bribes. With their tacit permission, you infiltrated palace grounds, successfully reaching Arzuna. 
Haggard exhaustion marked her features, anxiety evident in every movement. Grasping your hands with unexpected intensity, she spoke of the Sultan's murderous intentions – "Not only against me but targeting you as well... We cannot passively await execution!" 
Such preposterous claims confounded you – she had only recently entered royal service, receiving abundant treasures and unprecedented favor – why would the Sultan eliminate her? Moreover, you had committed no significant transgressions recently...

Under darkness, you concealed yourself within a supply caravan, successfully penetrating palace defenses to reach Arzuna. 
Haggard exhaustion marked her features, anxiety evident in every movement. Grasping your hands with unexpected intensity, she spoke of the Sultan's murderous intentions - "Not only against me but targeting you as well... We cannot passively await execution!" 
Such preposterous claims confounded you – she had only recently entered royal service, receiving abundant treasures and unprecedented favor – why would the Sultan eliminate her? Moreover, you had committed no significant transgressions recently... 
Bewilderment clouded your thoughts as you attempted reassurance, suggesting her fears represented mere paranoia, particularly considering the multitude of women within the royal harem rendering her relatively insignificant! 
Arzuna regarded you with complex emotions, seemingly poised to reveal critical information before ultimately shaking her head in resignation. "I implore you, [player.name], prepare yourself while opportunity remains."

You hide in a supply wagon under the cover of darkness but fail to sneak into the harem.
Perhaps this fumbled approach triggered suspicion... Shortly thereafter, reports confirmed Arzuna's execution. Her mutilated remains suggested extensive torture preceded her demise.

5001101.title: Scourged Corpse
strings: Scourged Corpse
Such occurrences hardly warrant notice - A battered corpse was taken out of the palace.

Her beauty perished completely, leaving her face unrecognizable - what final expression marked her features? Terror? Supplication? Despair? Some other emotion entirely? Mercifully, her suffering has concluded...

5001102.title: Arzuna's Proposition
strings: Arzuna's Proposition
Arzuna awaits your decision... Should you harbor regicidal intentions, she pledges absolute assistance... Her sole opportunity for survival.
Arzuna Awaits
You must meet her yourself
You can either pay 10 Gold Coins to bribe the guard, or utilize the prepared Harem Secret Passage.
How will you comfort her? A regicide plot, a location unknown to the Sultan, or perhaps...?
It's okay to not bother.
It's obviously difficult to get into the Sultan's harem, but you don't have any better option. Pray... Pray that you can succeed.
Your Stealth and Physique determine your full dice count.
You need at least 1 Success to sneak successfully.
Strike First
Let's Escape
Dear, Don't Overthink

You successfully sneaked into the harem, reconnecting with Arzuna. 
Shadowy candlelight illuminated this bloody conspiracy, rekindling determination in Arzuna's dulled eyes. Together you meticulously examined each step of your dangerous plan, searching for the slightest vulnerabilities or oversights. Finally, Arzuna offered a genuine smile: "Excellent. I'll seize an opportunity to steal the Sultan's Signet Ring - trust me, I can accomplish this. I'll send word when it's done." 
Once initiated, this path permits no retreat.

You successfully sneaked into the harem, reconnecting with Arzuna. 
Shadowy candlelight illuminated this bloody conspiracy, rekindling determination in Arzuna's dulled eyes. Together you meticulously examined each step of your dangerous plan, searching for the slightest vulnerabilities or oversights. 
Arzuna listened with solemn attention: "So Ansuya has already committed herself... she..." Her voice trailed into thoughtful silence before she sighed softly, offering the intelligence she'd gathered in recent weeks: "May this prove useful to your endeavors."

"Let's escape together!" you implored, clasping Arzuna's hands firmly. "I should never have offered you to the Sultan!" 
Tears glistened in her eyes before she nodded decisively. Abandoning all treasures, silks, and jewels, she followed closely behind as you fled from this gilded prison.

Assassination attempts against the Sultan? Preposterous notion! Consider his Signet Ring, his elite guards, his limitless military strength... utter madness. 
You could only offer gentle reassurances to this frightened woman, promising the Sultan harbored no immediate lethal intentions - not today, not tomorrow. Beyond that? You couldn't guarantee your own survival, let alone hers...

You hide in a supply wagon under the cover of darkness but fail to sneak into the harem.
Perhaps this fumbled approach triggered suspicion... Shortly thereafter, reports confirmed Arzuna's execution. Her mutilated remains suggested extensive torture preceded her demise.
Accomplished the Impossible

[s1.name] retrieves the sheep-gut sheath containing the Monarch's seed from within her body - while the Sultan has discarded the fake into a box of chili peppers... Hopefully whatever you're planning justifies such risk, justifies the nearly hateful look she gives you.
The Sultan will soon discover Arzuna's escape - and yours. You have perhaps 3 days to flee! Escape to where the Sultan cannot find you, beyond this terrifying fate's reach!

5001103.title: No Return
strings: No Return
Arzuna prepares an elaborate seduction for the mercurial monarch - exotic wines, potent incense, passionate invitation... A deadly trap awaiting its arrogant prey.
Arzuna's Gambit
Arrogant monarch
You can only wait for her message.

Arzuna with trembling hands delivered the news - she had succeeded. The Sultan's Signet Ring was secretly replaced by her last night. What happens next depends on you. She urged immediate implementation before the Sultan detected the substitution, after which everything would collapse.

5001104.title: Fallen Blossom
strings: Fallen Blossom
The palace was filled with a heavy atmosphere... Everyone was trembling with fear and kept silent. Something serious was happening, and you might have had a premonition, but it was irreversible.
Arzuna's Fate
There is nothing more you can do in the face of such a turn of events.

Arzuna's broken body is dragged out of the palace, bearing unmistakable signs of prolonged torture.
People are shocked and horrified by the Sultan's unpredictability, while you alone understood what's the meaning for. The beast scans his kingdom with his fierce eyes, searching for her accomplices. 
You must not mourn her. You must not show sadness. The only way to console her soul is to win this game.

5001501.title: News in the Bathhouse
strings: News in the Bathhouse

The warm flow of water soothes your tense nerves. In these moments of fatigue and relaxation, people are always more likely to let slip their secrets. Here, you can gather all kinds of rumors, as well as tales of unrest often dismissed by nobles with disdain – stories of bandits, adventurers, and demons.
You can personally make the trip, or send any noble follower to the bathhouse.
Entry fee is 1 Gold Coin, unless you have a Bath VIP Card.
Certain items can be useful for chatting and probing.
The more successful the check, the rarer the Intelligence obtained.
An excellent check can generate new rituals.
If something or someone hasn't been discussed in the Bathhouse, it just doesn't exist. It's time to test your Charisma and Sociability.
Your Charisma and Sociability determine your full dice count.
You need at least 1 Success to have a chance of getting the information.
Do not bring crocodiles into the bathhouse anymore!
You don't know why you always hear about various things; maybe it's because people don't mind you walking up to them.
The sauna is crowded with people trying to talk to you; there's no need to pour water on the copper basin anymore.
You couldn't get a word in and only occasionally got some fragmented news while pouring water on the copper basin in the sauna.
You didn't get any news; you just had an ordinary bath.
Where's My Water
Madness, Sickness, and Taboos

You brought the Little Crocodile to the Bathhouse just for fun, since it wasn't big enough to swallow a person yet! The Little Crocodile seemed happy too...

What you didn't anticipate was that someone, while you were turned around, slipped... certain vital parts into the Little Crocodile's mouth. He didn't die immediately, but amidst his screams and the blood causing chaos, at least three people were trampled to death...

You mashed together oil and exotic fermented ingredients, binding the mixture to your groin and thighs with bandages. In the bathhouse, the stench was unbearable. Horror filled every face as people recoiled from you. Despite your insistence that it was just a small problem, the bathers fled in panic. Days later, word spread throughout the court that you had contracted a filthy disease. Some even claimed their own rashes came from merely sharing the bath with you.

The Sultan was very pleased with the farce – after all, who would fear a man whose groin was seemingly rotting away?
Dispute in the Bathhouse
Won't Float
During your conversation with everyone, you unexpectedly learned about a matter that needs attention.
The chitchat in the Bathhouse inspired Jenna's jewelry design.

The stares of people pierce your exposed skin. Even soaking in warm water, you can feel them, like a fisherman's thrown spears and ropes. When you rise from the pool, there is a feeling of more and more things tugging and pulling at you, like a voyaging ship pulling at a whale it is hunting.
Something noteworthy has happened.

When Maggie enters the bathhouse, she finds Adila sitting alone in the bath. The horrifying scars on Adila’s back have kept the other noblewomen from speaking to her. But as your wife, Maggie is not afraid of such things. She sits beside Adila and warmly praises her for her bravery as a warrior, as well as the graceful beauty of her figure. Her words earn Adila’s affection and respect. They agree to bathe together next time and plan to help each other care for their bodies with essential oils and delicate threads.
Your wife encounters some trouble in the bathhouse...

When [s1.name] disrobed, that cursed familiar golden chain upon [s1.gender(his,her)] chest drew furtive glances and averted eyes, spawning increasingly outrageous rumors that slowly dispersed in the steam.

5001502.title: Steam Social
strings: Steam Social

When two people meet in a steam bath, the first to leave is considered the weaker. These subtle victories even attract the secret attention of the court – they symbolize territory, Influence, health, and respect.
Look who’s here today.
Let's see who to send today. The prerequisite is to be a noble.
You can try putting some items on it, maybe it will be useful.
Ah, the Sultan Card. I knew we would need the Sultan Card. Alright, but it must be no higher quality than the subject card.
1 Gold Coin entry ticket is essential
This is an effective way to gain palace support.
You cannot enter the opposite sex's sauna.
Hmm... hmm...
The number of dice provided by your Charisma and Physique is affected by the opponent's Physique.
You need at least 2 Successes to win this bout.
The opponent fled the steam bathhouse like a defeated rooster, understanding more clearly that they should side with the stronger party.
You wanted to earn respect, but the opponent only saw a weakling.

Provocation, boasting, pretending to stay calm, luring the opponent to exhaust all their stamina... In the end, he collapsed in the suffocating steam, and you did not call a servant, continuing to wait until he stopped breathing. Upon hearing this, the Sultan whimsically demanded that the ministers add this as a method of execution, but everyone desperately dissuaded him.
The news of your malicious provocation in the steam bath soon spread, and more and more people began to believe you are truly mad.

You are the same kind, that's enough. The steam conceals the eyes of the world; now you can enjoy each other... Later, everyone said you've gone mad to complete the Sultan's game, but the Sultan himself said your taste wasn't bad.
You can't remove two Carnality Cards with the same person and the same method twice. Try other, more exciting ways.
He angrily punched you and left.
The opponent looked at you with a strange expression.

5001503.title: Bathhouse Date
strings: Bathhouse Date
A lover yearning for your body is calling you.
Your wife who longs for your body.
Of course, it's you.
Carnality or Bloodshed
Signs of Carnality – Bathhouse
You can use Carnality or Bloodshed according to your "preferences", or you can choose to add nothing.
Your bold actions have sparked calls for mixed bathhouse. The Sultan finds it very amusing.
Unfortunately, you cannot please the Sultan with in the same way twice.

You drowned your lover in the Bathhouse. The Sultan enjoyed the story very much and demanded a statue of the drowned lover be carved and placed by the pool. The ministers finally persuaded him to compromise on not having the statue's lower corpse spray water.
You had a wonderful date, strengthening your affection for each other.

5001504.title: Explanation
strings: Explanation
The Sultan demands an explanation – you let a crocodile show up at the bathhouse and cause deaths and injuries.
Protagonist
A Bloodshed Card no higher than Silver tier
The Sultan bursts into hearty laughter at your story, and gladly breaks the Bloodshed Card to spare you. However, some court guards wear expressions of impending doom, which is very strange.
While your crimes are still hotly debated, the Sultan is clearly captivated by the details of your story – some court guards wear expressions of impending doom

5002001.title: Sanitarium
strings: Sanitarium
You can spend Gold Coins here to treat injured or sick people.
Injured or sick people
The consultation fee is 1 Gold Coin.
Injuries and Sickness will reduce character attributes
In the [Sickness Outbreak] event, injured characters may die
Wounds close and Sickness heal, but the fear of death still hovers over you.
Perhaps illness makes you melancholy.
Be more careful next time.

During the nights when your wound keeps you awake, you think longingly of a certain friend renowned for his skill in medicine...
At that time you have only just inherited your father's title and entered the Sultan's court. You are injured while accompanying the Sultan on a hunt. That night, in pain and unable to sleep, you are encamped far from home and cannot summon your own physician. In desperation you secretly appeal to the court physician. It is a rash choice, but—unexpectedly—he helps you, and a friendship begins. Later, as both of you grow busier with the Sultan's demands, the contact between you dwindles...
Moved by these memories, you write a letter addressed to the palace.

The physician smiles as he cautions you, then returns your payment. He refuses to take a coin, explaining that you are the patron behind a new, inexpensive, effective medicine—benefactor to the poor and the sick alike. Everyone is grateful to you.

5002002.title: Sickness Outbreak
strings: Sickness Outbreak
The smell of the wound, the sounds within your body, the color of the vomit... all tell you that the footsteps of death are near.
The unfortunate soul chosen by Death
It's best to have something that can boost Physique.
Stacked Sickness and injuries status will reduce character check values
You will permanently lose deceased characters
Placing herbs can prevent death
When it knocks, everyone is alone.
Your Physique determines your full dice count.
You need at least 1 Success to have a chance to escape death.
Just like every mortal, died from injuries and illness.
It paused inside the body for a moment, then quietly left. However, you might not be so lucky next time.
This elixir contains immense vitality, capable of suppressing the most formidable diseases.
It saw the weapons you prepared, those plants growing from the earth. It laughed and consumed these tributes, then left peacefully.
It seems some mysterious magic has helped you get through this ordeal for now.

5002003.title: House of Delights
strings: House of Delights

The city's brothel, said to have a history older than the city's walls and palace. Regardless, it's a good place to break the Sultan Cards, because no matter how beautiful and praised they are, they are just playthings indulged in for money.
Many practice with Junah before marriage to gain confidence when facing their wife.
Pay her 2 Gold Coins to become her guest. If you pay double, you can break an Extravagance Card in the corresponding tier.
One person for physical joy and a companionship of double person is to gamble, you can't ask someone else to help you with that right?
You can use this opportunity to break a Sultan Card of no higher than the Stone tier – Carnality, Bloodshed, Extravagance… or simply to seek pure joy.
Certain items can help you perform better...
Even a prostitute's death can cause public resentment
Be careful, spending too much energy and money on prostitutes might upset your wife.
The prostitutes appearing each time are random.
Once their passion is ignited, they might open their hearts to you.
This is just a transaction, but it might spark Passion.
Your Charisma and Physique determine you the full dice count.
You need at least 2 Successes to have a chance for Passion to spark.
It costs at least 2 Gold Coins.
The House of Delights is closed for now. Do return another time!
To use the Extravagance Card here, you'll have to pay 4 Gold Coins~
Customer, I miss you...
Don’t pity a woman whose life is as worthless as grass, as long as you can enjoy yourself.
Want to play something thrilling?
Master, I'll pour some wine for you.
You've already broken the Carnality Card this way before; the Sultan won't admit it again.
Sorry, bro

To sell the act, you drink a few glasses of wine and apply some numbing ointment to ensure it stays completely unresponsive. After all, you’re trying to fool the Sultan!
However, Junah takes it personally, devastated that she can't arouse you anymore. When she breaks down crying, you frantically call in some Ladies of Delight to prove it's your problem, not hers.
Your little performance backfires – soon the whole palace is gossiping about your supposed impotence. And now, what if you draw another Carnality card – what will you do then! At the very least, the Sultan seems highly amused by the story. It turns out that even the most ruthless ruler can be more forgiving toward an impotent courtier.
She knew you were there for the Sultan Card task. But what does it matter? Men have always found endless reasons, and she always remained gentle, listening to their stories and praising them.

Passion and death blended together, turning her body into a dream chasm that you couldn’t escape until you were completely exhausted and cold.

Is this an illusion that every man has? You see flames in her eyes – is it love or madness? She craves you. If it's not just self-flattery, she might meet you outside of work hours.
