Under these circumstances, you dare not argue but repeatedly nod affirmatively until she graciously allows you to try holy water before escaping...
Sure enough, the next day the whole capital know you have lost your male prowess due to excess. What to do if you draw another Carnality card! The Sultan is quite amused by this joke; evidently, even the most brutal monarchs are more forgiving of an impotent subject.

Throughout the process, she seems a bit absent-minded. The noble Lady Jalila turns out to be just a Bronze Card, not Silver nor Gold, leaving her lost and denying you the pleasures of legends.

However, afterward, she becomes a cheerful conversationalist, sharing tales of hidden quirks, stories of ladies striving to become upper level, and various beauty preservation secrets...

Of course, when you politely decline to be a supplier for her nectar of youth, along with matters of card tier, it pricks at her self-esteem, thus ending your leisure time together.
The Carnality Card cannot be reused on the same person, but Lady Jalila states that if you perform better, in the future you may receive rewards that even the Sultan would envy.

After spending a considerable amount, you were lucky enough to enter Ms. Jalila's secret chamber – devoid of sight and freedom by silver chains and a horse-leather mask.
Then, in the prolonged darkness, her breath, words, and touch guided you upward, never before had you lingered so long near the peak, growling, whimpering, begging, and your surging desire made you the most humble being in the world... until she let you release.
The Extravagance Card cannot be reused on the same person, but you still spend lavishly, entering Lady Jalila's chamber again and again and again... only the shackles and masks help you relax.
Coming here only for pleasure

At first, she thought you were joking until you revealed the blade... then she broke down, begging, struggling, fighting with you until, in the end, only an ugly, broken body stained with blood, viscera, and excrement remained. Later, many said you randomly picked a lowly woman to replace Ms. Jalila, who had become a city legend.
Ms. Jalila is a mask, an imagined being woven by men's desires and women's skills. Amidst the tumult of passion, you seemed to see the visage beneath the mask, but she called it another, better mask.

In the evening, you fell asleep while she read poetry in a low voice, gaining the first dreamless deep sleep you've had in dozens of days. In the morning, she prepared breakfast for you and shared a small tip on mixing dried fruits and honey...

In a sense, this is also a kind act. You chose an innocent person, who had no connections and whose death would not bring sorrow to anyone, to satisfy the Sultan's malicious game. For this humble girl, the more she knew, the more she realized her powerlessness against the world, only adding to her pain.
In the end, she held the books high – keep the blood from staining the covers. What a good child.

Clearly, she's not unfamiliar with such matters, but during the process, she couldn't hold back her tears... She apologized while asking if even after studying, a woman could only do such things.

The next morning, you saw she kicked over the ladder for taking the book and hung herself on the beam in the study.

You ask her three questions about the book, she answer two correctly, and summarize one better than you remembered. You immediately realize she's a genius! She deserves the best treatment – so you declare you'll adopt this child as your goddaughter, hastily arranging as decent and swift a ceremony as possible. Of course, the noble status isn’t easily obtained – everyone, including Lumera herself, still considers her as your servant, labeling your benevolence as a desperate courtier's whim, or some strange idea to fulfill the Sultan's task. After all, she’s so small, inconspicuous, and even the Sultan doesn’t care to harm her... Only you understand she holds Promising Futures.

You order servants to prepare a chamber befitting her noble status, purchasing fine clothes, jewelry, and exotic spices... After a complete transformation, she emerges as a remarkably graceful, keen, and endlessly curious lady – a treasure whose true value only you recognize.

This brings you an unexpected delight, even providing comfort amid the Sultan's Game – yet Lumera, still unaccustomed to her noble station, soon returns to the servant's quarters, with her all books...

 This time, you survived, but you know there will be a next time...

Your consciousness begins to blur. Junah's body sways, pleasure like water, drowning your awareness...
Perhaps this is the best ending.

You bought this famous queen.

On your way home, at least twenty nobles were peeking at your sedan chair, so you had Jalila throw out her shoes, socks, jewelry, and clothing through the window one by one, causing a madness among the crowd...
 You have grown accustomed to the madly, envious, and fearful gazes of people. Of course, there's also your wife's cold side profile.

The next day you became the focus of the palace again. The Sultan praised your elegance, but the awkward blessings from many courtiers made you suspect that they had all once knelt at Jalila's feet...

Many, many years later, troubadours still sing of the queen's death. From hope to despair, her story is repeatedly staged, becoming a textbook of sadomasochistic enlightenment for countless teenagers.

You check thrice through the peephole in the training room cubicle; if not for the famous wound on his left leg and the indispensable magical Signet Ring... without the crown, silver knife, gold ornaments, and lavish attire, naked with a hood on, it’s damn hard to tell... the man panting under Jalila’s foot is the usual highest Sultan.
Now, he seems to enjoy this particular roleplay, loudly uttering vulgarities unimaginable to the courtiers...
Fortunately, Queen Jalila remains unaware of his true identity, professionally wielding the whip and adjusting her heel's pressure while awaiting your signal.
The Bloodshed Card burns hot in your chest. You can complete it, you can satisfy it, and gain total release – you’re so nervous that you're confused if Jalila’s lines are provoking the slave beneath her or taunting yourself.
Finally, you resolve, giving Jalila the execution signal, letting her choke the slave below with her whip... then you draw the blade and rush into the room.
As you roar in vengeance, the naked Sultan reaches climax under Jalila’s strangulation. Suddenly, as death awakens the ring's power, a crimson flash engulfs all of you... the Sultan's thrill-induced shaking and moaning body is your last sight before death.

You check thrice through the peephole in the training room cubicle; if not for the famous wound on his left leg and the indispensable magical Signet Ring... without the crown, silver knife, gold ornaments, and lavish attire, naked with a hood on, it’s damn hard to tell... the man panting under Jalila’s foot is the usual highest Sultan.

You signal Jalila not to do anything unnecessary, just complete the roleplay as usual.
Eventually, the Sultan takes off his soaked hood and orders the outside officers to reward the Queen’s skills with a big bag of Gold Coins.
You can't shake the illusion that while paying, he smiles at your peephole.

You go to Jalila again. Not out of rationality, but a self-destructive desire.

In this Sultan's Game, maintaining one's humanity is extremely painful, only by sinking into the muck of carnality can this burden be alleviated even for moments.
Clearly, Jalila understands this suffering. She mercilessly drags you to hell to forget this world.

However, this time, you don't wish to return; you've grown tired of escaping and repeating. You hand the Bloodshed Card to Jalila, whispering your final wish... and the most professional queen never disappointes her slaves.

Using her longest, finest whip, she wraped it around your neck, suspending you, caressing you until you entered the ultimate darkness of bliss, until the Sultan’s envoy arrived to confirm the resolvement of the Bloodshed Card.

In this Sultan's Game, maintaining one's humanity is extremely painful, only by sinking into the muck of carnality can this burden be alleviated even for moments.

Clearly, Jalila understands this suffering. She mercilessly drags you to hell to forget this world.

You are a beast, a slab of meat, specks of dust. But ultimately, you have to get up, continue facing harsh life as a pitiful human.

Jalila pretends to wrap her whip around Nabhani's neck, pulling him close as she lazily banters with him. It turns out that you're not the only one trying to make Queen Jalila your eyes and ears. From what they say, Nabhani became Jalila's patron long before you did, to the point that his exchanges of intel always include complaints about you.

You wait for a long time, but no passionate demands arise between the two of them. Tired of listening, you flash the glint of the Bloodshed Card at Jalila through the peephole.

For a brief moment, you catch a flash of excitement in the Queen's eyes. The whip tightens around Nabhani's neck, lifting him halfway off the chair. His helpless struggles only invite Jalila's gentle caresses...

It is an unusually exquisite death, and in that moment, the three of you share a dark satisfaction.

Jalila stands still as she lazily banters with him. It turns out that you're not the only one trying to make Queen Jalila your eyes and ears. From what they say, Nabhani became Jalila's patron long before you did, to the point that his exchanges of intel always include complaints about you.

You wait and wait, but no passionate exchange develops between them. You feel oddly both relieved and disappointed. 

Through the peephole, you make exaggerated winks and gestures trying to signal "I don't care," but Jalila somehow reads it as "Give him holy water" – such chaos. It's turning into an absurd day.

If not for your command, who would dare waste such a sweetheart adored by women? But the wicked desire to claim both his life and body is enough to make Jalila blush.

She ties him up, straddles him, and plunges the blade at the height of his ecstasy.

The strike does not end the warrior's life immediately. Instinctively, he breaks free from one binding and seizes his weapon in a flash – only to gently set it down, caress the queen's breasts, and die with a smile.

NabHani has another trick up his sleeve. He often says the art of swordplay is just like the art of pleasing a woman. You finally understand how his agile and strong fingers work their magic... Judging by Jalila's moans, these skills are truly extraordinary. You watch intently, making mental notes for future reference... though the peephole reveals only so much.

Shama's visit delights Jalila. She quickly lays flat a small bed fitted with restraint straps, a makeshift table. Then rummages about, digs out tea leaves gifted by some past guest. Even the stove she fetches is one meant for patrons with certain appetites for pain. And there, in that strange setting, they sit and chat at ease. Shama even removes her golden crown and hands it to Jalila to touch. She laughs, at one point, as she places it atop Jalila's head and studies her seriously. You don't intrude further on their reunion. But just before you withdraw, perhaps it's your imagination, Shama's gaze seems to flicker, briefly, toward your peephole. Then, without lowering her voice, she turns the conversation to some recent rumor she's heard about a certain courtier. It sets Jalila laughing, unable to stop.

You need another plan. Fast.

As the rumors circulate, those who mourn her begin leaving gifts at a street corner near the bookstore where she would spend hours with her books.

When you go there, the corner is already piled high with flowers, jewelry, and books – some of them priceless, yet untouched by anyone...
Just before you leave, a masked slave girl stops you. She says that Shama left you a gift.

Sure enough, you see an eager smile on the Sultan's face: "He used to be my strongest asides, [player.name]. If you can present a Conquest Card, I'll allow you to send troops."

When you return to court, everyone see the unwashed blood on you – yours, your fellows, your once-fellows who now bode different purviews; everyone also see the head you mount high on a spear, its once proud and angry features frozen in endless fear of death.
You present it to the Sultan, telling him how you razed the fields and flowers around that city, forcing the enemy to open the gates for the final battle, and told those awaiting death within the city that all their suffering and punishment stemmed from the stubborn lord who refused to acknowledge his own daughter.
All the officials are silent, but the Sultan claps and laughs. He permits you to break this Conquest Card as a reward for bringing him this bloody tale.
After several days of an extraordinary, hard-fought battle, the enemy's elite cavalry cut off your final route of retreat. You have failed and all were slain.
War brought you remarkable yields
Besides that head, you also loot the city thoroughly. Everything that once belonged to him – money, horses, jewels, weapons – now all belongs to you.

5002032.title: Flames of Fury

Shama's resolve is firm
Compensation

She shouldn't have come.
You catch her hand, telling her you've prepared a carriage for her to leave the capital, to hide away somewhere far. But she just shakes her head, full of apology.

"I'm sorry... it was my fault to have involved you." She gently strokes your weary face, voice soft yet determined, "You're the best person I've ever known... so I can't trouble you any longer."

You hear she's gone to her father after leaving your house. The next day, that arrogant lord leaves your territory, satisfies with Shama's head in hand.

The lamentable and failed war you started for her ends with this beautiful woman's death, becoming another tale of fatal beauty known to the people.

5002033.title: My Lord
strings: My Lord
After vanquishing Shama's father, you petitioned the Sultan for rights to the territory. Curiously, the decree arrived by Shama's own hand.
Master of Two
Shama

As the last "son" of the former ruling family, Shama gracefully knelt before you, kissing your feet - a ritual she had performed before. 
At last, you stand among the realm's most ancient noble houses. And Shama? How thoughtful of the great Sultan to provide you with an aide familiar with local customs.
As a slave, she owns nothing. All belongs to you now.

5002034.title: Ascension
strings: Ascension

Shama is now the legitimate heir of that territory—even though she was once a prostitute contorted in a twisted cocoon, unacknowledged by her father—now, it's not only you who believes so, but the whole world by rights of rite.
Shama is about to take her position

Please take it

Upon another reunion, you find Shama stalwartly unchanged. Rather, she is always more gentle, more courteous, more well-conducted than any noble.

"Thank you for everything you've done for me... really, I never thought anyone would treat me like this..." she smiles softly at you, sighs slightly before continuing, "I never thought I'd return to that land, as a lady, and that a farewell from this place would be such a hesitant one... fate truly is strange, is it not, [player.name]?"

Shama takes a small gold statue from her lapel, placing it in your palm: 'Isn't it cute and interesting? My mother gave me this trinket before my secret was discovered. It's always been with me all these years—I thought that was love!'

She gazes at you with a smile: 'Now, I don't need it to remind me. I have gained a far, far more genuine love now.'

The city's brothel, said to have a history older than the city's walls and palace. Regardless, it's a good place to break the Sultan Cards, because no matter how beautiful and praised they are, they are just playthings indulged in for money.
Newcomer at the House of Delights, Salwiyah
Pay her 4 Gold Coins to become her guest. If you pay double, you can break an Extravagance Card in the corresponding tier.
One person for physical joy and a companionship of double person is to gamble, you can't ask someone else to help you with that right?

To sell the act, you drink a few glasses of wine and apply some numbing ointment to ensure it stays completely unresponsive. After all, you’re trying to fool the Sultan!
Salwiyah tries everything she can to please you, but can not succeed. She would rather die than believe she has lost her allure! So she stubbornly and persistently wear you out all night until she finally tires herself out...
Heartbroken, the girl slams the door as she leaves, crying. Soon enough, all patrons of the House of Delights know about your impotence... And now, what if you draw another Carnality card – what you will do then! The Sultan finds this joke amusing. It turns out that even the most ruthless ruler can be more forgiving toward an impotent courtier.

As you reach for her neckline, Salwiyah's violet eyes filled with tears, her delicate body trembling softly, whispering 'no', with fragile innocence, like a friend's untouched daughter, like a bud never bloomed for anyone.

But you know, you don't need to pity her or truly 'stop.' You only need to unleash the beast inside without any guilt and enjoy the ecstasy of conquest. In the end, she lies beside you, picks up the thin card from your chest, and smiles sweetly: 'Oh, I recognize this thing on it. My mother says this is love.'
Despite Salwiyah's passionate entertainment, a Carnality Card cannot be simply used on the same person again.

Seeing the extra reward money you produce, Salwiyah's face blooms with a violet, soft, and docile smile. She leads you to a secret, gold-threaded intricate wooden box full of decorative gold and jewels. Her soft body leans against you, teasingly whispered: now, you may decorate her by hand anywhere with them.
Extravagance Card cannot be consumed again on the same person... but you just want to see her smile... the violet smile that flourishes only under gold's watering...
Coming here only for pleasure
No! No!

The moment you draw the dagger, the young girl draws back in fear, desperately hurling everything at hand towards you, screaming, crying, resisting in a maddening frenzy. Look at this sorry figure with her hair disheveled – so ugly. How could she ever get the luxurious life she yearned?

You coldly snap the Sultan Card. May she realize in paradise that mercy begged for is as fragile as this. See, none of her seated patrons dare stand in your way. As for how they will lament her death later, or attack your cruelty, what does it matter to a life already gone?
Is this an illusion that every man has? You see flames in her eyes – is it love or madness? She craves you. If it's not just self-flattery, she might meet you outside of work hours.

You wander through the vagrant camp, surrounded by hungry children, gaunt women, and filthy men with vacant stares. How could there be books for sale in such a place?

"When fate takes a bad turn, some sell their books first, while others cling to them until the very end," he explains, weaving through the crowd with eyes fixed on people's hands. "Under our most exalted Sultan's rule, such rises and falls of fate are commonplace. Those who recited poetry in gardens yesterday might well be begging for gruel here today."

You can't help but wonder... if your fate fell, would he buy back his books from your dirty hands as well?

You find some valuable books... You try to speak with the bookstore owner, but she covers her face and hurries away, as though she's done something more shameful than the women of the night across the road.

5002501.title: Pack of Vicious Dogs
strings: Pack of Vicious Dogs

A pack of wild dogs rampages through the slums, attacking lone passers-by. Some drunks were even devoured in their sleep, losing their lives. They severely impact the safety of the city. The security team has tried multiple times to catch them but failed each time. To catch these beasts, who have grown wisdom in order to survive, special measures might be necessary...
You can put a dog lure here, or money to lure people.
You can either go yourself or dispatch a strong enough follower to hunt.
An extra companion, a better chance of ensurance.
You can take this to break a Conquest Card of Bronze tier or lower, or a Extravagance Card
Some things might come in handy in the battle.
You can act yourself or use some commercial methods.
Your plan worked. The Wild dogs were attracted by the bait and trapped in a dead-end alley. Now it’s time to test your combat skills...
The number of dice provided by your Combat and Physique is affected by the Wild Dog's corresponding attributes.
You need at least 1 Success to drive them away.
If you use bait, extravagance is impossible; if you use Gold Coins, extravagance is necessary.
With your current [Physique] and [Combat] abilities, don't go looking for death.
If we have the support of [Intelligence], we will have a better chance of winning.
You need to prepare 8 [Gold Coins] as bait.
To resolve Conquest, you need to personally send [person] as bait.
Operation Failed

The last wild dog whimpers as it falls. Once they feasted on human flesh, now they will become someone's meal.
You have resolved a major problem for the slum residents, and they respect you more.
The last wild dog falls with a snarl, its sharp fangs injuring you and your companions. You’re badly wounded, but you’ve successfully solved this problem for the slum residents.

The Wild dogs were more ferocious than you expected. You and your companions were brutally bitten, retreating and forced to abandon the capture, fleeing the area. You can only hope that next time these beasts will be as easily lured.
To exterminate them, first strengthen their virility
Really virility?
Hunting can always be considered a form of Conquest, even if it is hunting wild dogs

You announced loudly that eating the members of dogs can make a man never lose his vigor. Because your task of indulging Carnality had become so burdensome... You offer to buy all dog members at 10 Silver Coins each, along with their subcutaneous fat, that can cure baldness.
Soon, you had to stop this hunt, as wild dogs outside the city had vanished, and there were barely any domestic dogs left alive...
A rare moment, the Sultan cautiously observes you at court, wondering if this is a trick or truly effective...
[s2.name], who acted as bait for you, barely escaped the wild dogs' attack with his life. But he is gravely injured. Without timely treatment, he may die from his wounds worsening.

When you asked the Sultan to nullify the Conquest card, he showed great regret. He blamed you for not leaving any alive. He wanted to see how they ripped through human flesh to earn their terrifying reputation.

5002502.title: House Occupied by Vagrants
strings: House Occupied by Vagrants

You overhear a noble in the Bathhouse complaining, intentionally or not, about how his house outside the city has been occupied by a group of cunning vagrants. The steamy mist makes everyone laugh, dismissing it as a joke, because everyone knows that if he were willing to spend some money to hire a few mercenaries, the problem could easily be solved. He hasn't done that. Perhaps he knows that you have been chosen by the Sultan, and you are the one in this city who most likes, or rather, needs to meddle in other people's business.
Leader of the Vagrants
You can personally go or send your elite followers to fight.
An extra companion, a better chance of ensurance.
Some things might come in handy during a Conquest, and if you plan to use money, you'll need at least 8 Gold Coins.
You can take this to break a Conquest Card of Bronze tier or lower, or a Extravagance Card
After defeating the villains, most will be imprisoned in the Sultan's jail.

You arrive at the location of the house. The vagrants occupying the place are emaciated, in ragged clothes, and armed with crude weapons. They don't seem difficult to deal with. After half a day of observation, you also notice that the group of vagrants is not completely disorganized; they vaguely have one leader. Perhaps, besides violence, you can try other methods.
You try to persuade them to come out.
The number of dice provided by your Sociability and Physique is affected by the Leader of the Vagrants' corresponding attributes.
Your Sociability determines your full dice count.
You need at least 2 Successes to drive them away.
You need at least 3 Successes.
If you use Gold Coins, an Extravagance Card is necessary; if you use a Conquest Card, then there is no need to insert Gold Coins.
With your current [Sociability] and [Combat] abilities, don't disgrace yourself.
If we have the support of [Intelligence], we will have a better chance of winning.
You need to prepare 8 [Gold Coins].
To resolve Conquest, fewer funds might suffice.
Successfully persuaded the mob
You failed

You use your silver tongue to both threaten them with the dire outcome of occupying a noble's mansion, and promise benefits if they left on their own accord.

The untraveled, starving mob are shattered by your words, murmuring hesitantly. You take advantage of their lapse in vigilance to capture the leader, sending the vagrants scattering headless.

The noble, overjoyed, showered you with endless gratitudes over and over again. You stop him just as he is about to hurry into his house. With sudden realization, he slaps his forehead and offers you some coins as a reward.

Your flowery words can not shake the hardened hearts of these cold-blooded vagrants.
Life has taught them too many harsh lessons, they're only convinced by tangible things they can see and touch, like food at hand, like weapons in grip.

You were beaten out of the mansion with sticks, bruised all over while plotting how to give those rascals a cruel lesson next time.
No one can refuse a real feast.
You failed to persuade them.
This can barely be considered a Conquest.
You spent a large sum of money setting up a feast outside your mansion for a hundred people. It was a true feast, with a giant roasted camel, sweet fruits, and jars of fine wine...

The vagrants swarm out from the mansion, and the leader can't stop them. Once disunite, you catch her easily. As the others see the tide turning, after they have their fill, they scatter like bird flocks.
All the food was fed to wild dogs.
Afterwards, the Sultan mocked you for spending money to let commoners eat for free, but indeed this could be considered as an act of Extravagance.
Afterwards, the Sultan mocked your foolish idea, but the extravagant feast for hundreds of people convinced the Sultan to acknowledge that you resolve this Sultan Card.

The Sultan finds this story dull, dismissing the guards to take the leader of the vagrants slandering before him away. Before you can break the Conquest Card and retire, you hear the Sultan yawn, telling the noble, "Ahmad, I heard there's fine wine in your mansion?"
The noble hastily promises to dedicate all his wine to the Sultan. But the Sultan smiles without remark. That miser knelt, shaking with cold sweat, takes a while before reluctantly claiming he misspoke, saying he'd offer the whole mansion instead... The Sultan waves, accepting the wine only, and giving the mansion to you—such is most befitting, the spirit of the Conquest Card.

5002503.title: Famous Hamar Brothers
strings: Famous Hamar Brothers

It is said that the brothers Hamar and Jemor, who occupy this place, are infamous and cruel highway robbers. One values life more than money, and the other values money more than life. If someone is unfortunate enough to encounter them together, they will have neither money nor life. The security team warns passing caravans to hire enough guards and avoid this dune area whenever possible.
Cunning Jemor
Ferocious Hamar
You can either go yourself or dispatch a strong enough follower to hunt.
An extra companion, a better chance of ensurance.
Some things might come in handy in the battle.
You can take this to break a Conquest Card of Silver tier or lower
After defeating the villains, most will be imprisoned in the Sultan's jail.
The whereabouts of the Hamar Brothers have been exposed, but capturing them is not easy...
The number of dice provided by your Combat and Physique is affected by the Brothers' corresponding attributes.
You need at least 2 Successes to catch them.
With your current [Physique] and [Combat] abilities, don't go looking for death.
If we have the support of [Intelligence], we will have a better chance of winning.

Each brother has his strengths and weaknesses. You had one companion disguise as a miserly merchant leading a camel alone, enticing the greedy Jemor. Without his cunning brother, the reckless Hamar was no issue. You managed to separate and defeat them individually, tying them up and marching them back to town well before sunset.
You underestimated your enemies, or perhaps god’s favor was not with you today. As the blood-red sunset fades, the Hamar Brothers claim more lives.
The Sultan allows you to break this Conquest Card. In the following days, you hear that guards frequently come and go at the city gates, seemingly searching for the thief's treasure.

5002504.title: Divine Stallion
strings: Divine Stallion

Someone swore that they had seen a pure black horse in the wilds east of the city. It was elegant and slender, with satin-like hair that shone as it ran, seeming to fly with the wind despite lacking wings. Many hunters tried to track it down and tame it, but they all returned empty-handed.
You can go yourself or send an experienced hunter.
More companions, more help.
Some things might come in handy during the taming.
Even if you fail, you can try again in a few rounds.

Following the hunters' guidance, you lay in ambush for several days and finally saw it. The pure black stallion stepped into the shallow ripples of the oasis under the enchanting moonlight, its fur shimmering as though it held a light. Seemingly catching your scent, it raised its head and looked towards your hiding spot. You almost dared not breathe as it gazed out at you from afar.
"They say the divine steed chooses its own master." Your guide's voice drops to a whisper. "Many have tried to capture it. All have failed."
Something stirs within you, a pull you can't explain. Slowly, you rise to your feet. Your eyes fix on the horse, a creature not of this world. You open your arms to it.
Your Wisdom and Survival determine your full dice count.
You need at least 2 Successes to capture the stallion.

The stallion steps gingerly, seeming hesitant. However, it soon snorts and approaches you. The shimmering light reflects in the water, creating a path of scattered brightness behind it. It lowers its head gently as it reaches you. You touch its warm forehead, feeling as though you’ve touched the generous gift of a deity.

The stallion steps gingerly and snorts, then turns and disappears into the darkness. The moonlight illuminates the white sand, but it seems as if the thick shadows are untouched by light. It disappears without a trace. Perhaps it will appear again, waiting for the right time and a suitable master.

5002505.title: Killing the Fierce Lion
strings: Killing the Fierce Lion

A lion, banished by its pride, approaches a human city during the dry season, desperate for food. Initially, it preyed on livestock, but later, it attacked shepherds, killing them swiftly. Once a beast has tasted the sweet and fragile human flesh, it becomes unstoppable. Stop it now! Or someday, you will become its prey.
The fierce lion with countless victims under its fangs.
You can either go yourself or dispatch a strong enough follower to hunt.
An extra companion, a better chance of success.
Some things might come in handy during the hunt.
You can take this to break a Conquest Card of Bronze tier or lower, or a Extravagance Card
If left unchecked, more innocent victims will fall, and eventually, you and your followers will suffer.

Hunting a lion requires more than just bravado. You had better be well-prepared – with traps, bait, or stronger weapons... You'll need anything that can give you the slightest edge. And pray for good luck...
The number of dice provided by your Physique and Combat is affected by the enemy's corresponding attributes.
You need at least 1 Success to win.

Preoccupied with other matters, you neglected the lion outside the city. Soon, news came that a merchant was killed by the lion. However, the good news is that after a full meal, it should refrain from causing trouble for some time.
With our current [Physique] and [Combat] abilities, it's best to make more preparations.
If we have the support of [Intelligence], we will have a better chance of winning.
An Extravagance Card needs to be used with a Gold Coin.

The lion cautiously circles around, eventually succumbing to the temptation of the sheep and stepping into your trap. 
Its paws and stomach are pierced by sharp wooden spikes, its fur soaked in blood. It roars loudly, trying to escape, but you force it back with your spear.
This is a battle of strength and endurance; you cannot afford a moment of laxity. Finally, the lion exhausts its last bit of strength and collapses with a whimper. After ensuring it is truly dead, you drag its body out of the trap. 
Conquering a lion is the ultimate symbol of a warrior's glory. As you wearily carry the lion's bloodied head through the long street, everyone remembers the hero's name.

The lion did not fall into your trap. You must rely on your agility and strong physique to engage in a prolonged struggle with the cunning beast. 
Finally, you seize an opportunity to leap onto the lion's back and plunge a dagger into its vulnerable throat. 
Despite its attempts to throw you off, you hold on tightly to its mane, praying to the gods. Gradually, its struggles weaken, and it collapses on the blood-soaked sand, lifeless. The world is silent, save for the sound of your heartbeat. It is dead. A sudden wave of relief washes over you, followed by unbearable pain and dizziness. 
When you awaken, you have been taken to a city Sanitarium by a passerby, and your bravery in battling the fierce lion has become a city-wide legend.

A reckless attack has cost you the chance of victory. 
You and the lion face off, not daring to show any fatigue. Using the best disguise you have, you maintain a strong facade. After a long standoff, the injured lion roars and retreats. Watching its form disappear into the sands, you nearly drop your dagger and collapse. 
Blood has long soaked through your clothes, and pain explodes from your back, spreading throughout your body. The lion's claws have left deep, hard-to-heal wounds, and you need immediate treatment.
Human, Beast, and Demon all can be bribed

You declare zealously, considering the mountain lion as sly as a demon, hunting it is too hard, so you will slaughter a cow at its mountain ridge haunt daily, to protect travelers along the way with feeding it such fresh meat...

The first feeding succeeded. Servants terrifiedly tell you the mountain lion followed them to a hillside near the city... it remembered where this fresh meat came from, expecting its next meal – you'd better not disappoint it.

The Sultan listens intently to your detailed lion hunt story. He accepts the lion's head you offer and permits you to break a Conquest Card. 
A few days later, the blood-soaked lion's head hangs on the wall of the audience hall, symbolizing the Sultan's power, glory, and bravery.

5002506.title: Merchant's Relics
strings: Merchant's Relics
It is said that a poor merchant was attacked by a lion and his bones were gone. His only remaining relics scattered in the wilderness, unclaimed...
You can go yourself or send a sufficiently cunning follower to steal it.
Some things might come in handy.
As long as the mountain lion exists, there will be more innocent victims.
Finding those lost items in the vast wilderness is not easy. If you want to seize them for yourself, you must avoid being noticed...
Your Wisdom and Stealth determine your full dice count.
You need at least 1 Success to find the target.
Following the traces of struggle and blood, you find the crime location. Seizing the moment when no one is around, you silently take some valuable items without being noticed.
The chaotic traces near the remaining corpse confuse you. The lingering smell of blood attracts vultures and hyenas. You narrowly escape their attack, leaving empty-handed.

5002507.title: Lion Rampage
strings: Lion Rampage
No one dares to hunt the lion, so it becomes more brazen. News of human-eating lions comes frequently, but this time, you find the victim seems to be a friend you know...
One of your followers seems to have been killed.
This is an unfortunate accident. You can't stop it.
Killing the mountain lion can stop such things from happening.

The corpse is fragmented and unrecognizable, but you can barely identify the victim as [s1.name] from the tattered clothes and accessories. He has indeed been missing for several days. That damned beast...Will you continue to endure this or resolve to avenge [s1.name]?

The corpse is fragmented and unrecognizable, but thankfully, it has some subtle differences from your friend's physique. This time it’s a false alarm, but what about next time? The lion will soon become hungry again. How long can you stand by and do nothing?

5002508.title: Trail of the Wolf King
strings: Trail of the Wolf King

A Wolf King has emerged in the prairies, rumored to possess human-like wisdom. Whenever someone tries to hunt the Wolf King, it becomes aware and completely vanishes. If the hunt fails, it’s likely that the hunters will be surrounded by the wolf pack.
You can go personally or send a smart follower to explore.
An extra companion, a better chance of success.
Some things might come in handy during the hunt.
If you fail, you will be ambushed by the wolf pack.
Search for the wolf's den.
Your Wisdom and Survival determine your full dice count.
You need at least 1 Success to find the target.
Found the location of the wolves’ den. Time for the next step: the raid.
The wolves ambushed you during the search, you barely made it back.

5002509.title: Battle at the Wolves’ Den
strings: Battle at the Wolves’ Den
Ultimately, human wisdom prevailed. You successfully located the wolves' lair, forcing the wolf king to confront you directly.
You can either go yourself or dispatch a strong enough follower to hunt.
An extra companion, a better chance of success.
Some things might come in handy during the hunt.
You can take this to break a Conquest Card of Bronze tier or lower
Time to face the wolf king and the pack.
Check time.
Your Physique and Combat determine your full dice count.
You need at least 1 Success to win.
Perfectly killed the wolf king and hunted down the pack.
Fought the wolf pack and the wolf king, emerging victorious.
Didn’t win, run fast
Resolve Conquest Card

5002510.title: Sewer Crocodile
strings: Sewer Crocodile

Travelling merchants tell tales of a rare beast known as the crocodile living in remote forest rivers. Now, due to a rich man's mistake, a crocodile hatchling has slipped into the sewer. No one knows if it’s still alive.
You can go yourself, or you can send a follower with sufficient skills.
Some things might come in handy.
With some luck, you might catch the crocodile alive.
The sewer is so narrow that only one person can move in and out smoothly.
Check time.
Your Survival and Combat determine your full dice count.
You need at least 3 Successes to capture the crocodile.
Exploration failed
The crocodile whose mouth bound by straps, was yanked from the canal, astonishing people with its pure white body.
It was a desperate struggle, but fortunately we won. This man-eating monster will claim no more innocent lives.
Obviously, entering the crocodile's territory was not a wise decision. Fortunately, only a row of tooth marks was left, and life was not lost.
Unexpected Discovery
A eunuch's headscarf caught in crocodile teeth... Apparently the Sultan really does feed executed slaves to the canal!

5002511.title: Snake Valley
strings: Snake Valley

Someone told you about a sandy valley outside the city, where many snakes roam. The black market is buying their venom glands at a high price. But it's not easy to obtain them... First, you need to survive the onslaught of snake fangs.
You can go yourself, or you can send an experienced follower to explore
An extra companion, a better chance of success.
Some things might come in handy during the search.
You need sufficient survival knowledge and strong physique to hunt the snakes.
Enough wisdom and knowledge might bring unexpected surprises.
In the desolate valley, you hear the hiss of snake tongues approaching...
As you leave the valley, you notice a clump of low shrubbery...
Your Physique and Survival determine your full dice count.
Your Wisdom and Survival determine your full dice count.
You need at least 1 Success to hunt the snakes.
You need at least 2 Successes to find the healing herbs.

Familiar with the snake’s habits and experienced enough, you swiftly press down the snake’s head, pin its neck, and quickly stuff it into the prepared sack. Live snakes fetch a better price. You seem to hear the sound of coins falling into your purse.
Oh my, so many snakes, slithering towards you like a tide. Your hair stands on end, feeling nothing but instinctual fear. You flee the valley in madness, and naturally, gain nothing.

Attracted by its feather-like small leaves and crumpled yellow flowers, you suddenly remember a healing herb you saw in the herbal collection. Its juice is said to even neutralize viper poison. You carefully collect some for future use, an unexpected surprise indeed.

Nothing special about the slender branches of the tree with crumpled small yellow flowers. If they were more vibrant, maybe you could have picked them for Maggie. Too bad... you shake your head gently and rush home before night falls.

5002512.title: Horse Betting
strings: Horse Betting
Send your rider and steed to compete, place bets. If victorious, you may receive a reward. Failure means losing everything.
Dispatch characters with high Survival attributes to participate.
The participating steed.
Some things might come in handy during the competition.
The maximum bet you can place is 2 Gold Coins.
Your opponent
Rely on the Physique of the steed and the Survival of the rider for checks.
Win and you get double your bet, lose and you lose everything.
Horse Betting Check

Congratulations on your victory, you have won doubled your bet.

5002516.title: Feeding the Fierce Lion
strings: Feeding the Fierce Lion

Initially, it was just a whim to resolve the Extravagance Card, but now the mountain lion has set its sights on you, expecting your blood offerings. You thought you could last for ten days; after the seasonal change, the wind would pick up, making the mountain path too difficult for merchants, and you would gain a good reputation.
The fierce lion with countless victims under its fangs.
Use 1 Gold Coin to purchase a strong, hefty bull.
Feeding is every day... please remember
It grows stronger day by day...
The Lion's Bargain

The servant who leads the cow reports strange occurrences every day. Sometimes he says the lion smiles at him, sometimes he says the lion follows him to the door... at the most exaggerated times, he says the lion stands up, walks on two legs, and picks his teeth with bones... You have no choice but to replace the servant, and warn them not to gossip.

One night, a hideous man with bad breath and sharp teeth appears in your dream...
"I am a magician. Previously, during sleepwalking, I was hurt and had to temporarily reside in the mountain lion's body."
he explains... "Thanks to your offerings, I have recovered. But I can't forget the taste of the best meat I ate in the lion's body, human flesh... Can you grant me one more human offering? In return, before leaving, I will make the lion loyal to you, giving you a powerful pet."
You are preoccupied with other matters and neglect the lion outside the city. You soon realize the consequences.

5002517.title: The Mountain Lion's Final Demand
strings: The Mountain Lion's Final Demand
Should you trust the evil dream or dispose of the monster still craving human flesh?
The fierce lion with countless victims under its fangs.
You can either go yourself or dispatch a strong enough follower to hunt.
An extra companion, a better chance of success.
Some things might come in handy during the hunt.
You can take this to break a Conquest Card of Bronze tier or lower
Sacrifice for the Mountain Lion.
If you place a sacrifice, you won't have to combats it. This will satisfy the mountain lion's hunger and earn its reward.
If you choose to combats, be prepared, as it is now stronger than before.

Hunting a lion requires more than just bravado. You had better be well-prepared – with traps, bait, or stronger weapons... You'll need anything that can give you the slightest edge. And pray for good luck...
The number of dice provided by your Physique and Combat is affected by the enemy's corresponding attributes.
You need at least 1 Success to win.

You decide to stay away from this strange animal. Fortunately, just as the dream foretold, the magician eventually left, and you never heard of the Mountain Lion attacking people again. Maybe he’s fighting off his own desires too.
With our current [Physique] and [Combat] abilities, it's best to make more preparations.

You sacrificed a living person.

The mountain lion eagerly pounces on its meal... devouring wildly, feasting grandly, leaving only bones and blood pools, with the feline sighing satisfyingly, you are sure something has departed from its body.

The gigantic cat curiously eyes you, its face smears with blood, then lie on the ground exposing its soft belly for you to caress.

The Sultan listens intently to your detailed lion hunt story. He accepts the lion's head you offer and permits you to break a Conquest Card. 
A few days later, the blood-soaked lion's head hangs on the wall of the audience hall, symbolizing the Sultan's power, glory, and bravery.

5003001.title: Dissonance
strings: Dissonance

You notice that Maggie no longer waits for you to have breakfast together in the mornings and only responds with cold silence or brief, dismissive answers when you speak. Despite living under the same roof, you find that you meet less and less, as if you are no longer companions of fate riding the same camel. She is still as gentle and calm as usual, but you always feel an undercurrent in her deliberate avoidance of your gaze... could this be an illusion?
Think about what you've done.
Wife
Maybe there's still a chance to make amends before an incident happens.
Maybe something can help.
At this point, you can avoid the outbreak of your Wife's Resentment, but as long as the repulsion exists, such events will continue to happen.
The more Resentments your wife has, the more severe subsequent events will be.
Your Wife's Resentment will bring negative modifiers to checks, please be aware.
You deliberately wake up early and, in the lingering dawn mist, stop your wife as she silently prepares to leave, "What’s been bothering you lately?"
The number of dice provided by your Charisma and Sociability is affected by Repulsion.
You need at least 1 Success to get through this.

Maggie impatiently interrupts your rambling. She appears tired, her face somewhat pale, as if ill.
She rubs her temple, sighing softly. "Never mind," she says. "Prepare that 'scented water' for me. I wish to bathe."
You stand bewildered before realizing she means what Nabhani previously prepared for her...

You said a lengthy string of nonsense, and Maggie patiently listened, just as she did in your happiest times together. Could that uneasy feeling be just a false impression? Suddenly, you fall silent. Seeing you stop talking, she finally speaks, denying and overturning everything you assumed: "Really. You're overthinking it. I am not upset." She politely lowers her head in a bow before leaving.
It was as if you were just strangers who happened to meet on the street.

You said a lengthy string of incessant nonsense, but Maggie's expression remained unchanged from start to finish. She responded to your insincere performance with indifference: "I am not upset. Finished? I'm leaving."
You said a lengthy string of incessant nonsense, and Maggie barely tolerated listening to it. She interrupts you with a frown: "I said I am not upset. I'm leaving. Let's talk next time."
You don’t need to do much. Your usual warm gestures have temporarily eased your Wife's Resentment.

Maggie looks at you and calmly says, "I am not upset.”
You know she is upset, and it's because of you. You are well aware of what has happened, but now is not the time to discuss it.
You tell her a series of jokes, make several funny faces, and make promises. Finally, she can't help but let out a small laugh. The smile is fleeting, and she repeats, "Alright, I'm not upset.”
No man would take her words seriously. You know the crisis still exists, and the repulsion still lingers in her deeply disappointed heart. But the axe won't fall on your neck today.

5003002.title: Journey to Visit a Friend
strings: Journey to Visit a Friend
A servant tells you that your wife Maggie has gone to visit a friend and will be back in a few days.
Your Wife is already away
This ritual will occupy your wife, preventing you from involving her in other matters.
When engaged in one ritual, other similar events will not automatically involve this character.

Maggie is back. She nods at you as usual, but before she walks past, you grab her and ask why she didn't tell you in advance. She calmly replies that even if she had told you, you wouldn't have gone with her to visit friends, right?
She's right. You were completely caught up in those cards. They gave you a lot, courage, power to do things you never dared or could do before. But for everything they gave you, they took away more. In this game of cards, you are neither the dealer nor the player anymore; you can't leave the game and say you've had enough and now will spend time with your beloved Maggie. There was a time when Maggie always smiled at you.
That was a very long, long time ago.

5003003.title: Stress Relief
strings: Stress Relief
A servant tells you that your wife Maggie went shopping in the street early in the morning and will return in the evening. It seems she can't help you with other things today.
Maggie has gone out
Maggie took some money
This is an unfortunate event that has already happened, you can't change it.
If your money is not enough to support your wife's expenses, she will be even more repulsed.

Maggie is back. You didn't ask her proactively, and she didn't tell you what she bought today or what new things happened. Silence hangs over you both, making you feel exhausted. That night, you dream that you are walking with camels through an endless sea of sand. You talk about random things just like before, until she suddenly becomes quiet. You see your sins reflected in her clear eyes, like a omen of a sandstorm just brewing in a corner of the sky.

Maggie came back, but she didn't say a word. She just went back to her room and heavily locked the door. You are bewildered, puzzled, and only by interrogating her maid do you learn that she fancied a piece of jewelry but didn't have enough money to buy it.
You know Maggie. Even if no one mocked her on the street, she would still torture herself for that embarrassing moment. She will start to recall every mistake you made during your marriage, shedding tears over them once again.
When her tears run dry, you will lose all chances to make amends.

5003004.title: Storm Omen
strings: Storm Omen

The servant tells you that Maggie left early in the morning. Upon closer inquiry, they hesitate and cannot give you a clear answer. You have a premonition that the storm you have been unwilling to face has already arrived.
Maggie has gone out
You can go yourself, or you can send a follower to investigate
You can bring some items with you to aid your investigation more stealthily
If you discover something, subsequent events may be triggered.

At this point, asking sincere questions and communicating is impossible – no one will repeatedly accept a dagger with a soft heart. She has long raised her shield and built high walls; you can't go back to the past, and it's your own doing. Do you really want to find out where Maggie went and what she did? Then be like Wild dog following the scent of meat. But be clear, no one welcomes Wild dog. For the sake of the little dignity left between you, it's best not to be discovered.
Your Stealth and Sociability determine your full dice count.
You need at least 1 Success to have a chance of getting the information.

You don't even know how you got here. You emerge from the dark alley. 
Three minutes ago, a young man inside the door opened it with a ladle in hand; he smiled when he saw Maggie. He embraced your Wife, lightly kissed her, and then pulled her inside. A tempting and rich fragrance poured out from every crack in the bricks. Was it from the soup he made by hand? It stirred your fading memories; why did it seem so familiar? It was like Maggie's favorite flavor - information you yourself had shared with him. 
You found yourself approaching, almost placing your ear against the wall, trying to hear the murmurs and whispers inside. In this small room, Maggie was no longer your Wife. She belonged to another man. You hadn't seen her smile in such a way for a long time, and now, her beauty and gentleness were laid bare for someone else to enjoy. A flame burst in your chest – was it anger, jealousy, hatred, or resentment? Unknowingly, you and Maggie have reached the edge of a cliff.

In the maze of intertwined alleys, you lost track of Maggie. There are countless forks in the road beneath your feet, each one leading to an unknown end, questioning you about what outcome you really want. Fate has played a dark joke on you. It's time to turn back.
Finally, you turn around and retrace your steps. At the end of the path is your home, where you and Maggie live, lying under the night sky. You open the door and see Maggie kneeling at the table. She glances at you calmly and then returns to her work. You are weary and confused, but for now, it seems like nothing is wrong. In the lamplight, she is still your wife.

5003005.title: Accumulated Grief
strings: Accumulated Grief
You notice that Maggie has had trouble sleeping lately and lacks energy during the day, as if she were sick.
Wife is sick.
Melancholy and Sickness permanently reduce your Wife's Attributes.
If your wife repeatedly falls Sick, you may lose her.

At your persuasion, Maggie reluctantly ate something, but soon vomited uncontrollably again. You almost watched her become pale, weak, and emaciated with your own eyes. She often stared blankly and cried for no reason; she always woke up from nightmares and could hardly sleep all night. Finally, one day, you got up and found that she was still asleep, peaceful as a baby.
The weather was good that day, and the servants were busy setting up the breakfast table, the courtyard was bustling with excitement. This false prosperity lightly wrapped around a quiet, melancholy, and stopped heart. You held her cold hands and repeatedly confirmed that you had lost Maggie forever.

At your persuasion, Maggie finally ate something reluctantly, but the gloomy clouds still gathered between her slightly furrowed brows. What she needed was not food, blankets, or potions, just like a tree with a rotten core, sunlight, and rain could no longer allow it to continue to live as usual. What she needed was some kind of intangible and formless thing – it brings life, and it brings death; the more it brings joy, the more it brings torment.

5003006.title: Into the Dream
strings: Into the Dream
Everything is as usual. It seems you have returned to the moment when you loved each other the most.
You come to your wife's side as usual.
Tonight, your wife is unusually gentle.
This is a failed ending, you are dead

When you walked into the bedroom, you smelled a light fragrance. Maggie sat by the bed, somehow interested in fiddling with the brass censer.
The curling smoke from the agarwood blurred her outline, soft as a dream. You walked over gently and tucked her fallen hair behind her ear. She looked up at you, and her glass-like eyes seemed to be filled with shallow affection that she wanted to speak of but couldn’t.
This must be a beautiful dream. You kissed her red lips, tasted a moving fragrance like sweet fine wine. You were intoxicated with this long-lost tenderness, unable to think of any peculiarity.
Just sleep like this. Forget about the indifference, suspicion, and resentment that had long been entrenched between you, the things that cruelly exhausted all the trust and love. Let it take you back to those youthful years, where endless loving words filled every kiss's gap. Back then, you couldn't imagine you would come to such a sad end...
No, don't think about it. Don't think about it. Don’t let the poison in the cup, the dagger under the silk, show itself. Don’t let this rare tender night cool again. Let it all be a dream. Death is but an eternal sleep, and tears and blood share the same temperature. You embraced the hazy illusion and deeply sank into the dream.

5003007.title: Set You Free
strings: Set You Free
Something is happening secretly.
Wife
Cook
All Your Property
This is a sudden misfortune that you were too late to prevent, you can only accept the result

Maggie left with a man, taking all your money. It wasn't without signs, as you gazed at the empty mansion, thinking about the past, feeling half anger, half helplessness, and vaguely, a sense of inexplicable relief – honestly, you had already betrayed the love you once had, and now she has betrayed you, isn't this fair? No more useless guilt and worry! You lost Maggie, and you gained freedom.

5003008.title: Face the Reality
strings: Face the Reality
Just a wall away, your wife is having an affair with another man.
Unaware Wife
Lovestruck Habib
You cannot tolerate your wife's betrayal
You choose to leave, pretending that nothing happened
According to the Sultan's law, adulterers will be executed

You kick open the door, and your wife who betrayed you stares back in shock, while the man who seduced her instinctively protects her. You recognized him instantly - Habib, the talented cook you'd summoned from your territory to prepare meals at your guesthouse. When had this liaison begun? The signs must have been there. You should have noticed.
You are furious, completely losing your rationality. A war breaks out in this small room, with painful roars and the cries of a woman. This alarmed the nearby neighbors, and soon the guards of the security team arrived. They separated you and Habib, and this scandalous betrayal was exposed to the public, becoming a hot topic of conversation. People eagerly anticipate the tragic fate of Maggie and Habib, and speculate on who will be lucky or unlucky enough to become your next wife.

Your hands and feet are cold, almost unable to move. Maggie betrayed you; this thought lingers in your mind like a curse. Deep regret and cowardice rule your heart, making you only want to escape from here. You would rather know nothing; you would rather be an ostrich burying your head in the sand. You even find an excuse for yourself. If you just leave like this, you and Maggie would be even, right? She can go ahead and be happy with her lover, because you did the same before. You can leave some room and dignity for each other, maintaining a marriage in name only. It doesn't matter who betrayed whom. Let it be.

Your hands and feet are cold, almost unable to move. As you hesitate, night quietly falls. When you look at that window again, Maggie has long left her lover's place. Even if you wanted to do something, you have missed the opportunity.

5003009.title: Execution
strings: Execution
According to the law, Maggie and Habib will be executed.
Wife being executed
Habib Being Executed

You can take this to break a Bloodshed Card that matches the Habib's tier

You look at the two rolling heads, feeling an eerie and pale calmness inside. It's all over. The complex love and resentment between you and Maggie, regardless of everything, has come to an end, driven by impulse and anger. No one will ever be sad because of your transgressions again. You no longer need to feel guilty or uneasy and can fully enjoy your future pleasures. If you can't stand the dark, empty mansion, you can marry a young, beautiful, or ambitious woman to be your new wife, to play this game of life with you. But the one waiting for you under the lamp will never be Maggie again, that's all.

You coldly watch the two heads roll. You have no more ripples in your heart. You request the Sultan to offset the Bloodshed Card with the lives of these two people. The Sultan scrutinizes you and laughs heartily. Is it the betrayal that bred your cruelty? You still think about the set of cards you once despised immensely, which you now turn to your own advantage. But nevertheless, he appreciates your rationality and decisiveness, personally breaking the card you presented.

5003010.title: Brewing conspiracy
strings: Brewing conspiracy
Your evil deeds have bred hatred and repulsion in the dark, and some conspiracies against you are quietly brewing...
You have offended many people.
Maybe someone is willing to help you.
Maybe something can help.

You have made some mistakes, but that doesn't matter, does it? Rumors are like poisoned daggers hidden in their sheaths, but who says they can't be used by you?
The number of dice provided by your Charisma and Sociability is affected by Infamy.
When you achieve 3 Successes, your Infamy -1.

You notice that people have been whispering and murmuring behind your back recently, but as soon as they see you looking over, they act as if nothing has happened. Something is brewing under the surface; be careful.

You failed. You and your friends can't control the spreading rumors. People's repulsion with you is growing, and they are eager to distort and judge you, hoping to see you fall from grace and shatter. You should know this is the favorite feast for rats and vultures.

Is it because everyone has been intimidated by your fearsome reputation? Everything seems calm. Occasionally, someone passes by your door and quickly leaves, their expression showing a hint of pity when they look at you.
You don't need to do much; your usual warm-hearted actions make many people willing to help you.

No one in this world cares about the truth; everyone is enjoying and performing in a farce. You are both the hidden spectators indulging in the dark and the clowns laughing uncontrollably on stage. Keep going! Perform until the end; as long as you perform until the end, you will be the winner.

5003012.title: Rumors Spread
strings: Rumors Spread
Overnight, rumors spread, mixing truth with falsehood.

Things have spiraled out of your control. The frenzy with which people add fuel to the fire has dissipated what little resolve you had left, and you are forced into a desperate struggle. You have become a pure embodiment of evil. No evidence is needed, and anyone can accuse you of any crime, which will be met with gleeful laughter. No one cares about the truth, and no one listens to your explanations. Give up, fall into depravity; conscience and truth have no place on this cursed land.

You ran yourself ragged, managing to stop the rumor's spread just before things became irreversible. However, you noticed that many people no longer respect you as they once did. Regardless of your power and wealth, they can see through your splendid attire to the disgrace beneath and laugh uproariously.

5003013.title: Justice's Challenge

For justice, revenge, or glory? Someone blocked your door, demanding a duel.

You lost. Your life is rapidly fading away with your flowing blood. In the challenger's eyes, you see profound void and silence. Some will rejoice at your death, and a new round of struggle will begin over your wealth and power. Some will rise to fame, others will be chosen for the next round of the Sultan's Game, and maybe some will cry for you all night. But rest assured, they will soon forget you. The world is like a desert, and we are just dust.

After a tough combat, you finally beheaded the challenger. The Sultan rewards your bravery, allowing you to offset a Bloodshed Card. On his throne, he watches your bloodstains with interest, his smile sending chills down your spine. Maybe he thought of a new game... you wouldn't want to know what it is.

After a tough combat, you finally defeated your opponent. The eyes that were once filled with resolve and fury now only reflect shock and despair. You won, and you're not planning to kill him. Death is too easy, isn’t it? You can judge and mock him as much as you like, just as people have done to you.
You cursed your opponent right to death with vicious language! You've won!
You have applied poison to your weapon, and you only need to make a small cut, and then you can wait for victory! With that stratagem, you've won!
Your cowardice has become the latest joke in the city. Your noble peers feel humiliated and despise you even more.
Your bravery and noble mercy make the crowd applaud, wishing they could reward you with a few coins. See, fools do not care for bloodshed and the shadow of death; they just seek entertainment.
Your incredible bravery and noble mercy are widely praised throughout the city. This victory has intimidated many who wanted to trouble you. For the time being, you should be able to live peacefully.
Your bravery and noble mercy amaze everyone. People talk about this victory with great enthusiasm, either out of respect or fear, they no longer dare to openly express their repulsion.

You can't remember how the accident happened, only that your head felt a sudden blow, followed by a dizzying, drunken feeling. When you woke up, every part of your body hurt; your hands and feet almost couldn't move. Then you saw your friends who were also bruised and groaning. Suddenly, you felt a burst of happiness. At least, you are all still alive...

A meticulously planned assassination silently captures you before dawn. Embrace the cold, dark, and eternal silence. Your crimes will be judged before the gods.

The women bake bread for the journey, servants silently help you move unusual supplies, and children sing songs of the departing swan –
Everyone knows of your coming escape, yet they guard your secret.
They sign the dubious documents and turn a blind eye to your carriages; knowing your plans, none dare speak to the Sultan.
Even the most despicable bow before you, if not out of respect, then out of fear. You are tearing yourself from the soil, causing the insects and ants below to tremble – but they remain silent...

Those who seek to divine you will find their tongues seared by your radiance; those who dare reflect you will be pierced by your light. To escape the Sultan's game, you must deceive – deceive the Sultan, deceive fate, deceive the magician...
Take everything you can and escape before the Sultan finds out!

It's him! I heard he's cursed by the Sultan's Magician – he has to defile and slay a woman every single day! I heard it's a man! I heard he gorges on gold and children... Grass withers where he walks!

5004501.title: Seeking Order Aid
strings: Seeking Order Aid

On the holy day of worship, sacred waters cascade over polished temple stones, flowing past the bare feet and prostrate hands of the faithful. 
The priests of the Purist stand within the temple's depths, among soaring white pillars, beneath the azure canopy of heaven and purifying sunlight, their gold-dusted skin shimmering with subtle radiance.
Order High Priest
You can go yourself, or you can let Maggie seek the Order's aid
Because of your past actions, no one welcomes you here, nor will anyone answer your questions.

Iman serves as High Priest of the Purist Order, yet surprisingly bears a countenance lacking compassion - cold, even detached. 
He accepts the Sultan Card you present, closes his eyes in prolonged silence, then shakes his head. "I cannot destroy this." Returning the card, he meticulously cleanses his fingers with spring water dripping from the columns, as though contaminated by utter filth. "If you seek blessing or confession, I stand ready to assist." 
His tone remains formal, yet his gaze holds such profound tranquility that you cannot determine whether his reluctance stems from lack of incentive or genuine inability.

Faith in the Immaculate Purity
Witness to Devotion
Follower Witnessed Piety

You haven't yet reached new heights; your prayers remain unanswered.
A sacred voice thunders through your quiet mind, guiding your vision toward a new, perfect, sinless earthly kingdom...
You suddenly understand... to live in this world is to live in sin; without proper atonement, one cannot return to the pure throne.
Closing your eyes amidst cold sunlight and flowing springs, you extend your hand and - in this moment of revelation - sense something like... god's touch.

strings: Confession
In this place of accumulated sin, confess your transgressions to the priests, cleansing your soul and faith.

That place is no longer my shelter
The Immaculate Purity is not the god I worship
Meow?
What right does a slave have to confess? The Purist Order recently preaches that slaves need their masters' grace for their souls to be saved!
I can't go - I'd be exposed!
The mirror holds no sins to confess.

Maggie prays for her husband - for you. 
She beseeches the Immaculate Purity to protect your soul, that you might remain the man she married despite all you've endured...

Seliman, face covered, quietly asks the priest what penalty adultery carries. 
The priest explains that adulterous men and women have their loins burned until their desires are purified. Seliman then asks if one person can bear double punishment for both parties. 
The priest sighs, convinced this man is beyond redemption.

Habib has the priest bless his butcher's knife, then places it on flowers while praying that the animals sacrificed for human appetites might return to the Immaculate... Clearly not his first such ritual.
Jenna generously donates gold from her jewelry business to the Purist Order. The priests tactfully ignore her covetous glances at their opal ornaments.

Jabal isn't devoutly religious, but prays for his fallen comrades nonetheless. He questions different priests, seeking satisfying answers about old soldiers' final destinations - but never receives entirely pleasing responses.
Nayla's moans echo from the prayer chamber - you knew exactly how she'd confess. According to her, she's already seduced the neighboring priest, though you'd rather not hear details.
How does Qais have so many sins to confess? Upon returning, you see he's voluntarily submitted to purification - being thoroughly beaten.
Jawad reluctantly performs a token confession at your insistence, donating a few coins - which produces roughly the same spiritual effect as the most heartfelt contrition.

Adila refuses confession, claiming she's never regretted anything nor believes divine correction necessary... After much persuasion to simply go through the motions as a favor to you... remarkably, a sacred power - whether Immaculate or otherwise - blesses her blade.
Fatuna weeps uncontrollably in the confession chamber, eventually shedding tears of blood that blur her vision for days - the priests declare the Immaculate has heard her confession.
Zaki believes in divinity but lacks maturity to properly revere it. After confession, he tells you, thoroughly alarmed, that the chamber induces terrifying visions...
Nabhani spent half the day coordinating his outfit for the temple visit, attracting admiring noble ladies and servants along the way... Predictably, the irritated priest eventually expels him.

Faris must have committed many errors - though he's forgotten them all! Eager to help you through confession, he begins describing inappropriate childhood feelings toward a horse, so shocking the priest behind the partition that he stumbles.

What sins could Junah possibly confess? No one taught her prayer words! But pleasing the divine through confession sounds appealing; Junah excels at pleasing others, especially divine beings. 
So Junah, after consideration, removes her clothes in the Immaculate's chamber, arms and legs outstretched - offering her entire life for god judgment... 
When she hears heavy breathing and moaning from the next compartment, she smiles and concludes her confession.

Jalila angrily recounts priests' misconduct in her chamber: how they lick her feet and call her whip the divine touch... When she mentions holy water, the priest peers around the partition begging her to leave...

Shama was born into sin: her father once demanded Purist priests burn away her "inappropriate parts" with hot irons, then seal her with healing magic - such bodily anomalies represent impurity to the Purist Order. 
However, priests who've tasted her have different opinions... In the prayer room, Shama quietly meets old friends, smoothing your relations with the Order, accomplishing your task.

Alim has accumulated too many sins... He fears starting prayer might incinerate him instantly! 
Under your persuasion, he finally attempts confession, fabricating adultery with a noblewoman before stealing a coin from a passing priest - this god lacks power, he concludes.

Lumera obeys your command - though you know she holds no reverence for divinity. 
Returning from the temple, she tells you something in that dark chamber truly listens to everyone's thoughts.

Raed has many confessions, heaviest being the sin of weakness: failing to protect everyone, witnessing tragedy without intervention, knowing the world contains endless wrongs yet allowing it to continue... 
The god offers no response, yet she senses its suffering.

What do these bandit brothers know of confession? Yet the more debased the sinner, the more their contrition must be proclaimed, thus demonstrating divine mercy's vastness and mysterious judgment... Your arrangement pleases the Purist Order greatly.

Surprisingly, Mahir confesses... 
Reportedly reciting formulas and celestial coordinates in the chamber, theorizing connections between the Order's aether collection devices and the moon - apparently proving the divine approaches our world! 
The next day, Order representatives visit, asking you to silence Mahir...
Faraj refuses to reveal his confession but confirms the practice genuinely soothes body and mind... Unfortunately, one cannot confess frequently.
Hassan composes his various minor misdeeds into a humorous rhyme, singing loudly - the neighboring priest quickly has him removed.

Seated in the confession chamber with only an oil lamp symbolizing the Immaculate's salvation in this dark world, you wait. No divine presence manifests - so you begin recounting your story to the darkness, detailing how you've completed and plan to complete the Sultan Cards. 
As you speak, countless versions of yourself emerge from shadows, taking seats... Elders, children, mostly various-expressioned adults of different builds, mostly silent but occasionally sharing personal memories. Behind them, larger forms quietly take positions... listening to your life story...
They say the dancer performed in that dark chamber, and after her departure, it overflowed with petals and fragrance - the Purist Order proclaimed this an auspicious sign.

Malkina shows the divine her hands - fingers scarred from embroidery research, skin roughened by grinding dyes and minerals - surely a form of confession? 
The priests scoff, despising labor's marks and mocking Malkina's ignorance... This barely qualifies as preaching.
Books carrying dark knowledge and impure thoughts, volumes perpetuating Star-Souled beliefs, should rightfully be destroyed.
You couldn't care less what Inal's confessing about. Women's tears? Always over something worthless anyway.

Inal's chattering voice fills the confessional in an instant, light, quick, unstoppable. One moment she's praising you, the next Maggie, the next that plump little bird she spotted on a branch, how it'd taste roasted... She's not here to confess. She just wanted somewhere to talk. But for the gold? The priests can't be bothered to care.

You don't know why, you really don't, but after Asal came out of the confessional, he slipped you a gold coin all mysterious-like, said it was your cut this time... Wait. Hold on. What kind of book did he sell those priests to rake in this much?
Sacred Lewdness!
Sand Dust

This Star-Souled idol, long banished by the Immaculate Purity, should have been destroyed ages ago.

[s1.name] was surrounded by priests and believers, denounced as blasphemer and cultist, criticized and mocked. Suddenly, everyone acquired the right to shove, seize, and toy with [s1.name]! As if they were all pure saints!
Finally, [s1.name] fled in humiliation, and that precious garment naturally fell into the furious priests' hands... It should be destroyed - such waste.

After obtaining the Aether, Badriyyah doesn't leave with you. Giggling, she walks step by step into this sapphire-like pool... Let this mortal woman soil the nectar prepared for the gods!
She removes her garments one by one; the fabrics quickly dissolve like ink in the azure pool... Then her tattoos begin fading - you've never seen her like this, naked and clean.
When her hair begins falling out, she smilingly prevents anyone from approaching, mischievously pressing her lower abdomen... Urine and blood flow down her legs into the pool, followed by nails, teeth, peeling skin and organs - black organs.
As her final skeleton collapses and dissolves in the pool, the formerly sapphire-clear water has become pitch-black, churning with foul bubbles... You'd better flee quickly, before the god realizes someone has spat in its refreshing treat.
