These designs flow from [s1.name]'s eyes into your dreams. In that realm, countless eyes watch you as mysterious patterns etch themselves into the empty spaces of your soul, constructing bridges across the void...

5006134.title: Nighttime Gift
strings: Nighttime Gift
Perhaps you should show this crystal to Samir and discuss how to handle it.
Referring to the Codex Compiled by Samir
Midnight Crystal

Samir turns the crystal-like formation over and over in his hands, a puzzled frown on his face. Then, as if struck by a sudden thought, his eyes light up.
"This is the potion after it's been reprocessed... consuming the imitation of the Water of Life through some unusual force, leaving only the residue...! This could be tremendously useful for pharmacology. It might even open an entirely new field of study!"
He thanks you, practically glowing with excitement. You have never seen Samir so happy.
After a long while, a servant knocks at your door, bringing a massive tome. Its edges are trimmed with pure gold, and every page is adorned with beautiful calligraphy.
As you skim it, the contents are largely the same as the original medical texts, with one new chapter added. Samir has illustrated the effects of the Midnight Crystal on alchemy, including testimonials from several palace eunuchs who volunteered to experiment with its power.
At the end, Samir writes: "This is another step humanity takes toward the unknown. Its direction may be uncertain, its power may be unstable, yet human conquest is built step by step. Viewed from centuries hence, this may well be a great step. I am grateful to my friend [player.name] for your assistance."

5006135.title: Drink of the Night
strings: Drink of the Night
The wine is brewed. It is time to invite friends to taste it.
Today's menu
You can go youselft, or invite followers to taste it
Someone has to try it, after all.
Soon, you are all intoxicated...

No one expected to fall so quickly! It is as if darkness itself has fallen upon you, and consciousness slips away. When you awaken the next day, something about you has subtly changed—though it is hard to describe. Perhaps this is the gift of the night.
Singing While Drunk

You hear Hassan's laughter and his recitation of poems, yet no one remembers exactly what he wrote—not even Hassan himself. He swears that he produced a masterpiece before succumbing to the wine, and you all nod in agreement—but all that remains are disheveled clothes and leftover food. Even Lamblet stares back impassively, refusing any responsibility.

5006136.title: Rough Gems
strings: Rough Gems

Gems on the market are far too expensive! Jenna hopes you can locate some rough gems, offering to cut them for you at no charge—though embedding them into your equipment will cost extra. In any case, this proves quite beneficial.
Best handled by someone with keen perception and negotiation skills.
It costs at least 2 Gold Coins.
Finding rarer gems will cost 4 extra Gold Coins.
A consumables for assistance in the search.
Searching for high-grade gems is more difficult than medium stones but yields rarer results.
In this land, diamonds are special.
You begin searching for rough gems.
You begin searching for rare, high-grade rough gems.
Wisdom and Sociability determine your full dice count.
You need at least 3 Successes.
You need at least 5 Successes.
That's What You Want
This is just a plain stone.
Total Loss
Jenna carefully slices open the raw stone, and the gem within bursts forth with brilliance...

"The clarity is no good..." Jenna shakes her head, disappointed. "Every raw stone is a challenge... skill, precision, courage... and above all, luck." She puts away her tools and offers you an encouraging smile. "Perhaps next time you'll reveal a perfect gem."
Jenna carefully slices open the precious raw stone, and the gem within bursts forth with brilliance...

"The clarity is no good..." Jenna shakes her head, disappointed. "Every raw stone is a challenge... skill, precision, courage... and above all, luck." She puts away her tools and offers you an encouraging smile. "Perhaps next time you'll reveal a perfect gem."
Perhaps worried that your spirits might be crushed, Jenna even contributes a few Gold Coins from her own purse—small, but a token gesture.
Wretched Gem Thief

You seek out a supposedly skilled jeweler in the black market to help cut the rough gem you purchased. What a beautiful gem it is! Just thinking about it makes your heart ache... But that wretched jeweler finds an excuse, and suddenly your gem disappears without a trace! You never see him again. No one does. Cursed be him! You swear at him hundreds of times and vow never to deal with these blasted stones again—at least until you have a trustworthy jeweler like Jenna by your side.
Just Take It
Before leaving, Jenna slips you a piece of cow bone. This "gem" you both helped hype has now increased in value, and she is willing to share the spoils before the excitement fades.

5006137.title: Gem Embedment
strings: Gem Embedment
Jenna can help embed gems into your equipment.
One piece of equipment
One gem
2 Gold Coins budget
Each piece of equipment can be embedded with only one gem.
Place an unsocketed piece of equipment and a gem to embed the gem into the item.
Place an equipment piece with embedded gems inside without adding a gem to remove its socketed gem.
Place both a gem and an equipment piece with an embedded gem to replace the current gem with the new one.
Quite a Fine Piece
Remove It
Replace It With a New One

Jenna nods earnestly, tracing her finger across a spot on [s1.name]. "If you have a gem, I can set it right here. What do you think?"
You nod in agreement. The task now is to find a jewel truly worthy of such an embedment.
After a careful session of delicate hammering and polishing, Jenna cuts and sets [s2.name] with practiced hands—[s1.name] now shines like the stars! With this gem in place, it feels reborn.
Jenna works with patient care as she disassembles the setting, all the while asking if her craft has failed to meet your expectations.
Jenna polishes a fresh gem, wearing an expression that says, I know exactly what you mean. After all, customers crave novelty—that's how jewelers make their living.

5006138.title: A Dubious Treasure
strings: A Dubious Treasure
A shifty merchant seems to be peddling some suspicious stones... The luster, the purity—surely, these are diamonds!
Suspicious Diamond
Perhaps there are clues to be found in the Dark Alley.
With careful preparation, you can trace the diamonds' source in person or send any follower in your stead.
10 Gold Coins. No bargaining, no exceptions.
Perhaps among the vagrants, there are clues to be found.
Consumables to assist the investigation
Business is always a matter of patience; if you don't buy today, there will always be another chance... Perhaps.
When it comes to an investigation, subtlety is everything. You have but one chance.
The trail is difficult to follow. Prepare yourself.
You attempt to shadow the merchant discreetly, hoping to uncover the true source of these questionable diamonds.
Survival and Stealth determine your full dice count.
You need at least 10 Successes to win.
You need at least 5 Successes.
You sensed a trap. After careful thought, you resisted the lure of diamonds. Of course, you lost the chance to deal with those merchants.
Things have been tense lately. After careful thought, you resisted the lure of diamonds. Of course, you lost your last chance to deal with those merchants.
I Want It All
Let me see your goods
Never give yourself away
You snap up all his diamonds in one go. The merchant weighs the heavy purse, beaming with joy as he bows repeatedly to thank you.

You sort through the stones carefully—unbelievable, they really are diamonds! The merchant takes your payment, then packs up and disappears into the alleys, no doubt seeking his next wealthy customer.
You keep to the shadow at a distance, watching silently without drawing attention—and without buying into these dubious gems.
You succeeded
You lose the trail.
An Easy Pursuit
He was pretending!
[s5.name] fixes eyes upon him.
The outcome pleases you nonetheless. After all, who doesn't dream of snatching up these glittering trinkets at such a low price?

This merchant shows unusual caution. He wanders through alleys in circles, changes sedan chairs twice, and finally slips into a light carriage bound for the outskirts.
[s5.name] follows at a distance. More than once, the merchant halts to scan his surroundings, clearly sensing something amiss, but [s5.name] conceals with skill each time and avoids detection. After nearly half a day's journey, the barren land opens to reveal a vast pit before [s5.name]...
Wide at the rim but narrowing toward the bottom, it resembles a flattened funnel. Along its walls, a spiraling dirt path winds upward. From afar, dozens of laborers strain to push wheelbarrows laden with earth. Around the pit, freshly dug soil forms towering mounds, while emaciated figures crouch by the river, endlessly washing and sifting the dirt. Cruel overseers pace the rim with long whips, striking and cursing without pause...
At once, you understand: this is a hidden diamond mine—unknown to the Sultan, yet lying just beyond the capital, beneath his very gaze!
Worse still, the merchant seems to remember your face. From that day forward, he never appears before you again.

The merchant quickly sells off every last diamond. With hours of daylight left, he indulges himself—brothels, gaming houses, taverns—before staggering drunkenly into a light carriage bound for the outskirts.
[s5.name] follows at a distance. After nearly half a day's journey, the barren land opens to reveal a vast pit before [s5.name]...
Wide at the rim but narrowing toward the bottom, it resembles a flattened funnel. Along its walls, a spiraling dirt path winds upward. From afar, dozens of laborers strain to push wheelbarrows laden with earth. Around the pit, freshly dug soil forms towering mounds, while emaciated figures crouch by the river, endlessly washing and sifting the dirt. Cruel overseers pace the rim with long whips, striking and cursing without pause...
At once, you understand: this is a hidden diamond mine—unknown to the Sultan, yet lying just beyond the capital, beneath his very gaze!

The merchant quickly sells off every last diamond. With hours of daylight left, he indulges himself—brothels, gaming houses, taverns—and then vanishes without a trace. Cursed be him! He must have sensed your pursuit and remembered your face. From that day forward, he never appears before you again.

5006139.title: A Bloody Diamond Pit
strings: A Bloody Diamond Pit

This is a secret diamond mine unknown to the Sultan. The miners are gaunt, hollow-eyed, their strength sapped. Overseers crack whips without mercy, trampling those who collapse until they no longer cry out. It is plain to see: these people are expendable. To keep the mine's location secret, the workforce is meant to be consumed and then silenced. Buying slaves would be cheaper than these losses. Most of these wretches were seized from the Dark Alley by the mine's owners.
Diamond Mine's Owner
Pit Guard
You can lead the assault on the diamond pit in person or send your followers in your stead.
You can lead an entire troop to seize the mine.
Consumables useful
If you wish to keep this operation hidden from the Sultan, you must assign someone responsible for covering your tracks.
You can take this opportunity to break a Conquest card of Silver tier or lower, demonstrating your loyalty.
Rally your forces and overturn this wicked place.
If you intend to deal with the mine in person, you must first conceal your movements, lest the Sultan learn of it...
A grim battle looms!
Now! Clear the field. Leave no trace for the Sultan's spies.
The number of dice provided by your Physique and Combat is affected by the enemy's corresponding attributes.
Your Sociability and Stealth determine your full dice count.
You need at least 2 Success to win.
You need at least 4 Successes.
You paid no further heed to the diamonds or the mine. What happened thereafter... you simply do not care.
Without Mercy
You succeeded
Loyal as a Diamond
You fail to hide it from the Sultan.
The Sultan's spies remain completely unaware of everything that has happened here.
Your forces have barely assembled before guards on the other side notice the activity. On this open plain, no movement goes unseen.

Although the diamond merchant hates the idea of bloodshed, he hates the thought of being beheaded by the Sultan for hoarding mines even more...
[s4.name]'s blood makes the diamonds redder.

You overpower the guards and force them to lead you to the mine-owner's crude tent.
Seeing you—and the blood on your blade—he crumples in terror. Worthless creature. You do not hesitate. You kill him, then sweep your gaze over the tent piled high with newly unearthed crystals... Possessing this vein would yield diamonds without limit. The profit is tempting, but ownership brings terrible risk.

The Sultan laughs aloud, even deigning to step down from the golden stair and clap you on the shoulder. "Excellent! Excellent!" he proclaims, allowing you to break this card before leading the court to inspect his newly won treasures. For a moment, you stand in the very center of favor.

You are still counting diamonds in your sleep and undecided on the mine's fate when the Sultan's army surround you.
How did he learn? Perhaps his spies watch your every move, or perhaps the pit lies too close to the capital. No matter how sweetly you swear the mine is yours to dedicate to the Sultan, he smiles thinly and orders his men to take the vein into custody.
...Alas! How much gold might that have been?

The mine—stained with the mine-owner's blood, the guards' blood, and the dried blood of countless laborers—now falls entirely under your control. The guilty wealth lies at your feet. You may now decide the mine's fate.

5006140.title: Bloody Wealth
strings: Bloody Wealth
This natural diamond vein consumes vast amounts of labor daily to extract sparkling stones from deep underground.
Overseer – requires Sociability and Wisdom
Concealer – requires Stealth and Sociability
Guard – requires Charisma and Combat
Mining Slave
Recruiter – requires Stealth and Charisma, or any unit designated as at your disposal
A consumable for assistance.
The Diamond Pit
To maintain operations, the mine requires managers, concealers, guards, and laborers—each indispensable.
The manager's Sociability and Wisdom, combined with the slaves' Physique, decide yield.
The concealer's Sociability and Stealth decide whether the operation is exposed.
The guards' Charisma and Combat decide whether any slaves dare resist.
The recruiter's Stealth and Charisma decide whether new laborers can be "recruited."
If you have someone marked as "under your command", placing them in the recruiter slot immediately converts them into new laborers.
Full Focus
Silence
No Escapes
Listen up: there's an extremely valuable opportunity here...
The manager's Sociability and Wisdom plus the slaves' Physique determine the full dice count.
The concealer's Sociability and Stealth determine the full dice count.
The guards' Charisma and Combat determine the full dice count.
The recruiters' Stealth and Charisma determine the full dice count.
You need at least 10 Successes to extract ore.
You need at least 4 Successes.
You need at least 5 Successes.
You should be aware: this bloody enterprise is best kept from prying eyes.
It probably wouldn't be wise to let this person know...
Breakthrough

A monstrous machine descends from above, shaking the earth and destroying the terrain. Countless laborers are buried, and many diamonds are crushed, but your haul is still considerable.
Such a violent display is unlikely to escape the Sultan's notice, but you should have been prepared when you resolved to enable it...
Work Halted
This Is Your Fate
Beware of Fraud
I Do Not Lie
Rest in Peace, My Child
No workers are present in the mine today. Operations must cease.
After a full day of labor, not a single usable diamond is unearthed. Instead, one worker collapses and dies. Worthless wretch.

All the workers exhaust themselves in loyal service to you. They bring you a fair yield, and—pleasantly enough—there is now one less mouth to feed at supper.
—Signed, [s1.name].
All the workers exhaust themselves in loyal service to you. They bring you a fair yield, and—pleasantly enough—there is now one less mouth to feed at supper.
Damn that useless [s2.name]! Not even a handful of laborers can be kept under watch. One has escaped before the very eyes! You are in serious trouble now.
Cursed slaves! While your thoughts wandered for just a moment, one of them fled. You are in serious trouble now.

No voice is heard here but words of praise for you.
—Signed, [s2.name].
Great. No voice is heard here but words of praise for you.
A mere slave dares glare at the guards. He's done for.

The workers profess their devotion to you, choosing to remain in the mine and continue their labor. They swear not to return home until they unearth greater and finer diamonds for you.
—Signed, [s3.name].
The workers "volunteer" to remain in your mine and labor for you. How fortunate.
[s5.name] works for you until death. [s5.gender] has no choice.
With disappearances occurring one after another, suspicion runs high. No one believes [s5.name]'s promises.

There is indeed boundless wealth here—but it belongs to you. Heh.
—Signed, [s5.name].
Look upon the faces of those you deceived. Hah! Yet you did not lie—there truly is wealth without end. It simply belongs to you.
Badriyyah grants release to a worker crushed by exhaustion. From his dying body, she draws out one last essence—pure and untainted.
The cursed moon rises, and with it the damned night. Wretches of the earth, are you prepared to give your loyalty once more to Lord [player.name] when dawn comes?

5006141.title: Diamond of Hope
strings: Diamond of Hope
The enslaved and broken miners crowd within this pit—an abyss like the very eye of a devil—awaiting your management.
Who will soothe, who will lead the poor?
The Bloodstained Mine

Each worker is gaunt, scarred from the lash, their wounds raw and unhealed. Their eyes fix on you, heavy with fear and uncertainty. They know the guards and the overseer who once ruled here lie dead by your blade. What they do not know is whether you will send new guards in their place, or whether you yourself will become the new overseer of the mine.
Raed comes over to join them.
Alim steps forward.
Aziz steps forward.
Gullis steps forward.
Bharat steps forward.
Badriyyah arrives.

The moment she appears, scattered cries of "Boss!" rise from the crowd. A few gaunt men push their way forward, nearly weeping with relief as they see her. Even those dragged here from the Dark Alley recognize her, whispering in hushed voices: "It's her! She's the leader of those vagrants... her men never go hungry!"
Raed lifts her head high and calls out to all: "You may leave if you wish! Lord [player.name] will provide rations and send you safely back to the capital. But those who leave—keep your mouths shut! If word of these mines reaches the city, I swear the fool who leaks it will regret it!" She swings her spiked mace with a grin.
"Or you may stay, my friends. You may stay and dig these fine stones—not for a master, not to escape the lash, not merely for a full belly, but for yourselves, for your children, for a better life."
"Lord [player.name] grants you the freedom to live here, to work these mines, to make this wealth a legacy that endures. Now, it is your turn—will you keep the secret? Will you stand with us, and snatch this scrap of meat from the Sultan's mouth?"
For a moment, silence. Then one withered hand rises... then another, a third, a tenth—until every hand is raised. The workers cheer, shouting your name, swearing to guard the secret. For the first time since they were brought here, they laugh—truly laugh.
Raed smiles. She quickly sets the order—who will take on the heaviest digging, who will build and strengthen the outpost. She is so skilled at this! Work flares to life, vigorous yet orderly. You know the place will soon thrive, bound together by one shared secret. These diamonds will no longer be stained with foul blood; their brilliance will first reflect the joy on human faces.

As soon as he appears, several children cry out "Father!" and rush into his arms, clinging to his legs and sobbing apologies: they swear they will never again snatch food from strangers or run off without care.
Those dragged here from the Dark Alley recognize him too, and they now have nothing, clutching their pockets out of instinct.
Alim checks that his pups have all their limbs, knocks each lightly on the head for good measure, then turns to the workers. "You may leave if you wish! Lord [player.name] will provide rations and send you back to the capital safely. But those who leave—better keep your mouths shut. If I hear talk of these mines in the city..." He pauses, chuckling darkly. He doesn't spell it out, but everyone can picture the miserable scene of having even the underwear at home stolen...
"Or you may stay. You may stay and dig these fine stones—not for a master, not to escape the lash, not merely for a full belly, but for yourselves, for your children, for a better life.
Lord [player.name] grants you the freedom to live here, to work these mines, to make this wealth a legacy that endures. Now, it is your turn—will you keep the secret? Will you stand with us, and snatch this scrap of meat from the Sultan's mouth?"
For a moment, silence. Then one withered hand rises... then another, a third, a tenth—until every hand is raised. The workers cheer, shouting your name, swearing to guard the secret. For the first time since they were brought here, they laugh—truly laugh.
Alim smiles. He quickly sets the order—who will take on the heaviest digging, who will build and strengthen the outpost. He divides the tasks as easily as sharing bread among his people. Work flares to life, vigorous yet orderly. You know the place will soon thrive, bound together by one shared secret. These diamonds will no longer be stained with foul blood; their brilliance will first reflect the joy on human faces.

Aziz's fearsome face and hulking frame silence the crowd. No one dares speak. In a gravelly voice, he recites: "My master, Lord [player.name], grants you this choice. You may leave, or you may stay. If you stay, you may work these stones for yourselves, earn for yourselves, live here as your own. But whether you leave or remain, you must keep the secret. If the truth escapes, every head will roll—yours, mine, even my master's. That is my master's word."
The workers are stunned into silence. Then they whisper among themselves. Some dare to ask questions, and Aziz answers as best he recalls your words. At last, one man steps forward: "We will all stay! We will guard each other's silence!"
Soon, work flares to life, vigorous yet orderly. You know the place will soon thrive, bound together by one shared secret. These diamonds will no longer be stained with foul blood; their brilliance will first reflect the joy on human faces.

Gullis tells the uneasy workers: you permit them to leave or to stay. If they remain, they may mine for their own future, and for their children's. But secrecy is absolute—should word spread, not only they but you yourself would lose your head. For such wealth belongs only to the Sultan.
The workers are struck silent, then whisper among themselves. At last, one man steps forward: "We will all stay! We will guard each other's silence!"
Soon, work flares to life, vigorous yet orderly. To your surprise, Gullis manages the people and the outpost with ease. You know the place will soon thrive, bound together by one shared secret. These diamonds will no longer be stained with foul blood; their brilliance will first reflect the joy on human faces.

"I have a bargain for you," Bharat says with a smile to the anxious workers. "Lord [player.name] — the very man who slew the mine's former master—declares this: you are free to leave, and free to remain. You may live here, you may mine these stones... and heavens, do you realize what these are? Diamonds! Do you know their worth? Once, such gems belonged only to the Sultan. Now, every stone you draw from the earth is yours alone."
The crowd stares in disbelief, whispering in uneasy voices, peppering Bharat with questions. He answers each one patiently, offering advice, his silver tongue swiftly winning their trust. Before long, they not only swear to keep the secret, but even agree to sell their diamonds solely to him... Surely this is the very deal Bharat came running for.
Whatever his motives, work flares to life, vigorous yet orderly. You know the place will soon thrive, bound together by one shared secret. These diamonds will no longer be stained with foul blood; their brilliance will first reflect the joy on human faces.

There is not a soul among the captive workers who does not know her, for in the Dark Alley none has lived without her aid. When the scent of her medicines drifts across the pit, Badriyyah and your followers tend every wound, binding each until the last is healed. At last, weary, she wipes her brow and delivers your decree: "You are free to leave, and free to remain. You may live here, you may mine these stones, and work for your own future, for your children's future. But—" Badriyyah's voice hardens, "—whether you go or stay, you must keep this place secret. Should word escape, not only you but even my lord himself will lose his head."
They fall to their knees, weeping with gratitude, praising Badriyyah, praising your mercy. You know that with their diligent hands, this place will soon thrive, bound together by one shared secret. These diamonds will no longer be stained with foul blood; their brilliance will first reflect the joy on human faces.

5006142.title: Roast Pigeon
strings: Roast Pigeon
The feast is ready - time to invite friends to enjoy it.
Today's menu
You can go youselft, or invite followers to taste it
Someone should eat this, right?
Enjoyed Roast Pigeon
The bird is bathed in fragrant oils, crisp without, tender within—a rare delicacy indeed.
Hassan was in high spirits.

Hassan tastes the dish and composes verses at the table, reciting aloud:
"Fly, pigeon!
From the sky you pluck sapphire,
from the spring you gather diamond.
Your feathers gleam with emerald,
your beak pierces crystal.
Fly, pigeon!"

5006143.title: Feast of Gems
strings: Feast of Gems
You plan to ask your wife to arrange for Jenna to meet the noble ladies at the baths.
Your wife
Jewel-embedded Equipment
5 Gold Coins cost
You can break an Extravagance Card of Silver tier or lower.
To break the Sultan's Extravagance Card, six jewel-embedded pieces of equipment are required.

[s1.name] discreetly tells her closest friends that her favorite jeweler has arrived in the city, bringing several remarkable pieces. Of course, it's nothing worth mentioning. So why not enjoy hot baths, massages, essential oils, and delicate pastries—while glancing over the jewels together?
The noble ladies laugh and readily agree, promising to arrive adorned with their finest jewelry.
A Beacon of Light
A Beacon of Beauty
Splendid Feast

When Jenna steps into the baths gathering, every lady freezes for a moment.
Like the rest, she wears only a silken veil, clinging damp against her skin in the rising steam. But over the silk she gleams with jewelry—gold and silver, agate and sapphire, amethyst and emerald, and diamonds that chime as she moves.
Ordinarily, no noble lady would flaunt such splendor in public. Yet here, in a space that blurs the line between intimacy and society, Jenna does not display her beauty, but uses herself as a living canvas, revealing her craft.
"Oh... like a lighthouse, piercing even the mist with light!" Maggie comments, laughing as she rises from the pool. She takes Jenna's hand. "My dearest Jenna, tell me, is this necklace for sale? And this darling belt? Look at those earrings—magnificent!"
The others crowd in eagerly.
Jenna smiles, half kneels, and places her ruby earrings into Maggie's palm. "Your husband is my benefactor, and you are his dearest treasure. These jewels belong with you."
Maggie beams—not for the jewel, but for the gift itself.

When Jenna steps into the baths gathering, every lady freezes for a moment.
Like the rest, she wears only a silken veil, clinging damp against her skin in the rising steam. But over the silk she gleams with jewelry—gold and silver, agate and sapphire, amethyst and emerald, and diamonds that chime as she moves.
Ordinarily, no noble lady would flaunt such splendor in public. Yet here, in a space that blurs the line between intimacy and society, Jenna does not display her beauty, but uses herself as a living canvas, revealing her craft.
"Ha! Look at you—dressed up ten times more flamboyantly than me. You'll steal all my spotlight!" [s1.name] teases as she emerges first from the bath, studying the glittering ornaments. "Your earrings are divine. The mist cannot dull their shine."
The others crowd in eagerly. Jenna smiles, half kneels, and gently clasps her ruby earrings onto Nayla's ears.
Admiring herself in the water's surface, Nayla nods in satisfaction amidst a chorus of compliments. "They are perfect. I'll have the payment sent to your estate, and I'll commission an entire new season's work from you! By the heavens, a woman without new jewels is as bare as a woman without clothes!"
The noble ladies murmur agreement, encircling both her and Jenna in delight...

After leaving the baths, every noble lady departs with vivid memories: the pool strewn with petals, the refreshing pomegranate tea, the dazzling display of gems...
Word spreads swiftly, reaching the ears of the Sultan himself.He nearly rises from his golden throne in fury. You prostrate yourself at once, hurriedly explaining: yes, it was indeed a banquet of jewels—but only for women! Not a man present! Not the sort of banquet he imagines, but merely a gathering where ladies flaunt their adornments.
When his spies return with the same report, the Sultan finally, grudgingly, sets aside his wrath. He permits you to break the Sultan's Card. The affair brings you reputation.

5006144.title: Healing Wounds
strings: Healing Wounds
Samir's imitation of the Water of Life appears capable of healing monsters' wounds.. though as for human, well, you have never tried.
Characters Who Need Treatment
Imitation of the Water of Life
Some lives would rather suffer once than endure again.
The moment it smelled the potion, it struggled desperately to break free of your restraint and fled to who knew where.
I'd rather die than touch this again!
Sob, sob... no...
Gentle Healing
Better a Short Pain than a Long One
In an instant, the wound closes. [s1.name] nuzzles your hand fondly, as if asking for more.
The moment the medicine touches its wound, the poor animal shrieks in pain. You pin it down with your weight, fighting to keep it still—all for the sake of healing.
[s1.name] clenches the teeth, cursing through tears—you seldom see [s1.gender(him,her)] lose composure. Clearly, the pain is real.

No one warned you it would burn like this! Agony twists your face, tears streaming unchecked. If heaven granted you another chance, you would rather pay gold—or even die of the wound—than ever let this foul draught touch your flesh again.

5006145.title: A Nobleman's Order
strings: A Nobleman's Order
A young lord sent Jenna an order: he wanted an emerald ring. The design didn't matter—what mattered was that the stone appear as large as possible!
Jenna
Requires 5 additional Gold Coins for other materials.
Proper Gem, Must Be Large
The client requests an emerald.
If you present a gem more precious than emerald, he will be all the more pleased.
Insert a large proper gem.
Yes, this is exactly the emerald the guest wants.
Finer than a emerald but not over the top—this will certainly satisfy the guest.
Either too humble for his station, or too exalted for him to deserve.
The Poem of the Emerald
You Deserve Better
You Deserve the Finest

On the tiny emerald, Jenna engraves a love poem, praising the nobleman's charms from head to toe. Her craftsmanship is exquisite, the fine script covering the gem's surface and making it seem larger than it truly is.
The nobleman is delighted. He flaunts his emerald ring everywhere, visiting the noble baths thrice a day until many are forced to memorize the poem.
Alongside the payment for the stone, Jenna shares part of the profit with you.

The nobleman once thought emeralds suited him best—now he realizes it is any gem that flatters him.
He admires his finger from every angle, eager to thrust his jeweled hand before the noblewomen at every chance. So pleased is he that he grants Jenna a lavish reward, which she shares with you.
It is only what you deserve.

The nobleman is struck speechless at the sight of the sapphire ring. With trembling hands and reverent care, he accepts it, too awed to wear it at once. For a brief moment, the jewel's beauty purifies his restless heart. His gratitude toward Jenna is boundless, and his praise for you as well.
Jenna shares the profit with you. It is only what you deserve.

5006146.title: A Noble Lady's Order
strings: A Noble Lady's Order

A lady who had attended the bathhouse jewel banquet sent in an order: she wanted a pair of "the most beautiful, most splendid, most gorgeous" gem earrings—ruby at the very least, or else she would be outshone!
Jenna
Requires 5 additional Gold Coins for other materials.
The Central Gem for Custom Jewelry, Must Be Large
Gems for Decoration
The client requests rubies.
If you present a gem more precious than ruby, she will be all the more pleased.
Insert a proper gem.
Yes, this is exactly the gem the guest wants.
Finer than a ruby—this wll certainly satisfy the guest.
This gem dose not befit the guest.
A True Diamond!
What She Truly Wants Is Not Rubies, but Prestige
Exactly What She Wanted

You need not even step outside to hear of the lady who has commissioned a pair of diamond earrings.
She wears them everywhere—even stooping so far as to parade them in the slums. The weight of her gems changes with every retelling, each time a little heavier.
Jenna's design no longer matters; what truly gleams now is what these flawless stones represent—status, wealth, and the meaning people impose upon them.
The tale spreads quickly, and both you and Jenna gain a great reputation from it. Completing a genuine diamond piece also teaches Jenna much in Jewelry Design.

A pair of sapphire earrings—each gem pale and translucent, like a handful of seawater. With careful cutting, they shimmer so brightly they could almost be mistaken for diamonds.
The noble lady is utterly charmed. She flaunts them everywhere, encouraging others to assume they are diamonds.
Later, she commissions several more pieces in a similar style, spending a fortune—though still far less than what true diamonds would cost.
Jenna shares part of the profit with you. And beyond the gold, she gains valuable insight from this creation.

Jenna crafts a pair of earrings using the deepest, richest rubies, each stone set in a thick frame of gold. There is no artistry, no subtlety—only size, brilliance, and weight.
The client is overjoyed. Smiling, Jenna shares the profit from the commission with you.

5006147.title: Puppy's Commission
strings: Puppy's Commission
A noble asked Jenna to craft a red-gold collar for his beloved dog, set with amethysts—or at least it had to be amethyst-grade.
Jenna
Requires 5 additional Gold Coins for other materials.
Proper Gems
The client requests an amethyst.
If you present a gem more precious than amethyst, he will be pleased as well— but best not to overdo it; it is, after all, only a dog.
Insert a proper gem.
Yes, this is exactly the amethyst the guest wants.
Finer than amethyst but not over the top—this will certainly satisfy the guest.
Either too humble for its master's status, or so costly the master would hesitate to keep it.
Practical Demands
Woof!
Rubies Are a Better Match
The noble pays handsomely for the golden amethyst collar. Jenna shares part of the earnings with you.

The noble is delighted with the emerald collar, exclaiming, "Now this suits my dog perfectly!"
He brags endlessly about his pet's noble lineage—until the impatient little creature lets out a bark, eager to go play.

The noble sends you a letter overflowing with gratitude. In it, he praises both you and Jenna for your keen eyes and impeccable taste—only such discerning artisans could recognize his dog's refinement and craft a collar worthy of it.
He parades the dog through the palace halls, proudly telling anyone who asks about the collar of the brilliant jewelers who made it.

5006148.title: The Canvas for Her Jewels
strings: The Canvas for Her Jewels

Business is booming for Jenna. She decides to hire models to wear her jewelry and have portraits painted of them. The reproductions will be sent to the empire's wealthiest provinces—a clever way to spread her fame and fortune even further. A brilliant idea, indeed.
Jewelry Fit for the Wearer
Models Caught by Jenna
This event consumes no time. Please execute it manually.
The gem will be consumed upon completion.
Jenna Invites [s2.name] as Her Model
Jenna Herself Is the Best Ambassador for Emeralds
Jenna seizes you by the wrist and drags you straight into her workshop...

Raed is perhaps the most fitting ambassador for agate. She sits carelessly in a chair, resting her foot on a spiked mace planted in the ground. Her ears are heavy with long strings of agate earrings, echoing the gleam of her silver-inlaid agate belt. Each of her fingers is adorned with a different agate ring, all crafted by Jenna—and, as Jenna claims, "each can double as brass knuckles." Her promise of "a full set of weapons, free of charge" is likely what convinced Raed to model in the first place.
The portrait artist, clearly overwhelmed by such an unusual subject, paints with trembling hands... yet the finished piece turns out remarkably well.
The copies—complete with price tags for each jewel—are sent throughout the empire, carrying Jenna's name to every corner of the realm.

Junah lies obediently on a low couch, wearing nothing but a coarse linen cloth. Across her body drape long strings of agate necklaces, their mixed colors echoing her eyes and skin. Now she looks like a figure stepped straight from a painting—gazing outward, inviting, yearning.
The painter adores his model, and the resulting portrait is exquisite.
The copies—complete with price tags for each jewel—are sent throughout the empire, carrying Jenna's name to every corner of the realm.

Alim and his pups volunteer without invitation. His only request is simple: each pup must get a piece of agate.
Jenna agrees. The painter captures the hands of Alim and his pups—rough or tender, calloused, scarred, and strong—all wearing Jenna's agate rings.
He has never faced such a request before, yet paints with delight. The final work moves every viewer who beholds it.
The copies—complete with price tags for each jewel—are sent throughout the empire, carrying Jenna's name to every corner of the realm.

Inal is so excited to model that she can hardly contain herself. She borrows rouge and shadow from her mistress and slicks her hair back with generous oil.
Jenna adorns her with a full bridal set of red carnelian jewelry—matching earrings, bangles, and a silver chain. When she sees herself in the mirror, she nearly forgets to breathe.
The painter captures the moment perfectly: a young bride gazing at her reflection, as if she were looking upon her own future.
The copies—complete with price tags for each jewel—are sent throughout the empire, carrying Jenna's name to every corner of the realm.

Zephyr is delighted to model, though a bit nervous. His face turns red as Jenna ties strings of red carnelian beads around his bare legs—each movement now makes them jingle softly. "I can't run like this," he mutters shyly, scratching his head.
The painter immortalizes the scene: a pair of strong, graceful legs bound by jewels and golden thread, aching for release. The copies—complete with price tags for each jewel—are sent throughout the empire, carrying Jenna's name to every corner of the realm.

When Jenna asks Aziz to model, the large man makes only one request: he wants a bride's red carnelian ornament.
Jenna agrees. She dresses him in full warrior's armor—a gleaming cuirass, a curved blade embedded with blood-red carnelian, and a large hide shield.
The painter portrays him as bold and magnificent, his crimson gems gleaming against his powerful form. That's quite a convincing piece of art.
Afterward, Jenna gifts him a delicate red carnelian ring fit for a bride. He carefully tucks it into his pocket.
The copies—complete with price tags for each jewel—are sent throughout the empire, carrying Jenna's name to every corner of the realm.

You can scarcely believe Jenna manages to invite Ansuya herself...
She arrives with two maids and two eunuchs in attendance, wearing a gold-embroidered robe adorned with amethyst that glows softly in the light. Her beauty is serene, almost divine. Her maids praise her endlessly and whisper, "If His Majesty could see her now, he would surely fall in love again. Why not buy the jewels for yourself?"
Ansuya only shakes her head gently. "Better not, let his heart rest a little."
The painter captures her tranquil, sorrowful smile—but the Sultan forbids any likeness of his concubines in public display... Thus, her face and crown are subtly altered before the image circulates.
The copies—complete with price tags for each jewel—are sent throughout the empire, carrying Jenna's name to every corner of the realm.

Jenna practically drags Hassan in from the street. He is, as usual, drunk—rambling about moons like goldfish and stars like bubbles...
Jenna places a necklace of amethyst around his neck and gives him a cup filled with wine. In his homeland, amethyst is said to ward off drunkenness—though others claim it invites intoxication. Looking at Hassan now, it's hard to tell which legend wins.
The painter captures this very moment. He originally plans to paint Hassan younger and more handsome, but Jenna refuses. "Paint him as he is," she says. "Then everyone like him will want an amethyst too."
The copies—complete with price tags for each jewel—are sent throughout the empire, carrying Jenna's name to every corner of the realm.

Qais looks unexpectedly fitting in Jenna's amethyst armor, choker, and earrings. Even he admits it suits him.
Like crystal, he is both strong and fragile. In the portrait, he appears calmer than usual—almost like an ideal courtier.
Qais loves the painting so much that he blushes while asking Jenna for a copy. "I'll keep one for myself," he says shyly. "It'll be my own portrait... commissioning one privately is far too expensive."
The copies—complete with price tags for each jewel—are sent throughout the empire, carrying Jenna's name to every corner of the realm.

Maggie owns gems far rarer than emerald, yet this cool green crystal has always been her favorite.
She sits before the painter, a golden veil heavy with polished emeralds draped over her head. Smiling, she tells a story—to the painter, to Jenna, and to you standing nearby. When she was three, her father gifted her a pony named Emerald...
As the tale ends, the painting is complete: Maggie looks radiant, gentle, and noble. Anyone who sees the portrait will surely wish to wear jewels like hers.
The copies—complete with price tags for each jewel—are sent throughout the empire, carrying Jenna's name to every corner of the realm.

Jenna sits before the painter, lifting a gold chain between her fingers to show the fine filigree and the square gems hanging from it. Her earrings are large emeralds paired with tiny golden birds. On her wrists gleam silver bangles set with smaller stones—pieces made for clients with lighter purses.
The painter captures her perfectly. It is a fine painting. The copies—complete with price tags for each jewel—are sent throughout the empire, carrying Jenna's name to every corner of the realm.

Nothing suits a kitten better than emeralds.
Jenna tries two or three heavy gold necklaces embedded with large emeralds around Lady Becky's neck—each one fits perfectly. All of them do.
The painter can hardly contain his joy, capturing Lady Becky's many adorable poses on a single canvas. The portrait is so delightful that even you, watching from the side, secretly wish for a copy to hang in your study... Of course, that lasts only until Lady Becky grows impatient, topples the painter's jar of pigment, and storms off in a fury.
The painter captures her perfectly. It is a fine painting. The copies—complete with price tags for each jewel—are sent throughout the empire, carrying Jenna's name to every corner of the realm.

Malkina and Jenna know each other all too well. The scraps and shards from Jenna's workshop often end up in Malkina's hands—she grinds them into powder and paints them over her clients' eyelids. In turn, whenever Malkina's customers ask for fine jewelry, she sends them straight to Jenna.
So, when Malkina cheerfully poses in a full set of ruby adornments—armlets, nose rings, chokers, rings, anklets, bangles, hair nets, slippers, earrings, and more—repeating poses again and again for the painter, you feel tired just watching her, though hardly surprised.
The painter captures the allure of the gems with perfect precision. It is a fine painting.
The copies—complete with price tags for each jewel—are sent throughout the empire, carrying Jenna's name to every corner of the realm.

Ruby suits Nayla perfectly. Though not the most expensive gem, it burns the brightest red. Nobler stones pale beside it—colorless, blue, or faint—they cannot match her. Nayla is made for a gem that burns like love, like death, like desire itself.
She laughs softly, playing with these vivid little trinkets, naturally knowing how to draw every eye in the room. The painter works swiftly, his brush flying. The result is a dazzling portrait—anyone who sees it must fall at her feet.
The copies—complete with price tags for each jewel—are sent throughout the empire, carrying Jenna's name to every corner of the realm.

The fabled Princess Raedina is invited to sit. As the painter prepares, she chats endlessly with Jenna about gems, her curiosity both keen and old-fashioned. She asks several times whether pearls have fallen out of favor. "But pearls are so beautiful," she insists.
Jenna patiently explains while fitting her with peach-colored ruby earrings, their vivid hue casting a rosy shadow upon her pearl-draped veil.
When the portrait is finished, it looks as though the princess herself is kissed by both pearl and ruby.
The copies—complete with price tags for each jewel—are sent throughout the empire, carrying Jenna's name to every corner of the realm.

[xiaochou.name] sits before the painter, dressed in a set of sapphire jewelry—rings, earrings, and a long necklace.
He sits perfectly upright, not moving an inch. Yet, strangely, the painter cannot seem to capture his features. Every brushstroke blurs into fog.
Finally, on your suggestion, the painter replaces his face with that of an imagined handsome man. Only then does the painting take shape—and, thankfully, the result looks rather impressive.
The copies—complete with price tags for each jewel—are sent throughout the empire, carrying Jenna's name to every corner of the realm.

[xiaochou.name] sits before the painter, dressed in a set of sapphire jewelry—rings, earrings, and a long necklace.
She sits perfectly upright, not moving an inch. Yet, strangely, the painter cannot seem to capture her features. Every brushstroke blurs into fog.
Finally, on your suggestion, the painter replaces her face with that of an imagined beauty. Only then does the painting take shape—and, thankfully, the result looks rather impressive.
The copies—complete with price tags for each jewel—are sent throughout the empire, carrying Jenna's name to every corner of the realm.

That Nawfal would agree to help Jenna at all is astonishing. When you step into the workshop, the sight nearly startles you...
He sits calmly at the center of the room, a book in his hands, his eyes fixed on the page. Upon him gleam sapphire ornaments worthy of a grand vizier—especially a ring so large it almost seems unreal...
From the first line to the final stroke, Nawfal says not a single word, as if you, the painter, and Jenna were made of air.
The copies—complete with price tags for each jewel—are sent throughout the empire, carrying Jenna's name to every corner of the realm.

Sapphire is a jewel of noble wives, and Jenna's design for Maggieis nothing short of magnificent.
Her turban is woven from gold and peacock thread, embroidered with birds—each carrying a tiny sapphire in its beak. When she lowers her head, the whole room flickers with starlike reflections, as though a piece of the night sky has been draped over her shoulders.
The painter praises her beauty and grace without end as he completes the portrait.
The copies—complete with price tags for each jewel—are sent throughout the empire, carrying Jenna's name to every corner of the realm.

Jenna drags the Roaming Swordsman off the Dark Alley and forces him into her workshop.
Despite his curses, she adorns him with a full set of diamond and gold ornaments—massive stones shaped like stars, hanging across his scarred chest.
For some reason, despite being broke, living off scams and back-alley brawls, he somehow goes perfectly with diamonds. Even the painter, astonished, keeps murmuring in disbelief as he paints.
It turns out to be an excellent portrait. The copies are sent throughout the empire, carrying Jenna's name to every corner of the realm. There is no price listed beside the diamonds—after all, those who can afford such stones would find numbers insulting.

Jenna presses you onto a velvet cushion before the painter and sets a splendid diamond crown upon your head... The painter freezes, brush trembling—only those of royal blood may wear such finery.
Jenna has her own way. Smiling, she tells the painter, "That's easy—just paint his back. That should do, right?" In the end, he paints a noble wearing a diamond crown. Who that person is—or whether they even exist—doesn't really matter.
And so, trembling, the painter follows her instruction...
It turns out to be an excellent portrait. The copies are sent throughout the empire, carrying Jenna's name to every corner of the realm. There is no price listed beside the diamonds—after all, those who can afford such stones would find numbers insulting.

Jenna lures Lumera into her workshop with a copy of The Study of Gems.
While the girl buries herself in reading, Jenna quietly takes a handful of gold chains set with jewels and drapes them over her head. Then she brings out a pair of diamond earrings and a ring with a diamond as large as a hazelnut, adorning Lumera piece by piece. Throughout the process, Lumera never once looks up. She takes in every word about gems, committing each detail to memory, yet she seems utterly indifferent to the real, hard, glittering stones around her.
Even the painter—famous for his quick hand—barely finishes the portrait before Lumera closes her book. His final stroke adds a glint to the diamond resting on her brow. It is an excellent painting.
The copies are sent throughout the empire, carrying Jenna's name to every corner of the realm. There is no price listed beside the diamonds—after all, those who can afford such stones would find numbers insulting.

Adila comes toJenna's workshop on behalf of her aunt and grandmother to collect a commissioned piece. Jenna, at that moment, is fretting over who might model her new line of bone ornaments...
Naturally, the warrioress is pressed into the chair before the painter. Across her chest, Jenna drapes a chain made of carved oxbone—each piece shaped like a blade and linked with steel clasps. It can serve as decoration, or as a practical harness for carrying her sword. In skilled hands, it could even become a weapon.
Adila rather likes it—if it can be called jewelry at all—and remains seated until the painter finishes his work.
The portrait is later hung at the entrance of Jenna's shop, where all who pass may see it. Adila's noble and ancient lineage soon draws attention, and before long, other aristocrats quietly visit Jenna, asking to try "the one that lady wore."

Faris visits the market intending to buy marrow bones for his dog, and somehow ends up dragged into Jenna's shop.
Moments later, he sits awkwardly before the painter while his dog gnaws its prize by his feet, and Jenna busily decorates him with earrings, hair bands, and rings made of polished bone. The sight is so absurd that both you and the painter burst out laughing.
Yet the awkwardness quickly fades when Faris realizes the painter is a fellow gambler from Dog Track. The two spend nearly the entire session chatting, though the work still gets done.
Soon after, patrons from the Dog Track begin showing up with copies of his portrait in hand, demanding identical accessories. They all believe Faris's luck comes from his jewelry, and that whoever wears it will share in his fortune.

Riel catches sight of Jenna working with oxbone on the street and approaches with curiosity.
"City folk still use that?" she asks. "I thought you only liked those silly shiny stones."
A mistake. Jenna grabs her wrist in a flash and drags the she-wolf into her shop. She forces Riel into the chair before the painter and fits her with a cuirass made of bone and bronze. Riel has never seen anything like it, and certainly never met a city woman bold enough to press her down by the shoulders.
What follows is a silent contest of wills between the two. By the end, the trembling painter produces a masterpiece: Riel stands fierce and untamed, gripping a bone blade, her arms bound with gold-inlaid bone bands. The ornaments seem to restrain her wildness—just barely.
The painting is hung in Jenna's shop for all to see. From time to time, the tribal women captured and brought to the city stop before it, gazing at the image of the she-wolf with solemn admiration.
Slowly, this pale, living, warm "stone" begins to adorn more and more people.

5006149.title: Consort's Commission
strings: Consort's Commission
A certain favored consort—she never gives her name—sends Jenna an order. She wants a piece that will "make other women jealous—mad with envy."
Jenna
Requires 5 additional Gold Coins for other materials.
Proper Gem, Must Be Large
A consort of the Sultan deserves nothing less than sapphire.
If you present a gem more precious than sapphire, it will win her favor.
Insert a large proper gem.
The gold coins she enclosed only cover a ruby—use a ruby, then.
This gem befits the status of a court noble.
This gem is beneath a noble's dignity.
This much money will only get a ruby.
Simple Pleasures
Only Diamonds Befit the Sultan's Beloved

You can tell something is amiss. A true royal consort would never call herself "the favored one," any more than a true Sultan would announce his name. And with so few coins—barely enough for one modest ruby—you are certain this woman is no concubine of standing.
You tell Jenna to craft a ruby necklace nonetheless. For most, rubies are treasures too hot to touch, but for a true favorite of the Sultan, such a stone might bring only the faintest joy—no larger than a fingernail.
Jenna sends the necklace to the palace. The supposed consort never replies—not even with a note, let alone a promised reward...
Disheartened, Jenna gives you all the meager profits from the commission. Perhaps you've been deceived by a woman with no right to her claim... or perhaps you've made an investment. Who can say?

You sigh. A true royal consort would never call herself "the favored one."
The Sultan's harem is full of unhappy women, for he forbids them from finding joy in anything—or anyone—other than himself. Perhaps the woman who placed this order is lying, but what harm is there in making her a little happier?
You suggest that Jenna use sapphires. They may not be treasures fit for a consort, but they are certainly worthy of a Vasir's wife. Whoever is behind the order will surely be pleased.
Jenna nods and sets to work. She crafts a fine gold bracelet, embedded with large, radiant sapphires, and confidently sends it to the palace. But the so-called favorite never replies—not even with a note...
Still, that's exactly what you expected. Jenna generously gives you all the profit from the order, and the matter ends there. Perhaps you've been deceived by a woman who was never allowed near the Sultan's chambers... or perhaps you've made an investment. Who can say?

Nothing less than diamonds can express proper respect for the Sultan's most favored consort!
Though the deposit she sent is nowhere near enough to cover the cost, you still advise Jenna to use this precious stone, and even provide her with a rare, large diamond of your own. Jenna is thrilled. Even a jeweler of her skill rarely gets to touch such a magnificent gem. Soon, she completes a beautifully carved diamond ring and sends it to the palace. But the so-called favorite never replies—not even with a note...
"She must be a fraud!" Jenna exclaims in despair. That "beloved consort" only paid 9 Gold Coins as a deposit, yet you lost such a huge gem over it! Through tears, Jenna insists on giving you the entire payment, hoping to make up for your loss. At least, she says, crafting the piece itself brought her a moment of genuine joy.

5006150.title: Slave Girls' Commission
strings: Slave Girls' Commission
An old eunuch from the palace arrives with an order—for Sultan's slave girls. Even slaves of the Sultan must wear something worthy of his house: at least silver settings with amethyst.
Jenna
Requires 3 additional Gold Coins for other materials.
Proper Gems
Even the Sultan's slave girls wear at least amethyst jewelry.
If you present a gem more precious than amethyst, the client will be pleased.
Insert a proper gem.
A safe choice.
Finer than amethyst but not over the top.
Either too humble for the Sultan's court, or too exalted for a slave girl to possess.
You suggest amethysts.
You suggest emeralds.
You suggest rubies.

For women without the means to protect themselves, too much beauty often means too much trouble.
You tell Jenna to keep the amethyst, make the design modest, use good silver, and set the stones well. One day, if these women ever leave the harem, they might sell the jewelry for a living.
Jenna nods in agreement.
Not long after, the old eunuch takes her work—a batch of simple silver collars designed for ease of movement, with no fragile details, each adorned with several lovely amethysts.
The slave girls will be delighted with these pieces.

But you make sure to emphasize that her designs should be more discreet. Those gems are quite valuable, and keeping them subtle will help avoid unwanted attention. Later, when the slave girls are released from the harem, they can sell the pieces for a bit of money to start a new life. After all, they own almost nothing; their jewelry and clothes are often considered their only personal property.
Jenna nods, fully understanding what you meant.
Not long after, the old eunuch takes her work—a few emerald pendants that can be worn with any chain. They are the kind most easily sold in the markets, almost designless, with gems that can be removed simply by prying off the copper mount.
The slave girls will be delighted with these pieces.

When a slave girl catches the Sultan's eye, her fate is overturned in an instant... Wasn't Zazie once a slave herself? If they can cloak themselves in brilliance, perhaps one day they'll rise high enough to serve as your allies...
Jenna inclines her head, vowing to craft jewels that outshine all others.
The old eunuch takes her work, frowning as he weighs the pieces. "Rubies, you say? And the only one?"
Yes. Rubies. The only one.
Perhaps these jewels will help some ambitious girl claw her way onto the Sultan's gilded bed. After all, you've already set her first rival in her path...

5006151.title: Treasures for the Sultan
strings: Treasures for the Sultan
Word of Jenna's craft has reached the Sultan. That skill, now, must be turned to pleasing him.
Jenna
Requires 10 additional Gold Coins for other materials.
Only diamonds are worthy of the Supreme Sultan
You may add a high-grade gem as accent and ornament.
To break an Extravagance Card, you must offer 20 more Gold Coins to make the piece even more resplendent.
You may break an Extravagance Card by using additional high-grade gems.
To break the Extravagance Card, you'll need two high-grade gems and further payment.
You dare affront your master with such paltry stones? That is courting death!

You dared ignore the Sultan's summons? Very well.
You are dead. Your residence, your wealth, your jeweler, and all your servants—now belong to the Sultan.
A Golden Opportunity

The Sultan wears many gems—some to boast of his dominion's riches, others to hint at his mood, still others for beauty, eccentricity, or sheer folly. But only diamonds carry true weight when offered to him. The empire's mines belong solely to the Sultan; to buy diamonds at ruinous cost, to cut and set them with your own purse, and then return them as tribute—this is the court's silent ritual of loyalty.
You cannot risk angering him over a trinket. So you order Jenna to use diamonds of the finest grade. Every expense is yours to bear—for the royal guard brought only a decree, and the Sultan himself has no use for Gold Coins.
Jenna fashions a golden armlet set with diamonds, etched with scenes of the Sultan's conquests. It gleams with a brilliance beyond compare—a true masterpiece.
Soon after you present it at court, a royal messenger arrives at your gate. He lifts his voice so all may hear:
"At last night's banquet, His Majesty—the radiant sun, the pillar of all peoples—wore the diamond armlet gifted by Lord [player.name]. He kept it upon his arm for the entire feast!"
The story spreads, twisted with each retelling, until people say you gifted the Sultan a life-sized statue of solid gold. May such rumors never reach his ears.
Still, you are spared. The extra coin you provided went untouched. Jenna returned every last piece.

But only diamonds carry true weight when offered to him. "At last night's banquet, His Majesty—the radiant sun, the pillar of all peoples—wore the diamond armlet gifted by Lord [player.name]. He kept it upon his arm for the entire feast!"
The story spreads, twisted with each retelling, until people say you gifted the Sultan a life-sized statue of solid gold. May such rumors never reach his ears.

You scrape together a chest of Gold Coins and a trove of precious gems, pressing them all into Jenna's arms.
You tell her to see it as providence itself—an opportunity to win the Sultan's favor. Make it vast. Make it splendid. Make it absurd if you must! Besides, it might even help you break an Extravagance Card.
She tests the weight of the gold, her face as pale as yours.
At last, Jenna forges a statue of the Sultan: life-sized, hollow, wrought entirely of gold. The cost in bullion is beyond reckoning. Your coffers lie bare, and Jenna's hoard vanishes with yours.
The Sultan's eyes are flawless diamonds. He raises his hand high, clutching a larger diamond in his fist. Beneath his feet lie the heads of his enemies, their skulls inlaid with rubies, sapphires, and lapis lazuli. The monument is so magnificent that even a god would falter into silence before it.
When the royal guard comes to collect the work, terror seizes him. He stares, slack-jawed, for long minutes, then stumbles back and flees to the palace. Reinforcements arrive, and only with eight men do they manage to carry the idol away.
The Sultan is overjoyed! He rises from his seat and stands beside the statue, studying its details one by one.
He lingers on its bold symbols of virility, then laughs as he turns to the women at his side. "Tell me—do you prefer the statue, or the man himself?"
The answer is exactly what he expects. Laughter fills the court, the Sultan basks in delight, and in such a mood all sins are forgotten. Every noble present etches the memory of your gift into their hearts, and they are left dazzled, jealous, and afraid.
Oh, the Sultan will surely allow you to break such a trivial Extravagance Card. He even scolds you lightly for troubling him with such a petty matter when he was savoring the statue's glory.

5006152.title: The Sultan's Summons
strings: The Sultan's Summons
There is no time for farewells. Jenna is taken straight to the palace by the Sultan's guards and messengers.
Jenna
You've finally tracked down news of Jenna.

The Sultan has summoned Jenna to tend to his crown. He has seized new lands and gathered rare jewels, and the imperial diadem—symbol of absolute dominion—must grow more lavish with every passing year. This year, the burden falls on Jenna. An honor beyond words, perhaps... and the kind of honor that can cost one's head. In silence, you pray for her.

5006153.title: The Crown's Appraisal
strings: The Crown's Appraisal
The crown's adjustments are finally complete. As tradition dictates, the Sultan summons his court to behold the empire's most prized treasure.
Jenna
A Jester
An Honor Guard
A Noblewoman
You must be present yourself
When the Sultan presents his crown, who would dare absent themselves?
The Crown Hears All
A Crown Stained Red

You stand at the very front, and your eyes fall immediately on Jenna, kneeling beside the masterpiece. She looks wan and frail, dark shadows carved beneath her eyes—proof she has labored three nights without rest.
The coronet itself is nothing short of resplendent. The new jewels burn with a freshly cut brilliance, while the older stones have been raised to greater prominence. Even the gold has been pared back, to make room for the Sultan's latest conquests: diamonds the size of pigeon eggs. To house them, Jenna forged a triple tier, clustering the stones until they blaze like fire against the midnight sky.
The Sultan enters. His gaze lingers on the coronet, then on Jenna. At last, he turns to his courtiers. "My loyal ones, what say you?"
A susurrus spreads through the chamber. Many praise its renewed glory—but not all speak true. Envy poisons their tongues. They sneer that the diamonds are poorly cut, that the coronet is too thin with gold, and that the triple crest makes the Sultan seem shorter. Petty slanders, one after another.
Your fury rises. You are ready to bare your teeth when [s2.name] and [s4.name] step in first, lashing their "taste" with razor wit and questioning their morals and loyalty. [s3.name] bristles outright, outraged that anyone would insult the Sultan's majesty. His hand rests on his sword at his waist, and he's one of the few guards granted the honor of bearing arms before the Sultan. Now he's ready to draw steel for the Sultan's honor.
The court erupts. Courtiers rush to hold him back, while the offending minister collapses to his knees, choking out excuses. For a moment, the grand hall teeters on the edge of a village brawl. The Sultan laughs. To him, this quarrel is far more delightful than the coronet. Amused, he plucks a golden leaf from the diadem and bestows it upon you and Jenna. A gift such as this... a reward beyond reckoning.

It gave the minister two fierce scratches right across his face! Howling in pain, the minister stumbled and fell, then quickly knelt down in fear of having disrupted the court... The Sultan laughs. "My loyal ones, what say you?"

Your fury rises.
You laugh coldly, fixing your gaze on the offending minister. "Oh? So the sight of our sovereign's joy offends you? Must the Sultan always frown to satisfy you? After all his triumphs, after all he has given this empire, you quibble over a coronet? A coronet! Do you dare imply it lessens his stature? What are you suggesting? Speak it! Tell us what treason festers in your mind. Do you whisper that His Majesty falls short in other ways as well? By heaven and by the golden blood of the empire, such a traitor deserves the sword here and now, lest I disgrace the memory of every Sultan who favored your house!"
Your hand flies toward a royal guard's sword.
Courtiers surge forward, restraining you before steel can be drawn. The minister collapses to his knees, stammering that he meant no such thing. The Sultan laughs. To him, this quarrel is far more delightful than the coronet.

The coronet itself is nothing short of resplendent. The new gems burn with a freshly cut brilliance, while the older stones were shifted slightly upward. Even the gold has been pared back, to make room for the latest conquests: diamonds the size of pigeon eggs. To house them, Jenna forged a triple tier, clustering the stones until they blaze like fire against the midnight sky.
The Sultan enters. His gaze lingers on the coronet, then on Jenna. At last, he turns to his courtiers.
"My loyal subjects, what say you?"
