Only because she is worth it

You prepare a grand ceremony to announce to everyone that Lumera is your adopted daughter. Over time, Lumera no longer shows any signs of her former thin and withered appearance as a beggar. Her graceful, wise eyes and composed demeanor – and, of course, your prominent influence – convince everyone.

People congratulate her, young ladies affectionately link arms with her, and Lumera gracefully greets them, maintaining a calm expression showing no surprise or joy at her new status. You know her heart is probably still tied to the study.
Of course, Fardak is also present
No one has any objections to this marriage

The moment Fardak sees Lumera's face, his eyes light up.

If he came here just to humor you or simply fulfill his father's orders, that's no longer the case. He fidgets nervously, eager to strike up a conversation with the girl, yet too shy to know where to begin.

In contrast, Lumera is much calmer. She quietly gazes at Fardak, as if she already understands that he is the future you've arranged for her.

You keep chattering, introducing them to each other, until Maggie pulls you aside and drags you out of the room. Only then do you realize what's happening. "You should let the two of them have some time alone," Maggie says with a playful smile, whispering in your ear. "How wonderful – young love at first sight."

The moment Fardak sees Lumera's face, his eyes light up.

If he came here just to humor you or fulfill his father's orders, that's no longer the case. He fidgets nervously, eager to strike up a conversation with the girl, yet too shy to know where to begin.

In contrast, Lumera is much calmer. She quietly gazes at Fardak, as if she already understands that he is the future you've arranged for her.

You keep chattering, introducing them to each other, until your mouth runs dry. Yet Fardak continues to look stunned, as if your words are simply passing through him without registering. This guy is completely mesmerized. Finally, you realize what's happening and laugh heartily as you excuse yourself from the room, giving some space to the newly acquainted pair.

Fardak doesn't emerge from the study until sunset, his cheeks flushed. When he sees you, he gives a respectful nod and says with determination, "Please, give me your blessing to marry Miss Lumera. I'll do anything!"

You peek inside, and sure enough, Lumera is buried in her studies again. Still, they must have connected during their long conversation, as she clearly doesn't mind Fardak's company. You gladly approve of the match.

5008063.title: Young People's Wedding
strings: Young People's Wedding
You agreed to Fardak and Lumera's marriage, and naturally, the wedding should be arranged intensively.
Groom
Bride
You or Maggie must attend this wedding as elders
This would be a good opportunity to leave, should you remind them? Only you and Maggie can do this.
You can take the opportunity to break an Extravagance Card no higher than Silver tier.
Organizing a wedding requires at least 5 Gold Coins, and if you want to break an Extravagance card, you must take out 15 Gold Coins

The wedding proceeded as scheduled

On a day bursting with flowers and sunshine, guests laugh and cheer, swaying freely to lively music. Fardak leads Lumera through the joyful crowd toward you and Maggie.

With a warm smile, you scatter petals over the two of them, then pull them into a hug, gently saying blessings for their life ahead.

You notice a shimmer of tears in Maggie's eyes; the moment feels like a dream – a perfect scene where happiness seems so close for all. Holding back a swell of feeling, you slip an arm around her shoulders as she leans into you.

On a day bursting with flowers and sunshine, guests laugh and cheer, swaying freely to lively music. Fardak leads Lumera through the joyful crowd toward you and Maggie.

With a warm smile, you pour them some liquor, then embrace them, gently offering blessings for their life ahead – though you don't believe in some of the words yourself.
You thus break an Extravagance Card
The wedding draws to a close like this, and you sincerely hope this happiness won't be just a fleeting illusion...

As the ceremony nears its end, Maggie pulls Lumera aside, as though preparing to share a few private words. After speaking to her alone for a moment, she also calls Fardak over. Lowering her voice, she tells them this is the perfect time to use "returning home for the wedding" as an excuse to escape this city.

"You can take her back with you," Maggie says, gripping both of their hands tightly. "And don't come back. This isn't a place where happiness can take root."

Lumera remains silent, her bridal attire making her as beautiful as a lily glistening with morning dew. Her new husband, however, snaps out of his near-dazed state of bliss. After a long pause, he nods slightly. "I understand… I'll ask for his permission when I next meet with the Sultan."

The ceremony continues – dancers spin, liquor splashes freely, yet beneath the noise, everyone carries their own worries in silence.

As the ceremony nears its end, you take on a fatherly demeanor and pull Fardak and Lumera aside. After giving them some advice, you lower your voice and tell them this is the perfect time to use "returning home for the wedding" as an excuse to escape this city.

"You can take her back with you," You say, "and don't come back anymore. This isn't a place where happiness can take root."

Lumera remains silent, her bridal attire making her as beautiful as a lily glistening with morning dew. Her new husband, however, snaps out of his near-dazed state of bliss. After a long pause, he nods slightly. "I understand… I'll ask for his permission when I next meet with the Sultan."

The ceremony continues – dancers spin, liquor splashes freely, yet beneath the noise, everyone carries their own worries in silence.

All this effort to adopt a beggar girl and throw her a wedding, just to break this Extravagance card, right?

The nobles exchange knowing glances, secretly scorning Lumera and the naive boy who marries her.

5008064.title: Pathway Home
strings: Pathway Home
With your blessings, Fardak and Lumera left the city, embarking on the long-awaited pathway home...
Returning Groom
Returning Bride with Husband
Seven days later, Fardak returned alone
Seven days later, Lumera returned alone

You set up a feast for him at home, and during the meal, he tells you that as soon as Lumera arrived in his hometown, she dived into the library there, and he follows her, reading, drinking tea, chatting, and making love there, spending time more beautiful than dreams.

"But I know deep down that she does not long for me," Fardak says with a bitter smile. "Everything she does is out of a thirst for knowledge, a craving for more books. I love her, but she doesn't love me... It's pretty common, and I am not sad about it. However, I am willing to give everything to the one I love. That's why I'm willing to come back here, so she can be Lumera - the girl who spends her days in the library with her books, no husband to worry about."

As he says this, a faint, happy smile remains on his face, and finally, he bows to you, thanking you for everything you do for him.

You pull her into the living room and ask what happened, while Lumera wears a relaxed smile on her lips, "Do you remember the first book you gifted me... It was then I knew what I wanted: I want to absorb knowledge ceaselessly, to make myself a tower of Knowledge. I won't be a good wife to him, and I can't handle running his estate or dealing with his clan. That's why I asked Fardak to let me come back."

"Fardak cried and asked me not to leave him, but in the end, he changed his mind." She waves the books in her hand, "These are from his private library, many of which I haven't read before, and he gifted them to me before I left."

At this point, she gives a slight smile.

After giving you a respectful bow, she turns to her room in your mansion. She removes her splendid clothes, changes into a coarse skirt, sits cross-legged as usual, and earnestly begins reading the next book.

5008065.title: Hometown Folks Meet
strings: Hometown Folks Meet
Ever since you asked him to visit your guesthouse once, you've noticed that Fardak seems to frequent it more often...
Fardak
Fardak has returned

He tells you that, back at your guesthouse that day, he heard familiar hometown accents – intonations unique to the Northern country's residents.

These people were wary of you and the locals, staying guarded until Fardak spoke their native tongue, putting them at ease. They turned out to be nomads from Fardak's tribe, driven here by a severe drought that forced them to flee famine.

Fardak's been mingling with them lately, but when you ask about their talks, he dodges, clearly hiding something.

5008066.title: At Your Service
strings: At Your Service

That evening, Fardak brings a man to see you.

The man has sharp eyes, wears tattered clothes, and walks with a slight tilt to one side, as if he's spent years carrying a sword at his hip.

Fardak calls this man "General," but as he attempts to introduce him further, the man raises his hand to stop him.

"I need to make sure I can trust this gentleman first," he says, gesturing toward you. "Otherwise, I reserve the right to decline, even if it's your order."

So, how do you prove yourself...?
Fardak
Mysterious Man Accompanying Fardak
Things to show him, to prove yourself.
You brought them to your secret training ground
You showed him your generosity
You explained your plan in detail to the General

You show them your elite troops, and the General asks if they can spar with the men he brought. You agree.

Those people are obviously nomads who have roamed the guesthouse, now organized into a troop by Fardak and the General. Achieving this in such a short period is extremely difficult, but compared to them, your troops are better trained and coordinated. The General nods frequently as he watches, finally raising his hand to halt the attack.

"You have proven to be a strong leader and shown that choosing you was a wise decision by Fardak." Saying this, he bows to you and then to Fardak, "I am a loyal servant of the Chieftain and General of this small troop. Out of Fardak's desire, you may employ our strength at the appropriate time."

Fardak puffs his chest, visibly proud.

You present the general with countless magnificent suits of armor and razor-sharp swords, and generously gift him a large sum of military funds.

As the servants carry out the items one by one, the general looks stunned, then thoughtful, and finally bursts into delighted laughter.

"You have proven yourself a valuable ally and shown that Prince Fardak has excellent judgment," he says, nodding to you before bowing to Fardak nearby. "I am just the general of a humble, struggling force. My loyalty lies with a tribe that dreams of fairness and freedom. From now on, I will gladly await your commands."

His approval greatly pleases Fardak. Straightening his back, Fardak proudly tells you that his father sent this general to gather intelligence on him. They have already rallied the nomads wandering the Dark Alley and those near your guesthouse and are secretly training them in preparation for action.

You understand what Alim wants, so you throw Hemir, who has been locked up at your place, right in front of him. Seeing how cooperative Lord [player.name] is, Alim grins so wide his rotten teeth look like they might fall out... he offers a Supreme Mystery Box as part of the deal.

He glances at your empty purse and mockingly says with a wink: "Knowing your lordship's poor financial situation, I'll tell my boys to give you less trouble in the future."

strings: Fate of the Pickpocket
The time has come. You decide to use the card you drew to deal with the little pickpocket bold enough to steal your property.
Hemir
In this situation, you should step in personally.
You can use this to break a Stone tier Bloodshed Card
Time to deal with this thief!
You decided to relish in Bloodshed.
You stole my money, so I take your life – fair trade.

strings: Night Thief
You probably should have expected it – a thief steals what they can't have.
In the middle of the night, he taps on your window
Alim came for him
Alim stole your gold coins

He should be satisfied

Old Alim stole a lot of wealth, but you know he came for the little pickpocket – he seeks revenge, and stealing just once won't satisfy him.
Old Alim stole a lot of wealth, but you know he came for the little pickpocket – now he should be satisfied.
Old Alim stole a lot of wealth, but you know he came for the little pickpocket – you missed him, but this should mark the end of the grudge.
Wasted
You disrupt the old thief's footing with your bow and arrow – he tumbles from the rooftop, along with that young pickpocket. Both fall to their deaths, their necks broken.
You disrupt the old thief's footing with your bow and arrow – he tumbles from the rooftop, breaking his neck.
It's quite a loss
Even for you, it would take ages to earn this much money! Just thinking about it makes your blood boil – that old thief's greed rivals that of the Sultan!
When you woke up in the morning, you discovered that Alim had carved a "Poor" character into your ceiling beam.

5008072.title: Nest of Decay
strings: Nest of Decay

You come to the depths of Dark Alley, with its towering walls and iron gates sturdy enough to withstand armed soldiers – but it still stinks like a garbage dump. Alim clenches his fists. 
"It's them... They've been eyeing my boys..." 
You ask him who they are. 
"The beggars of Dark Alley... They all listen to an old man called White-Belly, who always tries to turn my kids into beggars... This time they're even stealing!" 
You remember the child beggars in Dark Alley, often physically disabled, using their deformed bodies to forcibly evoke passersby's sympathy... And you think of lively, healthy Hemir. You need to act quickly.
This beggar leader won't let you in
Sturdy Gate
Alim's Impotent Rage
You can do this job yourself, or send any of your followers to do it.
Send a person to assist with this matter
Consumable to improve abilities.
You can use Combat, Notoriety or Infamy to make the cunning White-Belly submit
Saving lives requires not just force, but a keen eye for observation
Open the Gate
Continue Searching
The number of dice is affected by the challenger's Combat and Physique.
Your Survival and Stealth determine your full dice count.
You need at least 9 Success.
You need at least 6 Success.
In the end, you didn't help Alim… of course, you never saw him again either
Your words can split steel
There's always a bigger fish
Master Key

Almost everyone in the Dark Alley knows you; they gather around the beggar's hideout, shouting your command: "Open the gate!"

Under this pressure, the gate opens, and an old man with disgusting white sores covering his belly emerges. "What's all this about?" he squints at the crowd, then notices Alim. "Oh, it's the old mutt searching for his lost pup? He ran off, who knows where. Nothing to do with me." The angry crowd seizes him. Meanwhile, Alim rushes straight into the squalid den with you.

Seeing the sturdy wooden door, Alim's heart races with panic. He blurts out, "Do you know Lord [player.name]? The Sultan's most terrifying minion! He eats children, kills women, rapes men, and brushes his teeth with their ashes! He is right here! And I swear, if you don't open this door, he will rape you, then kill you! Even if you fled to the ends of the earth, the Sultan's magician will still find you, gnawing off your rotten dick at midnight!" 

Before you say anything to clarify yourself, White-Belly – trembling with fear – flings the door wide open.

There is a kind of key that can open any door: large enough, thick enough, heavy enough, a log wrapped in iron... lucky you, you can actually use this key. White-Belly, still listening inside, is knocked off his feet, revealing ugly white sores on his belly...
You wasted too much time

The gate is reinforced specifically to withstand group attacks. By the time you find tools to break through, nothing remains but the stench of garbage... All the beggars and that child-trafficking kingpin White-Belly have vanished. Alim races frantically into the night... After that night, you never hear from him again.
Unexpected Discovery
Nothing Gained

This is a trash heap, home to a swarm of young beggars – most of them crippled, while a few have yet to be maimed.
You search through them one by one, but there's no sign of Hemir…
Suddenly, Alim grabs something from around a young beggar's neck. It's a crude wooden whistle.
"This belongs to Hemir. He carved it himself. That old bastard must have dragged my boy here – forcing him, beating him, trying to make him a beggar. Then Hemir refused, so he beat him even harder, probably even killed him. That's why the other kid has his whistle." He clenches the whistle tightly in his hand… Maybe you could interrogate White-Belly again – or at least kill him to let Alim vent his anger.

This is a trash heap, home to a swarm of young beggars – most of them crippled, while a few have yet to be maimed.

You search through them one by one, but there's no sign of Hemir…

Alim kicks White-Belly to the ground… then pulls out his blade, the one he uses for cutting purses.

Maybe you could interrogate White-Belly again – or at least kill him to let Alim vent his anger.

5008073.title: Street Urchins
strings: Street Urchins

White-Belly's subordinates are not just Hemir... they're a large group of kids – some missing arms, legs, some ears, eyes, but each with a mouth. You have killed the person who once enslaved them, and something like hope now rises in their hearts. Specifically, most of them just want to eat a full meal.
Hungry Street Urchins
3 Gold Coins are required to buy food for the street urchins.
All You Can Eat Today
None of My Business

You buy up almost all the flatbread and grilled meat in the Dark Alley, quickly arranging for clean well water to be brought before anyone chokes. Some kind people even bring some porridge and cheese—all of which vanishes into the street kids' stomachs like a whirlwind.
White-Belly used to be a force to reckon with in the Dark Alley. Many people come specifically to watch these disabled children eat—praising your generosity and kindness, though plenty mock your foolishness too.
When the last street urchin eats until sprawled out on the ground, the crowd laughs and disperses. As you plan your next move, Alim discreetly slips a wad of money into your pocket. "I picked it from everyone," he winks at you, "consider it their tip for watching the show, right? Haha..." He puts a finger to his lips in a hushing gesture and disappears into the crowd.

You shrug. Helping these street kids won't do you any favors. And the most important thing is, you don't want a bunch of hungry mouths following you around. Alim doesn't seem surprised – he never expected you to stick your neck out for strangers anyway...He ends up taking all the kids back to his place. Looking after them will keep him so busy that you probably won't see him around for a while.

5008074.title: White-Belly
strings: White-Belly

Alim wants to slice up that beggar leader with his knife – considering what the man did, he deserves it; but you might handle it better, like finding out where Hemir is... What's keeping a ruthless trafficker from talking anyway?
Angry Alim
Try to convince White-Belly, need to show him something.
You must handle White-Belly yourself.
Use the Sultan Card to deal with this villain.
Anything you find useful
Different Sultan Cards have different effects, maybe one can make him speak?
Special evidence or acts of chivalry might open his mouth
Using a Sultan Card prevents presenting evidence; choosing to present evidence prevents using a Sultan Card.
Duel with White-Belly
The number of dice is affected by the challenger's Combat and Physique.
You need at least 6 Success.
Convince White-Belly, or use a Sultan Card on him.

Alim drained every drop of blood from White-Belly... but he never revealed the whereabouts of the child nor admitted to killing Hemir. The matter drove him nearly insane—it's said he continued to search in the Dark Alley to no avail.
Smells Fishy
You signal Alim to kill White Belly
Death and Truth

Alim drains every last drop of blood from White-Belly… but he still won't reveal the Hemir's whereabouts or admit to killing him. Alim is on the verge of losing his mind–it's said he's been scouring the Dark Alley ever since that day, to no avail.
Alim tortured White-Belly to death. Even in his final moments, he never revealed the child's whereabouts.

You present White-Belly with the Sultan's Bloodshed Card, offering him a chance: a one-on-one duel to the death, witnessed in the name of the Sultan's Game. If he wins, he walks free and may even tell his tale to the Sultan, but if you win, he must divulge what he knows.

For any condemned prisoner, this is a fair and even honorable opportunity. Neither White-Belly nor Alim raises any objection. Or rather, they seem baffled as to why you would go to such lengths for a child.

Alim unties White-Belly, who grabs his favored iron rod... he straightens his posture, puffing out his chest, trying to face you with the dignity of a true warrior.

...

Moments later, White-Belly falls to the ground. He shouldn't be surprised by this outcome.

"Hemir is my biological son... I sent him to be an apprentice at a mill..." he gasps, revealing shocking truths before his final words fade into a gurgle of blood.

Modest as it may be, perhaps this tale of death might provide some small amusement for the Sultan? As for Hemir, now that you have your lead, you can leave the rest to Alim – just make sure no one tells the boy who really killed his father.

You present White-Belly with the Sultan's Bloodshed Card, offering him a chance: a one-on-one duel to the death, witnessed in the name of the Sultan's Game. If he wins, he walks free and may even tell his tale to the Sultan, but if you win, he must divulge what he knows.

For any condemned prisoner, this is a fair and even honorable opportunity. Neither White-Belly nor Alim raises any objection. Or rather, they seem baffled as to why you would go to such lengths for a child.

Alim unties White-Belly, who grabs his favored iron rod... he straightens his posture, puffing out his chest, trying to face you with the dignity of a true warrior.

...

Moments later, White-Belly breaks your shinbone, and you lie in pain on the ground – an outcome that surprises everyone present.

"Hemir is my biological son... hah..." White-Belly reveals this shocking truth just before crushing your skull. But now, you'll never have a chance to share this story with the Sultan...
His gaze no longer stubborn
Alim, some rumors aren't just rumors
You tell him he'll lose everything, yet he simply smiles

You took out Hemir's whistle, telling White-Belly that the child must be connected to his beggar gang...
You told him you will question every street urchin here, even every person in the Dark Alley—someone must have seen a child with this whistle. Meanwhile, you'll torture him every day until Hemir is found. If he's alive, you'll let Hemir kill him personally. Or, he could reveal Hemir's whereabouts now, and you promised he can leave alive.
This threat hit home, and he gave up resisting, revealing a shocking truth—Hemir is his long-lost biological son.
Alim's eyes widened in shock: "Then why did you kidnap him? Who kidnaps their own son?"
"Because I went to find him before! I told him 'You're my son, I'll spend money to buy you an identity, I'll send you to be a respectable apprentice'—but this ungrateful brat actually—I can't even—he told me that he wants to follow Alim to be a thief! What father wouldn't be furious hearing that? Tell me, Alim—my son wants to follow you to become a thief! What do you think about that?!"
Alim, usually articulate, with lips parted as if to speak, said: "If I hadn't picked Hemir up from the streets and brought him home... he would have starved to death."
"Sure, he's not starving, but now he's turning into a thief. He'll end up on the gallows... or torn apart by the nobles' hounds!"
"Oh, come on, following you means being a beggar at most!"
"I've saved money—yes, I've stepped on other kids to do it, I'm a bastard, I'm scum, I'm a vulture—but I've saved that money to give Hemir a future. You're the one teaching him wrong!"
This had to be the most pathetic custody battle ever. Anyway, now that you had found out Hemir's whereabouts, killing his biological father isn't an option—just leave the rest to Alim.

Although Alim has threatened White-Belly dozens of times, he doesn't expect you to actually take out the Carnality Card... Old Alim wants to run away, as it is said that when the card glows, your manhood will surge through everyone in sight; but he doesn't dare turn his back on you or look away from what's happening even for a moment. 
... 
Afterward, you pull up your pants and look at White-Belly who has bitten his tongue to commit suicide: there must be some special hidden truth in this matter that we'll never know now. 
Old Alim is truly, completely frightened; he might never dare to appear before you again.

You nail this shameful trafficker to the iron gate, forcing him to watch as you conquer this place with the powers bestowed by the Sultan. You empty his lair, take away all the beggars and thugs, level the garbage heaps (which he calls treasures), flatten every inch of stinking soil, and remove the graffiti on the walls (which he calls history).

In the end, he bleeds out and dies in spasms, and all you get is nothing but an empty room... Alim leaves disappointed, leaving all these trophies to you.

5008075.title: Turning the Millstone
strings: Turning the Millstone
Alim has found Hemir. Would you like to see him? It seems that he is really working as an apprentice at the mill.
Pickpocket
You can go yourself, or send a follower
Pay 1 Gold Coin
Hemir remembers you

This is a childless couple whose ancestors were nobles, but by this generation, they only have this mill left. They don't recognize you, but Hemir proudly shares the story of how he once stole from your home… The miller's face darkens slightly – it's clear they've been raising Hemir like their own son, and no one wants their heir to be a thief, do they?
You quickly cut off his rambling, pulling out a shiny gold coin and insisting on buying flour milled by Hemir himself – the boy reluctantly heads off to work.
Later, as Alim drops noodles into the hodgepodge soup, his tears fall into the pot. "The boy's finally on the right path," he mutters, "I couldn't be happier!"
The miller brought out the best liquor from home
The miller's hand trembled as he poured the liquor
The miller's wife baked a huge, deliciously fragrant flatbread for you
The miller couple knelt to greet you

This is a childless couple whose ancestors were nobles, but by this generation, they only have this mill left. The mill owner shakily took out Hemir's apprenticeship contract for you, a distinguished figure, to review. It's the most generous type of contract, where the apprentice must fulfill the obligations of a firstborn and will inherit all the master's property and powers. This means everything here will belong to Hemir as long as he works hard.
At your request, Hemir is called out of the mill, his face covered in flour, his hair and clothes full of bran, his body reeking of donkey dung. But at least he appears well-fed, looking much brawnier than when you last caught him, his face rounder.
"It's [player.name]!" he shrieks, then begins boasting to his master and mistress about your greatness, your charisma, how many followers you have in the Dark Alley… He points to his small arm where you once caught him, bragging about your lightning-fast reflexes and martial prowess as if that spot were coated in gold. Honestly, this somewhat intimidates the miller couple – they can evidently recall the other side of the tale: you, plundering, debauching, and causing all manner of evil, protected by black magic...
So, you have to wave your hand to stop him. You explain you're here for Alim's sake. The old man would be delighted to have some flour personally ground by the pup... oh, the apprentice he used to take care of.
The silly child eagerly drives out the donkey and personally mills a large bag of fine white flour with the finest wheat for you...
Later, as Alim is dropping the dough into the hodgepodge soup, you share this detail with him. Old Alim's tears begin to fall into the soup – plop, plop – right alongside the dough... he definitely needs to use less salt now.

"It's [player.name]!" he screams, his teeth chattering with fear. He asks, trembling, if you're here to kill him, to root out White-Belly's remaining underlings... He drops to his knees begging you to kill only him, not to do anything worse to the mill, to his master and mistress...
Before the whole family falls to their knees, you interrupt this farce; you have to wave your hand to stop him. You explain you're here for Alim's sake. The old man would be delighted to have some flour personally ground by the pup... oh, the apprentice he used to take care of.
So the young boy breaks into a smile through his tears and personally grinds a large bag of snow-white flour from the finest wheat for you...
Later, as Alim drops the dough into the hodgepodge soup, you tell him this detail. Old Alim roars with laughter, spittle flying everywhere, completely killing your appetite.

5008076.title: Thief Apprentice
strings: Thief Apprentice
"This young pup came back to me, still set on being a thief... but that's wrong. So, my Lord, help me set him straight until he goes back to the mill."
Alim
Hemir

Alim knew you had no time for such lowly matters... he left quietly, and as for Hemir, who cares?
You could get a part-time job
Old dog and pup

It's not hard to see why Hemir's fed up with the mill: who wants to spend their life trudging in circles with a donkey? Making someone else's gold coins do the spinning is much more fun; especially since Alim’s pretty good to his pups. He's out of options now, pinning his hopes on that slick tongue of yours that can even fool the Sultan.

So, acting all grown-up, you pour this kid a full glass of wine and sit across from him:

"Hundreds, maybe thousands, of kids in the Dark Alley would kill for your chance right now. It's tough for a thief to turn miller, but a miller… can turn thief whenever he likes."

This lesson isn't quite what Alim expects, but Hemir clearly takes it to heart. He vows to work hard, inherit the mill, and one day become a master thief like Alim – which brings Alim to tears of joy.

Hemir doesn't listen to you at all, instead nestling affectionately into Alim's arms. He wants nothing but this old dog, this father-like thief ringleader. With no other choice, Alim takes Hemir back to the dog den. While his mouth curses the boy for being useless, incompetent, and unable to know what's good for him, his eyes betray a smile.
You're still green
He'll achieve great things
Lord [player.name] is a deep one
In this touching moment, you catch Hemir's fingers sneaking into your wallet... Honestly, he's much better at turning the mill.

In this touching moment, while you were distracted, Hemir silently took the gold coins from your wallet. It wasn't until after they left that you noticed Alim proudly scolding him, making you finally realize what had happened.

Hemir slips his hand into your wallet with silent precision... but as he rummages deeper and deeper, practically diving in with his whole body, he can't find even a single coin. Left with no choice, he exchanges an awkward forced smile with Alim...

5008077.title: Alim's Feast
strings: Alim's Feast
A kid from the Dark Alley has a fresh start – and you all feel like you've done something truly significant, worth celebrating with a Dark Alley special dough-drop stew.
Alim
You can invite any friend
Yourself
Dough Soup
You can enjoy it with your followers
Savor the Present
Destiny Like the Dough Soup

Surprisingly, Maggie isn't repelled by dirty Alim at all. Instead, she happily listens to Hemir's story – the embellished version by Alim, of course – even having a servant cut some of her favorite pickles to add to the stew. This dish's charm is mixing everyone's goodies into one pot. 
She praises your courage and mercy, saying you've done a great deed for Hemir... Suddenly, you realize: in reality, neither you nor Alim, especially you, have done anything meaningful regarding Hemir... It's ridiculous; what exactly are we celebrating? 
Holding Maggie in your arms, her body warmed by the steaming dough-drop soup, you decide not to think about more complex things but quietly enjoy this moment of warmth.

The secret recipe of the Dark Alley is simple: throw in whatever you find – stolen loot, street scraps, or robbed things. To prevent Alim from tossing in real junk, you bring a large piece of lamb, much to Alim's evident delight. He giggles as he serves everyone a bowl, regardless of whether they're lords or slaves – the newly ground flour smells surprisingly fragrant, and Alim has added numerous mysterious ingredients. With each bite, you never know what's coming, and it's best not to wonder what's in there.

5008078.title: Hungry Mouths
strings: Hungry Mouths

These little beggars have latched onto you – they eat like there's no tomorrow… but once you play the good guy, everyone expects you to keep it up… Before they eat you out of house and home, hurry to find them a way out.
Hungry Street Urchins
This money can feed the kids for no more than 3 Gold Coins.
Today is a hopeful day
Empty
Every hungry mouth gets fed without hurting anything but your wallet.
Your wallet is as empty as the kids' stomachs, but you had better worry about yourself first – they can tough out hunger way better than you can tough out broke.

5008079.title: Become Prostitutes
strings: Become Prostitutes

You've been stressed over these street urchins – They must find a way to sustain themselves! Today... as you pass by the House of Delights, where a pretty girl is stuffed in a big clay jar, her head poking out to lure in customers; maybe it's a stunt, maybe it's for real… either way, a wild idea crashes into your head.
Children
Every day, by putting the children into Methinks, you can come up with an idea for their placement.
If you don't like the current idea, leave it alone and wait for the next one.
They have a bright future
Becoming prostitutes is not good

Buthayna was fond of these special girls. "Look at them, adorable! That's the type many guests go for!" She then pinched a boy's cheek. "Every guest feels more confident in front of them! You've made an excellent selection, Lord [player.name]. I'll take them all!"
So, it was settled. Even if Alim angrily objected, he couldn't support so many pickpockets.
You didn't pull them out of White-Belly for this kind of mess, at least not now.

5008080.title: Beast of Burden
strings: Beast of Burden

You find Bharat – a guy who wheels and deals between the Sultan and foreign lands, full of dodgy tricks to scrape by. The thing is, he only takes on mute or deaf kids as his little helpers, figuring their silence works in his favor. For the rest, he is willing to show them some sleight of hand, cheap scams, and juggling – begging is much easier on those long trade routes compared to the capital. It will cost you a few coins, though.
Children
You need to give the foreign merchant 5 Gold Coins as children's maintenance
Every day, by putting the children into Methinks, you can come up with an idea for their placement.
If you don't like the current idea, leave it alone and wait for the next one.
At least, they can leave here
A Beast of Burden, No Matter How Far It Roams
Bharat promised to take the children when he next leaves. Though his business isn't entirely legal, he wouldn't harm them or dare betray you. Alim is reassured by this arrangement.

You think for a moment. Bharat definitely won't teach these children anything decent, and will only treat them like animals and tools... Perhaps in a few days, a better idea will come along. Better to wait for now.

Piousness

5008082.title: Become Dogs
strings: Become Dogs
These children are gentle and obedient. Perhaps you could recommend them to the Court... The nobles prefer flawed slaves – they tend to be more dependent on their masters.
Children
It costs 10 Gold Coins for a bribe
Every day, by putting the children into Methinks, you can come up with an idea for their placement.
If you don't like the current idea, leave it alone and wait for the next one.
Beat a dog, mind its master
Better to be a normal dog than a castrated one

You bribe the eunuch in the Sultan's harem, who praises the children's obedience to several concubines while portraying them as pitiful and helpless. Many girls get picked to wait on the consorts, and a few noblewomen take some in, too. As for the boys, a handful sign up to become eunuchs, while others turn into errand boys and informers outside the palace. Once they’re a bit older, they ought to scrape by with what they’ve picked up.
Alim asks detailed questions about the harem, but you warn him not to even think about it.

Life in the palace, no matter how dignified, is not enviable – all men get castrated, and as for women, it's not much different from being castrated. You think this life is worse than being a beggar... Think again, think of another way.

5008083.title: Become a Lamb?
strings: Become a Lamb?
There is not just one god in this world... Some gods shepherd their people, while others grind their teeth, suck blood, and favor fresh lambs...
Children
Convictions of the Cult.
Every day, by putting the children into Methinks, you can come up with an idea for their placement.
If you don't like the current idea, leave it alone and wait for the next one.
Badriyyah took them away
Forget it

Badriyyah takes the lead, and you stick close – the stuffed beggars scamper after you the whole way.

Then, in a pitch-black woodland untouched by moon or stars, she turns around and kisses you, her sweet juice seeping into you. When you savor such an extraordinary reward, you realize all the children have disappeared.
You saw that woodland and even heard that call, but you are not prepared to take the children to such a place.

5008084.title: Become Rats
strings: Become Rats

You found Alim again and suggested that he might consider teaching these children to become thieves. After all, he's quite good at taking care of children... Of course, you could give him some money to kick things off.
Children
You need to give Alim 8 Gold Coins for the children's care
Every day, by putting the children into Methinks, you can come up with an idea for their placement.
If you don't like the current idea, leave it alone and wait for the next one.
Every man to his trade
Too Many Thieves

In the past, these children had to rely on their disabilities to earn sympathy while begging, but now Alim has shown them how to make money on their own. After all, without offering people a chance to feel superior, those with disabilities are invisible to normal people, aren't they?
Looking at Alim's sly and confident smile, you feel you could not tolerate small children turning out this way... Think again, think again.

5008085.title: Become Human
strings: Become Human

Alim proposed a bold idea: to establish a school that would shelter the beggars from Dark Alley. Think about it – he is already skilled at caring for his puppies, but they need a gentleman to teach them proper manners rather than the tricks of thievery. So, if you're willing to help, Alim could fund half of the project – which means quite a fortune for him!
Alim
Half each, 10 Gold Coins
If you're willing to pay 20 Gold Coins, you can take the opportunity to break an Extravagance Card no higher than the Bronze tier
Children
Every day, by putting the children into Methinks, you can come up with an idea for their placement.
If you don't like the current idea, leave it alone and wait for the next one.
This school's future exceeds Alim's imagination

Alim noticed you had built this shelter much larger than these beggars actually needed. You told him that this place would not only house one group of beggars but become a base for educating all homeless children: We are nurturing the future.

Although Alim did not fully grasp what you said, he smiled, knowing it's always right to follow you.
You don't trust Alim
Perhaps there are other solutions? Anyway, you politely declined Alim's suggestion for now.

5008086.title: Abandoned
strings: Abandoned

5008087.title: Dog Den
strings: Dog Den

Alim calls his thieves' den The Dog Den, this rundown former Noble mansion is full of children... As you remain determined to fight the Sultan to the end, Alim suddenly invites you to visit. Maybe he has something special to say, but he also blinks desperately, reminding you not to forget gifts for his little pups.
Alim's Pups
Alim
You can go yourself, or send a follower.
One Feast, or 10 Gold Coins
Bring delicacies to show respect
Gold coins will warm their hearts

You brought [s4.name]—the best dishes from Dark Alley's best cook! Even the Sultan himself rarely tastes such delicacies. Every one of these pups—caught in that awkward age between childhood and youth—eagerly shares the food. Each get only a small bite, yet not a single quarrel breaks out among them. 
As laughter fills the air, they made space for two cushions. Alim sat across from you, breaking a melon in half and offering you a piece. "This is my Dog den," he said, gesturing at the children around you. "I found each of them on the streets—starving, skeletal, barely clinging to life. I fed them lamb pilaf until they could stand on their own, and they worked to repay me." There's a weight to his voice, and you listened in silence. "I don't claim to be charitable; I think the poor can't afford to be charitable... After all, how can you help others when you can't help yourself? But I hope these little pups will live better lives than mine – like eating honest food, not stolen scraps." 
Under his command, the strongest of the children, nearly grown, knelt before you. "Take them," Alim said. "Help them do something great—something that can change the fate of these little dogs. Let them, and their children after them, rise to nobility!" 
Then, Alim knelt before you as well. He added that these children know every street and alley in the city—and they would prove invaluable in the battle to come.

Alim smiles as he distributes the gold coins to all the children. Every group has a leader, and they are left with the money – just like animals disappearing before a disaster, Alim's little pups will also evade the imminent bloodshed.

In the end, only the oldest, almost adult children remain... they knelt with Alim before you: "Take them," Alim says. "Help them do something great – something that can change the fate of these little dogs. Let them, and their children after them, rise to nobility!"

Alim implores you, stating that even if the city turns into a burning hell, these children can help you find the right path.

5008088.title: A Proper Meal
strings: A Proper Meal
Habib has arrived at the guesthouse's kitchen, arranging his pots and sharpening his knives, preparing for this pre-appointment trial.
Ready to Impress
How much will you allocate for ingredients? 10 gold coins would certainly be more than sufficient.
If you provide 10 gold coins for a feast, you can take this to break a Extravagance Card of Rock tier
You can spend up to 10 Gold Coins. The more coins you spend, the more dishes you'll get.
At your service.
You provided Habib with a generous budget
Generous Funding
Test of Skill

He accepted the coins with excitement, purchasing fresh, seasonal ingredients from the market without pocketing a single copper piece. These exceptional materials showcased his culinary mastery, and soon, irresistibly enticing aromas wafted above the guesthouse - complex, rich, intoxicating. 
Not only were the rough laborers you'd hired captivated, but you yourself could not help swallowing in anticipation...

He respectfully accepted your reasonable sum - perfectly suited for his specialty: feeding many bellies with fair-priced, satisfying meals. 
Soon, appetizing aromas filled the guesthouse, causing the hired laborers to grow restless, craning their necks and asking when the feast might begin.

Creating a generous yet economical meal with limited funds - the ultimate test for any cook. 
Habib accepted with quiet understanding, taking the modest sum to the marketplace. Before long, delicious aromas drifted through the guesthouse. Without prompting, your hired laborers abandoned their half-hearted tasks, gathering in curious anticipation. 
Undoubtedly, Habib had found his rightful occupation.

Building some pathetic guesthouse in a place like Dark Alley, then throwing away a thous... ten gold coins to fill the bellies of those worthless commoners - such wasteful extravagance is certainly enough to break this low-tier Extravagance Card.

5008089.title: A Troubled Wife
strings: A Troubled Wife

Noticing the mistress's recent melancholy, Habib inquired discreetly about Maggie's food preferences. Perhaps if you took his skills to prepare her favorite treats, she might forget your recent disagreements...
Wife's Discontent
Habib
You chose to reveal her preferences - who knows Maggie better than you or Inal?
You chose to warn him against meddling in personal matters
Warn him or inform him? The choice is yours.

How dare he make such inquiries - how dare he concern himself with your wife?! You reprimanded him harshly, warning that his continued employment depended on minding his own affairs! 
Habib's face drained of color as he stammered silent acknowledgment.
Peacock's Display
Send Inal

With ill-concealed pride, you described Maggie's culinary preferences in elaborate detail - naturally, no one understood her tastes better than you! 
Unfortunately, Habib absorbed every word with earnest attention, betraying no reaction to your boasting. Requesting brief patience, he donned his apron and soon presented an exquisite dish. He even advised you which lunchbox would best maintain proper temperature during delivery... Momentarily speechless, you finally snatched the meal away in irritation. 
After dining, Maggie's mood brightened considerably, and the recent tensions between you dissolved effortlessly. You would never admit the dish's true creator.

Inal provided Habib with remarkably detailed descriptions of her mistress's favorite dishes. He listened with intense concentration, even making written notes. Donning his apron, he welcomed Inal into the kitchen, generously sharing culinary secrets for future occasions when her mistress might need cheering. 
Inal returned rosy-cheeked with happiness, humming while arranging the dishes before Maggie. Learning you had commissioned this feast through Habib, Maggie finally offered a soft "hmph" and the beginnings of a smile. The petty disagreements between you melted away like morning frost.
Mind Your Own Business

5008090.title: Everyone come together!
strings: Everyone come together!

Habib proved his culinary mastery - observe the eager crowd surrounding the kitchen! Without your presence at the doorway, they would have stormed inside to seize their portions. Smiling, you signaled that the feast could begin.
Hungry Masses
You may join them if you wish
Maggie would love to sample Habib's cooking
You can invite one non-noble follower to dine with you
Workers' Banquet
Place followers or enjoy the meal yourself
Besides enthusiastic chewing and swallowing, no other sounds disturb the table. People eat with gusto, then lavishly praise Habib.
United Presence
Joining the Feast
Eager Acceptance
[s4.name] sampled Habib's cooking for you.

Your joint appearance instantly transformed the atmosphere - none present had ever dined with nobility! 
Habib served you both first, then distributed portions to others with stern authority. His obvious favoritism caused Maggie to suppress amused laughter. 
Cherishing that smile, you sent for wine for everyone, with a special bottle reserved for Habib. Your generosity earned universal acclaim.

Your presence caused discomfort among Dark Alley's residents - none present had ever dined with nobility! With a dismissive gesture, you assured them no special treatment was necessary. Habib's extraordinary cooking gradually dissolved all tension. Though initial conversation included obligatory flattery, soon they focused entirely on appreciative consumption. 
Afterwards, you summoned Habib for private commendation, entrusting him with lodge management. His respectful bow was answered with the crowd's enthusiastic cheers.

At the first sight of the legendary wise and gentle lady, the people of Dark Alley instantly became awkward and restrained. Only Habib maintained his composure, approaching with utmost respect to personally serve Maggie a special portion, accompanied by a glass of fine wine reportedly brought from your territory. 
Habib's cooking was truly exquisite, conquering the palates of everyone present, including Maggie herself. Afterward, she offered Habib words of encouragement, informing him that your guesthouse would now be under his management. He nodded solemnly, barely concealing his excitement as he vowed not to betray the lady's trust. The crowd, hoping he would stay to continue cooking for them, erupted in unified cheers.
[s4.gender(he,she)] can't stop praising his skills and reportedly linger at the guesthouse for days afterward, enjoying free meals and refusing to leave.

5008091.title: Someone didn't get any
strings: Someone didn't get any

The guesthouse overflows with people! Many who never contributed labor joined the food queue, desperately hoping to taste Habib's renowned cooking. Quickly identified by legitimately hungry workers, arguments erupted and escalated toward violence!
Rioters of Dark Alley
Simpler solutions: One Feast, or 3 Gold Coins
Restore Order
Everyone stand down immediately!
Your Charisma and Physique determine you the full dice count.
You need at least 3 Success to control the situation.
Your negligence allowed dissatisfaction to escalate until your guesthouse was practically destroyed - truly an undeserved calamity.
Marked Target
Silent Authority
Hunger Conquers All

No one listened to [s3.name]'s commands. The starving crowd, enraged by [s3.gender(his,her)] fine adornments and healthy appearance, directed their collective fury at [s3.gender(him,her)]... 
Though [s3.name] eventually escaped the mob, [s3.gender(his,her)] dignity suffered irreparable damage...

[s3.name]'s thunderous command froze the entire establishment. Faced with genuinely threatening fists, rationality returned instantly as people shrank back like quails, meekly forming an orderly queue...
[s3.name]'s attempts to maintain order are drowned out by shouting and cursing. After a day of chaos, your guesthouse looks completely ransacked.
Open Feast
Irresistible Aroma

You put down what seems like pocket change - though a fortune to the Dark Alley dwellers - and announce that those who queue properly will eat their fill, while troublemakers will be banned. 
Just like that, everyone quiets down, bowls in hand, waiting patiently for their meal.
You instruct Habib to double the portions while warning that anyone causing trouble won't get a bite. Soon, the tantalizing food aromas make everyone forget their previous anger.

5008092.title: Nobles also want to eat
strings: Nobles also want to eat
News of your excellent cook spread rapidly, reaching even noble circles. They repeatedly hinted at their desire for an arranged tasting session.
Culinary Curiosity
You can treat him to any feast or spend 5 gold coins to prepare something fresh.
You can go yourself, or you can let Habib handle it
You ignored these nobles, who spread word that your guesthouse was unremarkable.
Personal Reception
Given Funds
Delegated Welcome
Directions Given
Know Your Place
Insolence Punished

5 gold coins provided sufficient ingredients for Habib's appropriate multi-course presentation. The gourmand noble expressed satisfaction with both meal and respectful reception, subsequently speaking favorably of you in court circles.

Habib's talents required no introduction! The gourmand noble expressed satisfaction with both meal and respectful reception. Soon, Dark Alley residents whispered that common folk at your guesthouse enjoyed dishes normally reserved for nobility! This rumor further enhanced your establishment's growing reputation.

5 gold coins provided sufficient ingredients for Habib's appropriate multi-course presentation. The satisfied noble departed with appreciative belches. 
Of course, his condescension in visiting a Dark Alley establishment already represented extreme humility - expecting reciprocal favors would be unreasonable.

Habib's culinary mastery required no introduction! He transformed even leftover dishes so skillfully that none could detect their secondary nature. The satisfied noble departed with appreciative belches while everyone privately mocked his pretensions to gastronomic sophistication. When you later inquired about this with amused disbelief, Habib responded with appropriate deference that he disliked the visitor's presumptuous attitude toward you.

You "forgot" advance notification, so Habib "mistakenly" identified him as another food-seeking intruder - albeit better dressed and more refined in appearance... 
Learning from previous incidents, Habib showed no hesitation in ejecting the intruder with a well-aimed skillet. The noble's anguished protests echoed across three neighboring streets.

You regarded the noble with contemptuous sidelong glance before departing with dismissive snort. 
Soon, Dark Alley residents circulated claims that your guesthouse served dishes even nobility couldn't access! This rumor further enhanced your establishment's growing reputation.

The noble, observing your apparent discomfort, immediately adopted a sneering expression: "Never mind, I had no genuine interest in such an establishment." 
He departed without a backward glance, later spreading malicious rumors among his peers.

5008093.title: Dinner is Served
strings: Dinner is Served
Habib's carefully prepared feast, enough to satisfy several guests.
A Meal by Habib
You can invite any friend
You can enjoy it with your followers
Hassan was in high spirits.
Delicious food, close friends - there couldn't be a more perfect meal.

He burst forth at the table:
"What gives this dish its charm
Is not the spice,
Nor the oil,
But the eyes of
The chef,
Watching eagerly beside the pot."
Hassan's verse stired something within Habib...

5008094.title: Comfort Food
strings: Comfort Food
Today, you find Maggie lounging on cushions, reading while enjoying a plate of unfamiliar preserved fruits...
Has she been unhappy lately?
Maggie
Don't you want to ask Maggie what delicious treats she's enjoying?
You decide not to disturb Maggie

Curious, you walk over and pick one up to taste. 
However, Maggie stops you: "Ah... these are better for women," she gently scolds as she takes the preserved fruit from your hand. "Habib made these especially for me. He says eating them makes a woman's body warmer from the inside out... and more beautiful." 
"What's wrong with me trying one?" you sidle up next to her, pretending to be quite hurt.
Maggie laughs, appearing to be in good spirits. She tosses a preserved fruit at you: "Look at you! You always want everything - always want the best of everything! Even a plate of women's preserves, you must have your share!" 
You catch the preserve and examine it carefully. It appears to be a peach with its pit removed, stuffed with spices, then preserved in honey. Just imagining the process makes you think it's incredibly labor-intensive. It's hard to believe Habib finds time to make these while taking care of so many people. 
Maggie seems completely unaware of your thoughts, just giggling as she says: "I'll ask if he has something suitable for men, and I'll tell him how greedy his master is!"

You've barely shown your curiosity when she laughingly offers you a handful. 
"Would you like to try? Though these are better for women," Maggie says with a smile. "Your chef made them for me. He says they"re good for a woman's body." 
You take the preserve and examine it carefully. It appears to be a peach with its pit removed, stuffed with spices and preserved in honey. Just imagining the effort makes you wonder how Habib finds time to make these while caring for so many guests. 
"Delicious, isn't it?" Maggie leans against you. “I'll ask if he has something suitable for men, so you won't have to be so envious while pretending not to be." Maggie giggles behind her hand, and you take the opportunity to lower your head... hmm, her lips are still sweeter.
She sees you from afar, nods politely, and even gives you a pleasant expression. Well, at least she's happier now.
Maggie greets you with a smile but says nothing. You both continue with your tasks, sharing the unbreakable understanding that has developed between you over time... presumably.
Days Later

As Maggie instructed, Habib brings a men-only special jar of preserved fruits just for you. He explains it's a traditional food desert scouts eat before journeys to improve speed and agility. 
Something about his emphasis seems peculiar.

5008095.title: A Jar of Candied Fruits
strings: A Jar of Candied Fruits
A jar of preserves exclusively for men! Maggie had them made especially for you! Who hasn't tried them yet? Hahaha!
Hunger Stirs
You can invite any friend to share them
You can enjoy it with your followers
Are you the only one with a wife?
Hassan was in high spirits.
Everyone rolls their eyes as you show off shamelessly, and they quickly devour the entire jar of preserves.

"Let this jewel of sweetness
Drop into the stomach,
Press close to the heart;
It will feel the heartbeat of a woman
Stirred by you."
Hassan's verse stired something within [player.name]...

5008096.title: Free Feast
strings: Free Feast

Habib has made an incredibly delicious Marvelous Mush from kitchen scraps - er, I mean, from leftover ingredients! It's now more popular than the main courses! Um... would you like to send someone to taste it?
Marvelous Mush
Crowds of the Dark Alley
Who will you send to taste this mush?
If you discover something, subsequent events may be triggered.
This is obviously a false accusation; you need to point out the suspicious parts
Your Stealth and Sociability determine your full dice count.
You need at least 5 Success to have a chance at uncovering the truth.
You need to send someone

You refused to join the commotion over leftover scraps! Your choice proved entirely correct when someone discovered a rat's head in the Marvelous Mush! Horrified retainers avoided your guesthouse for days, much less offered assistance.
Watch What You Eat

In the courtyard filled with the aroma of food, [s3.name] and [s4.name] had just picked up their bowls when a commotion broke out from the crowd - someone was holding up something by its tail, shouting, "What is this in the soup! A rat? This unscrupulous chef...! It's horrible, horrible!"
Handle the Situation
Skeptical Response
Questioning the Chef?
Eat up! Why the hesitation?

The guests begin stirring their soup, checking for strange objects, while [s3.name] and [s4.name] exchange glances before stepping forward to defend your reputation - such a thing could not - must not happen in your guesthouse. [s3.gender] promise a thorough investigation, then half-threaten, half-persuade the man who found the rat into an empty room next door. Looking at his troubled expression mixed with greed... he must be deliberately causing trouble!

[s3.name] and [s4.name] exchange glances before stepping forward to defend your reputation - such a thing could not - must not happen in your guesthouse. However, everyone is stirring their soup, whispering about what might be in it... Your inn's reputation hangs in the balance, and the man who found the rat wears a smug, satisfied expression... He's definitely suspicious! 
There's no time to waste! [s3.name] drags the man into an empty room next door, slamming the door shut to block out the whispers of "Are they silencing him?" from outside.

Amidst the commotion, Habib emerges. With his towering height, he stands beside the troublemaker like a robust tower. "May I see this rat?" 
The man falters, nervously waving the rat before dropping it into Habib's hand. 
"Indeed, it is a rat. However, a rat's neck is fragile and would break apart if cooked for long. Given this rat's condition, it must have been placed in the soup just moments ago." As he speaks, Habib draws a sharp kitchen knife from his apron and calmly dissects the rodent before everyone, revealing internal organs still flushed with blood. His Marvelous Mush had been simmering all morning, as everyone had witnessed. 
The troublemaker is speechless. He awkwardly mutters something about a "misunderstanding" and tries to back away, but the crowd prevents his escape. Habib seizes him by the collar with an iron grip and drags him into the empty room next door.

"What? Where's a rat?" Alim rises languidly, squinting at the troublemaker. He walks over, takes the rat from the man's hand, and with a chuckle, stuffs the entire rodent into his mouth, producing spine-tingling chewing sounds. 
Everyone falls silent, including those standing beside him. Alim seems completely unaware of anything amiss. "What's wrong? Eat up! Haven't you had this before? It's a rare delicacy!" 
Well, yes, living in the Dark Alley, who hasn't eaten even mud when starving? Those days feel like another lifetime now. Thanks to Master [player.name]... The crowd quickly mumbles a few prayers before returning to their mush. 
As for the dumbfounded troublemaker, just as he tries to slip away, Alim grabs him firmly - he hasn't properly thanked this brother who provided him with an extra meat dish.

"What? Where's a rat?" Alim rises languidly, squinting at the troublemaker. He walks over, takes the rat from the man's hand, and with a chuckle, stuffs the entire rodent into his mouth, producing spine-tingling chewing sounds. 
Everyone falls silent, including Habib who stands beside him speechless. Alim seems completely unaware of anything amiss. "What's wrong? Eat up! Haven't you had this before? It's a rare delicacy!" 
Well, yes, living in the Dark Alley, who hasn't eaten even mud when starving? Those days feel like another lifetime now. Thanks to Master [player.name]... The crowd quickly mumbles a few prayers before returning to their mush. 
As for the stunned troublemaker, just as he tries to slip away, Habib grabs him firmly - someone who nearly ruined his reputation won't escape so easily!

5008097.title: Troublemaking Rat
strings: Troublemaking Rat

This troublemaker is stubborn. First, he insists he didn't fake anything, then his eyes shift as he says if you give him 10 gold coins, he'll tell you who's plotting against you; otherwise, he won't talk...
Troublemaking Thug
You can go yourself, or you can send someone to interrogate him
He demands 10 gold coins from you, otherwise he won't tell you a word
Beyond Consequences
Financial Solution

[s2.name] talks until their lips are chapped, but the troublemaker remains unmoved. 
"I said, if you don't give me money, I won't tell you anything." His eyes are full of greed mixed with fear - yes, fear of death - he knows he's cornered, but what of it? He's a thug living day by day, not caring if he dies. His survival strategy is to bite hard when someone important like you needs something from him. 
"Or..." he suddenly smiles, with a hint of madness in his eyes: "Let me meet Habib's gentle and beautiful lady. I've never tasted a woman's flavor in my life. If she comes to see me, perhaps I'll be willing to talk?" 
...How despicable...!

This is likely the first time the troublemaker has met a refined lady like Maggie, and he seems quite awkward. Maggie has someone bring him a cushion and some refreshments. Rather than directly asking who sent him to cause trouble, she gently inquires about his circumstances. As they sit facing each other, the troublemaker doesn't know where to put his hands and feet, his arrogance completely vanished. 
He stammers a few responses, then gradually reveals everything he knows. 
It turns out the person who sent him to cause trouble at your guesthouse was a nobleman. From his description, you can identify who it is. 
After confessing everything, the troublemaker remains silent for a while, then suddenly leans forward while Maggie is lost in thought and kisses her cheek - 
He dares!! Enraged, you draw your sword to strike him down, but Maggie gently presses your hand. She looks at you, then at the troublemaker, shaking her head: "Let it go. He's just a child. He doesn't know what he wants... a woman, or a mother..." 
The man pauses at her words, then suddenly tears well up in his eyes. He tries to wipe them away unsuccessfully, finally breaking into loud sobs. 
Through Maggie's soft sigh, you notice that this thin youth has a childish face. At fourteen or fifteen, an age when noble children would still be carefree... 
You strictly order everyone in the room not to speak of what just happened, then leave with Maggie. 
A few days later, someone mentions that a rat from Dark Alley has died. No one bothers to tell Maggie, of course, and no one knows who did it - perhaps for betraying his master, who knows?

After receiving the gold, he readily reveals everything he knows. 
It turns out the person who sent him to cause trouble at your guesthouse was a nobleman. From his description, you can identify who it is. Now, it's time to settle the score.

5008098.title: Big Rat
strings: Big Rat
You now know who sent someone to throw a rat into Habib's Marvelous Mush to frame you. How will you handle this?
This person was behind it all
You can go yourself, or send a noble follower
You can show him a Sultan Card of Bronze tier or lower: Bloodshed, Carnality or Conquest
If the Influence is sufficient, it might be enough to intimidate him
Using a Sultan Card requires you to go personally
You show the Bloodshed Card
You show the Carnality Card
You show the Conquest Card
Jest or Madness?

The game grants you the simplest, most direct form of revenge: ending his life. No other excuse needed, no additional explanations required. Just like that, he dies in a pool of blood. As pitiful as the fat rat in the soup.

To avoid your humiliation, the man leaps from his own attic, literally splattering his brains on the ground. 
Unfortunately, the Sultan is unlikely to accept this incomplete card usage, so you find the nobleman's young son - inheritance works this way, doesn't it? One inherits both honor and debts.

"Listen, your family will be destroyed within seven days," you smile, tapping his cheek with the card. "Not a soul will remain... including the rats." 
He trembles in terror and faints - never to wake again. No matter. His death is inconsequential. You're a person of your word.
Given your current Influence, neither impeachment nor condemnation would achieve your desired outcome. To him, what difference is there between you and a street rat?

You merely tap his shoulder after the court session ends, and he immediately kneels. Sobbing, he claims it was his own foolishness, jealous of your rising influence in Dark Alley, even surpassing Vizier Abdul - 
Wait, did he just mention an unexpected name?

You merely tap his shoulder after the court session ends, and he immediately kneels. Sobbing, he claims it was his own foolishness, jealous of your rising influence in the Dark Alley that now surpasses even Abdul's former standing... 
Really? That's surprising, given his apparent loyalty to the former Vizier.

5008099.title: Family Portrait
strings: Family Portrait

You want everyone to know that challenging you, a dignified Sultan Card player, will not end well. May all who scheme against you or employ petty tricks carefully weigh the consequences and understand this simple truth.
Hastily Assembled Troop
You must go yourself, or send followers to command your troop
You must lead an troop or sufficiently powerful followers into battle
You must defeat the opponent's troop
Escape Means Death
Having heard your declaration, the opponent has hastily assembled their troop. Battle is imminent.
The number of dice provided by your Combat and Physique is affected by the opponent's corresponding attribute.
You need at least 5 Success to win
How dare you refuse your sacred promise to the Sultan Card? The Sultan disapproved of your evasion and executed you with a mere gesture.
You succeeded
You failed
You arrange the heads of the deceased in neat rows - this is what makes them a family, after all.

Your men barely withstand the opponent's troop's first charge, and once retreat begins, it cannot be stopped... In the end, you're dragged from your tent and beheaded by this troop. 
When your head hits the ground, what difference is there between a person and a rat?

5008100.title: Waiting for a meal
strings: Waiting for a meal
You promise these wandering beggars a meal - and a good one at that.
Hungry People
Any feast prepared by Habib
Habib happily prepares feasts for children, and if that's not possible, you can let him use Methinks.
Hungry beggars realize you're just talking, not truly disappointed, they simply leave resignedly.

These children have never seen such delicious food; they're almost frightened. You pat their little heads and tell them that yes, they really can eat their fill. 
Thus, everyone at the guesthouse witnesses how these few children demolish a feast that seven adults could hardly finish. Your kindness and generosity once again leave a deep impression on everyone.

5008101.title: Cold Amusement
strings: Cold Amusement
Recently, your wife has been quite unhappy with you. You can sense her growing resentment, and you didn't please her in time.
Wife's Resentment
Cold Maggie
Maggie's Late Return

You ask where she's been, but she acts as if you don't exist, walking straight past you. 
She has learned to ignore you, as if this way she doesn't have to face the problems between you, as if the barriers standing between you can simply be treated as nonexistent.

You're at your wit's end. Not only has he been harmed, but your reputation has suffered immense damage as infected clients spread word throughout their circles... Perhaps you should never have dabbled in this business.

You plead understanding - your humble establishment couldn't possibly entertain the esteemed Sultan. If something displeases him, punishing you would be one thing, but what if his anger extends to those who recommended you? 
Though displeased by your refusal, the noble leaves. He later apologizes to the Sultan at great cost to save his life. He blames all these losses on you - all because of your wretched Velvet Chamber!
