You specifically instructed Habib to ensure that, while every dish remained delicious, the flavors be made bolder so the Sultan drinks more—as the more he drinks, the quicker he gets drunk, and the more likely you are to get through the day peacefully...

Your best chef is dead, but his dishes haven't spoiled yet... You've added extra salt and spices not only to mask any deterioration but to make the flavors stronger, encouraging the Sultan to drink more - after all, the more he drinks, the faster he'll become intoxicated, and the more likely you'll survive the day...

Everything goes according to plan. The Sultan enjoys each dish immensely, commenting on every course. He even summons Habib to personally inquire about certain recipes... Habib later tells you that he could feel the Sultan's gaze following him all the way out of the room.

Everything goes according to plan. The Sultan enjoys each dish immensely, commenting on every course. He even wants to summon your chef to personally inquire about certain recipes... 
You reluctantly explain that the chef recently had an unfortunate accident involving his neck and a kitchen knife... in short, he's dead. The Sultan gives you a suspicious look, clearly believing you're withholding a talented chef from him.

He eats with evident pleasure, particularly enjoying the accompanying wine. He even orders his eunuchs to record several recipes. Before the banquet ends, the Sultan generously rewards you with gold, laughing as he watches you become even more attentive after receiving his favor.
As the wine's flush still colors the Sultan's cheeks, you quietly clap your hands, and the music in the hall gradually shifts to something more seductive...

[s2.name] carefully approaches the Sultan, kneeling respectfully. Learning this beauty is your gift to him, the Sultan beckons her closer, then casually slits her throat with his dagger. 
The Sultan admires her face, frozen in shock and terror, then bursts into laughter: "What excellent entertainment! [player.name], you never disappoint me!" 
You force out a dry laugh while wiping cold sweat from your brow...

[s2.name] approaches the Sultan with dignified grace, kneeling before him. Learning this beauty is your gift to him, the Sultan smiles. He beckons her closer, and you witness firsthand the cruel pleasure of receiving the great Sultan's attention. 
You hear the woman's painful moans and try to convince yourself they contain some pleasure, but they don't. Perhaps even the Sultan feels none. He's merely playing with a fresh, interesting prey, nothing more.

Learning this beauty is your gift, the Sultan's eyes brighten slightly. He beckons her closer, and you witness firsthand the cruel pleasure of receiving the great Sultan's attention. 
You hear the woman's painful moans and try to convince yourself they contain some pleasure, but they don't. Only the Sultan seems genuinely entertained, enjoying this rare after-dinner treat.

Seeing Maggie kneeling submissively, the Sultan laughs aloud. 
"Ha!" he looks at you intriguingly. "What does this mean, my dear courtier?" 
You kneel with equal submission, explaining she is your most precious woman. You couldn't think of anyone else worthy of entertaining the esteemed Sultan. 
The Sultan accepts Maggie, while you avoid her cold, mocking glance in your direction.
After this, people truly begin to fear you.

At first, everything proceeds smoothly - Shama's elegance and beauty could conquer any man, until the Sultan touches something that shouldn't exist... Even slightly intoxicated, the Sultan recognizes what it is. 
He pauses, toying with it, seemingly curious about its connection to her anatomy. Finally, he skillfully cuts it away, using the gushing blood to enhance his pleasure, even as the body beneath him gradually grows cold.

For survival, and for the vagrants, Raed could endure every manner of suffering. But the Sultan—this humiliation, and this alone—was what she could never accept.
She drew the blade she kept close to her body and struck with all her strength, yet the edge found nothing but the Sultan's robe.
That wild gift, laced with so many secrets, thrilled the Sultan beyond measure.
He was elated, satisfied beyond words.
Behind the bloodstained curtain, he made you all wait for a long while before bursting into laughter and leaving—ordering his soldiers to take away Raed's corpse.
The Sultan seems momentarily stunned by your advance. He pushes you away. "Return to your seat, courtier," he says, nearly spilling his wine with laughter.

Kneeling, you respectfully present the card depicting lovers, begging your master to break it - which is absolutely inappropriate. The Sultan narrows his eyes dangerously. Swirling his wine leisurely, he says, "Courtier, if you wish to please me, take this game more seriously. If not... what exactly are you trying to do?" 
Sweating profusely, you withdraw the card, offering many flattering words and promising never to take such shortcuts again. Only then does the Sultan wave dismissively, letting your transgression pass.

When the atmosphere feels right, you activate the Rod of Life in the main hall, promising the Sultan unprecedented pleasure. 
Naturally, the ashen-faced Sultan has your head removed.

As the banquet nears its conclusion, you invite the Sultan to see your velvet-curtained chamber, to hear what people discuss there... 
The Sultan eagerly sets down his wine cup, following your lead as you guide him up the attic stairs.

You whisper in the Sultan's ear that the most common topic here is people's inability to approach the sun-like greatness of the Sultan. "You wouldn't believe how many people journey great distances to glimpse your divine countenance, almost like pilgrims!" You bow humbly. "They should envy me - not only do I have the honor of seeing you at court, enjoying your favor, but I'm blessed to prepare meals and pour wine for you!" 
The Sultan laughs with pleasure. Laugh, yes, laugh, you join him with sincere-seeming mirth. You haven't lied - many indeed come from everywhere to see him, except they come to drink his blood!

You whisper in the Sultan's ear that the lower city's people pray daily to the Immaculate Purity, describing religious ceremonies in detail, answering his every question like his informant in the Dark Alley. The Sultan remains noncommittal about their devotions but seems quite pleased with your attitude. 
Naturally, the Purist Order's priests are equally pleased upon hearing of your assistance.

You quietly inform the Sultan that the lower city's people pray daily to the Immaculate Purity. You indignantly reveal that during ceremonies, the Purist Order priests conceal significant amounts of gold - gold that rightfully belongs to the Sultan's treasury. 
The Sultan remains noncommittal, but seems pleased with your attitude, as if you've truly become his informant in the Dark Alley. He even rewards you with a vial of Aether, something priceless to the Order but merely a casual gift from him.

Even the scent of blood hangs in the air... 
You awkwardly meet the Sultan's knowing smile, explaining embarrassingly that occasionally - just occasionally - some cultists visit... 
The Sultan merely pats your shoulder, telling you to relax. He seems unbothered - after all, what is such minor evil to the Sultan?

The cultists in the room fervently proclaim their grand plans while you stand sweating beside the Sultan, not daring to speak... 
The Sultan smiles with interest, seemingly believing it, or perhaps just enjoying it as entertainment. Before leaving, he casually rewards you with a vial of Aether... 
Perfect - this Aether, along with the Sultan's obvious attitude, is exactly what you need.

Through the heavy curtains, you hear indignant voices. You move to intervene but the Sultan stops you. Disguised as an ordinary noble guest, he smokes a water pipe while listening to others eloquently criticize corrupt officials and vizier factions, accusing them of emptying the great Sultan's treasury, forcing him to delay military campaigns... 
He occasionally asks questions, and after about one water pipe's worth of time, he calmly rises, his expression unreadable, and quietly departs.

Through the heavy curtains, you hear indignant voices. You move to intervene but the Sultan stops you. Disguised as an ordinary noble guest, he smokes a water pipe while listening to others criticize self-proclaimed virtuous officials who constantly trouble the Sultan with trivial matters. "Can gold multiply through arguments? Couldn't they be more considerate?" 
The Sultan cheerfully joins their conversation, occasionally asking questions. After about one water pipe's worth of time, he calmly rises, his expression unreadable, and quietly departs.

You arrive at the scene before the killer departs. He's prying open a mercenary's mouth, seemingly intent on cutting out the still-pleading tongue... 
The face is familiar - recently, this wandering swordsman worked under your roof. You stare at each other, uncertain whether to apprehend him or question his motives. 
He coldly regards you. "I avenge the nine princesses of Hukakasus," he says. "For my nine disgraced sisters." 
His sword hand shifts slightly, turning the blood-stained, sharp blade slowly toward you. "[player.name], you too dishonored them."

The Roaming Swordsman silently watches you. This time, he doesn't leave when commanded, coldly stating: 
"You cannot stop me."
Eight corpses, eight faces frozen in terror and anguish. With minimal reflection, you recall sharing drinks with them once - what were you discussing then? You've somewhat forgotten.

Is killing drunken mercenaries who couldn't control their mouths true revenge? Does he know who truly dishonored his family and sisters, or is he afraid to face them?

The Roaming Swordsman falls. His eyes quickly dim, losing their luster like weathered stone. Perhaps he should have died long ago, buried in this nameless soil that was once his Homeland. Perhaps becoming dust now isn't too late - to be blown by the wind to where all his relatives, all his sisters chose death over dishonor.
You've captured a serial killer from the nameless masses - a traitor, a prince of the Homeland. The Sultan greatly praises your accomplishment, graciously allowing you to break this Bloodshed Card.

It's all meaningless, isn't it? Killing those who merely insulted his sisters only quiets his own rage and highlights his powerlessness. 
His sisters were never truly dishonored - they joined hands and took their lives together when the city fell. Who truly harmed them? This sword may never taste the blood of the true enemy... 
Realizing this, he suddenly loses all enthusiasm. As he has many times before, he abandons the easily attainable victory and departs, dispirited.

The Homeland prince's blood rivals gold in value. You successfully break this Bloodshed Card.

As the blade pierces your heart, you see his cold eyes. He cleanly withdraws his sword, wiping your blood from his face. With a slight sneer, he says, "That's the difference with princesses." He leans to your ear, ensuring you hear his final words: "Their honor isn't for someone like you to casually tarnish." 
So it was... about those drunken jokes... What... a jest... this is...

5008129.title: Food Poisoning
strings: Food Poisoning
This morning, chaos erupts in the guesthouse as people vomit and cry for help, apparently poisoned. The culprit is quickly identified...
Habib

After preparing this disastrous meal and causing you enormous trouble, Habib is never seen again. 
He disappears - or rather, flees - without returning to your estate, his hometown, or telling anyone his destination... 
You feel angry, confused, but helpless.

5008130.title: Armed Sheep
strings: Armed Sheep
As if you needed more troubles, Habib suddenly loses his mind. Wielding a boning knife, he storms your residence shouting your name, demanding you come out so he can kill you.
Deranged Chef
Inevitable Failure

Your servants easily overpower and bind him. He curses you wildly, using every foul word he knows - unfortunately, his repertoire is limited, his worst curse being "may you die miserably." 
Finally, he breaks down sobbing: "She was the best woman - the best! The best! You had her but you - you - may you die miserably - she didn't even have a proper funeral... She! She! She was the best woman! You... you son of a dog!" 
Ah... so his rage stems from Maggie's death. 
But you have too many concerns to waste time on a deranged chef. You order him dragged away. 
The next day, your steward informs you Habib has vanished. He didn't return home or to your estate. His belongings remain scattered in his room, nothing taken... Other servants believe he was so heartbroken over Lady Maggie's passing that he decided to follow her. 
This feeling is difficult to describe, but at least... someone was willing to die for Maggie, even if... that person wasn't you.

Habib was puzzled but quietly accepted the offering. Soon after, he brought you a bottle, claiming it was brewed from the night itself.
Somehow, it seemed too fast—you suspected he may have just steeped it quickly.

Such a plump pigeon was rare! Habib eagerly opened it, only to find a huge gem rolling out... a massive diamond! You realized this is a gift from the workers for the freedom you granted them, they returned their thanks in their own way.
None of the dishes were tricky, but serving a whole table steaming hot at once kept Habib running ragged.

Habib expertly deboned all the wild game, skewering them to roast slowly over the fire... As the fat dripped onto the iron tray below, he kneaded the dough, chopped up a dozen fresh vegetables, and whipped up hot flatbreads and sauces... Now, whatever you fancy, grab it with a flatbread by the fire and gobble it down right away!
Habib had never seen beef so perfect, gleaming like a jewel... He insisted on blanching the thin slices only in the purest snow-melt water, and wouldn't let you dip them in any sauce...
After killing the chicken, Habib found a note inside its belly detailing the perfect way to cook its breast... And so this dish was born.
It was said to taste like dragon meat... True or not, you stayed in the kitchen while Habib simmered the donkey fat.
Habib had three servants flash mirrors at the monster's head. Once the sunlight dazed it, they could safely take its eyeballs out one at a time...

This drink didn't make itself—you ran all over the capital to gather twelve murderers' weapons, then bribed the high constables to use their autopsy room...
In a place like that, you sealed the bloodied knives together with syrup, salt, and baking soda in a barrel, and the monster would follow inside... An overnight ferment, and the frost on the barrel surface told you it was ready.
The tricky part? Whether chopped or deep-fried, the snakes just keep squirming. That's why you need a proper iron cage to hold them down.

The key lies in keeping the monster intact. While it's still alive, cram plenty of minced meat into the gaps in its shell, then steam the whole thing in a massive pot. Crack it open once it's done, and you will find the monster's magic fully infused into the meat!

Knead the dough to fill every missing part for the Toothy Remnant. During this process, the monster grows quiet and docile. Once it has fully fused with the dough, cut off its head again, carve it apart, and roast the still-squirming pieces into form.
It ages the same no matter what you soak it in, so don't waste the chance—use the fine spirit.
You're starting to suspect that killing that succubus was completely unnecessary! But where did Habib hide it? Curse that chef!
Few chefs got to make a dish like this... So even though it was technically an unclean beast, Habib went all out to make it tasty.

The cage opens and the racing hound s burst forth, chasing the fleeing rabbit. But Luna... 
It charges forward with lightning speed as usual, then suddenly drops its head. Its momentum prevents it from stopping properly, causing it to roll forward and slam its neck against the track barrier. It stops completely, tongue lolling, pink foam spraying from its mouth. 
The spectators gasp as something flashes past you - Faris, already rushing onto the track. 
In the disorienting commotion, you help Faris carry Luna back to his room. The poor hound is already dead. Tears well in its beautiful eyes, and despite Faris's efforts, its eyes won't close. Its neck is broken - racing hound s' bodies built for ultimate speed have no protective fat, making one fall potentially fatal, as happened now. 
Faris cradles Luna's body, burying his face in its beautiful fur. 
"Please leave... I'm sorry you lost so much money. I'll find a way... but please go. Today, I don't want... don't want to say anything..." 
You have no choice but to leave the hound -fighting pit alone.

Your unwise bet earns the Sultan's prolonged laughter. You don't understand why he's so amused - is it merely because you lost money? Could a hound 's death entertain him so? You don't understand. Nevertheless, the Sultan allows you to break this card.
[s2.name] bursts from the starting line like lightning.

[s2.name] fails to respond promptly to the starting command, falling far behind. You curse several times, but seeing the highly anticipated "Luna" fatally crash into the track barrier shortly after starting, those who bet on it surely lost more than you... This thought makes you feel somewhat better... 
Wait, that's inappropriate... Luna was certainly a good hound . When Faris approaches you red-eyed, you feel guilty. "I have a request," he says through clenched teeth. "[player.name], when you have time, let's speak privately."
[s2.name] maintains advantage throughout, leaving others far behind.

[s2.name] gets pushed and jostled, never regaining the advantage. You curse several times. 
Only now do you notice Faris kneeling in the corner, clutching his beloved black hound... 
What happened? You quickly ask those nearby. They unleash a stream of curses, saying that damn hound crashed into the track barrier shortly after starting, costing them everything! 
You add a few agreeing comments, until Faris approaches red-eyed... hopefully he didn't hear what you just said. You nervously ask his purpose, and he says through clenched teeth: "I have a request, [player.name]. When you have time, let's speak privately."

[s2.name] charges toward the finish line with absolute advantage. It wins, and so do you. 
Amid the cheering, you suddenly notice Faris kneeling in the corner, holding his beloved black hound. What happened? Before you can ask, the dog-fighting pit servants surround you, stuffing your pockets with heavy Gold Coins.

In the race's final moment, another hound overtakes [s2.name]. It loses, and so do you. You lose everything. 
You and others who bet on it curse loudly, but eventually sigh that your hound just had a momentary lapse - surely better than Crescent! That one crashed into the track barrier right after starting, breaking its neck! 
Everyone laughs mockingly, while you remain unusually silent, frowning: No experienced racing hound should make such a basic mistake, unless...

How he loves seeing expected heroes die meaninglessly - even if just a hound!

5008149.title: Vengeance Request
strings: Vengeance Request

Faris approaches you, seemingly composed though rage still burns in his eyes: "I will avenge Luna's death. I'll get to the bottom of this." He speaks with determined, calm certainty. "What about you? You lost significant money in this unfair race - will you just let it go?"
Faris
You choose to help him

Polite Acknowledgment

Accompanying Faris are four slender racing hounds like Luna. Before formal discussion, he introduces each by name, as if they're participants in this meeting. 
"This is Gold Sun, this is Silver Mist, this is Thunder Wind, and this fellow is Abdul. Yes, named after the Abdul you know - after his third passive-aggressive courtroom comment toward me, I decided to name a houndafter him and then neuter it." He winks mischievously, then pulls out a necklace with sharp canine teeth. "And my favorite, Luna, I keep with me... at least part of him."

They wag their tails frantically, eagerly placing paws on your legs, nudging your palms with their foreheads... Who could resist petting their clever little heads? 
Faris watches you all with a smile, even showing a hint of affection. Only when they nearly knock you down, licking your face, does he intervene. "They adore you - I'm almost jealous - but this confirms you're trustworthy." He extends his hand, pulling you up with newfound sincerity.

They sniff you briefly, seemingly just familiarizing themselves with their master's friend's scent, before returning to lie obediently at Faris's feet, neither barking nor misbehaving - more polite than many nobles' children.

You invite Faris and his hounds into your reception room, asking what truly caused the accident - why did Luna suddenly...? 
Faris's expression turns serious. "I'm certain someone used poison - on the bait rabbit that entices the hounds forward. They knew Luna likes tearing into its prey." 
He speaks calmly, even with a slight smile. "Luna lost, making many people rich. My money - and money from everyone who believed Luna would win - all went to them. The cost? My Luna, dead." 
He shakes his head, continuing: "The hound-fighting pit people know me too well. They'd hide any evidence if they saw me, so I need your help, [player.name]. Help me discover what poison was used, who administered it, and who ordered it... I'll repay you, I swear."

It comes from a desert oasis recently crushed by the Sultan's cavalry. The local tribe reportedly used it to stimulate coughing to clear inhaled sand - a medicine that becomes deadly in large doses. 
Yet even you, a powerful courtier, haven't heard of this poison. Who could possibly have access to it?
You find no useful clue

These names are obviously false - "Such-and-such III," "Emperor So-and-so" - but... they're familiar pseudonyms. You recall the Sultan occasionally using these names playfully when addressing his eunuchs...

You and Faris review the evidence together, both falling silent. 
Now, there's only one answer, one neither wants to voice, one painfully obvious, one cruelly clear... 
"So that's it," Faris says hoarsely, "it was him all along. No wonder this dog-fighting pit has operated so long..." 
You nod. Then ask what he plans to do. 
"What to do... of course I want to avenge my Luna, but behind this is - is..." he takes a deep breath through clenched teeth, "the Sultan himself! He owns everything - the entire country - yet still takes what little we have... a handful of gold, one wonderful dog... we can't possess anything he doesn't... his greed truly has no end - none!" 
The conversation halts abruptly, leaving you deep in thought...

After speaking, he deflates like punctured skin, taking a moment before bowing to you. 
"At least now I know the truth," he sighs wearily. "From now on, [player.name], whatever you need, I'll find a way to help."

Hearing your dangerous thoughts, Faris remains silent for a long time. Darkness flickers in his eyes - seemingly moved yet hesitant. Finally, he offers no response. 
"Except that," he sighs wearily. "Except that, [player.name]. Anything else, I can help with."
You exploit his grief and the betrayal by his master to corrupt his soul
He nods, perhaps he'll follow your advice.
You reveal your Bloodshed Card alongside your blade
He cleaves open your chest, then your abdomen, your head... striking repeatedly, as if you embodied someone else deserving his boundless rage.

You present Faris's severed head to the Sultan, faithfully recounting his words - cleverly omitting your knowledge of the Sultan's connection to the dog-fighting pit. 
The Sultan appears briefly regretful before smiling. "I see." Moved by your loyalty, he waves dismissively, gifting you the axe from Faris's possessions.
The next day, he arrives at your household - a capable new assistant.

Kneeling at the Sultan's feet, you passionately lament that Fadia is the finest slave girl possible - despite your best efforts, no one compares. Before he dismisses your excuses, you quickly present a platter of gold coins, humbly suggesting this might somewhat compensate... The Sultan narrows his eyes with an amused smile, teasing you thoroughly before finally relenting.

Nayla thoroughly instructs the Sultan's concubines in bedroom arts. Adding their own improvisations, they collectively employ these techniques on the Sultan in a single night. 
He is thoroughly pleased with the experience.

Nayla instructs the Sultan's concubines in intimate arts while serving him herself - something she's always wanted to try! 
After finally satisfying the Sultan, she rushes back to share this extraordinary experience. 
"Honestly, what woman hasn’t dreamed of becoming his concubines?" she says, covering her mouth with a cheerful laugh. "Our king – both strength and size – is absolutely top-notch! The only issue, well..." 
She tilts her head slightly, glancing around before leaning in to whisper, "He doesn't care about how I feel at all... Of course, he's the Sultan – why would he care? But if he could just see me as a person instead of a piece of meat, the pleasure would be so much greater." 
"Of course, our king doesn’t need to consider anyone's feelings, so just one experience like this is enough for me. Thank goodness I'm not one of his concubines!” Saying this, Nayla goes on to share some palace secrets she overheard. Before leaving, she slips you a handful of coins, probably hoping you'll help her find her next prey.

Initially, the Sultan doubts Mahir's usefulness - she appears plain with roughened fingers and cheeks. But since you've vouched for her with your life, he nods approval. 
Soon, Mahir develops an automatically rotating bed for the Sultan... She returns bearing generous rewards while the Sultan? He's still enjoying his new toy.

When you release the succubus in the palace center, letting dark, sweet-coppery power flow unrestrained, everyone falls into momentary hallucinations - except the Sultan. 
He observes his courtiers' infatuated states with subtle cruelty. Intrigued, he beckons you to bring the creature before him, wanting to touch its oil-like skin and discover what generates such power beneath its mist-shrouded face.

Badriyyah brings her complete tattoo kit to the palace, providing the Sultan's women with stimulating tattoo patterns that quickly spread throughout the harem. This novelty satisfies his taste - though needles on the Sultan himself remain unthinkable.

You did not know what had happened to her in the palace, but clearly she—or at least part of her body—had been buried in the royal mausoleum.
Whatever she had whispered to the Sultan in her final moments had evidently planted some ill thoughts of you in his mind.

The Sultan is thoroughly pleased with [s1.name]'s beauty, appearance, and trembling body - as well as your flattery. He waves Fadia away to serve you, then immediately leaves the audience hall to enjoy new stimulations in his harem.

strings: Unexpected Visitor

Fadia seems to be experiencing a "guest" role at a banquet for the first time. She sits stiffly, anxiously scanning for hidden traps.
 She respectfully consumes everything you serve, leaving nothing, as if completing a duty. Only when you say "you may go" does realization dawn: could this truly be... such a peaceful, gentle evening?
She appears somewhat dazed, eyes unable to hide surprise, but instinctively obeys, straightening her clothes before quietly departing.

Fadia is surprised by your decision, then terrified - perhaps thinking you want Maggie to join for some cruel entertainment. Instead, Maggie brings desserts, tea, soft cushions, and several kind maids.
Once seated, Maggie compliments Fadia's beautiful hair, with maids enthusiastically agreeing... Soon, Fadia shyly but proudly shares her hair care secrets, her eyes noticeably brightening.
You quietly slip from the room.

Since you've already broken a Carnality Card, there's no reason not to enjoy its pleasure.
Fadia proves extremely compliant - no matter how you position her body, bend her limbs, or create shameful poses, those large brown eyes reveal no dissatisfaction.
As you indulge, you consider that perhaps this compliance is her greatest weapon: she survives at court not through beauty, status, or favor, but through a submissiveness the king finds uninteresting... As long as the Sultan maintains no special interest, she avoids a specially arranged death.
You complete this encounter, nothing more.

She lowers her head, exposing her slender neck, accepting this cruel command with the same compliance. 
From beginning to end she speaks only once: "Noble lord, may I close my eyes?" 
Your blade falls before she can. 
But slaves shouldn't make requests.

Under your interrogation, Fadia confesses. She quietly lies prostrate, exposing her long neck. Faris stands red-eyed with grief, rage, and helplessness. 
You opportunely place a Bloodshed Card before him: "This is just the beginning," you whisper. 
"Yes, just the beginning," he repeats in a deep voice, drawing his blade without hesitation. 
Avenging a hound, resolving to kill one's sovereign for a hound - is it absurd? He wipes blood and tears from his blade, looking to you with clenched fist: "I understand - you should too - this isn't just for Luna. For centuries... my family served this empire like dogs, tearing at whatever enemies each Sultan designated, but..." 
He pauses, shaking his head tiredly, as if further words were pointless. Finally, he meets your gaze, sheathing his sword: "So be it. When you need me... use me like a hound."
It absolves you from murder charges, but the woman who died in your home was the Sultan's favorite slave girl - serious consequences await.

5008155.title: Sultan's Message?
strings: Sultan's Message?

Fadia visits late at night, nervously clutching her black robe, claiming to bring the Sultan's verbal message for your ears only. 
Beneath her veil lies a swollen, pale face that has clearly been weeping profusely.
You can go yourself, or send Maggie to meet her
You might break a matching tier Carnality Card... perhaps.
Once again, a slave girl's fate rests in your hands

You ignore her. She hesitates, lingers, finally leaves your doorstep. Nothing happens afterward - the Sultan doesn't punish you, she doesn't do anything. Apparently this wasn't important.
Woe... what should I do...
Private Audience
Silent Witness
Feminine Comfort
Desperate Confession
However, you cannot break this Carnality Card

Candlelight illuminates her swollen eyes; she appears pale and extremely fragile. 
Before you speak, tears stream down her face. She wipes them awkwardly, but they continue flowing. Through sobs, she confesses: "I have no orders from the Sultan. I lied to you, lied to the palace eunuchs and harem overseer. Since the Sultan often sends me out, I told them this was another errand... You may turn me in or kill me, I deserve it... but my heart was breaking, I had to do something..."

No comfort needed - she simply requires a place to release emotions, to truly weep. 
You remain silent, watching the night sky through your window, giving Fadia all the time she needs. 
Eventually her crying subsides. She kowtows in gratitude before explaining everything in her hoarse voice.

Maggie is surprised by Fadia's late-night visit but approves of your decision to involve her - after all, a slave girl's midnight visit warrants the lady's attention. 
Maggie has servants bring pomegranate tea and water pipes. Through gentle persuasion, she gets Fadia to drink and smoke, gradually calming her. 
Since Fadia insists "certain matters are for Lord [player.name] alone," Maggie departs, telling her, "Don't fear - I married an honorable man. He won't harm you." 
Fadia sighs with slight relief before explaining everything in her hoarse voice.

This isn't a lengthy tale. 
Fadia first shows you a scar on her side rib, where someone stabbed her from behind. She explains it happened while performing rope-walking for the Sultan. 
You've witnessed this "rope-walking game" once - the Sultan forces slave girls to cross an extremely thin rope while guards stand below with raised swords. The girls tremble in terror, some immediately losing control, others falling to instant death... She was fortunate. 
Fadia explains the Sultan remembered her name after that "rope-walking" because he considered her obedient... but like all subjects, her loyalty stemmed purely from fear. 
Occasionally, the Sultan assigns personal slaves tasks unsuitable for courtiers. Recently, becoming obsessed with dog racing, he would thoroughly examine every conceivable hiding place on her body whenever she returned with his winnings... finding this amusing too. 
Then... he ordered Fadia to obtain a certain herb and deliver it to someone at the dog-fighting pit. She sensed something wrong but complied - not just from obedience, but for glimpses of Faris... 
"I never spoke to that lord alone. He knows nothing of my lowly desire, nor should he... I merely used his appearance, his voice, his character to fabricate for myself a man worth loving with my life - I simply wanted to see him more!" 
She breaks down again, unable to continue. But no further explanation is needed - you understand completely. That herb killed Faris's beloved dog. Fadia, acting for the Sultan, killed... Luna.

You grab her shoulders, whispering that approaching a man's house at night invites danger... 
She stares wide-eyed. For the first time, you read anger and hatred in those eyes. 
"So... you're just that kind of person too... What was I expecting? He must be the same..." 
She laughs bitterly, then closes her eyes, submissively accommodating your assault.
The Sultan disapproves of using his slave twice to break cards - it lacks originality

5008156.title: Path to Redemption
strings: Path to Redemption

Fadia desperately confesses everything, appearing utterly grief-stricken, guilty, and remorseful - as if ready to die for this dog if it would ease Faris's heartbreak. How will you guide her toward redemption?

Blaming Luna's death on an insignificant slave girl is such an easy choice. But this isn't truly an answer - a slave girl could never defy the Sultan's orders - even a powerful courtier like yourself couldn't manage that. 
Hearing your words, Fadia breaks into renewed tears, overwhelmed by your precious empathy and kindness. 
After composing herself, she solemnly promises that whatever you require, she'll help with all her ability.
You exploit this slave girl's vulnerable moment to instill dark secrets - she becomes seduced by this power and possibility. When she departs, her eyes have taken on a different hue.

You suggest Fadia seek confession at the Purist Order's church, where priests will provide proper guidance and cleanse her sins. 
Fadia dries her tears, nods, and departs.

At the Sultan's court, who doesn't struggle merely to survive? Sometimes to stay alive, she - even you as a powerful courtier - must act against conscience. You all walk a tightrope; without forgetting the blades below, how can you reach the end? 
Under your guidance, she recalls small moments of happiness, glimpses of joy, and tiny sparks of hope. She seems relieved, glancing back at your mansion before leaving with slight envy.

strings: Mysterious Note

Faris approaches you, looking perplexed, showing a wrinkled, greasy paper that appears to have wrapped meat. Written in crooked charcoal letters in the center: "Come to the dog-fighting pit." 
This might be a trap or a joke, but he asks if you'd accompany him.
Faris

Little Moon, Little Moon, come!

The dog-fighting pit bustles as usual. Now that you know its true backer, you better understand its brazen operation. Noble-run gambling establishments face heavy restrictions, prohibitive taxes, and strict rules - yet none of these constraints matter for the Sultan's personal venture. No wonder this pit has crushed all nearby competition... Other gambling houses might almost seem honest by comparison! 
You both stand at the entrance, neither wanting to enter. Just hearing the hounds' barking reminds you of Luna. 
After a while, Faris grows impatient. 
"Probably just a tasteless prank," he says. "Let's go." 
As you turn to leave, someone rushes from the darkness, thrusting a ragged bundle into Faris's arms before fleeing. 
That bundle... it's warm and moving! You pull back the cloth... 
A fluffy puppy lies in Faris's hands, barely two weeks old, covered in glossy black fur, chubby and healthy. Most striking is the crescent-shaped white mark on its forehead... 
Faris's hands tremble uncontrollably as he cradles the puppy, his face first brightening, then nearly breaking into tears. 
"Idiot, complete idiot... whoever did this, prepared this for me, is an absolute idiot! My Luna was the finest Saluki hunting dog, purest bloodline... What is this? A mutt! A mongrel! This fool knows nothing about dogs!" 
Then he buries his face in the puppy's soft fur, sobbing loudly. 
The puppy innocently licks his face. Passersby stare in bewilderment. Inside the pit, cheers erupt as someone wins. 
"Little Moon," Faris's voice is muffled. "You little mongrel, little mutt, little wretch, your name... is Little Moon."

5008161.title: Playful Little Moon
strings: Playful Little Moon
Faris brings Little Moon to visit. This sociable puppy has boundless energy each day. It carries a small ball, looking expectantly at you, hoping you - or anyone - will play with it.
Little Moon
Moon's Chosen Friend
Different followers playing with Little Moon will produce different effects
Territorial Outrage
Puppy Love Incarnate
A Song of Two Moons
Eager but Unwelcome
Feast For Puppy
Fetch Champion
Happy Little Moon

Lady Becky immediately bristles, tail raised high, hissing loudly at Little Moon. 
You struggle to carry away the defensive cat, but Little Moon seems delighted with this playmate, circling frantically while you hold Lady Becky, its tiny tail wagging furiously. 
Meanwhile, Lady Becky hides in your arms, continuously cursing at the dog - though unintelligible to you, clearly nothing pleasant - this vulgar muttering continues until nightfall, long after Faris has taken Little Moon away. 
Some say this jealousy, this fiercely independent attitude, is precisely what makes cats so charming... perhaps.

"Oh! I've always wanted an adorable little dog!" 
Maggie immediately embraces Little Moon, her face radiating a brilliant smile you haven't seen in ages. 
That day, Maggie plays with the puppy for hours, finding various toys and treats, speaking in childish reduplications. 
By evening, when it's time to return the puppy, you ask Maggie if perhaps you should get a dog too? 
"No... better not. The Sultan's game might claim our lives any day. At least people can seek their own escape, but a puppy... would just keep waiting and waiting if we disappeared. Just thinking about it breaks my heart." 
She smiles sadly, shaking her head, giving Little Moon a final kiss before returning it to Faris.

Mutton Stove seems quite interested in Little Moon. 
You witness this sheep and dog affectionately basking in sunshine together, while the poet himself snores nearby. They pass the entire day this way. 
That evening, after Little Moon departs, the poet shows you his latest work - this paper remarkably free of Mutton Stove's saliva and not impatiently eaten. 
"From little moon, to crescent, to full moon, 
each moon, 
is countless moons I've gazed upon. 
From me, to you, to him and her, 
each person, 
gazes upon their own moon." 
This truly is a fine poem.

"Ah, a hunting dog! Like Faris's hunting dogs? I've always wanted to lead a pack hunting like him, but they always bark at me!" 
Adila chatters while rubbing Little Moon's head. Then, almost immediately - Little Moon struggles and barks loudly at her. 
Adila feels terrible. She borrows your dressing room, working hard on her appearance, washing away any possible blood scent - but it's futile. The puppy decides, and Little Moon simply dislikes her. 
Adila leaves sadly, though this experience slightly improves her communication skills, having genuinely tried to befriend the little dog.

Jenna holds the puppy high, looking into its eyes for quite some time. 
"How adorable... Oh, I've just had an inspiration!" 
With that, she races back to her workshop, leaving you to entertain Little Moon for several hours.

Habib's eyes light up seeing the puppy. 
"The lady loves puppies, oh, I do too! Let me see how to pamper this little one..." 
He mutters while rummaging through the kitchen, discovering various treats like lamb bones and beef marrow. Soon, servants gather around Little Moon, softly asking what the puppy prefers. If Faris hadn't specifically instructed against overfeeding, this little dog might have consumed your dinner too. 
Afterward, Habib seems inspired with new cooking ideas; his oil-braised bone marrow and stewed leg bones prove absolutely delicious.

"Faris leaves you to care for his dog? That's like entrusting his wife to you!" Nabhani feigned surprise, "He treats dogs better than most men treat their wives!" Though joking, Nabhani appeared fond of the puppy. Little Moon and it frolicked around the marketplace, drawing female onlookers. Glancing at the women's compliments of Nabhani's charm, you figured out why the playful Iron Guard had to bring the dog along...

You steal time from your busy schedule to spend an entire afternoon playing fetch with Little Moon. The puppy follows your commands, happily running across the carefully trimmed lawn, eventually collapsing exhausted in your arms. You carry it back to its soft bed, where it unsuspectingly lets you pet its treat-filled belly.
That was a bone too splendid to have seen—and too big to carry between jaws! Little Moon dropped the bone, gave you a joyful bark, and grabbed it again as fast as it could!
You send someone to play with Little Moon for a day; everyone thoroughly enjoys themselves.

Poetry

Little Moon

Now it appears quite majestic, with the crescent mark on its forehead widening, as if growing alongside the dog, gradually transforming into a curved moon. 
"It can now assist somewhat with hunting, though naturally, it's far inferior to my Luna..." Faris mutters, his face betraying an indulgent, affectionate smile. He pats the dog's head, earning a series of crisp, happy barks. "It needs growth, needs training. If you have any opportunity to use it, take it along."

Without raising alarm, you cross the church's immaculate stones to find priests and discretely indicate the cultists' direction. The priests charge forth angrily; the cultists scatter. No one suffers the indignity of excrement. Excellent - another peaceful day preserved.

How delightful! You summon Badriyyah for whispered instructions. Then, posing as an ordinary believer, you cross the Purist Order's pristine stones amid enchanting jasmine fragrance and engage several high priests with complex theological questions. Your discussion attracts numerous believers, forcing the priests to offer increasingly elaborate explanations.
Soon, no one monitors the temple's opposite end. A bucket of excrement descends at the perfect moment, accompanied by thunderous laughter from the cultists. The entire Purist temple becomes a repulsive mess, cleansing waters spreading filth everywhere, soiling both faithful and priests alike. Fortunately, having anticipated this, you hid behind columns, avoiding significant contamination. Ha! Will the deity claiming to purify everything bestow precious grace for this? The mere thought amuses you beyond measure!

You summon Badriyyah with a superior idea. She and the cultists immediately perk up.

Though the Cultic God can only project into our world, projections work perfectly! There's already plenty of physical excrement - who knows who produced it!"
The cultists regard you with reverent awe, deeply admiring your talent for devising profane ideas.
Whether such admiration constitutes something positive remains questionable.

Following a hastily assembled yet remarkably effective cult ritual, cultists hiding behind the Purist temple completed their preparations.
Nearby, followers crossed crystal-clear streams flowing over pristine white stones, discussing scripture with priests—a scene repeated countless times before. Suddenly, innumerable locusts darkened the sky! They swarmed frantically, forming a massive, writhing human silhouette suspended in mid-air...
The priests and followers stared upward in horror as the locust-figure crouched, positioning its posterior directly above them and then...
A cascade of excrement descended with perfect timing as the locust swarm exploded amid your thunderous laughter... The entire Purist temple became defiled beyond recognition, with people covered in filth. You remained protected behind a column, relatively clean.
The scene proved so traumatic that several witnesses immediately renounced the Purist, turning instead to the Cultic Gods... After all, if a deity could not prevent such humiliation in their own sanctuary, how could they possibly protect their followers?

You can't help asking the woman why she's doing this. She chuckles wickedly, confessing she worships the Purists' mortal enemy - the Cultic God.
"Every single one of those priests lives in misery, then they forbid others from being happy - that's wrong. I just want to help them out. Everyone should be more joyful, since we never know when we'll die!"
You deeply appreciate her perspective. After brief consideration, you tell her you have an even better idea.
"Why not have the Cultic God itself contribute something substantial?" you propose. "Wouldn't that be more blasphemous, more entertaining, more deliciously outrageous? The priests caught in the desecration and those fearing similar treatment discover your involvement with the cultists! Their fury knows no bounds as they vow retribution.

strings: Cult Messenger

A Cult wailer stands at your door, claiming important business.
Everyone knows the Cultic God followers are evil, frightening, detestable, and sworn enemies of the Purists. Moreover, this mansion's mistress, Maggie, devoutly follows the Purist faith. How will you proceed?
Badriyyah
You can go yourself, or you can ask Maggie's assistance to receive her
You ignore this cultist, and she recognizes your position, never returning.
Invitation Extended
Uncomfortable Truth

She exudes potent exotic fragrance, possibly floral or medicinal. Seeing you, she smiles, "You possess those remarkable cards, don't you?"
"Surely you wouldn't mind using them to help our magnificent master spread earthly influence?"
You explain your limited knowledge of her master...
"How truly unfortunate. My master is the only deity worthy of worship, whom you might call the Cultic God. He brings followers ultimate pleasure and unimaginable gifts. Unlike that self-righteous Purist, he never imposes supposed morality on others."
Without awaiting response, she leans closer until her nose nearly touches your face.
"I'll await you here." She provides a note with a suspicious address crudely written in red, likely paint. "Bring a Sultan Card; we'll complete your task without payment - all for our master's glory."

Maggie and Badriyyah converse for half an hour; her face bears an awkward yet polite smile when escorting her visitor out.
Turning to you, she sighs deeply.
"Cult Badriyyah wants your help elevating their influence. She believes your Sultan Cards enable anything... She suggested - or rather explicitly described - numerous so-called pleasures that merely sickened me. But I understand, my dear husband, that for these cursed cards, you might need her suggestions... This isn't your fault."
You embrace her. Being understood and accepted - this indescribable warmth flows through you as Maggie sighs with relief, having apparently sought the opportunity to express these sentiments.

Maggie angrily reports that Badriyyah truly seems insane - she actually requested Maggie "take" your Sultan Card for her! She wanted to dispose of it for you, thereby enhancing the Cultic God's reputation! She even confidently assumed you, a government minister, would certainly assist because "he'll receive tremendous joy from my master."
"I refused, saying my husband wouldn't perform disgusting acts for that filthy deity. Then... she laughed loudly, saying 'well said'! Truly insane! She thought I was complimenting her!"
Thus devoted Maggie rejected the fallen Cultic God's proposition - possibly a blessing indeed.

Badriyyah holds the card overhead as followers pound the ground, walls, even adjacent worshippers' heads - "We shall fulfill it, revealing to the entire empire that the Cultic God's children accomplished this great deed!"
The followers surge away like a tide surrounding Badriyyah, apparently planning to kill someone matching this card's tier. But who? You remain uncertain.

Badriyyah holds the card overhead as followers pound the ground, walls, even adjacent worshippers' heads. They howl, surging away like a tide surrounding Badriyyah. How do they define "conquest"? How will they implement it? This leaves you deeply unsettled...

5008168.title: Fate's End
strings: Fate's End
The cultists have chosen someone - no, the Cultic God has selected this impure killing's target, and you can no longer prevent what unfolds.
The Sultan Card you gave the cultists
Sacrifice

Returning home, you find the door wide open, unguarded. You enter hesitantly, puzzled by the silence...
A piercing scream erupts - cultists pour from your inner chambers like a murky tide - they raise the broken Bloodshed Card, shouting the Cultic God's name...
Overwhelming dread freezes your steps; you dare not uncover the truth - but Maggie's personal servant falls before you: "Master - they brought the Sultan Card you gave them... they killed the mistress!"

You anxiously await news at home, wondering whom the cultists killed. Then someone knocks; blood-covered people laughingly present something...
A head - Badriyyah's head.
She still laughs, maniacally, staring directly at you!

Just arriving home, your errand slave races toward you, face twisted with terror after witnessing something horrific.
"The cultists - they've gone mad! They stormed the Purist temple! Many died, Purist guards fought desperately... but the cultists were too numerous, too frenzied - they tore High Priest Iman to pieces! Master, they carried the Sultan Card you gave them!"
You feel drenched in cold water, chilled throughout. Now, beyond the Sultan blaming you for employing cultists to fulfill your card, the Purist Order likely becomes your enemy...

Just settling into your mansion, you hear palace news. A Cult-following eunuch suddenly went berserk, strangling a woman favored by the Sultan... Reportedly, before being beaten to death, he shouted the Cultic God's name, producing the Sultan Card you provided.
You first consider the Sultan's punishment, then realize you've actually felt relief through another's sacrifice... This game has changed you, hasn't it?
Squandered Favor
Another Visit
Angel
Dreadful news arrives - cultists wielding your Bloodshed Card, howling and laughing, slashed [s2.name]'s throat... You find yourself strangely relieved. At least it wasn't you, right?

Hearing how you broke this Bloodshed Card, the Sultan's expression darkens: "You're exhausting my favor, [player.name]." He toys with his ring, watching you coldly. "Surely you don't believe you've gained authority to assign others to this game?"
Cold sweat pours as you repeatedly deny this; another such incident would certainly cost you your head.

Badriyyah wants more! She giggles, seeking a second, third card... But self-preservation prevents you from providing another. She seems disappointed, though her smile never fades. "Well then, let's reframe - not you providing cards, but me helping you. That works, right?"
She settles this unilaterally.
The cultists' ritual grants you disturbing insights into forbidden realms.

In the moment the card breaks, through the corpse's gaping wound and spreading stains, you witness a sublime vision: a divine angel unfurling wings, heralding this world's master's birth. You convince yourself - no, you firmly believe: [s2.name]'s death was necessary, sacred. Only through their blood could this stagnant world find change and liberation!

You suddenly feel yourself lifted skyward - more precisely, carried by an enormous hand. You struggle to turn but find your entire body wrapped in soft, warm, billowing pink skin. This gigantic hand raises you higher and higher...
A pair of immense, moist almond eyes observe you from the void, each eyelash like a tree, their inner corners white as whale bellies. Warm breath washes over you as the hand delivers you between house-sized lips... In saliva, a giant octopus-like tongue licks, flips, and sucks you... Apparently satisfied with your moistness, the hand retrieves you, holding your head while moving downward...
You pass two majestic peaks, across a vast pink plain that could feed an entire village, followed by a forest blacker and more lush than the Sultan's royal gardens... Then... impossible... wait...
She inserts you into her lower body.
Mucus fills your mouth, nose, ears, every orifice... You feel almost inadequate, as even your entire body barely stretches those firm, warm walls... Fortunately, the Great Mother Goddess shows mercy toward humble creations, toying with you briefly before squeezing you out with a soft moan.
You plummet directly from the goddess's loins.
Landing in your own bed. You awaken abruptly, drenched in sweat, with an ink stain mysteriously burning your palm.
The cultists fulfilled their promise; their manic laughter seems to echo throughout your home... Yet this twisted communion has damaged something within you - perhaps pride, perhaps dignity...

You scrub vigorously at the mysterious ink stain without success. Through feverish haze, you still hear her gentle humming. You sense that stroking this mark might summon her enormous face to your window again.
Beyond that permanent stain and your psychological trauma, she leaves nothing more.

The cultists' promised "date" finds you during dinner.
Reaching for a succulent lamb chop, a sharp knife suddenly pierces your hand. A special dancer appears beside you, her limbs gleaming blades, her figure hypnotic, each movement deadly graceful.
Guests and servants appear bewitched, continuing their eating, drinking and music as though nothing unusual occurs. Musicians convulse, desperately playing otherworldly rhythms, their bleeding hands unnoticed. This frenzied music and the dancer entwine around you, awakening desire while razor-sharp edges strip away your clothes and even skin.
Like a mating insect, she completes her pre-fertilization dance before joining with you... Those blades firmly grip your torso, piercing your spine, sending irresistible commands to your brain - provide abundant life essence to the female!
You cannot recall how much you ultimately yielded... Your final memory shows her insect-like removing your skullcap, harvesting nutrients for reproduction... The nightmare shatters; you return to the banquet hall - guests, musicians, your body, clothes, that lamb chop - all seemingly untouched... Yet you're utterly exhausted, a burning ink stain mysteriously appearing on your trembling palm, that "date's" sensation lingering so intensely you'd gladly amputate to banish it.

You scrub vigorously at the mysterious ink stain without success. Through feverish haze, you still feel those cutting sensations. You know now - caress this mark, and she'll perform that deadly dance of steel and flesh once more.

At dusk, when sun and moon crowned opposite horizons, the cultists delivered their promised rapture.
From some twisted realm they conjured a beast bristling with scythe-limbs that cornered you, your screams echoing unheard as you watched it sever your head. Through your tumbling vision, you saw it carving chest, loins, legs - piece by piece.
Yet strangely, no pain came - only a dull, maddening itch where the blade had passed.
Then the creature seized your severed member and forced it between your lips... Terror, shame, revulsion, nausea - and the pleasure you denied - crashed over you in waves.
It played with agonizing patience while you prayed the summoning would fail, that it would be dragged back soon. Why won't it leave? Please, just leave...
When consciousness returned, servants clustered around calling your name. They'd brought Samir to examine you, prescribing herbs to calm your nerves.
You raised intact arms, checked beneath covers that everything remained where it should, then felt overwhelmed with relief - surely just a nightmare... But the burning stain in your palm reminded you otherwise...

You scrub vigorously at the mysterious ink stain without success. Through feverish haze, phantom sensations of severed limbs still haunt you. You know - caress this mark, and the full service returns.
Beyond that permanent stain and your psychological trauma, it leaves nothing more.

You never suspected the cultists' creature would masquerade as your own courtyard's pomegranate tree!
As you passed with growing unease, branches suddenly lashed out and seized you...
What followed defies pleasant recounting. The tree violated you thoroughly, inside and out, before your entire household. It offered certain... outlets for release, but through no agreeable means... Your cries never ceased while servants tried desperately to help, only to be savagely whipped by other branches.
When it finally tired, it spat out a broken Carnality Card and cast you aside. You lay there drenched and deeply shamed, but... the cultists had certainly fulfilled their promise and made quite an impression.
A wet, clinging stain mars your palm, impossible to wash away - constantly reminding you of dark things, as if that tree lurks ready to ensnare you again...

The Sultan listens intently as you explain disposing of this Carnality Card.
"These cultists love summoning all manner of perversions, yet refuse to serve me - they despise the Purist essence in my palace. I've killed several to correct their disloyalty, but they truly fear nothing, not even death." He shakes his head ruefully, then grows wrathful. "Yet they did this for you."
...You try explaining such "carnality" brought no pleasure, but the Sultan won't hear it. He's convinced you enjoyed what even he cannot access, and this represents the gravest possible disrespect.

Badriyyah wants more! She giggles, seeking a second, third card... For your own survival, you absolutely cannot oblige. She seems disappointed, though her smile never fades. "Well then, let's reframe - not you providing cards, but me helping you. That works, right?"
She settles this unilaterally.
The cultists' ritual grants you disturbing insights into forbidden realms.

You performed sacred coupling for divine pleasure... The Sultan's Game witnessed this deed. In the moment the card breaks, through the splattered stains, you glimpse a sublime vision - pure devotees kneeling before the true god. In ancient times, a god was judged evil and banished for unauthorized world-alteration - now, through game-created stains and your vision, Their name will be sanctified anew, returning once more.

strings: Devourer's Hunger

Raw Material
The Sultan Card you gave the cultists

You wake in your barren home to find blood and flesh scattered across the floor, along with tattered clothing scraps barely recognizable as belonging to their former owners. Kneeling in the crimson pool, you laugh through your tears, knowing the Cultic God has claimed these lives.
Meanwhile, cultists flood the marketplace, lavishly purchasing meat and wine to feast every vagrant, beggar, prostitute, and vendor on the street. They join hands in circles, singing and dancing, praising the Cultic God's generosity while speaking your name with admiration.

You wake to discover your home stripped of valuables - gold, tools, ornaments... The newly emptied spaces marked with bloody trails. The Cultic God has taken them.
Meanwhile, cultists flood the marketplace, lavishly purchasing meat and wine to feast every vagrant, beggar, prostitute, and vendor on the street. They join hands in circles, singing and dancing, praising the Cultic God's generosity while speaking your name with admiration.

You wake to find your possessions gone - gold, tools, ornaments... everything of value. The Cultic God has claimed them all.

Badriyyah sips from a cup of black herbal liquid, claiming it both stimulates and serves as tattoo ink. To dispel your skepticism, she smiles and offers you a taste.
The flavor defies description - pungent, potent, spicy, even meaty. You cough violently, eyes streaming with tears, convinced this wicked woman is toying with you! Yet when you wipe your face clean and look up, the world has transformed...
The cramped, dim room now feels spacious, the cultists appear beautiful, and Badriyyah... she radiates a flowing navy-blue light identical to your own - the signature of magical power, a blessing from the Cultic God.
[s2.name]'s skin now bears marks identifying you as master. In cult symbolism, this signifies: slave.

His Faith Forgotten?
The Tapestry of All Things
You didn't request her services for your people, so she returned to her own business.
Maggie firmly rejected these blasphemous designs and was deeply offended by your disrespectful arrangement.

Iman gave you and Badriyyah a cold stare before leaving without a word.
Badriyyah shrugged innocently: "I told you Purists hate my work. Those foolish followers only know how to smear gold powder on their skin without a trace of artistic sense."
Well... you miscalculated. If the priests learn you've been consorting with cultists, you'll face serious consequences.

The moment Badriyyah’s needle touched [xiaochou.name]’s skin, the pattern—whole, perfect, beyond even her imagining—bloomed like a flower across [xiaochou.name]’s flesh… Such a canvas, so exquisite, was one Badriyyah had never seen. She danced in ecstasy, wild with joy, pouring her secrets, her magic, her very life into [xiaochou.name]’s body. The visions piled upon visions, endless, until all was pure black—and then, at last, [xiaochou.name] claimed them, sealing them away where no mortal eye could ever see.

As the card snaps, a painless, bloodless scar appears on your chest, transmitting ecstatic joy - in this game, the sin of world-rending stands absolved, even when potentially committed by a god.

After their deaths, a storm of putrid black rain sweeps the city, claiming many Purist faithful. And you... you suffer the same recurring nightmare.
You're caged, surrounded by numerous doors. Behind each stands, sits, or lies a monster. They glare hatefully at you for blocking their entrance to this world - their playground.
In some dreams, the Great Mother Goddess devours you; in others, pomegranate vines pierce your brain. The ending depends on which door remains when you wake, which monster waits behind it. You've become a plaything for these forgotten deities and demons, who have nothing else to torment thanks to you.
You desperately await dawn, growing fearful of rest itself, hopelessly praying the sun might never set again.

Is capturing priests victory? Is slaughtering believers victory? Is destroying the Purist Order victory? Or... killing Purists themself? The cultists surge into the Upper City with frenzied chants, that clean, flower-scented district, destroying and burning everything in their path - for your card has granted them this privilege, the same privilege Purist priests have long held over them.

The priests' disappearance alerts the Order and the High Constable.

You assure them these cultists merely research new tattoo patterns, drinking hallucinogenic herbs to design spirals and lines in their visions, posing no threat to the Purist faith.
The priests hesitate... so you adopt an authoritative tone from your position in the Order, delivering a pious, lengthy sermon until they yield and quickly depart.

You mention your wife Maggie, a devout Purist who generously supports the Order, always warmly welcoming white-robed children collecting donations door-to-door. After speaking, you glance at the overturned stalls and trampled food caused by overzealous priests, suggesting pointedly, "Such unpleasant confrontations might damage the Order's reputation."
Their expressions darken, and after brief conference, they leave the scene.

The priests weigh the gleaming coins with satisfaction. They came merely to create havoc and earn reputation as "Faith Defenders" among their leadership and followers, but their ultimate goal remains profit.
Once paid directly, their dedication to religious duty quickly fades. The priest bows to you before departing with newfound arrogance.

You casually mention that Iman, their High Priest, frequently visits you for tea and literature discussions. You deliberately note that Iman occasionally complains about impulsive actions by younger priests...
Your words prove devastatingly effective. The priests immediately shrink back, each trying to hide behind companions, dreading your recognition of their faces.
You graciously suggest they reconsider their approach: "I'm certain you're acting from the purest, most devout intentions, not for any financial motives."
They flee with expressions of grateful relief.
After [s4.name]'s dignified persuasion, the Purist priests finally depart.
The priests grow impatient with [s4.name]'s explanations, shoving this one aside to kick open the cultists' hideout door.

You tell Badriyyah and the cultists that while confrontation with the Purist Order is inevitable, the time isn't right. You fill their heads with "divine prophecies" supposedly from your dreams, together praising the great darkness before quietly escaping the decrepit building.

"Don't you want to summon something truly powerful and terrifying to humiliate these priests?" You present gold for purchasing premium ritual materials instead of continuing these petty provocations.
The previously aggressive cultists depart with cheers. Some even confidently claim that with such funding, they might summon the legendary Cultic God itself!

You tell Badriyyah and her cultists that while confrontation with the Purist Order is inevitable, the time isn't right. Your analysis is so persuasive that even the most zealous cultists feel light-headed from its complexity. Finally, you all praise the great darkness together before quietly escaping the decrepit building.
Through [s8.name]'s persistent persuasion, the cultists abandon their vengeful ritual.
No one heeds [s8.name]'s words as black liquid continues spreading across the floor, the hate-filled ritual taking shape.

Both sides calm under your influence, dissolving tension into nothing. As the jasmine scent fully disperses, cultists gather again around you with grateful eyes. Badriyyah, however, seems to have more to tell you.

Just as the priests decide to leave, cultists surge from hiding. Their hands covered in black ink, wielding makeshift weapons, they catch the unprepared priests off-guard, beating them thoroughly before the violence spills into the noble district...
The cultists heed your advice and scatter, but many are captured by priests and burned at the stake. Their bitter curses and dying imprecations linger in the air.

That day, the priests of the True Faith from Dark Alley captured sixty cultists, including their leader Badriyyah. Bound to stakes and burned alive - until the very end, Badriyyah laughed madly, filled with joy, as if witnessing world's end.

strings: God, Please Descent!

She generously offers you a chance to "share this joy," though you clearly understand that if you wish to stop her, now is your only opportunity.
Badriyyah

Before you could speak, Badriyyah drew close and took your hand, stroking the ink blot in your palm.
It had grown larger, now resembling a quill dipped in ink and flung across your skin.
"How beautiful it is..." Badriyyah gazed at the mark with fascination, "Like the sun, like mud, like an eye. This is my master's personal mark upon you. They carved one into me as well, but none so beautiful as yours."
She pointed to the large half-moon tattoo on her forehead.
"You are the Cultic Gods' beloved child, and you shall witness greater wonders yet."

Your mind holds no divine image - to you, They are merely a place for "exchange," where you offer blood and receive wondrous powers in return, nothing more. Hearing this, Badriyyah erupts in laughter, and when it subsides she says: "I admit you speak truly, but our master can do so much more than that."

You confess to Badriyyah that through repeated contemplation, dreams, suffering, and struggle, you've touched goodness's phantom, heard Purist whispers... Badriyyah's warmth leaves you, making you shiver involuntarily. She laughs with cold contempt, "Now you know - compared to our master, that thing is merely a perverted sadist, nothing more."

You suddenly grasp Badriyyah's hand, staring into this exiled demon's devotee. You tell her of the visitor in your dreams, that most pure and holy sovereign. As you speak, a phantasm of light and flame suddenly fills this dim chamber - merely hearing a name, a description, and Badriyyah is burned. Her face pales, making the tattoo on her brow appear even darker - yet her eyes show no fear, blasphemous curses flowing endlessly from her lips - pervert, sadist, tyrant, and more - until this brief vision completely fades.

You suddenly laugh - no fear, no grief - telling Badriyyah you have unveiled that ancient and immaculate deity's true nature - They have long since been worn away and maddened by endless ages! What purity, what perfection - nothing but erasure, destruction!!!
Badriyyah roars with laughter - so that's it! So that's it! The Cultic God's enemy is just such a monster! But ah, but - this world will be overthrown by it, scrubbed to nauseating whiteness, rather than led by the Cultic God into sweet eternal darkness - how tragic!

You smile and tell Badriyyah that in some dreams, you feel darkness's gentle embrace, have been kissed by evil's lips, held tight by the Cultic God's hands...
Badriyyah's eyes shine as she looks at you, seemingly more certain of her earlier assessment: "Embrace it, welcome it, dear [player.name], surely some most powerful Cultic God belongs to you alone."
Her voice carries dense enchantment, like phosphorescent flames dancing in darkness, "How many wandering Cultic Gods hunger to feed on your card game's power, yet none dare act... Heh..." She hums with soft laughter, flicking the Sultan Card in your chest, producing a long, crisp sound, " - You belong to Them... This was written long ago."

You grasp Badriyyah's hands tightly, joyfully telling her that an eternal Creator, supreme among all exiled Cultic Gods, once descended in your dreams, and in infinite darkness you beheld Their countenance - such perfection, such magnificence!
Badriyyah's hands tremble slightly beneath yours, her eyes filling with tears at this incomparable, magnificent divine vision!
"I knew it, I knew it!" She stares at you, speaking incoherently, "I knew it - how many wandering Cultic Gods hunger to feed on your card game's power, yet none dare act... because you belong to Them! This was written long ago."

Miracles? You suddenly laugh - exhausted beyond measure, sorrowful beyond words - telling Badriyyah you have long seen that greatest Cultic God's true face - beneath creation's facade lies nothing but a bottle of putrid, muddy, viscous ink. They would paint this world, devour this world, and yes, destroy this world.
Hearing your words, Badriyyah weeps, but these tears hold neither despair nor pain - quite the opposite, her lips curve upward, her face radiating unprecedented relief and joy: the god and Their believers alike have suffered too much, and what They intend to do is the same - destroy this world! Wonderful!
Without hesitation she grasps your hand, staring straight at you through her tears: "I knew it, I knew it!" She stares at you, speaking incoherently, "I knew it - how many wandering Cultic Gods hunger to feed on your card game's power, yet none dare act... because you belong to Them! This was written long ago."

Badriyyah stares at you for a long time, seemingly unable to believe you would side with those hypocrites. But you remain so resolute, so unwavering, that finally she spits hatefully and storms away in anger.

What could be more important than welcoming the Immaculate Purity's descent? Whether They grant the world grace or destruction... who has the right to question a god?!
Badriyyah is stunned by your fervor. She freezes for a long moment before laughing strangely. "Ha ha, ha ha...! Fine then, let us be enemies! Let's see who's faster!" After speaking, she spits harshly and departs with head held high.

Badriyyah cannot accept that you can clearly hear the Cultic God's revelations yet side with Their enemy!
She nearly leaps with rage, cursing you with every foul word she's ever learned. She even grabs your hand trying to scrub away the ink stain in your palm - but that's impossible. As she scrubs and scrubs, realizing this truth, she suddenly laughs again. "Ha! Ha! Fine, rest assured, the Purists can never compete with the Cultic God. Let's see what fate awaits you! Let's see if your god will save you!" She claps and laughs endlessly, departing with great interest.

Almost the moment you reveal your faith, Badriyyah begins laughing uncontrollably, tears streaming down her face as she nearly doubles over: "Wait, wait, what did you say? Ha ha... You worship that sadist? Ha ha ha ha!!"
She caresses your cold face, cupping your chin in both hands, giving you a moist kiss: "Wonderful, [player.name], I eagerly await when our sovereign, our master of night descends, to see how your broken faith can save you. I'll stay by your side, anticipating that day."
Faith has never needed reasons, and Badriyyah doesn't intend to convince you. She simply taps the ink stain in your palm and smiles meaningfully - like a blessing, like a curse - then departs.

"What is that to us?" She shows you her hands soaked in thick black herb juice, the cold liquid spreading across your brow and face as her voice becomes low and gentle, "I speak no words of blessing, we do not; for blessings always concern money, longevity, health and such things; but living in this world itself is a curse, so I do not bless you. I hope you rejoice each day, that tomorrow exceeds today in joy, that the third day doubles the second's happiness! Then, I hope you soon find pleasures worth dying for, soon escape life's servitude."
She studies you and smiles again, "It won't be long - wait and see, you'll soon escape those nauseating voices."

Silent darkness embraces and soothes you both. Soon Badriyyah calms down. Her hands work constantly in a basin of foul black liquid before she speaks: "Do you know about Aether? The priests guard it fiercely - it's very important... and I happen to know how to contaminate it. With luck, perhaps I can directly solve that thing in your dreams." She smiles mysteriously but refuses to say more.

You and Badriyyah together praise night's dark master, the strongest, most concentrated evil among the exiled Cultic Gods. She shows you her hands soaked in thick black herb juice, the cold liquid spreading across your brow and face as her voice becomes low and gentle, "I speak no words of blessing, we do not; for blessings always concern money, longevity, health and such things; but living in this world itself is a curse, so I do not bless you. I hope you rejoice each day, that tomorrow exceeds today in joy, that the third day doubles the second's happiness! Then, I hope you soon find pleasures worth dying for, soon escape life's servitude."
She studies you and smiles again, "The wait won't be long, be assured."

You and Badriyyah together praise that greatest destruction, that greatest ending, for you know the Cultic God will descend - no, They are about to descend!
Tears of happiness flow endlessly as Badriyyah kneels before you, excitedly grasping your hands, pressing her face against the ink stain in your palm. "Please let me become the cradle for the Cultic God's birth! This would be my greatest glory."

Your mortal eyes cannot see the divine countenance - no matter. Many cultists like you surround Badriyyah, and it doesn't matter. She smiles and takes your hand. She can see, she will guide, she will summon that great Cultic God's descent! When that time comes, you can all escape life's servitude together, sharing in that sweet and gentle eternal sleep.
