This extraordinary feat will become a Platinum... No—Diamond! No, Diamond wouldn't suffice! Cobalt, Titanium, Krypton, Aether... anything! Sultan Cards of unparalleled rarity will come into being, entering the game that plagues the world!

Responding to your call, Fardak draws a dagger. This blade, once bathed in noble blood and infused with potent magic, cuts through Fardak's own throat as its ethereal glow splits the inked void before you. "No need to hesitate." A gentle breeze nudges you onward. "Go now. This is the least I can do for you."

What are you anticipating from this reserved attendant, often awkward in manner? Suddenly, a sharp, clear whistle pierces through the clouds, accompanied by the cries of hawks and the thunderous gallop and neighing of stallions. You witness the inked mist enveloping you torn asunder, as swirling dust propels you closer to the sun, though the horseman remains nowhere to be found.

Inal, absorbed in her culinary tasks, remains unaware of your call! Immersed in her kitchen chores, she transforms bitterness from stems and peels into sweet ambrosia. Amidst her melodious humming and skillful handling of ingredients, the acrid essence within your soul is cleansed, replaced by a radiant luminescence.

You share this joyful news with Faraj, recounting your extraordinary exploits as you once did while seated on the carpet, conversing casually. Will he rejoice in your success? Will he wish you well? Will he whisper your name and pay homage to your journey? His response materializes in a solitary tear. It dilutes the inked darkness surrounding you, offering a glimpse—through a radiant halo—of the land you once dwelled in, now resembling a tiny insect trapped in amber.

You chant Their name—the old god who has fallen into Lamblet's trap, now a cornerstone of creation.
Their flesh scatters through the ascending passage, and from it, you taste fury—directed at you, yet more so at Lamblet who has long deceived Them! Driven by malice, a vast void materializes at the heart of the Ink Sea. The Destroyer has carved a path for you as They have done for eons. "Proceed, accursed mortal! Don't let that filthy sheep triumph!"

You chant Their name—the old god who has fallen into Lamblet's trap, now a cornerstone of creation.
Their flesh scatters through the ascending passage, and from it, you taste fury—directed at you, yet more so at Lamblet who has long deceived Them! Driven by malice, the inked realm parts before you. After all, this realm originates from the Corrupter Themselves, as both are elements of the Creator's grand design...

You have rehearsed this scenario before, haven't you? You understand the demeanor, the countenance, and the radiance that can distinguish you from the ordinary. Thus, you recreate that moment, exuding a brilliance that outshines all others...

Need Hassan's help? He is practically Lamblet's servant. Yet your trust—the bond—stirs the clarity within him. He remembers it all, every cycle... a truth no mortal can bear.
He shatters, scattering like loose pages to become every poem ever written in the cycles. Amid Lamblet's roar, Hassan composes his final poem to pave a celestial path for you...

You spare no effort in dismantling the old world repeatedly.
The fabric of this mortal realm is intricately and densely woven, rendering your violent attempts futile. The inked ocean crafted by the Creator always mends itself, rejuvenating to initiate another similar cycle...
Is this world truly unchangeable? Does life itself hold any potential for self-improvement? Perhaps these questions linger even for the Creator Themselves... Amidst this ceaseless, fruitless cycle of destruction and reconstruction, your ascension begins...

You hurl the King of Flames into the ink. Indeed, it embodies a mass of fury, animosity, and delusion... a seething inferno. It is targeting the mundane yet malevolent, unforgiving, and desolate world itself! The flames rip a fissure in the inked ocean—a fiery circle tearing the heavens wide for your passage.

Surrounding you is infinite ink, like mist and mountains, morphing into demonic forms, hindering your ascension. This is the embodiment of the sins and desires you left in the mortal realm... In this crucial moment, you summon Riel, and along with her emerge the spirits of ancestral chieftains! The warriors engage with the monsters, carving a way for you: "Begone, vile beasts! Do not block our city dweller friend!"

No call is needed—your unique sword has always dwelled within you. This sword of desire or being has never parted from you...
Now, at this moment of ascension, you reclaim it beneath you, merging once more with the whirling brass phallus of unmatched glory. Erected with pride, it unleashes a blinding radiance that awes and enthralls mortal hearts. Then, effortlessly, you break free from the inked mortal world, like a true god.

You call out to the stars and strike a bargain. Their light flickers for you, paving the way for your ascension amidst the corrupt darkness... In return, some stardust fall into your palm—in your own world, you would scatter them and let them witness your story...

You call out to the creature of the mirror and reveal the Creator's secret. It surges forth with light and crystal, erecting towers towards the heavens to aid your ascension.
No pleading, command, or bargain is needed, for the mirror hungers by nature for what it has never seen.

Who could be more befitting than a ruler unshackled by this realm to unlock the gates beyond the mundane world? In response to your vow, the queen begins to sing, weakening the barrier to the higher realm... Finally, with a simple gesture, the bone cage shatters. All your incarnations in this cycle disperse. This world can no longer hold you captive, and indeed, the queen achieves the liberation she has long sought...

You call out to Faris, but only his dogs come to your aid. Little Moon arrives with a swarm of affectionate creatures, licking and nuzzling at your palms and calves... Ah, now you comprehend and converse with them, for you are almost a Creator yourself.
It is then that you realize that only humans erect barriers within their hearts... and that only humans aspire to shatter them. At your request, the dogs lead you beyond the bounds of the mortal realm, until their influence can extend no further.

Habib, your unfaithful attendant... Could he possibly play a role in your grand ascension? You summon him, not so much seeking his assistance as issuing your final judgment upon him! He believes you are unaware of his intentions and actions!
Habib remains silent, simply kneeling to proffer you a bowl of soup... Instinctively, you consume it, and your non-existent stomach immediately churns violently.
From the first sip of milk at birth to the candied fruit you tasted while polishing the Dragon's Eye... every morsel you have ingested for sustenance during your mortal existence is regurgitated, returning to the mortal world below.
Before you can reprimand Habib, your weightless form ascends within the winds of creation...

Crafting a world is not as unattainable as one might think. Everyone holds an image of the world. Look at this young man. Has he not matured, evolved, and chosen to follow in your footsteps?
Recognizing this, you nurture the radiance within him, illuminating your own path to ascension...
To let the other self rise higher, you sacrifice yourself and blend into the radiance of ascension... Even to the Creator, it is a worthy offering.

Without hesitation, she constructs the pathway to your ascension with her own thoughts and soul... No explanation needed, no persuasion required, no call for friendship or emotion—all that is necessary are your words expressing the desire to explore uncharted territories, to behold landscapes never before witnessed.
You elevate the monumental work you have contributed to completing. Countless tomes ascend, intertwining into a passageway that guides you towards ascension...

Answering your summons, Samir arrives bearing an oversized bottle, a replica of the Water of Life. As the cork pops, clear liquid spurts out. The throngs of sins and desires, and even the inked realm itself, desperately reach for the precious droplets. Seizing this opportunity, you leap through the fissure, soaring higher.

Numerous hands reach out. Countless shoulders and backs offer themselves as your stepping stones to ascend. You have aided them, and they now willingly provide support. Ultimately, Raed lifts you up, fixing you with a stern gaze: "As you rise higher, never forget these willing souls who have served as your foundation!"

Iman does not pray for you. Or perhaps he does, but not in reverence, not to lift you skyward. The Immaculate Purity is dead; where does his grief and remorse fall? [player.name] is leaving—who will behold the scars etched into him?
"O God, my God, why have you forsaken me?" His prayer causes cracks to appear all over your form. To evade annihilation, you have no choice but to sever the connection.

"You mean to flee alone to some fresh, perfect, clean place... and to leave everyone else to suffer in this world? Lord [player.name], so many still care about you!"
Instead of coming to your aid, Badriyyah summons a legion of demons to besiege you in the tumultuous ocean of suffering...

Nayla, will you assist me in reaching greater heights and attaining more power? As this thought crosses your mind, the woman materializes beside you—her arms envelop your neck from behind, her warm breath grazing your ear. You sense the void beneath you where her embrace once lingered... Multiple versions of her, myriad illusions and memories entwine around you, hindering your ascension...

You recklessly summon an apostle tainted by the Corrupter. How dare you attempt to escape this realm inscribed in the ink of the Corrupter Themselves? Flee now, for the world has fixed its gaze on you, [player.name], and if you are not swift enough, They will devour you!

You called out to Shama, what was already yours. "Come! Kneel! Let your master step upon you to ascend the final stairs!"
Shama arrived, smiling, and in the path of ascension, she embraced you... The abyss! The root of darkness and madness, as well as the primal chaos against the Creator, rose from her shattered flesh. To avoid being devoured, you fled in blind panic. But alas, Lamblet was even faster!

A sudden pang of guilt hit—could you really leave like this? If you went to a new world, what became of Maggie? What of all the others who loved you? Through this game, you gained so much... but what had you given them in return? And if you drained their power here, what would become of them in the real world?
Hesitation. Conscience. A Creator should have neither. At the very least, Lamblet thought so. They laughed and seized the chance to surge past you.

Would this stubborn political rival help you, if you promised a brighter future in a new world? Too bad. He withdrew silently from this contest no mortal was meant to join—his strength was for changing this world, not some distant, next one.

What foolishness it is, to seek the power of annihilation amid the ascension of creation...
All things will eventually pass. The end is void, meaningless. Life is but writhing flesh. All creations will be forgotten. Surrender. Destroy.
You have to sever a part of yourself just to avoid being consumed by it.

You coerced the North Star into your grasp, commanding it to summon the stars and uphold you—the future Creator. The Highlord roared at the sky in ragged anger... Soon the stars blazed alight, casting upon you rays that were not lethal, yet enough to hinder you.
Lamblet laughed loudly and surged past you, telling you that the Highlord had just screamed, "This one is off to write stories where none of us can see!"

You once tempted the gods into sin—was that not a glorious feat worthy of praise? Alas, this evidence of your trespass against the world only tore open the path of ascension, nearly casting you back to the mortal realm... and widening the gap between you and Lamblet.

You once rewrote the world and planted subtle suggestions in the minds of gods—was that not a glorious feat worthy of praise? Alas, this madness that intoxicated the gods only conjured endless illusions for you, nearly casting you back to the mortal realm... and widening the gap between you and Lamblet.

Who defines right and wrong? Who distinguishes the glorious from the humble? And who shapes your very essence, blending water and ink in precise proportions?
You call out to Qais in the void, and he answers. Although he is unaware of the challenges you confront or the numerous obstacles blocking your path to ascension, he has faith in you. The ink parts before you, unveiling a new path for you to tread... However, as you step upon it, it crumbles, disintegrating into decayed mud, tarnishing you as you whirl aimlessly in the void... much like how Qais was led astray and tainted by you.

This thing could not support you, and it would not. In the winds of creation, it faded from your heart and returned to the mortal realm...
Quick! Dig through your pockets, memories, and heart! You had already wasted too much time...
The mortal realm, steeped in ink, symbolizes a boundless ocean of suffering... How much must be offered, how much borne, before the trial of ascension reaches its conclusion?

5010204.title: Self Identification
strings: Self Identification

You enter the void, standing alongside the gods... Lamblet erupts in fury—they never envisioned your potential!
"You know, [player.name]? You don't even exist. You are but a vessel I have crafted, a parchment reused time and again, a handful of sand molded at my whim..." Their words carry weight, striking at the core of your being... If you cannot resist their influence, only obliteration awaits.
To be, or not to be, that is the question.
You are keenly aware that every boon destiny grants you comes with an additional service charge beyond the marked price.
They have posed a question, and you must answer it.
What was once granted to you now threatens your very being.
This is a strike from fate itself. Meet it with equal strength.
Huh?
Stop This Sham!
How Dare You Turn My Servant Against Me
[player.name]'s Resistance Before Your Theft

How can you prove [player.name]'s existence? In despair, you dredge up your countless failures... Betrayal, deceit, humiliation... and the most despicable acts that have let down those who hold you dear, all in the name of survival. This is mere sophistry! Merely the inevitable outcomes of humanity's flawed nature, ha! This doesn't even deserve deliberate intent! You, and the mortals you represent, are simply pathetic!

Lamblet's words piece you like blades, cleaving you asunder in the void... At this crucial moment, a tremendous force seizes your ear, wrenching you away from Lamblet, filling you with acute pain and shame. You are a flawed human, loved by some and loathed by others. To some extent, this serves as evidence of your existence, doesn't it? Just ignore that lamb's nonsense!

You recall Hassan—it was he who introduced Lamblet to you! He must know something!
"Hahahaha! You know, he was my very first creation! With his awkward poetry and baseless court gossip, he created this story! The entire cycle!"

Lamblet may indeed possess the ability to manipulate all beings and wield boundless magic that perpetuates the endless game... However, you have ventured into their domain, and both you and Hassan have glimpsed the story's very beginning... Hassan assures you that he remembers everything: On that day, upon learning you were compelled to join in the Sultan's Game, he couldn't resist penning a poem, a rebellious verse... Fear then overcame him, prompting him to feed the manuscript to Lamblet, which allowed Lamblet to seize the opportunity, infiltrating [player.name]'s story!
Disputed by Hassan's claims, Lamblet erupts in fury! Seizing this moment, you distance yourself from them—this competition for transcendence is far from over!

Is this the truth? Hassan gazes at you in terror as you begin to fragment, like a marionette with its strings severed, a hollow shell patched together from a narrative torn apart...
"Don't be so sad. You see, when Hassan's talent eventually faded, I even borrowed some from you to grant him!" Leaving these twisted words, Lamblet propels your fractured souls into the void as it speeds towards the ultimate gateway...

You call out to Arzuna, your blood kin, entwined with you on the same branch of the Tree of Life... linked from the very beginning of the game, or so it should be!
Lamblet scoffs with disdain, "You see, every man carries a woman in his heart, and vice versa! So, after I created you, I simply extracted that woman from your heart, infused a touch of scandal, resentment, and betrayal. That's how I casually brought her into being!"

In some unknown, distant realm, Arzuna dances beside a campfire. Through the flames and smoke, your debate touches her soul...
Without uttering a word, she dances with greater fervor in harmony with the rhythm of life itself. As Lamblet, with their twisted words, attempts to shatter the tree housing [player.name]'s essence, you witness the seed named Arzuna in the distance has already sprouted a fresh bud of its own. Thus, despite the fading connection, you affirm your own existence... In the void, like another seed dislodged from its branch, you too, sprout new extensions, ascending into a higher existence...

Lamblet may indeed possess the ability to manipulate all beings and wield boundless magic that perpetuates the endless game... However, you have ventured into their domain, planting the seeds of defying fate for Ascension and yourself.
As if responding to Lamblet's disdain, Arzuna, through the resonance of blood ties in the void, imbues you with her fury and her refusal to surrender. It pierces your core like a blade, seeking retribution, affirming her existence, and sharing this determination with you.
Ah, just as a man embodies a feminine aspect within his heart, she too, holds her own masculine facet. Humanity itself is not to be fragmented or torn asunder! Nor can it be whimsically manipulated by gods! Empowered by the surge of boundless energy from the blade within your core, you initiate a further ascension...

Is this the truth? Arzuna gazes at you in terror, as a gaping void suddenly pierces your chest. Is this the fragment Lamblet tore away? And is this very flaw in your humanity the root of all past sins? Helplessly, you and your sibling observe each other bleed, strive, and diminish, like two separated pieces of flesh...

You summon Jenna—her creations still adorn you! Her craftsmanship and artistry are not playthings to be manipulated!
Lamblet erupts with laughter: "Her very existence springs from your soul's hollow craving to adorn itself!" With those words, the jewels burst into flames, their brilliance overwhelming your essence...

"No, that's not the case," Jenna's voice resonates from the jewels. "It's because you embody these virtues that you can master the jewels." She begins to recount the selection of each piece as if reminiscing over cherished possessions. Indeed, every symbol etched on the metal and every gemstone adorning it... they embody your choices and memories over a specific time frame. These are not mere superficial embellishments, but treasures amassed through your very existence. Realizing this, you once again absorb the jewels' radiance. Lifted by their luminosity, you ascend into the heavens...

Lamblet may indeed possess the ability to manipulate all beings and wield boundless magic that perpetuates the endless game... However, you have ventured into their domain, leaving an imprint for Jenna, and for yourself. Those blazing jewels merge with your soul, their radiance blending with your eyes, illuminating the path to ascension...

Is this the truth? Jenna gazes at you in terror, watching herself ignite like the jewels upon you as your form diminishes into a spectral silhouette... As Lamblet distorts reality with their words, both of you become lost in the void.

"Malkina! Malkina!" You instinctively call out her name as Lamblet's words distort your features, reshaping your very existence, for she has spent the most time adorning the reflection in the mirror, perhaps?
Lamblet lets out a sinister chuckle. "Hah! Her? When I created you, I gathered the leftover faces and melded them together, and there she was, a makeup artist to embellish others!"

As Lamblet tears apart your face, an unexpected turn of events unfolds: as your human mask shatters, the divine essence beneath radiates with a brilliant light... Lamblet denies your humanity, yet you shed this facade of mundanity and ascend to greater heights.

Lamblet may indeed possess the ability to manipulate all beings and wield boundless magic that perpetuates the endless game... However, you have ventured into their domain, leaving an imprint for Malkina, and for yourself.
Under Lamblet's influence, your face fractures, and Malkina splinters into a myriad of faces! Nevertheless, she remains unfaltered, selecting from these visages, reconstructing them, recalling the superior versions of yourselves... and directing this power towards your ascension.

Is this the truth? Malkina gazes at you in terror, witnessing shattered visage... She too fractures, transforming into countless faces with broken browbones, lips, foreheads, and noses... unable to maintain her existence...

If I don't exist, how can he continue to exist? And if he is real, how can I be false? When questioned about your existence, you summon your counterpart without hesitation...
Lamblet almost bursts into laughter: "Him? Isn't he merely a duplicate of yourself, created by me? Goodness, haven't you understood the concept of a 'secret twin' just to make your game easier? What a fool, [player.name]!"

Lamblet may indeed possess the ability to manipulate all beings and wield boundless magic that perpetuates the endless game... However, across those infinite cycles, were those versions of you truly the same person? Or did they become someone entirely new each time? And what about those twins who accompanied you? Did the same one aid different versions of [player.name] across cycles, or did they perish alongside their counterpart? You once struggled with this question, but now, you have inscribed this realization in the Tome of Destiny: Innumerable [player.name]s and their twins are a two-headed bird sharing one body! Just as the prophecy predicted, when one head eats the sweet fruit, the other is nourished too...
As this realization unfurls, the countless [player.name]s from infinite cycles merge into your essence, igniting myriad notions and unfurling wings to shield you from the void. Move forward! Taste the fruit of transcendence and achieve liberation! Liberate yourself, and let the countless [player.name]s bring this game to an end!

Your dismayed expressions mirror each other... Without the support of your counterpart, the very foundation of your identity crumbles. It's only now, in this bitter moment, that you realize your paths to annihilation are not entirely identical.

You mock Lamblet at their words, daring them to scrutinize you closely—even they cannot discern you, yet they attempt to distort your existence with their Lies!
"How can this be...? How... how could a mortal give up the opportunity for ascension, passing it to another? Even if it's your own mirror image!" Your ascended self and you speak as one, your divine voices resonating through both mouths. "Deep within the recesses of our souls, we are always one... but a lesser deity like you can never understand that truth!" With each word uttered, the gap between you and Lamblet widens as you dissolve into the brilliance of ascension, allowing your other self to rise even higher...

Although you are uncertain about what an innocent cat could possibly do in a moment like this, you boldly take him out from your embrace... Lamblet erupts into a mocking laughter at this sheer absurdity: "It's just a plaything! A mere stray kitten that I casually intertwined into your story! Yes, it was I who arranged the appearance of your cat! Just give up already!"

Holding your beloved cat close, you defy Lamblet's twisted words. Let them attack you all they might, but they will never tear you apart from your cat! Thankfully, you have long inscribed your own code in the Tome of Destiny. Lady Becky remains steadfast in your arms, allowing you to caress his soft belly... I've got my cat, and I'm caressing him, therefore I am. Isn't that the simplest truth? Gazing down upon Lamblet, the pitiful creature without a cat companion, you ascend higher...
With a resolute decree from Lamblet, they seize your cat, your essence, your dignity, and every semblance of superiority. Oh, just crumble in silence, wretched human...

Alas, you fail to find anything sturdy enough to withstand Lamblet's influence. Amidst their words, the threads of fate is relentlessly shaken until it snaps... Trampling over you, Lamblet ascends higher, leaving you stranded in the void.

5010205.title: Flames of the Void
strings: Flames of the Void

<color=#3F2A29>You have transcended the world woven from ink, breaking free from the Creator's blueprint! Now, you have entered true "nothingness"! Your form, your essence, your very breath... everything touched by this "nothingness" begins to ignite...</color>
You are now on the path of ascension.
What is protecting you? Their giving, or your trust?
Have they merged with you, or become mere consumables?
Come, offer souls strong enough to defy the void!
The shell that protects you in the void.
<color=#3F2A29>You must survive in the void and stabilize your existence.</color>

Just like in all your moments of distress, your wife envelops you from behind, shielding you from the flames and the void itself. Perhaps this is the safest haven in the world... Yet, you press on with your ascension, soaring along the path of elevation... leaving a trail of your wife's tears in your wake.

Ansuya stands ready to sacrifice herself for your great cause. Embracing her noble determination, you infuse it into the winds of creation... She fills this void with her own body and soul, shielding the flames from you.

Despite her flesh being ablaze and scarred, Zazie clings to you with unwavering resolve, her embrace tightening around you. "We're almost there, [player.name]," she whispers, holding onto you, urging you onward. "Look at the world below! See the staircase we've climbed! Every trial and peril... Endure this suffering, for you'll ascend to greater heights!"
In this moment, the flames seem less scorching. Has she bolstered your endurance? Or have her ambition and willpower permeated the void itself? The answer eludes you.

Will this mercenary, seemingly indifferent to all, be willing to assist you? Isn't he the mortal most tormented by nothingness, his soul seared deepest by the flames? You try to reach out to him, but there is no response... Eventually, you have no choice but to utter his true name: Sirshana.
A shining star rises, bringing enlightenment to the lost prince. Finally, he lifts his head from the intoxicating stillness towards the heavens... It is not him who shields you from flames, but the stars themselves, beseeching you to reveal their child the meaning of existence during your great ascension.
To reveal the ultimate truth to him, you bellow and thrust your chest forward, and the stars gleefully radiance, piercing the void for you.

Amidst the scorching flames of the void, Jenna's jewels begin to swell, resembling radiant balloons.
They hold within them the passion poured into their creation, the sentiments entrusted by their owners, the stories woven throughout their journeys... These treasures, cherished by humanity, gather around you, softly enveloping your essence...

Iman embraces you. Is it out of compassion, yearning, or love? From his wounds springs forth a surge of life force, emitting a boundless healing glow that outshines even the intense grasp of the void's flames.
How does he wield such formidable power? Is it through the blessing of the winds of creation or the lingering grace of Immaculate Purity? You will never know... All you feel is as if wings crafted from light have manifested behind you, propelling you to ascend higher...

The instant her name escapes your lips, a wave of regret washes over you. She takes out a steaming, putrid pot—her ultimate sorcery born from destitution, shame, hardship, and excrement! The inescapable stench of the human cycle!
However, as it showers down upon you, the scorching flames indeed feel less intense! Preferring not to dwell on the specifics, you ascend further with desperate determination...

You lead the tyrant of the mortal realm into an uncharted domain. Within the void, he witnesses countless distant worlds teeming with infinite possibilities... Fueled by his desires, he transforms into a gargantuan beast covered in razor-edged fangs and claws. Driven by primal hunger and an insatiable obsession, he charges towards the new frontiers ahead. And you, just like his former wicked courtiers, seek refuge behind him, hitching a ride on his fractured form.

Jabal is certain of his fate—to devote himself to a legendary clash, charging forth to carve a path to glory...
You call upon him, fulfilling his aspirations. He laughs as he wields his massive axe, his valiant determination effortlessly cleaves through void and flame.

Are you sure about this? Isn't the emptiness within her soul vaster than the void itself? Don't her ceaseless desires scorch more intensely than the flames? Are you absolutely sure you wish to summon her?
Yes, yes. Even within a woman like her, there exists a secret called "hope."
You bestow a kiss upon Nayla's deepest, unexplored essence... and it ignites an overwhelming delight. Tears stream from her eyes, warding off the encroaching flames.

As Qais sacrifices himself, the flames cease to consume your flesh, and no longer do screams escape your throat. You sense him being devoured bit by bit. Mortal flesh cannot withstand such prolonged torment, but self-sacrifice always sparks the most profound miracles.

If the void is defined by the absence of the Creator's touch, then what power can dispel this nothingness? Adila responds with her sword, its radiance carving a path for you. Does it succeed due to her essence? Her relentless pursuit of the ultimate truth? Or her undying determination? The answer eludes you, yet you are well aware that she has poured her all into this strike...

A mortal can hardly fill the void, as none of them are whole. You summon Fatuna, in all her diverse forms across countless cycles... those mothers, lovers, killers, and wives. Countless versions of her repay your shared bond, crafting an impenetrable shield against the void.

The world itself exists within the void. Thus technically, the void is omnipresent, compelling all beings to confront it with their very essence. Nabhani envies you for having reached a realm of absolute void! Here, he can allow himself to burn entirely! To illuminate the void and spare himself from a prolonged existence, evading the fear of an unknown destination... Thus, with composure and delight, he dedicates himself to you in this profound darkness, blooming for you, elevating you to greater heights...

Manar, in her exploration of uncharted realms, hears your summons in her slumber. In her dream, you both venture to the edge of the world together, and now, amidst raging blizzards outside, you must cling to each other for the last traces of warmth.
In the void, as the searing torment pushes you toward oblivion, you share the same vision—the tent, her breath, and her human embrace... These images grant you the strength to persevere and venture onward...

Under what circumstances do flames fail to vaporize a single droplet of water? You beckon Junah as if calling forth a drop from the vast ocean. She regards you with sheepish eyes, and within her gaze, you see the essence of all beings.

Jalila whispers in your ear, assuring you that the torment of flames engulfing your being is but a gift. It dawns upon you that all this serves as a foreplay to sublimation, where the present will transform into ecstasy upon culmination!
Does this mirage bolster your endurance? Or does your joy permeate the void? The answer no longer matters now, as you are already ascending to higher realms...

As you call out for Shama, a card bearing her image greets you, its back adorned with various labels: Male, Female, Bookworm, Noble, or Concubine, categorized by tiers like Bronze, Silver, or Gold... Manipulating these cards behind the curtain, she hurls them one by one into the void's flames, each card offering you a fleeting moment of protection. Eventually depleted of her own fate, she places a card hidden at her thigh upon your heart, then plunges into the flames herself, stirring the winds of creation to elevate you to greater heights...

You're on fire! Alim swiftly takes out a massive piece of felt... the most tattered, musty, and patched blanket you've ever seen.
"Come on, this is the only blanket in the doghouse! Only the youngest child gets to use it!" Alim grumbles as he drapes it over you, and countless fleas scatter in panic from the flames. Despite its miserable state, the profound human essence it exudes effectively shields you from the void... To escape the overpowering stench of the blanket, you muster every ounce of strength, ascending towards the heavens...

Upon hearing your summons, she seizes her quill without hesitation. When engrossed in storytelling, a mortal mirrors a god crafting worlds. Empowered by this divine essence, the ink-drenched bristles of her brush and the words she inscribes transform into a shield for you. Like the Creator's design, it carves out a small, secure realm in the void—exclusively yours.

Throughout history, the stars have chronicled the tales of the mortal world, using them to outline the boundaries of the void within the Creator's realm. At your request, a star gradually brightens, twinkling cheerfully as if lifting its gaze from a tome. In response to her plea, all stars begin twinkling for you, conveying starlight and stories to your side, expanding the secure boundary untouched by the void...

Guided by the bond of blood and destiny, Arzuna lifts her gaze from some remote corner of the world, beckoning to you. As the golden bells on her wrist chime melodiously, you reach out and clasp her hand. Stars transform into fiery embers, the universe into a guiding light, all of existence swirling in your wake, following and mirroring your cadence... Your dance extends across the void, crafting a stage before you realize it...

You grasp the essence of the void itself: It is not true "nothingness" as it originated from "existence," laden with the dread of existence. Is this truly surprising? Even in your mortal form, you resolved to shatter the vessel of void and apprehension, to reshape the world!
Confronted by your blade, the void unveils its claws and jaws—the form of a beast set on consuming and tearing you apart. Now, do what you do best! Fight the beast!

Sacrifice two mighty gods, using their flesh and blood to create a new world! As you break the Bloodshed Card, wielding its power to shield yourself from the flames of void, the very world quakes.
You hear the outraged rebukes of great beings, as well as the magician's ecstatic moan. Today, the collectors witness and record the moment before the Creator's birth, washing away the ancient humiliation cast upon Them by Their maker and the first of humankind. This becomes Their strength, and drives the game to heights never seen before. The new world will carry forward this grand game, with even rarer cards! This extraordinary feat will become a Platinum... No—Diamond! No, Diamond wouldn't suffice! Cobalt, Titanium, Krypton, Aether... anything! Sultan Cards of unparalleled rarity will come into being, entering the game that plagues the world!

Step through the gate of heaven and earth, and forge a new world within the greatest mystery! As you break the Carnality Card, wielding its power to shield yourself from the flames of void, the very world quakes.

Sultan Cards of unparalleled rarity will come into being, entering the game that plagues the world!

Responding to your call, Fardak draws a dagger. This blade, once bathed in noble blood and infused with potent magic, cuts through Fardak's own throat as his blood quells the flames enveloping you—at least for the moment. "No need to hesitate." A gentle breeze nudges you onward. "Go now. This is the least I can do for you."

You blow the keepsake from him. He, along with his kin, heeds your call. Each bears a share, willingly shouldering the load, enduring the searing heat of the flames. Like Aziz, his kin excel in endurance, particularly in your honor.

Her ancestors, those long-forgotten generations, had performed the same ritual for eons—chanting for the captive god in torment. You summon her and hear her hum: First pluck the aged leaves, then probe the deep green stems with your nails... Amidst this rhythmic song, your anguish eases.

You called out to Faraj—unable to confess your own fiery plight. You only told him of your ascent. "Want to hear of the splendor... and mysteries beyond?" Then something fell, easing your pain a fraction.

You chanted Their name—the old god who had fallen into Lamblet's trap, now a cornerstone of creation.
Their flesh scattered through the ascending passage, and from it, you tasted fury—directed at you, yet more so at Lamblet who had long deceived Them! Driven by malice, a colossal white path split the void. For the first time since creation, the Immaculate Purity didn't erase—it filled. Go, wretched mortal! Don't let that lamb prevail!

You chanted Their name—the old god who had fallen into Lamblet's trap, now a cornerstone of creation.
Their flesh scattered through the ascending passage, and from it, you tasted hatred—directed at you, yet more so at Lamblet who had long deceived Them! Driven by malice, a piece of pitch-black armor swallowed you into the void. For the first time since creation, the Creator sought to conceal Their work in such quiet secrecy. Go, wretched mortal! Don't let that lamb prevail!

Flames burned away the skin that marked you as [player.name]. But it didn't matter; someone had prepared a new shell for you, one fit for divinity. From the ashes you emerged anew, radiating a brilliance powerful enough to pierce the void...

Need Hassan's help? He was practically Lamblet's servant. Yet your trust—the bond—stirred the clarity within him. He remembered it all, every cycle... a truth no mortal could bear.
He shattered, scattering like loose pages to become every poem ever written in the cycles. Amid Lamblet's roar, Hassan composed his final poem to cleave the void for you...

Why fear the flames? It was the promise of a painless, costless revolution that you dreaded most! Seeing your torment as the price of the future, you burst into laughter and a wild howl!
In irony, as you embraced it all, the void quietly receded—lifting you ever higher.

The void's silver flames gnawed at your flesh. Soon, fiercer, gold-crimson fire burst from your wounds, cloaking you in the armor of the King of Flames. Oh... the void? No matter. My hatred, my fury—there was plenty left! Come!

You called out to Riel to witness the bravest of the city dwellers and your magnificent feat. She saw and marked your burning form. In the future, in the world you would leave, young barbarians venturing beyond their tribe would use sacred powders and silver fire to carve unique scars upon themselves.
Your pain and wounds were shared with countless brave souls, and this promised blessing lifted you ever higher...

No call was needed—your unique sword had always dwelled within you. This sword of desire or being never parted from you...
Now, at this moment of ascension, you reclaimed it beneath you, merging once more with the whirling brass phallus of unmatched glory. Erected with pride, it unleashed a blinding radiance that awed and enthralled mortal hearts. Then you effortlessly lit the path through the void, like a true god.

You called out to the stars and struck a bargain. Their light flickered for you, cleaving the cold void in the corrupt darkness... In return, some stardust fell into your palm—in your own world, you would scatter them and let them witness your story...

You called out to the creature of the mirror and revealed the Creator's secret. It surged forth with light and crystal, using every reflection of the old world to counter the terrible void.
No pleading, command, or bargain was needed, for the mirror hungered by nature for what it had never seen.

Facing the flames of the void, you opened the cage and freed the Queen of Jinn—could she help? She didn't have to perish alongside you, at the very least. The Queen smiled and pointed at the empty cage; only then did you realize the flames had already receded from you. The repeated flesh of yours burned there in your place, bearing it all. From your own ashes, you began to rise higher.

You called out to Faris, but only his dog came to you. Little Moon arrived with a swarm of clingy creatures, licking and nuzzling your palms and calves... Oh, now you could understand and converse with them, for you were almost a Creator yourself.
They told you, "Only mortals see this as a void! Smell closely—so many scents of the world, each a poem of creation..." Following the scents, you advanced in peace and rose ever higher.

Habib, your disloyal servant... Could he contribute to your great ascension? Hardly a call for help—it was a final judgment, and you knew everything he had schemed or done!
Facing the terrifying flames, Habib hastily pulled out two pots: one large and black for you, while one small and cute for himself. He used the precious flames to cook himself, fleeing back to the mortal realm with newfound strength... "Lord [player.name], we are even now."

You borrowed the [player.name] in his heart, the stronger, truer one who once shaped his inner world. This great teacher could burn and suffer nothing... If a spark ever seared him, it was merely a youth's fleeting dream.
To let the other self rise higher, you sacrificed yourself and fell into the flames of the void... Even to the Creator, it was a worthy offering.
Without hesitation, she cast her thoughts, soul, and all her past creations into the fire. It was like feeding old materials to a furnace, to forge you into something far greater.

If all things sprang from the void and would return to it, did humanity's endless gathering, creating, and recording mean anything? Now, you could finally test it—knowledge collected by mortals formed a shield around you, guarding your soul and carrying you toward a new world...

Samir tore through his bag for anything that could help you—spices, herbs, bones, and finally his own flesh—hurling it all into the flames!
The fire devoured everything and filled the void with an intricate scent, forever entwined with the legends of your miraculous feat.

Countless hands reached out. Shoulder to shoulder, people leaned on one another and sheltered you at the center like a woven basket. You had helped them once, and now each offered themselves, bearing the searing void in your place. Among them, Raed endured in silence, eyes blazing with warning as her flesh burned to ashes: "When you rise higher, never forget these foolish souls who willingly became your shields!"

Iman did not pray for you. Or perhaps he did, but not in reverence, not to lift you skyward. The Immaculate Purity was dead; where did his grief and remorse fall? [player.name] was leaving—who would behold the scars etched into him?
"O God, my God, why have you forsaken me?" The prayer nearly ignited your heart in the flames of the void—and to escape annihilation, you had no choice but to sever the connection.

"You mean to flee alone to some fresh, perfect, clean place... and to leave everyone else to suffer in this world? Lord [player.name], so many still care about you!"
Badriyyah held out a steaming, stinking jar. This was her final magic—poverty, humiliation, despair, excrement! The inescapable stench of mortal cycles! While you tried to dodge that filthy torrent, several flames seared your soul...

You must be insane to summon Nayla at a time like this! Whose hollow was greater, her heart or the universe? Whose flames burned hotter, hers or yours? Had you not severed the connection in time, even a god-to-be like you would have been reduced, like countless men before, to fuel for that insatiable void!

In your folly, you summoned an apostle ravaged by the Corrupter. A chiding sound rang out as a force clutched your hand. She spared you from the flames of the void, yet pulled you plummeting downward, as if through endless inky amniotic waters back into the womb that birthed all things... Run, [player.name]! Run fast, or a new cycle would be waiting at the end!

You called out to Shama, what was already yours. "Come! Kneel! Let your master step upon you to ascend the final stairs!"
Shama arrived, smiling, and in the path of ascension, she embraced you... The abyss! The root of darkness and madness, as well as the primal chaos against the Creator, rose from her shattered flesh. To avoid being devoured, you fled in blind panic. But alas, Lamblet was even faster!

A sudden pang of guilt hit—could you really leave like this? If you went to a new world, what became of Maggie? What of all the others who loved you? Through this game, you gained so much... but what had you given them in return? And if you drained their power here, what would become of them in the real world?
Hesitation. Conscience. A Creator should have neither. At the very least, Lamblet thought so. They laughed and seized the chance to surge past you.

Would this stubborn political rival help you, if you promised a brighter future in a new world? Too bad. He withdrew silently from this contest no mortal was meant to join—his strength was for changing this world, not some distant, next one.

What foolishness it is, to seek the power of annihilation amid the ascension of creation...
All things will eventually pass. The end is void, meaningless. Life is but writhing flesh. All creations will be forgotten. Surrender. Destroy.
You have to sever a part of yourself just to avoid being consumed by it.

You coerced the North Star into your grasp, commanding it to summon the stars and uphold you—the future Creator. The Highlord roared at the sky in ragged anger... Soon the stars blazed alight, casting upon you rays that were not lethal, yet enough to hinder you.
Lamblet laughed loudly and surged past you, telling you that the Highlord had just screamed, "This one is off to write stories where none of us can see!"

You once tempted the gods into sin—was that not a glorious feat worthy of praise? Alas, this evidence of your trespass against the world only tore open the path of ascension, nearly casting you back to the mortal realm... and widening the gap between you and Lamblet.

You once rewrote the world and planted subtle suggestions in the minds of gods—was that not a glorious feat worthy of praise? Alas, this madness that intoxicated the gods only conjured endless illusions for you, nearly casting you back to the mortal realm... and widening the gap between you and Lamblet.

With Qais's willing sacrifice, flames engulfed his body. A breach tore open in his melting form, revealing the vast hollow in his soul. It was too late to retreat! The fire surged with insane intensity, scorching your unguarded spirit.

This was the void. The emptiness. Only true meaning could fill it, satisfy it, and ease your pain.
Quick! Dig through your pockets, memories, and heart! The silver blaze was still consuming you!

What was burning you? The hunger of nothingness for being—or its denial?
How much must be offered, how much borne, before the trial of ascension reached its end?

5010206.title: Winds of Creation
strings: Winds of Creation

<color=#3F2A29>You are nearing the end. The wind toward a new world grows ever fiercer... No longer can you rely on arms or wings alone—you must hoist your sails and ride the force of creation.</color>
You are now on the path of ascension.
What divine hands and eyes could forge this?
Could one glimpse the sparks of its forging on the mortal horizon?
Will your work smile when seeing itself?
Proof of Power
<color=#3F2A29>Extract the essence of your heart, shape the laws of creation, and prove your dominion.</color>
<color=#3F2A29>Who or what can serve you?</color>

You called out Maggie's name. Drawing on your memory, the essence of her soul, and near-Creator power, you shaped a primal law—a compass of right and wrong, a will unshakable in goodness.
Through this law, you could untangle chaos, cleanse the murk... and give your creations the chance to perfect themselves and the world. The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You called out Ansuya's name, telling her the destined moment had arrived. For a greater cause, she sacrificed herself without hesitation. Her body, soul, and suffering all vanished into the winds, leaving a few undying embers. It was a force of destruction and despair, yet it also shone as a symbol of unending hope and significance.
Through this law, you could grant a final mercy to the old and open a way for the new. The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

Without a shred of mercy, you summoned Zazie. Wielding near-Creator power, you replayed her life, her story, her desires, and even the ecstasy you shared like molten gold in your palms—hammering, folding, and carving—until a law emerged, fierce enough to shape the world itself. It was a nature eternal, a force tempered to endure, yet also a seed of chaos, greed, and conflict. The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You tried to distill the nameless mercenary into a single law, but failed. In the end, you uncovered the self he had buried: the Prince of the Stars, Sirshana.
From a distant world, starlight flickered and lent you its strength to complete this radiant yet secret work.
It was the law of exile, concealment, and oblivion—meant to veil the world's secrets, even as it etched them into fate. For this was also the law of destiny and self, marking what mattered most. The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You lifted one of Jenna's works, stripping it back to raw minerals and replaying its forging. Drawing her will within this work and near-Creator power, you shaped a primal law.
That was the force of choice and change—through it, you could refine your world, though at the cost of forsaking or destroying certain things. This law excelled at breaking even the most unyielding of forms. The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You tried to peel away Iman's wounds—not just to extract his essence, but to ease his suffering. Yet to some extent, he resisted your changes in this sacred process; the wounds remained, though dulled and softened, and all you gained were shattered scabs.
Brimming with Iman's life and the Immaculate Purity's lingering power, these scabs still embodied a law. You grasped them, savoring their weight... It was the force of sacrifice, healing, and silence that could veil all—something destined for the world you were about to create.

You summoned Badriyyah. Like all deities, you demanded her life and soul, and she offered herself willingly. What could you distill from her flesh and blood? Ecstasy? Corruption? Freedom? Oh... all of it vanished into the void, leaving only a single tear at the end.
It was the law of grief, despair, and mercy, giving voice to the abandoned, the broken, and the destroyed. It would etch the memory of the fading into the world—something destined for your hand.

Even him... you had to use him too? There was no choice—this was the most potent soul in your memory.
Transforming him proved beyond imagination; the great monarch would never allow anyone to define or condense him! You soothed him, "Ah, Your Majesty, in the new world, you will merge with all things."
With a terrifying grin, he dissolved into mist, then reformed in your hands as a formidable law: the law of wrath, dread, and war, bending the weak to the strong without bloodshed. Wielding this law, you would raise your own herd in the new world.

When you summoned him not for battle or adventure, Jabal betrayed a trace of disappointment. You told him that through this ascension, he would become the vanguard of vanguards, leading countless warriors down the path of adventure.
He accepted gladly, handing over his armor, battle-axe, and blood into your hands. Wielding near-Creator power, you shaped a primal law. It was the force of expedition, adventure, courage, and chance, strong enough to set all things in motion—whether warriors venturing afar, insects in nuptial flight, or seeds drifting away. The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You lifted Nayla, examining her through the eyes of a Creator. Brilliant... you took her singular flaw, preparing to reuse this design in future creations. Because of this imperfection, all things would remain unsatisfied and forever carry the hope of being made whole. The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

Ah, Qais, he trusted you, baring his tender self. But you took the other side of him and shaped it into a law strong enough for the act of creation. With this resilience, even individuals could stand against the world, guarding the selves they cherished... And equally, it contained a seed of transformation, rebirth, and decay.
The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You began to process Adila, extracting her essence with near-Creator power, yet she treated it as nothing more than another challenge. When her will crystallized into a law, you could wield it to mold all things. That was the fate of trial—and the strength to endure it.
The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You distilled Fatuna, deepening her intoxicating essence. What overflowed in the chalice was a law all desired but feared—a force to nourish, ferment, and corrupt. Through this law, you could craft a cradle that gave life, or crush the weak within it... The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You called out Nabhani's name. Drawing on your memory, the essence of his soul, and near-Creator power, you shaped a primal law. Through it, you could make flowers wither for the sake of fruits, compel courting birds to grow dazzling tails, and command fish to surrender eggs to the tides... The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You called out Manar's name, weaving her will and traces across the earth into a law—tough as rope, yet smooth as silk. That was a law of distance and space, one you could use to shape a vast world—and, more importantly, to awaken in beings the longing for it. The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You called out Junah's name. One droplet responded at first, then surged endless, unmeasurable tides. No forging or weaving was needed; this was one of the primal laws required to create a world. The power of all living beings was tiny as a droplet, raging as a tide, or still as the ocean. You captured a single crest, carrying Junah and all life toward a new world. The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You took a crimson whip-mark from Jalila and shaped it into a brush for creation. It was a law that entwined punishment with reward, and pain with peace. No being could ever see through your design, yet all feared your will even more. You could impose the harshest trials on your most cherished creation, or strip the greatest "self" from those who possessed the most. Thus, the world bowed to you. The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You distilled Shama's radiant visage and soul with near-Creator power, shaping a primal law potent enough for world creation. With it, you infused all existence with impermanence—sorrow of parting, joy of reunion, the birth of life, the unforeseen in creation, and even yourself! Where would destiny truly end? You swallowed the answer with a smile, letting the winds of creation lift you ever higher.

You called out to Alim, but this sly man hid, pretending not to hear your summons! In a flash of anger, you stripped away his disguise. Stirred by the winds of creation and honed by your divine power, a great and hidden law was born.
It was the way of endurance, humility, tolerance, and wisdom. The winds of creation howled, muffling Alim's complaints and lifting you ever higher.

You called out Lumera's name. Drawing on your memory, her soul, and near-Creator power, you shaped a primal law. Though it, you dictated the order of seeds and fruits, of fortune and misfortune, and of virtue and vice. This allowed the weak to taste revenge, while also giving them ever more excuses for their frailty.
The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

At your call, a star awoke, radiating delight as she shared her insight: "Language is the bedrock of civilization, and books the ladder of progress." Hurry—pour more desire to express into all souls, so she might have more volumes to read! With a smile, you wove her wish together with your near-Creator power into this law. It was a light to cleanse all beings, revealing not only the wonders within their hearts but the ways to express them. Determined to place this light on the orbit closest to the world, you rode the winds of creation upward.

You called out to Arzuna. She was already gone, yet the fragile thread between you remained in your grasp. You pulled and pulled, shaping this endless tie with near-Creator power into a law fit for world creation. It was the way of connection and continuance—what kept the world whole when all things drifted apart. The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You infused every created soul with the spirit of defiance and courage. It drove ewes to fight lions for their lambs, fish to swim against the tides to spawn, the lowly to slay rulers, and filthy hands to topple divine statues. Yet, it also erased all labor for peace, birthing endless conflict.
The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

To win this race, you turned to an evil power that was never yours. As you snapped the Bloodshed Card and let it melt into the winds of creation, the whole world trembled.
You heard the outraged rebukes of great beings, as well as the magician's ecstatic moan. Today, the collectors witnessed and recorded the moment before the Creator's birth, washing away the ancient humiliation cast upon Them by Their maker and the first of humankind. This became Their strength, and drove the game to heights never seen before.
A law sank into your soul, ready to take form in the new world you create. It was the way of battle, bloodshed, and extinction—the fallen nature of life itself. From this moment on, killing would no longer be merely for survival... You would forge a crueler world, and your creations would rise stronger for it.

To win this race, you turned to an evil power that was never yours. As you snapped the Carnality Card and let it melt into the winds of creation, the whole world trembled.
You heard the outraged rebukes of great beings, as well as the magician's ecstatic moan. Today, the collectors witnessed and recorded the moment before the Creator's birth, washing away the ancient humiliation cast upon Them by Their maker and the first of humankind. This became Their strength, and drove the game to heights never seen before.
A law sank into your soul, ready to take form in the new world you create. It was the way of indulgence, lust, and greed—the fallen nature of life itself. Oceans surged, peaks heaved, and life multiplied without restraint, pursuing desires beyond necessity. This world was destined to be wilder, harsher, and more vibrant...

To win this race, you turned to an evil power that was never yours. As you snapped the Extravagance Card and let it melt into the winds of creation, the whole world trembled.
You heard the outraged rebukes of great beings, as well as the magician's ecstatic moan. Today, the collectors witnessed and recorded the moment before the Creator's birth, washing away the ancient humiliation cast upon Them by Their maker and the first of humankind. This became Their strength, and drove the game to heights never seen before.
A law sank into your soul, ready to take form in the new world you create. It was the way of confusion, emptiness, and deviation—the fallen nature of life itself. Your creations were fated to go astray, patching a world torn by their own hands with futile constructs... a practice for the Creator to be.

To win this race, you turned to an evil power that was never yours. As you snapped the Conquest Card and let it melt into the winds of creation, the whole world trembled.
You heard the outraged rebukes of great beings, as well as the magician's ecstatic moan. Today, the collectors witnessed and recorded the moment before the Creator's birth, washing away the ancient humiliation cast upon Them by Their maker and the first of humankind. This became Their strength, and drove the game to heights never seen before.
A law sank into your soul, ready to take form in the new world you create. It was the way of triumph, domination, and oppression—the fallen nature of life itself. Be it towering mountains or vast plains, idols or taboos, your living beings would one day conquer them... Though, perhaps, that too was an odd delight.

You called out to Fardak, and with near-Creator power, distilled the toughest part of his soul into a law. By this law, the grass learned to weather storms, and the seeds managed to withstand the bitter cold. It was the way for the weak to survive and struggle against oppression; yet, before hope arrived, it often only led to harsher trials. Amid a quiet sigh, the winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You called out to Aziz. Would your former slave serve as your tool? A flicker of resistance met you; at the very moment you left the world, he chose freedom! Amid this struggle, you drew from him the remnants of chains and contracts, forging them into a brand-new law.
It was the law of dominion, control, and understanding. If you became a Creator, would you use this power to shepherd your flock as you commanded Aziz? Would you grant them freedom? Embrace them as family? Or... perhaps place the chains into their own hands? As your thoughts swirled, the winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You drew inspiration and power from Inal's secret bloodline. It was the law of focus, joy, and rapture—echoing in the songs women hummed as they worked, and in the visions induced by the shamans' potions. The subtle force linked thought, action, and reality, serving as a wellspring of all magic and belief. The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You wielded near-Creator power to temper Faraj's soul, forging its essence into a primal law fit for world creation. It was the force of ideals, pursuit, and dreams—allowing you to sketch perfect blueprints for all things, while every being was free to render their own inner perfection. The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You chanted Their name—the old god who had fallen into Lamblet's trap, now a cornerstone of creation.
Their flesh scattered through the ascending passage, and from it, you tasted fury—directed at you, yet more so at Lamblet who had long deceived Them!
"Do you still wish to guard or mend the world? Will you still grant me a chance to correct my missteps, and together shape that perfect world?" Answering this final call, the last remnants of flesh, will, and power flowed on the winds of creation into your hands and coalesced into a lump of chalk... The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You chanted Their name—the old god who had fallen into Lamblet's trap, now a cornerstone of creation.
Their flesh scattered through the ascending passage, and from it, you tasted fury—directed at you, yet more so at Lamblet who had long deceived Them!
"Do you still wish to keep writing? To leave your strokes in the new world?" For any Creator, this was never a question. The last remnants of flesh, will, and power flowed on the winds of creation into your hands and coalesced into a precious bottle of ink, carrying you ever higher.

Malkina had long left her essence within you, knowing you were destined to rise to supreme divinity. You drew her adornments, thoughts, and intellect, weaving them with near-Creator power into a primal law: the force of perfection, transformation, and disguise. Once, Malkina had used to beautify mortals; now, you would use it to refine the entire world. The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You snatched Hassan back from Lamblet! They shrieked in a fury, trying to reclaim their slave by wielding fate, curses, lies, and all those lassos and hooks. But with the winds of creation and your power, your poet friend wove himself, all existence, and every cycle of reincarnation into a single poem. In your hands, that poem became a primal law for world creation. It was the power of metaphor, mimicry, and implication; in a mighty world, it was magic, while in a serene world, it became art. The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

With near-Creator power and the ambition and resolve to reshape the world, you forged a formidable tool—the primal law to create the new and also to destroy the old. Even the great architects of creation cast glances your way, wary of your misuse of this force yet curious what might happen if it touched the old world.
No matter—this was the power to bring forth a new world. You raised it high, riding the winds of creation upward.

You tossed the garment of the King of Flames into the winds. Drinking in the power of creation, it swelled, blazed, and finally took form as an enraged god. You might not fully command Them, but you could guide this destructive power to rend heaven and earth. Perhaps, once your design was complete, Their wrath would smash through the cosmos... But for now, at least, They were carrying you ever higher.

You attempted to process Riel, but her nature resisted all molding! So you preserved that wildness, turning it into a law in your grasp. It was the root that eroded walls, the sand that buried ruins, and the beast that refused the bait. By this, your creations would never reach perfection but gain a spark of charm... The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

No call was needed—your unique sword had always dwelled within you. This sword of desire or being never parted from you...
Now, at this moment of ascension, you reclaimed it beneath you, merging once more with the whirling brass phallus of unmatched glory. Erected with pride, it erupted with a law capable of shaking the world! That was the limit of power, yet also the power that let all things surpass it, pursuing light through destruction. This ruthless resolve stirred the winds of creation, lifting you ever higher.

You called out to the stars and struck a bargain. They sparkled and pierced the void's darkness, spilling stardust into your grasp. This was the power the previous Creator had entrusted to the stars—a law of time and record, where the record itself bore witness to the passage of time. To extend this record into the new world, the starlight stirred the winds of creation, lifting you ever higher.

Your thoughts reflected the creature, like one mirror facing another. Drawing on the infinite echoes and near-Creator power, you shaped a primal law of recording, understanding, and embracing. Through it, your creations would be remembered, as the line between being and memory would blur... The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You asked the Queen of Jinn for a glimpse of her secret... But the moment you freed her, she slipped away, leaving only a cage ablaze in her wake. Through her magic, the world-shaping force seeped, drop by drop, from your past corpse. This was the law of death and rebirth, woven with the very secret of immortality. The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You yanked at Faris's soul, bringing a tangled wake of dogs, horses, and riders into the light. You shook off their mortal shells, clutching only the raw bonds they shared. Under your near-Creator power, a law of creation took form. It was the shared instinct of the pack, the rhythmic pulse of the flock, and the collective ecstasy of the mob. Through this law, you could command the many with one and fold the many back into one. The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You snatched all Habib's aged broths, yeast, and spice! From his hoarded treasures, you distilled a law that bordered on magic. It was the force of change and harmony, capable of shifting the essence of one creation into another. Yet it was a cruel law too, hinting that all things would devour each other in the quest for ultimate perfection. The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You took something from Zaki—not him entirely, but the version of himself he longed to be. Drawing on near-Creator power, you forged it into a law. It was the force of growth and imitation, allowing you to shape a creation into the form you envisioned—but it also hid the temptation to break those very bounds.
The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You offered yourself as a blueprint for creation. It was a law of backup, replication, and reflection... yet one that carried the promise of self-discovery for all. Using it, you embraced mistakes even as they were doomed to repeat. Amid this intricate rhythm, the winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You called out to Mahir and drew from her soul a crucial fragment. With your near-Creator power, you forged it into a law—a force of calculation, measurement, and observation, a keyhole left for truth itself. It allowed your creations to grasp the world around them, perceive your intricate designs, and even glimpse the essence of reality—though you wrapped that essence in computations mortals could hardly fathom. As the final formula took form, the winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You summoned rationality—but it served as only a prelude, framework, or method. That was the law of selection and inclusion, and of culling and forgetting. With this power, you would decide what deserved to exist and what was fated to fade... for your record was the world itself.
The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You called out to Samir and, with near-Creator power, folded his soul, skills, and very life into a law fit for world creation. It was the force that mended broken lifelines, and rewrote shattered fates, endeavors, and wills... The winds of creation rose, lifting you ever higher.

You called out to Raed, and to all who trusted you two and would give everything. She still stood before them, confronting your divine power with her final challenge. From her voice and gaze, you drew that will and forged it into a law fit for world creation. It was the force of rallying and defiance, the last cry of the weak, and the light that endured even in adversity. With your spirit inspired, the winds of creation lifted you ever higher.

You called out to Iman, but only a frail prayer answered: The Immaculate Purity was dead; where did his grief and remorse fall? [player.name] was leaving—who would behold the scars etched into him? "O God, my God, why have you forsaken me?"
Amid this trembling inquiry, the winds of creation slipped through the hollow of his soul. You had no choice but to sever the connection immediately.

You summoned Badriyyah. Like all deities, you demanded her life and soul, and she offered herself in near-ecstatic sacrifice. A mass of inky filth exploded the instant you touched her, and by the time you dispelled the nauseating stench, the soul had drifted away from your grasp amid the winds of creation.

You lifted Nayla, attempting to examine this masterpiece of creation. Yet, the dust of desire had already seeped into every corner of her soul. When the winds of creation swept away the dust, her tempting whispers vanished, leaving barely a trace in your memory.

In your folly, you summoned an apostle ravaged by the Corrupter. Yet, there was nothing to hold onto. Her chalice had long run dry, and from that parched essence, the first thing to evaporate was her very soul!

You called out to Shama, what was already yours. "Come! Kneel! Surrender your last soul to your master!"
A stone lock appeared before you... You shattered it, but what burst forth was not a sweet sacrifice, but the abyss itself! That was darkness and madness incarnate, the primal chaos against the Creator. To avoid being devoured, you fled in blind panic. But alas, Lamblet was even faster!

A sudden pang of guilt hit—could you really leave like this? If you went to a new world, what became of Maggie? What of all the others who loved you? Through this game, you gained so much... but what had you given them in return? And if you drained their power here, what would become of them in the real world?
Hesitation. Conscience. A Creator should have neither. At the very least, Lamblet thought so. They laughed and seized the chance to surge past you.

Would this stubborn political rival help you, if you promised a brighter future in a new world? Too bad. He withdrew silently from this contest no mortal was meant to join—his strength was for changing this world, not some distant, next one.

What foolishness it was, to seek the power of annihilation amid the ascension of creation...
All things passed. The end was void, meaningless. Life was but writhing flesh. All creations would be forgotten. Surrender! Destroy!
You could not even extract this power—you had to sever a part of yourself just to avoid being consumed by it.

You coerced the North Star into your grasp, commanding it to summon the stars and uphold you—the future Creator. The Highlord roared at the sky in ragged anger... Soon the stars blazed alight, casting upon you rays that were not lethal, yet enough to hinder you.
Lamblet laughed loudly and surged past you, telling you that the Highlord had just screamed, "This one is off to write stories where none of us can see!"

You once tempted the gods into sin—was that not a glorious feat worthy of praise? Alas, this evidence of your trespass against the world only tore open the path of ascension, nearly casting you back to the mortal realm... and widening the gap between you and Lamblet.

You once rewrote the world and planted subtle suggestions in the minds of gods—was that not a glorious feat worthy of praise? Alas, this madness that intoxicated the gods only conjured endless illusions for you, nearly casting you back to the mortal realm... and widening the gap between you and Lamblet.

You seized his soul, trying to extract fragments fit for creation. But there was nothing! Not even the slightest trace... Only then did you realize: what you had erased with inky shadows might be exactly what you now needed.

This thing could not support you, and it would not. In the winds of creation, it faded from your heart and returned to the mortal realm...
Quick! Dig through your pockets, memories, and heart! You had already wasted too much time...
Must even a Creator prove Their worth? How many miracles must you unveil before the world would yield—or was it only your immature heart that remained unproven?

5010207.title: Clay Gate
strings: Clay Gate
<color=#3F2A29>You have reached the end, and the key fits perfectly. Yet, the gate does not budge; your strength alone is not enough! This is the final secret—no one can create a world alone.</color>
Is It the Final Step?
Will they share it with you... or become part of a new world itself?
Do you truly wish to share the power of world-creation with it?
Can you bear to coexist with it for eons to come?
The Dawn of a New World
The key to the gate
<color=#3F2A29>Select those you wish to see in the new world.</color>
