Maggie laid her hand on the Clay Gate, and you met it with a nod. The clay was gentle, her touch warm. As your powers intertwined in the light, the gate to the new world slowly swung open...

She asked, but the moment her hand touched the Clay Gate, it seemed set ablaze. She burned herself and left an ashen handprint, as if infusing something fierce into it... The gate to the new world slowly swung open, revealing the fire she offered you—and before that, she had already found her own peace.
Zazie lunged forward eagerly, leaving a golden handprint on the Clay Gate. Her desire and greed began seeping into the world you were about to create...

The nameless mercenary pushed at the Clay Gate, but it didn't budge! Just as anxiety set in, starlight surged, sending strength and blessing from the distant mortal realm. A shimmering handprint appeared on the gate, and he transformed into starlight that illuminated the world beyond...
The moment her palm pressed down, crystalline veins blossomed across the Clay Gate. Beyond it, you glimpsed the light of a new world waiting for you to mold...

Iman pressed his whole body against the Clay Gate. He didn't push, only offering prayers for the departed deities and the bygone world. The boundless longing and healing finally tore his body apart, and in that pool of blood, the gate slowly creaked open...

Badriyyah laughed, so wild it made you almost regret asking for her help. Fueled by a streak of grievance and rebellion against the current world, she smashed herself into the Clay Gate and dissolved into a mass of inky darkness. Then the gate trembled like a heartbeat, and from beyond it, the world seemed to stir to life with a resounding wail...

A strong arm swung over your head, pushing the massive Clay Gate before you. "Such loyalty, [player.name]! For now, I will not judge you for standing in parallel with me!"
It was a foolish decision, but with that immense soul and power, the gate truly began to swing open...

No need for words! Jabal pressed his palm against the solid Clay Gate, forcing it open a sliver, as he had countless times with the closed palace gates. A glance inside, and he faded away in laughter. Mourn him not—all he ever wanted was that single look.

You attempted to persuade Nayla with a jumble of promises, yet she only leaned against the gate, curling a finger at you. Was now the right time for this? Had any Creator ever opened the gate in this way? How would you face your... countless creations? You hesitated—but soon, thought stopped mattering. Honestly, it was kind of thrilling.
You almost forgot you were racing against Lamblet, and even the watching great beings fell silent in shock. Together, you soared to the climax, and the gate swung open for this wild revelry. Amid the radiance, her voice lingered softly in your ear, "Don't forget what you promised, [player.name]."

Qais was, of course, willing to help you. As you might not know, he had long dreamed of changing the world! His confusion and fury at the present burned so fiercely, and his hope and vision for the future shone so clearly, that even the stubborn gate had no choice but to yield a little more...

Her mettle, every scar on her body, and every soul of prey she had slain screamed in a bone-chilling chorus. The gate creaked open under Adila's force, but what seared itself into your mind was her proud smile.

The moment Fatuna laid her hand on the Clay Gate, a sharp, fleeting ache jolted her belly. She paused in surprise, then gently patted the gate, as if soothing it. You couldn't help but lean closer, straining to hear beyond into that chaos—if a heartbeat had already begun. Was it yearning to be born and meet you sooner? Your palms were slick with sweat...

You grabbed Nabhani by the shoulder and whispered about a little pleasure spot. He pushed the gate without a second thought, only for it to stay firmly shut.
He eyed your "innocent" face and sighed, muttering as he fiddled with the gate, "Alright, my dear brother, let's make a bet. If I can open this gate, you don't call me for the next week... no, two weeks. I nearly slept with that new songstress just now..."
He pressed his hand to the gate again, his figure dimming like the last glow of sunset. The slowly opening gate let out a breeze scented with roses and wine.

Come on, Manar. You invited her to the Clay Gate. What could attract an explorer more than an unknown new land? Manar could hardly wait; she peered through the crack, tracing shapes and shadows with her fingers. Under this fervent, self-sacrificing desire, the heavy gate and the world beyond hummed in resonance, parting the mist just enough for her to glimpse it.

You called out Junah's name. One droplet responded at first, then surged endless, unmeasurable tides pounding against the gate, prying open the crack, and flowing into the nascent world to anchor its very foundation. Junah remained unseen, yet you know you would meet her again—like a drop in the ocean that, when rain fell, would kiss your cheek.

You voiced a challenge that bordered on provocation. Despite a flicker of uncertainty, Jalila steeled herself, stepped forward, and bellowed at the obstinate gate—how dare it block the steps of a great Creator, humiliate the world beyond, and fail to properly welcome its master? She was fully in her element now, pulling out every tool at hand and wielding her skills against the massive stone... It was a contest of sheer expertise, and in the end, the gate yielded—perhaps unwilling to let holy water spill at its own "feet."

Answering your call, Shama pressed her hands against the Clay Gate—hands both feminine and masculine, hands that had once written, crafted perfumes, sifted coins from the dust, and plucked jewels from coronets... This tangled fate pried open the crack of the gate. She let out a relieved chuckle, slightly nodding to you.

What? A gate that wouldn't budge? Old Alim was born for this! With several strange sticks in hand, he squatted before the gate and set to work... You hesitated, almost wanting to ask if a lockless gate really needed this. Yet somehow, this final gate of creation creaked open a little more.
Before descending to the mortal realm, his expert hands snatched something fast from behind the gate and stuffed it into his pocket. You pretended not to notice.

At your call, Lumera's innocent face lit up with a bright smile. Without hesitation, she pressed her hands to the Clay Gate. Suddenly, a dazzling radiance burst forth, and the heavy gate rumbled open an inch. Through the crack, you glimpsed the chaotic forms flickering with starlight...

You stood before the gate, so close to the heavens and stars, and called out the name etched in your heart. Following your voice, a star slowly lit up, twinkling with joy, as if it had just lifted its gaze from a book. "Are you stepping into a new world?" You seemed to hear her chuckle, and then a streak of starlight blazed across the sky, slipping through the narrow crack of the Clay Gate. Like the aftermath of an ancient explosion, the gate groaned and trembled, opening a little more for you...

Answering your call, Arzuna arrived among the clouds. But she passed right by you and pressed her hands to the gate—just like that morning, and the countless mornings after, when she had set out alone. She pushed the gate open lightly, without a backward glance or a word of farewell, and vanished without a trace.

You had dreamed a thousand times of stepping into the Lapis Lazuli Palace, sword pointed at your sovereign! Too many times—so many that you could no longer tell fantasy from memory, dream from reality... but none of it mattered. You gathered these useless fragments and cast them from the clouds, exhaling a heavy breath; your soul seemed to have lightened. Then you turned, resolute with authority, commanding the gate of ascension and creation to open a little more for you.

Sacrifice two mighty gods, using their flesh and blood to create a new world! As you slid the card into the Clay Gate, both worlds trembled.
You heard the outraged rebukes of great beings, as well as the magician's ecstatic moan. Today, the collectors witnessed and recorded the moment before the Creator's birth, washing away the ancient humiliation cast upon Them by Their maker and the first of humankind. This became Their strength, and drove the game to heights never seen before. The new world would carry forward this grand game, with even rarer cards! Platinum? No—Diamond! No, Diamond wouldn't suffice! Cobalt, Titanium, Krypton, Aether... anything! Unleash the torment, and chronicle the birth of the new world!

Step through the gate of heaven and earth, and forge a new world within the greatest mystery! As you slid the card into the Clay Gate, both worlds trembled.
You heard the outraged rebukes of great beings, as well as the magician's ecstatic moan. Today, the collectors witnessed and recorded the moment before the Creator's birth, washing away the ancient humiliation cast upon Them by Their maker and the first of humankind. This became Their strength, and drove the game to heights never seen before. The new world would carry forward this grand game, with even rarer cards! Platinum? No—Diamond! No, Diamond wouldn't suffice! Cobalt, Titanium, Krypton, Aether... anything! Unleash the torment, and chronicle the birth of the new world!

Consume all to achieve the grand feat of ascension! As you slid the card into the Clay Gate, both worlds trembled.
You heard the outraged rebukes of great beings, as well as the magician's ecstatic moan. Today, the collectors witnessed and recorded the moment before the Creator's birth, washing away the ancient humiliation cast upon Them by Their maker and the first of humankind. This became Their strength, and drove the game to heights never seen before. The new world would carry forward this grand game, with even rarer cards! Platinum? No—Diamond! No, Diamond wouldn't suffice! Cobalt, Titanium, Krypton, Aether... anything! Unleash the torment, and chronicle the birth of the new world!

Step into another world, or even create another world! As you slid the card into the Clay Gate, both worlds trembled.
You heard the outraged rebukes of great beings, as well as the magician's ecstatic moan. Today, the collectors witnessed and recorded the moment before the Creator's birth, washing away the ancient humiliation cast upon Them by Their maker and the first of humankind. This became Their strength, and drove the game to heights never seen before. The new world would carry forward this grand game, with even rarer cards! Platinum? No—Diamond! No, Diamond wouldn't suffice! Cobalt, Titanium, Krypton, Aether... anything! Unleash the torment, and chronicle the birth of the new world!

You had Fardak push the stone gate. To your surprise, it didn't budge... Didn't he want to create a new world with you? Still clinging to this rotten old one? He pondered, then drew the dagger. Blood, thick with resolve, had soaked its blade. Slowly, the gate to the new world swung open—and his body tumbled, through the void, back to his homeland.

Following your command, Aziz heaved against the massive stone gate. As the crack slowly widened, he heard the distant thrum of hooves and smelled the scent of grass and wind. Tears fell into the void, and he poured every ounce of his strength into moving the gate faster.

When summoned before the Clay Gate, Inal still had a rag in her hand. Despite her displeasure at having her work interrupted, she pressed a damp handprint onto the gate. With that gentle push, the gate began to slowly swing open...

For Faraj, that was enough. Nothing could satisfy him more than your recognition and standing with you in creation. He grew taller, stronger, closer to godhood—and with a power beyond your imagination, he slowly pushed open the gate to the new world.

You chanted Their name—the old god who had fallen into Lamblet's trap, now a cornerstone of creation. Their last remnants of flesh and will bent to you, surrendering to the future Creator... "Come. Do you still wish to guard or mend the world? Will you still grant me a chance to correct my missteps, and together shape that perfect world?" Answering this final call, a pale handprint appeared on the Clay Gate, sealing a contract of loyalty for you and the new world.

You chanted Their name—the old god who had fallen into Lamblet's trap, now a cornerstone of creation. Their last remnants of flesh and will bent to you, surrendering to the future Creator... "Come. Do you still wish to keep writing? To leave your strokes in the new world?" For any Creator, this was never a question. A black handprint appeared on the Clay Gate, sealing a contract of loyalty for you and the new world.

"Hurry! At least put on some lipstick, and fix your lashes and the corners of your eyes! Let me trace your cheekbones with gold dust! Wait, you haven't washed your hair? Perfect, no time for oil anyway! Slap this brown paste over the flab, but leave the shine for the muscles!"
None of this was really necessary. Yet with Malkina urging on, the gate for the Creator actually began to swing open. Oh, she was getting even more frantic!

Need Hassan's help? He was practically Lamblet's servant. Yet your trust—the bond—stirred the clarity within him. He remembered it all, every cycle... Pressing paper to the Clay Gate, he wrote with feverish intensity, determined to record every detail of Creator [player.name]'s legend! As the extraordinary cycles tore him into countless sheets, his strokes etched themselves upon the massive stone gate to the new world. Words that traced the dawn of existence coaxed the gate to slowly swing open.

You wielded the invisible Blade of Dreams, forged from pure ideals. With every step toward the Clay Gate, those ideals began to turn to reality. At the same time, your weapon, shoulders, and spine bore tenfold, a hundredfold, a thousandfold, even ten thousandfold the weight. By the time you reached the gate, drenched in sweat, the burden of life had bent your back and choked your breath... Yet by some miracle, it guided your trembling hands to slowly open the gate of creation.

You summoned the King of Flames, the idol forged by your hand to bear the wrath of all living things. Now it needed no human host; it burned on its own, towering before the massive gate. Its touch melted the stone, leaving a terrifying trail of lava. Imperfections of the old world seared into the new, wounding it and forcing the gate for the Creator to slowly open...

Riel was puzzled, unsure where she was and what you expected from her. Yet she remembered tales from her childhood: the mightiest shaman would, in dreams, lead their tribe to a land teeming with prey... So she stepped forward and left her bloody, muddy handprint—pressing the barbarians' dream into the new world.

After a brief hesitation, you reclaimed the sword beneath you, merging once more with the whirling brass phallus of unmatched glory. Erected with pride, it unleashed a blinding radiance of existence and desire—so potent that even the gate for the Creator cracked under the force...

You called out to the stars and struck a bargain. Their light flickered for you, piercing the void to gather before the Clay Gate. A handful of stardust followed that sacred glow, seeping into the crack of the Clay Gate and illuminating the chaos beyond. The stars were watching now—begin your work as Creator!

You told [xiaochou.name] that a new world lay ahead. And before you could finish, [xiaochou.gender] lunged forward, desperate to pry the gate open for a glimpse. The Clay Gate parted by a sliver—and at once swallowed the curious creature of the mirror whole...

You offered the Queen a sacred invitation: to wield her power and forge a new world alongside you... and perhaps other things as well.
Alas, the arrogant Queen of Jinn fled the instant you opened her cage! She escaped back to the realm where she alone reigned supreme... As you cursed and seethed in frustration, the prison forged from your very bones slowly unfurled its limbs beside the Clay Gate and gazed at you thoughtfully, while the great gate creaked open slowly behind it.

Tch... Faris! The fool was hesitating! Did he not realize the honor he had been granted? He even wished to return home for his dog!
While you delayed, behind the Clay Gate, within the Chaos, creatures had already caught the scent of their master. They began to bark and call out for their Creator...

Your cook never expected such an invitation from you... Yet no chef would ever refuse the chance to cook for the entire world. He wiped his hands hard, then cautiously and slowly stroked the rough stone gate—could this be another trap set by Lord [player.name]? With his wit, his soul, and his magic, the Chaos Fluid beyond the gate began to churn and blend, shaking the very Gate of Creation...

It was Zaki's greatest honor that you would deign to create a world with him! His hand trembled as it touched the Clay Gate. He did not understand what was required of him, nor what would unfold... Yet this thrill, this anticipation, slowly pushed open the door to a new world...

Hmm... At least you knew who was the best one to share the world with. Perhaps, after the Clay Gate turned into a mirror and devoured your avatar, you saw him waving at you from within... Was everything truly alright?

Want anyone else? Mahir paced excitedly before the gate, probing every crack with a steel ruler and awl... At last, she uncovered a hidden hollow! The moment she reached inside, the gate whooshed open and swallowed her whole! Before you could even react, the heavy stone gate and the world beyond ground to life with the clank of gears, then slowly creaked open...

You hurled the Encyclopedia violently against the Clay Gate! Pages scatter, words and images swirling into radiant light... The knowledge of the old world ascended to the power of the new, and the massive gate truly began to open...

You called upon your old friend, and Samir gladly lent his strength, pressing his hands firmly against the heavy gate. How feeble these hands of healing were—they could barely wield a weapon! Yet how resolute—daring to reverse life and death, to alter fate itself! With his resolve, the Clay Gate boomed loudly, absorbing his audacious, unyielding soul, then slowly opened...

Raed arrived, along with all those who followed and trusted in you. One by one, they pressed their handprints, their very essence, onto the silent gate. Finally, Raed stared at you: Don't you dare make another terrible world this time, Lord [player.name]! When she too placed her hand atop the handprints of all living beings, the unfeeling stone gate finally creaked open...

How could feeble hands and a broken, scarred body help you push open this gate? The Immaculate Purity is dead—where had his sorrow and repentance gone? [player.name] was leaving; who would gaze upon his scars now? 
My God, my God, why did you forsake me? 
With this desperate prayer, his soul—every scar upon it—sealed itself forever onto the Clay Gate, forging a new shackle...

You meant to flee alone to some fresh, perfect, clean place... and to leave everyone else to suffer in this world? Lord [player.name], so many still cared about you!
Badriyyah held out a steaming, stinking jar: this was her final magic—poverty, humiliation, despair, filth, the inescapable stench of mortal cycles. You weren't sure if it was just your imagination, but even the gate seemed to shut tighter, as if fearing these impure things would sully its threshold...

Push it open? This thick, massive gate? Nayla would never soil herself with such crude, menial labor! It would ruin her nails, mess her hair, drain her health! She refused you without hesitation, then leaped from the clouds without a second thought... Foolish woman. This was no jest—you had no idea how far the ground lay below...

You foolishly summoned an apostle deeply corrupted by the Corrupter. At your plea, she smiled and placed her hand gently upon the Clay Gate, murmuring: "Naughty..."
In that instant, the gate—or rather, what lay within it—let out a short, piercing cry! You slapped Fatuna's hand away at once! Too close... You nearly became the laughingstock of all creators. On the very brink of ascension, you almost lost the world you were meant to forge!

You called out to Shama: this thing that already belonged to you—come, kneel, let your master drain your last strength!
Shama came, pressing her hand softly into the Clay Gate. The shackles around her neck, wrists, and ankles were absorbed by the gate, and her soul was freed at last. As for you... you'd best have checked your pockets and thought hard: what other forgotten powers did you have left to exploit?

A sudden pang of guilt hit—could you really leave like this? If you went to a new world, what became of Maggie? What of all the others who loved you? Through this game, you gained so much... but what had you given them in return? And if you drained their power here, what would become of them in the real world?
Hesitation. Conscience. A Creator should have neither. At the very least, the gate remained unmoved.

Would this stubborn political rival help you, if you promised a brighter future in a new world? Too bad. He withdrew silently from this contest no mortal was meant to join—his strength was for changing this world, not some distant, next one.

What foolishness it was, to seek the power of annihilation amid the transcendence of creation...
All things passed. The end was void, was meaninglessness. Life was but writhing flesh. All creations would be forgotten. Surrender. Destroy.
You could not even wield this power—you had to sever a part of yourself just to avoid being consumed by it.

You coerced the North Star into your grasp, commanding it to summon the stars and uphold you—the future Creator. The Highlord roared at the sky in ragged anger... Soon the stars blazed alight, casting upon you rays that were not lethal, yet enough to hinder you.
Lamblet laughed loudly and surged past you, telling you that the Highlord had just screamed, "This one is off to write stories where none of us can see!"

You once tempted the gods into sin—was that not a glorious feat worthy of praise? Alas, this evidence of your trespass against the world only tore open the path of ascension, nearly casting you back to the mortal realm... and widening the gap between you and Lamblet.

You once rewrote the world and planted subtle suggestions in the minds of gods—was that not a glorious feat worthy of praise? Alas, this madness that intoxicated the gods only conjured endless illusions for you, nearly casting you back to the mortal realm... and widening the gap between you and Lamblet.

Unfortunately, no matter how hard he struggled, he could not move the Clay Gate an inch. He even set his own soul ablaze! Yet no flame came—only smoke rose, its form scattered uselessly by the high wind in an instant...
Too weak, unbound by true bonds—such power could not manifest before the Gate of the Creator... Hurry. Your time was running out!
Was the gate truly moving... or was it just your illusion? Was the chaos of a new world growing brighter... or fading away? Hurry—this was the final trial. Move fast! Before Lamblet did!

5010208.title: The Ultimate Question
strings: The Ultimate Question

This is your final step out of the old world, and your first into the new. The chaos ripples, and the primal question echoes between the worlds, deep within your soul: "Who are you? Who are you?... are you?... you... u..."
Give the World an Answer
This is truly the last choice.
Only Here Do I Realize I Am Not Myself
Only Here Do I Realize I Am Truly Myself

Following the question, you looked back in shock—and you saw yourself. That was not [player.name], it had never been yours to begin with... It had been given by the violent, yielded by lovers, willingly offered by those who hoped for you... Beneath it all lay the countless souls, the tide of history, the infinite lights... and you were the refraction of them all.
With this realization, you saw the path behind you—the way home... Clothed in power enough to shape worlds, you ran, weeping, beginning your return...
When you reached the door, Maggie opened it for you herself.

You stepped forward, letting action speak louder than words, walking upon the surface of Chaos. From the tiniest lines on your fingertips to the unspoken fragments in your memories, everything you were began to expand...
The cycles of the game, like spiraling golden threads once sealed tight in your heart, now unfurled, releasing the gathered power of fate. So this was it! All had been for this moment! From an inconceivable angle, you watched yourself dissolve, scatter, like a ripened fruit... Every memory, every drop of flesh and blood, melted silently into chaos—and then grew, shifted, beginning the work of making a world.
God said, let there be [player.name], and so you found yourself.

5010209.title: Ascension of Lamblet
strings: Ascension of Lamblet
How many ages have They plotted for this? How much divine power have They stolen for your game? Now They lunge hungrily toward the final reward.
You have 6 rounds left to become the Creator.
You must reach the end faster than Lamblet—and you have 6 rounds left.
The Sundered Sheep

In the void, colorless flames burned you both equally. Lamblet spewed endless mist to fight the fire—but you saw more of their exposed form.
It was countless palaces, temples, and statues... nameless gods imprisoned within, mortals clinging like ants. You even saw a colossus resembling yourself, and a tower you had once destroyed with a tornado... Their hoarded treasures from cycles untold were cast aside, laid bare, burned away in the void as they accelerated wildly...

5010210.title: Ascension of Lamblet
strings: Ascension of Lamblet
How many ages have They plotted for this? How much divine power have They stolen for your game? Now They lunge hungrily toward the final reward.
You have 5 rounds left to become the Creator.
You must reach the end faster than Lamblet—and you have 5 rounds left.
The Great Serpent

In the boundless void, Lamblet began to swell... coiling and uncoiling endlessly, swallowing whole mountains of matter and power into its spiraling form. It stretched its colossal, infinite maw toward the distant Gate of Creation, like a many-headed beast of legend that devoured the stars.
Compared to it, you were but a mortal speck of dust. Yet fortunately, the path of ascension was not measured in physical distance—it lay within your own heart...

5010211.title: Ascension of Lamblet
strings: Ascension of Lamblet
How many ages have They plotted for this? How much divine power have They stolen for your game? Now They lunge hungrily toward the final reward.
You have 4 rounds left to become the Creator.
You must reach the end faster than Lamblet—and you have 4 rounds left.
Dead Gods

To prove its sovereignty, the colossus known as Lamblet began to coil inward. Realms, mountains, halls, and seas—all power and matter deemed useless were cast aside. They tore deeper into their own flesh, revealing a core that glimmered like gemstones and pulsed like a heart... Within it blazed the light of the Creator, each shard once belonging to a great being that had once taken part in the forging of worlds.

5010212.title: Ascension of Lamblet
strings: Ascension of Lamblet
How many ages have They plotted for this? How much divine power have They stolen for your game? Now They lunge hungrily toward the final reward.
You have 3 rounds left to become the Creator.
You must reach the end faster than Lamblet—and you have 3 rounds left.
The Many-Colored Gaze

As the long-lost divine radiance surged forth, the entire path of ascension trembled... All gods and saints across the world bore witness to this sacred contest. Even the great beings that lurked beyond the Veil, who had once partaken in the making of worlds, could not help but turn their gaze upon you in awe.
That mysterious purple hue came from Lady Metaphor—you had known this subtle watchfulness long since, when you sang verses or wove spells...
That black deeper than the void belonged to Lord Ending... He lay far from the mortal realm, yet felt impossibly close to you both...
That blinding golden light was the Magician—or rather, the entity behind her... It was recording every detail of the race between you and Lamblet with countless fingers...

5010213.title: Ascension of Lamblet
strings: Ascension of Lamblet
How many ages have They plotted for this? How much divine power have They stolen for your game? Now They lunge hungrily toward the final reward.
You have 2 rounds left to become the Creator.
You must reach the end faster than Lamblet—and you have 2 rounds left.
The Fabric of the Game

As you soared through the void, the light of the mortal world faded. In your eyes, nothing remained but the gate—and each other. At last, you saw the tangled, patchwork glow within Them: lake-like "Imitation," emerald "Repetition," pale "Modification," even a pearl-hued glimmer of "Sharing"... To fulfill Their grand design, They devoured countless beings, and from them forged the Sultan's game... your game.

5010214.title: Ascension of Lamblet
strings: Ascension of Lamblet
How many ages have They plotted for this? How much divine power have They stolen for your game? Now They lunge hungrily toward the final reward.
This is your last chance.
You must reach the end faster than Lamblet—and this is your last chance.
Etiquette Before the Feast

They had reached the Clay Gate before you! And naturally, They had no intention of using a key to open it. Their colossal form collapsed inward, nebulae swirling around Them, all physical shape dissolving into oblivion, Their divine radiance dimming like an eclipse... They meant to devour the seed of the new world outright.
Just as despair took hold, you realized: no matter how much destruction Their black hole unleashed in the void, no matter how much matter it swallowed, the distance between Them and the Clay Gate never changed. This was the final secret: no one could create a world alone—and certainly no one could devour one alone.
And so, in resignation, the lingering divine glow began to trace living faces upon the darkness: a greedy, cunning ram; a fierce, mighty lion; and one that resembled a human... resembled you, [player.name].

Though, some people might be driven mad with rage because of this...

5300176.title: 这不是偷
strings: While the bookstore owner and the book seller were bargaining, you noticed a few children slowly approaching you, pretending to look straight ahead but glancing at you like cats crouching near pigeons. So, you pretended to look at the book in the book seller's hand and suddenly reached back to catch a little dirty hand reaching for your belt. You swiftly grabbed the book seller and flipped him to the ground before he could escape. This guy wanted to make twice the money, both from the book and from the cut he got from the thief... Now he and the little thief beg for mercy, saying they were wrong to target your wallet. To demonstrate his sincerity, the man slaps himself while the little thief knocks his head hard. Everyone around is watching... What will you do?
"Leave the books and go."
"This cannot go unpunished."
They fled in panic, the Bookstore Owner shrugged: If I'm ever forced to sell books, I'd want to use that trick too.

You viciously beat up those trying to extort you and took everything from them. The Bookstore Owner stood at a distance, looking at you coldly, seemingly unsatisfied with your actions. When you both left together, he finally complained to you... Actually, I understand him, selling books is like selling one's soul...

5300177.title: 你礼貌吗？
strings:
You all arrive at a noble's mansion. Looking up, you see servants in silk uniforms running about, gold-winged birds languidly singing in pomegranate trees... The noble host moves from the inner residence to the outer hallway, his corpulent frame carried by six slaves, all sweating profusely. Behind the palanquin, two maidservants follow, carrying a pile of books...
"He must kneel to choose," the noble says, "no commoner can stand before me, pointing at my collection." – How will you respond?
Mock him in person
Go back and deal with him

You sighed disappointedly and then told the Noble that only the Sultan could meet courtiers while lying down, and his demeanor... tsk tsk, it indicated his family has been away from the Lapis Palace too long, forgetting basic etiquette. 

The Obese Noble awkwardly asked his bearers to lower the sedan chair and struggled greatly to pose himself decently... You waved impatiently, saying you didn't have time for his acrobatics, the Sultan was about to see you, so quickly hand over the books. As for the payment... 

He immediately refunded you multiple times what he'd received for selling books... The Bookstore Owner boasted about this for a long time after returning.

At that time, you endured silently, only casually mentioning a few days later during court that the combination of that lord and his sedan looked larger than the Sultan's throne... 

Shortly after, coincidentally, he offended the Sultan over a minor issue, nearly spending his entire fortune to spare his life – on the bright side, he lost dozens of pounds!

The bookstore owner was afraid to talk to you for a long time after hearing about this...

strings: You wander through the Dark Alley, sizing up one fence pawn after another, or dubious little shops. Finally, an old woman's stall piques your interest... Just as the bookstore owner reaches for an interesting-looking book in front of her, another hand comes in from the side to press it down. The obstructive buyer is a brute with a face full of flesh, not interested in the book... a common trick in the Dark Alley, just to extort money.
Fight over it
Check the cards you brought today

Following the rules of the Dark Alley, you directly cut off his hand... He fled like a frightened animal, but his blood ruined most of the books. Afterward, the bookstore owner kept complaining, asking why you didn't use the Bloodshed Card to scare him, even the Carnality Card would have sufficed!

You asked the bookstore owner to introduce himself, and he only spoke three words, which terrified the rogue and the book vendor into fleeing... Later on, people said you were going to use the Carnality Card on a rogue. But regardless, the book was saved, and it didn't cost any money.

Jabal, the General of the Sultan, suddenly stops you as you leave.

Jabal was right, and besides, it was mutually beneficial with no reason for refusal.
He laughed and grabbed your shoulder, "Just wait, I'll bring you the Wolf King's head."

Presenting One's Wife and Concubine

5300262.title: 处置凶兽头颅
strings: The blood at the neck of this head has long congealed, but the stench remains. How do you plan to deal with this grim trophy?
Use as decoration materials
Give it to an ally
Give it to Jabal
Sell it to a merchant who interested in
If you could find a Jeweler to serve you, this head could be made into an accessory – the striking and grotesque form would surely inspire her.
You decide to gift the head to a Follower.
You decide to give it to Jabal, your companion in this combat.
It seems Jabal is busy now, maybe try again tomorrow.

5300263.title: 苏丹奔赴猎场
strings:
The blood of beasts no longer thrills the Sultan. But he suddenly wonders if a giant wolf could be kept as a dog?
Of course, he doesn't care about anyone's answer. His thoughts are already at the hunt, eager to try himself.

5300264.title: 认识异国商人
strings: You plan to entrust a familiar Merchant with selling this item.

5300265.title: 不认识异国商人
strings: You didn't find the right Merchant to help sell this ominous item, maybe the time isn't right yet.

5300267.title: 黑街的邀约
strings: Your Renown Spreads Through the Dark Alley On this day, someone invited you to watch an underground boxing match, promising its excitement. You have a premonition that this journey may bring special rewards.

5300268.title: 再一次拳斗
strings: The underground boxing match began once more. If you want to find out the fighter's identity, don't miss this chance.

5300269.title: 利用
strings:
Just think a bit... It is something on Jabal: present it to the Sultan to expose him, and perhaps you have a chance to eliminate the Sultan's right hand... 
Or, you could declare that you killed the formidable pugilist and renown your name? What will you choose?
Blackmail Jabal
Present it to the Sultan
Renown your name in the Dark Alley
You hold it over Jabal for sure, it is now or never. But what kind of rewards do you intend to demand?
It seems Jabal is busy and can't respond to your invitation. Maybe try again tomorrow.
That's it, you can present it to the Sultan in the The Grand Game.
It could serve as an evidence of defeating a famous pugilist, for bragging rights in the Dark Alley.

5300272.title: 被偏爱的与被冷落的
strings: The pleasure seeker, who is snubbed by the Lady of Delights, angrily points at the man they favor — Nabhani — and stakes all his dignity as a man, demanding a duel with him. Do you want to intervene in this dispute?
Persuade the neglected
Persuade the favored
Remain neutral

You approach the man being neglected and quietly remind him that Nabhani is the Iron Guard of The Sultan, a renowned swordsman of the empire. Is it somewhat unwise to challenge someone like him? 
Halfway through your words, the man's legs already begins to tremble... You tell him that countless people have surrendered to swordsmen of this caliber before him, and it is no disgrace; on the contrary, people would praise him for daring to challenge. Moreover, what is less dignified than gambling with one's life? Why sacrifice everything just for a moment of rage?
The man drops his sword, bows deeply to both you and Nabhani, and flees.
People heave a sigh of relief, and the Ladies of Delights tacitly agree never to mention this abandoned duel again.
As you left, Nabhani smiles and waves at you.
“Well done, you're always able to persuade others, whether it's an unpopular coward or The Sultan.”

You approached Nabhani, patted his shoulder, and gestured for him to notice the anxious and worried Ladies of Delights around. If anything happened to him, how sad these girls would be! Why disappoint so much love over a vain duel?

Nabhani laughs heartily: “You're right, [player.name], you always have a way with words to touch people's hearts, whether it's me or The Sultan! All right, my friend, I apologize for monopolizing the beautiful little mermaid for too long—”
He bows to the neglected man—Since there was a step, the man readily accepted, and the two shook hands, leaving it at that.

You did nothing, simply watched with the others.

The man can't even withstand three moves under Nabhani’s sword, falling with tears on his face as the blade struck his heart.

The physician, who had been waiting at the side, rushed up to treat him, but you had seen the faces of the dying before, and it mirrored his present countenance.

Even though it was a duel witnessed by many, although Nabhani was The Sultan's Iron Guard and heir to a noble house, such an incident would undoubtedly affect his reputation... In the days following, he probably wouldn’t appear in the city.

5300273.title: 肉体展览
strings:
Nabhani eagerly pulls you through the Noble's residence to a bustling market. It's filled with the weeping, groaning, and cries of slaves, alongside the whipping and cursing of slavers.
He brings you to sit in front of the sellers, young and tender bodies parading before you.
"Today we'll save an unfortunate lady," he winks at you, "it's one of my favorite pastimes."
He explains that he'll buy a slave and give her free status to save her from brutal masters or brothel owners; in the tears and gratitude of words (perhaps other ways of thanks) from a rescued girl, Nabhani finds immense satisfaction.
Continue

Several diverse-flavor Slave Girls were tethered behind the slaver. Nabhani's gaze brushed over their faces and finally rested on you.
"Which one do you fancy? They are all priced similarly, and today we can save just one... the seller insisted he could spare only one; any more and he might struggle with future business."

5300274.title: 燃烧的奴隶市场
strings: You heard an insignificant rumor about a slave breaking free during a market transaction, killing his master and burning half the street...

5300276.title: 柔弱的女奴
strings: The frail slave girl is extremely fearful of the so-called 'freedom.' She looks at you with big, pitiful eyes, hoping that Nabhani — or you — might keep her. Normally, Nabhani wouldn't mind another beautiful company, but this time it's different; he looks at you, somewhat indecisive.
"You should take her in, my friend."
"How about leave her to me?"
"She should learn to live on her own."

Since you put it this way, Nabhani doesn't refuse any longer. He affectionately pulls the girl close, promising to care for her and provide for her needs; from now on, no one can sell her again.

The girl cries once more, this time in surprise, saying she wishes she could tell her mother about her handsome, generous new master. And Nabhani patiently explaines that she is now a free person, able to visit her mother anytime, triggering a third round of tears from the girl.

Satisfied, Nabhani bids farewell to you with her in his arms, seemingly not new to rescuing a beautiful maiden and ending up keeping her for himself.

"Of course!" Nabhani laughs, pushing the maiden into your arms.
The warmth and softness in your embrace makes you forget everything else for a moment...

Upon hearing your words, Nabhani also nods. But the girl bursts into tears, clinging to both your feet and Nabhani’s, lamenting that you shouldn’t grant her any freedom. She never possesses it and knows it will make her lose the ‘master’ who sheltered, fed, and clothed her, so it must be a bad thing.

She sorrowfully says, given her beauty and the efforts she made to serve her master, why does she end up in such a miserable state?
Nabhani’s embarrassment is apparent, but there is nothing more to be done. He can only comfort the girl with a few kind words before leaving with you.

You believe she will eventually find her own way.

5300278.title: 如此大恩
strings:
Salwiyah is thriving in the House of Delights like a fish in water. It is said that she often tells her patrons how she is saved by you and Nabhani and how she feels her lowly origins makes her unworthy of people like you... At the height of emotion, she will inevitably shed silent tears in self-pity.

Of course, she tells the story to make the patrons spend more gold on her, a poor yet beautiful girl, but regardless, the good name of the kind deeds you and Nabhani do spread from this.

5300280.title: 我不如她吗
strings:
After an intimate moment, Salwiyah rests her exquisite and beautiful head at your feet, looking at you with big, affectionate eyes, saying coyly, "Master~" Although she is already a free person, she still insists on calling you "Master," with a sticky tone. 
“I saw dear Maggie's wardrobe and jewelry box, she has so many, so many good things... Master, am I not as good as her? Am I not more beautiful than her? Do I not make you happier than she does?"
How could she compare with you?
Yes, you are not as good as her

Salwiyah's eyes lights up.
"Then I want a gold collar and a purple silk dress with gold-embroidered violets matching my eyes!"
She giggles, climbing onto you, wrapping her hands around like a clinging vine.

You sternly rebukes her for daring to compare herself to Maggie.
Salwiyah's big eyes fills with tears as she cries and withdrew, but... perhaps it is a mistake, you always feel her lips seems to be uttering a long string of the most vile and venomous curses...

5300283.title: 久违的清静
strings: After Salwiyah's death, there was no more annoying coquetry and crying swirling around Maggie's courtyard. Although this long-lost serenity is tainted with bloody hues, she feels more at ease for it… Oh, may the gods forgive this lack of compassion…!

5300287.title: 如此大恩2
strings:
Salwiyah is thriving in the House of Delights like a fish in water. It is said that she often tells her patrons how she is saved by you and Nabhani and how she feels her lowly origins makes her unworthy of people like you... At the height of emotion, she will inevitably shed silent tears in self-pity.
Of course, she tells the story to make the patrons spend more gold on her, Nevertheless, the good deeds of you and Nabhani have spread far and wide - along with the rumors that you are unable to satisfy your concubines at home, which damages your image of virility.

5300288.title: 奈布哈尼的耻笑
strings: Nabhani heard the rumors circulating in the town and sympathetically sends you a certain type of "those who understand will understand" potion... You prefer be mocked directly instead of his exaggerated act.

5300290.title: 更多的细纱
strings:
It's said the Sultan gifts your fine silk to a harem woman, sparking a frenzy. All want it, yet there is only one piece.
So, Habunah is summoned by the Sultan, becoming a court artisan... Overall, it is a good thing.

5300291.title: 工匠街区的意外
strings: Someone loudly announces outside: the commoners' district is on fire!

5300293.title: 一个提议
strings: The masked libertine – none other than The Sultan himself – demands you relinquish the golden key to him, allowing him to become the host of this debaucherous party. What do you think?
Of course, it should be you
Please listen to me...

You stand up and approach the masked guest, kneeling to present the golden key.
The masked guest accepts it, patting your head – an immense honor for a subject of the Sultan.
Although Madam Buthayna doesn't know the masked guest’s identity, her shrewdness quickly graspes his significance, unhesitant in leading him inside.
The women grumble softly, reluctant to leave you, while other male guests curse the masked guest for not inviting them but have no recourse.
Nabhani is confused, but he respects your choice.

You respectfully approach the masked guest, presenting yourself like a humble and polite servant without prematurely revealing his identity, as after all, he is still well-masked at this moment!

You lean in and quietly assure this exceptionally distinguished guest that having you host this indulgent party will certainly make it more entertaining: because you will definitely invite him, and any issues that may arise at the party will be your responsibility. He can enjoy himself to the fullest, even with more freedom than in the palace...

The masked guest – who is the Sultan – ponders and contemplates... Finally, he agrees with your proposal.

After all, everything in the empire is his, and occasionally letting people believe they truly own something adds a layer of intrigue to the game.

Seeing this, the shrewd Madam Buthayna immediately recognizes he is no ordinary person. While she ushers you in with the girls surrounding you, she also lavishly flatters the masked guest, promising to serve him even more attentively next time.

The masked guest nods, says nothing, and left just like that.

5300294.title: 友情提示
strings: Nabhani has won the golden key, but he hasn't realized yet that the masked guest is The Sultan himself... Will you persuade him to bestow this honor and favor upon The Sultan?
Advise Nabhani to give up
Stand by and watch

You lean close to Nabhani, urging him to take a closer look at the masked guest's ring, and then softly advise him that relinquishing the key is not disgraceful; it is merely prudent self-preservation. Undoubtedly, he is the most popular man, and the girls' perception of him won't change with the transfer of the key.
Nabhani smiles wryly at you and says nothing. At this juncture, what choice does he have? He stands up, approaches the masked guest, and respectfully presents the golden key to the opponent.
Although Madam Buthayna doesn't know the masked guest’s identity, her shrewdness quickly graspes his significance, unhesitant in leading him inside.
The women quietly expressed their resentment, reluctantly leaving Nabhani's side. The other male guests, not understanding the situation, cursed the masked guest for not inviting them to join in the fun, but they could do nothing about it.
You accompany Nabhani for a while longer, helping him digest the bitterness of his disappointment. After that, you both go home separately.

You respectfully approach the masked guest, behaving like a humble and courteous servant, but without revealing his identity, after all, until now, he still wears the mask well!

You whisper in his ear persuading this extremely distinguished guest: letting Nabhani host this licentious party would certainly be more interesting because Nabhani will definitely invite him, and any issues that may arise at the party will be Nabhani responsibility. He can enjoy himself to the fullest, even with more freedom than in the palace...

The masked guest – who is, in fact, the Sultan – ponders and thinks... Finally, he nods and leaves after giving you a deep glance.

Nabhani is happy again, twirling the key and proudly heading to the backyard surrounded by the girls. You wipe the cold sweat from your brow with lingering fear – this guy, he has no idea how much pressure you bore for his "happiness"...

5300295.title: 游戏的准备
strings:
Buthayna invites you to sit, opening a massive ledger.
"Throwing such an ecstasy-bound party requires expenses; just for all girls to serve your selected guests is significant..." Her face beams slyly, red-tipped nails tracing the accounts, "As the most popular and generous guest, I imagine... you'd fully prepare for this party, right?"
Starting by crowning the most popular man, then enticing with an indulgent party, mixing desires with pride, then selling high... No matter who the most popular man is, Buthayna profits all the same.

Just 30 Gold Coins, she claims, "and if you add 10 more, I'll attend the party too… forty years ago, I was the hottest courtesan in this city, ha, one of my patrons was the current Sultan's father!"
She offers a cringe-worthy coquettish glance, seems looking forward to your response.

5300297.title: 出让钥匙
strings:
Nabhani approached you, hands empty, confusing you.
"The key's gone, that golden key to paradise, I gifted it."
You were aghast, about to question him – 
"Not to a man, it's beyond any man's worth, I entrusted Madam Buthayna; directing her to assign it to different courtesans per party, letting them choose their favored guest…" He winked, excitement glowing, "Imagine, their first time having a choice, imagine who they might choose?" 
Then embracing, he promised a spot at any courtesan party.
Though delighted for the courtesans, immutable facts prevented worry's release… you hoped the Sultan forgot his committed agreements when convinced.

5300304.title: 石妓女赎身
strings: A messenger came to your door with a letter from Junah. She is waiting for you.

5300305.title: 畸恋
strings: Junah came to find you. You know it's foolish, but you can't refuse, as if enchanted.

5300306.title: 铜妓女处理尸体
strings: Jalila's maid found you. She wore a robe over her work leathers – things seem very urgent.

5300307.title: 决斗
strings: Due to Jalila's accident, a relative of that noble has challenged you to a duel.

5300308.title: 贾丽拉成为盟友
strings: Jalila has returned and found you immediately. To thank you for your help, she is willing to do anything. Generally, you can take this famous queen as your consort, but from another perspective, it might be more profitable if she continues to serve you secretly as a queen.
Take her as a consort
Retain her career

5300309.title: 贾丽拉被处死的消息
strings: You've heard that Jalila was sentenced to death for accidentally killing a noble.

5300310.title: 女王的朋友
strings: Jalila's maid tells you that more slaves have come to serve the queen, and you can decide her fate.

5300311.title: 父亲的刺客
strings:
Lately, you notice Shama seems a bit melancholic, and your relationship encourages her to confide in you about her experiences.

It turns out she is an illegitimate daughter of a noble, despised by her father due to a congenital deformity. Now, her father has learned about her profession as a prostitute in the House of Delights and believes she has disgraced the family.

"My father won’t let me go, and perhaps his assassin is already on his way." As she speaks, Shama slightly curls her lips, an expression filled with a mix of worry and perhaps a special kind of relief, which stirs a ripple within you...
I can help you kill your father
I can take you as a concubine
Let's talk about something else

After listening to your words, Shama just giggles softly, completely not taking it to heart. She has long known and has become accustomed to the fact that promises in House of Delights are not to be trusted – until you seriously ask about her father’s name, the location of her territory, and the situation there.

She widens her eyes in surprise and beginning to dissuade you: "You don't need to oppose him for... well, for someone like me." But you only gently squeezed her palm.

In the past, you would never consider standing against a great lord, but now, you have gained the power to change fate from this twisted game – even if it's just the fate of a prostitute.

As long as you step in to redeem Shama and marry her, wouldn't everything be resolved? This is a misguided idea, but it's also the easiest way.

Shama listens, covers her mouth and laughed, "Sure, my lord. I'm waiting for you." As she says this, it's uncertain how much is in jest and how much is serious.

The only difficulty for you now is that this requires a large sum of money.

"Of course." Hearing this, Shama just smiles, showing no disappointment. As usual, you talk about poetry and art, then go to bed amidst the elegant fragrance she lights. Your relationship is just like that, she's a Lady of Delights, after all, she shouldn't bring you trouble, right?

5300313.title: 葬礼
strings:
One day, you suddenly receive an invitation to attend the funeral of a beloved concubine of The Sultan. 

The name on it is prominently written as "Shama."

5300316.title: 继承人推荐
strings: Now that the pompous Great Lord is dead, who should inherit that vast and desolate territory? During a court session, The Sultan casually asks you.
Of course, I should inherit
Let Shama inherit
The place is burnt barren by you, leaving a mess for anyone who takes over. The Sultan is pleased to see someone take on this unwanted burden... though his smile appears somewhat malicious.
Ha! Letting a prostitute become a lord! The Sultan likes this idea and has the documents sent to Shama on that day.

5300319.title: 探访监狱(首次)
strings: Message: Recently, it has been heard that two Nobles angered the Sultan and were imprisoned.

5300324.title: 升级舞姬
strings: Arzuna gracefully curtseyed before explaining her intention - she hopes... and feels confident she can offer you greater assistance.

5300325.title: 升级舞姬2
strings: Arzuna gracefully curtseyed, wearing a gentle smile. She explains she could help you more in future, provided you first assist her.

5300326.title: 和舞姬密会
strings: The dancer sent you a secret letter from the palace. She hopes to meet with you.

5300329.title: 与舞姬密会-重试
strings: The dancer sent you a secret letter from the palace. She hopes to meet with you.

5300336.title: 记录玩家是否有战斗力超过4的人

5300337.title: 书店不营业了
strings: Asal plans to focus on assisting you, and the Bookstore will no longer be open.

5300338.title: 首次抽到苏丹卡的提示
strings: Only <color=white><size=172%>[sudan_life_time] days</size></color> left, must quickly find clues to break this Sultan Card.

5300339.title: 首次抽到苏丹卡的提示
strings: Whoa! This is a Gold tier card, do I have to point this card at the Sultan!?
No way! That evil magician said there would be [sudan_redraw_total_left_times] chances to <color=white><size=172%>redraw</size></color> every <color=white><size=172%>7 days</size></color>?
(Click the deck box in the top left corner and choose to redraw the Sultan Card)

5300340.title: 首次抽到苏丹卡的提示
strings: You can <color=white><size=172%>merge</size></color> two identical cards by stacking them together and <color=white><size=172%>split</size></color> them by clicking the number below the card.
You can <color=white><size=172%>merge</size></color> two identical cards by stacking them together and <color=white><size=172%>split</size></color> a merged card by selecting it.

5300341.title: 正直官员的回馈
strings: A few days after coming out of prison, Lord Qais found you. He seems to have something to say.

5300342.title: 正直官员的回馈
strings: A plainly dressed man angrily blocks your path. You remember him as the young prisoner you rescued from jail for speaking against the Sultan. During this time out of prison, he has figured out the current situation – you have become a player of the Sultan's Game! “How can you do this?” he appears deeply disappointed, “I never thought I was rescued by someone like you... I’d rather go back to prison and wait for that Bloodshed card pointed at me! Ha, it's absurd!”
Then I will grant your wish
I am not like the Sultan
Go away, don't make me curse you

You sneer, this ungrateful fellow! You paid a whole ten Gold Coins to obtain the Sultan’s forgiveness for him! And this is how he repays you? Very well, you decide to satisfy him. At least now, he deserves a Silver Card!

You patiently explain to him that you are not like the cruel Sultan. Moreover, it was because you criticized the Sultan that you ended up in this predicament. You are the same kind of person as he is.
But the young man's eyes are still full of vigilance and scrutiny: “Really, then you underestimate the power of this game... Let's see how low you will sink. This is... this is all my money, take it back, we owe each other nothing.”
You look at the pitifully few Gold Coins he left behind and smile helplessly.

This ungrateful fellow! You paid a whole ten Gold Coins to obtain the Sultan’s forgiveness for him! And this is how he repays you? Using all your lifelong patience, you resist the impulse to curse at him and instead point to the door, telling him to get out. Qais stares directly into your eyes without backing down – that's just the kind of person he is. Even in front of the Sultan, he wears this face – 'This is all my money, we owe each other nothing.' He throws a few coins at you and coldly leaves.
You look at the pitifully few coins, laughing in anger.

5300343.title: 诉冤的女人
strings:
A maid takes a great risk to ask for your help.
The mistress of her lord, a tax collector, went back to her hometown with her child some time ago and never returned. After a brief investigation, her hometown people claimed they had never seen her. The official handling the case thus ruled that the tax collector murdered her to get her dowry and fabricated her disappearance.
But the maid insists her master would never do such a thing; he and his wife have always been very loving. She heard you are a rare kind noble and plucks up the courage to seek your help to find out the truth.
Find out the truth
Not my concern
You and your master...
The verdict is correct, there's no need to discuss further.

If what she says is true, then it is indeed suspicious. You can't bear to see an upright person wronged, so after contemplating for a moment, you promise the maid that you will help find out the truth.

What does this have to do with you? Besides, it's against the rules to meddle in a case that isn’t yours, and would surely offend the official responsible for it. You wave your hand and have the audacious maid driven away.

You interrupt the woman and ask, “Why are you so worried about your master? Could it be that you...”
Her face instantly turns red, and she stutters that her master is a good person, very kind, and treats all the servants well... She talks for a long time, in great detail, as if the tax collector were a reincarnated saint.
You have a sudden realization and say abruptly, “Then, the official responsible for the trial was indeed wrong. The one who benefited the most from her death is not him, but you.”
The young maid is stunned for a moment before responding, “... Yes. It is me.” Strangely, she breathes a sigh of relief, bows to you, and leaves briskly.

You believe the outlines of the case are very clear, and the minister responsible for the case did not misjudge. Should you doubt your noble colleague and instead trust a humble servant? Especially when she speaks so much yet provides no concrete evidence, just relying on emotions. However, emotions are so fickle that one night is enough to turn them into enmity.
Upon hearing this, the maid instinctively wants to refute you but quickly realizes it is useless as you have already made up your mind. She leaves in disappointment.

5300344.title: 初步调查
strings:
Hearing that you intervened in the case, Qais comes looking for you, 'Why are you against me? Do you want to overturn the conviction of such a heinous person? Defending his well-documented evil deeds? I totally misjudged you, you enemy of justice!'
Only then do you realize that he is handling this case. You tell him you just want to find out the truth, but he doesn't believe you.
'Stop making excuses, you just want money and fame, right? You also want to prove I'm wrong just because I don't agree with you joining the Sultan’s Game!' Qais finishes speaking and leaves in a fury.
Thus, you part on bad terms.

5300345.title: 深入调查
strings:
Qais heard about your progress and came once again. After understanding the doubts in detail, he frowned tightly, 'If there are really hidden truths in this matter, I will assist you in the investigation. But my eyes will also be fixed on you, and don't try to play any dirty tricks!'
It seems he is hostile towards you, but it hasn't blinded his mind. As you know, he is also someone who seeks justice.

5300346.title: 收服正直的官员
strings: Qais found you to 'report' the results of the previous case.

5300347.title: 诉冤的女人2
strings: Do you remember the maid who pleaded for her master last time? She stopped you again, then took out a purse from her bosom, containing five Gold Coins she had scraped together, all her savings, her entire property. She grabbed your clothes and begged you to pity her and help her find the truth for her master...
Alright then...
Not my concern
You and your master...
The verdict is correct, there's no need to discuss further.

Her diligence and stubbornness moved you. Moreover, this poor woman looked at you as if you were her last hope... You sighed, took the money, and seriously promised her that you would help find the truth – as for whether the truth would be as she imagined, both of you don't know for now.

You firmly refused the woman again and harshly told her that it was not because the reward was insufficient that you were unwilling to help her.
- Besides, even if you want to bribe me to help, you can't do so in broad daylight! How could I save face among my colleagues this way?
The woman bit her lip and left, looking back every few steps. You had a feeling she wouldn't give up so easily.

You interrupted the woman and asked her why she was so worried about her master. Could it be that... Her face turned red instantly. She said her master was a good person, very kind, and treated his servants well. You suddenly realized and said, 'Then Qais was wrong. The one who benefits most from your master's wife's death is not him but you.' She was stunned for a while before saying, 'Yes, it should be me.' For some reason, she bowed to you and left with a light step.

You sighed and told her the truth of why you didn't want to interfere – you believed the case was already very clear and that the minister responsible hadn't misjudged. Could you not trust your noble colleague but trust a lowly maid instead? Besides, she had said so much without providing solid evidence, driven purely by emotion. However, emotions can change easily; one night's time is enough to turn against each other.
Hearing this, the maid wanted to refute you but quickly realized it was useless. You had already made up your mind. Disappointed, she left.

5300348.title: 诉冤的女人3
strings: The maid who pleaded for her master came again! This time, she was tightly wrapped in a coarse cloak. When she stopped you, you noticed her eyes were red from crying. She looked at you desperately, knelt on the ground, 'I know that a bit of money cannot catch your eye... and I have nothing left but this barely acceptable body...' She said, loosening the cloak she was tightly holding. Only then did you realize she was naked under it. 'As long as you can help clear my master's name, I am at your disposal...' She said, sobbing and trembling, lying on the ground with her bare back illuminated beautifully by the sunset.
Agree to the deal.
Politely refuse the deal.

Sighing, you considered accepting her, but then you heard a commotion outside. Qais broke into your residence, harshly pulled the kneeling girl off the ground, and tightly wrapped her cloak around her. He then looked at you coldly: 'The Sultan Card can twist a person's heart, I knew that long ago. But you... you are truly shameless! I despise you.'
Then he whispered something to the girl, making her burst into tears before walking out with him.
After that, the news spread about your disgraceful attempt to coerce women into submitting – Heavens, you didn't even have time to do anything!

You quickly avert your eyes and order her to put on the cloak; your voice stern in telling her of your ill-wish to help, a choice bound to reasons of your own – you are a gambit of the Sultan's Game, thus time is but one of the sacrifices to be made for it. You even advise her to find another master – she is a free person, after all. She can choose, can't she? The maid purses her lips, shake her head and want to say something, but in the end, she leaves, laden with extreme disappointment and despair.

5300349.title: 倒霉鬼
strings:
Later, you heard that Qais was moved by the maid's persistence and reopened the investigation into the tax collector who killed his wife. No one knows if he found anything or whom he offended, but you only know that he eventually died in some city, falling into a well...
He was truly an unlucky guy. People mysteriously mocked his overestimation of his abilities. And you were glad you didn't intervene, or you might have been the unlucky one.

5300350.title: 同日死去
strings: Soon, the man who went mad and killed his wife and children to seize their dowry was executed. It was initially a trivial matter. However, recently people have been talking about a maid who supposedly took care of the man's corpse and then hanged herself at the door of the Qais's house. You immediately thought of that stubborn and rigid face, imagined his surprised, terrified, and self-doubting expression, and gleefully spread the news, adding some embellishments.

5300351.title: 是我做的
strings:
You heard that a maid recently confessed to Qais out of guilt – you now know that Qais was the minister in charge of the tax collector's case. She claimed that in a moment of weakness, wanting to marry her master, she devised a plan to kill her mistress and the young master. Qais, shocked and angry, immediately started an overnight interrogation. It's said that at the final execution, the tax collector begged to execute the sinful maid himself...
You sighed softly. This was the maid's choice.

5300352.title: 算你识相
strings:
You met Qais at palace. He proudly lifted his chin at you and actually came over to talk. It turned out he was the minister responsible for the tax collector's case. Naturally, what you told the maid had reached his ears.
"I am glad you didn't use your privilege to meddle in my case, stirring up all sorts of trouble," he said, seemingly having a newfound respect for you. For some reason, seeing his smug look, you regretted not being able to prove his judgment wrong. But regardless, even if only temporarily, you now have one less enemy in court.

5300357.title: 群龙无首和权力游戏的保险机制

5300501.title: 偷盗的仆人
strings: When disaster struck, you and your wife dismissed most of the servants to keep them from being caught up in this cruel game. Unfortunately, not everyone appreciated your goodwill; one person stole some money... Luckily, he was caught just as he was about to spend it.
This money was given to him by me.
Let him atone with his body.
Leave the money, let him go.
You let him go, perhaps out of mercy, or perhaps out of fatigue.
You locked him in the warehouse, waiting to use him when you draw the Bloodshed or Carnality card.
You kept the money because you needed it. You let him go because you lost interest in brutality and rage.

5300502.title: 欠钱的朋友
strings: Earlier, when you were still prosperous, you lent some money to a friend. Now, in your time of need, he found various excuses to refuse... The newly bought gemstone ring swayed in front of you, particularly annoying.
Turn away in anger.
Find a chance to Blackjack him.
Humiliate him at palace.
Cancel his debt.
You walked away, feeling a bit sad – the friendship was bought off by a few Gold Coins... But on the other hand, you recognized his true nature for just a few Gold Coins, which is not a bad deal...

No matter what excuses he makes, you keep nodding – your heart has already left and gone to an alley on his way home. You used to walk arm in arm through there often; tonight, you will collect your debt.

You are not going to argue with him in private. All the harsh words, you will say in front of the entire palace. People love to support you in such trivial matters – for you bring them such amusing jokes!

Smiling, you pat him on the shoulder and tell him that you have earned the Sultan's favor and no longer need such small money.
His sly face shows a sliver of suspicion... At least for a long time, he won't trouble you.

5300503.title: 打老婆的邻居
strings: Your neighbor – a fool who always competes with you – beats his own wife's face just to warn her not to talk to someone like you (a man who commits adultery with women using magician cards).
I am exactly who you described.
Beat him up
Ignore him
Just women?
Friend, isn't this serendipitous? I have a need for carnality, and you happen to have a wife.
Just as you knock on his door, he jumps out the back window, breaking a leg and wetting his pants. This makes you lose interest in tormenting him further. This matter ends here.

You don't take your neighbor's words to heart, let alone the plight of that poor woman. However, shortly after, the neighbor blocks your door and accuses you of seducing his wife and hiding her away. He speaks with such conviction, touching hearts, and people sympathize with him, pointing fingers at your nonexistent misdeeds... At this moment, you are at a loss for words...
You don't know me well enough, friend... now we have a chance to deepen our understanding of each other.

5300504.title: 贼人之手
strings: Maggie had a beloved piece of jewelry stolen – who could have done it? Inal, the maid who came with her dowry, has the easiest access to her jewelry box; and the boy, Zephyr, often runs errands in the city and can easily fence stolen goods... Or... could it be a friend who recently visited your wife?
Maid Inal
Zephyr
Noble friend

You accuse Inal of being the thief, shocking Maggie. She repeatedly stresses that her maid couldn't have done it, but you insist on the accusation. After a body search reveals Inal has stolen nothing, your wife is extremely disappointed in you.

You had always found this man suspicious... Work he should complete in an hour sometimes takes him three. After your accusation, he weakly falls to his knees, admitting he stole silver spoons from the dining table but swears he knows nothing about the jewelry. Finding nothing in the search, you reluctantly accept this outcome.

You propose to talk to Maggie's friend about the jewelry, and unexpectedly, she seems relieved. 'To be honest, I've had my doubts. She first wanted to see my jewelry box, then started talking about her husband's gambling... But I kept thinking, should I suspect a friend?'
You comfort her and then write to the woman's husband. A few days later, you receive a blank letter along with a bag containing the jewelry.

5300505.title: 读书人
strings: Several friends from your old school gather at your home. After a few drinks, you all discuss a topic that had sparked debates back then: What distinguishes humans from animals – the soul, intellect, body, or divinity?
Soul
Intellect
Body
Divinity

Of course, it's the soul. You persuasively argued that the human soul is unique, describing how animals would seem if they had souls: they would be like people in different skins. You convinced everyone, and they all raised their glasses to toast your enduring soul.

Of course, it's intellect. Even those who have lost their soul are still human, those with physical impairments are still human, and primitive people who have never encountered divinity are certainly human. Only intellect distinguishes humans from animals. You eloquently discussed these perspectives, convincing everyone, and they all raised their glasses to toast your eternal wisdom.

Of course, it's the body. First comes a sharp mind, then hands to serve the mind, and finally a strong physique. Only then do intellect, soul, and divinity have a place to reside. You refuted the theologians obsessed with the void, emphasizing the importance of the flesh, and everyone was convinced. Later, everyone raised their glasses to toast your everlasting health.

Divinity, always divinity. Sorcerers can create puppets that speak and think like humans, but they are not loved by the gods, so they will never be human. At the core of every human thought lies the pursuit of the noble, the good, and the beautiful. Your noble and eloquent demeanor conquered everyone, and they all raised their glasses to toast you for eventually standing beside the divine.

5300506.title: 祖传的……
strings: A person suddenly approaches you, showing you a bundle of old items, claiming they are treasures passed down from your ancestors and asking you to buy them back. You inspect them; some are good, some are clearly fake, but some seem worth appreciating.
I'll take it all
I Only Want the Best
You thief
No, I’m not interested
You boldly took out a large sum of money and told him you wanted it all.
There are indeed some notable items here. You picked out a few delicate trinkets related to your family and decided to buy them.

You carefully examined the trinkets, noticing they bore signs of being buried underground for a long time. So, you threatened to throw the guy in jail. He resisted fiercely, but of course, he couldn't beat your guards. You took everything, losing only a bit of reputation in the eyes of some.
These items were somewhat interesting but not worth the price, especially considering the many expenses you have now. You declined his offer, and he left in a huff.

5300507.title: 妻子的梦
strings: This morning, Maggie seemed very troubled. She said she had a nightmare where she was on a small boat with a dog, a rope, and a flute. The boat was drifting on the sea, and she felt increasingly afraid but didn’t know how to use these three items. She seeks your comfort. How would you explain the dream?
It's a lucky dream
It's an ominous dream
It's a self-reflection dream
You’re just confused

You embrace her and tell her everything will be fine.
The dog represents a faithful companion, the rope represents a means to an end, a way out; and the flute is the Wife's favorite instrument, symbolizing joy and leisure. Even if she feels her life is drifting like a boat on the sea, with a companion, a way out, and joy, she is sure to find happiness.
Hearing your words, she smiled gently, her eyes filled with love.

You look into your Wife's beautiful eyes and tell her, it might be an omen.
The dog represents a barking troublemaker, the rope symbolizes a noose, and the flute is the jester's favorite, pleasing the monarch. These three things combined will bring storms, destroying the small boat.
Hearing your words, she clings tightly to your arm and asks what to do. You try to comfort her, telling her you will be extremely careful to prevent this dream from coming true.
You both snuggle together for a long time, finding some sense of security from each other's warmth, until she stops trembling.

You smile and hold your Wife's beautiful face, telling her not to worry, that the dream stems from her deep-seated anxiety and fear, and has no significant meaning.
Dogs can be both servile and vicious, ropes can save a person or strangle them, and the flute is both her favorite instrument and the jester's delight. These three things, along with the small boat drifting at sea, all symbolize her anxiety about the future.
Hearing your words, she buries her head in your chest and asks playfully, what should she do then? You stroke her hair, telling her that no matter what, you will always be there for her.

You find it really boring to dwell on the meaning of a dream. A dream is just a dream, no matter how bad it is, can it be worse than your current life?
Maggie is very disappointed with your indifference and hasn't spoken a word to you for three whole days.

5300508.title: 以神之名
strings: Someone beats drums and gongs at your doorstep, singing hymns loudly. As you open the door, a group of children shower you with white flowers and shout 'Hooray' and 'Thank you.' Before you figure out what's going on, they pull out a donation banner 'for the pure children'...
Donate a large sum
Donate a little
Give nothing
This is a great opportunity to gain fame, and besides, you genuinely want to help these children in need.
They seem determined not to let you leave without a donation. After some consideration, you decide to give them some money...

Yes, you don't plan to give a penny. The clerics and children just stare at you, and you stare back, the standoff lasting for quite some time. Finally, the clerics left in frustration, loudly mumbling about how the irreverent will go to hell, and you instructed your servants to shut the door tightly, so as not to be disturbed by such nonsense.

5300509.title: 躲雨的人
strings: It's about to rain heavily, and a group of passing travelers hope to rest under your roof. They look weary and travel-worn. However, you notice faint bloodstains on the hems of their cloaks and the outlines of weapons under their tarps. They are certainly not ordinary Merchants... you decide?
Arrest them
Kill and loot them
Welcome them

Believing them to be rebels hiding in the city, you feign hospitality and invite them to join your feast, secretly sending someone to alert the High Constable. Soon, they are caught in one fell swoop, proving your loyalty to the Sultan.

You deceitfully invited them to join your feast, only to strike them down once they let their guard down. The exhausted travelers barely resisted and became victims under your blade. Unfortunately, their meager goods contained only a bit of grain and a few broken Weapons, better than nothing.

They might be rebels or bandits, but at this moment, they were merely travelers seeking rest in your eyes. You welcomed them, provided them with a warm dinner and beds to sleep in. They left, profoundly grateful for your help.

5300510.title: 行脚僧
strings: A strangely dressed itinerant monk claimed that you have a connection to the god he worships, and wanted to give you an ancient statue. The statue had a serene and compassionate look, but you always felt something was off about it...
Accept the statue
Politely decline
Rebuke loudly
