For days, you couldn't sleep well and felt groggy upon waking. Until one day you accidentally killed a servant... The blood calmed you down for a short time, and you quickly asked someone to get rid of the strange statue, throwing it as far away as possible. However, many people still think that your excuse is just an excuse to cover up the crime...

You politely declined the statue. However, for several days, you were plagued by evil whispers in your dreams. You rebuked, struggled, cursed, and fled in your nightmares until... seven days later, your nights returned to peace, as if nothing had ever happened.

You loudly rebuked the cultist in public for trying to lead you down an evil path and undermining your faith in God. You urged everyone to reject such a gift from the devil, and the crowd, convinced by your speech, saw you as undeniably pious and virtuous.

5300511.title: 喝醉的同僚
strings: A colleague from the court came to your home for a feast. Probably having drunk too much, he drunkenly vented his grievances to you and began to recklessly complain about the Sultan...
Pretend nothing happened
Criticize the crimes together
Distance yourself from him
Report to the Sultan

You pretended not to hear the words and had his servant quickly send him home. Early the next morning, the colleague stood at your door, pale-faced and wearing a flattering smile. He warmly shook your hand, hoping you would forget last night's events, admitting he was truly drunk and confused. You felt the outlines of several Gold Coins in your palm. Very well, you decided to give him the benefit of the doubt.

Sultan, Sultan, the source of all the kingdom's pain is him! That tyrant acting with impunity, that depraved demon king!... You vented your frustrations in a drunken tirade. Fortunately, there was no third person in the room... No, even if there were, how could it matter? Who in this world could honestly disagree with you?

My goodness, how dare he slander his monarch, his master? Even if it's true, he shouldn't speak so recklessly! This fool will bring about his own demise, and yours too! You hurriedly escorted him out of your room and permanently removed his name from the guest list. No one asked why, and people continued to flock around you.

My God, how dare he betray his monarch, his master? This is truly intolerable!

The next day, in court, you publicly announce his crimes. He collapses to the ground, trembling, defending himself by claiming he was drunk, swearing up and down that he dared not harbor disloyalty.

The Sultan is in good spirits on this day and does not execute him publicly but instead imprisons him. Maybe you can even visit him.

5300512.title: 商队投资
strings: A strange merchant invites you to invest in their caravan. They plan to depart soon, traveling along the coast to transport Eastern goods to the distant North... If they arrive smoothly, a hefty profit awaits. However, long-distance trade journeys are always fraught with various risks...
Invest heavily
Firmly refuse
Express doubt

The people on the distant northern coast adore spices, ceramics, and all sorts of shiny trinkets from the mysterious East. Almost anything can fetch ten times the price there. You believe there is indeed substantial profit in this, so you decide to invest some funds.

You don't want to take any unnecessary risks. Besides, even if it does make money, you can't afford to wait so long. You insist you have no money to invest in his project, leaving the merchant disappointed. Shortly after, word gets out, and everyone knows you're broke. Some unknown benefactor even pityingly tossed a few Gold Coins into your wall...

For safety reasons, you ask the merchant to prove his identity, ask for his documents and inquire about the goods they have prepared. In the end, he stammers and hurriedly leaves. They might have been swindlers or smugglers, but either way, your Property remained unscathed...

5300513.title: 午夜美人
strings: At midnight, you hear a knock on your door. A young, beautiful woman dressed seductively appears shyly asking to spend the night with you...
Follow the Trend
Stay Strong
Unveil the Truth

You swear you initially didn't intend to do anything, but things got out of hand... after a night of passion, you even consider... making her your Wife? Wait... you wake up abruptly, disbelieving that your Wife is sleeping beside you. Where did the woman who shared your bed go? Is she still your Wife, or... no...

You refuse to let the woman in and quickly shut the door. It’s too late at night, isn’t it? Maggie would definitely be angry if she saw you entangled with this woman. The next day, Maggie tells you that a man nearby died in his sleep mysteriously, looking as if his soul was sucked dry... you shiver, unsure if it has anything to do with the midnight beauty.

You painstakingly avert your gaze from her face, and only then do you notice the bright moonlight illuminating both of you, yet she casts no shadow! The woman freezes, seemingly unable to accept this, screaming as she vanishes.
The next day, you discuss it with your Wife, who tells you with a strange expression that recently many men seem to have died by the hands of this spirit seeking a lover... You might have done a good deed after all – the woman is freed, and men need no longer endure such futile temptations...

5300514.title: 神秘的符号
strings: Your farmers are worried because someone has recently drawn many mysterious symbols near their homes... Perhaps wise Master, you can find something out?
These are mysterious runes
These are thieves' marks
Post an advertisement for tax collection
Stop bothering me

You went to the location described by the farmers and discovered complex and mysterious runes that seemed to have an inexplicable pattern... The longer you stared at them, the more they appeared to be able to respond to you, flickering, floating, calling you... Oh no, not now... You quickly averted your gaze and ordered someone to take rubbings of the runes to bring back to your study. You plan to study them carefully...

You determined that these were marks made by thieves, indicating that a house had only one woman during the day and that tomorrow they could act... In any case, you warned everyone to be vigilant and ordered the runes to be erased.

Someone dared to scribble and post advertisements near your estate? You ordered the guards to watch by the wall and impose a tax of one Silver coin for any caught. Since then, the runes have never reappeared. Similar troubled nobles were enlightened and followed suit, making a little pocket money.

Farmers should just focus on farming, why are they worried about such trivial matters? You beat them and drove them away, telling them not to bother you with such petty issues. However, the problem wasn't truly resolved... Their fields inexplicably produced less, but no one dared anger you again. They used every means, even selling their young daughters, to scrape together this year's taxes...
Such cold-hearted rule made you infamous.

5300515.title: 骗子登门
strings:
A lavishly dressed man suddenly appeared at your door, gesturing to indicate he was an exiled foreign prince and hoping for your support to return home, promising a reward afterward.
Whether or not there would be a reward, you knew there was definitely a trick...
Expose him
Dog Eat Dog
Use him.

You ruthlessly exposed his identity, clearly not a foreign prince. From countless details, you could tell he had nothing to do with nobility, just a clown pretending. Hmph, lucky for him he met you today; otherwise, he might have been beaten up. The obviously flawed conman begged for mercy, promising never to do it again...

You pretended to believe him, but while he was distracted, you Blackjack him cold. Unfortunately, apart from his rather refined clothes, he had nothing else of value... No wonder he dared to scam you in desperation. Too bad for him. You snorted coldly and ordered someone to throw him into the alley to fend for himself.

You needed to spread your good reputation; what could be better than supporting a real foreign prince? You came up with a plan.
First, you told the Swindler you had seen through his scheme but wouldn't expose him. You would host a grand feast to entertain him, then send him on a distant journey. You'd teach him noble tricks to ensure he wouldn't be caught out, and he had to split the money he conned with you... Fortunately, his acting didn't disappoint you.

5300516.title: 邻居投诉
strings: Your neighbor, a scholar, complained that your feast was too noisy, interrupting his creative flow and preventing him from finishing his great work!
Cancel the feast
Ask him to move
Ignore him
Deafen him
What could be more important in this world than academic research? It's just a few paused feasts after all, nothing major. However, people quickly got used to no longer gathering under your roof.

The feast is an extremely important sociability occasion for you, and you cannot compromise on this point. But he can move to another quiet residence until he finishes his work. You half-threaten and half-sincerely tell him that you still have some Influence in the city and can help him find a suitable place. The scholar, knowing that further entanglement would lead to nothing, leaves in indignation.

Your feast is definitely going to happen; as for the scholar, who cares! If he can't finish his manuscript, he'll figure out what to do, even if it means heading to a quiet prison.
You harshly kick the scholar out of your house, and no matter how furious he is, there's nothing he can do. This soon becomes a well-talked-about topic at the feast, highlighting your Influence in the city.
Great, now he won't complain about the noise, will he? This is truly a once-and-for-all solution! You smile like a devil.

5300517.title: 邻居著作
strings: Your neighbor, the scholar, finally finished his masterpiece. He gave you a copy of the manuscript and thanked you for your tolerance. He left your name in the preface of the book, which made you famous in the academic world.

5300518.title: 苏丹的金苹果
strings: The Sultan, in a whimsical mood, asks you to judge the most beautiful female in his harem...
The woman who has been with you the longest
The newest addition to your collection
Your next woman

You say this because the woman who has been with him the longest often holds more power and is harder to offend... Hearing your answer, the Sultan bursts into laughter and tells a string of dirty jokes, then dismissively waves you away like a dog.
Although you didn't win his favor, at least you didn’t make an enemy, which makes it a good day.

Your answer makes the Sultan burst into laughter. He pulls the woman by his side and asks what she thought. She laughs along, saying, "Your subject is right," which makes The Sultan even happier. In the Lapis Lazuli Palace, only his laughter echos, and everyone bow their heads, daring not to speak.

Later, The Sultan casually tosses you a gold slipper as a reward for your clever answer.

The Sultan seems surprised at your response. He is momentarily stunned, then pats the armrest of his throne, laughing heartily. He continuously praises your answer and then begins imagining which towns or countries to conquer next to turn their princesses and noblewomen into the Sultan's concubines. He laughs greatly and is immensely pleased – your previous mistakes now seems insignificant, and you once again become his most favored subject.

5300519.title: 贸易路线
strings: Envoys from a neighboring country come to request permission from the Sultan to establish a trade route. They want to transport the rice and spices from the Sultan’s lands to their own country. This trade deal is certainly beneficial, but the neighboring country is experiencing a famine, making price negotiations tricky...
Demand full payment
Offer them a discount
Negotiate earnestly

You are a servant of the Sultan, and your mission is to fill the Sultan's treasury. Although the starving people of neighboring countries are pitiful, they are unfortunate not to be subjects of the Great Sultan. After hearing your statement, the envoy from the neighboring country left without a word. The Sultan is very pleased with you.

You know the Sultan will definitely not be pleased with your words – because you promised to help the neighboring country with favorable prices to get through the famine quickly. The envoy leaves with endless gratitude, and you still stand in the Lapis Lazuli Palace, pretending not to notice the icy gaze behind you.

You carefully explain the reasons for refusal. The Sultan's country is not bountiful this year; the grain available is limited, and the price can't be very cheap either. Instead of trading here, it would be better to try relocating some famine victims to the territory of nomads, where water and grass are abundant, and it's still the right season to cultivate new fields. The envoy understands that this is the best you can do, bows to you, and leaves the Sultan's palace.

5300520.title: 吉兆
strings: A noble presents the Sultan with a strange beast: it has the head of a deer, the body of a leopard, and the tail of a pheasant. The Sultan is very intrigued by the creature and asks you how to interpret it.
It's a deception
This is a good omen
This is a bad omen

While the noble was unaware, you stepped forward and grabbed the antlers, shaking them vigorously. The seams of the leopard body split, and the monstrosity collapsed into several pieces. The noble stared at the floor, pale and speechless. The Sultan lazily waved a finger, and the guards dragged the poor soul, who had hoped to win the monarch's favor, out.
Courtiers whispered, incredulous – even the scammer himself – at your audacity. Your daring act became a favorite tale among the common folk for quite some time.

Emboldened by your Support, the Noble stood taller and prouder. The Sultan nodded and instructed the monstrosity to be taken to the treasury. Later, you and the Noble continued to praise and fabricate prophecies of good omens, until the Sultan grew tired of it. 
Some disdain your sycophancy, but it matters not; the Sultan is very pleased with you.

With a grave expression, you told the Sultan that a leopard-bodied bestiary always heralds bloodshed within the palace and that only by burning it could the disaster be averted.
Thus, flames arose in the palace square, the stench of burning flesh lingered... You breathed a sigh of relief, having noticed that the beast was sewn together. Yet, a chill climbed your spine; perhaps it was an illusion, but in the thick smoke, the beast's eyes seemed to open, staring intently at you...

5300521.title: 两个丈夫
strings:
A wanton Noble lady demands the Sultan's judgment on her marriage. She married a Noble, but the husband, feeling insecure about his performance in bed, secretly had his brother fulfill his marital duties. The Noble lady didn't realize that the nightly visitor wasn't her husband until her husband died unexpectedly in a fall, and the unaware brother sneaked into her bedroom that very night!
Now, the enraged and grieving Noble lady demands the entire property of her deceased husband's family – including the brother's share – as compensation for the family's deceit.
Support her claim
Oppose her claim
Why don't you two get married?

Empathizing with her plight, you agree that this was a great humiliation... With your support, the noble lady is deeply moved, breaking down at the Sultan's feet to pour out her sorrow, leaving her husband's brother extremely embarrassed.
In the end, the woman receives a large sum of wealth, enough to erase the painful memory. She gifts you an rare treasure as a token of gratitude for your support.

While the husband acted wrongly and met an unfortunate end, not only did he miss out on tender nights with his beautiful wife, but he also broke his neck... However, the family's property doesn't belong to him alone; his opportunistic brother also has a share.
You argued persuasively, allowing the brother to retain his rightful portion. He was very pleased and rewarded you handsomely for your efforts.

You study the expressions of the two individuals, cautiously suggesting: Why don't the noble lady and the deceased's brother try it out? This way, she can continue as the mistress of the house, and the brother won't be deprived of all property, plus, she seems quite satisfied with her nighttime visitor, doesn't she?
At your words, the two are first stunned, then angry, and eventually both fall silent.
Courtiers whisper, having various opinions about your suggestion, but it is clear that people regard you as a smart person who can solve all sorts of problems.

5300522.title: 奇异的机械
strings: A peculiar man claiming to be an inventor seeks an audience with the Sultan, presenting a mechanical bird crafted from metal. The bird can tell time, fly, and preen its feathers. He hopes the Sultan will buy it with its weight in gold.
You dare ask the Sultan for payment?
This talent is worth its weight in gold
I don't see how this bird is useful to the Sultan

The inventor was terrified by your stern rebuke; he quickly explained that he only hoped to get some funds to continue his research. But you questioned him again, would the Sultan let his loyal craftsmen lack resources? As long as he promised to dedicate everything to the Sultan, what is a few Gold Coins? The Sultan smiled and nodded, requesting the craftsman to offer the bird as tribute.
The inventor, with tears in his eyes, complied. As he handed it over, the mechanical bird’s clockwork eyes slightly shuddered, appearing to cry too.
The Sultan was very pleased; this was sufficient.

As soon as you said this, the Sultan, also quite interested, spoke, 'Since you appreciate his talent so much, surely you don’t mind paying a little too?'
So, you had to buy this damned bird out of your own pocket and then present it to the Sultan...

The Sultan has countless Slaves to report the time for him, numerous officials to answer his questions, innumerable stunning women to perform for him – what use is this bird? The inventor was speechless to your question, and you drove him away.
Perhaps, many years later, he will understand that being favored by the Sultan is not necessarily a blessing, but until then, the people of the palace clearly think you are an arrogant jerk.

5300523.title: 不敬之书
strings:
Someone presented a popular booklet from the market, which told a legendary love story between a king and a fallen princess. In the story, the princess, having lost her country, has to work as a washerwoman. She meets the handsome monarch by the river while washing clothes, and the two overcome many difficulties to find happiness.
The Sultan asked what you think of this matter...
This is a praise to the Sultan.
This is a slander against the Sultan.
This is just a woman's pastime.

You emphasized the description of the 'king' Character in the book – handsome, strong, robust; doesn’t this perfectly resemble the real Sultan? All the young girls see the Sultan as their dream lover, isn't that natural? Listening to your explanation, the Sultan smiled and never mentioned this trivial matter again.
As you were leaving the palace, a Merchant, reeking of ink, waited for you at the door. He handed you a heavy bag and thanked you profusely.

You reacted with great anger. The book depicts the king as a weak fool, ignoring his national duty and involved with a past enemy, actually suggesting that a dignified ruler would need to grovel to a washerwoman for love! This is our enemies trying to tarnish the almighty Sultan's image in the eyes of the people, and they must be severely punished! 
The Sultan, after hearing your words, seemed thoughtful. He gestured and gave some instructions to the guards. 
Probably some people will lose their lives because of this. You wiped off your sweat. At least, the Sultan was very pleased with you.

After flipping through a few pages, you casually tossed the book aside, saying as lightly as possible that this is just a woman’s trifle, your wife occasionally reads such things as well.
You did everything you could to convince the Sultan that women are short-sighted, brainless fools, and the things they focus on are not important. Of course, deep down, you knew the exact opposite is true—a woman drawing water at the well might know more than the Sultan on the golden throne.
But fortunately, the Sultan accepted your words, mumbled his agreement, and never brought up this topic again.
You, the author of the book, the printer of the book, the seller of the book... many, many people kept their heads.

5300524.title: 河流的方向
strings:
A river that flowed through the territories of two Nobles suddenly changed its course recently. Now it flows through one Noble’s land but hardly through the other’s. The latter presented this matter to the Sultan, requesting an adjustment of their land borders. He is willing to cede a larger piece of land in exchange for the area where the river flows.
The Sultan asked what you think about this matter...
We should respect the river's will.
People without the river are very pitiful.
Leave everything to the blade.

Since the river is changing course, it shows that it's tired of that noble, right? When you say that, the noble is furious while the other noble laughs happily. He nonchalantly walks to your side and chats casually. From now on, he will be your ally at court.

As for the one who loses the river, his territory will soon wither, and he himself will naturally not appear in court, causing trouble for you.

You trade double the land for a piece of land with a river running through it, thinking this is fair. After all, how can people survive on land without a river?
You forced both parties to sign a fair agreement and promised to personally oversee its implementation, finally calming things down.
The noble is very grateful to you, but his opponent is spreading slander about you.

You step in front of the guard, draw his sword, and throw it between the two nobles, telling them to let the blade decide.
The Sultan is entertained, clapping his hands and urging them to fight to the death. The two nobles nervously pick up the sword, trying to maintain their dignity, and then begin to fight fiercely.
Ultimately, one will survive covered in the other’s blood, winning the land and the river. But apart from the Sultan, no one in the palace will cheer for this.

5300525.title: 苏丹的梦
strings: The Sultan had a strange dream that left him unsettled. He asked you to interpret the dream for him. In the dream, the Sultan saw a beautiful woman standing on the edge of a cliff. As he approached her, she began to slowly jump off the cliff, and he ran to see her shattered body below. Then, he suddenly saw the woman standing next to him again, jumping off the cliff and shattering once more. This scene repeated countless times until he finally woke up.
It's a good omen
It's a bad omen
You've been working too hard for the country...

Countless people fell to their deaths before the Sultan, yet the Sultan remained unharmed. Isn’t this a good omen? This dream indicates that no matter how dangerous the situation, the great monarch will always turn peril into safety.
Hearing your explanation, the Sultan nods thoughtfully. The ministers breathe a sigh of relief... Thankfully you were here, or who else could have resolved the tyrant's wrath?

You cautiously asked how many women were in the dream, wondering if the Sultan still remembered. The palace fell silent, as everyone knew that the defeated Sultan of Hukakassus had nine beautiful daughters, who committed suicide together after their country was destroyed...
Before the Sultan could get angry, you hurriedly grabbed the priest and performed a series of exorcism rituals. After the rituals were completed, the Sultan was finally satisfied and rewarded you with some gold.
You just hope he doesn’t have that dream again tonight. You wiped the sweat from your forehead, warning yourself to keep your mouth shut next time.

You wouldn’t remind the Sultan of the dream's omen. After all, everyone knew that the defeated Sultan of Hukakassus had nine beautiful daughters, who committed suicide together after their country was conquered...
You flattered the Sultan, assuring him that he was overworked and that it was only affecting his sleep. You recommended some beautiful girls and various entertainment spots, but he remained disinterested.
After exhausting your speech, with a dry throat, the Sultan finally waved you away.
However, as you left the palace, you couldn’t help but look back and were shocked to see nine pale girls in the shadows where sunlight couldn’t reach.

5300526.title: 苦水
strings: Recently, several wells in the royal city have suddenly turned bitter, prompting many complaints. The Sultan asks for your opinion...
Dig new wells
Supply water from outside the city
Endure it
Investigate the non-bitter water wells

These wells were left by the previous king, and over the years they have gotten deeper and deeper. It would be better to survey new locations and dig fresh wells. You specifically mention that a beautifully decorated well is needed in front of the Sultan's palace, and fetching water from it should require a fee to the royal treasury.
The Sultan is very pleased with your suggestion.

There is plentiful water in the rivers outside the city. By transporting this water into the city for sale, not only can this problem be solved, but it can also bring about a small profit, right? Of course, the water is a gift from the heavens to the great Sultan, so the money should also belong to the Sultan.
The Sultan is very satisfied with your proposal and rewards you with some money, laughing.

Wells occasionally experience this, but the nobles have their private wells, so the commoners just endure it. A few days of bitter taste in their mouths, but what's the big deal? Their lives are already bitter enough!
The Sultan is amused by your witty remark, so despite others' complaints, the matter is put to rest.

Why does the well water taste bitter? You sense something is not simple.
After investigation, you discover that some well owners deliberately put lime in others' wells! Such despicable tactics have recently doubled their earnings, at the cost of bitter-tasting water for the entire city.
The issue is resolved, and some people are punished, but since you blocked others' income, it's understandable they bear grudges...

5300528.title: 痴心妄想
strings: For reasons unknown, the Sultan has been looking at you with a gloomy and cold gaze, filled with a certain murderous intent... Although you cannot figure out what you did to displease him, you should know what to do next, right?

5300529.title: 友情提示（废弃）
strings: Will you advise Nabhani
Let it go

5300530.title: 出让钥匙
strings:
Nabhani approached you, hands empty, confusing you.
"The key's gone, that golden key to paradise, I gifted it."
You were aghast, about to question him – 
"Not to a man, it's beyond any man's worth, I entrusted Madam Buthayna; directing her to assign it to different courtesans per party, letting them choose their favored guest…" He winked, excitement glowing, "Imagine, their first time having a choice, imagine who they might choose?" 
Then embracing, he promised a spot at any courtesan party.
Though delighted for the courtesans, immutable facts prevented worry's release… you hoped the Sultan forgot his committed agreements when convinced.

5300533.title: 想开妓女的游戏但大伙都不在了
strings: All the girls are gone, and I'm only realizing it now. Nabhani let out a weary sigh, gave you a meaningful look, then walked away without another word.

5300534.title: 想开妓女的游戏但大伙都被赎身了
strings: You've bought the freedom of every star performer at the House of Delights! The remaining courtesans were too intimidated to accept the golden key... Eventually, Buthayna had to intervene and retrieve it herself. As for Nabhani... he promptly dismissed the entire affair from his thoughts.

5300535.title: 妓女的游戏开起不来的其它状况
strings: The entertainment with the Ladies of Delights never got off the ground, and Nabhani offered no explanation. Perhaps it's just as well... you felt a quiet sense of relief.

5300536.title: 监听奈布哈尼追随者tag，移除时关闭不可靠的盟友系列

5300537.title: 银趴前提示语
strings: Embark on an adventurous fling with Nabhani, but instinctively realize this indulgence in the Sultan's Game could bring savagery, chaos, and a fate beyond ordinary acceptance - are you sure you want to do this?
Yes, I will
Forget it
Dear friend, no matter what happens next, please don't scream.

Forget it? Nabhani looked at you disappointedly—yet quickly smiled: Good brother, what I do is what you do! I've got the Carnality Card covered!
That evening, whatever happened, every prostitute in the House of Delights was calling out [player.name]'s name...
The Sultan felt tricked, but without evidence, reluctantly allowed you to void the Sultan Card.

5300540.title: 追击豺狼帮
strings: Riel has found the hideout of the Jackals remnants and mobilized all her forces, determined to wipe them out in one fell swoop, leaving no one alive!

5300541.title: 吃掉他的肝脏
strings:
Riel captures the new leader who rallied the Alley Jackals' remnants, cutting open his stomach before everyone and pulling out a bloody piece... 
Just as she's about to stuff it in her mouth, she looks up and smiles at you: "Hey, city dweller, want to share?"
Let me taste!
I'd rather not...

5300542.title: 我要去妓院2！
strings:
Riel comes to you aggressively this day. Behind her, two strong enforcers vigilantly observe the situation, while someone stays by her side, constantly keeping one hand on their knife hilt. 
"Hey, I heard something that makes me feel I should do something, but can't. I hate this feeling, so I came for your help - since you're the craftiest city dweller I know." She winks at you, an expression mixing intimacy with contempt. "You probably frequent brothels, right?" 
Before you can answer, she waves dismissively, as if the answer doesn't matter. 
"My people tell me some of my tribe have been taken to a place called 'House of Delights' - a brothel, filthy place." She says, "I want to charge in and rescue them - my people learn killing and hunting from childhood, not spreading their legs! But... uh, the place has tight security, tighter than the Jackals, I'd say." 
"Help me get inside. I'll repay you." She stares at you directly, her tone completely unapologetic.

5300543.title: 枪姬众
strings:
Riel comes to find you, followed by rescued barbarian girls. Their faces bear dark red war paint, wearing armor like Riel's, carrying strange long spears. 
"The slave hunters who brought us to this city all work for the same person... I can't believe I didn't think to seek revenge earlier. I'm stupid! Stupid like a city dweller!" 
Perhaps realizing these words might offend you, she scratches her neck awkwardly. "Anyway, I've discovered who he is. This guy belongs to a hunting band specializing in capturing our brothers and sisters as slaves. This band must die. I'll take over everything they have, and I'll eat their livers." 
She says fiercely: "I'm gathering strength for this, which takes time. If I succeed, I'll become the most powerful gang in this city. If I fail, city dweller, would you burn our bodies and scatter the ashes in the westward wind? It will carry us home, and our ancestral spirits will thank and protect you." 
You agree to her request.

5300545.title: 追查猎奴人
strings:
Riel and her gang come to find you. Now they look like a disciplined force. She gets straight to the point: "That matter we discussed - the time has come." 
"I must find that slave hunter, but - " her face shows rare frustration: "During this time, I've searched house to house, beaten information out of mercenaries, bought information with money - tried everything, but it's not working... I can't find him." 
She spits in frustration, "They've angered so many people that they're hiding! But I know you're the most resourceful person in the underworld. If you help me this time, I promise when you need me and my sisters, we'll help you with everything we have."

5300547.title: 处置猎奴人
strings: You choose to believe he's told you everything he knows. Since he's useless now, Riel licks her lips and asks if she can now eat his liver. She's been waiting so long.
Just... handle it yourself, but be discreet
Let him go, not worth it
You nod to Riel, then leave the room, not wanting to witness this primitive brutality.

Since he cooperated and told you everything he knows, you shouldn't be so harsh from a moral standpoint. You suggest releasing him - he's betrayed his master, has many enemies and people watching him. This is punishment enough... 
Riel reluctantly accepts your reasoning.

5300548.title: 微妙的感谢
strings: Someone anonymously sends you a bag of gold... no explanation given.

5300550.title: 奴隶暴动
strings:
Reportedly, the slave market has had issues. Their business grew too large, capturing too many slaves - finally the enslaved rebelled. Worse, hearing so many of their people were captured this way, barbarians and nomads formed troops to demand justice. 
All evidence points to the Vizier, as everyone says he's been funding the slave trade!

5300551.title: 宰相之死
strings:
The day after quelling the rebellion, Abdul commits suicide at home. He knew what was good for him - otherwise, his entire family might have died. 
No one cares about his death because all eyes focus on the vacant Vizier position he left... The court erupts in a new round of verbal battles for this chair. Finally, the Sultan grows tired. He simply points to your name, making you Vizier - since you suppressed the rebellion Abdul caused, you can handle the rest of his mess. 
The couriters are silent for a moment, then they all congratulate you with smiles, warmly interacting with you. Surrounded by flattering voices, you feel a bit elated...

5300552.title: 族长的祝福
strings: The barbarians, grateful for your rescue of their people, give you this valuable treasure - you certainly know its worth, as Riel standing beside you stares at it wide-eyed... She clearly wants it badly. Will you give it to Riel?
Show it to her
Keep it for yourself
Your wealth means you don't mind one more or less robe. You decide to give it to Riel.
Though you say this, it's actually quite comfortable to wear. After consideration, you decide to keep it. After all, they gave it to you.

5300553.title: 芮尔的匪帮助阵
strings: Riel comes to help!

5300554.title: 我叫小薇
strings: Hello! Because I lost a bet, I'm staying here to play with you! You can call me Little Wei! In front of you, the jinn appears particularly small, able to hide inside a sleeve and brush across a face like a falling leaf unnoticed. Quite useful... Hey! Where did you get that gold coin in your hand!

5300555.title: 小安留下了
strings: Hello! Because I lost a bet, I'm staying here to play with you! You can call me Little An! I'm a combat jinn! I spend my days dueling romantic rivals! Do you have many such rivals to duel? This is a rather strong jinn—with an enchanting appearance... As you look at her, you sense she's also examining your body with interest.

5300556.title: 小留留下了
strings:
Hello! Because I lost a bet, I'll stay and play with you! You can call me Iliona! This fairy extends a hand half your size, deflating at your frozen reaction - she was waiting for a hand-kissing ceremony. 
Sigh, seems there's so much to teach you! Let's do this! I'll handle court affairs for you in the future - you do have court affairs to handle, right?

5300557.title: 宰相之死
strings:
The day after quelling the rebellion, Abdul commits suicide at home. He knew what was good for him - otherwise, his entire family might have died. 
No one cares about his death because all eyes focus on the vacant Vizier position he left... The court erupts in a new round of verbal battles, while you try hiding at the back of the crowd... 
Fortunately, considering your major battlefield failure, no one dares mention your name before the Sultan...

5300558.title: 不守规矩的佣兵
strings:
In the Dark Alley, the Sultan's law is just one way to solve problems. Many other methods often require the parties themselves to figure out. 
Now, a noble finds you, begging for help with a troublesome matter. He's upset a self-proclaimed "Roaming Swordsman" mercenary in the Dark Alley by breaking rules... 
"I hired him to resolve a problem... I thought he'd intimidate her, drive her from the capital, but I never imagined he'd kill the woman and throw her head at my doorstep! Now everyone knows my mistress is dead, and I'm the murderer!" 
He gives you money, asking you to "teach a lesson" to this rule-breaking mercenary. He's arranged to meet this man in the Dark Alley. 
"They say... he's the most formidable mercenary in the Dark Alley... I wanted someone capable to handle things, I, um... Surely you can manage him, you're a powerful courtier in the Sultan's court!"

5300560.title: 烂纸头启动
strings: That Alim fellow is taking advantage again... He's found some old books, practically rags, but wants to sell them to you as antiques.

5300561.title: 锐草之地幕后
strings: There's a wasteland where stars bloom brilliantly - but covered with sharp grass, hard as blades, white as frost... That's the place mentioned in the "Builder's Guide" with a hidden passage connecting to the Homeland palace, where the Star met mortals in secret.

5300562.title: 儿子的索要
strings: The Roaming Swordsman comes to ask about an expedition

5300565.title: 剑客问询
strings: What do you want to ask him?
About the Lost Tribe
About Ascension
Why trust me?
Why now?

"Actually, the entire empire consists of homeland exiles, but... only those loyal to King Ultagi, loyal to the Gilded Blood family, will help." He sighs, "Can't blame people - commoners just want peaceful lives - that's what I concluded after twenty years as a commoner myself. As a prince, I really thought everyone should die for their country, ha, ha, ha." 
He lists several family names, all ancient families from the homeland era. They're not particularly prominent now but still flourishing. 
"If I approach them, they'll certainly help. Partly because they swore loyalty to me and my father, partly because they know they won't have good lives in the Sultan's realm, especially under the current Supreme Sultan... If I succeed, they naturally become high nobles."

"I don't want to be king, much less Sultan - or any administrator." He stares at you directly, seemingly gauging whether you believe him. "The reason I'm plotting this with you is precisely because I think you're more suitable than me." 
He points to the Blade of Lament. "Just carrying this sword lets you claim to be the legitimate Gilded Blood heir, giving legitimacy to restoration. Despite my appearance, I truly am a prince - old Kook told me all this."

"Ah, good question." He lazily scratches his ear. "Probably because... you're the only one among the Sultan's courtiers who's established Notoriety in the Dark Alley. Your Influence side lets you approach the Sultan, making our plan feasible... while your embrace of the Dark Alley makes me think... perhaps we can understand each other." 
He folds his arms, grinning. 
"Besides, even if you betray me, being killed by a formidable opponent like you means at least I won't die like my father, at the hands of nobodies."

You ask why, after twenty years as a nameless Roaming Swordsman, he now resolves to seek revenge. 
"Hahaha..." he laughs, scratching his chin. "I don't know either. I thought I'd drift through life this way, never thinking about revenge. After all, I don't want to be king or Sultan - I love being a Roaming Swordsman! Once old Kuk and the others die, no one will pressure me anymore. I can do what I want, live how I want, die how I want." 
Then he snaps his fingers, rubbing his wrist, seemingly preparing difficult words. 
"Then... I saw mother's... belongings. I thought, if I completely give up, after old Kook dies, after I die, no one will know about Mekana, about King Ultagi. Only that tattered handwritten booklet - all other history... all names, erased by the Sultan's scribes. Our existence reduced to such little evidence, a few broken plates, broken slippers, gone." 
He straightens up, eyes gently meeting yours - eyes seemingly not belonging to his alcohol-ravaged body, eyes belonging to a prince. 
"I don't want to be forgotten. We were good people. Good people shouldn't be forgotten." He says softly.

5300567.title: 剑客无可杀之人
strings: The Roaming Swordsman no longer appears in this country

5300568.title: 消除一个苏丹的猜忌
strings: Given your merit in presenting relics from the previous dynasty, the Sultan's suspicion diminishes somewhat.

5300569.title: 誓言之证1升2
strings: The Testament to Bygone Oaths has changed

5300570.title: 誓言之证2升3
strings: The Testament to Bygone Oaths has changed

5300571.title: 誓言之证3升4
strings: The Testament to Bygone Oaths has changed

5300572.title: 敦请圣像
strings:
To prevent your bothering him with divine matters, the Roaming Swordsman offers a lead.
He tells you their Highland people's Highlord left one trace in this world - the only remaining trace.
He embellishes wildly, claiming you'll receive various treasures - obviously he simply wants to send you away. However... perhaps this warrants investigation...

5300575.title: 妻子成为秘教徒后定期消除妻子的不满的仪式

5300576.title: 疯狂面具
strings:
Today, the Roaming Swordsman stuffs a mask into your palm. Crudely made with unpolished burrs, painted with wild totems that make your hair stand on end...
"Made it like that god you mentioned - here's your gift." He yawns cheekily, takes a wine jug from your table, and swaggers away.

5300577.title: 父亲的肉
strings:
"Darling, help me with something." After learning the Cultic God's methods, she comes to you, "Help me find my deceased father from the abyss, another realm, the underworld, anywhere... You'll agree, won't you?"
Her hands coil around your neck like snakes... You nod wisely.

5300580.title: 拜铃耶的嫉恨
strings: Perhaps your argument with Lumera was too loud that day—even Badriyyah heard about it. She approached you with rare seriousness, asking where to find that insolent girl to prove the Cultic God's power.

5300581.title: 拜铃耶的训练
strings: Badriyyah praises Inal's talent endlessly. "She's born to serve the Cultic God!" Badriyyah grabs your hand excitedly, "[player.name], you don't understand how wonderful she is - only you and she herself haven't realized... Hehe, let me help her!"

5300582.title: 拜铃耶的训练
strings: "Not enough, not enough." Badriyyah seeks Inal again, "She has much more to learn."

5300584.title: 奈布哈尼的离去
strings: Your secret cult base construction doesn't escape Nabhani's notice. He can't believe you've fallen into darkness's abyss while he remains powerless... Finally, he finds you, pours you wine, and fills his own cup. After this drink, he never returns to your side.

5300602.title: 讽刺的歌
strings: A poet kept by a nearby clan has been writing satirical poems about you lately, annoying and persistent like a fly.
Verbal sparring
Duel
Praise highly
Seek the Sultan's help

You are furious and curse the poet frantically. Your frantic state leaves a deep impression on people, and the poet quickly writes a humorous satirical poem to retaliate. Your name is accompanied by laughter for a long time.

The poet did not expect you to challenge him to a duel. He's not adept at combat and loses without suspense. You coldly pull the saber out of his heart and look around, seeing only fearful eyes. Good, no one dares to mock you now. You suddenly understand the Sultan. Fear is the best rule.

You find the poet's original manuscript and genuinely think it is excellent, humorous, sharp, and philosophical. Your high praise surprises everyone, and the poet writes a new poem praising your magnanimity after hearing this.

How dare he treat you like this? You must make him pay! Killing one poet is not enough; the clan will cultivate new ones. You make up your mind and bring a Conquest Card to the palace, hoping the Sultan can help, sending troops to utterly wipe out that clan.

5300603.title: 蛇鼠一窝
strings:
There is a dispute at the city gate. After inquiries, you learn these travelers want to enter the city for pilgrimage but cannot provide a guarantee. The guards firmly insist they might be spies and refuse entry.
A guarantee? You've never heard of a city entry guarantee. Maybe it's a new ruse by the soldiers to extort. You decide...
I will guarantee
Extort travelers
Bribe soldiers
Identify spies

The guards' forced extortion is intolerable. Protecting a few pilgrims is nothing to you.
You sneer and tell the guards that they are your guests. Due to your status, the guards grudgingly let them in with a smile.
The travelers are very grateful, and they spread your good reputation.

You walk over, pulling the few clueless travelers aside, telling them you are an important person in this city, and as long as they are willing to give you some money, you can guarantee them. Otherwise... heh... they'll have to leave.
The travelers look at each other and eventually gather enough money to give you. The guards are very repulsed with you stealing their income, but due to your status, they grudgingly let them in.

Ah, these travelers from other places have heads as thick as elm. You pull them aside and explain the twists and turns to them. The travelers, half-believing, handed the guards a few Gold Coins, and the guards' harsh tone changed to a smile and allowed them to pass. Everyone – including the guards – were very satisfied with you.

You jump out and loudly declare that these travelers are spies and must be captured and tortured! The guards look at each other in disbelief but nod anyway. Those unlucky fellows, no matter how they protest their innocence, are arrested and tortured, eventually confessing through tears that they are spies... Well, now you, the captain of the guard, and the warden have all made impressive contributions in your roles.

5300604.title: 诡异的游戏
strings: On the street, a peculiar man stops you and invites you to join a mysterious game... He tells you that if you successfully complete it, you will receive a rare treasure, and the game is very simple, with every step clearly written in this ancient manual...
Join the challenge!
Drive him away
Introduce him to the Sultan

You were born to challenge various games! You take the ancient scroll from his hand and follow the ritual steps one by one... First, extinguish all the lamps in your house on a moonless night, close all the doors and windows, with no light, no sound, facing the corner and silently count 50 numbers, then you feel a breeze touch the back of your hand, you have to go, you need to find a place to hide and play hide and seek with the wind... hehe... you seem to hear the sound of a child’s silver bell-like laughter, has she come to find you?...

The Sultan's Game is already annoying enough, who wants extra thrills in a game where the knife is already at your throat? You scold him fiercely, but he just watches you with a growing exaggerated and distorted smile. His features soon blur into a mess, and then he is swallowed by darkness in an instant, disappearing completely in front of you...

You take him to the palace and introduce him to the Sultan. However, as the beggar steps forward, a plume of black smoke rises from the Sultan's ring, and the ancient book in his hand, which supposedly recorded all the rules, disintegrates into ashes... His game lost its power.
The Sultan, bored, orders his execution. As for you... You sweat profusely, racking your brains to praise the Sultan's divine power protecting him, using all your lifelong knowledge to muddle through. However, everyone knows you did something utterly foolish.

5300605.title: 禁忌的画册
strings: Recently, a highly explicit picture book has been circulating secretly in the city, with you and the Sultan as the protagonists...
Strike hard!
Subtle hint
Consult the Sultan
Let me take a look

Such strange tastes! What a blasphemous idea! Just thinking about the contents of this book makes you feel uneasy and restless. So, you sent soldiers to confiscate all black market stores selling this book overnight, even having several copyists beheaded. After such a sensational night, everyone in the court barely held back their laughter while praising your swift action, making you the city's laughingstock, even the Sultan looked at you with some amusement...

Everyone knows that this picture book depicting your taboo love and carnal relationship with the Sultan is just a joke. They deliberately talk about it in front of you to ridicule you, but you ambiguously and meaningfully smile, neither confirming nor denying it. As a result, everyone falls silent again. For a long time, their gazes at you carry a hidden sense of awe and flattery.

This matter is of great importance... You covertly buy a copy of the picture book and present it to the Sultan, asking how to handle it. The Sultan flips through a few pages with great interest and smiles as he accepts it.
Wait, what does this mean... In an instant, you break out in a cold sweat. You can’t help but overthink, and by the time you leave the palace with the gold rewarded by the Sultan, you feel the intense gaze of your sovereign lingering on your back...

Is there such an album? Don’t you want to get one to appreciate it?... Thus, during that period, your mind is filled with those forbidden, ambiguous, and sensual images from the book... Maybe... cough, maybe one day, you can make it come true...

5300606.title: 懈怠的士兵
strings: You recently discovered that the soldiers' training performances have been extremely slack. Upon investigation, you found out that someone has been spreading an evil belief among them, teaching them to seize the comfort and glory of this world and not to worry about the crises and depravity of the afterlife...
Kill one as a warning to others
Pray to exorcise
Reiterate discipline
Let things drift

You publicly executed a soldier who secretly went to drink. Everyone was intimidated by your ruthlessness and dared not slack off again. However, after the incident spread, many people felt the punishment was too severe, that the soldier did not deserve to die...

You gathered all the soldiers and held a public prayer session with the priest. You warned everyone not to indulge in the current joy and overlook the loss of their soul's integrity, suffering in hell after death... The soldiers confessed their sins to you and swore not to repeat them.

You gathered all the soldiers and sternly admonished them to value discipline and not act recklessly. You ranted until sunset, but the soldiers felt incredibly weary from your clichés. Outwardly, they swore that you were right, but inwardly, they were already considering where to go for a drink after the meeting...

No one wants to live a hard life; it's normal to crave pleasure. Put yourself in their position, if no one slanders you to the Sultan, you absolutely wouldn't waste time getting up so early to attend court...
After a while, the soldiers finally realized, you are one of them! Their pioneer and exemplar! They began to support you even more.

5300607.title: 着火的宅子
strings: In the city, a noble's mansion suddenly caught fire! The lady of the house cried out that her pet cat was still inside, but people were holding her back, saying it's not worth risking her life for a cat...
Bravely save the cat
Loot in the flames
Call to put out the fire

She cried so heartbreakingly, you know that the cat is not just an ordinary pet to her. Without much hesitation, you stepped forward and rushed into the flames... Soon, you heard the cat's meow, and through the thick smoke, you grabbed the weak little creature and miraculously escaped the sea of fire... The lady tearfully thanked you repeatedly and said she would give you everything she had left to repay you.

Who cares about people or cats, you only care whether there is anything valuable in the unburned parts of the house... You found a bunch of nice jewelry, but as you were trying to stuff them into your pockets, someone noticed your robbery...

You called on people to help put out the fire, and under your strong leadership, people quickly divided tasks: fetching water, rescuing people... Soon, the fire was extinguished, and the woman's property was preserved to the greatest extent. However, she kept calling out the cat's name in the ashes, hoping to hear its response... You comforted her, saying that a cat’s sense of smell is more acute than a human’s, and it probably escaped before the fire broke out.

5300608.title: 询问品级
strings: A noble stopped you, hoping you could tell him the tier of himself and his archenemy. You recalled his name and made a judgment silently in your heart – he was just a Bronze tiered young man, and his archenemy, who was about to inherit the family property, would soon reach Silver tier. "Your archenemy is Silver tier, as for you..." You hesitated whether to tell the truth.
You are Stone tier
You are Bronze tier
You are Silver tier
You are Gold tier

You deliberately told him he was just Stone tier.
The young man flushed red with anger, "How is this possible!" He drew his knife in a fit of rage and challenged you to a duel. However, his knife skills were truly lacking. You deftly dodged and kicked him to the ground, and his miserable appearance made you laugh.
The young man never raised his head again and left hurriedly. Not long after, you heard that the young noble's bad temper had significantly improved and he no longer vented his anger on servants.

You honestly told him he was Bronze tier.
"Am I not as good as him?" The young man muttered in frustration. You then encouraged him, telling him that with hard work, he could also rise to Silver tier. The young man shook his head, unsure if he believed you, but gave you some money as thanks.

You cared for the young man's ego, telling him that he, like his rival, is of Silver tier and no worse than him.

"I knew it, I would never lose to him!" Encouraged, the young man left satisfied. It is said that later, he worked exceptionally hard, striving fervently, and indeed stood on equal footing with his rival without losing to the opponent.

With malicious intentions, you falsely praised him as the noble Gold tier.
"Hahahaha!! I knew it!!" The young man was overestimated and swaggered away. Soon after, you heard that he recklessly declared war on his rival and was quickly defeated, crumbling like a sand dune and losing everything...
His family, in their grief, blamed his failure entirely on you, but you didn't care at all. Hahaha, what an amusing farce!

5300609.title: 分羊
strings: Two people in the city are arguing. One claims that his neighbor stole his sheep, while the neighbor says that he abandoned the sick lamb, and if not for him taking it in and treating it, the lamb would have died in the desert... They ask you to judge who the sheep should belong to.
Original owner
Neighbor
It belongs to me
Butcher the sheep and divide the meat

You support the claim of the original owner. The sheep was his to start with, and no matter the twists in between, it doesn't change its ownership. The original owner was overjoyed, patting your shoulder and calling you a brother.

The money and effort spent treating the sick lamb is enough to persuade you that the sheep should belong to the neighbor. The neighbor thanked you for your fairness and left contentedly with his beloved lamb.

Hehe, since I came across this, this sheep belongs to me!
You laughed loudly and ordered the servants to take the sheep away, leaving the two of them standing there, staring at each other in confusion...

You've been neighbors for so many years, why ruin your relationship over such a small matter?
You smiled, took both of their hands and put them together, ordering the servants to butcher the sheep on the spot and roast it. The aroma of spices mingling with the fat of the roast lamb would make even the fiercest person put down their weapons!
They reconciled and unanimously praised your wisdom and benevolence.

5300610.title: 染血的赌约
strings: A bored noble in the city sent his two slaves into the desert, betting on which slave would live longer. Would it be the strong man who had lost an arm, or the weak woman?
Bet on male slave winning
Hold slave girl victory
Stop inhumane behavior!
Force nobles to join the game

Only one arm left, he could still do many things, but instead, he did nothing and simply waited for death. Those who bet on him winning stomped their feet in anger, accusing the noble of rigging the game. Under everyone's pressure, the noble had no choice but to return all the bets.
Thankfully, although you joined an evil pastime, at least you didn’t lose any money.
The frail woman persisted till the end. She won the game but only lived half a day longer than the other slave. People argued over the outcome of the bet, but no one cared about her life or death.

You denounced the noble for his cruel behavior, but instead were ridiculed. Slaves were his property; he could do whatever he wanted with them. Others also found you boring. They didn't invite you to join the game anymore.

Such an interesting game, why not add another player? You forced the noble to join the desert adventure game and even generously allowed him to bring some supplies. However, even so, he was still the first to die in the game.
Great, to save their own lives, no noble dared to play such a cruel game again... They only whispered ill of you in the court.

5300611.title: 商人之争
strings: A poor man complains, saying he helped his brother with all his assets to start a business, which prospered; however, the brother now refuses to share the profits. Now the brother is rich while he struggles even to provide for his daughter. The merchant angrily insists the borrowed money was long ago repaid in full.
Blame the Merchant
Blame the poor
I can support you
I can support your daughter

You accused the merchant of failing to abide by the traditional shareholder agreement. The merchant, fearful of offending a powerful minister like you, resentfully handed over the money. The poor are grateful to you.

You blamed the poor for being too greedy; not having taken the risks of trade, nor putting in effort to run the business, yet they dared to demand most of the profits, truly insatiable!
The merchant praised your fairness and discreetly gave you money as thanks afterward.
You had no intention of judging these two's actions, but you happened to have some spare money on hand... you gave the poor man a smile.

Can't afford to raise a daughter? You can help raise her, even introduce her to some affluent families willing to adopt...
That poor man fled in terror, never daring to mention this again. The merchant was elated, boasting about your prowess all around, earning you a mixed reputation.

5300612.title: 神的栖所
strings: Someone accuses their neighbor of smashing a Holy Stone he carried, said to be the dwelling of the family’s god. The neighbor vehemently accuses him of extortion, claiming it's clearly just a common broken stone!
This is extortion
This is a reasonable claim
Let me see this stone
How dare you worship foreign gods openly

You pointed out this is outright extortion, then drove the young man away.
That night, you couldn't sleep, kept hearing phantom rat gnawing sounds. The next day, your servants timidly inform you that one of your granaries collapsed for no apparent reason, and the neighbor of the young man appears to have had a mysterious fire...
While the young man gloats, denying involvement, claiming it's divine retribution and wrath.

Neighbors grudgingly paid the young man a hefty compensation. After receiving the money, that family quietly left the city. Neighbors believed they were off to deceive elsewhere, further emboldened by your leniency.
But so what, you are the ruler of this territory.

The young man presented you with that broken stone.
The young man's neighbor wasn't wrong; it does seem like an ordinary stone, except where it fractured, there appears to be strange blood-red streaks within the stone's core...
Yet, just from seeing this, that night, you dreamed of an invisible entity hungrily, and twistedly... demanding more blood from you, more and more blood...
You denounced the young man as a cultist, ordered his capture for a future holy trial... or so they say, who cares what you do with the captive later?

5300613.title: 撤回的献祭
strings: At a court meeting, a minister pleads for aid as disaster strikes his territory, seeking funds from the Sultan. The courtiers immediately mock him, saying he deserves his fate – years ago, after struggling with infertility, he made a sacred vow to a deity. He had promised to give up his third child in exchange for divine blessing. The deity answered his prayers, granting him children. But when his third child was finally born, a father's love stayed his hand from fulfilling the sacred vow. Now his lands suffer under divine wrath – punishment for his faithlessness!
You must offer your second-born son to appease this divine wrath
Bloody sacrifices must be prohibited
I can help you communicate with the god

You told him it's too late to sacrifice a child's blood, as divine punishment has already been unleashed. He now has to kill two children to appease its wrath.
The Sultan laughed, commending your wisdom, then commanded the minister to bring his two children immediately—he wanted to see their throats cut and their blood draining, staining the entire palace's lapis lazuli floor...
As for whether the calamity on the minister's territory was averted by this sacrifice? Nobody cares.

You decried the bloody sacrifice, deeming it too violent and primitive. If God were pure and benevolent, it wouldn't favor such methods. The zealot nearly jumped to argue, and you debated from dawn till dusk, growing more skeptical as you argued... What is the true face of God? If it can be defined and distorted by men, then how can it dare claim divinity?
You suggested you could mediate his communication with God, offer a consultation, which enlightened the minister’s eyes, and he gratefully promised to reward you heavily upon success.

5300614.title: 你的心中栖有魔鬼
strings: Someone knocks on your door, eerily staring: “A demon resides in your heart... It will corrode you, control you, and finally devour your soul, making you a puppet of its will... Only I can help you, only I can.” His eyes twitch nervously, “Let me cut open your chest, let me help you remove it.”
Then please
Go away, you've mistaken me for someone else
You will pay for your nonsense

No wonder! No wonder you've been plagued by headaches, chest tightness, and inability to focus...! All of it now has a reasonable explanation! You hastily invited the person inside to ask how to cure these ailments. He simply rotated his stiff eyeballs and repeated: "Let me cut open your chest."

You chased that lunatic away. Whether it was his gibberish or not, you spent the next few days feeling terribly ill, often hearing the hollow echo of your own heartbeat at night, as if someone was lightly knocking at the door of your soul, thumping and thumping...
Devil this, soul that, he's merely trying to harm you under absurd pretenses! You loudly called for the guards to arrest him. Now, it's your turn to cut open his chest!

5300615.title: 寄养子之死
strings: Someone fostered his child in a business-dealing desert tribe, believing growing up in the desert would make him strong and smart. Unexpectedly, after an unprecedented sandstorm, the tribe reports his child missing—essentially stating what everyone knows: a child cannot survive alone in the harsh desert...
Search the Remains
Offer spiritual consolation
You must pay for your foolishness and negligence
To reassure them, you dispatched a small team to search the desert for traces of the child—alive, see the person, dead, see the remains.
You decide to perform a ritual to appease the soul of a child who died unjustly in the disaster.

You looked at them coldly and thought, rather, both of them deserve to die.
You motioned for the guards to drop two knives between them. Fight it out, the winner can leave my courtyard.
They attacked each other with hatred, reluctance, anger, and sorrow, until ultimately both collapsed exhausted and dead.
Hearing about this, the Sultan lamented why you didn't invite him to witness such a spectacle? Although he said it, his light tone clearly showed satisfaction with your choice...
