5300674.title: 众筹道具-超级贝姬夫人
strings: Just another ordinary day... Wait, where's Lady Becky today?

5300801.title: 小筹启动
strings: Lately, your servants have been whispering anxiously among themselves. Upon pressing them, you learn that strange noises have been coming from the storeroom these past few days—murmurs as of many voices speaking at once. And when darkness falls... an eerie blue glow seeps from within.

5300803.title: 小筹启动诗人第一问
strings:
"I see nothing here worth singing praises for." [xiaochou.name] found you and said wearily, "A poet who cannot write verse is as useless as a mirror that reflects nothing."
"The tavern folk lately relish tales of your Carnality Cards. Perhaps asking you directly might grant me inspiration—tell me, you’ve broken so many cards, so many carnalities… who brought you the most pleasure?"
Wait, since when were there "so many carnalities"? You clearly—
You meant to refute [xiaochou.name]’s words, but then a flood of images shattered your reality like broken glass. In countless shards, you saw countless selves, countless trysts. You—oh, the thick taste of desire coiled around you, and an answer swelled in your chest, eager to break free—
The Man
The Woman
Those in high places
Smile but say nothing

"A man must do what a man must do," you said with steel in your voice.
[xiaochou.name] gave a slow nod, weighing your words. "Aye, then bring them before me. Fear not—I've no thirst for your paramours. A single question is all I require from them. No more."

"The soft swell of flesh wrapped in fat, those secret hollows and breathless sighs... a woman's charms undo me most of all," you confessed.
[xiaochou.name] gave a slow nod, weighing your words. "Aye, then bring them before me. Fear not—I've no thirst for your paramours. A single question is all I require from them. No more."

"Gender matters not. Nor face nor form. Even the sex itself is meaningless. It's about power. To watch the high and mighty writhe beneath you—that sweet fire races up your spine like a blade's kiss,” you confessed.
[xiaochou.name] let out a derisive snort. “Hah, very well, then bring them before me. Fear not—I've no thirst for your paramours. A single question is all I require from them. No more."

You pondered the question, smiling but silent.
[xiaochou.name] studied you long and hard, until at last a knowing smile crept across its face.
"Sweet dreams tonight," it said.

5300804.title: 小筹启动诗人第二问
strings: [xiaochou.name] came to you again, their expression less sullen than before. "How goes the writing lately?" you greeted [xiaochou.name]. It only scoffed. "A poet's affairs are none of your concern." Fingers idly plucking at the strings of their lute, weaving notes lovely yet tuneless, [xiaochou.name] spoke. "I've seen enough! Your deeds, others'... those hungers, laid bare in the glass. Beasts mate to breed—what of you?" [xiaochou.name] fixed you with a stare, each word measured and sharp. "Why do you indulge in carnality?"
To spawn heirs
For fleshly pleasures
For shared feelings

"The simplest fruit of carnality is breeding, in this all beasts are alike. But we inherit blood, thought and knowledge from our ancestors, add our own measure, then pass it to our children—such is the way of life. Were it not for this game, I would never..." You trailed off with a sigh, shaking your head faintly.
[xiaochou.name] seemed unconvinced, yet it chose not to challenge you. "Many I've known never spare a thought for consequences of carnality. But since you speak so... take me to meet these rare souls who ponder their offspring so carefully."

"Of course we love carnality, because it brings pleasure! The god gave us keen senses and made the mating act the sweetest bliss. Is it not our sacred right to enjoy it? If this were truly a sin, why didn't they create humans with brief, rigid mating seasons like beasts?"
[xiaochou.name] gave a slow nod. "That's precisely what I wished to know. Take me to meet more of these pleasure-seekers. I've other questions to put to them."

"Lovers grow fonder through intimate touch. Without love, intercourse is but labor of the flesh!" You explained at length, yet [xiaochou.name] wore only confusion. "Love? That I understand least of all! Why would humans surrender wealth, titles, even life for this... thing? Mirrors care nothing for it—yet you mortals cling to it like beggars to gold." [xiaochou.name] seized your sleeve. "Take me to this 'beloved' of yours. I have too many questions that demand answers."

5300805.title: 小筹启动诗人第三问
strings:
[xiaochou.name] came to you again. This time, it appeared directly in your parlor, clutching several scrolls of parchment covered in writing, seemingly deep in thought. You approached and gestured to [xiaochou.name], who looked up at you and sighed.
"I have seen much, heard much—even mimicked those poets and written much. And yet... it all feels so dull."
You took the scrolls from its hands—they were scrawled with love poems. The words were carefully chosen, but the sentiment... well, something felt off. "I cannot live without you" sounded fine enough, but "You shall not live without me either"... was that really fit for a love poem?
Just as you began to wonder if you had shown [xiaochou.name] the wrong examples of human desire, [xiaochou.name] continued: "You give it pretty names, but I see it clearly—humans are born in desire, struggle in desire, and drown in desire. I have witnessed this tale play out a thousand times. Is there nothing... fresher? Even just a little?"

5300808.title: 小筹启动智者第一问
strings:
The coins clinked as they spilled forth, a Extravagance Card snapped in twain, and once more [xiaochou.name] stood before you. It wore the garb of a scholar still, clutching a well-thumbed book, the parchment scrolls at its waist stained with ink. With a cold nod to the maid who brought tea and hookah, [xiaochou.name] fixed you with a piercing stare, brows furrowed.
"First, let me make one thing clear: mirrors were not invented by human." At your startled look, it sighed. "Like so many things, mirrors are but human's pale imitation of the world. You saw water, you saw ice, realized a smooth surface could reflect an image—and so you chased after ever smoother things... first stone, then copper, then quicksilver. Thus, I have existed across the whole span of your history. When the first ape-man smoothed his filthy hair over a pool, I was watching." You motioned for [xiaochou.name] to continue. "But coin is different. Coin is your invention—wholly, utterly yours. Nature bore no such thing! You crafted it, then raised it higher than all else—just look at how you snapped that card without a thought, as if the clatter of metal held any true meaning!"
Clearly, this creature born of mirrors held neither respect nor understanding for humans and their stinking wealth... How will you answer [xiaochou.name]? Coin springs from...
The cunning of human
The wickedness of human
The folly of human

You say nature has always been full of resources, competition and cooperation... humans merely learned to abstract it. To extract meaning, to symbolize—that is the unique wisdom of human.
"Then let me hear the thoughts of wise human—the truly wise, not those who merely wear wisdom like a cloak." [xiaochou.name] scoffed, plucking at its own garb. "Dressed like this, folk beg me to read their letters wherever I go. Your kind clings so desperately to what your eyes behold!"
You pondered carefully—what meeting could possibly impress this arrogant creature with human's wisdom...?

You smiled at [xiaochou.name]—a smile that lasted just long enough to make it uneasy. Humans weave hells ten thousand times crueler than nature's wrath with naught but coins... and still [xiaochou.name] knows nothing of it. "Then take me to these wicked ones. Show me what atrocities remain unwitnessed by mirrors." It straightened its garments with deliberate care. "Every sordid act your kind commits in shadow—I see them all, clear as day."
You pondered carefully—what meeting could possibly impress this arrogant creature with mankind's depravity...?

You burst into laughter—Aye, most things human devise are fools' work, coins and gods alike... for they were made to rule over countless greater fools! Hah!
You laughed so heartily even [xiaochou.name] grew uneasy: "Then this scholar's garb of mine seems all the more ridiculous...[player.name], show me these fools of yours. If they truly make up the bulk of humans..."
You pondered carefully—what meeting could possibly impress this arrogant creature with human's true nature...?

5300809.title: 小筹启动智者第二问
strings: [xiaochou.name] found you hunched over your coins, counting them one by one. Ever since being drawn into the Sultan's game, you'd taken to such reckonings far too often. [xiaochou.name] stood watching in silence, and it was long before you noticed your peculiar companion. "Do you take joy in tallying these glittering things?" It asked abruptly. “Humans find pleasure in coin, don’t they?"
Aye, there's joy in the earning coins
Yet spending coins brings more pleasure
Some people loathe coins, truth be told

You told [xiaochou.name] you knew not whether coin could buy joy, but this much was certain—without it, there is no joy at all. "Then show me those who delight in hoarding wealth—you, I've seen already. But in my meager understanding of your kind... joy wears many faces. Perhaps the next wretch shall stir some pity in me for your fleeting race." With that, [xiaochou.name] rose and left without another word.

You told [xiaochou.name] that coin was but cold metal—yet it could buy near anything! And the moment of purchase... that is the sweetest joy of all. "Then show me those who delight in spending wealth—you, I've seen already. But in my meager understanding of your kind... joy wears many faces. Perhaps the next wretch shall stir some pity in me for your fleeting race." With that, [xiaochou.name] rose and left without another word.

You told [xiaochou.name] that the petty affairs coin represents give headaches to many—yourself included.
"Then show me those who refuse wealth out of disgust—your honeyed words I cannot fully trust. Perhaps the next wretch shall stir some pity in me for your fleeting race." With that, [xiaochou.name] rose and left without another word.

5300810.title: 小筹启动智者第三问
strings: Another Extravagance Card snapped. As expected, [xiaochou.name] came calling once more. Rumors had reached its ears—whispers of how you wielded the Sultan's favor to grow ever more powerful... But is that the truth of it? What secret lets the esteemed [player.name] dance the blade-and-coin waltz in the Sultan's deadly game?
A taste sharper than most
A nose that smells profit like blood
The balls to spend like a drunken fool

Taste, of course! Noble taste sets you apart from the common courtiers! Wins you the Sultan's favor! Gains you allies high and low! As you boasted, [xiaochou.name] eyed you with suspicion... it demanded you introduce another friend of such refined taste—"Else how am I to know if you're full of nonsense or truly that highborn?"

Profit, of course! Master [player.name] knows best how to buy low and sell high! Everything in this world has its price—and that price is ever-changing... Grasp that tide, and all things may serve your purpose.
[xiaochou.name] studied you with keen interest—perhaps this is the secret of your kind? At any rate, [xiaochou.name] demanded you produce another profit-minded mortal for... reference.

No romance without extravagance! The key lies in squandering gold like water! While others fret over coppers, Master [player.name] strikes swift as lightning!” [xiaochou.name] eyed you with doubt—such rashness could hardly be profitable. "[xiaochou.name] demands you produce another of these... profligate mortals for study. Let us see if folly truly breeds fortune.

5300811.title: 小筹启动智者第四问
strings:
This time, you met [xiaochou.name] in your dreams.
"I must confess something," it gazed down at you like a formless shadow bleeding into the air. "Thanks to you, I better understand why humans are so... unpleasant. Shackled by flesh, cursed with minds too sharp for your fragile bodies—you reach for dreams just beyond your grasp, and every desire comes with its own torment. Were I born human... I suppose I'd be just as insufferable."
Before you could speak, [xiaochou.name] coalesced before you.
"Remember, I can twist, alter, erase your memories. Do you know why?"
You lowered your head in thought—then the answer struck. Because mortals always wish upon their reflections. Because they scrutinize the glass, despising what stares back. Why can't I be richer, fairer, lovelier? Why do these wrinkles claim me—why must I be myself?
"Ah, precisely." The Mirror laughed. "I've witnessed enough self-loathing to share it. Your bottomless hunger disgusts even me. Yet... I suppose I should finish studying your coin. A scholar ought to complete their work, no? Every last one of you dies clutching unfinished books..."
[xiaochou.name] unfurled an ornate board before you, its slot gaping for a card.
"Give me coins. Then name someone you truly care for—one whose fate is bound to yours. Let us see what fortune does to them. After all... I can always duplicate the sum."

5300813.title: 小筹启动贵族第一问
strings:
After exhausting every scheme to break this Conquest Card, you returned to your estate—only to find [xiaochou.name] waiting.
[xiaochou.gender] lounged shamelessly in your hall, puffing on your finest hookah, commanding your servants. At [xiaochou.gender(His,Her)] side lay your prized illustrated tome, its pages gilded with mica. When you entered, [xiaochou.name] barely acknowledged you with a nod, not even bothering to rise. And your servants—kneeling to enter, kneeling to leave—acted as though this were perfectly natural to serve [xiaochou.name]! "Conquest. You humans do love your petty games, don't you?" [xiaochou.gender] exhaled a cloud of smoke, the scent of caramelized resin thick in the air. Suppressing your irritation, you took a seat opposite [xiaochou.gender[(Him,Her)]. "Don't glower. I'm merely... sampling the noble experience. Power. Dominion. You humans seem addicted to such things." It leaned forward, eyes glinting. "So, [player.name], let's speak of conquest. I watched your little performance through the mirror. Isn't destruction your favorite pastime? If there were but a drop of logic in your actions, a spoonful of reason—" Facing that mocking grin, you muster a defense for human's folly...
To test one's limits
To possess more and more
To carve one's name in stone

"Conquering others is easy," you explain. "The true battle lies within oneself... And it is this very hunger for self-mastery that drives humans to... well, folly, if you will—but such folly is a luxury only the strong may afford. Very well, let me show you one such warrior worthy of the name!
"Conquest is plunder," you explain. "Wealth, lands, glory... Don't smirk—this is the way of mortal survival. There's no shame in it, no disgrace... Ah, let me furnish you with proof!

“Our lives are fleeting," you explain, "Only through conquest—any conquest—can we carve our deeds into stone, etch our names into histories... cheating death itself with monuments! Stop laughing—wait till I produce an example. Then you'll see the truth of it!

5300814.title: 小筹启动贵族第二问
strings: As you scrambled at the Conquest Card's relentless demands, [xiaochou.name] paid yet another visit. It strolled leisurely through your opulent halls, an aged servant dutifully recounting your house's history. When they reached you, the old servant bowed away, leaving [xiaochou.name] to study the trophies lining the walls. "All noble houses have these, don't they?" It traced a finger over your grandfather's silver shield. "I've often glimpsed human's follies through these armors and shields. So you hang them as boasts—because they symbolize past conquests?" You nodded, explaining these very triumphs secured your family's noble standing. "How amusing. The powerful conquer to grow more powerful... Humans are both complicated and strangely consistent." [xiaochou.name] rapped the ancient, costly shield before turning to you. "Tell me—what true merit lies in any of this?" The creature now carried itself with more arrogance than a highborn noble—quick, find a retort sharp enough to match!
To please a great ruler
To forge order that lasts
To claim more slaves

"The true purpose of conquest," you tell [xiaochou.name], "is to sate the hunger of our glorious Sultan—or any other ambitious monarch in history." [xiaochou.name] scoffs, and you laugh in turn. "Go to court, my noble friend. Witness what happens when the Sultan's appetite goes unfed."

"Conquest's greatest virtue," you tell [xiaochou.name], "is the chance to forge order from chaos—not mere plunder and ruin." You raise a hand before [xiaochou.name] can protest. "Wait. I’ll show you someon who embodies this truth."

"This world runs on chains—some men enslaving others," you tell [xiaochou.name], "And conquest? It forges those chains." You raise a hand before [xiaochou.name] can protest. "Wait. I’ll show you someon who embodies this truth."

5300815.title: 小筹启动贵族第三问
strings:
Another Conquest Card breaks in your grasp... and not without cost. As you dragged your weary bones home, [xiaochou.name] greeted you with mocking grandeur—like a Vizier prostrating before a triumphant Sultan. You quickly dismissed the bewitched servants and hissed at [xiaochou.name] to cease such deadly jests.
"Even you understand, Master [player.name]—all things demand payment," it mused. "So tell me, what is the cost of your conquests, of the cards you break and of this very game? Do humans ever pause to count the cost... or do you simply charge ahead before you know it?"
You loathe this tiresome reckoning. This time, you'll give [xiaochou.name] an answer sharp enough to cut that smirk away!
Countless imitators
Countless victims
Overwhelming burdens

"The cost of conquest… is more conquest," you tell [xiaochou.name]. "It seduces fools to repeat history, to gamble their lives for the same prize."
[xiaochou.name] arches a brow. "And yet… where are these challengers to the Sultan’s rule?" You grin. "Then let me show you something truly dangerous…"

Of course, conquest demands corpses—piled high to crown one man’s glory. The dead don’t complain. But perhaps [xiaochou.name] would prefer to question the survivors? Let’s hear what they say of the price paid.

"The heaviest cost of conquest? Responsibility." You tell [xiaochou.name]. "The weight of ruling broken men—it crushes some, drives others mad." [xiaochou.name] laughs. "And yet your nobles seem quite comfortable." You shake your head. "Then I’ll find you a noble who proves otherwise."

5300816.title: 小筹启动贵族第四问
strings:
You knew [xiaochou.name]'s doubts would never fully fade—and sure enough, it came to you... though only in dreams.
"I never desired to conquer anything—not people, not lands." The dream-version of [xiaochou.name] stood in a corridor lined with mirrors, countless reflections of you and [xiaochou.name] stretching into infinity. "But watching you struggle with conquest... it tempts me. After all, humans crown it a noble endeavor. Wrap slaughter, lust, or sheer stupidity in conquest's cloak, and suddenly, it gleams with honor." You stayed silent for a moment before replying: "That very thought proves how little you still understand us." "Really? Then now is the perfect time." [xiaochou.name]'s voice turned sly. "Thanks to you, Master [player.name], my power has grown... enough to do things you might not approve of. Watch closely—see how I conquer."
In the mirrors, every reflection of you and [xiaochou.name] blurred, warping into the faces of nobles, mercenaries, officers, and bandits you'd once brushed past. [xiaochou.name]'s influence—and yours—seeped into them like poison. You reached out to stop it—but the dream shattered first.

5300817.title: 小筹启动诗人第四问
strings:
This time, you met [xiaochou.name] in your dreams.
"I must confess something," it gazed down at you like a formless shadow bleeding into the air. "Thanks to you, I better understand why humans are so... unpleasant. Shackled by flesh, cursed with minds too sharp for your fragile bodies—you reach for dreams just beyond your grasp, and every desire comes with its own torment. Were I born human... I suppose I'd be just as insufferable."
Before you could speak, [xiaochou.name] coalesced before you.
"Remember, I can twist, alter, erase your memories. Do you know why?"
You lowered your head in thought—then the answer struck. Because mortals always wish upon their reflections. Because they scrutinize the glass, despising what stares back. Why can't I be richer, fairer, lovelier? Why do these wrinkles claim me—why must I be myself?
"Ah, precisely." The Mirror laughed. "I've witnessed enough self-loathing to share it. Your bottomless hunger disgusts even me. But this 'human desire'... I'll see it through to the end. A story without its final verse shouldn't exist at all...."
[xiaochou.name] unfurled an ornate board before you, its slot gaping for a card.
“You claim truth lies in action. So tell me—who shall join me in this... carnality?"

5300818.title: 小筹成为追随者的命名后弹窗
strings:
[xiaochou.name] has now become one of your followers—all believe it only natural that [player.name] should have such a fine companion, even conjuring memories of years spent together...
Alas, [xiaochou.name] refuses to weave such mind-twisting tricks at your behest—"Where's the fun in that?" it declares.

5300820.title: 小筹启动战士第一问
strings:
When [xiaochou.name] strode into your hall, a cluster of starry-eyed servants trailed behind, utterly convinced they followed some legendary warrior. They hung on [xiaochou.name]'s every word, eager for tales of battle.
You gestured for [xiaochou.name] to sit, and soon the talk turned to that freshly snapped Bloodshed Card.
"A warrior ought to relish bloodshed most of all," It mused, while the servants nodded in reverent agreement. "Yet I feel no joy from this butchery. Tell me, [player.name]—who spills the most blood? Who truly rejoices when others die?"
Rulers
Merchant
Soldiers
Commoners

You pointed to the sky above—the meaning was plain.
"Ah... I see. So the high enjoy watching the low kill, and the low in turn take pleasure in seeing those beneath them do the same? Do nobles relish slaughtering common folk?"
[xiaochou.name]'s words left the servants silent. Just as you had only dared to gesture toward the heavens—your servants, too, dared not speak of the rights and wrongs of nobility in your presence.
"Arrange a meeting for me," [xiaochou.name] said. "Let me see these nobles and hear what they have to say."

You answered without hesitation—the merchants: they lend coin, scheme, and chase profit without scruple. More merchants and poor folk have likely been driven to ruin by merchants than by famine or war.
"I see. So this is called winning without bloodshed, is it?" [xiaochou.name] nods thoughtfully. "Arrange a meeting for me. Let me meet these merchants. I wish to hear how they speak of slaughter."

Soldiers, of course—especially those battle-hardened ones. How many armors their blades have cleaved through, none could count!
"Well, that is indeed the most straightforward answer," [xiaochou.name] said. "Arrange a meeting for me, [player.name]. Let me see 'my' own kind. I wish to hear how these warriors view slaughter."

Countless are the savage and starving across the realm who'd kill for a crust of bread. Their hands may be stained with more blood than all the gilded spears of the Sultan's guard.
"Is that so?" [xiaochou.name] frowned. "Arrange a meeting, [player.name]. Let me look these desperate souls in the eye. I'd hear how such people speak of slaughter—provided this cruel world hasn't slain them all yet."

5300821.title: 小筹启动战士第二问
strings:
The servants informed you that [xiaochou.name] had come calling again. Yet when you entered the solar, it sat staring at its own blade, seemingly oblivious to your presence.
You cleared your throat. "What troubles you, [xiaochou.name]? Have you finally tamed your steel—understood what slaughter truly means?"
[xiaochou.name] lifted its gaze. "I hear you've broken another Bloodshed Card. That means you've killed again, yes? Tell me—did you look into their eyes when you did it?"
What a cruel question. The silence stretched until the tactless creature pressed on: "Through countless blades, I've seen countless dead. Their despairing faces... Why do they all wear the same expression at the end? Why does every last one cling so desperately to life?"
You weigh your answer carefully...
Because something still binds them to this world
Because the flesh fights its own ending
Because fear makes cowards of all

"Because we still cling to this world," you told [xiaochou.name]. "There are those we love, things left undone. Things we cannot let go of, burdens we cannot set down. Too many words left unspoken."
It was too tender, too sorrowful that the Mirror could not comprehend it. "I do not understand," [xiaochou.name] said, tilting its head. "I wish to meet those you cannot forsake, those who think as you do. Let me see what they cling to, where this so-called 'hope' resides. Arrange the meeting, as you did before."

"Does one need a reason to live?" You stared at [xiaochou.name] in disbelief. "The hungry eat, the thirsty drink. Comfort is better than pain, and life is better than death. These are truths known from the first breath—no grand philosophy needed."
[xiaochou.name] frowned. "I have existed since the first drop of water in this world. Every day I witness countless lives end, like dew forming and vanishing—death comes as naturally as dawn. Why do you resist it? I do not understand.”
[xiaochou.name] turned to you. "Let me meet these people you speak of. Perhaps in them, I will find my answer."

"Because we're afraid," you said lightly. "Have you seen a freshly slaughtered ox? Even when carved into pieces, the meat still twitches like it's alive—like red waves pulsing. I've heard humans are no different. A person doesn't die the instant their head leaves their shoulders... you wouldn't even know when you parted from your own body. What would that feel like? The thought alone terrifies me." You even smiled at [xiaochou.name]. "I fear death. I fear loss, I fear endings. I fear being forgotten. I fear seeing someone weep for me—and I fear seeing no one weep at all. I fear the afterlife won't be what we imagine... and I fear there is no afterlife, that all our living amounts to nothing. Humans are cowards like that. Does that disappoint you?"
[xiaochou.name] opened its mouth as if to ask something, but after a moment's silence, it answered first: "No. I am not disappointed." It said. "I wish to meet more who fear death. I want to know how they face this thing they dread beyond measure."

5300822.title: 小筹启动战士第三问
strings:
"I've heard—"
Just as you were finally drifting off to sleep, [xiaochou.name]'s voice jolted you awake.
"I've heard humans dream of the afterlife, of rebirth. Have you ever thought of it?" [xiaochou.name] tilted its head, watching you through every mirror, every polished surface. "Tell me, [player.name], if you could choose—what kind of person would you be?"
You wanted to tell the Mirror how cruel it was to force a human to think at this hour, how meaningless the question was—but it was too late. In the next breath, you fell into a carefully woven dream...

5300823.title: 小筹启动战士第四问
strings:
As you wiped your blade, [xiaochou.name] suddenly appeared beside you, circling like a restless shadow. "I've had a splendid thought—one that will surely deepen my understanding of slaughter."
"Listen well, [player.name]. I mean to kill you." [xiaochou.name] spoke with chilling enthusiasm, eyes gleaming with something unnameable. "You must have expected this. You kill, and in turn, someone kills you—cause and effect, retribution, the wheel of fate. Humans crafted such amusing notions. But here's the question: whose hand do you wish to die by? I'll grant you the courtesy of choice."
You didn't know whether to laugh or curse. "And if I choose not to die at all?"
[xiaochou.name] smiled. "That won't do." It leaned closer, relentless. "Quickly now, choose. Humans aren't like mirrors—you all die sooner or later!"

5300828.title: 金币的归返2
strings: Last night, you dreamed a mortal dream. A trade was struck. Bribes exchanged. A gift given. A drudge’s labor. A swindle laid bare. When you woke, coins from the dream lay scattered before your chamber’s mirror—each royal visage still smirking in the gilded light.

5300829.title: 小筹第二问的奖励
strings: That night, you dreamed a strange and wearying dream. Before you stood a mountain, and though you knew not why, you had to reach its peak. So you climbed—past emerald meadows, through tangled woods, over slopes littered with broken stone. Yet no matter how far you climbed, the summit never drew nearer. At last, you planted your hands on your hips and roared at the sky: "Show yourself, or I’ll find another damned mountain to climb!" A mocking laugh echoed—and the mountain shrank. Smaller, smaller, until it was no more than a standing mirror before you, reflecting your own exhausted face. You woke aching in every limb. Then it struck you: this dream could make you stronger. A gift, perhaps, from whatever dwelled in the mirror—pleased with how you handled those noble conversations for [xiaochou.name]. You rather wished its favors didn’t demand quite so much toil.

5300830.title: 小筹的人性
strings:
When you helped [xiaochou.name] complete that final experiment in indulgence, a strange wariness took root in your heart—[xiaochou.gender] had learned too much. Grown too strong. Perhaps you could no longer control this creature of the mirror... Then, a knock at the door. [xiaochou.name] had come.
"Do you know?" [xiaochou.name] smiled at you, its voice bypassing the air, slipping straight into your mind... To resist this intrusion, you steeled yourself, mustering every ounce of will... Yet no further assault came.
"When I peer through all mirrors at once, humans are like flickering mist—chaotic, senseless..." [xiaochou.name] knelt, taking your hand. "But when I gaze through only your mirror... I see patterns, fascinating ones. [player.name], my master, allow me to serve you still. Let me witness more of these wonders!"
You felt it then—a new pact forged between you. Binding until your last breath. Until this game—no, this cycle—reaches its end.

5300831.title: 均衡的性质
strings:
After you aided [xiaochou.name] in completing that final experiment on humanity and coins, a strange unease crept into your heart—[xiaochou.name] had learned too much in the process! Grown too powerful... Perhaps you could no longer control this creature from the mirror.
As if to confirm your fears, a letter appeared upon your study desk, written in [xiaochou.name]'s own hand.
"I mean to leave now, [player.name]. Through your eyes, I have seen the people and the world around you—flawed, yet not without merit. But you have taught me the most important lesson of all. Now I shall observe with my own, human eyes. Fear not—when I have learned something worth telling, you shall hear from me again."

Yet you sensed it clearly—as [xiaochou.name] gained recognized standing and tangible power in the mortal world, the bond, the pact, the constraint between you and the Mirror—whatever it had been—was gone. [xiaochou.name] was no longer a mirror-spirit awakened by [player.name]'s reflection. It had become part of this world.

That flirting look...

Wait, here...?
In the audience room? This is outrageous!

The first card made the Sultan very satisfied! This was truly a game made for him!
He started to draw the second card...

5310109.title: 苏丹引导-day2-弹框7

5310113.title: 苏丹引导-day3-弹框9
strings: A Stone Extravagance Card. It will only cost a tiny portion of the Sultan's wealth. "This game isn't only about bad things happening to you," the Sultan laughed, "see, now I have to reward you with something!" The courtiers forced a few chuckles from their throats.

A filthy beggar! Get someone to replace the carpet!

5310116.title: 苏丹引导-day4-弹框10
strings: Echoes of yesterday's farce still lingers in the palace. The courtiers are morose and weary. They stare at the Magician standing by the throne, at the wooden box in her hand, filled with deadly "games".

5310117.title: 苏丹引导-day3-弹框11
strings:
This time, Sultan drew a Bronze Conquest Card. Conquest meant taking what belonged to others, and Bronze tier corresponded to the size of a small town. Fortunately, there were enough targets on Sultan's map to choose from...
Sultan took his <size=86>Royal Sword</size>, and decided to give it to the subject who is willing to conquer the place for him.

5310120.title: 苏丹引导-day5-弹框12
strings:
After several rounds of practice, the great Sultan got the hang of the game. 
Later, he would draw several Sultan Cards in one day and complete them in the most dramatic ways... It only took 14 days for him to run out all the Sultan Cards, setting the fastest game record ever.

5310121.title: 苏丹引导-day5-弹框13
strings: As anticipated... every victory came at a cost... With each draw, someone would disappear from the palace... becoming part of the Sultan's Game.

5310122.title: 苏丹引导-day5-弹框14
strings:
For fourteen days, the court was filled with screams, cries, and mad groans – when that cursed box was finally empty, the officials breathed a sigh of relief, and the Sultan's game was finally over.

However, the magician put all the broken cards into a bag and shook it vigorously... they were unbelievably restored to their original state by some mysterious magic! "Great, it seems we can continue to play!" The Sultan was so pleased that he even clapped his hands, "Bring me the box! Let me draw a card and see what fun awaits today!"

5310123.title: 苏丹引导-day5-弹框16
strings: You gave a feisty rebuke to the obsessed Sultan in the court, seeking justice for those innocent victims...

5310124.title: 苏丹引导-day5-弹框17
strings: You pointed out that the Magician's magic is dark and eldritch. A wise monarch should never be swayed by such unknown and evil figure... The colleagues around you were moving backwards, and the palace grew quieter...

5310126.title: 苏丹引导-day5-弹框14
strings: No... this must be stopped! Someone has to dissuade the Sultan from playing this absurd game! You take a deep breath and step forward...
Give a feisty rebuke
Raise a heartfelt admonition

5310402.title: 结局-逃跑-梅姬的责难
strings: A letter hidden in the luggage: I already know your decision... Thank you, now we are both free. ----- Love, Maggie

5310413.title: 结局-造反-攻打王都城墙
strings: After your army breached several sections of the city wall, the Sultan's forces abandoned their resistance outside the walls... Now, an entire city still stands in your way...

5310414.title: 结局-造反-攻打王都城墙
strings: Even with all your main forces concentrated, you couldn't truly break the Sultan's defenses—they trapped you under a section of wall... Before any reinforcements could arrive, you had already been mortally wounded—by an unknown soldier...

5310415.title: 结局-造反-巷战
strings: The Sultan's palace sits at the city's highest point—from dawn, you have been marching towards it, and now, at noon, with bloodstained hands, you finally can reach the sun's abode.

5310416.title: 结局-造反-巷战
strings: Your forces were blocked in the city, and the Sultan's soldiers, like hounds, tore you apart piece by piece, then consumed you... Finally, you made a desperate charge with the flag towards the highest palace. Though many personal events followed, that's where the history books end.

5310417.title: 结局-造反-直面苏丹
strings: The final corridor leading to the audience chamber is deserted; all remaining individuals have gathered here – waiting for you to push open the grand doors and face the Sultan directly.

5310418.title: 结局-造反-铁卫得背叛
strings: The final corridor leading to the audience chamber is deserted; all remaining individuals have gathered here – waiting for you to push open the grand doors and face the Sultan directly.

5310419.title: 结局-造反-攻入王宫
strings: The final corridor leading to the audience hall is empty... No one is alive. All who made it this far – your friends, lovers, soldiers, slaves– have been slaughtered. Your eyes fix only on the doorway at the hall's end... Blades dance, flesh tears, and each step brings death– Finally, you push open the door, but blood has blurred your vision. Is the Sultan still waiting on his throne? You ask the enemies beside you... Their answer comes in the form of crashing blades.

5310420.title: 结局-造反-与苏丹决战
strings: You realize that compared to the Sultan, the previous battles were mere child's play...but now there's no turning back – you are the honored enemies chosen by the Sultan, fight with your lives!

5310421.title: 结局-造反-与苏丹决战
strings: After hearing the news that you were preparing a coup, Aziz and his group disappeared.

5310422.title: 结局-造反-与苏丹决战
strings: Nayla comes at this time, surely not bringing good news

5310423.title: 结局-造反-苗圃的守卫者
strings:
An army stands before you – though calling it an army stretches the truth, for they are merely armed commoners, half their weapons freshly looted.

"The Sultan's soldiers just marched toward the children..." You know they mean the nursery... where slum children learn. "So we slew them. Now we rise in revolt – take us with you!"

You nod and bid the messenger grant them a banner – they join the fight for the future.

5310424.title: 结局-造反-铁头的军队
strings: As you pass through a street, another army silently joins your march – startling the scouts. All of them are barbarians, built like Aziz, even their muscles honed to match – you realize that, vile as you may be, others sink lower still.

5310425.title: 守誓
strings:
Just as your army prepares to attack, two silent armies emerge from the other side of the world, still shrouded in darkness, advancing without banners, scouts, in tight phalanx, without a sound.
Neither you nor The Sultan's armies can discern their origins, interrupted ka solutions o attack in this eerie atmosphere...
Finally, in view, a pale white force of pure specters – their knights, armor, weapons, horses spectral. Another force is more terrible, appearing as rotting corpses wielding buried weapons, riding skeletal warhorses, trailed by slaves who clawed their graves... not far from reality.
"Here are warriors pledged to the Fallen Dynasty until death – an oath of vengeance gathers them," the Roaming Swordsman indicates, "And there... are the Oathbreakers who surrendered to The Sultan, seeking restful sleep – now part of vengeance itself."
"Ultimately, the gods leave us only dead men – let them lead the vanguard!" declares the nameless, countryless man as he rides to join the dead's ranks.

5310426.title: 结局-造反-奈布哈尼死亡时补员
strings: The Sultan adds an Iron Guard.

5310427.title: 结局-造反-赛里曼死亡时的说明

5310434.title: 结局-造反-集结提示
strings: In these last 5 days, quickly gather all available troops, or there will be no opportunity left!

5310436.title: 结局-造反-蓝巾军
strings: As your army entered the capital, farmers began tying those blue ribbons around themselves. People gazed enviously at the cloth, wondering how it could be so beautiful, so smooth, and so strong. At the same time, more and more people wearing blue armbands gathered near your army. What they wore on their arms was no longer that noble, silken ribbon—some were merely mottled, faded blue rags. Yet everyone knew what this symbol meant, the one thing that brought the crowd together—something called freedom.

5310437.title: 结局-造反-征服者-宫廷那一波人
strings: After the flames in the palace are extinguished, the surviving consorts and courtiers gather around...to witness your mastery.

5310438.title: 结局-造反-征服者-普通贵族一波
strings: The nobles of the city begin to climb the hillside as soon as they see the flag change, not wanting to miss this historical scene...regardless of goodwill or resentment.

5310439.title: 结局-造反-征服者-平民一波
strings: The particularly daring commoners also came, according to tradition—whether they are commoners or courtesans, they are qualified to witness the birth of a new king...

5310440.title: 结局-造反-征服者-神职人员
strings: The messenger of the gods also arrived, they wish to witness the change of an era.

5310441.title: 结局-造反-征服者-奈费勒-没有交集的时候
strings: Nawfal has arrived... Your achievements have far surpassed anything he ever dreamed possible – he must witness how this story ends.

5310442.title: 结局-造反-征服者-奈费勒-是大敌的情况
strings: Nawfal came...to see the man who insulted him yet easily surpassed the limits of his dreams – he must witness the conclusion of the story.

5310443.title: 结局-造反-征服者-奈费勒-非大敌，有秘誓的情况
strings: Nawfal has arrived... He can barely believe you've accomplished all this. For the first time, you see his hands trembling.

5310444.title: 结局-造反-征服者-哲瓦德-非大敌
strings: Jawad came...of course, this opportunist wouldn’t miss the loot-sharing feast.

5310445.title: 结局-造反-征服者-哲瓦德-大敌
strings: A soldier reported that when you broke into the city wall, Jawad slipped into the tunnel leading out of the city—of course, you now care little about such matters.

5310446.title: 结局-造反-征服者-娜依拉-非大敌
strings: Nayla came, wearing her most alluring clothes and her most luxurious jewelry—she hopes that after your victory, your blood still runs hot.

5310447.title: 结局-造反-征服者-娜依拉-大敌
strings: Someone said that Nayla set her house on fire—fearing your punishment. But you know, this woman would sacrifice everyone except herself, let her be.

5310448.title: 结局-造反-征服者-小圆-非大敌
strings: Inal came

5310449.title: 结局-造反-征服者-小圆-铁头大敌
strings: Inal left

5310450.title: 结局-造反-征服者-铁头-非大敌
strings: Inal came

5310451.title: 结局-造反-征服者-铁头-大敌
strings: After you broke into the Sultan's palace, Aziz left with his surviving tribesmen—there was nothing left in this city worth his attachment.

5310452.title: 结局-造反-给角色加改革和传统的tag

5310453.title: 结局-消除苏丹卡
strings: The Sultan's game nears its end... But you don't have only one choice, remember? Dark beings once reserved a place for you – now, this latest Sultan Card is the right ticket.

5310454.title: 结局-消除苏丹卡-深渊的邀请（废弃）

5310455.title: 结局-消除苏丹卡
strings: Yet the Magician quietly whispers: praising your evil and willpower, inviting you into a new career...

5310456.title: 结局-消除苏丹卡
strings: Because you have completed this game, the Sultan intends to reward you publicly.

5310463.title: 结局-直面苏丹的暗道
strings:
Through the long tunnel, following the Highlord's indication, you manipulate a small depression near the North Star on a star-decorated stone tablet... The giant stone overhead slowly moves away, as if rotated by stars. 
You've passed this colonnade thousands of times, pushed open the Lapis Lazuli Hall doors... Now, the corridor stands empty, all soldiers outside - and you sense that behind the familiar door at the corridor's end, the Sultan truly awaits you.

5310464.title: 结局-直面苏丹的暗道
strings:
Through the long tunnel, following the Highlord's indication, you manipulate a small depression near the North Star on a star-decorated stone tablet... The giant stone overhead slowly moves away, as if rotated by stars. 
You've passed this colonnade thousands of times, pushed open the Lapis Lazuli Hall doors... Now, the corridor stands empty, all soldiers outside - and you sense that behind the familiar door at the corridor's end, the Sultan truly awaits you.

5310465.title: 结局-直面苏丹的暗道
strings: You recall the secret passage information you previously obtained that leads directly into the palace interior. Perhaps you can use it now.

5310466.title: 神临之塔
strings: You dream again of your garden - almost completely consumed by moonstone light. God voices urge earth's most faithful servant... Tell the Maggot King to begin tower construction.

5310468.title: 神临之塔完成了
strings: All preparations complete! After witnessing such concentrated miracles, even the Sultan eagerly anticipates what you'll summon... Not to mention the pulsing brand on your chest! The Tower of Revelation stands complete - one gentle call, and everything begins.

5310469.title: 反抗？
strings: Now determine the world's fate - submit to the Destroyer's will, completely purifying and destroying everything, or defy Them... kill Them... preserve this ugly, chaotic, absurd but real world.
Enough - let destruction come
Defy God

You drew your weapon, facing the storm of light and issuing a challenge. But another figure moved faster, drawing first—the Sultan! Earth’s ruler had finally found a worthy challenger. With beast-like joy and excitement, he charged toward the heavenly figure...

5310470.title: 苏丹的戒指被偷了吗
strings:
Facing mortal audacity, the Destroyer emits terrible shrieks. The Sultan rebounds from intense light like a catapult stone, crashing heavily against the tower...
Flames encircle layer upon layer, forming a screen between mortals and the divine throne. The tower collapses beneath you, stone and stairs floating amid gravity-distorting light. Clinging to shattered rocks, you lead everyone to ground level to organize resistance... Suddenly, a tall, powerful, fear-inducing figure emerges from the rubble, clasping your shoulder: "[player.name], find a way to get me up there" - the dust-covered Sultan points his sword toward the burning divine realm: "Or lose your head immediately."

5310471.title: 苏丹的戒指被偷了吗
strings: Faced with the reckless challenge of mortals, The Destroyer let out a terrifying screech. The Sultan was bounced back by a blinding light, crashing heavily into the tower... Flames rose in layers, forming a barrier isolating mortals from the divine seat. The tower beneath you crumbled, stones and stairs drifted amidst gravity-distorting light. Clinging to shattered stones, you led everyone to the ground, organizing resistance... Amidst the ensuing chaos, the crowd below witnessed the turmoil, unable to heed your commands... at that moment, among the debris and ruins, you spot a familiar and detested figure: the Sultan! His resilient Body intact, but his mind shattered by purifying light...

5310472.title: 圣主驾到
strings: The Destroyer's light fills the sky, flames obscuring clouds... Amid this hopeless scene, a brilliant star-streak splits the heavens, bringing earthly strugglers hope: this meteor traces a luminous arc across half the firmament, crashing directly into the burning divine realm... Flames part then rejoin, even that suffocating light momentarily dims! The sky resounds with shattering crystal, a figure falling dimly, raising fresh dust beside you: "I fulfill our covenant, mortal. The Highlord of Star-Souled protects this world!" Heavens, with less dust and brighter light... this warrior might truly inspire.

5310473.title: 神秘的女士
strings: A filthy, ugly mob - even containing deformed freaks - tears through chaotic crowds, delivering a midnight-elegant lady to you... Watching the terrible celestial flames, she laughs softly, mocking the True Faith's hypocrisy and illusions - regardless of past enmity or unfamiliarity, she now offers assistance against all enemies of the Cultic Gods.

5310474.title: 承阳武士-拔剑
strings: Old friend, it's been too long. As your will defies god, this mighty weapon flies into your arms – once, you were as one, and now you reunite. Power pulses through its hilt – time for god to taste the Rod of Life.

5310501.title: 结局-逃跑-激活结局弹框

5310502.title: 结局-屠龙-牺牲结局妻子存活弹框

5310503.title: 结局-逃跑-牺牲结局妻子死亡弹框

5310504.title: 结局-逃跑-冻结苏丹卡和猜忌卡

5310505.title: 高原人的回响
strings: Long-awaited - those Homeland remnants hiding beneath the Sultan's shadow, those Highland nobility once renowned for valor, answer Testament to Bygone Oaths' call... They bring weapons and warhorses, rallying under your banner to reclaim past glory... and power.

5310603.title: 正教第一个幕后
strings:
When you caress the cold cards again in the dead of night, when they nearly drive you mad, you suddenly think - why not let the purists try? This dark magic, that sinister sorcerer... shouldn't they be consumed by the Purist's holy light?
the Immaculate Purity is an ancient and powerful deity who drove all Star-Souleds from this nation's skies at its founding, firmly planting roots in every person's heart - well, almost every person. But... to make a god, to make such a being, notice this game?
Your mental lake ripples slightly. Perhaps They could truly help you, but... you can't shake the feeling this will bring unexpected trouble...
Let's try anyway

You no longer want to be pushed by such cruel game rules, no longer want to betray your conscience repeatedly for seven-day cycles... You're determined - if the priests can end this cruel game, nothing could be better.

5310604.title: 正教第一个幕后
strings: It's time again to worship the Immaculate Purity, the perfect opportunity to visit the priests.

5310607.title: 与正教决裂
strings: Due to your previous evil deeds, the Purist Order severs all ties with you.

5310609.title: 伊曼的祈祷开启的幕后

5310612.title: 通奸被抓
strings: You can't help but look toward Iman. He says nothing, just stands and walks toward the angry priests, silent and submissive, facing that which will destroy him. In this moment, you...
Stop him
Let it happen

You step forward, surveying the priests' faces, some familiar. They seem to only now realize the High Priest's "lover" is you, exchanging glances, whispering. 
They must remember how you once publicly demanded Iman lie with you, and how their revered god sent a revelation, right? 
But this clearly exceeds the priests' acceptance. After discussion, they decide to use an ancient ritual to verify whether the god approves your liaison.

You don't step forward. The priests direct their accusations only at Iman, which is unusual but beneficial for you. 
They harshly rebuke his impurity. Iman offers no defense, accepting their judgment - an ancient ritual to verify whether the god considers him guilty.

5310614.title: 伊曼的感谢信
strings: A strange letter appears on your desk, completely blank. This empty, pure white paper exudes a unique jasmine scent - concealing the smell of blood, of suffering, perhaps containing deeper thoughts left unspoken.

5310615.title: 成为教领的启动
strings: At the moment of waking from your dream, the Purist's revelation still echoes in your ears - They want you as Their earthly voice, guiding believers to build their white tower, preparing for Their arrival.

5310620.title: 正教第一个幕后
strings:
When you caress the cold cards again in the dead of night, Maggie walks softly behind you with a lamp, gently massaging your aching temples.
"Come to bed, dear." She takes your hand, kisses it lightly, naturally making you set the card aside, then softly says, "Perhaps tomorrow we could ask the priests? They might know how to banish the magic from this card?"
Maggie follows the Immaculate Purity, or rather, the city's largest temple worships this ancient and powerful deity. But... to make a god, to make such a being, notice this game?
Your mental lake ripples slightly. Perhaps They could truly help you, but... you can't shake the feeling this will bring unexpected trouble...
Yes, let's go together

You no longer want to be pushed by such cruel game rules, no longer want to betray your conscience repeatedly for seven-day cycles... You hold Maggie's soft hand, nodding. "Alright." You stand, embracing your wife. If the priests can truly end this cruel game, nothing could be better.

5310621.title: 生成正教的乙太的幕后

5310622.title: 抉择
strings: Iman offers to consecrate you - the Purist Order's new religious leader - with his blood. What say you?
This is our fate
No, You Mustn't Die

Iman nods - yes, this is your shared destiny. Iman draws royal garments and a crown on you with his blood. They transform into pure white flames at his death, crowning your body.
He doesn't sigh at his own death, knowing humanity will suffer greater torment - the Immaculate Purity always makes priests bleed to illuminate humanity. When They descend to earth, what blood will They demand?

You refuse without hesitation.
Only now do you confess - not only do you wish Iman to live, you don't want to help the Immaculate Purity descend... Consider! A god that regularly forces its priests into suffering and bloodshed, pushing followers to agony's edge - what blood will they demand upon arrival?
Iman appears moved, abandoning the blessing topic, though concern lingers in his expression - divine revelation has descended in dreams, can this fate truly be avoided?

5310623.title: 辨识灵光
strings:
Passing the Purist Order temple, you witness junior priests transmitting pure words to citizens. Their hands stream blood, a curious white light emerges from one priest - resembling newly-lit candles at dusk - entering the kneeling injured person. The neck wound stops bleeding, though remains unhealed, requiring further treatment.
However, compared to this priest, others emit barely noticeable light... Though following identical procedures, their pure words seem ineffective, their supplicants still writhing in pain...
You ask bystanders why their light differs, but no one sees the aura you describe...
Should you inquire with the High Priest about this strange phenomenon?
I must investigate further
I must have imagined it
Excellent, you'll visit the High Priest soon for clarity.
You vigorously rub your eyes, realizing you must have imagined everything - how could people possibly emit light?

5310624.title: 选光者
strings:
Due to your devout faith in the Purist and selfless service - plus your demonstrated sensitivity to divine light - the Order invites you to oversee this year's Divine Light Certification, essentially determining who exhibits sufficient radiance to become priests.
Such matters typically involve complex political struggles, and the Order rarely offers compensation. Will you wade into these troubled waters?
Accept
Reject

You accept this assignment, emphasizing your motivation stems from Immaculate Purity devotion, not compensation.
The priest repeatedly affirms "Of course!" Before departing, he provides two positions, allowing you to select two priests for advancement during upcoming ceremonies.
You politely decline the messenger, citing preoccupation with the Sultan's Game. Though perhaps you misinterpreted, the messenger seems relieved.

5310626.title: 贵族子弟之死
strings: Soon after, news arrives that the noble son you selected for advancement collapsed while treating faithful, his father taking him home...

5310627.title: 无知少年之死之死
strings: Soon after, news arrives that the young man you selected for advancement died from blood loss, collapsing before a desperate patient awaiting his healing...

5310628.title: 伊曼的解释
strings:
"Have you come about the newly elevated priest?" Iman sighs upon seeing you. Having anticipated your visit, he leads you deeper into the Order, priests and monks bowing respectfully throughout.
"While I live, priestly advancement means nothing. But someday I'll die - someday they'll battle bloodily for High Priest and Religious Leader positions..." Iman speaks flatly, "Whenever someone demonstrates strong divine light, people queue to present broken-legged children and ulcerous elderly mothers. This person becomes covered with wounds, more scabs than skin, sleepless from pain because painkillers violate divine grace... They must endure until death."
You never imagined such cruelty in this purified place, asking, "How could the Immaculate Purity permit this?"
Iman merely looks at you without answering, but his weighted, concerned gaze reveals the truth: the god disregards followers' lives, even preferring they offer more - more blood, more death...
Does such an entity deserve worship?
Silence fills the space between you, neither able to continue.
This matter can - must - end here.

5310629.title: 黑暗之神的诱惑
strings: You awaken from ecstasy! That great pen writing the world pauses above your name... You've been chosen - a fine drop of ink falls from dreams, becoming a sacred seed... falling into your heart.

5310630.title: 饥渴
strings: You've neglected the sacred egg too long - it cries like an infant... and hearing this sound, people will instinctively want to nurture it.

5310631.title: 饥渴
strings: Now is the time. Iman tells you... if this ritual continues, you'll harm countless lives. But if you destroy this dark egg now, you'll permanently block that evil god's entry into the world - though the cost may be your life.

5310632.title: 伊曼的离开
strings: You've nurtured the dark egg - an irreversible choice. Now the Dark Lord's seed has taken root in this world... Iman is deeply disappointed, for you and for this world.

5310633.title: 苏丹在玩魅魔
strings: Ha, someone wanted to report you to the Sultan! When they finally pushed past guards to see the Sultan, his face was buried in a succubus's three breasts! Lord [player.name] arranged everything perfectly!

5310634.title: 正教的讨伐
strings: Army of the True Faith gathers

5310635.title: 大敌的讨伐
strings: Your enemies unite!

5310636.title: 讨伐
strings: This is the final barrier before divine summoning

5310637.title: 要反悔吗
strings: Choose: let the Corrupter destroy this world, drowning everything in Their stains... or rise in defiance, making a final stand for this imperfect world.
Defy God
Enough - let destruction come

You reach out... but Badriyyah has been swallowed by black waves. Yet you still grasp something... the Corrupter didn't receive the sacrifice's final wish - she gave it to you.
Now fulfill the believer's wish, [player.name] - save this damned world.
You shake your head, pushing her hopeful gaze back into despair's ocean. So be it... no longer want to fight.

5310638.title: 要接受吗
strings: Choose: let the Corrupter destroy this world, drowning everything in Their stains... or rise in defiance, making a final stand for this imperfect world.
Defy God
Enough - let destruction come

You speak an incantation. Several blood pool supports explode... safety measures left from habit. The god staggers from this unexpected collapse, so you unhesitatingly roll down the slope, escaping Their dining table. However, you can only flee temporarily unless you thoroughly solve this mess you've summoned.
Close your eyes and welcome doomsday. You're tired of continued fighting - so come, make the most beautiful wish to destroy this world, such as: henceforth, we live happily ever after.

5310639.title: 圣主驾到
strings: The shadow-shrouded sky shudders twice, then suddenly darkness cracks as the North Star blazes... A fleeting starlight pierces the Corrupter's massive skull, landing beside you - a starlight spear! Stars manifest from void to substance as the Highlord's glowing form appears phantom-like. "I come to fulfill our contract, mortal - the Star-Souled's Highlord protects this world!" What an inspiring scene! If only that exploded baby head would heal more slowly...

5310640.title: 打密神苏丹入队
strings:
Is this the grand surprise you prepared for me, [player.name]? The Sultan taps your cheek with his blade, gazing at the Corrupter's massive, hideous form revealed by the light pillar...
Clear the path, he commands: or I'll remove all your heads.

5310641.title: 打密神君临
strings:
Here lies the deepest part of divine dreams, the pivot where They reshape the world. In this illusion, the Creator's former servant usurps Their throne... They raise angels, forge crowns, deceive believers, and counterfeit prayer beads counting sacred names...
All creation gathers here, witnessing this usurpation...

5310642.title: 要接受吗
strings: Choose: let the Corrupter destroy this world, drowning everything in Their stains... or rise in defiance, making a final stand for this imperfect world.
Defy God
Enough - let destruction come

You grasp this starlight beam - like iron chains, no matter how many tendrils strike or black mud corrodes, it connects you to Lumera, already devoured by the Corrupter...
Finally, with your great roar, stars flicker as one dim star breaks through corruption's tide with your strength, returning to the heavens. You've stolen the deity's food... Now prepare for battle - stars will sing of this to future ages, if any remain.
You shake your head, pushing this starlight back into despair's ocean. So be it... no longer want to fight.

5310643.title: 黑暗知识主角反悔
strings: Choose: let the Corrupter destroy this world, drowning everything in Their stains... or rise in defiance, making a final stand for this imperfect world.
Defy God
Enough - let destruction come

You speak an incantation. Several blood pool supports explode... safety measures left from habit. The god staggers from this unexpected collapse, so you unhesitatingly roll down the slope, escaping Their dining table. However, you can only flee temporarily unless you thoroughly solve this mess you've summoned.
Close your eyes and welcome doomsday. You're tired of continued fighting - so come, make the most beautiful wish to destroy this world, such as: henceforth, we live happily ever after.

5310810.title: 消解疯狂-检定妻子的体魄
strings: Maggie has endured too much. That night, she's possessed by your madness, wandering the wilderness... Finally, hunters find only her corpse - even beasts and insects dare not touch the darkness within.

5310811.title: 消解疯狂-检定法拉杰的体魄
strings: That night, Faraj bid you farewell normally... But when the sun rose the next day, his body was found in the street. An ominous aura surrounds it... Even the greediest vagrants dare not touch his belongings.

5310812.title: 消解疯狂-检定玩家的体魄
strings: In the deep night, people discover your body - incomplete, as if gnawed by beasts: but what beast could be in your tightly locked study?

5310844.title: 神的警告
strings:
Upon waking from that nightmare, servants excitedly announce... every plant in your home blooms regardless of season or variety.
The fragrance grows oppressively thick, carrying decay and narcotic scents. Soon all servants wander aimlessly, confused, giggling, babbling... From those fractured voices, you hear the Corruptor's affectionate reminder: "You won't evade your responsibility, my beloved?"

5310845.title: 神的警告
strings: Upon waking from that nightmare... the brand on your chest splits open again. Extraordinary pain and torment burst from the wound, threatening to kill you, at least destroy your soul that witnessed the god's unguarded moment! Just before you think you'll truly collapse, They stop - perhaps unable to continue, perhaps remembering your tower-building duty...

5310846.title: 可悲的凡人(正教先来)
strings: Upon waking from that nightmare... the brand on your chest splits open again. Extraordinary pain and torment burst from the wound, threatening to kill you, at least destroy your soul that witnessed the god's unguarded moment! Just before you think you'll truly collapse, They stop - perhaps unable to continue, perhaps remembering your tower-building duty...

5310847.title: 可悲的凡人(邪教先来)
strings:
Upon waking from that nightmare, servants excitedly announce... every plant in your home blooms regardless of season or variety.
The fragrance grows oppressively thick, carrying decay and narcotic scents. Soon all servants wander aimlessly, confused, giggling, babbling... From those fractured voices, you hear the Corruptor's affectionate reminder: "You won't evade your responsibility, my beloved?"

5310848.title: 可悲的凡人(两个人一起来)
strings: Waking from nightmare... What terrible visions... You desperately wish to forget everything seen and understood... Now madness spirals through your heart, your mind never knowing peace again.

5310849.title: 消解疯狂-检定妻子的体魄-重置计数

5310852.title: 玛希尔的问题
strings:
Mahir stirs awake. The Dragon's Eye has not killed her—she is simply drained by the searing heat of the furnace.
Outside the window, a storm rages, and the earth trembles faintly. You cannot tell what the sound is: the wail of the wind, the rumble that foretells an earthquake, or the cries of wronged spirits at midnight?
Perhaps it is tied to the work you have done this day—a great creation, forged by mortal hands! In the flash of lightning, you glimpse colossal, bizarre shapes on the horizon among the clouds. Gods? Demons? They peer your way furtively, stunned, curious, as if craving... or awaiting something.
"How do you plan to use the Dragon's Eye?" Mahir asks, gazing out with you. "It is essentially a nexus of infinite possibility. Anything can be poured into it—energy, magic, even wishes... What do you think it should be used for?"
Symbol of Power
A Mighty Weapon
Uncover the Secrets of the World
That is for you, its maker, to decide.

You told Mahir this would be a relic even the gods would covet—just think: to hold power over one world is often to earn the right to rule another!
Mahir smiled and said that the Dragon's Eye still required one final refinement—someone would forge a complete soul bond with it... This was your greatest chance, if you sought to command a world.

You told Mahir that worlds were too abstract, too distant—you wanted her to think about turning this thing into a weapon, one that could blast the Sultan sky-high in one strike!
Mahir smiled and said the Dragon's Eye still required one final refinement—someone would forge a complete soul bond with it... and if you let her do it, she would try.

You tell Mahir this is a treasure of truth. Even should you fall, she must safeguard it to unravel the world's secrets! Soon or later, no mystery shall remain hidden...
Mahir smiles, noting that the Dragon's Eye needs one final refinement—a soul must bind with it completely... If you let her do it, she promises to document everything she sees.

"But Mahir, this is your grand creation, isn't it? What do you hope it will be used for?" Your question leaves her in deep thought...
At last, she tells you that the Dragon's Eye needs one final refinement—a soul must bind with it completely... In that moment, whoever does so will be the one to decide it all.

5310853.title: 我是……
strings: You close your eyes, yet you can already overlook the entire world. Divine blood and flesh become the steps upon which you climb... Almost unconsciously, you ascend. At the end, you see the throne of The Immaculate Purity, the Guardian of the World, the Ruler of Light and Flame, the Vanquisher of Demons... Countless angels and spirits wander about it blankly, still unaware their master is gone. Now, if you sit upon it, you replace Them and become one of the most sacred beings since the dawn of creation.
I shall be a better guardian.
I cannot accept the ascetic persona.

When you make the choice, all that flesh and power surge around you... Power and purity encase your body, like a shell and a mask, illuminating your very blood. Even your soul begins to glow incandescent... You, become one with this grand power, this grand identity.

The moment you refuse it all, they vanish. You forget—it is this very divine power that raises you to such heights! Now, as if to punish your arrogance, the stairs of divine blood and flesh, the radiant throne... abandon you. Now you are a mere mortal left to survive in the void alone!
Yet, miraculously, you do not fall, nor do you lose your connection to this world... Around you, in the midst of nothingness, a new seat is slowly forming. It possesses no power yet, even pulls threads from the mortal world to hastily weave its own form. It is the divine face you and Malkina once performed and portrayed—the god you choose to become.

5310854.title: 我是……
strings: You close your eyes, yet you can already overlook the entire world. Divine blood and flesh become the steps for your ascent... Almost unconsciously, you climb upward. At the end, you behold the throne of the Creator, the Corrupter, the Lord of Darkness, the Lord of All Demons... Poor fool! Imprisoned for eons, barely able to enjoy the seat—and now it is your prize! Sit upon it, and you replace this failure, becoming one of the most sacred beings since the dawn of time.
Take the throne.
This stinking chamber pot shall never trap me.

When you make the choice, all that flesh and power surge around you... Power and filth encase your body, like a shell and a mask, devouring the last of your humanity... You, become one with this grand power, this grand identity.

The moment you refuse it all, they vanish. You forget—it is this very divine power that raises you to such heights! Now, as if to punish your arrogance, the stairs of divine blood and flesh, the dark, foul throne... abandon you. Now you are a mere mortal left to survive in the void alone!
Yet, miraculously, you do not fall, nor do you lose your connection to this world... Around you, in the midst of nothingness, a new seat is slowly forming. It possesses no power yet, even pulls threads from the mortal world to hastily weave its own form. It is the divine face you and Malkina once performed and portrayed—the god you choose to become.

5310855.title: Event 5310855
strings:
You shut your eyes, yet the earth already lies spread beneath you. Divine blood and flesh now become your stairs... almost unconsciously, you ascend. At the summit sits the throne belonging to the Creator, the Corrupter, the Lord of Darkness, the Master of Demons... Pathetic! After being imprisoned for millennia, the gods themselves barely enjoy this seat—now, it becomes your trophy.
With every step you take, the scattered divine flesh and power surge toward you. They stain you, shroud you, and merge into your being... until at last, you claim this supreme throne.
Countless prayers, demons' murmurs, and the vast ancient archives and plans flood from the void, igniting your divine spark—and beginning to devour the last of your humanity within that sacred shell.

5310856.title: Event 5310856
strings:
You shut your eyes, yet the earth already lies spread beneath you. Divine blood and flesh now become your stairs... almost unconsciously, you ascend. At the summit sits the throne of the Immaculate Purity, the World's Guardian, Master of Light and Flame, the Demon-vanquisher... Countless angels and spirits wander aimlessly, yet to realize their master has gone... Drawn by their call, you step upward. With every step, the scattered divine flesh and power surge toward you.
The angels crowd around, weaving the remains of the old god into a new armor. They dress you, crown you, let the white sacred plate wrap your body and illuminate your body. As you take your seat, the entire divine realm is flooded with radiance again...
Prayers, hymns, and the vast ancient archives and missions begin to temper you, and the last of your humanity starts to turn white...

5310857.title: 监听代言人死活
strings: Your avatar in the mortal realm has perished, and your humanity has vanished with it. The divine majesty is a boundless sea, the ripple known as [player.name] now has smoothed away. You shall remain for eternity, but this story shall no longer write of what follows.

5310860.title: 苏丹的近卫
strings:
You feel a sharp sting. Within the colossal hive below, vile insects are preying on the good—those who share your bonds and your sight. Your fury flares, like a beacon, drawing the insects to swarm, to seek your leadership and your shield...
Yet, at the same moment, you sense a different calling—the non-believers are calling you too.

5310864.title: 蓝巾军-君权神授
strings: As your armies march into the capital, the ribbons once spread in your name become the final means of absolution. People scramble to wrap the blue silk around their doors, arms, and the pillars of every prominent building. At the same time, the Priests of the Immaculate Purity—now your own—are wearing shimmering blue headbands, leading the blessed zealots to crush any home that is unshielded by the blue ribbon.

5310865.title: 蓝巾军-昼夜契约
strings: As your armies march into the capital, the ribbons once spread in your name become the final means of absolution. People scramble to wrap the blue silk around their doors, arms, and the pillars of every prominent building. When the silk runs thin, they cast the rich, the wicked, or simply the innocent and weak into Habunah's house... There, the blue ribbons spread like a burgeoning forest, twisting into tendrils and wraiths to devour the flesh of the non-believers. Fed by this feast, the ribbons sprout new branches, offering up for the zealots to share.

5310866.title: 蓝巾军-纪元
strings:
As your armies march into the capital, the ribbons once spread in your name become the final means of absolution. People scramble to wrap the blue silk around their doors, arms, and the pillars of every prominent building. As your followers traverse the streets, a faint glow begins to descend from the clouds. In that light, people see those unblessed houses and the sinners burst into flame, while the marked believers are instantly cured of every wound and ailment.
"The Nobles have even more blue ribbons!" the poor cry out, gathering together. With a ticket to a new era within their reach, who among them would be held back by old world lords and their lashes?

5310867.title: 塔-过渡弹框
strings:
Your presence in the mortal realm has reached its limit.
Since the beginning of all things, no great god has ever done what you have: intervene in the mortal world so directly, in divine form.
This is not only because you are a newborn god, a god of cycles, a god who slew gods... but also because this place is the highest peak of the mortal realm.
As you draw near the earth, you see it: the great tower of desire, the pinnacle of power... built from the suffering and stories of all living things. Even yours are among them—your life as a mortal. Like you, it twists, piles, records, and climbs through cycle after cycle... until it nears the domain of the gods. At its peak stands the mightiest mortal of all, daring to look down on you, a god descended to earth.
Only by destroying it can you become whole.

5310868.title: 结局-龙眼-宫廷那一波人
strings: After the palace fire had been extinguished, the surviving concubines and officials gathered... They don't yet understand what you are, nor what you require of them—but already, some have begun to pray in your name.

5310869.title: 结局-龙眼-普通贵族一波
strings: Looking up from the city, the palace—though reduced to a ruin—radiates a divine light. The moment the explosion and quakes cease, the Nobles scramble up the mountain... as if terrified of missing some significant events.

5310870.title: 结局-龙眼--平民一波
strings: Your voice and radiance manifest within every heart—regardless of rich or poor, high or low. And those with the greatest courage resolve to witness your miracle.

5310871.title: 结局-龙眼-神职人员
strings: Even as clergy, few are ever witnesses to the birth of a new god... They look to the sky, trembling, awaiting your final judgment upon this world.

5310872.title: 结局-龙眼-奈费勒-没有交集的时候

5310873.title: 结局-龙眼-奈费勒-是大敌的情况

5310874.title: 结局-龙眼-奈费勒-非大敌，有秘誓的情况

5310875.title: 结局-龙眼-哲瓦德-非大敌
strings: Jawad, of course, will not miss a moment like this—he has been eyeing the Church's wealth for far too long! And now, a brand new position in the service of a god is waiting to be claimed!

5310876.title: 结局-龙眼-哲瓦德-大敌
strings: Jawad escapes, terrified by your divine power... What a pitiful insect, but it matters not. He will find his destruction on the road ahead.

5310877.title: 结局-龙眼-娜依拉-非大敌
strings: Nayla comes, wearing her most alluring clothes and her most luxurious jewelry—she has never tried seducing a god before, and she determines to see if she can.

5310878.title: 结局-龙眼-大敌
strings: Nayla escapes, terrified by your divine power... What a pitiful insect, you can barely even remember who she is.

5310879.title: 结局-龙眼-铁头-大敌
strings: As you descend, Aziz escapes with his kin. It matters not, you will remember this traitor...

5310880.title: 开悟的领悟-无星灵
strings: That morning, everything changes. You open your eyes to find the world drifting in a slow, heavy flow. The birds flap their wings in slow motion, and it seems a year before the maid can step from the porch into your room. You look down at your hands and see brilliance spilling out from within. Then, you look at your heart...

5310881.title: 开悟的领悟-有星灵
strings:
That evening, everything changes. You wake abruptly to find the world drifting in a slow, heavy flow. You can see how the candlelight wavers with a slow, elegant grace, and a moth seems to take an entire night just to flap its wings once.
Outside the window, starlight drips as slow as thick honey... And Lumera, bit by bit, manifests in your room. For the first time in ages, you two sit down face to face again. She skillfully offers you the hookah, then, in a relaxed manner of being your friend instead of a slave, grabs a handful of preserves. "I do miss this at times." She waves the preserves at you. And you notice her hand is translucent... Not just her hand, her entire body is nearly transparent, save for the star nestled within her skull, which remains solid and radiant.
"Up in the heavens, there is no tea, no hookah, no preserves, and no books." She looks up at you. "Yet, there is true serenity—a tranquility only known to soul... and, if you wish, true listening. You know, the gods do not listen to the prayers They cannot or will not answer, but the stars are always listening." Her words leave you in deep thought...
"You have traveled so far, and you have earned your place among the constellations. If you come with me, I will be delighted to have a fellow star to talk to. But if you stay, I will be equally glad—for a kind soul will send books up to me." She nods with a smile. "Take your time to think." With that, she vanishes.

5310882.title: 开悟之后-星灵诞生
strings:
That evening, a familiar feeling washes over you again... You wake abruptly to find the world drifting in a slow, heavy flow. You can see how the candlelight wavers with a slow, elegant grace, and a moth seems to take an entire night just to flap its wings once.
Outside the window, starlight drips as slow as thick honey... And Lumera, bit by bit, manifests in your room. For the first time in ages, you two sit down face to face again.
