You know, the gods do not listen to the prayers They cannot or will not answer, but the stars are always listening." Her words leave you in deep thought...
"You have traveled so far, and you have earned your place among the constellations. If you come with me, I will be delighted to have a fellow star to talk to. But if you stay, I will be equally glad—for a kind soul will send books up to me." She nods with a smile. "Take your time to think." With that, she vanishes.

5310883.title: 星之战士-昼夜契约
strings:
Suddenly, a corner of the sky fractured, as if tearing open a black wound in the daylight. Stars flicker inside it, from which the aurora-like droplets rain down upon the earth... Whatever bathes the shining grease—soldiers, stone, livestock—melts into brilliant sludge... At last, the gleaming masses converge together, shaping themselves into a glowing human shape. By an ancient covenant, every Star-Souled longed for the mortal world and desire falls into the mundane realm under your power, becoming extraordinary soldiers in your service.
Now, they cast away the indifferent mask of the Star-Souled, revealing their fangs and sexual organs you granted: to eat, to mate, to relearn humans' story in this way.

5310884.title: 星之战士-纪元
strings:
As fervent crowds gather in your name, as miracles unfold one after another, minor disorder inevitably arises within your army. At that moment, a row of stars begin to shine, revealing themselves in the broad daylight. They arrange themselves into arches and beacons, guiding the soldiers' formation before descending as luminous warriors who stand at the head of every line.
It's the stars! They arrive to honor their covenant with the fallen dynasty! To fulfill the promises of the past and bear witness to the dawn of a new era—this time, the stars themselves will stand at the forefront to record the story.

5310885.title: 星之战士-君权神授
strings:
Suddenly, thunder shutters the sky, as if your wrath explodes in the clouds. Later, the stars fall like rivers of fire across the heavens, destroying a distant watchtower.
From the ruins walk burning stars, bearing the weapons and armors you granted them. By the covenant of the fallen dynasty, you fulfill what the Immaculate Purity has never achieved—chaining the stars and remaking them as warriors of wrath... And after your victory, the stars write only the story you permitted to endure.

5310886.title: 奈费勒-君权神授
strings:
As you ride the river of the faithful, irresistibly advancing through the world and savoring the joy of leading a vast army... something stirs in the distance. It's a thought, a gaze from an insect. Weak and insignificant, yet sharp enough to pierce your heart like a needle.
It's a thread tied impossibly tight to you! Why has it escaped your awareness until now? You send your infinite power toward it—and meet only refusal, denial, and disappointment. Instinctively, you burn the insect to death... yet the piercing pain remains. As wound marks your followers, so does this tiny pain mark the presence of [player.name]... Whatever the insect has been, its sting awakens your forgotten memories of mortals, and of [player.name].

5310887.title: 奈费勒-昼夜契约
strings:
As you ride the river of the faithful, irresistibly advancing through the world and savoring the joy of leading a vast army... something stirs in the distance. It's a thought, a gaze from an insect. Weak and insignificant, yet sharp enough to pierce your heart like a needle.
It's a thread tied impossibly tight to you! Why has it escaped your awareness until now? You send your infinite power toward it—and meet only refusal, denial, and disappointment.
Blasphemy! You crush the insect in fury, grinding it into a crimson stain upon the earth... Yet in that same instant, the stain burns itself into your heart—like searing iron! Agony follows. The stain's form twists and changes without an end, awakening your memories of mortals, and of [player.name]...

5310888.title: 奈费勒-纪元
strings:
As you ride the river of the faithful, irresistibly advancing through the world and savoring the joy of leading a vast army... something stirs in the distance. It's a thought, a gaze from an insect. Weak and insignificant, yet sharp enough to pierce your heart like a needle.
It's a thread tied impossibly tight to you! Why has it escaped your awareness until now? You send your infinite power toward it—and meet only refusal, denial, and disappointment.
In fury, you rip the offending eyes out of the insect's head! You embed them like jewels into the heaven that belongs to you—and to this new era. Behold the age I shall create, pitiful non-believer!
And yet... with these eyes, the world seems clearer to you, and so does the form of [player.name].

5310889.title: 承阳剑-君权神授
strings: As you ascend, the tool once bound to your blood begins to shine with sacred brilliance... It rises to the sky, then comes to rest in your hand. You swing it once, and memories of using it for mortal passion flood back. At last, the root of desire must return to the mundane realm. Thus, you cast it back to the world below.

5310890.title: 承阳剑-昼夜契约
strings: As you ascend, the tool once bound to your blood begins to shine with sacred brilliance... It rises to the sky, then comes to rest in your hand. You swing it once, and memories of using it for mortal passion flood back. At last, the root of desire must return to the mundane realm. Thus, you cast it back to the world below.

5310891.title: 承阳剑-纪元
strings: As you ascend, the tool once bound to your blood begins to shine with sacred brilliance... It rises to the sky, then comes to rest in your hand. You swing it once, and memories of using it for mortal passion flood back. At last, the root of desire must return to the mundane realm. Thus, you cast it back to the world below.

5310898.title: 女术士的话
strings:
There remains one thing unforgotten—the Magician! The one who has brought it all! She—no, they are not human... You search with every follower's eyes, hunt with fire in the sky and howling storms—they are not allowed to escape!
Yet, before you fully master your divine power, they flee... At last, all you found are unfinished Sultan Cards, carved from gems and crystal. They depict countless visions of your ascension to godhood, but the names are not yet written.

5310901.title: 宣战
strings: You feel a sharp sting. Within the colossal hive below, vile insects are preying on the good—those who share your bonds and your sight. Your fury flares, like a beacon, drawing the insects to swarm, to seek your leadership and your shield...

5310902.title: 屠龙之梦-有两个正当性
strings: You defeat a dragon. Your courage has been proven. Its blood will drench your banner, honor your army, inspiring them to slay an even larger, more savage monster...

5310903.title: 屠龙之梦-有两个正当性

5311001.title: 飞升线加入手牌的幕后
strings: Are these memories? Bonds? Or a curse left behind from a game once played? All that you have faced, touched, hated, and desired now comes into your hands. On the path of ascension, everything you have will be tested. You must be ready... to offer it all.

5311002.title: 是否臣服
strings:
Lamblet seethes at this unexpected turn! You hid this trick where they could not see! He chases you madly—now like a ram, now like a tattered cloud, now like a writhing mass of flesh and fangs...
A flicker of doubt crosses you—after all, you are only human! Do you truly know what to do next? In this race to ascend to a new world, what awaits you if you fail? Perhaps... you can parley with this deity, so deeply bound to you. Every ruler needs subjects—even a Creator. And that is where your true strength lies!
Lord Lamblet, hear me...
This lamb cannot be trusted.

There is no time to think. In the instant your resolve falters, the horrific, eerie mass nearly seizes your feet and swallows you whole. You pull yourself together and run desperately, shouting: "Wait! I can help you!"
"Please. I can serve you! I am useful—just like I was before!"
The swirling clouds slow briefly. Then, a colossal ram head forms from the mass.
"Useful?" Lamblet bleats. The sound becomes a strange human voice in your ears, "What use do you have?"
They look at you with amusement, as though you are a delicacy already on a plate.

You leap into the air, riding the wind... And Lamblet no longer chases you. Instead, they begin to shrink, transforming into a great serpent, then into a giant bird, racing toward the gateway of the new world.
Mortal or god, it makes no difference in this race. And the victor will claim everything.

5311003.title: 结算陶土之门是否完成
strings:
Suddenly, Lamblet closes their mouth.
In the brief instant of darkness, Clay Gate vanishes from your sight—as if it had never existed. Lamblet, the path of Ascension, and everything you assembled or summoned—all gone, like a candle snuffed out—leaving illusions of candlelight lingering in the void and in your eyes...
You fail.

5311004.title: 结算墨色褪去是否完成
strings: Hurry! Lamblet is pulling ahead! If they reach the finish before you, everything ends!

5311005.title: 结算墨色褪去是否完成
strings: You... made it! The endless ink actually has an end! But beware, Lamblet is waiting for you here... And they have set a deadly ambush.

5311006.title: 结算虚空之火是否完成
strings: You're still burning—how much longer can you hold on? Hurry. Don't let Lamblet get ahead of you...

5311007.title: 结算虚空之火是否完成
strings: At last, you stabilize your form, soaring through the void like a god! Now, the true competition begins. Who will prove themselves the one destined to shape worlds?

5311008.title: 结算造化之风是否完成
strings: Keep gathering your divine power! Let its radiance command the winds of creation! Don't let Lamblet take the lead!

5311009.title: 结算造化之风是否完成
strings: It worked. The power you wield begins to shine, catching the winds of creation like a sail. You are racing toward the finish.

5311010.title: 结算陶土之门是否完成
strings: Not enough—you have yet gathered the power required... to push the gate open, to create a new world...

5311011.title: 结算陶土之门是否完成
strings: You have succeeded! Yet success itself no longer holds meaning. The void, the old world left behind, the raging Lamblet—everything begins to collapse inward, to return to zero. Then even zero is gone, even the very idea of "nothing" fades away. All things belong to you, awaiting your first step.

5311032.title: 飞升线鲁梅拉星灵成功

5311033.title: 飞升线弑君的计划成功

5311046.title: 飞升线革命的计划成功

5311050.title: 飞升线星神的信仰成功

5311052.title: 飞升线妖精女王提灯成功

5311061.title: 飞升线妻子的不满失败

5311064.title: 飞升线被困的星神失败

5311071.title: 飞升线百科全书目录成功

5311075.title: 飞升线最后一天进入陶土之门成就幕后

5320001.title: 领路者
strings: Your kindness has become an example for the youth Fatuna visited with her son Zaki to present you with a gift. It was to thank you for setting a moral example for her son, 'He now cares about the lives of the elderly servants at home and takes initiative in asking about the taxes of the estate... I'm so happy and touched, all thanks to you.'

5320002.title: 昔日之影
strings: Your understanding of the 'world beneath the surface' has attracted Fatuna Fatuna has recently been often chatting with your wife over tea. She finds some of your perspectives quite interesting, so one day, she took the initiative to speak with you.
Receive her privately
Receive her together with your wife

You chatted for a while, and you mentioned some heroic deeds in the Dark Alley, as well as your thoughts on fate, the invisible, and many aspects of life. She watched you, nodding constantly, but her gaze seemed to drift further and further away...
After a long time, she suddenly realized her rudeness, smiled and apologized to you. "I am really sorry, what you said reminded me of my late husband, he also loved to hang out with the fortune tellers and prostitutes in the Dark Alley... Oh, oh, I meant no offense, quite the opposite... how should I put it, hmm..." Two blushes rose on her cheeks, and you suddenly realized that she was indeed quite an attractive woman...

With Maggie present, Fatuna seemed a bit embarrassed. She chatted with you for a while about everyday matters and that unrelenting individual, then took her leave, just like on many previous afternoons.

5320003.title: 抉择
strings: While you were courting Fatuna, she made a tempting proposal... She wants you to marry her. Maybe, for your happiness, you should find some time to discuss this with Maggie? Or... humph, why should she refuse you? Maybe she’s just pretending to be uninterested.
No, I want her now
Maybe I should ask my wife

You know in your heart that Maggie would never agree. Of course, Maggie also wouldn’t agree to you cavorting with Fatuna behind her back, but as long as she doesn't find out, what’s the harm? You arrange to meet Fatuna again, and ignoring the eager expectation in her eyes, you take her directly to bed.

This... this is actually a brilliant idea! In your mind, you picture Maggie and Fatuna surrounding you, bringing you drinks and peeled grapes, these two beautiful women of distinct charms... Hmm... You can't help but be moved. Immediately, you promise Fatuna that you will handle this matter and persuade Maggie, for the sake of your... for your happiness!

5320005.title: 剧毒的果实
strings:
Lately, you notice Fatuna visiting your wife more frequently. The two women whisper but stop whenever you approach, averting their gaze...
What are they planning? Are they shy at you hearing? Fatuna’s proposal resurfaces, heartbeat quickening. Surely she's charmed by you, still wanting marriage, right? Would Maggie agree?
Recalling Maggie, you smile, noticing her softer demeanor recently. Fatuna knows how and will convince Maggie.

5320006.title: 询问妻子的意见
strings: Fatuna's proposal kept swirling in your mind... Now you finally have the chance and the courage to talk to Maggie about it.

5320007.title: 选择
strings: Maggie verbally says she respects your choice, but her gaze is sharper than a knife. Your scalp tightens... how should you choose?
Let Fatuna join our family
No, I only love my Maggie

Maggie stared at you for a long while before finally nodding coldly. "Since you insist, let it be."
You kissed her with joy and ran out to discuss the wedding with Fatuna. You didn’t see Maggie, after you left, meticulously wiping her face with a handkerchief, as if she had just touched something dirty.

You... of course you didn't have the courage to say you wanted to marry someone else under such glaring eyes. You hugged your wife tightly, closed your eyes, and loudly swore that you were just joking, and she, your eternally loved Maggie, would be the only flower in your garden. Maggie let out a soft laugh, unclear if it was mocking or reassuring. But in any case, she returned your embrace and gave you an extremely tender kiss.

5320009.title: 与法图娜的婚礼
strings: You told Fatuna the good news, and she cried with joy. After overcoming the biggest challenge, Maggie, you quickly set a wedding date, and next, it's time to nervously prepare for your wedding.

5320010.title: 与法图娜的婚礼
strings: At this auspicious moment, the wedding with Fatuna can begin.

5320011.title: 楷模
strings: Zaki came to see you alone, thoughtfully asking if all good deeds are rewarded in turn? He looked a bit apprehensive, not knowing if he admired your kindness or pitied your suffering.
Not necessarily
They certainly will

You told the young man that when you do good deeds, you never expect a return from others, but that doesn't mean you don't need a return.
He apologized for his dullness and hoped you could explain further.
"You don't have to repay my kindness; you should pass it on to others, and thus, goodwill will ripple around us like a stone causing ripples on the water. In the end, these ripples will always come back to me, not from you, not from him, perhaps not from anyone I know, because the world has changed because of our good deeds, and I will eventually benefit from it."
He looked at you with wide eyes, and after a long time, he knelt down before you, swearing to follow you for life.
You could tell that your words benefited him greatly.

You told the young man that promptly repaying the kindness of others is as important as taking revenge on malice because only then will acts of kindness be encouraged and repeated over and over again.
He apologized for his recklessness and then asked you if doing good with the expectation of receiving some reward could still count as a good deed?
You replied to him that it certainly counts as a good deed because the final decision of receiving a reward still depends on the willingness of the receiving party. The doer of good has done a definite good deed and received an unknown reward. This kind of unequal exchange, what else can it be if not 'kindness'?
The young man was greatly inspired, he pondered for a long time, and suddenly thought of something, taking out a jewelry box from his pocket.
"My mother asked me to bring this to you as a reward for your teaching, hoping it can motivate you to continue teaching more people what kindness and nobility are."

5320012.title: 不义之事
strings: Zaki comes to you in a daze... Zaki tells you that he accidentally found a letter his father received before his death, revealing that his father had used his mother's family money to keep a prostitute. The letter was written by his father's brother, and from its contents, it seems the father was very worried that the mother would be furious about this, even fearing for his life. Remembering the days before his father's death, the young man recalls his mother suddenly preparing strange herbal tea, the sudden visit and departure of his uncle, noises at night, and all the father's guards being sent away... He knelt down and begged you to guide him...

5320013.title: 正义必须得到伸张
strings: Zaki found you covered in blood.

5320014.title: 轻易获得快乐
strings: Zaki comes to seek your guidance as usual...

5320015.title: 我不是故意的
strings:
On a rainy night, the door was knocked upon. Zaki, drenched, slipped into your house, grabbed your arm, and pleaded for help.
He had brought an extraordinarily provocative young girl from the dark alley's brothel to his home, mimicking the moves of a famous courtesan, and played a choking game with her... But his hands were a bit too heavy, and the prostitute was accidentally strangled to death by him.
Now the corpse is still lying on the carpet in his bedroom, and he is at a loss, only coming to you for help. What advice can you give him?
Set a fire...
If the price is right...
Give him up
Young people are bound to make mistakes, and fire is all criminals' best friend. You prepare the items like kerosene and let Zaki take you to the scene.

Prostitutes are consumables, and the dark alley's brothel is in the business of this. As long as you pay enough, they probably won't make a fuss and may even help you Disposing of a corpse.
Hearing your suggestion, Zaki begged you to accompany him to the dark alley.

Heavens, his stupidity had truly disgraced you. This time, you decided not to help him anymore. He had to face the wrath of the dark alley's slave master himself.
Your words had frightened the young noble, and he knelt down to beg you. But you coldly refused to look at his repulsive display, instead thinking of Zaki's family's exquisite foreign furniture, fully silk hand-embroidered carpets, and invaluable jewel wall decorations... If he and his mother disappeared, all of that could be yours...

5320017.title: 逐日之徒
strings:
Zaki came to visit you this morning with excitement all over his face, telling you that he heard people talking about you everywhere – in the tavern, in the palace, in the bathhouse, everywhere.
So what, you casually told him, only words from truly valuable and meaningful people are worth listening to. Listening to your words, his face suddenly turned red.
His embarrassed look stirred something in your heart, and a bold thought entered your mind: should you take the time to invite him to the bathhouse? He admires you so much... you could have some deeper communication...
Invite him
This is inappropriate

Zaki agreed immediately, but after a moment, he realized what your invitation meant. His face turned bright red, and the carpet under his buttocks felt like it was on fire, making him unable to sit still. He quickly bid you farewell, not daring to look at you, and left.
Such a lovely young man! You laughed with pride.

You are his teacher, and he is at the age where he needs guidance. How could you go against your morals and lead him astray? You quickly dismissed this inappropriate thought and sternly admonished him. Zaki, not knowing what he did wrong, left feeling aggrieved. And you breathed a sigh of relief...

5320019.title: 一桩丑闻
strings: Recently, rumors of your romantic scandal with Zaki have been circulating throughout the streets... Everyone, everyone is talking about it.

5320020.title: 第二次机会
strings: Your immense influence and widespread reputation attract Zaki's heart Zaki came to see you again. The look in his eyes was no longer mere admiration and reverence. He stuttered, saying that it had been a long time since you last met. Of course, this was not accurate; you knew he meant 'in private'. As you ponder this, he lowered his head and asked hesitantly, 'You must know, there are more people who admire... who admire you, not just me.' Of course, with your recent prominent influence, who wouldn't... wait a minute! Could the person he mentioned be Fatuna? You stood up in shock, 'You...?' Zaki buried his head, not daring to speak clearly, 'Anyway... anyway, I'll... I'll wait for you at the usual place.'

5320021.title: 这么多的书……
strings:
You found Lumera sitting idly in your study, with some books scattered around.
Seeing you, she looked at you with clear eyes and said, 'Master, I noticed that the books here are about very grand and significant events, but... there's nothing about ordinary people, about slaves, servants, or vendors – why is that?'
The writers were narrow-minded
They weren't written on paper
They weren't worth recording

You told her that the scribes of the empire had a narrow perspective, focusing only on the highest glories and hardly noticing the insignificant people. If she wanted such a book, she would have to write it herself.
She widened her eyes, then nodded heavily.

You were silent for a moment and comforted her, saying that perhaps such tales exist, but they have not been passed down. You've heard the songs that farmers and herdsmen sing during their leisure time. They don’t have parchment or reed pens, so these songs and stories are not recorded on paper, but are passed down orally.
You patted the girl’s hair and said, 'Maybe you can record these people's stories.'
She widened her eyes, then nodded heavily.

You coldly told her that it’s because they are not worth it. Parchment and soot ink are expensive, and only the most significant events and greatest inventions are worthy of leaving a mark in history. How the common people live their lives, who would waste time caring about that?
Lumera bit her lip, seeming to struggle internally, but under your stern gaze, she eventually gave up.

5320022.title: 读书会
strings:
You recently discovered by chance that every afternoon, when it’s less busy, the maids gather in the study around Lumera to listen to her read. The ink on the paper hasn't dried yet, seeming as if Lumera wrote it herself.
“...she smashed the water jug on the stone, and milk flowed into the river. But she didn’t feel any regret because it was given by her enemy. Honey given by an enemy is poison.” Lumera read softly, her voice steady, but her enunciation very clear, “Apolos cursed the man who gave her the milk with anger. She said she would rather starve than live off the charity of the one who killed her mother.”
The maids were engrossed, discussing Lumera's story animatedly, debating whether the protagonist should have smashed the milk jug, until the old Slave Girl reminded everyone that their master’s lunch was about to start, and they dispersed to work.
Only then did Lumera notice you in the hallway. After kneeling to greet you, she nervously twisted her robe and asked, “What do you think, master, should Apolos have kept the milk given by her enemy?”
Should have kept it
Shouldn’t have kept it
Do not waste the servants' time

You tell her that, in your view, honor is far less important than happiness. In other words, the ultimate goal of life should be to make oneself happy, and honor is just one of the means to achieve happiness. For the protagonist's child in the book, a cup of hot milk is happiness. Therefore, you think she should take the milk home and let go of hatred.
"You are always right." Lumera looks at you, nodding obediently. After a while, somewhat hesitant, she asks, "Can I still tell them stories?"
You smile and promise.

You tell her that if she accepts the enemy's gift, she must question her own heart about whether she still wants to pursue revenge. Others also have milk, and you can live without drinking milk. But revenge... there is only one way to resolve it.
She listens to your words and nods vigorously. After a while, somewhat hesitant, she asks, "Can I still tell them stories?"
You smile and promise.

You glare at her and tell her to stop worrying about the silly questions in the story. More importantly, she shouldn't be taking up so much of the servants' time. You didn't buy them to sit and listen to stories.
Lumera freezes for a moment, "I understand." She puts away the book, apologizes softly, and then leaves the study expressionlessly.

5320023.title: 继续深造
strings:
Lumera bows to you and tells you she wants to learn the ancient language of the empire, which is the language of her homeland. This language doesn't differ much from the common language, but many terms are different, especially those related to faith.
"I think the past is not important. What matters is that I use this life to do something I want to do. The ultimate goal of life is to achieve happiness, which is what you taught me. I have thought about it, and my happiness lies in learning more knowledge. Please send me to learn the ancient language; I will repay your benevolence doubly."
She says this while groveling, and you contemplate the answer. Sending her to learn the ancient language requires some money, but she is very smart, so it might be worth it...
Agree
Reject
Lumera has a thirst for knowledge, and you can satisfy her. Why not?
You reject her request. After all, the ancient language is too extravagant for a slave girl; she already knows enough. She silently kneels and curtsies, then leaves disappointed.

5320024.title: 编修之苦
strings:
Lumera's ancient language teacher finds you and first pays perfunctory compliments on her learning progress. After that, he proposes taking Lumera to work together.
Recently, the Sultan's scribes have been organizing a vast amount of old ceremonial documents, attempting to find evidence that the royal family of Lumera’s homeland once cursed the Sultan's ancestors. This would further convince the people that the Sultan is persecuted and just while portraying Lumera’s homeland as evil magicians.
Nine-tenths of these ancient documents are meaningless, and only the remaining tenth has some use. He needs people with some knowledge of the ancient language to help filter them.
Agree
Reject

There's nothing bad about this, and it's a good opportunity to practice the ancient language. However, you still demand that he pay Lumera according to the rate for free persons, as her time is valuable. The nobleman reluctantly agrees.

You have more important tasks for Lumera, so you reject his request. The other party gets very angry and spreads rumors that you are arrogant, disregarding even the Sultan's sacred duties. People whisper, anticipating the day when the Sultan punishes you.

5320025.title: 发现的诱惑
strings:
Lumera's ancient language teacher comes to you in a rage and blurts out, "Your slave girl is too rude!!"
He angrily tells you that while organizing the ancient documents, Lumera discovered a very obscure spell. This could be said to be the most important find in recent documentation efforts. Naturally, the scribes demanded she hand over the spell as their achievement, but she – a lowly slave – refused!
"She even had the audacity to bring you up, saying she only listens to your orders! Hmph... you will surely make that disrespectful slave surrender the spell, then whip her and make her lick our toes to apologize, right?!" He confidently gives you a knowing look, "If you do this, we will support you at the palace!"
You look down at Lumera, who has been dragged aside. Her arms and face are covered in bruises and dust. Despite hearing such harsh words, she remains silent, holding the bundle tightly. Clearly, that's what the noble wants to take away. She must have fought desperately to keep it.
Yes, she deserves a whipping
I think you're the one who should apologize

You didn't want to anger the nobles who had the right to participate at court over a slave girl. Naturally, you took the document from Lumera's arms and handed it to the nobles. Lumera said nothing, and after that, she rarely spoke to you.

He was stunned: “What do you mean...?”
You kindly explained to him what an apology was, and pointed out that Lumera probably wouldn't like an uncle who usurped others' achievements licking her feet, so that part of the apology could be omitted.
His face turned red with rage, and he burst out a string of curses and threats. Clearly, you had made an enemy in the Lapis Lazuli Palace, but that was not important.
Lumera looked at you, finally relieved, and presented the package to you.
"Master, it's the Starry Spell." Her eyes sparkled, and ever since you gave her a book in front of the bookstore, this seemed to be her happiest moment, "We can further interpret it."

5320026.title: 星灵之夜
strings:
You found Lumera in the study. She seemed spellbound, chanting the deciphered starry spell over and over again. Whatever you said beside her, she seemed not to hear a word.
After a while, she looked up, a silver star cross flashing in her left eye, both eerie and sacred... She read the spell faster and faster, and many words not recorded in the parchment slipped from her lips, as if some higher will were whispering to her, as if this will had chosen her as an innocent vessel...
You finally understood – the meaning of "opening" was to open a door leading to the path of infinity; "opening" meant severing the link to the present world – she seemed to have knocked on the door of the spell. Should you stop her from continuing to read it?
Call Lumera back
Praise the unknown existence

You shouted loudly at her, then shook her shoulders vigorously. Seeing that this couldn't interrupt her pouring chant, you grabbed the oil lamp and set fire to the spell in her hand!
The letters on the spell shifted with the dancing flames. The star cross in her eyes gradually faded. In the void, something seemed to sigh... Lumera suddenly collapsed to the ground, fainting as if exhausted.
Will she wake up? You worriedly sent for a doctor.

You stepped back two steps, respectfully looking at her.
Her chanting grew more and more frenzied, faster and faster, with her hands starting to move uncontrollably, and you recognized she was gesturing the names of each star spirit in ancient language. According to those extinct beliefs, all of man's power came from the stars, but no living person could withstand the true power of the star spirits, so the vessel must die—dying to achieve eternal life. Her movements suddenly stopped. Then, she looked at you calmly, as if it was Lumera's last glance as a human.
"Thank you, Master," she said, then smiled at you before closing her eyes.

5320027.title: 开小差
strings: Early in the morning, you found Lumera sneaking out, holding many precious parchments and carrying a bulging backpack, looking very suspicious. You stopped her and asked what she was going to do. She honestly replied that she was going to take revenge. But what revenge, against whom, and how? She lowered her head, avoiding your questions. Could this be an excuse? What will you decide to do?
Stop her
Help her
Let her handle it herself

Where is the revenge that needs all these scrolls and books? Moreover, you didn't want to lose a useful slave girl over some foolish revenge. You ordered her not to go out privately again, especially not with such valuable items. She was silent for a moment, and then knelt down to show obedience.

It's too dangerous for a young girl to seek revenge alone. You couldn't sit by and do nothing. Furthermore, whatever the task, an extra helper is never a bad thing.
Lumera hesitated for a moment, then gratefully nodded.

Revenge is such a personal matter. Let her go, it’s her own choice. Without saying anything, you shook your head and left. As you walked back to your room and looked back, her figure had already disappeared.

5320028.title: 一桩公开宣扬的复仇
strings:
You follow Lumera through the bustling market, walking through the seeking eyes of the commoners. Finally, her steps halt in front of a low, shabby shanty in the slums, where a gaunt, filthy old man squats, daydreaming. Upon seeing Lumera, the man’s eyes suddenly brighten. He jumps up, trying to grab her hand, but you step in front of her. 
“I’m here for vengeance,” the girl calmly tells the man, “Father.”
... This is her father? Surprised, you glance at the man. His expression becomes even more enthusiastic; he rubs his hands together, mouth agape, showing a grotesque set of yellow teeth: "I knew you’d make it big! Are you a noble’s concubine? Or a top-grade prostitute? It’s time you give back to your dad. What did you bring for dad? Wine? Cigarettes?” 
Lumera’s ever-unchanging expression cracks slightly, and through the fissure, you glimpse pain.
“I repeat, I'm here for vengeance,” she reiterates, clenching her fist.

The man just now finally understands her words, and scratches his head, "Revenge? What did daddy do? What are you talking about?"
Lumera explains he sold her mother to a brothel in the Dark Alley in exchange of wines. When he had no money, he sought out mother and lied to her that he still loved her, let her go with him, then sold her again. Until she was captured by the owner of her brothel, until she was beaten by her owner, until she was dead from the owner's torture.
Hearing that, the man feels surprised, "That's all? I didn't do anything wrong! The owner killed your mother, not me! I loved your mother, I just needed money at that time! I didn't have anything else to sell! How can a child blame her father due to such a thing – my lord, surely you agree? You won't allow a child to do such a cruel thing! I'm not a slave, I am a FREE MAN!"
He yells madly, many people raise their heads from windows of slum and stare at you three, Lumera stares at you too. "You said you will help me. Then... will you help me kill him?"
Continue
Of course
He's not the only one who deserves to die
Impossible
There’s no need to ask more, the words this man has said are enough to sentence him to death.

You tell Lumera that this revenge will not diminish her pain in the slightest, and that her father's depravity is too deep. You believe he should suffer more to atone for his sins. Moreover, it's clear there are others who deserve to die in this story, right? She looks at you with wide eyes and nods gently. You take the man away and temporarily imprison him. You need to think carefully about how to deal with him and how to make the brothel owner pay...

You refuse her. How could a noble, a minister, kill a free man for a slave girl...? Lumera nods, seemingly unsurprised. “Then, please go back to the mansion first.” She bows to you, “I will handle it myself.”

5320030.title: 廊下的故事
strings:
That afternoon, the maids sat around as usual, listening to Lumera tell a story. She held a scroll of parchment, her voice still flat.
She said there was a young girl whose father was a damnable scoundrel and whose mother was a foolish prostitute. The father sold the mother to a brothel in the Dark Alley, then tricked her to escape and sold her again until the brothel owner beat her to death. Yet it was this foolish mother who secretly saved money to let the girl learn to read with a teacher at the market. It was also this mother who, on her deathbed, held her hand and told her never to fall in love with men.
The maids were silent; anyone could tell this was Lumera’s own story.
At the end of the story, the girl stabbed a small knife stolen from her master’s house into her father's throat. At that time, the scoundrel was trying to taste his own daughter. Blood spurted out, and the girl ran back to her master’s house without even wiping her face.
The maids surrounded the young girl, stroking her hair. The older maids murmured curses, took out all kinds of treats from their aprons and stuffed them to her, while the young laundry girl promised to make her the best dress with lace. They spoke softly, comforting each other, and digesting the story.
Finally, the bell rang, and the servants had to go to work. After they left, Lumera noticed you standing in the corridor. She stood up and handed you the booklet she had written.

5320031.title: 孤女复仇记
strings:
A eunuch from the palace suddenly visits, claiming to serve Zazie, the most favored consort of the Sultan. The esteemed lady has recently become obsessed with a popular novel called "The Orphan's Revenge." Because she likes it, the entire harem has started reading it. Because the women of the harem like it, everyone is talking about it, and countless copies have been sold.
You ask the eunuch, puzzled, what does this have to do with you? The eunuch respectfully tells you that the esteemed lady believes the 'master' in the book who helps the protagonist seek revenge looks exactly like you, and she wants to ask you to urge the author to write faster so she can read the ending sooner.
You send the eunuch away, completely baffled. Before leaving, he leaves you a copy of "The Orphan's Revenge"...

5320032.title: 坦白
strings:
Lumera kneels before you, pushing a heavy bag of Gold Coins towards you.
"You knew about the book all along..." her eyes flicker. "At first, I just wanted to write a diary, but the pages grew... and then a copyist approached me. Even the maids who heard the story said I should publish it, so... These are my royalties. I'm just your Slave Girl; what's mine is yours. Please, you must accept it." She lowers her head deeply, seemingly embarrassed, before continuing, "Also, I'm about to write the ending. The scoundrel will die... In the story, who should be the one to kill him?"
Just write that you killed him.
Write the truth, I killed him.

She lifted her head, tears filled her eyes: "Is it really possible? Can I really take credit for this? I've always dreamed it was me who did it on that day... but I was too cowardly. Without you, I might have... I might have just scolded him. Can I really?"
You nod and tell her that this revenge was accomplished by her own hand, and you were merely a weapon in that instant. She bows to you again.
That's the truth, she has no right to fabricate it. Lumera nodded silently and retreated as if relieved. After she left, you counted the Gold Coins she offered, and the amount surprised you.

5320033.title: 意外的赏赐
strings: An unexpected reward comes from the palace, including several luxurious fabrics and a beautiful gold bracelet. The accompanying letter specifically mentions that they are to be given to the "brave girl who completed the revenge"... Of course, this refers to Lumera, but you are her master. You can decide who will receive the reward.

5320034.title: 意外的赏赐
strings: An unexpected reward came from the palace, including several luxurious fabrics and a beautiful gold arm bracelet. The accompanying letter specified that they were to be given to the "warrior who helped the girl complete her revenge"... Of course, this belongs to you, and you can decide who will receive the reward.

5320035.title: 腐臭的生意人
strings:
The brothel owner heard that you captured Lumera’s father, and he seems quite uneasy about it. He wants to host a feast to personally apologize to you and your servants.
You summon Lumera and ask her: "The owner probably wants to spend some money to stop trouble, and if he's ruthless enough, he might even try to kill you at the feast. What's your plan?"
The girl kneels on the ground, obedient and reverent: "It's up to you to decide."
You ponder, thinking of a strategy.
Take the money and settle it.
Life for a life.
Use him.
Then just take the money. It's the simplest solution. Lumera nodded, obediently and seemingly without much resentment towards the owner. So, after a bit of preparation, you took her to the feast.

The death of Lumera’s mother is directly tied to the brothel owner. What a poor woman, what a poor child... You look at Lumera with pity and pat her head, "I will make him pay with his life, don't worry."
Lumera nods heavily. She is ready to attend the feast with you, to face hatred, to face blood.
You know that brothels have some special dirty tricks to deal with those who betray them. Why dirty your own hands for revenge? You decided to use them.

5320036.title: 痛苦
strings:
Lumera has been somewhat distracted lately. She hesitated for a long time before knocking on your study door, bowing and asking: "Master, what kind of pain leaves the most unforgettable impression?"
You notice her small fist clenched tightly, as if she has resolved to give someone a lesson they'll never forget.
Hunger
Shattered Hope
Fire

It's hunger, you told her, that kind of long, endless torment and despair where even death becomes a form of release. Lumera nodded thoughtfully. Then, looking into your eyes, she made up her mind, "Please allow me to visit my father in prison. I think it’s time to end this."

It's the repeatedly shattered hope, you told her, just like her mother... Lumera nodded thoughtfully. Then, looking into your eyes, she made up her mind, "Please allow me to visit my father in prison. I think it’s time to end this."

It's fire, you told her. The deaths you most dread to recall are all connected to fire. Lumera nodded thoughtfully. Then, looking into your eyes, she made up her mind, "Please allow me to visit my father in prison. I think it’s time to end this."

"I tasted the flavor of revenge, thank you." she said, "Then I wrote this book, but I think this should be my last book. Writing is not as interesting as I thought, reading is still more fun."
She knelt and bowed to you, then left your room.
This is the end of the revenge story.

5320050.title: 另一封信
strings:
Returning home that day, you saw Maggie carrying a box of jewelry. “Look, it's from Fatuna.” She waved the short note in her hand, pulled you over to read the letter together, looking very happy.
The thin paper was adorned with delicate handwriting, filled with sincere gratitude. You remembered seeing Zaki today and saw a rare smile on his face. It seems that the mother and son have finally, as you wished, let go of their grudges.
“Oh my, Maggie, how did you do it?” You couldn't help but pull Maggie into your arms and kiss her forehead joyfully. Maggie winked at you mysteriously. Her smile was so beautiful, making you love her all the more. Maybe, this is Maggie's magic.

5320051.title: 一封信

“Dear teacher:
We may have been born guilty, but at least I once lingered in kindness.
   --Zaki”

5320104.title: 帝国之花
strings:
Nayla finds you and hands you a simply bound booklet that looks like it was printed by the folk, with no name on the cover. You open it to sweep through the pages, which are filled with roughly made portraits of women. 
“Lately, people at the market have been surrounding those who can read, asking them to read this aloud,” Nayla fiddles with her hair, clearly displeased, “It lists the most beautiful women in the entire empire, with some comments, as if commoners have the right to judge us... utterly ridiculous!” 
You quickly flip through, finding that among the early portraits are two of the Sultan’s consorts, your wife, and several other acquaintances... 
“And, in this damned booklet, I’m ranked only seventh, do you think that’s reasonable?”
She stares at you intently.
Unreasonable, you should rank higher
You shouldn’t take such things so seriously...

You nodded, agreeing with her statement.
 You told her, in your humble opinion, she should at least rank in the top three; let alone she is the Sultan's woman, no other woman could compare to her Garnet-like charisma and beauty.
 Nayla giggled after hearing this: "You always know how to make me happy. If only men in this world could learn from you. Alas, even you are only a man... We women, if we are to start competing, must strive for the first place. The top three means nothing; the empire's top three and the empire's 300th have no difference! So..."
 She casually played with some strands of hair falling over her chest, seeming lost in thought. After a while, she turned to you, her gaze revealing a venomous inspiration.
 "If the six women ranked ahead of me could mysteriously vanish for unknown reasons, that would be wonderful. I'd toast to such 'coincidences' with you." She giggled, delicately tracing her fingers over your cheek and chin, carrying a hint of an unspoken meaning, then swayed her body and left your home.

You told her you have no interest in such meaningless rankings, and she shouldn't fit herself into the mold of some sky-fallen flatterer, who possibly never even actually saw her! Moreover, being the seventh to appear in the portrait doesn't necessarily mean the seventh most beautiful – who knows the logic behind this order?
"Oh, you are right," she nodded, "but I do mind. I can't stand other women ranking above me. Maybe you are right, but it doesn't stop me from continuing to do what I want."
She casually played with some strands of hair falling over her chest, seeming lost in thought. After a while, she turned to you, her gaze revealing a venomous inspiration: "You will have a way, right? You've been selected by the Sultan to play this game, you... oh, I won't say more, I won't expose you! Yet... if the six women ranked above me vanished suddenly for no matter what reason... I'd be grateful to you for such 'coincidences.'"
You sternly refused her, whether she believes it or not, you would not lift a hand – especially since the list includes your wife! In her face, you tore the book apart, and she seemed furious, cursing you before taking two deep breaths to say angrily she would show you.
Apparently, she hadn't given up her idea; she had means to get help...

5320128.title: 娜依拉声望事件--恶毒的花嫁
strings:
This morning, sudden clamor and the intense scent of roses reached from outside your home. Startled, you opened the door to find an incredibly luxurious palanquin carried by eight slaves stopped at the entrance, with Nayla sitting atop it. She reclined against a mountain of cushions, wearing white gauze of unimpeachable purity, her hands full of gold bracelets and gems, gold adorning her ankles.
"The empire's most beautiful woman wants to marry you, my dear." She lifted her gold-powdered eyelids and raised her voice, "Will you accept me as your wife?"
The onlookers erupted in cheers. Nayla must have calculated that such a public proposal would put you in a moral bind, betting you wouldn’t reject a lady’s proposal in public... Of course, she’s quite charming and has plenty of properties; she might indeed be a good choice for a new wife... What will you decide?
Accept
Reject

Hearing your answer, Nayla excitedly stood up from the palanquin and pounced straight into your arms.
You barely caught her and her belongings. Around you, people erupted into a huge cheer, and at that moment, they seemed to forget her bad reputation... Now she is nestled in your arms, shedding tears of happiness, practically like a simple little girl. 
After this, she had the dowry moved into your courtyard, and the valuable jewelry and veils caused countless men to exclaim in envy, and you knew from this moment on, you can't reconsider. Nayla would never allow such a thing to happen.
With a blank face, you tell her you have no current plans to marry, and before she begins to wail or perform, you swiftly shut the door and instruct the servants not to let this madwoman in.

They might curse you mad couple a million times in their hearts, but it doesn't matter. As long as they never speak up, the world is peaceful.

5320132.title: 娜依拉声望事件--别丢我的脸

Of course, once money's in your pocket, it's not up to her anymore.
