5320137.title: 娜依拉声望事件--全能老妇
strings:
The slave market is open. A familiar trader tells you an old woman in this batch is quite a buy; she can keep accounts, cook, and care for young children, quite versatile.
But as you approach the old woman, you find her emaciated, face gray, eyes with an unhealthy hue... she seems very ill. The slaver, feeling a bit embarrassed by his overzealous sales pitch, crudely kicks the old woman, complaining about her falling sick at this moment. 
Maybe you could buy her, perhaps saving her life...
Buy her
I don't need a sick old woman

You stopped the slaver and accused him of mistreating a sick person. Immediately, he put on a fawning expression, "What an honor for her to meet such a benevolent master as you. Just 5 gold coins, just 5 gold coins, and she is yours."

You shook your head, remarking that if an all-round elderly woman is cheap, you might reluctantly buy her, but if she's seriously ill... You coldly criticized the slaver for daring to exploit your renowned generosity by pushing this elderly woman onto you. The slaver, feeling ashamed, turned around and whipped the old woman hard. This had nothing to do with you, and you left the slave market. You never saw that old woman again.

5320138.title: 娜依拉声望事件--意外的拜访
strings:
Nayla suddenly comes to visit you. She keeps saying it's nothing serious, yet she coquettes, curries favor, and flirts with you, while her eyes keep scanning your residence, seemingly looking for something... After a while, she finally lets out a sigh and tells you the truth.
"I heard... you bought a female slave? Would she happen to be named... Kaya?"
You recall that the sick female slave does seem to be called that. Nayla becomes excited, grabs your hand, insisting that you sell the female slave to her.
"She's a traitor... a venomous woman! Sell her to me, let me kill her!" She offers a high price of 10 gold coins, but...

You shake your head, telling her you can't just hand someone to her to be put to the gallows just like that.

Nayla becomes aggressive, raising her voice: "Do you know what she did to me? She... She was my wet nurse! I trusted her so much, liked her so much... My mother hated me, and my father didn't care about me, it was just her by my side... But, but she seduced my father – she cared for me just to do this – She didn't care about me at all, she abandoned me and ran away!" 

You ponder her words...
Accept
Reject
That's not what I heard
Alright, you're right

You agreed. There's no reason to anger this noblewoman over an old, useless slave. She showed a snake-like smile...then kissed you and hastily bid farewell.
After that, Nayla never mentioned Kaya to you again, and you never saw that female slave or heard about her.

You shook your head and instructed the servants to help Kaya to the parlor.
Upon seeing her, Nayla acted like she'd been stung by a bee, abruptly standing up. She trembled, gritting her teeth, appearing like a hurt ten-year-old girl rather than a dignified noblewoman who attracts attention.
Kaya was evidently surprised as well, squinting her eyes and examining Nayla closely... Then she smiled gently: "You're so beautiful, young lady; indeed, I knew from the start you'd be a great beauty."
At your behest, Kaya bowed her head, recounting how she was raped by the master and stripped of her freeman status by the mistress to Nayla. Despite Nayla rudely interrupting, scolding, and insulting her many times in between, the old woman kept smiling, gazing at Nayla as if she were a tantrum-throwing child.
"That's how it is, my young lady, my little princess. I know I'll die like an ant by the roadside, but oh Lord, I actually got to see you again before departing! Thank the Lord, thank you." She bowed down laboriously, kissing your and Nayla's toes.
Nayla stood frozen in place, repeatedly licking her lips like she wanted to speak but didn't know what to say. Kaya was helped away, leaving you two staring at each other in the parlor, until, suddenly, she burst into a sharp cry: "...She should have covered her breasts when my father came to see me...more tightly covered! She...she was wrong... My God, she was wrong! Otherwise, the only one wrong would be my father... I know my father is a snake, a shameless maggot!"
Subsequently, Nayla covered her face with a veil and ran out of the parlor in tears.

Seeing her firm stance, you said nothing else, merely calling the servants to take Kaya to Nayla's sedan chair. Nayla affectionately kissed your face and left you with the money she promised.
After that, Nayla never mentioned Kaya to you again, nor did you hear or see anything about the female slave.

5320139.title: 娜依拉声望事件--意外的拜访2
strings:
Nayla suddenly comes to visit you. She keeps saying it's nothing serious, yet she coquettes, curries favor, and flirts with you, while her eyes keep scanning your residence, seemingly looking for something... After a while, she finally lets out a sigh and tells you the truth.
"I heard... you bought a female slave? Would she happen to be named... Kaya?"
You recall that the sick female slave does seem to be called that. Nayla becomes excited, grabs your hand, insisting that you sell the female slave to her.
"She's a traitor... a venomous woman! Sell her to me, let me kill her!" She offers a high price of 10 gold coins, but...

You shake your head, telling her you can't just hand someone to her to be put to the gallows just like that.

Nayla becomes aggressive, raising her voice: "Do you know what she did to me? She... She was my wet nurse! I trusted her so much, liked her so much... My mother hated me, and my father didn't care about me, it was just her by my side... But, but she seduced my father – she cared for me just to do this – She didn't care about me at all, she abandoned me and ran away!" 

You ponder her words...
Accept
Reject
No... I don't think this is right
Alright, you're right

You agreed. There's no reason to anger this noblewoman over an old, useless slave. She showed a snake-like smile... then kissed you and hastily bid farewell.After that, Nayla never mentioned that woman to you again, nor did you see or hear about her.

You can't make a decision so easily; at least, you should listen to Kaya's side first. So, you ordered the old slave Kaya to be helped over.
Upon seeing Kaya, Nayla acted like she'd been stung by a bee, abruptly standing up. She trembled, gritting her teeth, appearing like a hurt ten-year-old girl rather than a dignified noblewoman of many attractions.
Kaya was evidently surprised as well, squinting her eyes and examining Nayla closely... Then she smiled gently: "You're so beautiful, young lady; indeed, I knew from the start you'd be a great beauty."
Nayla sneered, spewing venomous curses at Kaya like a viper. She called Kaya a traitor, a whore, a harlot; she had believed in Kaya completely as a child, so when her mother told her Kaya was sneaking into her father's bed, everything she believed was destroyed – she grew more agitated, almost hitting the old slave, but you held her back.
Kaya listened quietly, her smile unchanged, gazing at Nayla as if at a misbehaving child: "As you said, that's how things are, my young lady, my little princess. I'm sorry, I failed you. I know someone like me deserves to die like a fly by the roadside, but oh Lord, I actually got to see you again before departing! Thank the Lord, thank you."
She bowed laboriously, kissing your and Nayla's toes in turn. Nayla stood frozen in place, repeatedly licking her lips like she wanted to speak but didn't know what to say.
Kaya was helped away, leaving just you two staring at each other in the parlor. Then, as if to conceal something, she covered her face with a veil and ran out of your house.
Seeing her firm stance, you said nothing else, merely calling the servants to take Kaya to Nayla's palanquin. Nayla affectionately kissed your face and left you with the money she promised.

5320140.title: 娜依拉声望事件--唯一裂隙

5320141.title: 娜依拉声望事件--唯一裂隙
strings: Nayla routinely came to have tea with you, seemingly as usual. You spent a day just like any other, however, you peek her silent face, you're sure that after Kaya's death, there is something that changed quietly in her viper heart.

5320142.title: 娜依拉声望事件--唯一裂隙

5320143.title: 娜依拉声望事件--逝去之物
strings: On this day, Nayla routinely came to have tea with you, seemingly as usual. You spent a day just like any other, yet before leaving, she silently removed a ring from her finger and placed it beside you, without explaining why.

5320144.title: 娜依拉声望事件--扭曲的想象力
strings:
Nayla came to see you, telling you she wanted to know who the strongest man in the whole empire is – by "strongest," she means exactly what you think, the sensuality.
"All women are the same, oh really! When we see a man adorned with sparkling gems and a sword, striding down the street, we ponder if he's just as impressive with nothing on, hm?" 
She giggled, "If you think some women don't think like that, it's because... they're not as naughty as me, hence not as... alluring, right?" 
Before you could answer, she waved a finger at you. "I know how to get the answer. If I do what needs to be done with a few more men, I can tell you who the strongest man in this capital is... Will you help me? Even if not to help a beautiful lady, then to satisfy your own curiosity, or perhaps your pride, hm?" While giggling, she rolled up a parchment with a long list of names and tucked it into your clothes, her fingers lightly brushing across your chest. "Beyond those listed, there's you too," she said with interest, "Of course, I've already sampled your flavor, but I've heard seeing something as a competition or test can better unleash one's potential... so, I look forward to your performance."

5320145.title: 娜依拉声望事件--扭曲的想象力-名单
strings:
On this richly scented piece of stationery were listed a series of imaginative names:
The almighty Sultan,
Nabhani,
Iman,
Jabal,
Bharat, and you...
You almost laugh out loud, emperor, wanderer, priest, general, outlander, influential minister, she sure covers a wide range! Besides you, you dare say there isn't another in this empire who can help her complete this collection. But even for you, sending her to these people's beds would require the right timing... What price can she offer you? You're somewhat expectant too.

5320146.title: 娜依拉声望事件--帝国的勇士
strings: Nayla tells you that she has gathered all the information needed and is ready to start writing the True Warriors of the Empire, Ranked! You look at her enthusiastic expression, unsure if you have any chance to participate in this matter...
Remember to praise me as strong
Write truthfully – I am confident
Can you not write...

THIS IS THE ONLY THING YOU HAVE TO WIN!!! Upon hearing your request, Nayla giggles until you're nearly angry. She wipes tears of laughter from her eyes and promises repeatedly, "I know, I know, I won't forget your 'hard work' for me."

Upon hearing your words, Nayla's soft arm wrapped around your shoulder, half-joking, half-serious, "Then I'll truly write it as it is."
You nodded calmly. This calmness partially stemmed from your confidence in your male prowess, while the other part came from your pitiful pride, which forbade assuming defeat before this book was even completed.

You hope Nayla won't write such a book. It's certainly not because you doubt your own capabilities; you just don't want to become a target. Imagine, if your ranking is above the Sultan's, would you still save your head? But to lower your ranking for this... Why?!
Nayla giggled for a while after hearing this. In the end, she promised you she wouldn't write the book – or at the very least, it wouldn't circulate publicly.

5320147.title: 娜依拉声望事件--泄露的秘密
strings: That day, Maggie returned home looking furious, giving you a hard glare. Later you learned a rumor in the noble circle, claiming Nayla had slept with all the men worth sleeping in the entire empire and even gave them a ranking, with you prominently included... The noble ladies were all speculating and debating who performed best, but as for Maggie... she couldn't bear to listen anymore...

5320148.title: 娜依拉声望事件--帝国的勇士-重复触发

5320149.title: 娜依拉声望事件--帝国的勇士-重复触发

5320150.title: 娜依拉声望事件--这是真的？
strings:
"True Warriors of the Empire, Ranked" quickly became a sensation, causing an uproar in the city. Every woman was reading this guide – which underwent personal testings by prestigious and credible madams. After all, women don't lie to other women... Maggie was overwhelmed with questions, each and every one about the domineering prowess of her husband.
Maggie grew increasingly annoyed, finding you more detestable with every look. After so many years of marriage, why had you never performed that well in bed?

5320151.title: 娜依拉声望事件--帝国的勇士-重复触发

5320152.title: 娜依拉声望事件--帝国的勇士-重复触发

5320153.title: 娜依拉声望事件-促成交欢

5320154.title: 娜依拉声望事件-促成交欢

5320155.title: 救济日
strings: In recent years, the poor climate has led to poor harvests, and many emaciated and starving refugees have flocked to the capital. Someone suggested to you to host a public charity event, providing them some food to fill their bellies, while also enhancing your renown.

5320156.title: 铁头-善1-救济日重复触发

5320157.title: 铁头声望事件激活提示
strings: Aziz seems to have something. Insert it into <color=white><size=172%>Methinks</size></color>.

5320158.title: 铁头声望事件--这粥的味道
strings:
After a charity relief, Aziz slowly walks up to you. 
"I think, master – if you allow me to – that this time the porridge wasn't tasty, it was astringent, and the oats weren't soaked well," he says. "I think, Inal should be the one making the porridge. The porridge she makes is so delicious that would make you swallow your tongue."
You look at him suspiciously, "How do you know that?"
 Aziz stands quietly and calmly in the sun without answering. Still, there's no need to ask as you can guess because your household slaves always gather to share dinner. But can you really trust a slave's taste buds? What good foods could he have tasted?
Then let Inal do it
Are you kidding me?

You ponder for a moment and decide to let Inal handle the next Charity Day. The one who managed the Charity Day before is extremely repulsed at you by letting a female slave to take over his work. His harsh words are of no concern to you; however, upon hearing of it, Aziz kneels at your feet, pleading that you assign him to maintain order at the next Charity Day.

This is aid for disaster victims, not a delicacy for the nobles at a banquet. Filling their bellies is the most important, and the portions are the most crucial thing to verify; everything else can be conceded. He slowly nodded, saying no more. Somehow, your words spread, and the nobles laughed heartily, acknowledging you as a friend. As for those being helped, what right do they have to resent you?

5320159.title: 铁头声望事件--石餐盒
strings:
Passing by the slaves' banquet, you notice the meal box in Aziz's hand seems a bit special. It's not the style you provide for the slaves, but a meal box made from hollowed-out white stone. 
Seeing you notice him, Aziz stands up slowly and greets you, "If you will allow, I could introduce my meal box, master."
He tells you it's made from a kind of refractory stone used for fixing stoves. It cools food slower when stored, making it taste better, and if you store leftovers inside covered, they keep longer. 
You take the meal box and scrutinize it. Although it's covered in indelible grease stains, the meal box indeed has a unique feel to it, it's a good thing.
I want yours
Could you make more?
How dare you steal my stone

“Everything I own originally belongs to you anyway,” Aziz said, presenting the meal box to you.
Indeed, that's the truth; however, it's no trouble to casually reward him with something to balance things out.

You asked him if more lunchboxes could be made if materials were available. Aziz pondered slowly and then nodded. You summoned the house servant in charge of the storeroom, provided Aziz with some materials. Still, focusing on making lunchboxes meant Aziz would not be able to do other work.
"A mere slave dares to steal my stone!" In anger, you smashed the lunchbox to the ground. Aziz said nothing, kneeling in apology before you.

5320160.title: 铁头声望事件--错位的水果
strings:
This evening, the courtyard fills with a strange fragrance. You go out to observe. To your eyes, you see Inal and Aziz leaning against each other, sharing a small handful of red berries – such fruits have recently been imported to the Sultanate; many nobles have tasted them. But slaves doing so... perhaps only these two before you have. 
Noticing your presence, Inal jumped up in fright, while Aziz remained unhurried.
"I bought them with your rewards, if you allow. If you don't, please punish me." He stuffed the remaining berries into his big mouth, then silently kneeled down, preparing to receive a whipping.
Spare them
Give them small punishment
Your crime is unforgivable
There's a place where you can eat even bigger and sweeter fruits...

You bypass him and walk directly to Inal.
"How do the berries taste?" you ask. "Are they delicious?"
She trembles, unable to form a proper reply—her usual sharp tongue is entirely gone.
Behind you, Aziz, still kneeling, speaks slowly,
"They are quite sour. They should be eaten with honey. But I only had enough money for a small handful of berries, and I didn't want to steal honey from the kitchen—that would be wrong. Still, with honey, the sourness and sweetness together, maybe with some ice cream, it would be incredibly delicious."
You are stunned. That is, in fact, exactly how the popular court desserts are prepared these days. Though only a slave, Aziz's tongue is as discerning and sensitive as that of a noble.
You sigh, comfort Inal, and then let Aziz stand up. You assure him that you are not those stingy masters who reward their slaves with money yet don't let them spend it.
Aziz slowly nods, "If you permit it... then I'll remember it, Master."

Slaves aren't entitled to eat such precious things. You personally whipped him twenty strokes. For other slaves, it's a serious injury requiring several days in bed. But Aziz made no sound, seemingly unbothered. Beside him, Inal cried and pleaded noisily, even more animated than the one being punished. You got tired from the whipping and casually tossed the whip aside. The matter ended there.

To utter such audacious words in front of the master... If such a slave isn't killed, then a master's dignity isn't worth discussing. You waved your hand, ordering the guards to remove him. Aziz struggled fiercely, while Inal wailed sharply at the side, the red juice of the berries trailing from their mouths like blood, dripping onto their chests.

What triggered this in you? Maybe it was the contrast between the slaves and the expensive food, or maybe it was the pure love between the young man and woman... Anyhow, a dark idea sprouted in your mind... Quite a few noble ladies might like Aziz.

5320161.title: 小圆声望事件激活提示
strings: She seems to want your attention. Put her into <color=white><size=172%>Methinks</size></color>.

5320162.title: 小圆声望事件-让我尝尝
strings: What would berries with ice cream and honey taste like? You're considering whether to buy more berries and let Inal make a few bowls to try.

5320163.title: 铁头声望事件-巨大的玩具

5320164.title: 铁头声望事件--新鲜货
strings:
Bharat somehow got wind and visits, proposing to see the insulating and preserving Stone Lunchbox you have.

“I’ve seen something similar among the desert tribes in the west...” harat muses, stroking his chin, “They believe demons alter things written in ink, so all their writing is carved on specially made stone slabs. Even there, children must learn stonemasonry before they can learn to write...”
“I'm straying off topic, anyway, this skillful hollowing of the stone is quite good, complete with a lid, better than what I’ve seen. Caravans traveling long distances would need this sort of thing, how many do you have? Only one?”
He sighs, “One isn’t enough... Can you get the maker to produce more? I’ll package it well; this can turn into a great business.”
Agree
Refuse him politely
Of course, that's not a problem. You called Aziz and assigned him this task.

You're not interested in this business. Not to mention how long it will take Aziz to grind out the quantity he desires, you have a lot of tasks waiting for Aziz to do, not to mention how lowly the things used by desert tribes are. Being known to be involved in such business truly will be not worth the loss. Bharat can't persuade you and left sullenly.

5320166.title: 铁头声望事件--大批新鲜货
strings:
Bharat somehow got wind and visits, proposing to see the insulating and preserving Stone Lunchbox you have.
“I’ve seen something similar among the desert tribes in the west...” Bharat muses, stroking his chin, “They believe demons alter things written in ink, so all their writing is carved on specially made stone slabs. Even there, children must learn stonemasonry before they can learn to write...”
“I'm straying off topic, anyway, this skillful hollowing of the stone is quite good, complete with a lid, better than what I’ve seen. Caravans traveling long distances would need this sort of thing, how many do you have? I want them all!”

5320167.title: 铁头声望事件-大量石餐盒

5320168.title: 铁头声望事件--沙尘往事
strings:
You're not one to be suspicious by nature, but on this day, looking at Aziz by your side, various doubts suddenly surfaced in your mind. 

Why should a slave, who seeks only to stave off hunger, possess a discerning tongue, as if they've tasted the world's delicacies? He even wants to grind a stone diligently to make food tastier... But such knowledge, and such traditions belonging to the desert tribes, where did Aziz learn it from? Perhaps, Aziz should give you an explanation.

5320169.title: 铁头声望事件--主人的宴会
strings:
You step out for some fresh air from an all-night feast and see the large figure of Aziz blending into the shadows at the corner of the courtyard, motionless, as if one with the stones beside him. You approach and ask him what he's doing. 

"If you allow me to answer, master, I'm waiting for leftovers." As was customary, the remnants from the feast would be given to the slaves, which isn't wrong, but he continues... 

"Today's lamb is roasted better than ever, I can smell it from here."
Join the feast with me
Call all the servants
Then wait

He was startled, rarely showing a moment of panic on his normally dull face, looking around hurriedly, tugging at his coarse cloth hem, hesitating: "I am just a slave, please allow me to refuse." 

You insisted on your request, being the host of this banquet, you were willing to invite whoever you wanted. But first, you need him to wash his face, comb his hair, then come to the banquet hall as you said. You even tempted him, mentioning how delicious roast lamb is, and how fresh the appetizers are, ensuring he could eat his fill if he wished. Aziz indeed was tempted.

He was surprised, not understanding what you intended. You could only patiently explain to him that the banquet was about to end, and you prepared to celebrate once more with everyone at home afterward. Tonight there would be no masters and servants, only family and friends. You will sit together and share delicious food and exquisite wine. Aziz's eyes shone as he nearly devoutly saluted, then quickly did as you said, going to call those busy in the kitchen.

That should be enough, you think. Even if he was once the child of some tribal leader, what's so special about that? The countries pillaged by the Sultan, the ancient bloodlines destroyed, combined could fill a river. Now he at least has a shelter, and after the banquet, there’s some slightly cooled roast lamb to eat.

5320170.title: 铁头声望事件--是奴隶，也是主人
strings:
Returning to the residence on this day, you found Aziz waiting for you. He slowly saluted you. "If you allow," he said, "I think you should have this." He handed you a small flute made from camel bone. He gazed at you calmly and steadily, "Some of my tribespeople, some exiles, they need a master to hold their reins. I'm not fit for it." 

The huge hand squeezed your hand, clearly not following etiquette – "But you can do it."

5320171.title: 铁头声望事件--铁头死了军队会跑
strings: One day, you entered the barracks and found that – seemingly due to Aziz's disappearance – the barbarian army has quietly left you.

5320172.title: 铁头声望事件--激活美味的救济日
strings: Very soon, the day for handing out porridge is approaching again. You recall having promised that Inal and Aziz would oversee it this time.

5320173.title: 小圆声望事件--不安的梦
strings:
Maggie comes to you with her dowry female slave, Inal, hoping you can spare a few minutes of your time for this girl. Inal kneels and recounts a dream that has troubled her for a long while.
In the dream, she stands inside a sturdy house, warm and safe. Then, suddenly, she realizes she is also in the wilderness, meaning she is in two places at once. There are wolves in the wilderness, and she knows they are approaching, so she wonders, if she opens the door to hide in the house, will she also bring in the wolves, endangering the one inside? Dreaming, she stands at the house's door, shivering until she wakes. 
How should one interpret this dream...
Once you leave here, you'll be in danger
You crave freedom, even if it involves risks

You told her that in her dream, wolves symbolize danger, while the house represents your residence, her place of refuge. This dream signifies that someone might attempt to take her away from here soon... 

Inal was horrified by your words, vigorously shaking her head, saying she absolutely didn’t want to be taken away...

You told her that in this dream, the self within a safe house represents the surface ego, while the one in the wilderness symbolizes her subconscious. She clearly understands the current situation ensures survival without worries, and outside is filled with survival risks, yet she still yearns for freedom. 

Inal was frightened by your words, kneeling on the ground, repeatedly swearing she didn't want to leave your residence. She clung to your wife's leg, asking her to convince you together. It took some time before you calmed this loyal female slave down.

5320174.title: 小圆声望事件--石榴糖浆
strings: Perhaps to ask you not to drive her away or to prove her value, Inal served you a plate of ruby-like pomegranate syrup with crushed ice from the icehouse. She mixed the ice into the syrup and then kneeled to present it to you. With one bite, the sweet scent of pomegranate permeated your heart. With your praise, she withdrew happily, seemingly no longer bothered by the dream. After Inal left, your wife told you Inal was a houseborn slave born at her home, enslaved since her grandparents' generation, never experiencing the life of a free person or considering buying her freedom. "A simple-minded girl, great at cooking, a bit too talkative, but has always served well." You nodded, a strange thought causing some slight unease, but now... that's the best you can do.

5320175.title: 小圆声望事件--梦中之狼
strings:
Inal comes home in a panic, telling you she saw the wolf of her dream.
 
It happened while she was at the market buying ingredients – while picking a fat duck. "A duck must have plump wings to be tasty, then I opened the wings to inspect... oh, sorry master, I digress... then he appeared! He looked like a wolf... his eyes were glowing green! He stared at me, asked whose family I belonged to! I was terrified, I... I dropped the duck and ran home! Thankfully I hadn't paid for it yet... I brought back all the money – oh, master, what should I do, things from dreams are coming out!" She gesticulates frantically, tears on her face, visibly panicked. 

Just as you consider how to comfort her, you notice the large slave, Aziz, seems to be quietly eavesdropping from outside the courtyard.
Watching Inal's tear-streaked face, you suddenly realize she's quite a beauty too...
Aziz seems to have something to say?
Call Maggie to comfort her
Distract her

You walk towards Inal and wrap your arm around her shoulder. She jumps, then quickly understands what you intend to do.

"Master... I am the mistress's slave... I... I..." she trembles but dares not resist, "Please don't, don't..."

You call Aziz over. Without needing to say a word, Aziz seems to naturally understand what needs to be done. His massive figure follows behind Inal, matching her pace, like a gentle giant dog. You can't hear their whispered conversation, but from afar, you notice Inal's expression relaxes significantly.

Handing over the authority of handling household affairs to the mistress is a sign of respect towards her. Maggie listens to you and nods. She supports Inal by the shoulder and accompany her as they walk out slowly. Once they've finished their talk, you can find out what actually happened.

To relieve tension, the best way is to distract yourself, do something else. You pat Inal on the head and tell her she can freely buy something she likes with the money originally set aside for groceries. Once she's feeling better, she can tell you what really happened.

Her sobbing stops, and she shows a hesitant expression. A slave probably rarely has the chance to receive such a reward... She kneels to thank you and suddenly dashes out, having thought of something.

5320176.title: 小圆声望事件--庭院树下
strings:
Not long after, you glimpse Inal under a tree in the courtyard, humming a song while chopping something.
A sweet fragrance drifts over, and you realize she's cutting ripe dates, seemingly garnished with honey, figs, and the like – these are probably what she bought with the money you gave her.

Beside her is a small bowl of ice, and the chopped dates glisten with a delightful syrup. The ice has been finely crushed and mixed with cheese. Everything is prepared as Inal takes this delicious treat and runs towards the corridor. Who's on duty outside today...? It should be Aziz, right?

You don't make a sound and quietly leave.

5320177.title: 小圆声望事件--狼目
strings:
After calming down, Inal finally explains the 'wolf' she encountered. 
While selecting meat and poultry at the market, a man suddenly approached from behind, praising her beauty, saying he'd noticed her for a long time, trying to grab her hand, hug her waist, even drag her into an alley! 
Inal shook her head repeatedly, struggling desperately, she smashed the basket she was holding into his face, screamed for help, and fortunately, a strong butcher nearby recognized her as a regular, acting in time to stop the man. Inal was terrified, thanking the butcher before running home as fast as she could, with the man audaciously following her, shouting that they would meet again, that she couldn't escape. 
You don't know the man's background or when he might appear again, it seems rather troubling...
Send someone to guard Inal at all times
Hire someone to investigate that man
The man had his eyes on Inal, so arranging for someone to protect her is the natural choice. If he dares come back again, he'll regret it!
You decide to find someone to investigate this scoundrel's whereabouts, looking for an opportunity to teach him a lesson he'll never forget.

5320178.title: 小圆声望事件--女人的谈判
strings:
That night, your wife angrily brings Inal to you.
She demands you marry Inal and take her as a concubine. "You can't insult her like that, then just walk away – even if she is a female slave, she shouldn't be treated this way." 
Inal trembles with fear, constantly tugging at your wife's clothes, like she is trying to persuade her to let it be...
Marry her
I won't marry a slave
Hearing your promise, your wife's expression softens slightly – like going from the coldest day of winter to the end of Autumn.

You firmly refused.
You said that day you were just impulsive, merely confused for a moment, and you didn't want a single mistake to affect Maggie's mood later on.
Maggie stared at you for a long time, her expression cold, and finally, she made you swear never to touch this girl again.
It was no big deal. You granted her request and swore.

5320180.title: 小圆声望事件--夜袭
strings:
As you were sound asleep, a clamor arose – the servants, trembling, reported through the door that Inal and Aziz... had escaped! They dared not use the word "eloped."
Inal, as your concubine, had long since moved out of the slaves' quarters and into a small room next to Maggie's. By the time they discovered it that night, she had already gathered up all her scant clothes and jewelry, while Aziz had taken a sharp knife from the kitchen.
They said Aziz and Inal had always cared for each other, secretly meeting and deeply in love, but how dare they? Slaves do not have the right to free marriage! Moreover, she already belonged to you!

5320181.title: 小圆声望事件--小圆失踪
strings:
It was already late this day when a few slaves hurriedly found Maggie, who worriedly informed you that Inal, who had gone shopping earlier, did not return as scheduled. You quickly sent people to search, but ultimately could not find her.
You lost this slave.

5320182.title: 小圆声望事件--殴斗
strings:
A noble with shifty face and even more villainous features limps over to lodge a furious complaint, saying he only looked at your pretty female slave a couple of times, at most touched her hand, yet was already beaten by the guard nearby!
His spit nearly sprays on your face, and he angrily and self-righteously orders you that unless you hand over Inal, this won't be over! 
It seems this is the man who grabbed Inal. Even after being beaten so badly, he still refuses to give up?
Take my money and get out of my sight
You are right, Inal is yours
You haven't had enough yet
A slave striking a noble is a serious crime, though none of this was your fault. Observing his tenacious attitude, you begrudgingly decide to pay him off to make him go away and stop bothering you.
No matter what, a slave shouldn't lay a hand on a noble. You apologized to him and expressed your willingness to send Inal to his residence.

You smirked and told him that he deserved the beating, and warned that if he harassed the women of your family again, or if you drew a Bloodshed Card, he wouldn't stand here spouting nonsense!
He trembled with anger, almost ready to act, but the old servant behind him held him back firmly. His family might turn against you in the future, but many others praised your righteous reputation. Maggie was also very satisfied with your conduct, telling everyone she married an extraordinary man.

5320183.title: 小圆声望事件--微小的波澜
strings:
One day, the servant told you that Aziz went out on an excuse and never returned. You tried to send someone to find him, but to no avail. Shortly after, you heard of a major incident in the city. A daring group of vagrants attacked a noble's feast, injuring many guards and killing the host of the banquet, then disappearing with several slaves.
The unlucky noble who was attacked was the one who had once tried to take Inal from you.

5320184.title: 小圆声望事件--微小的波澜2
strings:
You heard about a major incident in the city. A daring group of vagrants attacked a noble's feast, injuring many guards and confronted the host, asking for a literate and cooking-capable female slave. Upon learning she had been tortured to death, their leader, in furious rage, killed the noble in a cruel manner, taking all the scarred slaves away.
You could probably guess who did it.

5320185.title: 小圆声望事件--恶意的赞扬
strings:
The Sultan suddenly mentions you during an audience. "I've heard... you have a beautiful and skilled female slave in your estate...?" 
You immediately understand this must be that scoundrel who was after Inal finding a chance to tell the Sultan. As for the Sultan, if he hears someone has an 'interesting' woman, he never lets it go.
With Inal's personality and appearance, the Sultan would tire of her before an incense stick burns out, then toss her to those cruel eunuchs... The Sultan waits for your response, wanting to hear "I'll offer her to you," but...
I'll offer her to you...
I'll offer something else in her place
I suggest investigating who told you this
The Sultan nodded in satisfaction. Before you could leave the court, the guards sent to fetch Inal were already en route.
"Oh? Like what?" The Sultan raised an eyebrow.

You told the Sultan that the female slave was just a little brat, with nothing appealing about her, not even worth your attention. You indignantly added that she had been publicly harassed by some damned fellow earlier and you had reason to believe that this whole thing was an outrageous attempt by him to use the Sultan's authority to attack you!
"Consider it... if I presented such an unremarkable and ordinary female slave to the great you, how could I redeem such a sin?" You bowed to the Sultan, pleading for the person to be brought to the court for you to confront face to face.
The Sultan nodded. So be it. He liked to see his subjects in relentless disputes; it meant there would be a little red blood spilled in the palace today.

5320186.title: 小圆声望事件--悲伤的铁头

5320187.title: 小圆声望事件--心之声
strings:
Inal finds you, her usually lively face now gravely serious as she kneels and presents her request. 

"If you allow, I'd like to buy my freedom. I can gather the money; madam has agreed. She even allowed me to save for it..." She shyly presents a handful of small change, totaling about two gold coins. 

You're somewhat surprised and ask why she suddenly has this thought. Inal once more brings up the dream that made her uneasy, "That depraved wolf of a noble, the merciless indulgence of the Sultan... if not for your kindness, I'd have been sent to them already, right? It's all because I'm a slave, all my happiness, all my joy, are reflections on water, shatterable with a touch from master or master's master. But if I were free..." She bites her lip, determined, "I think I'd... have more choices." 

You want to tell her even free people have masters, like courtiers oppressed by the Sultan. But it seems since that the vague dream of freedom has already lodged in her heart. What is your decision?
This money will do
No need. You are free
I don't like this idea

You took the money. She let out a long sigh, her lively character prevailing again. She said she checked out slave prices everywhere, feeling that those sold for one Gold Coin couldn't be as good as her, while those sold for three Gold Coins were prettier than her. She shyly admitted that the money included your wife's usual reward and some that "others chipped in for me." 
Saying so, she probably remembered to share the good news with her companions and left joyfully after bidding farewell.

Listening to what you said, she stared at you dumbfoundedly, tears streaming down her face.
"How could there be such a kind master as you in this world – I almost want to continue being your slave... oh! Oh! I really – I really – thank you..." She kissed your feet, washing them clean with her tears.

You refused her because you didn't want to lose a slave. While it would be nice if a free person could be loyal to you, a slave is firmly within your grasp, one who cannot run away... Inal bit her lip and left crying.

5320188.title: 小圆声望事件--激活这是我的主意
strings:
Before bed, Maggie found you and gave you a bag of money: "It was my idea to make Inal a free woman." She glared at you, "I just wanted to protect her a little, to make her happier, because it's not hard for us, is it?"
Seeing Maggie so insisting, you reluctantly agreed to her proposal. Thus, Inal left.

5320189.title: 小圆声望事件--自由之人

5320190.title: 小圆声望事件--闭上的那只眼睛
strings:
Your wife casually mentioned that ever since Inal moved out from the slave's common room to the small house next to hers, there had been noises at night, as if a big guy visits often...
You pondered for a moment, asking if she minded.
She chuckled, covering her mouth: "I like Inal, she has been with me since she was a child... If she has a child, I would want that child to serve me."
You both shared a smile. The world is cruel, a blade hangs over your heads, but still, with what little power, goodwill, and money you had, you provided a small refuge for some people... isn't that a miracle?

5320191.title: 奈费勒声望事件--初见--杀戮
strings:
Almost as soon as you break the Sultan Card, a voice echoes in the lapis palace.
"Who would have thought, with such unprovoked bloodshed and so many innocent victims, no one feels sympathy or pity." Your political enemy – Nawfal shakes his head, casting a sharp look around at all the courtiers, as the nobles lower their heads, hiding the "he's at it again" reflections in their eyes.
Nawfal once more kneels before the Sultan, his spine rigid, voice clear and firm: "You must not let this absurd game continue, Your Majesty, please rescind the power you granted [player.name]; he should not be excused from the crime of murder for the sake of a game! This is a royal privilege – " he emphasizes, " – under 'certain circumstances.'" 
The Sultan seems intrigued by his words, smiling at you as if really considering punishing you.
Nawfal is right
Who can stop me from entertaining you?

Could this be an opportunity to escape the Sultan's Game? 
Thinking this, you stepped forward and knelt before the Sultan. You admitted that Nawfal was right, that the power and the heavy burden of the Sultan's Game was too much for you to bear. 
"Before I commit greater, more absurd mistakes, I beg you to end this game. In doing so, I am willing to bear the current blame." 
"How can this be, my dear subject," the Sultan laughed heartily. Isn't this what he expected? At the moment you jumped out to criticize him and advise him, he had hoped to see your downfall, to see you become like him at the end of the game, his kindred spirit. 
Nawfal wanted to say more, but the Sultan waved him away. Leaving the court, Nawfal stopped you, warning, "Don't think this is the end of the matter." His gaze was sharp, but there was a smidgeon of dark circles, glaringly evident against his pale skin. It seemed he hadn't been sleeping well lately. You shrugged habitually, not engaging in conversation, and left directly.

You immediately knelt on the ground, accusing Nawfal of having a wolf's ambition. Your king was only looking for a puppet show to enjoy, yet Nawfal dared to overstep? Who did he think he was? 
Your flattery performance enraged Nawfal; with anger and disdain, he used his linguistic prowess to mock you as a mere clown, criticizing all your actions and words from the day you were born, while you adeptly countered his every move, quietly wondering why his smart head was devoted to remembering these old feuds... 
This was the most common scene in the Sultan's court. The nobles were always heatedly fighting for Gold Coins, power, and status, while the Sultan laughed heartily, indulging and even encouraging you to fight each other. 
Leaving the court, Nawfal stopped you, as such warning, "Don't think this is the end of the matter." His gaze was sharp, but there was a smidgeon of dark blue in his eyes, glaringly evident against his pale skin. It seemed he hadn't been sleeping well lately. You shrugged habitually, not engaging in conversation, and left directly.

strings:
Almost as soon as you break the Sultan Card, a voice echoes in the lapis palace. 
"If not for today, I would not have known you have such wealth. Why didn't you help those suffering from disasters with some money in the past?" Your political enemy – Nawfal is shaking his head, casting a sharp look around at all the courtiers and passionately criticizing the disaster in some borderland of the empire, urging everyone to open their wallets...
Yet, the nobles lower their heads, avoiding throwing money away on something not their territory.
Finally, Nawfal kneels before the Sultan once more, spine rigid and voice clear and firm: "You must not let this absurd game continue, Your Majesty, please rescind the power you granted to [player.name], otherwise, I have reasons to suspect he will hide under the guise of cards to gain undeserved benefits and prestige!" He glances at you sideways, adding, "... ones rightfully yours." 
The Sultan seems intrigued by his words, smiling at you as if really considering asking you to present more gold...

You shrugged habitually, not engaging in conversation, and left directly.

5320194.title: 奈费勒声望事件--初见--征服
strings:
When you break the Sultan Card, the court fell into a rare silence, even your political enemies didn't jump out to say anything. It was a silence most odd. 
In your imagination, he should have come out criticizing you, saying you didn't flatten an oasis, a town, a country to meet the conquest card's standard... Yet you couldn’t do that! You don't have private troops!
Lost in thought, Nawfal suddenly steps forward. The nobles around him lower their heads, hiding the "he's at it again" reflections in their eyes.
Nawfal kneels before the Sultan once more, spine rigid, voice clear and firm: "You must not let this absurd game continue, Your Majesty, please rescind the power you granted [player.name], otherwise, I have reasons to suspect he will seize the opportunity to eliminate his foes!" He glances sideways at you, supplementing, "... and you would hear no dissenting voices." 
The Sultan seems intrigued by his words, smiling at you as if really considering giving you a warning...
Nawfal is right
Who can stop me from entertaining you?

Could this be a good opportunity to escape this game as well?

Thinking this, you step forward and kneel before the Sultan. You admit that Nawfal is right, the power brought by this deck and the heavy burden it brings are unbearable: "Before I make bigger, more ridiculous mistakes, I implore you to end this game."

"How could that be, dear minister?" The Sultan laughs heartily. Isn't this exactly what he hoped for? At the moment you jump out to accuse and advise him, he hopes to witness your fall, to see you become like him, become one of his own at the end of the game.

Nawfal wants to say more, but the Sultan waves him off. As you leave the court, Nawfal stops you and warns, "Don't think the matter is over." His gaze is sharp, but the dark circles beneath his eyes are evident against his pale skin. It seems he hasn't been sleeping well lately. You shrug dismissively, without interacting with him, you leave of your own accord.

You shrugged habitually, not engaging in conversation, and left directly.

5320195.title: 奈费勒声望事件--冗长的询问

5320196.title: 奈费勒声望事件--好人蒙冤
strings: The Vizier's servant delivered a letter to you, grandly stating the Vizier supports your exercise of all the power given by the Sultan's Game, and others should not waste your time over this matter. Apart from signaling to others that the Vizier is on your side, this letter serves little practical purpose.

5320197.title: 奈费勒声望事件--男人本应如此
strings:
The Vizier Abdul sent you a cloak, embroidered with obscene sexual scenes in gold thread.
The servant conveyed his message: "You merely did what any man would do, and I heard the detestable Nawfal even impeached you for it. If I were you, I would surely retaliate fiercely against that scoundrel!"

5320198.title: 奈费勒声望事件--宫门募捐

5320199.title: 奈费勒声望事件--花点钱有什么不好
strings: The Vizier sent a beautiful gift, and his servant, dressed in luxurious livery, knelt and conveyed his message. "What harm is there in spending a bit of money to make yourself happy? I truly don't understand why Nawfal targets you everywhere, clearly, you are the most capable person in the court, see how much you've done for me!"

5320200.title: 奈费勒声望事件--不支持的队伍
strings: Nawfal has supporters in many places in the empire, among them idealistic rural gentry and nobles who still believe in justice. These people are willing to share their insights at Nawfal's gatherings... Then, your process of breaking the Conquest Card is repeatedly brought up by them. Even though there's no flaw in procedure, law, or logic, you have exercised something originally reserved for royalty – "Conquest," resulting in more opponents appearing against you in court, standing beside Nawfal during audience.

5320201.title: 奈费勒声望事件--这是至高的荣耀
strings: The Vizier's servant delivered a decorative saber, apparent more for show than use, along with a message. "The great Sultan is willing to lend you his weapon and authority, what immense honor and glory! What nonsense is Nawfal spouting! Why haven't you gotten rid of him?"

5320202.title: 奈费勒声望事件--冤家路窄
strings:
You spot Nawfal at the Angler's Bookstore, his head buried in an ancient book.
You haven't decided whether to mock him or ignore him when he spots you and leaves as if brushing off dirt, leaving behind a book he was perusing.
You vow you have no interest in what he reads but inadvertently glimpse the cover's title, 'The False Freedom.'...
What is this
His taste is odd

This title piqued your interest. As you skimmed through a few pages, you found it to be just a collection of commonplace political allegories, describing various ugly behaviors under a tyrant's rule, filled with clichéd viewpoints, nothing noteworthy.
However – wait. You suddenly noticed a note tucked within one of the pages... you discreetly slipped it into your pocket, intending to examine it at home.
You had no interest in what book Nawfal was reading, and this title didn't catch your attention either. With nothing else to notice, you unenthusiastically left the bookstore.

5320203.title: 奈费勒声望事件--无用的施舍延时触发器

5320204.title: 奈费勒声望事件--无用的施舍

5320205.title: 奈费勒声望事件--无用的施舍-奈费勒的来信
strings:
Nawfal secretly sent a letter through someone, but its content was not confidential.
In the letter, he thanked you for the generosity shown that day; no matter what, you had indeed done a good deed.
However... he was still worried. Nawfal told you he had do such charity for years, but the number of people coming for porridge only increased. He kept pondering if everything he did was merely futile or how to truly help the poor.
At the end of the letter, he helplessly wrote that it was just his self-questioning, not anticipating you could answer. Perhaps the question had no answer at all.

5320206.title: 奈费勒声望事件--思索与探求
strings: Your sudden visit causes Nawfal to raise an eyebrow, and when you clarify your intention, he scrutinizes you as if seeing you anew. You enthusiastically share conclusions from recent reflections, saying to truly help the poor, you should –
Help impoverished mothers
Let them accept their fate
Make them more useful
Help eliminate their true enemies

You told Nawfal to help the poor, we must help the strongest and most vulnerable among them – the impoverished mothers.
He pondered for a while and admitted you were right. But how to achieve this, how to try? Over a pot of tea, you both discussed and planned how much money, how many people it would require.
"Let's start from your territory, give it a try," he concluded. "I'll pay half, you'll pay half. If it works well, we'll try it in my territory too, again half and half."
Thus it was agreed.

As a power holder, you know the entire empire is built on injustice. Despite your and Nawfal's efforts, the existence of nobles means draining the lifeblood of commoners...
But at least you can help them accept their fate and live a bit happier. You suggested organizing rituals and celebrations, encouraging everyone to listen to sermons and understand that worldly suffering is a necessary path to eternal paradise...
Nawfal remained silent for a long time then sighed deeply. Maybe, maybe you were right. With a pot of tea, you both discussed and planned the costs and manpower required for such an endeavor.
"Let's start from your territory, give it a try," he said. "I'll pay half, you'll pay half. If it works well, we'll try it in my territory too, again half and half."
Thus it was agreed.

It's better to teach someone to fish than to give them a fish. To really help the poor, simply filling their stomach for a day is useless. We need to find ways to make them more useful to this empire, to the rich, and to themselves.
Nawfal pondered for a while, then admitted you were right. 
Over a pot of tea, you both discussed and planned how much money, how many people it would require.
"Let's start from your territory, give it a try," he said. "I'll pay half, you'll pay half. If it works well, we'll try it in my territory too, again half and half."
Thus it was agreed.

The fat on the rich grows from sucking the marrow of the poor; to help the poor, we must help them exact vengeance – or at least give them hope for revenge. 

Nawfal frowned, shook his head after a while, and said, "I detest violence...but perhaps this matter can only be resolved with violence. We can try." He said, "I'll prepare. We'll need some money, half you, half me." Thus it was agreed.

5320209.title: 奈费勒声望事件--母亲的水滴重复刷

5320210.title: 奈费勒声望事件--奶与蛋
strings: The women who had received livestock from your territory brought you tax and gifts, in the form of fresh sheep's milk and eggs. They and their husbands, along with their children, will work harder now that they have hope.

5320211.title: 奈费勒声望事件--稀疏的队伍

5320215.title: 奈费勒声望事件--神之恩重复刷

5320216.title: 奈费勒声望事件--正教传播事件
strings: After a period of evangelizing, the people's faith becomes more devout. They willingly endure hunger and hardship, praying each day, until one day, word arrives from your territory that a loyal, impoverished follower strangled his child, claiming when caught that he sent the poor little one ahead to enjoy the everlasting paradise, the pure kingdom of God...
Punish them
Console them
Help them
Reward them
Whatever the reason, it is intolerable for parents to arbitrarily kill their own children. You punished them severely, yet they wept, not knowing what they had done wrong.

You kindly received the devout follower and informed them that the child did not die, and is surely living happily in the world beyond... That night, you dreamt of a child with an unclear face, staring blankly at you in a silent, pure white world, motionless...

Poverty was to blame! Out of goodwill, you gave him some money as consolation, leading the destitute people in your territory to imitate his actions... When the matter spread, many mocked you as a fool.

You were pleased to see the scene of father and son in conflict, even instructing the servants to keep an eye out for similar incidents so you could be the first to arrive at the scene... Once someone spread this around, people were shocked by your indifference and cruelty, no longer believing in your previous guise of benevolence.

5320217.title: 奈费勒声望事件--密教传播事件
strings:
A poor woman in your territory suddenly claimed one day that she had heard the voice of God – it told her that the next Sultan would be born in this territory, with dark hair, marrying a noble lady, and involving itself in the cruel game before its time... 

You quickly told her to stop, forbidding any further talk! Nevertheless, despite your efforts to keep the servants from spreading this so-called divine revelation, more and more people came to know about it...

5320218.title: 奈费勒声望事件--稀疏的队伍

5320222.title: 奈费勒声望事件--粗糙的心意
strings:
One day, a servant brought you a wooden apple, crudely made but with intricately carved wormholes on its leaves, quite amusing. 
The servant told you it was the first work of art made by the poor children on your territory using the tools you sent them, offering you this apple.
These children will grow up to be self-sufficient and useful people with their own hands.

5320223.title: 奈费勒声望事件--稀疏的队伍3

5320227.title: 奈费勒声望事件--火焰大王名声显赫
strings: Later, with your operation and Nawfal's intelligence support, the Fire King completes several acts of justice... Now, without any need for embellishment from your minstrels, the King of Flames has gained wide renown. So, what should be the focus of the next publicity?
Incite
Guide

Killing the wealthy, corrupt officials, and even the Sultan himself with the King of Flames... Kill! Kill! Let those wicked nobles be afraid!
There's no need for you to teach much, as such an idea naturally arises and spreads like wildfire.

One day the King of Flames will lead us to raise our banners and usher change to this unfair world! At your behest, such rumors gradually spread. Whether in dim taverns or in uncouth fields, commoners and slaves alike whisper among themselves, discussing, hoping, dreaming...

5320228.title: 奈费勒声望事件--团结他们的

5320229.title: 奈费勒声望事件--火焰大王的呼唤

5320230.title: 奈费勒声望事件--清流交汇
strings:
While passing by Nawfal's secluded mansion during one of your private meetings, you notice unusually loud sounds coming from within. Entering, you find a gathering taking place, with Nawfal seated at the center. When you burst in, all the guests halt their chatter and action, simultaneously turning to look at you. 

You...
Why? Am I not allowed?
Sorry to intrude, I must be lost

The nobles whispered, among them some impatient young ones who immediately jumped up to insult you, referring to you as an unwelcomed and shameless intruder, even bluntly calling you the Sultan's lackey. 

"Haha." You smiled indifferently, then casually sat at the end of the banquet, picked up a ripe fig from a silver plate, and ordered the servants to bring good wine for you, "Yes, I am the Sultan's lackey, now let's see what you men were talking about, go on." 

The servants looked awkwardly towards Nawfal at the head of the table, your political enemy, and secret ally, who looked at you with heavy eyes, and indifferently allowed them to seat you. "What we're discussing isn't anything shameless compared to what you've done," he said mockingly.

Some nobles whispered, with some impatient young ones immediately jumping up to insult your shamefulness, bluntly stating you're unwelcome here, the Sultan's lackey, and wanted you out. 

You felt a moment of embarrassment and was about to explain, when you saw your political enemy sitting at the head of the banquet table, your secret ally, frowning, and signaled to the servants with cold annoyance to dismiss you. 

Realizing this, you immediately exchanged sharp barbs with him before dramatically leaving with a huffy look, reflecting as you went that you mustn't rush into Nawfal's territory unknowingly next time, as being seen was unbeneficial for either of you.

5320231.title: 奈费勒声望事件--泄露的消息3
strings:
After a day's morning assembly, the Sultan suddenly stopped Nawfal. 
"I heard you have a penchant for gatherings," the Sultan said with a smile, fiddling with a scroll of parchment in his hand. "I also heard that criticizing me seems to be in vogue at such gatherings." 
Upon hearing this, you hurriedly knelt on the ground, repeatedly declaring your innocence; you were just unintentionally, unintentionally caught up in it and never spoke such words. 
The Sultan nodded to you tolerantly, "I know, [player.name], you may leave; even the traitor raised by this upright minister says you're incredibly loyal to me. Ah, even though it's a bit dull, hearing about loyal ministers once in a while is always pleasing." 
As you were about to exit the court with a smile, you heard Nawfal speak up beside you, his voice cold and stubborn: "I never said anything at those gatherings that I haven't said to your face. If you wish, I can say it again."
His aloofness angered the monarch. Not surprisingly, the Sultan threw him into prison.

5320232.title: 奈费勒声望事件--获释的消息
strings: Not long after this, you see Nawfal at court. His unusually pale complexion speaks of his time in prison. He has destroyed the house for secret meetings to curry favor with the Sultan. But it doesn't matter – there are countless other places for private meetings if you want.

5320233.title: 奈费勒声望事件-年轻的叛徒
strings:
Through some circuitous means, Nawfal secretly meets you in a secluded place. 

He tells you that he has discovered the identity of the traitor from the banquet – the young noble who had been working for the vizier, his long-time rival. Nawfal has already expelled him from their ranks.

"Our youth shouldn't be like this," he sighs. "They should be discerning, ambitious, carrying a flame that never dims." 

Lost in thought, Nawfal's expression grows somber. The path forward remains unclear – a question that will take time to answer.

5320234.title: 奈费勒声望事件--泄露的消息1
strings:
After the morning assembly, the Sultan suddenly stops Nawfal.
"I hear you have quite a taste for hosting gatherings," the Sultan says with a smile, idly toying with a parchment scroll in his hand. "And I hear criticizing me has become quite the fashion at these gatherings of yours."

At these words, you quickly drop to your knees, frantically explaining your innocence – you were merely swept along by that scoundrel Nawfal's influence, the liquor loosening your tongue... but your loyalty to the Sultan has never wavered!
"Hmm, I'm told you did speak some words in my favor." The Sultan examines his nails with practiced indifference. "So, I've decided to give you a chance to prove your loyalty," he adds with a knowing smile.

5320235.title: 奈费勒声望事件--泄露的消息2
strings:
After the morning assembly, the Sultan suddenly stops Nawfal. 

"I hear you have quite a taste for hosting gatherings," the Sultan says with a smile, idly toying with a parchment scroll in his hand. "And I hear criticizing me has become quite the fashion at these gatherings of yours."

At these words, you quickly drop to your knees, frantically explaining your innocence – you were merely swept along by that scoundrel Nawfal's influence, the liquor loosening your tongue... but your loyalty to the Sultan has never wavered!

"Oh, is that so?" The Sultan studies his nails with languid indifference. "That's not quite what I've heard, my dear subject. But I'll still give you a choice – either spend a few quiet days in the dungeons... or perhaps years, decades," he gives you an enigmatic smile. "Or, you could amuse me and beg for my mercy."

5320236.title: 奈费勒声望事件--恶意的捉弄

5320237.title: 奈费勒声望事件--恶意的捉弄

5320238.title: 奈费勒声望事件--恶意的玩笑

5320239.title: 奈费勒声望事件--同盟还是敌人
strings: The love-hate feud between the male prostitute and Nawfal is intensifying, and the plot against him continues... The question now is, do you secretly inform Nawfal? Who is your ally, who is your enemy?
Inform Nawfal
Stand by and observe

After listening to your speech, Nawfal pauses and then smiles helplessly.

"I originally thought this rumor arose inexplicably, but someone is indeed fanning the flames behind the scenes..." He shakes his head, "Who would believe such a ridiculous explanation? That I ran out over a male prostitute, dueled someone, and disappeared?"

"Don’t underestimate the power of rumors, especially when you have no way to be the storyteller," you say.
"You're right." Nawfal nodded: "I understand." He pauses before shaking his head with a bitter smile and says, "I never expected that at the end, the person I trust the most would actually be you."

"Help me one more time," Nawfal looks up again, firmly saying, "The more Abdul hates me, the more it proves I'm right. And to continue doing the right thing, we must go along with this and do something to retaliate against him."

"Let him continue to spread the so-called scandal, but don't really let him kidnap me – or, let the kidnapping succeed but not actually succeed."

You nod, you indeed have some combat experts who can help Nawfal escape this misfortune.
Let Nawfal meet his fate, now you're wholeheartedly working for Abdul, waiting to witness the day that damned man falls from a great height.

5320242.title: 奈费勒--空椅子
strings:
So it went, Abdul's crimes are exposed. The court erupts in a new round of verbal skirmishes for the position of vizier, and finally, the Sultan tires of the noise, casually names you to temporarily handle the mess left by the Vizier, and then leisurely leaves the audience hall.

The courtiers pause in silence, then begin congratulating you with smiles, engaging warmly as if suddenly intimate with you. Surrounded by flattery, you feel somewhat elated. Yet you notice Nawfal watching you silently from a distance. His dark eyes meet yours as he subtly shakes his head before turning away. You belatedly realize that succeeding to the position of Vizier might not be such a fortunate circumstance after all.

5320243.title: 奈费勒--脏兮兮的空椅子
strings:
The story of the Vizier being so obsessed with a male prostitute that he kidnapped Nawfal, only to be killed by the latter, has spread throughout the court, becoming the most popular anecdote. Many keep retelling the events of that banquet with winks and nudges, each person with their own version.

After indulging in dozens of versions, The Sultan finally remembers he needs a new vizier: "Abdul's story is indeed captivating, but someone must take his dirty seat. [player.name], who do you think is suitable?"

For some reason, The Sultan singles you out, naming you specifically, as you can't shake off the feeling that a significant trap is laid out here... The trouble a vizier has to deal with is probably far more serious than you think...
I’ll take the responsibility
Let Nawfal take over
Remain silent

You pats your chest, saying you're happy to share the Sultan's worries and speak a lot of flattering words. He squintes and laughs, "Not bad. At least you're more capable than that lascivious old dog before." He nods, "Half of Abdul's territory will be confiscated due to his scandal and added to the state treasury. The remaining part is rewarded to you."

You show gratitude to the Sultan once again, and after he leisurely left, the courtiers come up to congratulate you, speaking all kinds of flattering words. In the vast palace, except for Nawfal who doesn't bow his head, everyone else does.

With Nawfal quietly shaking his head, you suddenly calm down. Maybe being the Vizier isn't necessarily a good thing...

You recommend Nawfal to the Sultan, acting as if you can't wait to see Nawfal suffer, knowing how many messy things a Vizier has to face daily.

"What a connection," you laugh, "A male prostitute tied the two Viziers together. I suggest when Nawfal becomes a Vizier, he should well reward that man who disturbed the nation."

The Sultan also laughs and says, "Not bad." The Sultan squintes at Nawfal and nods, "Half of Abdul's territory will be confiscated and added to the state treasury, the remaining half is rewarded to you, Minister Nawfal. From today on, you are my Vizier."

With a steady face, Nawfal gives the Sultan a grand bow and receives the Vizier's seal.

No matter if it is out of fear, apprehension, or temporary hesitation, your silence instead piques the Sultan's interest. He directly names you to temporarily deal with the mess left by the Vizier, and then leisurely leaves the audience hall.

Leaving you alone bewildered, at a loss with Abdul's dirty chair, endless government affairs, and unfillable deficits...

5320244.title: 奈费勒--奈费勒的谢礼
strings:
Not long after, someone sends you a gift. Inside the small box, aside from some ordinary gold coins, lay only a severed length of bloodstained rope and a short note in Nawfal's handwriting.
"Do you find this thank you gift laughable? I do as well. Yet it stirred some thoughts in me. After much consideration, I can share them with no one but you."
"...Only those who sit in the Vizier's chair know how much filth they have to face: struggles for power, endless demands, like a rope tying up everyone. May you and I both possess the courage to draw the sword and cut it free."

5320245.title: 奈费勒--一则蹊跷的新闻

5320246.title: 奈费勒声望事件--初见--纵欲
strings:
After braving the Sultan's detailed inquiries and finally breaking the Sultan Card, the ambiguous teasing in the Lapis Lazuli palace only increases. The courtiers crowd your shoulders with playful grins, saying that Lady Maggie looks so dignified, but in private, who would have thought... You're tired, weary of coping – until a cold snort suddenly rings out.

"Who could have imagined the court would fall so low – and all because of you?" Nawfal, your political enemy, glares at you before raking his eyes over the courtiers. The nobles bow their heads, masking their weary "here he goes again" looks.

Nawfal kneels before the Sultan, back rigid, voice ringing with conviction: "Your Majesty, this farce has gone on long enough! I beseech you – strip [player.name] of the power you bestowed. No one should be spared punishment for murder, adultery, and countless other sins, all for some wretched game!" He hesitates, eyes narrowing briefly, then bows deeply. "Such a right belongs to the king alone."

The Sultan listens intently, a faint smile playing on his lips as he regards you, clearly weighing Nawfal’s words.
Nawfal is right
Who can stop me from entertaining you?

Could this be a good chance to escape this game?

With this thought, you step forward as well, kneeling before the Sultan. You admit that Nawfal is right; the power and burden these cards bring have overwhelmed you.”: "Before I commit further absurd errors, I humbly implore Your Majesty to end this game. Thus, I am willing to bear the current accusations."

"How could that be, my loyal subject?" the Sultan laughs heartily. Surely this is just what he expects. The moment you dare to confront and counsel him, he relishes your downfall, eager to see you corrupted like him, a mirror of his own soul.

Nawfal wants to say more, but the Sultan waves him off. As you leave the court, Nawfal stops you and says coldly, "Dragging your family into this will only lead to disaster." His gaze is sharp, holding both warning and advice, yet the dark circles under his eyes stand out starkly against his pale skin.

You sigh softly, don't say a word to him, and leave alone. What choice do you have now?

You immediately knelt on the ground, accusing Nawfal of having a wolf's ambition. Your king was only looking for a puppet show to enjoy, yet Nawfal dared to overstep? Who did he think he was? 
Your flattery performance enraged Nawfal; with anger and disdain, he used his linguistic prowess to mock you as a mere clown, criticizing all your actions and words from the day you were born, while you adeptly countered his every move, quietly wondering why his smart head was devoted to remembering these old feuds... 
This was the most common scene in the Sultan's court. The nobles were always heatedly fighting for Gold Coins, power, and status, while the Sultan laughed heartily, indulging and even encouraging you to fight each other. 
Leaving the court, Nawfal stopped you, as such warning, "Don't think this is the end of the matter." His gaze was sharp, but there was a smidgeon of dark blue in his eyes, glaringly evident against his pale skin. It seemed he hadn't been sleeping well lately. You shrugged habitually, not engaging in conversation, and left directly.

5320247.title: 奈费勒声望事件-思想的苗圃
strings:
Nawfal arranged to meet you at a strange and remote mansion, not very quiet, with the sound of poor children playing and shouting beyond the walls.
"Do you remember what we talked about before," he mused, turning his gaze from the window to you, "I've come up with an idea lately."
He described the concept of a school. At this school, poor children could learn to read and write, understand and engage with your ideas, all for free. He even planned to provide a nutritious lunch each day for the children.
"I want to try planting some seeds, but what I can harvest? I don't know. If you're willing to give it a try, as before, let's split the cost fifty-fifty." Nawfal indicated a number: 10 gold coins.

5320248.title: 奈费勒声望事件-为希望而战
strings: A troop joined in

5320249.title: 奈费勒声望事件-思想的苗圃2
strings:
After hearing you've built an orphanage, Nawfal quietly found you.
After some disguising, you took him on a tour of the orphanage. It wasn't school time yet, so it was just the two of you. "Do you remember what we talked about before?" he asked, looking at you. "You've found the answer before I did—a school... This is good. I'm eager to see what kind of fruit you can grow from this soil."
He then suggested, if you were willing, to send some orphans from his territory to your school. Naturally, you had no objection.

5320250.title: 奈费勒声望事件-最后的愿望
strings: When your educational endeavor was thriving, you received bad news that a child had fallen ill.

5320252.title: 承阳武士-拔剑
strings: Old friend, long time no see. With your call, this powerful weapon flew into your arms—after all, you were once one, and now you are reunited. The power in the hilt surged; it's time to show the Sultan its true strength.

5320253.title: 宫廷-索要妃子-迎接莎姬

5320254.title: 宫廷-索要妃子-欲望或者野心

5320255.title: 宫廷-索要妃子-黄金体验

5320256.title: 莎姬的礼物
strings: Zazie sends someone to find you. Besides bringing gifts, she also brings a promise: "As long as I'm beside the Sultan, I'll find ways to eliminate the Sultan's Suspicion."

5320257.title: 宫廷-索要妃子-要答应莎姬的请求么
strings: Zazie tells you a bizarre story. Do you choose to believe and help her?
I'll help you
I'd rather not get involved
Zazie hands you her token, saying, "If you have a solution and have contemplated a plan, please act quickly. I feel my time is running short."
Zazie expected your answer, so she says nothing more. Her promise is tempting, but you've avoided plenty of trouble, haven't you?

5320258.title: 宫廷-索要妃子-莎姬的催促
strings: Zazie sends a note urging you to think of something... Now those evil hounds can reach inside!

5320259.title: 宫廷-索要妃子-莎姬的催促
strings: Zazie sends a note, but you can't understand what's written - it looks like a madwoman's scribbles. Her mental state is truly concerning.

5320260.title: 宫廷-索要妃子-莎姬的催促
strings:
You dream. It's Zazie, naked, among a pack of evil dogs, being licked, driven toward a high mountain... At the summit, her soul, her everything - will be torn apart to please the hungry Highlord. 
This isn't Zazie's own plea, but the Highlord's final warning... if you still care about her soul.

5320261.title: 宫廷-索要妃子-莎姬的死亡
strings: Zazie dies. Reportedly, in the Old Rose Garden, she tore flesh from her own body piece by piece... More terrifying, before death, the last human-comprehensible word she uttered was [player.name], your name.

5320262.title: 宫廷-索要妃子-调查苏丹的奴隶

5320263.title: 宫廷-索要妃子-调查苏丹的避孕的方法

5320264.title: 宫廷-索要妃子-星星的秘密
strings:
As if knowing your concerns, one day Lumera places an ancient book on your table: It records how the Star-Souled - the gods once worshipped by Highlanders - lay with mortals, gaining more power through reincarnation. 
One passage mentions that stronger Star-Souled require nobler human bloodlines for rebirth... otherwise they lose power in the mortal realm, even memory. 
When did you buy this book?

5320265.title: 宫廷-索要妃子-星星的信号
strings:
At night, you dream of Lumera... She's returned to the Star-Souled's realm - turns out the Highland Highlord is her kin! 
When clouds obscure other stars and moonlight draws a veil of silence, she whispers the Highlord's secret in your ear: He is the North Star incarnate, one of the most powerful Star-Souleds... however, His longing for the days of human worship clouded His wisdom. 
Lumera warns you, if the Highlord gains the Monarch's Seeds, he can fully revive in the mortal world with complete power - but this spells disaster for that mortal. 
Finally, as wind shifts the clouds and moonlight dims, stars twinkling again, she bids you farewell with a smile: Goodbye, master, I still miss those days reading books and eating preserved fruits by your bookshelf... Whatever difficulties you face, please don't give up. We watch your story from above - at the crucial moment, I'll do my best to help you.

5320266.title: 宫廷-索要妃子-书店偶遇

5320267.title: 宫廷-索要妃子-急迫的欢愉（废弃）

5320268.title: 宫廷-索要妃子-监听是否适用了纵欲卡
strings: You should have realized - beyond competing in carnal pleasures with his favorite courtier, what could better excite the Sultan? The night you broke this Carnality Card, Zazie received the sovereign's favor... Hopefully the plan proceeds smoothly.

5320269.title: 宫廷-索要妃子-最后一步
strings:
"Soon I could be crouching in that rose garden, stuffing this thing in that damned Highlord's mouth! But... I can't help wondering, what will he demand next? What if next time he wants the Sultan's - eyeballs or something, what then?" She clenches her teeth, clutching her stomach...
"Let me be honest with you, you might think I'm crazy - but my wish was... power, power greater than the Sultan's! I don't want to be just a vessel for the next Sultan... God, I want to manipulate others' fates too!" She stares at you, seemingly waiting for you to contradict her. But you remain silent...
"The Highlord promised to help me, but now I realize relying solely on him isn't the solution. I must give him whatever he demands, which is unacceptable... and I doubt he can truly fulfill my wish anyway. So... I'd like your advice..."
You should fulfill the contract
I can handle this better

You anxiously wait for news in the backyard when a woman in dirty wrappings suddenly jumps from the bushes, colliding with you. 
As you prepare to scold her, she raises her head and gestures "shh"... It's Zazie! This favorite concubine has shed all jewelry and gold, wearing slave girl clothes, smeared with something foul-smelling, her hair deliberately dirty and messy... Without those leopard-like eyes, you wouldn't recognize her! 
"I don't trust eunuchs to deliver something this important, so I disguised myself... But I can only be away briefly - the Sultan wants me constantly these days." She glances back nervously. "Come, let's talk inside quickly." 
She takes your hand, touching her warm belly - clearly, the Sultan's seed fills it. 
"Everything's handled as planned! Your arrangement worked perfectly!" She tells you Savasar is now a living corpse; she ensured her most trusted guards "executed" him. The Sultan is slightly displeased at how frequently slaves in this position die, but Zazie knows how to soothe this minor dissatisfaction.

You advise Zazie to fulfill the Highlord's contract. god beings aren't easily managed - though satisfying Their contracts doesn't guarantee a good outcome either. Let our ambitious Lady Zazie learn this lesson herself.

You tell Zazie you can eliminate this Highlord. Anything They desire, like the seed in her belly, can serve as excellent bait... 
Zazie stares at you silently for a long time, then suddenly lies on your desk, removing her pants - help me squeeze them out... Unless you want to suck them out with your mouth!

5320270.title: 宫廷-索要妃子-契约完成
strings: Word comes from the palace: The Sultan's favorite concubine Zazie has gone mad. She clutches her stomach, claiming she's about to give birth, though nothing is there. She cries, begging everyone to save her, saying she doesn't want to become a star. The Sultan, tired of her ravings, orders her stomach cut open to show her the truth... Everyone present swears they saw a bright star rise from Zazie's belly. This blood-bathed star circled above their heads before suddenly darting to Zazie's forehead... In that instant, everything darkened around them, a cool breeze brushing everyone's faces and ears... Then the blood vanished, the stench disappeared, the crying woman gone - Zazie vanished completely. The Highlord fulfilled his contract with the woman - "Zazie" certainly enjoys god power now, doesn't she? But now it's your turn to worry about that bizarre god...

5320271.title: 宫廷-索要妃子-苏丹奴隶的提示
strings: A note tucked in a poetry collection: You have four days to arouse the Supreme Sultan's passion, his most intimate courtier. Otherwise, I lose my tongue, and you lose everything you've plotted.

5320272.title: 宫廷-索要妃子-苏丹奴隶的提示
