“I used an ether bottle, stolen from the True Faith's church, and mounted it in my exclusive bi-directional semi-fluid tube, simulating the motion of a heart, but it's metal and won't rot!” She becomes more and more excited as she speaks, pulling your hand around the chest cavity, “If I can connect the other blood vessels and muscles, the corpse will move!”
Then, she finally lets go of your hand and eagerly grabs your shoulder with her even dirtier hand, covered in more slime.
You pry her hand off and think about her proposal...

5320504.title: 对行尸的处理
strings: For Mahir’s pursuit of invention and creation, this truly is a miracle, but can this dangerous Corpse really be put to use? Is it worth continuing, and what other trouble might it attract? Mahir gazes at you with glittering eyes, like an animal seeking praise...
It will be greatly useful!
This thing is not quite right.

This distance is almost a step away from resurrecting the dead – this step refers to capturing a lost soul. In any case, this is undoubtedly an extraordinary invention, and though you feel severely wronged, you still generously praise Mahir's efforts.

She is delighted and asks if there is a job where her creation can be tested, eager to see how much money this thing could earn for her and for you.

You point out that this “creation” simply does not take orders; it just moves, and these movements are reflex responses generated based on decaying memories. Not only useless, but it's also dangerous.
You demand Mahir to stop this disgusting experiment.
She's very dissatisfied and keeps fiddling with the copper tubes, trying to show you how cute and capable it is.
But any movements this corpse makes only disgust you.

5320505.title: 对行尸的处理
strings: As long as it's about this golem, Mahir is more diligent than anything... So, what should we make this big guy do now?
Start making money.
Improve its performance.

5320506.title: 对行尸的处理
strings: Mahir asks: Any opinions on this golem?
Want to use it to make money.
Want to upgrade it.

5320507.title: 只有税收不可避免
strings: The Sultan's tax collector found you and suggested that no matter what method you're using to make money, don't think you can pay any less of the Sultan's tax... in which case, at least half of your income would go to the Sultan...
Honestly pay the tax.
Talk to him about the law.
The tax collector was satisfied with your attitude and didn't bother the Sultan with this trivial matter... He just quietly issued an administrative patch targeting [unknown power].
"I am doing you a favor by not bringing up the law," he warns. Trouble may be coming your way next.

5320508.title: 咬了苏丹一口
strings: The corpse bit the Sultan According to palace rumors, while the Sultan ordered this toy to participate in some of his harem games... it bit him. Enraged, the Sultan ordered the guards to crush the corpse.

5320509.title: 男人真正想要的
strings:
Mahir comes to you with flushed cheeks, seemingly proud of her new idea.
“I’ve thought of an idea that will definitely make money, and will drive every man crazy!” she declares. “As soon as you hear it, you’ll immediately want to fund me!”
You let her speak.
“Let me ask you a question first – what do men truly desire?”
Money
Power
Love
Knowledge

Men need money to establish themselves in society, support their families, and achieve their goals. So, you tell Mahir, what men truly desire is money.
“But, but... everyone wants money, not just men! Think again, is there something that men want, but women don’t care for?”
She looks at you eagerly.
“If you really can't guess, I'll tell you!”

Power is the source of all things that men possess. Without power, men can’t hold on to anything. Whether it's strong arms or great influence, it’s all power, and it’s what men want most.
Mahir isn't quite satisfied with your answer.
“Power isn’t exclusive to men, right? I’m talking about what men desire most, not what everyone desires... You’re so dense, let me tell you!”

Loneliness is the only reason heroes fall, solitude is the curse that haunts monarchs; the only thing that can grant a man peace is the love from a lover.
This answer excites Mahir.
“Just a little bit more – almost right! To truly enjoy love, you need one more thing that every man desires, and that is – ”

Knowledge is a key to everything, all things can be summarized as knowledge and then passed down. You think knowledge is more important to a man than anything else.
“Everyone wants knowledge – for example, I want it too, but I'm not a man!” Mahir shouts in repulsion, “I said what men want most, men, the focus is men! Forget it, let me tell you the answer!”

5320510.title: 高速旋转的那个什么……
strings: Men obviously want big dicks! “A gold phallus filled with energy, spinning at high speeds, extendable and retractable, tireless – You don't know what expression to make for a moment – and in that instant, she somehow pulled out a... sample. This thing buzzes as it spins, pressing right against your nose, with Mahir endlessly explaining: “It's filled with aether, and it moves on its own. You just need to lie there, and it can handle everything! Plus, I can do a simple procedure to attach it to your skin so you can still enjoy a lot of pleasure! It's hard but warm, rugged yet comfortable, grand yet flexible, and it even has three extra modes: electric shock, heat, and cooling oil!" You hold your forehead, feeling dizzy. “Try it! Try it! You try it first, and then we'll promote it! Every man would want this!"
For the time being, let's ask one more question...
It’s indeed a good idea...
Get that thing away from me.

You ask her, if you're going to use this thing, then what about your original...

She pauses, seemingly never considering this question.
"Well... you can keep it, uh... bury it with yourself in the end? I've heard the eunuchs in the Sultan's harem do this! And, uh... you can also offer it to the gods?"

You tell her that gods probably wouldn't like such a thing. But to install that bronze luxury item made by her, you will have to cut the original, right?

She nods heavily. "Ah! Don't worry, you can keep your balls! Although I don't know if the sperm soaked in ether still has the ability to impregnate! It's also a good experiment!"

You really don't have the energy to argue with her.
So, will you install this high-speed spinning... whatever it is? Or do you think someone is more suitable than you?

I must admit, even if this isn’t the most wanted thing by a man, at certain times... it could definitely be in the top three.
 Mahir becomes more excited after receiving your affirmation, and she rattles off more benefits of this thing. Finally, she takes out a small wooden box.
 “Just cut off your current one and give it to me, I’ll take it back and make a mold based on it, and I can have it done in no time!”
... Cut it off?! And shouldn't it be three times bigger?!

You tell her that you didn't spend money to invest in her for this kind of return.
She is utterly confused, and as you forcefully escort her out the door, she keeps grabbing passing footmen and guards, asking, 'Don't you want a high-speed spinning gold phallus?'
...That's the end of it, you never want to hear about high-speed spinning again.

5320513.title: 每5天判定一次强者待遇

5320516.title: 世上唯一的珍宝
strings: How to handle this thing? Given its rarity, you can keep it as a rare treasure or give it to someone else...
Permanently keep it
Wait

5320517.title: 白嫖的快乐
strings: The whole city now knows about this incident. Now, the daughters of pleasure at the brothel desire to see your splendor – sorry, the splendor of the Rod of Life. It's completely free, but only when the ladies have time.

5320520.title: 伤痕与友情
strings:
Maggie casually mentions her experience in the bathhouse during dinner.
She encountered Adila there, with the young woman sitting alone in the bath due to the terrifying scars on her back, which deterred other noblewomen from speaking to her. 
But as your wife, Maggie fears no such matters. She sat beside Adila, warmly praising her bravery as a warrior and her smooth, beautiful waist, winning Adila's great favor and respect. They agreed to bathe together again and use essential oils and fine threads to groom each other...
Praise your wife
Be less showy, would you?
You praised her social finesse, and seeing a chance to be of help to you, her long-lost smile returned to her face.

You told your wife that drawing attention in public was unsafe and asked her not to do it again.
She studied you for a moment, then coldly accepted your advice.

5320521.title: 阿迪莱声望事件激活提示
strings: Adila seems to be looking for you. Insert it into <color=white><size=172%>Methinks</size></color>.

5320522.title: 酒与肉
strings:
Adila knocks on your door. She holds a paper-wrapped roast lamb in one hand and a liquor bottle in the other, apparently having stopped by on her way from the market.

"Ah, it's you. Would you like to have a drink?" She raises the bottle with an easy familiarity, then adds, "Though I originally came to find your wife..."

5320524.title: 战士不需要的东西
strings:
Adila comes to see you, or rather, she is brought by her mother, grandmother, and four aunts.

These noble women all wear serious expressions, while Adila looks ashen. Once they are all seated according to their seniority, the grandmother, sitting in the center, slowly begins.

"We come to you with a most important request."

She takes Adila's hand, caressing it while looking at you.

"Our granddaughter, our daughter, our niece, Adila, needs a husband, so that they may together slay the dragon."

You give Adila a puzzled look as her face turns from pale to red. "I... I mentioned to mother what if I wanted to slay dragons with outsiders..." she says, her usually loud voice now barely a whisper, "she said the only way to share the secret of dragon-slaying with outsiders was to marry... I quickly said to forget it, but you see... that's how it is..."

All the women look at you, their intentions all too obvious.

5320525.title: 唯一的人选
strings:
This morning, Adila knocks on your door. The fully armed warrior carries a heavy travel pack, her bright eyes blazing with anger and pride.

"I'm leaving." She proudly lifts her head and announces to you, "I don't need a husband; what I want is the head of that damned dragon. Hah! I've memorized every technique to slay it. I'll find the dragon myself – and then I'll kill it!"

Her voice is so firm that you know no matter what you say, you won't be able to change her mind. Perhaps adventure and death are the fates of a warrior. Even so, you can still prepare something for her.

5320526.title: 最后的准备
strings:
Having confirmed the lair, it's time to set off, yet Adila, somewhat embarrassed, approaches you, hesitating before stating her intention. 
She says to slay the dragon she needs at least three things: courageous companions, Fireproof Robe, and a Quenched Mithril Longsword.
She has resolved to slay the dragon alone, thus needing no companions; a Quenched Mithril Longsword is impossible to buy on the market, so forget it; but she hopes you can lend her some money to buy a set of fireproof armor...
Seeing her struggling financially, you realize, though she said 'lend,' the money is most likely a one-way trip...
Paying is what I do best
Let me handle the preparation
No, I won't provide further support
Money can always be earned, but participating in dragon-slaying is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. You thump your chest confidently, promising to take care of all the expenses.
If you take care of the preparations yourself, you could probably save some money. Adila gives you a grateful smile, more than happy with this arrangement.

You've spent too much time and energy on Adila and her dragon-slaying dream, and now you're feeling drained.

She looks disappointed, but far from defeated. Knowing her, you know she'll never give up on slaying that dragon.

5320527.title: 屠龙的勇行
strings:
Adila stands ready to depart. Mounted on her stallion and armed with dragon-slaying gear, she cuts a solitary figure.

Just as she bids you farewell, ready to begin her journey, a strange procession comes into view.

Her grandmother appears in ancient silver armor, leaning on a cane while gripping a sword. Her mother wears silver chainmail, one hand steadying her mother, the other firmly holding an oak shield. Her aunts, grandaunts, and even the household's old maids – all stand adorned in warrior's gear, slowly approaching together.
Continue

"We all thought," Grandmother stops in front of Adila and you, her voice hoarse and sharp, "and we've prepared, practiced, and worked hard for it, but we never managed to keep our courage like you until the end..."
Mother comes up to embrace Adila, the young warrior is taken aback, at a loss. "I thought you were all model ladies, who never touch weapons..." 
"We gave up being warriors, and then became ladies, because here lies another battlefield. But through generations, we've always hoped our daughters could be stronger warriors than we are."
Grandmother hands the sword she holds to Adila. "Take it, this is the quenched mithril longsword, you can't buy it anywhere, because it was tempered with dragon fire, you deserve it. Go, child, it's just a big lizard with wings, you will surely return victorious."
Adila bursts into tears. After crying, she solemnly takes the sword and sets off on horseback without turning back.
Behind her, the women softly sing a strange song until their youngest, bravest girl disappears into the distance, they finally sing the last line of the song:
"I strike! I fight! I break free...
At last I've slain the dragon's might!
That dared to chain my soul so tight!"

5320528.title: 处置龙眼宝石
strings: This unparalleled gift, this unparalleled glory – who shall be the chosen one? Or perhaps... you'll keep it for yourself?
This will be an extraordinary gift.
Let us see what it can do.
This gift, brimming with magic, will bind your fates together forever.
There may be secrets hidden—of dragons, and of worlds beyond this one.

5320530.title: 如果我……
strings: After dinner that day, Maggie sat beside you drinking tea. In this rare moment of peace and warmth, she suddenly remembered something and looked up to ask you, "Dear, I suddenly think... maybe practicing swordsmanship wouldn't be bad. What do you think?"
Support
Ridicule

You rest your chin in your hand, deliberately looking Maggie up and down until she grows visibly nervous. Only then do you nod and say you can't see anything wrong – with her well-proportioned figure, she might actually make an excellent swordswoman.

Maggie's cheeks turn slightly pink as she keeps protesting that you're teasing her – how could she ever be a swordswoman... but you can tell she's delighted.

After some playful banter, Maggie snuggles up to you and says that when family commitments are less demanding, she'll ask Adila for more guidance on sword fighting. You support her decision, only reminding her not to injure herself. Maggie gives you a bright smile and agrees.

You shake your head, advising her to forget it. Maggie has grown up in seclusion, she knows how to train maids, how to socialize with other ministers' wives, but when it comes to swordplay... she probably has never touched a sword hilt in her life.

Hearing your words, Maggie seems to sober up a bit; she looks slightly embarrassed, mumbling that she was just too caught up in the adventure stories she shared with Adila...

And that's the end of it.

5320531.title: 妻子声望事件激活提示
strings: Maggie seems to want to tell you something. Insert it into <color=white><size=172%>Methinks</size></color>.

5320532.title: 滋养与杀戮
strings:
Maggie carries a large jar of ointment as she leaves, and you ask her where she is headed; she says to the bathhouse.

"I'm so fed up with those gossips; every time Adila goes to the bathhouse, they act as if they're scared of mice or ghosts, running to other pools! Actually, most of those scars could fade away with proper care, and Adila just never learned how to take care of her skin properly."

Maggie tosses her head proudly; her ointment is well-regarded among the capital's ladies, a secret formula passed down from her grandmother through her mother.

"Dear, you might need some as well..." She gives you a dab, then veils herself and nods to you, "I'll go to the bathhouse right now. Have a wonderful day, my husband."

5320533.title: 休憩的方法
strings:
That day, you notice Maggie directing maids to weave something, seemingly an outfit.
"It's a gift for Adila. She's too tense, she's either fighting or practicing fighting! I told her, you can string a bow as tight as possible, but if it never relaxes, the string will snap. So I made this outfit for her, hoping she'll take some time to dance, visit the bathhouse, or even just stroll around the court. Ah, the joys of being a woman – she knows so little of them."
She raises the outfit to show you, its hues matching Adila's hair.
"I'm going to send it to her."

5320535.title: 奇怪的气氛
strings:
The atmosphere between Adila and Maggie seems strange to you...
That night, you went to find Maggie and asked her about her impression of Adila as a swordsmanship teacher.

"Oh, she might be the most powerful woman, right? No woman can hold a sword so steadily, and stab so deeply!" Maggie's eyes sparkled, "I believe if dragons existed, she would definitely slay them."

An unreasonable jealousy started bubbling inside you; Maggie has never praised you like that... Certainly, you've never thought about slaying dragons, but...

Perhaps sensing your displeasure, Maggie subdued her enthusiasm and promised she wouldn't practice with Adila anymore...

You open your mouth – it is indeed the result you wanted, but is it what Maggie wants? Because of your unfounded feelings, should you take away Maggie's cherished interest and laughter?
It's okay
Don't go

You gently touch Maggie's face, just as you used to when you were newly engaged. You tell her your greatest wish is to make her happy, and as long as she remembers that, whatever she does, you won't mind.

Maggie places her hand over yours, nuzzling your hand with her cheek, her trust and affection needing no words.

You stay silent for a moment and nod.

Your wife doesn't need to fight anymore; her skill has already exceeded expectations. Future battles should be left to the guards, to the men.

Maggie says nothing. In the silence, she senses your unease and mistrust. She lowers her head, accepting your decision.

5320537.title: 唯一的人选？
strings:
Adila was furious, as if she'd had a fierce quarrel with someone.
She kept complaining to you and Maggie, "My grandmother now nags me for at least four hours every day, saying I should find a husband before considering dragon slaying... but I will not yield! I need no husband, I need a dragon's head flourishing in blood!"

Adila proudly declared to you, "I'm leaving; the art of dragon-slaying is well-memorized in my mind, no one can stop me. I'm going to find a dragon and kill it myself!"

Maggie was very worried, after all, it's a dragon; it's not something one can accomplish alone.

Perhaps that worry was what helped Maggie persuade her, she pondered for a moment and said to you, "I don't need a man's help, but... maybe Maggie is right. I would like Maggie to help me, is that okay?"
I can't let her risk herself
This... alright

You refuse Adila.

Dragon-slaying is no mere social outing or leisurely chat in a bathhouse. And you won't risk losing your wife due to Adila and her family's revenge.

Adila sighs, saying she will continue her dragon-slaying quest alone.

Maggie is first surprised, then excited.

"You're going to slay the dragon alone, Adila? Oh my... you should find someone stronger to help you. Could I... maybe help with the little things? Like preparation work or something? I know I'm not much of a fighter, but I want to help."

Adila excitedly grasps Maggie's hand, then pulls out an ancient tome from her bag. The book is bound in an unfamiliar leather, its pages thick and weathered, carrying a faint scent of char.

"All the dragon-slaying secrets are in here, though some passages still elude me..." She hands the book to Maggie, hoping she can help decode its mysteries.

5320538.title: 精打细算
strings:
The clues from The Book of Dragonslaying have almost all been gathered. Next, Adila is preparing to set out across the Empire, searching for possible dragon lairs. Meanwhile, Maggie has her mind on something else – according to the book, that damned giant lizard's breath burns with unbearable heat, and common armor offers little protection against fire...

So, after Adila’s departure, Maggie called several merchants to home. She negotiated and bargained with them, determined to secure the equipment Adila needs for dragon-slaying.

Perhaps you have connections to share, or could help fund her preparations. Of course, you can also choose to do nothing – after all, dragon slaying doesn't really concern you...

5320539.title: 心焦之人
strings:
Adila has been away visiting the dragon's lair for several days. Maggie seemed a bit anxious.
"It's strange, I've never been so anxious because of anyone else... other than you. Perhaps it's because this is the first major event I'm involved in – and what could be bigger than slaying a dragon? What do you think?"

She turned to you, her searching eyes lingering over you.
"I want to prepare a blessing ritual for dear Adila... to wish her all the best. Shall we invite the priest?"

This ritual would certainly require some money. If you do not wish to spend, Maggie would, of course, pay herself.
Leave it to me
Hmm...

5320540.title: 祈福仪式
strings:
Seeing your hesitation, Maggie wordlessly turns and leaves the room. She takes out her personal savings to hire priests and monks to bless Adila, while you stand aside watching coldly, sneering that it's a waste of money – that she should invest in your ventures instead.

You have a bitter argument about it, and for days afterward, neither of you speaks to the other.

5320541.title: 突然的摊牌
strings:
According to Adila's plan, tomorrow is the day to set off on her quest, yet today she suddenly comes to find you – just you alone.

She dresses in her dragon-slaying attire, carrying an ancient longsword. While waiting for you, she continually hummed a song...
"...I kill, I kill, I kill the dragon who made me a woman."

You walk in and ask what she's singing, she seems flustered.
"I finally told my mother and grandmother about my dragon-slaying plans, they cried and said they always wanted me to be a lady, get married, have children, and not slay dragons because they don't want to lose me..." She sighs, handing you the sword to see, "Then they gave me this sword, saying only a girl determined to slay dragons is worthy of it. Each and every one of them tried, but found themselves ill-befitting the title of great warriors, so they chose another battlefield: being a mother. This is their song."

She lowered her head, and after a while, she looked at you with determined eyes.
"I have found that I love Maggie, sir."
You were taken aback, but felt unsurprised...
"Men should die for a woman's love, but so should women. So, I initially wanted to propose a duel with you, but slaying dragons is more important than love. I can't die the night before dragon slaying."
You finally regain some clarity, so you ask, what is it that she really wants.
"I will go slay dragons, then, if I can return alive, I will ask Lady Maggie to go with me. As a dragon-slaying hero, I will surely be able to support my woman, even if she has grown accustomed to be best by your side."

Your head ached, you tell her Maggie is not someone who would elope with a woman; her thoughts are too absurd.

Adila is not surprised by your words; she stands up, shining in the dragon-slaying attire Maggie prepared for her, accentuating her blazing valiance.

"I have informed you of everything like a real man beforehand, and as such I will depart like a real warrior to slay the dragon. I have not lied, and I leave no regret; this is enough."

She turns and leave, leaving you alone in the wind... maybe you should ask Maggie what she thinks.
Continue

Adila stands ready to depart. Mounted on her stallion and armed with dragon-slaying gear, she cuts a solitary figure.
Just as she bids you farewell, ready to begin her journey, a strange procession comes into view.
Her grandmother appears in ancient silver armor, leaning on a cane while gripping a sword. Her mother wears silver chainmail, one hand steadying her mother, the other firmly holding an oak shield. Her aunts, grandaunts, and even the household's old maids – all stand adorned in warrior's gear, slowly approaching together.
"We all thought," Grandmother stops in front of Adila and you, her voice hoarse and sharp, "and we've prepared, practiced, and worked hard for it, but we never managed to keep our courage like you until the end..."
Mother comes up to embrace Adila, the young warrior is taken aback, at a loss. "I thought you were all model ladies, who never touch weapons..." 
"We gave up being warriors, and then became ladies, because here lies another battlefield. But through generations, we've always hoped our daughters could be stronger warriors than we are."
Adila bursts into tears. Then, turning around, she embraces Maggie who stands beside you, and gives you a slight nod. With these final gestures done, she mounts her horse and gallops into the distance.
Behind her, the women softly sing a strange song until their youngest, bravest girl disappears into the distance, they finally sing the last line of the song:
"I strike! I fight! I break free...
At last I've slain the dragon's might!
That dared to chain my soul so tight!"

5320542.title: 突然的摊牌妻子的反应

Adila bursts into tears. Then, turning around, she embraces Maggie who stands beside you, and gives you a slight nod. With these final gestures done, she mounts her horse and gallops into the distance.

"I strike! I fight! I break free...

5320546.title: 询问妻子
strings:
Adila hopes you can allow Maggie to help her with some of the dragon-slaying tasks, and Maggie, well, she seems a bit tempted... Perhaps it's because she learned a lot of sword moves from Adila and is eager to try, or maybe she's simply concerned about her friend facing such a dangerous situation alone...

Their eyes are on you, waiting for your decision.
I can't let her risk herself
This... alright

You shake your head, refusing Adila.

Dragon-slaying is no mere social outing or leisurely chat in a bathhouse. And you won't risk losing your wife due to Adila and her family's revenge.

Adila nods thoughtfully. "You are right." Just as you think she might give up, her voice suddenly hardens. "Then I will do this on my own." 

Her tone carries such resolution that you know no one can dissuade her. Perhaps adventure and death are a warrior's fate, but... you think you might still be able to do something for her.

You nod in agreement. Adila throws her arms around Maggie in excitement, and Maggie can't help but catch her infectious joy.

"Oh my... you should find someone stronger to help you. Could I... maybe help with the little things? Like preparation work or something? I know I'm not much of a fighter, but I want to help."

Adila glances around at the women with pride, then pulls out an ancient tome from her bag. The book is bound in an unfamiliar leather, its pages thick and weathered, carrying a faint scent of char.

"All the dragon-slaying secrets are in here, though some passages still elude me..." She hands the book to Maggie, hoping she can help decode its mysteries.

5320550.title: 深潜
strings:
On some night, you return once again to this void. Darkness spreads endlessly under your feet, like the cosmos, like despair, like an endless slumber from which you won't wake.

You fall, and suddenly, cryptic hieroglypics and symbols once again float before your eyes. They bounce and zigzag, assembling into a question.

"What do you want? What are you looking for by deciphering that book?"
You realize it refers to the Book of Dragonslaying.
For justice
For freedom
For power
For wealth

You shout loudly, for justice! "But why is the dragon unjust, and killing it is just?" Once again, the characters materialize to form a sentence. "Perhaps your path seems righteous in its outcome, but your actions along the way are filled with injustice." A low chuckle echoes as the dark passage reopens, and you begin to fall once more. "Ah, by the way, what awaits you at the end might not be justice after all, but...oh, this is what you call 'the end.'" As you continue your endless descent, the words behind you fade from view.

You shout loudly, for freedom! "That's right, from the result, if you can truly defeat the dragon, you could indeed gain tremendous freedom..." Once again, the characters materialize to form a sentence. "Though I don't believe any soul can possess true freedom, we evade freedom, don't we?" A low chuckle echoes as the dark passage reopens, and you begin to fall once more. "Ah, by the way, what awaits you at the end might not be freedom after all, but...oh, this is what you call 'the end.'" As you continue your endless descent, the words behind you fade from view.

Without any pretense, you declare it's all about power! "Hmm, slaughtering another life to gain ultimate power, hmm, hmm, it is indeed something humans often do." Once again, the characters materialize to form a sentence, "A somewhat straightforward answer, but nevertheless, such answers are always the most reassuring; It seems this world is no different from any other where human souls dwell." A low chuckle echoes as the dark passage reopens, and you begin to fall once more. "Ah, by the way, what awaits you at the end might not be power after all, but...oh, this is what you call 'the end.'" As you continue your endless descent, the words behind you fade from view.

Without any pretense, you declare it's all about wealth! "Wealth, always wealth... The more you acquire, the more misery and anxiety it brings, doesn't it?" Once again, the characters materialize to form a sentence. "You scale one peak only to find another looming ahead. How strange and amusing you are!" A low chuckle echoes as the dark passage reopens, and you begin to fall once more. "Ah, by the way, what awaits you at the end might not be wealth after all, but...oh, this is what you call 'the end.'" As you continue your endless descent, the words behind you fade from view.

5320551.title: 深谈
strings:
The three of you gather together, each having completed your assigned tasks. They admire the equipment you've collected, taking turns trying each piece on. Both agree the gear is more than up to the challenge ahead.
Adila brings out a gleaming sword, telling you it's the blade their ancestors used – tempered in dragon's breath and steeped in the blood of a great wyrm.
"I told my grandmother that my mother, Jabal, and I had found the dragon and were ready to slay it. That's when they entrusted this sword to me." She swings the ancient blade with confident grace. "This sword can pierce dragon scales."
Jabal nods beside her and turns to you, "We've already set traps near the dragon's lair to prevent the beast from taking flight at the first sign of danger." They both look at you intently. "According to the ancient book, a four-person team is safest for dragon-slaying. One to wield the harpoon, another to draw the dragon's attention with a shield, a third to strike from above at its eye, and the last to deliver the killing blow with this quenched mithril longsword."
"We want you to join us – you've proven yourself worthy and capable. As for the fourth position... we'll leave it to you to choose whom to bring. Then we set off together!"

5320552.title: 深谈
strings:
All preparations for the dragon-slaying are complete. You can set forth whenever you're ready.

Remember - the slaying of a dragon will shake the world to its core. Whether you succeed or fail, your game will end here.

All things must come to an end – all things, without exception. Yet the nature of that ending hangs in balance, with only the thinnest line between triumph and tragedy.

Now go, warrior. Show that big lizard what you're made of.

5320553.title: 龙的最期
strings:
The dragon can destroy all Sultan Cards for you. 
This would be a great victory as you free everyone from this cruel game... 
But perhaps you have other thoughts. 
Adila and the others look towards you; the dragon has promised to break the curse, so its mission will be accomplished one way or another. So, what will you decide?
Deal a fatal blow
Make a deal with the dragon

"Hold on..." The dragon pants, "Do you know what happens when a dragon dies...?"

"It's cursed, of course I know. But it can't curse the same target again, I also know this!" Adila shows no retreat on her blood-spattered face, "So just kill you, curse whoever you want afterward, and my mission is accomplished!"

"Ahaha... hahahaha...!" As if hearing the greatest joke, the dragon's weakened eyes teasingly stare at her, "You're wrong, dragons simply don't die... dragons can't curse the same target because... dragons reincarnate... I am the dragon that cursed your family..."
Its words leave all of you stunned.

"I can directly break the curse, restoring your family to normal... I can also grant a wish, a wish that the dragon can fulfill..." Its enormous eyes then look at you, scanning you, its voice is filled with an irresistible temptation, "For instance... I can destroy those cards on you... haha... they're made of black magic... nothing but dragon's breath can destroy them..."
You don't trust it. Besides, you confidently believe that you can find a way to end this game on your own. You give it a slight smile and raise the dragonblood-thirsty sword.

The dragon nods slightly. For some reason, its wise eyes have a certain ridicule.

Come, take out your cards, place them before him.

5320554.title: 奈布哈尼声望事件激活提示
strings: Nabhani seems to be looking for you. Insert it into <color=white><size=172%>Methinks</size></color>.

5320555.title: 法尔达克声望事件激活提示
strings: Fardak seems to have something for you, put it into <color=white><size=172%>Methinks</size></color>.

5320556.title: 走廊上的花影，已经完成医典
strings:
Samir sent a servant to fetch you, asking to meet the next day in the corridor behind the Audience Hall. As court physician, leaving the palace required no small amount of petitions and paperwork, so it was easier for you to go to him.
When you found Samir, he was leaning against a column, head bowed, eyes on the floor.
Hearing your footsteps, he looked up and smiled. "You came, my old friend. Oh, I asked for this meeting because I recently have noticed something puzzling."
He drew from his robe the record of the harem women who had served the Sultan—yes, the one you had slightly altered for Lady Sadani—your heart gave a thump. You had, of course, expected someone to review it, but you had thought it would be those fat eunuchs who managed the harem; lying to them was easy, but to lie to Samir, the court physician... not so much
Yet before you could weave a story, he slipped the booklet away as if it were nothing. "Naturally, such trifles like this wouldn't linger in my head; I would tell the Sultan everything was in order, nothing amiss. But..." He sighed lightly. "My friend, the next time you plan to alter something—I never said you altered anything—just tell me, alright? There are ways to make it look much neater."
He winked; you both laughed.
After that, you chatted pleasantly for a long while and then parted.

5320558.title: 走廊上的花影，未开始医典
strings:
Samir sent a servant to fetch you, asking to meet the next day in the corridor behind the Audience Hall. As court physician, leaving the harem required no small amount of petitions and paperwork, so it was easier for you to go to him.
Still, why would this cautious, discreet doctor, who usually disliked cultivating courtiers, suddenly seek you out?
It made you think of the things you had done for Lady Sadani of late... In any case, you decided it was best to go and hear what he had to say.

5320562.title: 萨米尔的十回合倒计时

5320563.title: 萨米尔的死亡
strings: While you were scrambling to survive and claw your way upward, somewhere in a neglected corner, a court physician was quietly condemned—and executed that very day.

5320564.title: 相熟的访客
strings:
In the shaded corridor you find Samir. He looks exhausted, clothes dust-stained. At the sight of you, a weary smile flickers across his face. "I heard about the audience today... my friend, you do have a gift for finding trouble."
You clap his shoulder. "Says the man whose head would be on a pike without me."
"True." He smiles wanly. Now the Royal Guards are certain he supplied the abortifacients, and the eunuchs are inspecting the women of the harem for signs of recent miscarriage...
"They're in a hurry to find a scapegoat and wrap this up." You see through it at once and give Samir a look. "Truth doesn't matter to them. Their necks do. In fact, not even the Sultan cares—what matters is saving face."
Samir only shakes his head. "I know that's the easiest way out. But I won't accuse any innocent woman—they've suffered enough. You have no idea how many in this palace—" He stops, sighs, then produces a letter long prepared and presses it into your hand. The ink is still fresh, the handwriting hurried. "I didn't do any of it. No woman ever miscarried under my care. But... I'm sorry for dragging you into this. If the Sultan demands an answer, tell him it was me. At least you won't have to die for my sake."
Then I'll keep it.
I won't do that.

You slipped the confession into your robe; only then did he plainly relax, his expression easing. You smiled. "So I'm the villain forever ready to frame his friends, is that it? Fine. Now let's talk, Samir—you want the truth, and so do I. Don't tell me you mean to die without understanding a thing. This letter—you wrote it after the audience ended, didn't you?"
Samir smiled, a little sheepish, then fell silent; after a long moment he said quietly, "I do have some suspicions, but I..." He couldn't finish. He sighed and went on: "If you wanted to help me, then please lend me a helper—someone clever enough, able to move unseen. In the meantime, put on a show of investigating, talk to the women of the harem; as for the Sultan... well, you could hand me over at any time, [player.name], my friend. My life was in your hands."
You nodded and promised to buy him as much time as you could.

"You're the upright, kind-hearted physician and I'm the villain forever ready to frame his friends, am I?" You refused to take that damned confession, but Samir insisted.
"Take it, my friend; otherwise how could I ask your help? To tell the truth, regarding this matter I have some suspicions, only I..." He broke off, sighed, and continued: "If you truly wanted to help me, then please lend me a helper—someone clever enough, able to move unseen. In the meantime, put on a show of investigating, talk to the women of the harem; as for the Sultan... if there was no way to delay, hand my confession in, [player.name], my friend. Do not feel guilty, do not hesitate—this all began with me."
You could only nod and promise to buy him as much time as you could.

5320566.title: 萨米尔的死亡
strings: The Sultan's Royal Guards immediately set out for the physician's quarters to seize him.

5320567.title: 父亲认罪后的僻静之地
strings:
You happened to hear that a secluded patch of wasteland had come up for sale.
It was a low ahill with gentle slopes and a clear little river nearby... good ground for a graveyard, perhaps—oh, you hadn't grown so morbid as to plan your own end; you had simply remembered that Samir's father's bones were likely still in some paupers' trench. He was a criminal, a man of the fallen kingdom; no other burial ground would admit him... Well... though Samir had never said so, perhaps... in the end, he would want his father to rest in peace.

5320568.title: 卡帕尔死后的僻静之地
strings:
You happened to hear that a secluded patch of wasteland had come up for sale.
It wasa low hill with gentle slopes and a clear little river nearby... good ground for a graveyard, perhaps—oh, you weren't yet pessimistic enough to plan your own end; you merely recalled that Kapar's bones were likely still in some charnel pit. He was a criminal, a slave; no other burial ground would admit him... Well... though Samir had never raised it, perhaps... in the end, he still cared.

5320570.title: 生命之露
strings: Samir had heard that you had developed a "panacea" called Water of Life, whose effects were said to let even severed limbs grow back—utterly unbelievable! He came to visit, hoping you could spare him a sample for study.

5320574.title: 另一个世界的结晶
strings:
One morning, when you stepped out of your bedchamber, you noticed something at your feet.
It was a palm-sized, transparent crystal with a faint blue tint, like a solidified droplet of some liquid you had once seen. And if you looked closely, scraps of paper seemed to be caught inside.
You held it up to the morning sun and finally made out the fragmentary words on the scraps—
"for humankind... prepared..."
Judging from the hand, it appeared to be part of the labels Samir had written for those concoctions. It was probably a return-gift from those midnight visitors.

5320575.title: 医典编修简单模式的开启幕后
strings:
You meet Samir again under the eaves. The royal guards have already disposed of his father's body. There is no lightness of acquittal on his face—only fatigue and confusion.
"I don't understand my father." He frowns, muttering low. "Was he trying to save me? Or covering for those of our people who plotted against me, cleaning their last mess?"
It seems he had long suspected who framed him, but never had the chance to confirm it.
"Honestly, I'm not surprised. Who else would hate me so fiercely as my former kin? I betrayed my homeland, accepted the Sultan'a patron; I dragged our name through the mud and shamed them! But what did they ever give me? For their stubborn 'loyalty' I could no longer be a noble, nor a physician, nor even hold my head high as a man—we were as poor as dogs by the roadside. What noble would hire the doctor of a fallen court? Which commoner could afford the fee of a 'Court Physician'?"
"Yet I still wanted to be a doctor. I crawled my way out of that mire, went to the Chamberlain, declared I was of the fallen kingdom's court physicians and would forfeit all to serve the Sultan..." He buries his face in his hands. "Yes, they should hate me. I know. Sometimes, I hate this part of myself too."
Continue

"My father..." Samir drew a long breath and steadied himself. "Before the fallen kingdom fell—praise be to the Sultan!—the last order my father received from the king was to compile a new medical codex. From my earliest memories he was doing this, and he always trained me to do the same: compiling entries, writing annotations... After we fled that house, I never picked up the pen again, but now I wanted to finish it, so that I would owe him nothing further."

5320576.title: 热娜收集珠宝启动
strings:
"Wait," Jenna called out just as you were leaving, "I had a favor to ask, Lord [player.name]."
She opened a fine casket before you; inside were little cloth packets holding raw gemstones. "Look at these little darlings—aren't they beautiful? No one can resist them—crowns, necks, belts, wrists... everyone needs them!" Jenna met your eyes with eager confidence. "If you can obtain rough stones, I can cut and set them for you—charging only the tiniest fee. Nowhere in the capital will you find a fairer price! My only request is that you let me stamp the finished pieces with 'Jenna's Workshop'. I need to borrow a bit of your incluence to make my name known."
She grinned at you, open and guileless. "What do you think?"
Mm... it seemed worth a try.

5320584.title: 钻石事件触发
strings:
After handing you the gems, Jenna—unusually—wiped the sweat from her brow, hesitated, then said softly, "There's something I think you should know."
She drew you into an empty quiet room and produced a small stone—clear, spotless, blazing; just a little piece, yet it almost stabbed the eyes. "A diamond?!" you nearly cried out.
It was the only kind of gem on the market reserved to the Sultan; all the diamond mines were under his control. Every stone that somehow reached the market caused a frenzy of bidding at absurd prices. But how had Jenna gotten it?
You narrowed your eyes and tested it in the light; however you looked, the conclusion was the same. "Where did you get this?" you asked her.
"A few days ago someone offered me a rough stone—it wasn't expensive at all, at least not 'diamond-rough' expensive. Who knew it would cut into a treasure like this!" Jenna's eyes burned with undisguised fervor and obsession, but she hadn't let the windfall make her lose her head. She swallowed, mastered her reluctance, and closed your fingers around the gem—priceless beyond words."—But that's far from ordinary, isn't it? The more I thought about it, the more I felt it would bring me trouble rather than profit, so I decided to give it to a power-holder like you. If... I mean if, if you could find out its source, all the better. If... well, if we could safely make use of cheap diamonds, or even obtain more of them, wouldn't that be wonderful?"
You tucked the diamond carefully into your robe and nodded to her.

5320585.title: 钻石事件后续开启
strings: You had kept watch on the Dark Alley and finally spotted something odd: a furtive merchant seemed to be peddling suspicious stones...

5320586.title: 阿里木的猜疑
strings:
Alim came to you, still wearing his teasing smile, still speaking of life-and-death matters.
He told you one of his pups had suddenly gone missing; he had searched high and low, only to learn that the just-of-age boy had been dragged into a noble's residence and never seen again. He had asked around—beggars, street-sparrows, singing girls—and there had been many such cases of late; someone had been kidnapping people on the Dark Alley, and that kidnapper...
Here Alim looked at you. "Someone saw you and him making a 'trade' in an alley."
He had come to demand an accounting. You finally understood, hurriedly showed him the diamond you had bought, and told him everything you and Jenna knew.
Alim nodded and gave you several out-of-the-way sites, said to be the gem-seller's bolt-holes, apparently linked by tunnels; old Alim had already mapped them for you. If you meant to shadow the merchant, his intelligence would surely prove useful.

5320587.title: 拉伊德的猜疑
strings:
Raed came to you. The moment she entered, she slammed a massive spiked mace down before you and demanded to know whether you were connected to that damned kidnapper. You waved your hands and explained at length, until it became clear that two vagrants under her protection had vanished.
"I'm not petty enough to keep a tally, but anyone can see there aren't as many beggars on the streets as before." She frowned and glared hard at you, as if to see straight through you. "I tracked the carriages the kidnapper uses... he thought covering the coach tight would keep anyone from noticing! But... hmph!"
Raed did not share many of her tricks, at least not until she had confirmed you were truly trustworthy. "Your turn to explain, Lord [player.name]—why did you meet the owner of those carriages in the Dark Alley?"
You had known that buying those diamonds would bring trouble, but you hadn't expected the first trouble to come from the Dark Alley. Patiently, you explained everything you and Jenna knew and even showed her the diamond. Raed gave it a single glance and tossed that rare, priceless gem back to you like a pebble.
"Fine, I doubt you'd spend that much blood-money just to trick me." She nodded, and only then did she share the kidnapper's favorite tricks for shaking pursuit. Those tidings would surely prove useful to your investigation.

5320588.title: 钻石事件苏丹之怒
strings:
You could said you had been waiting for this day all along.
At last the Sultan erupted in fury at court—right here in the capital, under his very eyelids, someone had discovered a new diamond mine and had dared to secretly extract and sell diamonds behind the back of the great Sultan, the owner of all the diamonds in the world! How much gold had he been robbed of!
His troops swiftly slaughtered everyone at the pit—slaves, children, overseers, nobles... none were spared. Blood soaked into the earth and dried on the glittering stones. The Sultan picked up a blood-stained diamond and admired it for a long time, then left satisfied.
You did not know how many more diamonds would henceforth be washed in human blood before being laid before the throne. You only knew that from the day you learned diamonds were being traded in secret, you had foreseen this massacre. And now, the bloody scene finally unfurled before your eyes, and at last your heart could stop waiting in anxious dread.

5320589.title: 如何处置血钻坑呢
strings: Now this bloody place—stained with the blood of a wicked master, the guards, and the long-dried blood of countless workers—falls wholly at your disposal.
Present it to the Sultan.
Leave all as it is—and I am its master.
The workers must be freed.
The simplest way to handle it was to present that hot potato to the Sultan at the next audience; he would surely be delighted.

The owner of the pit had already told you the most profitable path, and his weakest, riskiest sales link was nothing to a power-holder like you. You decided to run that wellspring of wealth exactly as he had described—after all, there was not a single coin in this world unstained by blood.
Diamonds dug by enslaved hands were fit only to adorn filthy souls. You resolved to let the workers decide for themselves whether to stay or go.

5320590.title: 血钻坑芮尔离队
strings: Riel and her gang nearly tore your mine apart, adding a few more lines of red to the ledger. In the end, she took several of her former underlings, tore off a sleeve as a parting gesture, flung it at you, and walked away without a glance back.

5320591.title: 血钻坑阿里木离队
strings: Alim came only to spit in your face. Be grateful for your own mercy—you didn't even ordered the guards to seize him and throw him into the pit to dig for you.

5320592.title: 血钻坑拉伊德离队
strings: When you returned home, you found porcelain vases shattered across the floor, doors, windows, and tables in disarray, and only withered flowers left in the courtyard... It turned out Raed had come looking for you; when she couldn't find you after waiting and waiting, she stormed through the house in a blaze of fury. Given the state of things, let alone sending her on errands—over the next few days you had best not return home at all, lest she catch you...

5320593.title: 一只肥鸽子
strings:
A half-grown lad was sent to find you.
He wore a set of clean yet ragged clothes, and pride gleamed on his thin face. He bowed and handed you... a pigeon—yes, a pigeon. A dead pigeon. A very plump one.
Seeing your confusion, the boy raised his voice:
"I'm a butcher's apprentice. This is today's pigeon from my family for you. Isn't your lady wife building up her strength? She needs pigeon every week? So I'll be bringing one every week. You don't need to worry about anything else: pigeons only go coo-coo-coo, pigeons never cause trouble, and pigeons know their master; they know which eaves are the safest."
He rattled it all off fast and hard, clearly memorized. When he finished, he bowed with great pride and left your residence.
Setting aside what all that was supposed to mean, you examined the bird—it had been cleaned to perfection, and it did look rather quite suitable for roasting... perhaps you should have Habib cook it.

5320594.title: 秘密钻石
strings: Once again, the little pigeon brought you a gleaming diamond in its beak.

5320596.title: 想成为最好的珠宝商
strings:
"Oh my dear Lord [player.name], my most powerful friend—" Jenna breezed into your residence and embraced you as one noblewoman might another. Settling comfortably onto the cushion brought by your servant, she toyed idly with her rings before straightening, eyes bright with purpose. From her bodice, she produced a slim stack of manuscripts. "You've helped me so much already—surely you won't mind one more favor. Oh, and as with hunting gems, you'll profit handsomely, too!"
"I want to go further—be the finest jeweler in the capital. So... I need your help." She winked, speaking of fame and fortune with open candor, her smile so sincere it's impossible to resent her. "Here is my plan. Please, have a look."
Plan I: Win the hearts of great ladies.
Plan II: Make a name at court.
Plan III: Don't spare the little purses.
I've read it all.

5320597.title: 想成为最好的珠宝商
strings:
Seeing you turn to this page, Jenna smiled and explained, "The ones who love—and need—jewelry the most are the great ladies! But you know I don't have much sway among nobles, which is why I need you—oh, better yet, your lady!"
She talked at length about a jewelry-themed soirée where your wife attends in a full set engraved with Jenna's workshop mark, and everyone notices...
"Whether they remember my name is secondary. What matters most is that everyone will envy her eye, her taste, her sense of beauty, her wealth—envy her for having such a marvelous husband!" Jenna fixed you with a fervent look.
Ha! Of course!

5320598.title: 想成为最好的珠宝商
strings: Seeing you turn to this page, Jenna began to flatter you: you are the most formidable figure at court; none younger could ever hold your station; and those above you are all tooth-loosened elders... You could't help but laugh, and she used the moment to add, "So if I'm to win over the people in Lapis Lazuli Palace, I must rely on you."
Alright. Leave it to me.

5320599.title: 想成为最好的珠宝商
strings:
Seeing you turn to this page, Jenna self-consciously curled a lock by her temple. "Ah—this isn't meant to trouble you; take it as a joke if you like! See, every jeweler fights for the great ladies' gold. But ordinary folk outnumber them by the hundreds, even thousands! Many cheap stones are quite pretty; mixed colors and patterns can be designed to charm.. It's a shame to discard them just because they're cheap. I want to make jewelry the commoner can afford—"
You listened to her earnest pitch and then glance at the title she gave this section. She blushed and murmured, "Oh, and of course, while no one is looking, I might slip some coins from those little purses into my own..."
You could't help but laugh.
Money's money. No shame in earning it.

5320600.title: 放心吧
strings: You nodded to her, agreeing to her request and promising to do your best to promote all three plans. Jenna thanked you profusely, beaming with delight.

5320601.title: 贵族之间的宣传
strings: As you and Jenna had agreed, it was now the perfect time for your wife to host a banquet of jewels.

5320602.title: 权臣的格调
strings:
Early one morning, Jenna comes to you. Her face is a little pale, yet her eyes shine with excitement.
"After waiting outside the Lapis Lazuli Palace last time, I thought I would receive many orders from the nobles... but not a single one came."
You are startled—how could that be? Those people looked as if they wanted to strip the jewels right off her with their eyes.
"Because this—because I received this." Jenna hands you a thick sheet of parchment. You recognize it instantly as it is the Sultan's official stationery. "An order from the harem. The Sultan's women... want me to make their jewels."
Pinching the parchment, you sigh softly. If Jenna can perfectly satisfy the harem's demands, the courtiers will rush to fill her pockets with gold. But if her work offends even one exalted concubine... her creations will be worthless overnight. Lesser nobles can be ignored, but those great lords privileged to stand before the Sultan will not make any move until Jenna proves she can fulfill the harem's demands.
Jenna asks earnestly for your permission to consult with you more often. After all, you are one of the men in the Empire who best understand how to please the Sultan... and pleasing his women is, of course, another way to please him.

5320603.title: 污泥中的金粒
strings:
"I heard you have built a fine guesthouse!" Jenna cried joyfully one day. "Please—let me help there! I want to see how most of this city dresses itself."
It was a most unusual request—many nobles would have called such an arrangement an insult—but Jenna was different. She flitted happily through the guesthouse, bringing people food and gathering dishes for the kitchen; she wore different jewels every day, dazzling the retainers' eyes—though of course no one would be stupid enough to attempt robbery in your guesthouse.
From the second day on, women from the slums often came to see Jenna. They usually cradled children in one arm and clutched their work in the other—spinning, handiwork, or a beggar's bowl—and gazed longingly at the ornaments.
Jenna told them gently that many of the stones she used were not expensive at all, yet they looked no worse than the costly gems nobles favored. Her goal was to become the best jeweler in the city, so she would certainly accept orders from the poor—after all, it was the hands of laborers that pushed this city forward.
The women's eyes shone. They understood her.

5320604.title: 萨米尔的死亡
strings: The court physician had thus been condemned with ease. The Royal Guards had already set out to arrest Samir.

5320607.title: 贵公子的订单
strings: A young lord sent Jenna an order: he wanted an emerald ring. The design didn't matter—what mattered was that the stone appear as large as possible!

5320608.title: 贵妇的订单
strings: A lady who had attended the bathhouse jewel banquet sent in an order: she wanted a pair of "the most beautiful, most splendid, most gorgeous" gem earrings—ruby at the very least, or else she would be outshone!

5320609.title: 狗的订单
strings: A noble asked Jenna to craft a red-gold collar for his beloved dog, set with amethysts—or at least it had to be amethyst-grade.

5320612.title: 给宠妃的珠宝
strings:
The princesses of the palace led lives of crushing boredom; their favorite, and one of the few permitted, amusements was rivalry for favor. The Sultan's favor always took tangible form: the dearer a woman's jewels, the higher she stood above the rest.
Now, a currently favored consort—she did not give her name—sent an order: Jenna was to make a piece that would "make other women burn with envy, drive them mad with hatred."
Jenna came again to seek your counsel—after all, in her view, you understood better than most the proper measure for dealing with such grandees.

5320613.title: 给女奴的珠宝
strings:
An old eunuch who had long served at court delivered an order for jewels for the harem's slave-women. Even slaves, being the Sultan's slaves, wore at least amethyst set in silver.
Jenna again sought your advice—since, in her view, you best understood the fine measure required in serving those of power.

5320614.title: 给苏丹的珠宝
strings: A royal guardsman brought you a hastily scrawled rescript from the Sultan: "I hear you have a capable jeweler." That single line was all it took. You had to summon Jenna to your residence at once; for to please the Sultan was paramount, and a single misstep could be fatal.

5320618.title: 女奴们的回礼紫水晶版
strings:
The eunuch who had come for the collar returned once more. He said the harem's slave-girls had pooled together to prepare a token of gratitude for you. You tried to decline, saying it was Jenna who had made the jewels and any thanks should go to her, not you.
"We are lowly folk, not worth mentioning; but... we do live in that Lapis Lazuli cage." The eunuch smiled, a sly look on his aged face. "We know harp-strings do not sing on their own—gratitude belongs to the hand that plucks them."
He left the gift, bowed deeply, and hobbled away.

5320619.title: 女奴们的回礼祖母绿版
strings:
The eunuch who had come for the pendant returned once more. He said the harem's slave-girls had pooled together to prepare a token of gratitude for you. You tried to decline, saying it was Jenna who had made the jewels and any thanks should go to her, not you.
"We are lowly folk, not worth mentioning; but... we do live in that Lapis Lazuli cage." The eunuch smiled, a sly look on his aged face. "We know harp-strings do not sing on their own—gratitude belongs to the hand that plucks them."
He left the gift, bowed deeply, and hobbled away.

5320620.title: 一点回礼
strings:
The old eunuch who had come for the collar returned once more, his gaze betraying an effort to conceal his displeasure.
He told you that the ruby piece—the flawless coronet Jenna had made—had sparked a brawl among the slave girls. It was too precious, too beautiful! In the end a pale-skinned slave claimed it, biting a companion's nose in her triumph. Proudly adorned with the jewel and stained with blood, she knelt before the Sultan, declaring that she would kill for the immense favor of his bed—precisely the sort of words the Sultan relished.
She did indeed win a night's favor, but her appearance and skill were unworthy of the royal bed. The dazzling jewel entered the Sultan's collection, and she was flung back among the slave girls—only to be immediately strangled by the companion she had wronged.
The Sultan ordered the old eunuch to tell you he had greatly enjoyed the spectacle you had arranged; truly, you knew best how to please him.

5320622.title: 热娜被带走了
strings:
Jenna's pieces left the entire court deeply impressed; from then on her name became thoroughly known within the Lapis Lazuli Palace. But what came to her first was not a blizzard of orders and gold—it was a messenger from the Sultan.
Before anything could explain anything, the guards took her straight to the palace.

5320625.title: 热娜的礼物-金色的旗帜
strings:
After you begin assembling your own forces, Jenna finds you. She presents you with a banner fashioned from thin sheets of gold, hanging on the wall like flowing liquid. The banner is studded with gemstones, and on closer look, the stones spell out your name.
"I have always hoped to take part in deeds that change the world, because I've heard that only such deeds can spark a person's finest inspiration," Jenna says, looking into your eyes. "Now I finally have the chance to join the tide you have raised. So I made this banner... I am proud of it, and I am proud to have a friend like you."
When this banner rises with the sun above the city walls, people gather behind you, believing that the rightful ruler has arrived.

5320626.title: 热娜的礼物-宝石之盾
strings:
Before you set out on your dragon-slaying venture, Jenna found you and gave you a gold-plated shield, its surface set with gemstones ground to points, like a scatter of costly nails.
"Courage is more remarkable than gold and jewels, Lord [player.name]." Jenna said, looking into your eyes. "As soon as I heard what you meant to do, inspiration struck... I am proud of this piece, and I am proud to have a friend like you."
She gave you a formal bow. Being able to present this gift seemed to delight her.

5320627.title: 热娜的礼物-思考者
strings:
When you push open that door of your mind—when you awaken from your dream at dawn, Jenna finds you. She gives you a gold pendant bearing a lifelike statuette of a Thinker, and the chain is strung with gemstones associated with the arcane.
"I have watched you all along: your madness, your reason, your thought..." Jenna says, looking into your eyes. "Now I finally understand: when a human thinks, he draws near to the divine. That realization gave me this sudden inspiration. I am proud of this piece, and I am proud to have a friend like you."
She gives you a formal bow. Being able to present this gift seems to fill her with genuine joy.

5320628.title: 给自己的珠宝
strings: A young man seeking to become a court scribe requested a modestly respectable ornament for his interview; even a tiny amethyst would suffice.

5320629.title: 给爱人的珠宝
strings: A newlywed couple came to Jenna, requesting two pieces crafted from the finest red carnelian. Among the poor, tradition dictated that wedding jewelry be made from this fiery, passionate stone.

5320630.title: 给孩子的珠宝
strings:
A woman about to give birth sent her husband to Jenna, asking for a charm to pray for the safety of their child.
The thin man, embarrassed, asked Jenna what the cheapest gemstone was; when he heard it was agate, he exhaled with relief.
"I think we can still afford agate," he said, thinking aloud. "We won't have to go hungry to afford it. After all... we've already lost two children. I think... I think my wife and I need this jewel."

5320631.title: 牛骨
strings:
Today you went to Jenna's workshop because she had sent advance word that she had a new treasure to show you.
The workshop was filled with tools and little boxes, polishing compounds, gravers, wax blocks—you moved slowly inward, taking in the dazzling profusion...
Jenna came toward you holding up a piece of spotless white...
"Look at this! I have to show you!" She thrust the white thing into your hands. You ran your fingers over it—fine-grained, warm, smooth, with an almost magnetic pull that made it hard to let go. "It's cow bone! My newly discovered gemstone!"
You raised an eyebrow. Cow bone? Didn't every cow have plenty of it? Could that count as a gemstone? Weren't gemstones supposed to be rare, buried deep in the earth, unobtainable without effort...?
"You must think it's too cheap, right? But who says that gemstones must be expensive? All the noble and common orders you helped me take on taught me something—what is dirt to a noble can be a wedding treasure for the poor. So now, might this cow bone that means nothing to you become a treasure in someone else's eyes?"
You turned the bone over... its back was carved with lovely pomegranates, and little birds with cocked tails cheekily pecked at the seeds. The carving was undeniably beautiful, and the bone bore the craftsmanship perfectly...
"Let's try it, Lord [player.name]." Jenna's eyes seemed to glow in the dim workshop. "I'll bring all my skill to bear on these bones—they've set off torrents of inspiration in me... and you, you can test whether you can persuade nobles to accept your definitions: if you say bone is a gemstone, then it is a gemstone."
You smiled. It truly was an intriguing proposal.

5320637.title: 小薇在找你
strings:
That night, you soaked away the weariness of battle in the bath and staggered toward your bedroom. Your jinn attendant slipped out and drifted beside you. "Master," she giggled, shrinking to the size of a sparrow and hovering at eye level, "that was quite a fight... but have you forgotten? I am a jinn." You stared at her, confused. "Oh—common knowledge! You break a lamp, a jinn appears—and then you make a wish! A wish!" 
You suddenly understood...
Money! I need a great deal of money!
Power... the power to defeat the Sultan.
Can you make me happy?
Heh. I'm not falling for this.

What a splendid wish! The Jinn circles around you, and you feel a surge of magic binding the two of you together—your reactions grow swifter, your movement turns more precise... even your teeth feel a touch more dangerous.
The Jinn settles on your scabbard: "Kill! Murder! Slaughter them all, and their money will be yours!"
Yes, you should have known better than to expect anything sensible from a Jinn.

What a splendid wish! The Jinn circles around you, and you feel a surge of magic binding the two of you together—your reactions grow swifter, your movement turns more precise... even your teeth feel a touch more dangerous.
The Jinn settles on your scabbard: "You have been strengthened! Go kill someone! Veesa wants to watch Master [player.name] kill!"
Yes, you should have known better than to expect anything sensible from a Jinn.

What a splendid wish! The Jinn circles around you, and you feel a surge of magic binding the two of you together—your reactions grow swifter, your movement turns more precise... even your teeth feel a touch more dangerous.
The Jinn settles on your scabbard: "Kill! Murder! The happiest thing in the world is to kill. Veesa wants to watch Master [player.name] kill!"
Yes, you should have known better than to expect anything sensible from a Jinn.

You fix the Jinn with a stern look. Their bluster quickly fades, then they slink back into your arms—this is what they always do when one of their pranks fails. You pay them no mind, letting them mutter incomprehensible insults from inside your pocket.

5320639.title: 小安在找你
strings:
That night, you calmed down from the afterglow of passion and handed your soiled clothes to the servants to be washed. Your jinn follower poked her head out from the pile of garments. She breathed in the scent of desire lingering on them, caressing her own body without shame... She first terrified the servants, then stirred wicked thoughts in their hearts.
"I adore you, Master. You do the thing all souls in the world crave... my last mistress could never manage that," she winked at you. "I can help you do so much more... anywhere, any way, with anyone... I can hardly wait! Go on—make a wish to the jinn. Wish for it, and I shall grant you a blessing!"
Money! I need a great deal of money!
Power... the power to defeat the Sultan.
Can you make me happy?
Heh. I'm not falling for this.

What a splendid wish! Like a living whirlwind, the Jinn coils around you, their touch awakening a spark of pleasure within your body while weaving magic through it.
"Want to be rich? Then have more children! Fortune and fertility have always walked together! The wealthy never stop mating! Endry has already set a charm on you—now everyone will want to have children with you!"
...You sigh. Expecting anything sensible from this Jinn was your mistake... and the spell is nowhere near as effective as it claims.

What a splendid wish! Like a living whirlwind, the Jinn coils around you, their touch awakening a spark of pleasure within your body while weaving magic through it.
"The greatest power is virility! Without it, even the mightiest warrior is nothing but a coward in bed—and soon a coward in truth! Now Endry has strengthened you, Master! Go on! Endry wants to watch Master [player.name] mate with others!"
...You sigh. Expecting anything sensible from this Jinn was your mistake... and the spell is nowhere near as effective as it claims... At best, it has only strengthened you a little.

What a splendid wish! Like a living whirlwind, the Jinn coils around you, their touch awakening a spark of pleasure within your body while weaving magic through it.
"Let's indulge in more pleasures! Endry has strengthened you! Now you can enjoy so many intimate delights!"
...You sigh. Expecting anything sensible from this Jinn was your mistake... and the spell is nowhere near as effective as it claims. At best, it has only strengthened you a little.

You fix the Jinn with a stern look. Their bluster quickly fades, and they even shrink, retreating into your groin—this is what they always do when one of their pranks fails. Sigh—you are used to it by now, silently letting them spin.

5320640.title: 小安的倒计时自然消失时的触发幕后

5320641.title: 小留在找你
strings:
That night, as you removed your jewels and placed them back into their casket, your jinn follower appeared beside you. She shrank herself tiny and stood inside your jewel chest, hopping from one gem to another, then clutching a cluster of gold thread to examine it.
"You are truly a fine master, with so many wonderful treasures," she declared, lifting her chin with a proud smile on her delicate face. "But you could be greater still... I wish to be surrounded by even more splendors—and I can bless you, you know. I am a jinn, and jinns possess the power to bless. Wish to me, and I shall grant your desire... oh, but only one wish!"
Money! I need a great deal of money!
Power... the power to defeat the Sultan.
Can you make me happy?
Heh. I'm not falling for this.

What a wise wish! The Jinn bursts with excitement, scattering countless golden sparks across the room, falling with a tinkle like gold coins. "You will be wealthy! But don't forget—you need money to make more money. This isn't just my magic at work. It's a law of the world, understand?"
The Jinn's words leave you deeply unsettled...

What a wise wish! The Jinn bursts with excitement, scattering countless golden sparks across the room, falling with a tinkle like gold coins. "Money is power! You're now blessed—money will be drawn to you like iron to a magnet! But be aware! If you own too little, your money will be drawn to others!"
The Jinn's words leave you deeply unsettled...

What a wise wish! The Jinn bursts with excitement, scattering countless golden sparks across the room, falling with a tinkle like gold coins. "To be rich is to be happy! You're now blessed—money will be drawn to you like iron to a magnet! But be aware! If you own too little, your money will be drawn to others!"
The Jinn's words leave you deeply unsettled...
You fix the Jinn with a stern look. Their bluster quickly fades, and they even shrink until they become a dice, spinning in your teacup—constantly rolling ones to show their displeasure.

5320649.title: 小薇召唤妖精女王
strings:
"You've seen it, haven't you?" Veesa suddenly appeared in your study, where you had been exploring the secrets of your own soul... startling you greatly. "The very nature of power—you faced the question, and you answered it, didn't you?"
She looked urgent, so you nodded and told her the answer you had found in the battle within your soul...
"You might just be able to do it—you might! Let our Mistress enter this world. Let her see it with her own eyes. Let her taste what it means to be bound by flesh!"
As she spoke, she tore at the smoke that formed her body, as if mimicking her Mistress. "My Mistress may not be the strongest being you could ever glimpse, but she is without doubt the most beautiful, the most elegant, the most noble... She cast us aside into this place freely, for this is a barren, material world! But I think it is only right we invite her to come and see for herself!"
You're just out for revenge, aren't you?
What's in it for me?
Make the arrangements.
Don't be foolish
You reject her suggestion. Summoning powerful beings from another world is dangerous and foolish—don't even think about it.

5320650.title: 小安召唤妖精女王
strings:
"You've understood, haven't you?" Endry appeared before you suddenly, her form more alluring than usual, trembling with excitement as she exuded an almost tangible aura of temptation...
"The root of obsession—you've seen it, haven't you? All jinns have tried to cross those gates. For every soul in every world, the battle within the soul is the same. So I know you've reached this point. Perhaps you, who have seen this truth, are worthy to meet my Mistress..." She leaned closer, breathing jinn magic against your face, then smiled enchantingly.
"My Mistress is not one easily pleased. She's tried this, this, and this..." She uttered a string of lewd words without hesitation. "But she has always lived in a world of pure thought—she has never known the pleasures of the flesh... How many wonderful pleasures could we give her! Let her come, I beg you!"
All you want is to get with her, don't you?
What's in it for me?
Make the arrangements.
Don't be foolish
You reject her suggestion. Summoning powerful beings from another world is dangerous and foolish—don't even think about it.

5320651.title: 小留召唤妖精女王
strings:
"You crossed that gate, didn't you? So you've reached the same state as me." Your jinn stepped before you haughtily, arms crossed, eyes scanning you up and down. "All jinns pride themselves on spiritual understanding. To cross the gate... that makes you one of our finest. As you suspect, for every soul in every world, the great battle of the heart is one and the same... it is the only measure of soul power."
"You may have the means to connect our world to this one, and tempt our Mistress... and then, we can welcome here the most magnificent, extravagant, and wasteful Queen of all."
Why go this far?
What's in it for me?
Make the arrangements.
Don't be foolish
You reject her suggestion. Summoning powerful beings from another world is dangerous and foolish—don't even think about it.

5320652.title: 小薇为什么要这么做
strings: The question gave Veesa pause. She stopped darting about restlessly and looked at you quietly. "Ah... revenge. You put it well. This feeling swelling inside me... it is vengeance." She laughed, stretching her form, glowing in the sunlight. "Yes, I suppose it is revenge. Our Mistress is mighty in battle, yet she condemned me for disrespect when I challenged her. Why? How dare she? I won't accept it! Let her come here... let her fight while burdened by flesh. Then we'll see if she can still keep that elegant face!" Every particle that formed Veesa trembled, taking a long while to settle.
Interesting.

5320653.title: 小薇这么做我有什么好处
strings: Her Majesty the Queen is the most beautiful, most powerful jinn! Just imagine her serving Lord [player.name] personally... aah, Veesa can't take it! Veesa needs to stab something with a knife!
...Fine.

5320654.title: 小安为什么要这么做
strings: "Huh? Me? How could you say that—I love indulging in pleasure with you!" Endry smiled sweetly, her expression brimming with hidden ambition. "She rejected me. She had no right. I just want to show her what she's missing!"
...Amusing.

5320655.title: 小安这么做阿尔图有什么好处
strings: The Queen is the most beautiful, most powerful of all—just imagine, Master, how much joy she can bring you! I will teach her exactly how to please you! Every drop of grace that falls from her... will grant you magic and wishes!
That sounds promising.

5320656.title: 小留为什么要这么做
strings:
"In the jinn realm, the foulest curse you can utter is: 'May you wallow in the stench of the physical world for a hundred and one years.'" Iliona shook her head. "And that is exactly what she did... to me! To the noble, perfect, extravagant me—she exiled me to this filthy, lowly place!"
Hatred shadowed the jinn's elegant, enchanting features.
I understand.

5320657.title: 小留这么做阿尔图有什么好处
strings: "Her Majesty the Queen is the embodiment of power... she can fulfill your wishes with her own. In every sense." As Iliona spoke, golden dust drifted from her—a sign of her excitement and craving.
Interesting.

5320658.title: 关妖精的笼子开启
strings: The Queen of Jinn once left a very deep impression on your adventuring party... What preparations would be necessary to subdue such a powerful otherworldly creature? You wave your hand, asking Veesa to explain in detail...

5320659.title: 关妖精的笼子开启
strings: The Queen of Jinn once left a very deep impression on your adventuring party... What preparations would be necessary to subdue such a powerful otherworldly creature? You wave your hand, asking Endry to explain in detail...

5320660.title: 关妖精的笼子开启
strings: The Queen of Jinn once left a very deep impression on your adventuring party... What preparations would be necessary to subdue such a powerful otherworldly creature? You wave your hand, asking Iliona to explain in detail...

5320666.title: 魔物饭启动
strings: In recent days, Habib's kitchen has been filled with strange, chilling screams... Before you can confront him, he comes to you: "Lord [player.name], I've figured out how to prepare parts of... the monster. They should be quite delicious. If you permit, may I give it a try..." (Use Methinks and have Habib cook a feast from the monster.)

5321001.title: 妻子的感激声望事件lv1
strings: At nightfall, you are sitting by the window, worrying about the Sultan Card; a pair of warm and soft hands rest on your shoulders. "What a cruel fate... what a terrifying thing, why should it be borne by you..."
