Maggie says softly while gently massaging your shoulders, "There are so many scoundrels in the empire, so many impatient to harm others, but why must he force you into this game?" You cover her hand with yours, turning to meet her gaze. Her beautiful eyes are full of worry and love. You kiss by the window, alleviating the worries about the future – at least at this moment, you have a partner who loves truly, something even the Sultan has never had, such enormous happiness.

5321003.title: 妻子的私房钱声望事件lv1
strings: Considering your needs, your wife takes out a dowry. Maggie comes to you with her close maids, who carry a beautiful and heavy wooden box, and you recognize it as Maggie's dowry chest. She opens the box and grabs a few velvet pouches filled with heavy gold coins. "I wish I could help you more, my love... take these, at least don't worry about gold coins today." Maggie can have used these shiny little things to get beautiful silk, luxurious jewelry, an exquisitely decorated sitting room, but she chooses to give them to you. "Don't refuse, or I'll be angry! But... don't do anything to make me sad, or I'll be angry too!" Maggie says this with a smile, but her eyes aren't smiling.

5321004.title: 妻子亲族的帮助声望事件lv2
strings: As your influence increased, a relative sent spears and a famed horse.. A few envoys from Maggie's family have just left the estate when she finds you. "My parents sent envoys to ask about the Sultan's Game and check on my well-being. I assured them I'm fine and told them to have faith in my husband," she says, her eyes sparkling with pride. "Oh, and father sent you some gifts – you'll find them quite useful!"

5321006.title: 妻子特殊的枕头声望事件

5321007.title: 妻子为你辩解声望事件

5321009.title: 法拉杰声望事件激活提示
strings: Faraj seems to want to tell you something. Insert it into <color=white><size=172%>Methinks</size></color>.

5321012.title: 法拉杰声望事件-不可饶恕的欲望
strings:
Faraj knocks on your door once again.
This time, he comes to your side severely solemn.
"After that day, I thought about it," he looks straight into your eyes and said, "I thought day and night for three days... you must be right. But if I see you as a brother, then what are these uncontainable excitement and heartbeat when I'm near you?"

He looks at you with fanatical eyes: "I've figured it out, what I love is your wife. There is only this explanation."
We three can share this happiness together
I heard nothing
My dear brother, we've shared our hardships. Why not share some joy as well?

How dare he covet your wife!
You glare at him sharply, silently warning him to stop.

Faraj nods, seemingly relieved by your response. You both leave the matter unspoken, as if it never happened.

5321013.title: 法拉杰声望刺杀事件邪恶lv2
strings: Your wicked deeds have driven Faraj to the brink, prompting Faraj to fight back against you... Faraj will make a deadly move against you, be cautious in dealing with it

5321014.title: 法拉杰声望事件-侠名lv1
strings: On this day, Faraj excitedly comes to you, unable to hide his excitement, telling you he is about to organize a series of radical gatherings, exchanging ideas with advanced young people. Hoping to gain some of your help, he will be extremely grateful to you.
Accept
Reject
You agree to Faraj's request. He thanks you gratefully, saying he needs to prepare for the gathering.
You reprimand Faraj, warning him not to associate with those people lest he get burned. Faraj slinks away in a huff.

5321017.title: 盖斯声望事件激活提示
strings: Qais seems to want to tell you something. Insert it into <color=white><size=172%>Methinks</size></color>.

5321018.title: 盖斯声望事件-侠名lv1
strings:
A person has been pacing in front of your door for a long time, holding a long, slender package. You notice it is Qais, the overly Forthright Courtier, now showing some form of contemplation.

You send someone to invite him into the study to inquire about his purpose. He grits his teeth and places the package on your desk, uncovering the old silk covering it. "This is my family's ancestral sword – I know your family must also have one, but mine is older and sharper... Alas, I present it to you."

He looks as though he wants to say more, but after hesitating for a moment, he said nothing, saluted, and prepared to leave.
Call him back
Let him go

You sensed he's concealing something. When pressed, he smiled wryly and said, "Sometimes I wish you weren't so perceptive."
He recounted his family's history—territories, mansions, and properties lost over two generations. By the time he inherited his title, even his hereditary succession rights were gone—he's now the last of the Qais family entitled to call himself a noble.
His mother remained deeply troubled by this, and your recent prominence had rekindled what he called "inappropriate hope" within her.
"Truthfully, I've abandoned such aspirations, considering our sovereign... but my mother threatens to take her own life..." He sighed helplessly and shook his head. 'Forget this matter. Pretend I never came—she'll eventually accept reality."
You nodded thoughtfully. You could indeed speak to the Sultan at court, giving him a chance to reclaim his hereditary rights. Elevating an ally's status would benefit you as well, but you wondered: is it wise to draw the Sultan's attention to him again?

If he truly has something to ask of you, he will certainly come to visit you again. Thinking this, you let him leave.

However, after that, he never asks you for anything, and slowly, you forget about the matter.

5321019.title: 盖斯声望事件-待价而沽
strings:
Jawad heard about the court affairs and came to you, putting on a humble demeanor. He informs you with a smile that he bought the Qais family's title for his youngest daughter.

“If I’m old, or die, my dear little Arumina would have a reliance.” He displays a rare kind expression, then changes the topic, “It’s strange that this filthy stone begs for your aid, but from my perspective, even if you help him to this extent, that guy may never appreciate your kindness.”

Seeing your unchanged expression, he shakes his head and continues, “Given how much you’ve helped me, I’m of course willing to return it, but he must provide a title of equal standing in exchange to make it fair.”
Agree to his demand
Let him negotiate with Qais
You agree to Jawad's request; with your renown, it isn't difficult. Your confident and relaxed demeanor makes Jawad have an even deeper understanding of your Influence. He bows deeply to you.

You have helped Qais enough, the subsequent transactions should be left to be negotiated and resolved between him and Jawad.

These two "colleague" from prison never expected to meet again in such a situation, Jawad smirks and rubs his hands, eyes glimmering, while Qais seems to endure something, tightly pressing his lips, yet he still gracefully thanks you.

He can't offer anything to thank you anymore, but he will surely remember your kindness forever.

5321020.title: 收买头衔
strings: The nobles who sold titles before have shown up again. You can go talk to them.

5321021.title: 盖斯声望事件-荣耀回归
strings: Qais is overjoyed at the news of you securing the hereditary title. He can't stop thanking you, already talking about holding a ceremony to restore his family's honor.

5321022.title: 盖斯声望事件-归还
strings:
Qais takes out an old purse, inside are 10 gold coins he has carefully gathered. He insists on returning the money to you.

"I don't want our friendship to bear too much burden of other matters," he says seriously, "I want to remind myself and let you know that I follow you not out of a sense of obligation, but because it is the choice I made with my heart."

5321023.title: 法拉杰声望事件-您为什么不用我
strings:
That day, after finishing discussing affairs as usual with you, Faraj did not immediately stand up to leave.

In the flickering candlelight, he traced the patterns on the woven carpet, finally raising his eyes to look at you, his expression faintly aggrieved: "Why do you not..."
He hesitated, then plucked up his courage and said, "Why don't you use me?"
"What?"
"Carnality!" he boldly raised his voice, looking straight at you, "You have that need, don't you? I am willing to ease your worries, but... why don't you use me?"
I can't be unfaithful to my wife
Are we not good brothers?
It's just because the timing isn't right

"I cannot betray Maggie or break the promise I made before our marriage."

Faraj pauses, pain flashing in his eyes, but it quickly fades. He nods, then, as if nothing has happened, nods again: "I understand." He even forces a bitter smile. "What I admire is precisely who you are now."

Before leaving, he takes off an amber gemstone pendant he always wears and places it beside you. "I will always look up to this sun, even though it shines equally on everyone." With these words, he gives you a slight bow and leaves.

After this, neither of you brings up the matter again.

You are utterly speechless for a moment before regaining your sanity, then awkwardly explains to him that you consider him a good companion, a brother, even family. You never think of having that kind of relationship with him!

"You must think the same, right? You must have misunderstood your feelings for me," you confidently say, wanting to pat his shoulder and make a joke as usual, but somehow feels you can't do that anymore.

Faraj's expression turns confused, bewildered, as if wanting to explain or argue something but seems accustomed to following your arrangements, finding it difficult to refute.

In the end, he gives up thinking about it, reluctantly saying goodbye. You sincerely hope he will understand... after all, you really consider him a good brother...

You scratch your head. Of course, you know Faraj's feelings. However, you tell him that you haven't done it yet simply because you haven't drawn a suitable Carnality Card...

Faraj seems relieved, though new questions appear to trouble him. Still, he accepts your explanation for now.

5321024.title: 盖斯声望事件-意想不到的遗产
strings: Your servant has informed you of the situation: the noble who purchased Qais’s title has died, and his daughter’s title has been revoked. In other words, the Qais family’s hereditary right can now be purchased by anyone, costing at least 10 Gold Coins, with a purchasing window of only five days. You decide to...
Buy it
Inform Qais
Knowing well of Qais's desperate financial situation, you decide to help him by purchasing the title.

After telling Qais about the matter, his eyes lights up slightly only to dim again – solving it with money alone is certainly a good thing, but the problem also lies in the money...

He leaves heavy-heartedly but still sincerely thanks you.

5321025.title: 过时不候III
strings:
Due to negligence, or perhaps due to a temporary financial shortcoming, you missed the chance to acquire the title. By the time Qais learned of this news, there was no time to gather funds – he could only watch as the family’s glorious title slipped into someone else's pocket again.

It's said his mother fell ill due to the result, and Qais became somewhat despondent as a result...

“Please don’t apologize, friend, I am very grateful for all you’ve done for me. I just don’t understand…” he can't help but quietly seek answers from you, “In your view, are titles and past glories really so important?”
Yes, it's very important.
No, it's not important.
It depends on the person

You unhesitatingly tell him that past glory is certainly important, and we must not forget it. It's our surname and our ancestors’ efforts that allows us to stand here.

With this, you end up losing your words... blaming yourself for causing him to miss such a chance.

"It's alright," he says with a smile, shaking his head, comforting you instead, "As long as we're alive, there will always be opportunities, right?"

You then talk about other topics, but the issue concerning the hereditary title ultimately goes unresolved.

You look straight into his eyes, telling him that if those empty titles are so important, you wouldn't have stood up to denounce the Sultan originally. However, even if time can turn back, you will still make the same choice.

You pause, then shift your gaze away and quickly add, "I'm very sorry... I mean, I didn't mean to suggest this wasn't important, just that I didn't tell you about the news at the time. Actually, I intended to buy the title directly for you, but I didn't expect it would..."

"You don't need to apologize for such matters..." He is bewildered for a moment before sighing, "Moreover, you’re right. I also think it's not important... we... we’re similar people." He gently graspes your arm, a rare relaxed smile on his face.

Never before has your souls feel so close, seemingly already merged as one.

You hesitate, feeling unsure.

"Perhaps it's different from people; some value it above their very soul and life, while others cast it aside as easily as an old garment..."

"I see." Qais lowers his eyes in disappointment, failed to find clarity in the uncertain path.

5321026.title: 穷酸的拍卖会
strings:
You receive an invitation to a small auction, supposedly held by an ancient family looking to clear out some collectibles. Upon arrival, you find they are trivial items that nobody would buy – centuries-old dressing cabinets, second-rate portraits by unknown painters, an old emerald engagement ring...

Wait, you notice the back of the portrait has a seal from the Qais family. You also see Qais standing in the corner, his face growing paler under the ridicule of the guests. He must be making a final effort to buy back the family title...
I’ll take all of these
Keep silence

You know this must be his last resort, as he looks at each collection piece with both regret and attachment. You let out a soft sigh and raise your paddle, bidding ten gold coins – the price of the title.

Qais's eyes brighten instantly. He looks up, searching for his anonymous benefactor, but you have already slipped away from your seat, disappearing into the night.

You decide to remain silent. This is his battle. Everyone maintain their silence, and thus, he is predictably defeated.

Soon, many knew of an ancient family who broke their proud spine for a bit of money, and even so, they still didn't receive even a single gold coin. How laughable!

They mockingly talk about Qais, Qais's family, Qais's few friends, and of course, include you.

5321027.title: 盖斯声望事件-荣耀回归2
strings: Qais successfully raises enough money to reclaim his title, announcing he will hold a ritual to welcome back this honor.

5321028.title: 盖斯声望事件-赎回幕后
strings: Qais gaters enough money to redeem his mother's passed-down engagement ring.

5321029.title: 盖斯声望事件-盖斯的礼物
strings:
"I have brought you a gift."
A stiff and enigmatic smile appeared on Qais's face, a smile incompatible with his chiseled features, yet harmonizing with the scars and the darkness you both worship.
He presented a sealed old box: "My father, my grandfather, every one of my ancestors warned the next generation not to open it. But after that day, I sensed a familiar smell from within. I thought, you might have use for it." He offered it at your hand, expecting you to open it.

5321030.title: 盖斯声望事件-行脚商走了
strings: You don't pay the gold coins for the strange old book, and the merchant leaves.

5321031.title: 《被遗忘的仪式》事件激活提示
strings: This book exudes a mysterious power. Insert it into <color=white><size=172%>Methinks</size></color>.

5321032.title: 《丰产的仪式图纸》事件激活提示
strings: This book exudes a mysterious power. Insert it into <color=white><size=172%>Methinks</size></color>.

5321033.title: 《内宅的仪式图纸》事件激活提示
strings: This book exudes a mysterious power. Insert it into <color=white><size=172%>Methinks</size></color>.

5321034.title: 《剑盾的仪式图纸》事件激活提示
strings: This book exudes a mysterious power. Insert it into <color=white><size=172%>Methinks</size></color>.

5321035.title: 丰产的仪式说明
strings:
Qais deciphered the ritual blueprints.
He tells you it’s a ritual commonly used by the Sultan’s ancestors in ancient times – to appease the earth and please river spirits with the innocent’s blood, ensuring a harvest in the territory the following year.

“I am willing to be your sacrifice.” Qais stares into your eyes and takes out a sharp knife, offering it to you.
Prepare the ritual
Forget it
Why not? You readily accept the ritual knife. Qais's eyes are lit up by your decisiveness. Now he longs for blood and offerings, just as he once is obsessed with fairness and justice.
You refuse him. Qais said nothing, just nods thoughtfully: "It seems it has no value, then destroy it." He suggests.

5321036.title: 内宅的仪式说明
strings:
Qais deciphered the ritual diagram.
He tells you it is a ritual which can make participants more charismatic, and it’s easy to perform – requiring only public intercourse.

This was originally used in The Sultan’s harem, mainly when women brawled under the harem fountain. Of course, the ritual wasn’t intended to bring harmony – it was conducted to ensure women’s animosity was directed at each other, not at The Sultan himself.

Here, Qais pauses and adds blandly, “Thus, to complete this ritual, ‘being watched’ is also a necessary condition.”
Prepare the ritual
Forget it

An interesting ritual, isn't it? And quite thrilling... you can become more handsome, more beautiful without losing anything, who would let such an opportunity slip?

Following your instructions, Qais nods without any objection and goes to prepare the materials needed for the ritual.
You think for a while and decide to give up... My goodness, to make love in public, you're not a wild dog!

5321037.title: 剑盾的仪式说明
strings:
Qais deciphered the ritual diagram.
He tells you that this was a ritual performed by ancient monarchs before setting out on expeditions. Specifically, the people who perform the ritual must dispatch a troop to the heart of the empire’s founding site, where they would purify their bodies, burn incense, and parade for five days before returning.
This ritual hasn’t been performed in years, but it remains a luminous shadow in the hearts of many empire residents. Conducting it anew will surely win you considerable influence.
This time, his eyes meet yours, filled with anticipation: “I can prepare the materials needed for the ritual.”
Prepare the ritual
Forget it
You agree with his suggestion. Let's move forward with that.

"We will talk later." You think it over and deemed the conditions not ripe yet.

Qais nods, "Then, when you need it, you can call upon me anytime."

5321038.title: 妻子的困惑
strings:
One day, Maggie mentions Qais with you, saying he suddenly gave her an expensive piece of jewelry, which is strange because the Qais family has not been affluent. Why would he do this?

As Maggie speaks, her eyes suddenly fixate on you, “Do you know what’s going on?”
Confess to her.
Hide the truth.

Sweating profusely, you confess to Maggie what you did with Qais during the ritual, and swear you just wanted to test the effects of the ritual...

Listen to what you're saying, Maggie is furious at this!

It is difficult for you to explain why you had such an impulse towards Qais that day... and as you recall the sensation of that ritual, Maggie's gaze turns dangerous.

You snap back to reality, quickly looking for an excuse, but Maggie only needs a cold glance to silence you. She seems to see through everything, points to the door, and kicks you out.
This is really terrible...

5321039.title: 哲瓦德声望事件激活提示
strings: Jawad seems to want to tell you something. Insert it into <color=white><size=172%>Methinks</size></color>.

5321040.title: 听说有位贵人……
strings:
Jawad approaches you with an ingratiating smile to discuss marriages between nobles.
He inquires about young men from prominent families, and pulls out a fine bottle of wine, probing you about their virtues and if there were any disreputable acts... as if you must be quite familiar with these matters. 
Thus, you muster your spirits and endeavor to highlight the youth's virtues and excellence, until your mouth goes dry, but he shakes his head. 
"Still not quite... with all due respect, not worthy of my Arumina."
A bit annoyed, you say...
How great can Miss Arumina be?
Are you here to waste my time?

"Of course, she is the best girl in the world, my daughter, my jewel, my Arumina -" he proudly says, his expression changing suddenly, "Uh, you know, I wouldn't, uh... she's an unmarried girl, can't marry as a second wife, uh... not even with Influence like yours."...

You are amused by his words. It seems the rumors about Jawad spoiling his daughter in the court are indeed very true.

He is startled and quickly bows his head in apology.

In one moment he's a proud and joyful father boasting about his daughter, in the next he reverts back to his greasy and sly demeanor.

He slips several gold coins to your servant, smiles, and says this is for their tea.

5321041.title: 我自己可以做主
strings:
An uninvited guest shows up suddenly.

She is wrapped in exotic silks, with each strand glimmering with gold. It’s unimaginable how exquisite her attire should be if such precious fabric is only used to cover her face.

She slightly bows to you before suddenly pulling down the veil.
“I am Arumina, I heard my father discussed my marriage with you, allow me to beg you… my marriage is my own choice, don’t listen to my father’s nonsense.”

You examine her clear yet naive eyes… she is far from being an unparalleled beauty, not yet mastering the attire and jewelry on her, which is quite endearing.
Molest her
Promise her
Reject her

You lean close to her and blew into her ear, causing her to almost jump into the fountain, her face burning with shame and anger.

"You – you're not a good person, my father is right!"

She ran away like a rabbit, not even noticing her veil was left at your house.

You promise her that next time her father seeks your advice, you would directly suggest he go home and listen to his daughter's views – a mature woman's insight.

Miss Arumina is very pleased, knowing only one way to express her gratitude – stuffing a bag of money into your hands.

A woman's marriage in the clan requires her father's approval, so you cannot grant her request.

Hearing this, Miss Arumina remains undaunted. She spins on her heel, snatches her veil, and marches off with her head held high, not even bothering to bow farewell.

Your servants bristle at her impudence, but like father like daughter – she leaves behind a generous pile of coins as her meeting gift.

5321045.title: 哲瓦德的背叛
strings: Jawad no longer comes to your mansion to discuss business with you. He hires a team of guards to hide himself and his daughter in a fortress-like mansion, planning revenge against you.

5321048.title: 哲瓦德大敌事件-重复阶段

5321051.title: 哲瓦德死亡或对阿鲁米娜纵欲幕后

5321052.title: 恋爱咨询
strings:
Miss Arumina popped up again, brightly sitting in your sitting room, with dazzling jewelry all over, truly hard to ignore. 
"I have a few questions, to ask some male other than my father; among such males, those with some status, I only know you." She said, looking at you. Clearly, no one dared to correct this arrogant lady's etiquette problem, "Are you willing to answer?"

Your words made her face flush red, apparently, no one had ever pointed out her rude tone before. 
"My tone... what's wrong with it? My tone – that's just how I speak, it's perfectly fine!" 
You didn't reply. 
After a while, tugging at the pure-gold bells on her clothes, she reluctantly whispered, "Other than... um... other than maybe, maybe I should use 'you' instead." 
Though not much of an improvement, it's progress of sorts.

Her question was simple, "What kind of man is worth marrying?" 
Among her list of potential grooms, you, to your horror, saw the Sultan was included... All the other eligible young men in the capital were listed as well, she reasonably thought each one had a chance, based solely on her preferences. 
As you ponder how indulged she must have been by her father, you cautiously offer your perspective...
I would if you change your tone
Go ahead
Bravery
Wisdom
Power
Money

Strong men! I love them! Really love them!" She exclaims loudly, voicing her agreement, "I especially love those beautiful and powerful legs... Men need them to run fast so they won't be caught and killed during a duel!"

You want to correct her understanding of the word "duel"... but it's pointless; she won't listen now.

"So where to find brave men? Hmm... in the training ground? No, those are full of spoiled rich boys... Or should I go to the battlefield?"

She tilts her head, her childlike mind for once filled with thoughts beyond fine fabrics and precious jewels. After a moment, she gives her head a vigorous shake.

"Never mind – here's your consulting fee!"

You tell her that muscles weaken with age, wealth can vanish, and power can turn against you – but wisdom remains forever.

"But clever men are always finding clever ways to deceive women, aren't they? That's exactly what my father did to my mother... Though I suppose she did end up living quite comfortably..."

She drifts into contemplation, her childlike mind for once filled with thoughts beyond fine fabrics and precious jewels.

"Maybe a clever man wouldn't be so bad – if he's rich, handsome, and has status," she brightens up. "A man like that would certainly cause quite a stir!"

With that, she launches into a flurry of noble gossip from the capital's social circles – the kind of hot scandals you'd never hear in the bathhouse.

"Oh, just like you, right? Father says when you're unhappy, the Sultan isn't happy either, and you always know how to make the Sultan happy!" 
She speaks while thinking seriously, her childlike face uncharacteristically serious. 
"So I should find a courtier, and he must be strong, smart, and handsome... When a person has influence, they seem more handsome than others, like you, right?" 
You tell her you don't know how to respond to that. 
She laughs, finding the joke very amusing. As she left, she continued talking about how handsome and influential you are, which makes you more well-known.

"In that case, I might as well marry my father – he's the most brilliant at making money I've ever known, by any means necessary."

She catches your expression and bursts into laughter.

"Oh, I'm only teasing! You should see your face right now! Don't tell me you actually believed that? I won't marry my father; he's too fat!"

Then she grows thoughtful, her childlike features taking on an unusual hint of gravity as she considers your words.

"A man who knows how to make money... that's the best kind there is, isn't it? Perhaps you have a point – if he's good with money, he can buy anything: warriors, strategists, even ministers..."

She springs to her feet, gives you a quick curtsy, and presses something into your hand.

"This is your consulting fee!"

"Oh, just like you, right? Father says when you're unhappy, the Sultan isn't happy either, and you always know how to make the Sultan happy!"
She speaks while thinking seriously, her childlike face uncharacteristically serious.
"So I should find a minister, and he must be strong, smart, and handsome... When a person has influence, they seem more handsome than others, like you, right?"
You tell her you don't know how to respond to that.
She laughs, finding the joke very amusing. As she left, she continued talking about how handsome and influential you are, which makes you more well-known.

5321053.title: 不会开花的花园
strings:
Zephyr has grown plump, and though he wears your family crest and colors, his clothing is of very fine material – definitely not the kind you provide for servants.

When you inquire about this, he hangs his head, admitting he receives financial support from "a young lady."

"But... nothing can happen between me and that young lady; she's far too prominent, too wealthy, while I'm just your slave. I always reject her, but she never listens – when I refuse her gifts, she bites me!"

He shows his arm pitifully, which is indeed covered in bite marks.

"I know seeing her means either accepting gifts or getting bitten when I refuse, but I still want to see her... I think of her every day... I run really fast, between her place and this mansion, and the round trip doesn't take me long. And I never neglect my duties here.

5321057.title: 胖囚犯死了快脚结局
strings:
After Jawad’s death, Zephyr seems very anxious, and other servants say he often stays out all night… Just as you plan to discuss this with him, he suddenly brings a woman dressed in coarse hemp.

“I love this woman, and she loves me. We want to live together. Master, I will continue to serve you, I will share my food with her, please permit this.”

The woman trembles all over, sticking close behind him, like a leaf lost from its tree, or a little fish lost from its school.
According to The Sultan’s law, a slave is not entitled to have a wife. What will you do?
You are no longer a slave
You will be slaves together
She cannot stay

At your words, Zephyr's eyes widen; he can hardly believe what he's hearing.

You repeat yourself, asking if he would continue working for you as a free man. Of course, you'll pay him wages – modest, but enough for him and his wife.

Zephyr stands stunned, trembling from overwhelming kindness, unable to speak.

The girl behind him, his soon-to-be wife, loses patience. She fiercely grabs his arm and bites it, snapping him back to reality.

They both kneel at your feet, expressing their gratitude for your generosity, then leave together. Zephyr looks at her, and she looks back at him, their steps light as if they could float away.

You purchase the woman he brought as your slave, using the money as their wedding gift.

You assure Zephyr and his woman that within your mansion's walls, they are safe – no one can harm them or separate them.

They kneel at your feet, expressing their deep gratitude for your mercy and kindness.

As they prepare to leave, Zephyr lets the woman go first, but remains kneeling. He looks up at you and says:

"You know her true identity; I cannot hide it from you... She's by my side now, and I swear she'll never bring you harm, nor will I ever hurt her, my master. You must trust me!"

You simply nod, preferring to let the matter rest.

According to the Sultan's law, a noble girl without a father cannot marry freely – she must await the Sultan's decision. And you know how the Sultan will decide: he'll savor her for his pleasure, then discard her like a worthless rag...

However, sheltering such a girl would put you at risk.

You refuse Zephyr's request.

He breaks down sobbing, pleading for mercy, but the woman behind him, Miss Arumina, clutches his clothes fiercely, pulling him away.

"We don't beg for mercy from such a cruel man... such a wicked man! Come, let's go. We won't beg him!"

5321058.title: 回到上一回合结束触发事件的测试
strings: In the fleeting moment of crossing through time, you seemed to glimpse two twisted shadows watching you.

5321060.title: 回到上一回合结束触发事件的测试3

5321063.title: 归乡之径
strings:
At a casual gathering, Fardak mentions running into Manar at your doorstep not long ago. His eyes light up as he speaks of the young cartographer. 
"You know what? She told me about tracking lions and gazelles through the wilds for a very, very long time... And you know what? The trail led her right into my homeland – she discovered a path I never even knew existed!" 
He falls silent then, and you know he's missing his homeland, longing to return...
Gently remind
Severely warn

You subtly reminded him that whether he can return does not depend on a secret path, but on the Sultan's will. If the Sultan does not permit him to leave, attempting to escape will only bring disaster to his kin and territory.
"I understand," Fardak sighed, lowering his head, avoiding your gaze.
You could tell he was still young, naive, and had not given up this fragile hope...

You sternly warned him that since the Sultan ordered him to stay in the capital, he should not entertain unrealistic fantasies, and let the Sultan know his desires. This will only bring disaster to him and his territory! Has he not learned this after the initial incident?
Fardak was terrified by your words, paling to the point of speechlessness, unwilling to revisit the topic.

5321064.title: 证婚人
strings:
Fardak has been troubled lately.
Though reluctant to be trapped in the capital, his Father sees it as an excellent opportunity.
“He wants me to marry quickly, preferably a woman of noble background, to secure a footing here...” Fardak sighs, “But I... well, what do you think? Should I do it?”
Of course, I can even introduce you
No, you won't find happiness this way
Political marriage, you're familiar with this. It's done worldwide. You even volunteered to introduce him to suitable women... Fardak hesitated, ultimately not declining your enthusiasm.

Such things? He should ask his own heart!
When you said this, Fardak's eyes sparkled briefly, but recalling his father's stern demeanor, they dimmed again. "You’re right, I'll think about it more."

5321065.title: 证婚人再起
strings: If neither of you likes this person, then let's find another! You rallied, getting ready to set Fardak up with someone new!

5321066.title: 质子婚礼
strings: Faradaq and Lumera are engaged under your arrangement, and you need to prepare for their wedding.

5321067.title: 送别
strings: The Royal Hostage and the book-loving girl are going back to the Royal Hostage's homeland. Maybe they'll return, maybe not.

5321070.title: 质子声望事件为您效劳

5321071.title: 阿里木声望事件-抓贼（废弃）

5321072.title: 如何处置
strings: What to do with this little rogue? He says his name is Hemir, clearly belonging to a Dark Alley rogue group—there are countless such groups in Dark Alley.
Let him go
Hold him to cancel the card

You recover the coin, and as for the little thief, you scold him lightly and tell him to come to the guesthouse for a meal if hunger strikes... Others won't be so lenient. The boy stalks off, defiance in his eyes, and you wonder how much of your words sink in.

Even a seemingly insignificant life, a scrap of cloth, half a copper; in the Sultan's Game, they must all be treasured... You locked Hemir in the basement, planning to solve him using a matching rock card drawn later...

5321074.title: 黑街访客
strings: This day, when you arrive at the Guesthouse, you see a crowd gathered around a man selling stuff... You go up to him, and he's holding a pile of odd things for sale; upon seeing you, he grins. "I thought it necessary to visit you, sir, that kid you let go a few days ago was one of mine." The people around you tell you the man’s name is Alim, the head of pickpockets in the Dark Alley, taking care of all the little rogues. You wonder how to deal with him...?
Scold him
Praise him
Challenge him

You reprimanded this head thief to keep his subordinates in line, to stop expecting to profit at your expense. He grinned, ignoring your words. "If the lads try to nab your wallet, it's a compliment, saying you look wealthy! Only poor folks don't attract pickpockets, am I wrong? But there's a way to keep the lads off your back..." He gathered the stolen goods, displayed before you. "If you help balance their loss from not snagging your fine wallet... maybe I'd have more time to watch them, hehe, hehe, hehe..." You saw the stolen goods, all wrapped in a black bag—you had no idea what you might end up buying.

You praised Alim regardless of his intentions, for looking after the little pickpocket well. The kid had clean clothes, shoes, and no signs of hunger. Alim seemed surprised, then grinned goofily. "The old master knows how to talk sweet, heh, heh, heh... I merely want to take care of my own money-makers. The lads are my hands, eyes, and clips for wallets. When they're fed and warm, they work better... Let's not talk about this, would you like to see my wares?" He gathered the stolen goods, opened them before you. Everything wrapped in black bags—that meant you didn't know what you’d actually get if you bought any.

You taunted him, asking if since the little pickpocket failed, he thought he'd snatch your wallet himself? Alim widened his eyes, then laughed. "Hehe, maybe? Who knows? No wallet on Dark Alley I, Alim, can't snatch, but now's not the time for that talk... check out my goods first, won’t you?" He swept up the stolen goods, displaying them before you. You saw the stolen goods, all wrapped in black bags—you had no idea what you might buy.

5321075.title: 失落小径
strings: Your sly dealings on the Perilous Trail were detected by the Sultan's tax officer, and the news reached the Sultan’s desk the next day. You—and even Fardak—are in big trouble.

5321076.title: 阿里木声望事件-抓贼循环

5321077.title: 夜盗
strings: Alim came to your home; he's about to take some things.

5321078.title: 夜盗循环
strings: Old Alim has "visited" your manor - watch your valuables carefully...

5321079.title: 阿里木声望事件-走失的狗崽子
strings:
That evening, Alim unexpectedly knocks on your door. "There's a rogue who hasn't come back yet, this isn't right," his face isn’t smiling, but tense, "I need your help."
The "rogue" must refer to his small gang kids. He's evidently aware of your reputation in the Dark Alley... But how will you answer...?
Accept
Reject

"Please come with me, [player.name] sir." For the first time, the old thief showed an expression of gratitude, without a smile or a comical gesture, but instead, bowed profoundly to you—then he walked ahead, as if a seasoned guide.

When you rejected him, the old thief seemed to wither... like a puppet with its strings cut, unable to make exaggerated grimaces or gestures anymore. He must have been truly desperate to turn to you... Yet before you changed your mind, he vanished into the dark like all other Dark Alley urchins.

5321081.title: 拉磨幕后
strings: The lost child, Hemir, is working for a miller. Alim hopes you can visit him—much better than if a thief like him goes.

5321083.title: 遥远的馈赠
strings: After several anxious days, someone brought a gazelle before you, saying their master ordered them to gift it to you. After inquiring further about the master's condition, you finally felt relieved—Fardak seems to have safely returned to his homeland, and you needn't worry about him anymore.

5321088.title: 阿里木入队
strings: Today, when you left, an old servant took your bundle, pipe, and water bottle... He did it so naturally, even your maid thought he's the new servant, and you felt no discord in this seamless service. It was only after crossing two streets you realized the old Alim was always beside you, and intended to stay from now on.

5321091.title: 阿里木声望事件激活提示
strings: Alim seems to have something to tell you, put it into <color=white><size=172%>Methinks</size></color>.

5321092.title: 合宜之人
strings:
You plan to open a guesthouse in the Dark Alley, a haven for those who can help you despite their lowly status. Yet you hesitate – who should manage it? 
This person must come from common stock, skilled at handling peddlers and the various classes of society; they need to cook well, as a guesthouse's greatest attraction is free meals; this person must be sufficiently loyal to you, otherwise it would be quite dangerous; and they must be clever and adaptable – who knows what might happen in the Dark Alley? 
"What about that cook from your territory?" After hearing your concerns, Maggie thinks for a moment before suddenly suggesting, "I believe his name is Habib? When we first married and you took me to tour your territory, I remember we once had an excellent meal... Because I praised how delicious the food was, you specifically called him out to commend him, which is why I remember his name." 
You slap your forehead – Maggie's suggestion strikes true. So, you send word to summon Habib from your lands. He arrives tomorrow, and your guesthouse opens its doors.

5321093.title: 哈比卜的拿手菜
strings:
Habib arrives promptly. As precaution, you decide to test his cooking. The chef confidently accepts, promising not to disappoint Lady Maggie's recommendation, eager to demonstrate his skills with several specialties for everyone to sample. 
Naturally, you must provide funds for ingredients.

5321097.title: 边角料
strings:
This day, you enter the Guesthouse and catch Habib squatting by the slop bucket, busy with something. 
He is startled by your presence, hurriedly standing up, vigorously wiping his hands on his apron, nervously beginning to explain.
"It's, it's just, master... because the guesthouse has improved, we process more ingredients every day, and there are more trimmings... I just, just feel... it's a shame to throw it all away..." 
He rubs the corner of his clothes, looking at you nervously.
How would you like to make use of this?
Unnecessary

These scraps surpass the mud-mixed porridge consumed by slum dwellers. You nod, asking his plans. 
Habib appears delighted with your permission to use these materials to supplement meals - people work better on full stomachs!
Feeding your people garbage-derived meals? Unacceptable - people would disrespect you. You shake your head, forbidding this action.

5321098.title: 后街的动静
strings: One day, you discover several emaciated beggars searching through garbage heaps behind the guesthouse, seeking anything edible... Even children with rotten vegetable leaves in their mouths, likely provided by their mothers.
Come with me
Your Purpose?

The children you caught expected punishment, but you gently pat their hollow stomachs: "Don't eat these rotten leaves - come, let me provide something proper." Taking their hands, you gesture for other vagrants to follow.
Before you could scold them, these starving people scattered desperately. Finding nothing here, they must quickly search the next garbage heap, or risk not waking tomorrow...

5321101.title: 老鼠的下场
strings: Later, you learn the person ordered to plant rat parts in Habib's mush to discredit you died in Dark Alley. Perhaps this represents the consequence of choosing the wrong master.

5321102.title: 原谅的价格
strings: You found the courtier who framed you. Ashen-faced, he musters what little spirit he has left to promise that if you're willing to let this matter go, he'll do anything.
I want you to apologize to me publicly
I need your support
I want you to pay compensation

You demanded this noble apologize publicly at your guesthouse. More painful than death, he had no choice but comply.
Dark Alley teemed with people - commoners and slaves who never witnessed a noble lord apologizing, wide-eyed to miss nothing.
The courtier stood ashen-faced before your guesthouse, pretending the crowd didn't exist.
"I... apologize to you... for the rat incident." He bowed quickly before darting back to his sedan chair.
His bearers ran with unprecedented speed.
The crowd roared with laughter at this comedic scene, discussing the story enthusiastically for weeks afterward.
He nodded vigorously, promising future court support.

He sighed with relief. 
After negotiation, you departed his mansion carrying a heavy coin purse.

5321103.title: 想做人
strings: After eating a proper meal, they reclaim some dignity... but come tomorrow, hunger gnaws at them again... Is there any way to give them a chance – even just the children?
I can help you
I, Powerless

You contemplated before gathering these frail mothers, asking if they would entrust their children to you. You've established a nursery of hope where children could eat properly and learn life's principles. 
They thanked you tearfully before almost coldly resolute pushing their children into your arms.

You refuse giving these children false hope that the world might help them - such expectations might ultimately harm them more deeply.
Afterward, you never again saw these children near your guesthouse.

5321105.title: 和颜悦色的哈比卜
strings:
Recently Habib seems particularly cheerful, agreeing with everything you say, smiling even when scolded. 
He even chased after you to present a package of jerky, explaining a guesthouse patron shared rare game meat from outside the city, which he carefully prepared as jerky for everyone - including you, of course. 
Did Maggie receive some too?... This thought emerged unexpectedly, causing you to hastily shake your head, banishing it.

5321106.title: 高端服务
strings:
The expanded guesthouse has grown larger and more impressive. Habib approaches, pleased yet shy, rubbing his hands together.
"Sir, the guesthouse now has an excellent stove and spacious kitchen! We can prepare more complex dishes... Perhaps we could host banquets for those desiring such meals?" 
You catch his drift – perhaps the guesthouse doubles as a tavern, an eatery, drawing in paying guests...
Let's Do It
Forget it
You nod in agreement, and Habib beams with joy – he thumps his chest, vowing to make this guesthouse renowned and rake in riches for you.
You shake your head – the guesthouse serves to recruit useful hands, not to turn a profit. Habib's face falls a little, but he bows to your will.

5321108.title: 羊排与羊肉
strings:
After a fanquet, an unpleasant incident occurred. 
Today, the guesthouse serves retainers pea-dusted lamb chops, while Habib brings the paying guests hearty stewed mutton. 
As guests dispersed, one retainer mocked those eating freely – "Look, the meat from your chops? It’s all on our plates now." 
A fight brews from this. By the time you rush in, both sides bristle, ready to clash.
Support your followers
Support the paying guests

You tell everyone that this guesthouse was created to provide shelter for those who follow and help you, not simply to earn money from meals. Anyone rude to your people here needs to leave. 
The people from the Dark Alley erupted in cheers while the noble guests angrily left one after another. They will probably speak poorly of you in noble circles.

You tell the gathered crowd that much of the guesthouse's upkeep relies on the guests' meal fees. Hospitality demands they enjoy their stay if they've paid – so you ask everyone to treat them with courtesy, for their own good, too. 
The Dark Alley folk mutter and drift away, while the nobles preserved their dignity and repeatedly shared this story with their friends.

5321109.title: 变换的行列
strings:
It hits you suddenly – the children helping in Habib's kitchen seem different. So you ask Habib what's going on. 
His face drains white, his whole body shrinking as if his spine had been removed: "I know this is wrong, sir... but..." he mumbles, not daring to meet your eyes, "but these children have nothing to eat, they look so pitiful... so, whenever there's extra food, I call them in to help..." 
So that's it – the children's lineup changes daily. You're feeding every hungry orphan in the entire Dark Alley...
You're doing nothing wrong
You shouldn't do this

Habib hasn't requested additional budget for this, nor neglected any of his duties, so you don't reprimand him. However, you warn him that he must ensure these children wash their hands thoroughly and hold plates steady when helping serve, to avoid causing you any trouble. 
"They understand, they understand!" Habib quickly agrees. "They greatly value this opportunity... not only can they eat their fill, but they also have work to do!" 
He's deeply grateful for your tolerance.

You blame Habib for not using your money to aid these children and for the dangerous decision to allow unknown children into your guesthouse's kitchen. 
Habib does not refute your accusations. He kneels down and apologizes, promising never to let other children into the guesthouse again.

5321110.title: 忠善之人
strings:
Maggie heard about you reprimanding Habib for bringing hungry children to help in the kitchen. She doesn't look happy. 
"Habib is the kindest, most honest person – you shouldn't speak to him like that, especially in front of everyone," she glares at you. "What he's doing isn't wrong, those children deserve help.' 
Saying this, she pulls out an embroidered velvet money pouch – her personal savings. 
"I'll pay for it on your behalf. Just let them continue going to Habib's kitchen – why can't you just let everyone be happy?"
Do as you please
This won't work

You shrug and agree to Maggie's approach, but this doesn't make her any happier. 
"It seems we can never reach an agreement without arguing," she says, shaking her head as she leaves the room you're in. "I'm tired. I'm going to enjoy something nice tonight..."

You tell Maggie that you reprimanded Habib not just for wasting money, but because he acted without your permission. 
Hearing this, Maggie's eyes flash with mockery: "Ha! He's done plenty of things without your approval that have made others happy." 
She smiles and hands the purse back to her servant: "I'll handle this matter myself, husband. You must have more important things to attend to?" 
Ah... you've just been dismissed by your own wife.

5321111.title: 小小的快乐
strings:
The children return to the guesthouse. Their attitude toward you is cautious, but they're quite cheerful and enthusiastic with Habib. 
Perhaps you shouldn't dwell on this issue anymore. After all, your wife has clearly taken Habib's side... 
Though at least to uninformed outsiders, these children serve as excellent advertisements for your reputation for kindness.

5321112.title: 舍馆的阁楼
strings:
After the expansion, the guesthouse's third floor has become quite spacious, no longer the cramped warehouse it once was. 
Habib reports to you that many people, drawn by your reputation, have approached him wanting to rent this attic. Of course, who to rent it to remains your decision.
Prostitutes
Noble
Mercenary

How can a great city have only one brothel? You could establish a small-scale but premium House of Delights in your guesthouse attic, arranging service providers and clients... naturally collecting a modest fee.

Renting to nobles seems wise? Maybe you can set up a comfortable room deep in the guesthouse full of carpets and velvet cushions where those in power can gather to smoke water pipes and talk about things unfit for outsiders to know. These matters will become your, and the more Intelligence you possess, the stronger you'll be in court...
You could offer the attic to mercenaries for exchanging information and leads. Perhaps this provides mission opportunities and allows hiring powerful fighters...

5321114.title: 布缇娜之怒
strings:
Buthayna storms up to you, bristling. 
"You look like an upright sort – yet here you are, snatching my gutter trade!" She jabs a finger at your guesthouse attic. “ - sing my own people, no less!" 
Sure, no law says she alone runs this business in town, but...
I'll use my own people
Mind your own people first
We can form a partnership
Hearing your promise, she's not very satisfied but agrees to end the matter. However, who will continue this business now?

Hearing your words, Buthayna turns pale with rage. Pointing at you, her lips tremble speechlessly before she departs furiously. Afterward, she indeed strengthened supervision over her Ladies of Delight, who rarely found opportunity to work privately for you again.

She pauses, seemingly never considering this direction. 
"Well... not impossible, treating your attic as an extension of the House of Delights - sharing profits, losses, and these girls. However, your contribution won't be small?" Her false smile returns, suggesting her price will undoubtedly be high.

5321115.title: 拜铃耶的掉落
strings: "Cherish my Lord's blessing." Badriyyah had giggled behind her hand, lightly touching your forehead before leaving the attic.

5321119.title: 陌生的妓女来访
strings: Recently, an unfamiliar prostitute has come to your attic looking for business.

5321120.title: 遥远的瘟疫
strings:
A regular from your attic tells you that "something happened" at Buthayna's place. A prostitute named Siyama went there to offer her services, but she was already infected with a venereal disease, and Buthayna failed to notice. 
"Now several noble guests have been infected by her, with all sorts of stuff growing down there, oh my!" the regular exaggerated, "Luckily I never go there, your attic is cheap and good, and clean!" 
Despite the winding manner... your reputation has soared.

5321122.title: 丝绒暗室的掉落
strings: This velvet chamber becomes the most fashionable meeting place for officials and nobles, spreading your name far and wide.

5321123.title: 过于尊贵的客人
strings: After a court session, an official stops you, sweating profusely, saying he has important matters to discuss.

5321124.title: 如何款待尊贵的客人幕后
strings: The boring court session finally ends, meaning the day of the Sultan's visit to your guesthouse approaches. Think carefully - is there anything you haven't fully prepared?

5321125.title: 盖斯-意想不到的遗产
strings: After Jawad's death, his daughter's title was also stripped. This means the Qais family's hereditary rights are available again - anyone can purchase them now. It will cost about 10 Gold Coins, with a five-day purchase window. You decide...
Buy it
Inform Qais
Knowing well of Qais's desperate financial situation, you decide to help him by purchasing the title.

After telling Qais about the matter, his eyes lights up slightly only to dim again – solving it with money alone is certainly a good thing, but the problem also lies in the money...

He leaves heavy-heartedly but still sincerely thanks you.

5321128.title: 冒险者酒吧谋反阶段
strings: The adventurers have heard of your uprising plans and decide to repay your kindness. You can summon them whenever needed.

5321129.title: 公主的滋味
strings:
An old mercenary often brags at the adventurers' tavern, claiming he once followed the previous Sultan in conquering this land, and was rewarded by sleeping with several princesses from the conquered realm. 
"The taste was exquisite," he says, licking his lips. "Once you've tried it, ordinary women become meaningless." 
Other mercenaries mock him - how different could a princess's private parts be? How big could the difference be? The old soldier argues loudly, insisting he's right. 
They hope you'll settle this extremely vulgar dispute.
Princesses are indeed different
All women are basically the same

You tell them that even with identical physiology, lying with a high-status woman provides indescribable psychological satisfaction. 
The old soldier nods repeatedly, agreeing with you. Others eagerly ask what makes princesses special, the topic growing increasingly vulgar... 
Amid the lewd celebration, today's drinking party ends.

You mock him for taking women and bedroom matters too seriously, showing his lack of ambition. Aren't all women the same with the lights off? 
People laugh and argue, especially after you buy them a round. The drinking atmosphere grows livelier, and soon everyone forgets the topic.

5321130.title: 第一个牺牲者
strings: The old mercenary who boasted at the party dies - his manhood cut off and stuffed in his mouth... Everyone vaguely knows why, but no one dares discuss it.

5321131.title: 唯一的牺牲者
strings:
The old mercenary who boasted at the party dies - his manhood cut off and stuffed in his mouth. 
Everyone generally guesses why he died. They remain cautious for a long time with no other victims appearing, and the incident gradually fades from memory.

5321133.title: 妻子死亡后哈比卜事件

5321134.title: 奈费勒的谎言
strings:
News of your guesthouse hosting the Sultan quickly reaches Nawfal's ears. He arranges a secret meeting, telling you this is an excellent opportunity to purge the empire's remaining poison. 
You draft a list of corrupt individuals, arranging for people to discuss it at the right moment... though how much the Sultan will absorb remains uncertain.

5321135.title: 宰相的谎言
strings:
News of your guesthouse hosting the Sultan quickly reaches Abdul's ears. He hosts a banquet for you, giving you a list of people he dislikes. 
"Just have someone briefly mention this to the Sultan... Your velvet room isn't the palace, so the Sultan will more readily believe what he hears there. If he believes he's caught traitors, you'll be safe - and greatly distinguished!" 
You don't immediately agree but take the list.

5321136.title: 更刺激的比赛
strings: Someone tells you about a more exciting, higher-stakes competition than horse betting in the Dark Alley... dog-fighting. Want to see?

5321137.title: 法里斯的支持
strings:
Just as everyone cheers for Luna's victory, as servants bring your winning gold, someone squeezes beside you. 
"Hey, you like dogs too?" He lowers his voice, clearly addressing you, using formal speech and noble accent, "Quite surprising." 
You turn to see him smiling at you, a black hound with a crescent mark on its forehead happily pressing against his feet, tail wagging frantically. 
"Ha, see, this is my dog." He smiles proudly, patting Luna's head. "Keep the money it won you. You have good taste."

5321138.title: 法里斯的友谊
strings:
You and Faris have become good friends, meeting in the dog-fighting pit's small room. Luna enjoys grooming and massage from two servants, its slender head affectionately resting on Faris's lap, eyes narrowed in pleasure. 
Perhaps noticing your envious glances, he laughs heartily and gives you a small dog whistle, teaching you some techniques for befriending dogs. "If you're interested, get one yourself! Once you have a puppy, you'll see how wonderful they are, oh... baby!" He massages Luna's cheeks, kissing it several times. 
Hmm... you're not sure you want to become this disgusting.

5321140.title: 更高端的比赛
strings: The dog-fighting pit will host a higher-grade race, open only to the most generous, most imposing patrons! This competition has higher stakes... And why not try using the noble Sultan Card in the gambling... well, the Extravagance Card.

5321141.title: 自信的法里斯
strings: Hearing about the upcoming elite race with stronger dog competitors, Faris confidently slaps your shoulder with one hand while holding Luna with the other: "Hey! My Luna will definitely win. You'd be unwise not to bet on Luna this time!"

5321142.title: 幽怨的法里斯
strings: Having lost his beloved dog, Faris no longer wants to hear you proudly boasting about your wisdom and victory in the crowd.

5321144.title: 关闭拼凑真相
strings: You've gathered all the clues; the truth is before you. Time to talk with Faris.

5321145.title: 法德耶的愧疚故事线
strings:
As evening falls, a woman completely wrapped in black fabric arrives at your door. She claims to be the Sultan's messenger with a message for your ears only.
Her hand exposed, clutching the fabric tightly - you recognize this hand covered in expensive oils... It's Fadia.

5321146.title: 第一次帮助
strings: Through her connections among palace maidservants and eunuchs, Fadia gathers considerable intelligence for you.

5321147.title: 第二次帮助
strings: Fadia boldly alters the audience order list, allowing you and several others early entry to the palace, increasing your palace influence.

5321148.title: 第三次帮助
strings: Fadia befriends a favorite slave girl of a certain minister... Through this network, she begins spreading discontent with the Sultan on your behalf.

5321150.title: 遗忘的交易
strings:
Fadia sends you a bottle. 
She tells you that in a dream, someone made a deal with her, asking her to exchange the most important thing in her heart for... what was it? She's completely forgotten, but she vomited up a mass of things, perhaps including matters she once cared about! 
"You, wiser and more powerful than I, can surely use this better... As for me, I've forgotten all my troubles!"

5321151.title: 女奴之死
strings: Days later, you hear palace eunuchs disposed of a slave girl's suicide corpse. Reportedly, her body was covered in wounds, self-inflicted whip marks, her face frozen in a strangely happy yet unreal smile.

5321155.title: 破除洁净
strings: Passing the Purist Order temple, you notice suspicious people sneaking around, carrying a massive, foul-smelling barrel... Wait, surely they aren't planning to pour that inside?

5321156.title: 伊曼出走
strings: You not only organized Cultic God rituals but publicly defiled the Purist's sacred space... Iman cannot continue helping someone like you and departs permanently.

5321157.title: 密教的援助故事线
strings: A servant hesitantly reports a "wailer" from the Cult at your door claiming urgent business.

5321158.title: 拜铃耶声望激活提示
strings: Badriyyah seems to have something to tell you. Place her in <color=white><size=172%>Methinks</size></color>.

5321162.title: 法德耶之死
strings:
Soon after, word comes from the palace that eunuchs have disposed of a woman's hanging corpse. 
You never see Fadia again.

5321165.title: 拜铃耶营业无收益提示
strings: Badriyyah finds someone curious about tattoos, though they remain undecided.

5321166.title: 拜铃耶营业收益提示
strings: A noble finds Badriyyah... praising her craftsmanship extravagantly.

5321167.title: 拜铃耶营业收益提示
strings: Badriyyah finds someone curious about tattoos, completing a satisfactory work. As she continues working, the tattooed grow more numerous around you. Once you dreamed these tattoos became living creatures, devouring their owners...

5321168.title: 拜铃耶营业收益提示
strings: A poor man finds Badriyyah... after completing his design, she smilingly refuses payment.

5321169.title: 拜铃耶营业收益提示
strings: A demanding client finds Badriyyah, presenting bizarre demands and criticizes her work, eventually leading to a physical fight, parting angrily. This incident somewhat affects your reputation...

5321170.title: 拜铃耶营业收益提示
strings: A brash young man finds Badriyyah... They claim that since being tattooed, no one dares bully them anymore. Your Notoriety rises accordingly.

5321171.title: 拜铃耶的技术精进了
strings: Badriyyah's skill advances. Frequent use of that herbal mixture apparently increases her power given by the Cultic God.

5321173.title: 祭品
strings:
Badriyyah shows her black-stained hands: "Our summoning entity is quite gluttonous - it will certainly enjoy these fragrant offerings."
Use Purist priests as sacrifices for summoning dark spirits? Taking this action would make Purist faithful view you as demonic, but certainly... the entity you summon, and Badriyyah, would be delighted.
What are we waiting for?
Perhaps we should release them

Badriyyah covers her mouth, laughing as if expecting your choice.
Hearing this, Iman silently leaves your group.

Badriyyah shrugs - your captives, your decision.
The priests show no gratitude, not only ungrateful but spreading rumors about your relationship with cultists among commoners and nobility...

5321181.title: 我们都是祭品
strings:
To live, people struggle painfully through hardship - life is such endless toil, only death... only death can bring redemption!
Badriyyah laughs madly, kissing your cheeks and face with boundless joy - she's sincere, truly rejoicing at her master's arrival, at ending this world's suffering! So... what about you?
We are all sacrifices
Release me!

You respond to Badriyyah with equal joy, letting her uses long needles dipped in the pool's black liquid to tattoo complex patterns on both your skin and hers. When no more space remains for needles, your consciousness slowly fades as your souls flow out through these tattoos, consumed eagerly by the waiting "god."
This power helps Them temporarily enter the mortal realm, though only briefly... after all, this isn't shadow or ethereal dream, but the massive divine being itself. They will burst from the cavern to feast on the cultists outside, then find more people. They'll keep eating and eating until They've accumulated enough power to remain in this world - until They devour the entire world.
None of that matters now. None of that matters now. Being eaten doesn't matter - living is merely drudgery, nothing more.
What a joke - even if life is a puddle of mud and stinking water, death means nothing remains! You desperately struggle, trying to escape this place.

5321182.title: 献给阿尔图的花束
strings: Someone sent you flowers... They lack floral fragrance, instead carrying... more familiar, stranger scents. Perhaps you need quiet contemplation to remember what this is.

5321183.title: 密教的遗孤
strings:
You spread these flowers on your table, studying them carefully.
Though varied in appearance, they seem to share similar fuzzy stems and paired leaves. Their scent feels familiar - to confirm your memory, you simply cut these flowers, mixed them together, then breathed deeply...
Memories of the cave, of the Cultic God, strike you.
Though lacking many ingredients, this flower mixture must be the main component of that herbal juice Badriyyah gave you.
You immediately send people to investigate who delivered these flowers. However, you only find children huddled together, claiming ignorance of the sender - but that person fed them well and promised "the receiving gentleman will surely feed you again."
The children gaze at you expectantly.

5321184.title: 拜铃耶的下落
strings:
Days later, those children who brought you flowers approached nervously, handing you a note—perhaps fearing your anger at their initial dishonesty—then fled quickly.
The note bore a roughly drawn map, marking a wasteland at the city’s edge. It had once been a royal prison from the previous dynasty, now overgrown with flowers and grass sprouting from the bones of long-dead prisoners.
Following the map, you found the place—and there, as expected, Badriyyah was tending to the blooming flowers. She seemed unsurprised to see you.
As you told her about the secret curse of the Cultic God that had afflicted you, Badriyyah took your hand, studying the mark on your palm as it spread with angry red veins.
"They are angry." Badriyyah murmured, releasing your hand. Her eyes did not meet yours. "They punished me severely, and you too. This is what we deserve." Her black tattoos had multiplied, her voice hollow and weary.

"I won't abandon the cult—not from cowardice. But... the Cultic God, my master, is the only deity who ever answered my prayers. In my despair, when I thought someone like me didn't deserve happiness... They truly saved me." She shrugged, then pulled up a long needle. Seeing you flinch, she giggled again, now resembling the usual Badriyyah. "Besides, I won't abandon those fools. Oh, I know most cultists are illiterate idiots who've never eaten their fill, but should fools be bullied? Should fools be treated as fodder? With me here, they're... at least fools who know how to fight back."
You tried persuading her further, but Badriyyah shook her head.
"Let's talk about something else, my good lord. Do you know the source of happiness? It's always knowing where to find a switch that stops everything, a bell that wakes you up! Only knowing you can endure everything to gain liberation, to live differently, can you truly laugh from the heart. For many of my companions, death is that bell... and for me... behold this."
Continue

She turns abruptly, showing you her back. Still gripping the long needle, she points backward... Among intricate patterns, just below her shoulder blade, a beautiful buttercup is tattooed. Its lines seem somewhat out of place with surrounding tattoos.
"This is my own invention - not from our master's will, but because I wanted this design. I infused my own magic into this flower. I've tested it - my master cannot touch it. During every feast, every divine summoning, my back stays cold in that spot."
She turns to face you.
"If you trust me, I can tattoo one on your hand too - infusing both your power and mine. Perhaps it can expel the master's presence, free you from... those dreams. I know those dreams, of course - God, every cultist knows!"

5321185.title: 消失的回响
strings: After Badriyyah's method works, those god whispers can no longer disturb you. Your world becomes completely quiet, not even the slightest echo remains.

5321189.title: 做鸡
strings: A new idea has occurred to you.

5321190.title: 做牛马
strings: A new idea has occurred to you.

5321191.title: 做羔羊（正
strings: A new idea has occurred to you.

5321192.title: 做狗
strings: A new idea has occurred to you.

5321193.title: 做羔羊（密
strings: A new idea has occurred to you.

5321194.title: 做老鼠
strings: A new idea has occurred to you.

5321195.title: 做人
strings: A new idea has occurred to you.

5321200.title: 痛斥
strings: Clearly the Leader of the Vagrants does not share your view: she snarls that you tricked her into capture, and now and that neither she nor the vagrants you toyed with will ever turn around and play your twisted game.
I'm only trying to play this game.
I'm doing this for your sake.
You're in my hands now.

You told Raed it all simply came down to whatever cards one happened to draw at the time... At the very least, you were willing to spend patience, wisdom, and even a little money to break those cards at the smallest cost. If she was willing to help, perhaps you could do it even better... She held your gaze for a long time, but in the end, you persuaded her.

You told her that if you hadn't dispersed those vagrants, they might well have been slaughtered by other armies—and she would have died in a ditch. After a bout of haggling, she agreed to help you—so long as you would help the vagrants in return.

You told her serving you was her only way to survival—otherwise, the card would be broken! Don't be ungrateful... Ah, her eyes were truly steadfast and stubborn, which made it all the more satisfying when she bowed her head and yielded. Ever since you started playing this game, you had had more and more chances to savor that defeated look.

5321201.title: 拉伊德的逃跑
strings: The servants said a noble lady suddenly appeared in your house; they hadn't dared stop her or understood what was happening, so they had let her leave—someone saw her go out of the city... Was it Raed? In any case, you lost her trail; now you needed to beware her revenge.

5321202.title: 拉伊德声望激活提示
strings: Raed seems to want to talk to you. Insert it into <color=white><size=172%>Methinks</size></color>.

5321205.title: 流民的帮闲收益提示
strings: Every time you heard rumors about yourself, their content evolved; whether they were good or bad depended entirely on how those ever-roaming gossipmongers chose to spin them—so long as someone enjoyed listening.

5321206.title: 流民的帮闲收益提示
strings: Every time you heard rumors about yourself, their content evolved; whether they were good or bad depended entirely on how those ever-roaming gossipmongers chose to spin them—so long as someone enjoyed listening.

5321207.title: 作废
strings: That's it!

5321211.title: 拉伊德的请求
strings:
A servant reports that Raed and the vagrants have moved into that house—and have set up a wooden sign at the door, bearing your name... Clearly Raed's doing: with your name there, anyone who dares trouble these people will think twice, but any trouble inside will be pinned on you.
When you confront Raed about it, she grins, showing a mouth of rotten teeth: "That's right, good lord—come cut the ribbon for [player.name]'s Fortress!" What a rogue!

5321214.title: 流民谋反阶段
strings: They came from the [player.name]'s Fortress. Originally it had been a residence named after you... Now, to repay you, to defend their home, and to win homes for others, those who had been homeless took up arms to fight at your side!

5321215.title: 伪造公主
strings:
You tell Raed that she already knows the answer, which is why she's been tossing and turning in her thoughts. Hasn't she already used the image of a noble lady to cover the vagrants several times? Hasn't she seen how foolish guards and High Constables fawned over nobles? She possesses everything needed to be a noble—perfect manners, perfect education—so why not use it to seize greater advantage? These benefits can be redistributed by her hands so that more people eat their fill!
Raed bites her lip, hesitating, thinking... "Mother told me to keep far away... She spent her life teaching me to be a lady, but at the end, she told me to stay far from nobles—as far as I could. If anyone discovers I am the Sultan's sister... they would surely behead me. And that would be the mildest punishment, I'm afraid." She takes a long breath, then lifts her eyes to you. "But I can't hide forever. I am who I am—whether it's the schooling I had as a child or the blood and flesh that make this body, I can't evade it. You're right. Why not exploit myself to the utmost? Why not do what only I can do?" She leans forward, one hand loosening her messy hair she had hastily tied. "Princess Raedina will return to this city. She will help you greatly. But you must promise one thing to her friend, Raed: you must care for those vagrants—their food and drink, their health, their safety. If they are harmed, Princess Raedina will be heartbroken... And you know how noblewomen are, once they are heartbroken, they hide away—then you'll never find her."
You promise to care for the vagrants.
"You must also promise never to drag me into that filthy throne. I will never enter the palace, never be a lord, and don't you dare try to shove me anywhere for your political ends..."
You promise you will never use her heritage to make her become Sultan or anything else—a promise that now sounds almost ridiculous, to vow to a vagrant that you will never make her Sultan!
"Good. Then... I need to go make preparations. We'll speak again." She rises and gives you a haughty nod, every gesture perfectly that of a noblewoman.
Raedina

To better protect the vagrants, Raed draped herself in silk, adorned with jewelry, and carried herself with the hauteur of a noblewoman. No one would guess she had recently been joking and sharing meals with street beggars and wanderers.

5321216.title: 重新开启【玩家名】堡
strings:
The false-princess plan worked splendidly. Compared to the swing of a spiked mace, it was smiles, gauze skirts, and words traded between wine cups that truly helped the vagrants—after all, most suffering lies in nobles who refuse to spare even a crumb between their fingers for the poor... and Princess Raedina can pry open that narrow seam.
So—should we continue? [player.name] Fortress is protection enough now; must Princess Raedina still need to show her face so often? Raed sprawled in your parlor, exhausted by these make-believe games; she would gladly revert to the leader of the vagrants who needs no curling irons, no perfume, and can scratch her feet whenever she likes.
Fine. Be yourself.
The Princess's work is not yet done.

You tell her that she has already found her place—this city needs someone to occupy it, and she is doing it quite well. People should not lightly leave their position, just as a tree should not lightly move its roots. So, maintaining the present state is best—and often the hardest thing.
Raed nods, seeming to agree. "Yes... When I ponder these matters, I also wonder—if in the future I'm no longer the vagrants' leader, what will they do? A little girl who comes from nowhere has kept them alive this long—where will they find another Raed?" She smiles, picking up the rose tea the servant prepared and drinking it all in one gulp. "I'll be Raed freely—the vagrants' leader. There's plenty they need me to do."
And so, the Raed you knew returns—the rough, messy one who laughs loud and picks her nose.

You told her that once the game had begun, it was not hers to stop at will. This was merely the close of one round of returns; the next challenge would arrive at once—Princess Raedina would have to keep dancing for the vagrants, for Lord [player.name], for the Sultan's Game, until all was destroyed—just as you would.
She was about to trade barbs with you, venting the street-brutish eloquence she had banked up, but in your eyes she saw enough sorrow—or disillusionment—so Princess Raedina lifted her skirts once more, bowed to you with grace, and prepared to go on to the next revel.
Raed

With her messy hair, crooked teeth, and lack of sophistication, one could argue she is nowhere near conventionally attractive. But her crooked smile and the mace in her hand make one overlook these flaws.

5321217.title: 舞会的结束
strings: Plainly, despite all your effort, the plan failed. Princess Raedina did not gain enough influence in the capital, and so could do little for the vagrants—they are still attacked, insulted, hunted as prey without protectors. Raed came to you, tired and unsure, having lost confidence in both her selves—the princess and the vagrant.
I still need Princess Raedina.
Be yourself.
You persuaded Raed to keep trying to pose as Princess Raedina—after all, even a disregarded noble could accomplish more than a leader of vagrants. She accepted your advice, albeit reluctantly.

You waved your hand, resigned, and told her to drop the lady act—just bring the mace when she had time to help.
She jumped for joy and even let loose a thunderous fart—the vagrant Raed was back.
Raed

With her messy hair, crooked teeth, and lack of sophistication, one could argue she is nowhere near conventionally attractive. But her crooked smile and the mace in her hand make one overlook these flaws.

5321218.title: 伪造公主
strings:
Trouble has arisen.
Raedina comes to your residence and hands you a splendid, gold-lacquered roll of parchment. Her hands tremble uncontrollably. "The Sultan's eunuch brought it... to me... to Princess Raedina's residence," she said, forcing calm, her gaze still steady. "The Sultan said he has heard of the captivating princess and wishes to see me... He also said his harem is... rather empty."
A throb of pain crosses your brow. By imperial law, tribal princesses have the right to choose imperial nobles for husbands—a regulation set by the former Sultan to win the loyalty of tribal chiefs... Even the Sultan is, in theory, not allowed to force a tribal princess to marry him. Raedina's choice of this identity at the time had likely taken this law into account.
"Our king... is not much fond of rules, is he?" She forces a smile. "But of course, perhaps he merely wishes... to toy with me, and not truly bring me into the harem. He believes an invitation to the harem is a supreme honor for every woman in the empire... and thinks I will be more obedient for it... That's my guess."
You and she share a long, silent look. Everyone in the empire has to answer the Sultan's summons, but... "If it means sleeping with him, I'd rather die." Raedina stares straight at you. "Don't even think about it. If he insists, I will tell him everything before I die, and neither you nor I will escape. I won't sleep with the man who killed my mother... and I won't sleep with a brother by blood—some might be willing, but that's their business. I am not." You let out a long sigh. Yes—you have nearly forgotten this princess is by no means a toy for any ruler to manipulate.
You two speak for a long while more. In the end, you decide to find a companion to accompany Raedina before the Sultan—a person of high rank, difficult for the Sultan to approach, yet charming enough to overshadow her so the Sultan will lose interest. The plan is riddled with flaws, but you have little choice.

5321219.title: 拉伊德死亡
strings: You fretted all night... until the next day, you received a message from the Sultan's eunuch: a disguised scion of the old dynasty would be publicly executed.

5321220.title: 拉伊德赠礼
strings:
Princess Raedina sent you a gift.
When you unwrapped the silk around it, you started so hard you nearly dropped it—the True-Name Bracelet, which only the royal house had the right to cast! It was a token the Sultan gave his legitimate offspring... You hadn't even handled such a thing before, only heard of it in your fathers' tales: in a sense, it meant Raedina had a claim to the throne. As your thoughts churned and you stood at a loss, the maid who had brought the gift—she seemed to have been a vagrant before—bowed her head and said meekly that her mistress had a message for you:
"By giving it to you, I renounce the power it represents. Remember, you promised not to link me in any way to the foul throne."

5321221.title: 令人不快的刺探
strings: Raed went to you. Wary, she had surely heard from the streets that you've been prying into her affairs. "What do you want? To blackmail me? I've nothing left worth a lord's blackmail."
