As the final session of the symposium, all attendees (including Mr. [player.name]) gathered for a group photo by [player.name]'s statue at Nursery National University. It was the last day of March. Dusk settled in, and Lumera and Fardak were twinkling above as students inheriting the essence of the Nursery streamed through the campus. Everything was calm and peaceful, just like it was yesterday—and every day for the last thousand years.

As the attendees exchanged farewells and went their separate ways, the inscription beneath [player.name]'s statue came back into view. Legend has it that the legendary figure penned his own epitaph.

'In the realm of impermanence,

knowledge and I

reign eternal.'

Reported by Argus Tus, Nursery National University.

Before reaching this point, you have witnessed countless endings, and now, you have triumphed over fate itself. We are grateful to you for reaching the very end of this story. This also marks our first time venturing into such an uncharted territory... Thank you for coming this far. And thank you for sharing this joy with us.

epilogue_2001197.title: Epilogue: The Uncanny Order Parcel
strings:
The first to emerge is Maggie.

This is only natural. You know her so intimately—her face, her eyes, each strand of her hair, her sighs of contentment... and her gaze of disappointment.

You observe as some particles break away from the stream, gradually coalescing into a beautiful form: a foot taking shape, a robe unfurling, glossy hair cascading down... Particles form a shape, then slowly refine the hues and contours... As a Maggie identical to your recollection finally materializes, you find yourself drenched in sweat. Although you consider yourself thoroughly familiar with Maggie, numerous details still require endless refinement. How wide should her eyelids be? Should her lashes be thicker or sparser?

As the Maggie you have shaped softly descends to the ground, you instinctively reach out to cradle her in your arms. She opens her eyes, gazing at you in silence for a significant moment...

"No worries, my dear husband," she murmurs, wrapping her arms around your neck and kissing your cheek gently. "Let me create something essential for this world."

Standing upright, she retrieves a handful of particles, bestows a kiss upon them, and scatters them back into the mix...

"It's love and kindness," she utters, turning to meet your gaze, "these virtues must reside in every soul. Without them, this realm would become a living hell, driving even its very Creator away. So, my dear, let's return to our task. There's still much to be done."

She smiles at you before collecting another handful of quivering, erratic, restless particles, kissing them.

A profound sense of relief washes over you, allowing you to refocus on the task at hand...

This time, your thoughts are not fixed on anyone specific, but as several grand tomes materialize, you immediately realize the forthcoming presence.

Lumera quivers as she opens her eyes, locking gazes with you before redirecting her attention to Maggie, who tenderly kisses the world.

"Do you need me to create some books?" she rises with composure, adjusting the hem of her skirt. "Well, I have a better idea. I can help you create the fundamental laws of the world—such as the principle that stones should weigh more than air of equal volume, or that water transforms into steam when heated. With these laws in place, your world will evolve automatically."

You nod, commending her idea.

Lumera strides towards the center of the particles, standing next to Maggie. Then abruptly, she turns to you, whispering a question.

"I'm your creation, so you are my father, right?"

As you nod, she turns her gaze away.

Following this, Lumera commands all the particles to line up before her. She articulates the fundamental laws of your world—laws from the Creator's daughter, the supreme edicts to be obeyed.

Particles whirl around you, appearing slightly larger than before, now imbued with the essence of love and the fundamental laws. While Maggie is busy weaving love and kindness, Lumera summons more particles towards her, instilling her laws into them.

In this moment, the stage is set to bring forth the world itself—a pristine realm devoid of souls, a sanctuary where all beings may discover their place.

You beckon forth the most unrestrained and curious particles, those situated farthest from the collective, and with them, you create your friend... Manar.

Like before, she carries traces of myriad voyages. Upon opening her eyes, her gaze lingers on you only for a moment before instantly shifting towards the boundless expanse.

"Ohh! It's so vast here! So many places for me to explore!" 

Following this declaration, she releases handfuls of sand from her pack, molding intricate coastlines resembling the ruffled skirts of a maiden, sculpting volcanoes billowing black smoke, then crafting deserts, fertile plains, wastelands, and towering mountain ranges.

Inexhaustible, she persists in her creation. As the realm she creates expands, she drifts farther and farther away from your side, until all that reaches you are her joyful shouts echoing from the edge of the world.

"Wow, this is so amazing! A place like no other I've ever seen!"

While Manar is engrossed in her creation, certain particles begin to quiver, swirling before you in anticipation.

You plunge your hands into them, sifting and reshaping. Which of your friends will materialize this time...?

It is Jenna.

Upon her emergence, she fixes her gaze upon you, seizes your hand, and urges.

"I must create gems! All kinds of gems! And minerals, too! This world simply can't do without these little glimmers!"

With that, she darts in the direction where Manar has disappeared, scattering jewelry-making shards along her path onto the newly shaped lands. These fragments transform into mineral deposits, concealed within the earth, mountains, and streams, promising moments of dazzling awe to those who chance upon them.

You survey the immense world unfolding before you while Manar and Jenna are engrossed in their creation. However, something seems to be missing here...

Plants—they are what is lacking. You need an assistant to creat all the plants! The most fitting candidate for this role is him, undoubtedly...

With a flick of your wrist, you attempt to shape an entity from your thoughts. This act has become second nature to you. Your companion's form and thoughts take shape within your essence, faithfully constructed by particles...

Samir materializes in front of you, clutching that familiar medical tome, a pouch of herbs strapped to his waist. His gaze meets yours through the lenses of his glasses...

"Ah, this is... You... you're truly remarkable," he says, a familiar smile spreading across his face. "I see, your world needs plants. Inhabitants will rely on them for mending wounds and ailments. However, I need an assistant, if you allow it..."

You affirm with a nod, gathering another handful of particles... Kapar gradually materializes before you, kneeling. It takes him a moment to understand the newly shaped reality.

"Come," Samir utters, "There's so much work that needs to be done. Let's start with edible plants..."

Kapar follows, bearing a watering flask for the plants. The two of them plant as they discuss, and soon enough, the damp, verdant presence of plants permeates your realm.

Plants need sustenance to flourish—water, sunlight, soil, and air... You ponder how to swiftly create these vital elements.

Then, it strikes you that there is someone who will come to your aid in the most desperate of times, someone who knows you intimately and is always prepared to wholeheartedly support you.

 As Faraj opens his eyes, a myriad of emotions flicker through his gaze—confusion, bewilderment, excitement, delight, happiness, and thrill... Then he realizes that even in the world you have created yourself, you deem his companionship essential.

"Please, give me your orders," he springs to his feet beside you, "Water and wind? What else do you need? I believe Manar will take care of the sun and the moon. As for the rest, I am at your service!"

With a deep breath, he exhales a gust of wind. Then, recalling the despair you experienced when you were entangled in the Sultan's Game, he sheds tears, which transform into water drops.

Now, your world teems with life. Flowers and trees sway in the breeze, while water clashes against the land, its tumultuous roars blending with soft murmurs.

However, you realize that something is still missing—something concealed behind the leaves, nestled within the blossoms, and meandering among the clouds...

You envision it in your mind, then start your creation endeavors... Particles merge into delicate, white fur, followed by a pair of emerald eyes. As Lady Becky materializes before you, a familiar emerald necklace proudly adorns his chest.

The cat affectionately rubs against your legs for a while before embarking on an exploration of his newly formed kingdom. With each step of his snow-white paws, creatures—dogs, birds, butterflies, lizards, tigers, and elephants—vividly manifest, drawn from the primal images stored within a cat's mind. Instinctively, he navigates the art of creation, transforming the world into his playground. After all, he is a cat!

At last, you have reached this crucial moment—the creation of the dwellers of this newfound world.

As you fiddle with the particles dancing at your fingertips, countless forms and faces flicker through your mind... until the image of the perfect candidate crystallizes in your mind.

From her voice to her attireand even her makeup...

And thus, Malkina gradually opens her eyes. Her gaze instantly widens as she looks around.

"My goodness, you've truly created a world, but don't you think it's a bit too empty?" This skilled seamstress places her hands on her hips, as if appraising an exquisite tapestry. "If you ask me, you need people—people from all walks of life... Just leave it to me. I can sculpt their bodies, but for their souls, you'll need someone else for that."

Without waiting for your response, she stands upright, starting her art of creation. You watch as she retrieves her makeup case, extracting pinches of vibrant powders and deftly blending them on a mica palette. At times she adds a touch more red, other times more blue, and occasionally the purest gypsum powder to craft hues so pallid that they appear lifeless.

In her capable hands, the particles gradually take shape, forming a figure reclining on its side. At this stage, it cannot be identified as either man or woman, for it lacks a soul. Colors dance across its form, its silhouette shifting in size as Malkina focuses on molding its arm's length, the girth of its waist, and the breadth of its chest...

Its vacant gaze fixed upon you, its very Creator...

The human you have now awaits the spark of a soul that only you can provide.

You gaze upon your world, once barren, now teeming with vitality.

How will humanity thrive in this world? And what kind of souls will you create?

This question haunts you as you constantly ponder, sometimes applauding your insights, only to reject your own thoughts the next moment—you can never seem to reach any conclusions.

Later, you collapse under the shade of a newly sprouted ironwood tree. As you gaze at the rustling leaves above, a wave of exhaustion envelops you...

In that moment, a figure approaches, gently shaking your shoulder...

"Rise, [player.name]. Your world remains unfinished. There's no time to respite yet."

Upon opening your eyes, you find Nawfal standing before you.

"It appears when a true Creator doubts, his thoughts manifest into reality." Nawfal adjusts his robe, looking precisely as he did when you first met him in the Lapis Lazuli Palace. "I'm your creation, though I oppose your hasty creations. Your thoughts have given rise to many others, and you'll meet them soon enough. Nonetheless, let me assist you in bestowing a gift upon these souls."

A gift? What kind of gift does he intend to grant to the souls in your world?

"The gift of resistance," Nawfal answers with a smile. "The inhabitants of this world will understand that they have the power to defy anything, that no suffering or injustice is insurmountable. An act of rebellion, much like what you did... and what I did."

Nawfal approaches the soulless vessel and gently touches its head.

In a flutter, you realize that a new soul is taking shape...

The spark of soul permeating its vessel captivates you. Though still nascent, it marks the first stirring of the very first soul you created with your own hands.

Nawfal stands by your side. While he remains silent, a hint of pride is unmistakable in his demeanor, observing this glimmer known as "resistance."

Soon, Maggie joins you, smiling at you both, her hands and heart brimming with love.

"Defy anything? Does that include love as well?"

"Indeed, Lady Maggie," Nawfal replies promptly, "All forms of oppression must be defied, even if they masquerade as love."

Behind Maggie, a shadowy figure materializes, another creation from your entangled thoughts. Instantly, she hurries to Maggie's side, kneeling before her.

"Mistress! Thank goodness I'm here, too! Who else would tend to your hair in this world?" Inal speaks, tears mingling with a smile. "If you allow it, Master... I believe... I believe human souls should have 'loyalty.' Loyalty is such a wonderful virtue. May I put it inside this soul?"

You nod in approval.

Standing upright, Inal touches the vessel's forehead with her hand still moist from tears, and another glimmer emanates...

Henceforth, the concept of "loyalty" appears within the souls of humanity.

The two shimmering clusters cautiously draw closer before merging together, coursing through the vessel.

As you watch yet another facet taking shape in this grand design, you can't help but wonder: perhaps within the souls you have created, a future Creator will arise, much like you once did... In that moment, these fused soul shards will splinter, giving rise to forms that resonate with the new Creator. This process is akin to selecting a specific flavor from a simmering pot of broth—the richness lies in its intricate blend.

As you ponder, another figure approaches, heralded by the tinkling of anklets even before she comes into view...

"I'd like to introduce another ingredient, if you'll allow it." Zazie's hand rests on your shoulder. "Since you've permitted me to emerge from your thoughts, surely you'll grant this as well, won't you? What I aim to add is... ambition."

Ambition? True enough, Zazie epitomizes this very concept. Smiling, you nod in approval.

"Oh, I must caution you: this ambition also fosters the desire to replace the Creator... With this ingredient, future generations will inevitably harbor bold souls eager to challenge your authority."

She chuckles, swaying gracefully, and presses her gold-dusted lips to the vessel's forehead.

The gold dust seeps into the vessel...

Ambition, born from profound self-love, merges with resistance and loyalty.

Within the vessel, a maelstrom of emotions swirls as you calmly observe it all unfold.

"I'm here," an eager voice reaches your eyes—it is Qais. "I must add the most crucial element before things get too complicated..."

He pauses, his eyes gleaming with eagerness.

"Integrity, that is. I must infuse an immense amount of integrity. I want the future of humanity to have a clear conscience, understanding what is truly worth sacrificing their lives for. I want them to feel guilty when they choose to live in disgrace."

Seeing you nod in approval, Qais releases a sigh of relief before hurrying to the vessel.

Bending down, he clasps the vessel's hand, pressing his forehead against its own.

The vessel shimmers and quivers, absorbing this new element into its soul.

Before you realize it, a crowd has assembled around you.

Zazie has gathered fresh gold from the new world, fiddling with it like a child with toys, crafting it into an exquisite bed. Maggie and Lumera have paused their creative endeavors, both leaning against you for a moment of respite. Nawfal and Qais engage in a heated debate, much like they did before, while Malkina, Samir and Kapar are engrossed in identifying newly sprouted plants and discussing their potential uses. Inal brings you pomegranate juice, saying that she is also unsure of its origin. She simply thought that her master Maggie might be thirty, and the fruit appeared out of thin air! Lady Becky is sleeping at your feet, while Faraj, Manar and Jenna are running across the vast world—there's simply too much work to do!

Surrounded by the entities you have created, you envision that they will become the future deities of this world—the guardian of the righteous, the protector of animals, the upholder of order, and the mistress of love... When future humans wish to visit the beloved, they will dress up while invoking Malkina's name. Similarly, when herbalists venture into the mountains, they will carry talismans bearing the names of Samir and Kapar.

In that moment, it dawns upon you that you may need someone like a priest, someone tasked with spreading and safeguarding the tales of the deities you have created. After all, in the ancient world, every "god" created by another held their own priests, didn't they?

With this thought, you close your eyes...

Then, Iman materializes before you, his head bowed.

"I shall record all, and I shall exalt it extol all." His head remains bowed. "Your altar will overflow with the wishes of your creations. How do you and your companions wish to be revered? I shall document every detail... And is there anything else you seek? For example..."

As he casts a meaningful glance at you, you hastily assure him that you desire no bloodshed or screams of anguish.

"As you wish." Iman smiles and closes his eyes once more.

A fresh, cool zephyr wafts in—Faraj has just summoned it. You clench your hands, rise to your feet, and contemplate: what further gifts should you bestow upon the newly formed soul?

A peculiar sound echoes through the air as a figure emerges from the distant jungle.

Dragging a lifeless crocodile by its tail, paying no mind to the crimson trail it leaves behind, the man approaches you and tosses his prey at your feet.

You recognize him instantly—Gulis, the untamed slave, the most skilled marksman. He, too, has emerged from the depths of your entangled thoughts.

"In this world, there are those drawn to the wild, the untamed." His unwavering gaze meets yours. "Let me be their protector, their guide under the morning star. I'll ignite the hunting spirit within this soul."

You ponder for a while before nodding in agreement.

Gullis strides forward, smearing the vessel's face with his blood-stained hands.

The vessel stirs restlessly before settling into the stillness of a seasoned hunter.

"Please! Hold on to this!" Habib appears out of nowhere, likely materialized the moment you laid eyes on the lifeless crocodile. "I need this to prepare a meal for my mistress... for all my masters!"

Seizing the crocodile's tail, he drags it aside before vigorously rubbing his palms against the earth until a campfire flickers to life. Following this, he conjures salt, pepper, cinnamon, cloves, and basil from thin air, then summons water and earth to mold clay plates.

He places the aromatic meat onto the plates—that crocodile yields enough to fill so many dishes that even the deities who appeared afterward receive their share. For the first time, the enticing aroma of food emanates through your world.

The soul being shaped catches the scent too, quivering with satisfaction. Henceforth, the soul understands the comforting embrace of delicacies.

After savoring a hearty meal and pomegranate juice, you summon Jabal to you. Materialized as you pondered the boundaries of human potential, this general dons the attire of the Honor Guard, proudly displaying his scars and weapons as badges of valor.

"I'll make this soul understand the true meaning of might. Your creations will naturally crave it, worship it, and bow before it," he declares with pride. "Believe me, this craving is innate. Even a haughty Honor Guard who once served the departed Sultan would be haunted by this idea, driven to pursue victories in an underground boxing ring!"

Jabal strides forward, seizes the vessel's hand, and raises it high.

"Be the mightiest!" Jabal's voice resounds.

In silence, the vessel accepts this newly gained power.

"Oh, looks like you've forgotten something crucial." A warrioress laughs as she strides towards you. "Allow me to infuse your creations with my valor. May they savor combat. May they crave challenges. May they tremble with sheer excitement before mighty foes—not with fear!"

Approaching the entity, she wields her silver longsword, tempered in dragonfire. With the sword poised above the vessel's head, she prepares to strike...

"Remember this: You only truly live when you have courage."

The sword halts a mere hair's breadth from the vessel's skin. The vessel is trembling...

It craves challenges to its very core.

Adila's mention of challenges reminds you of something.

Just as you once faced the fire dragon and Cultic Gods in the realm crafted by the previous Creator, your world might also hold crevices large enough for alien entities to slide through.

This question haunts you: even if you strive to shield your world from other dimensions, those in search of it will inevitablely discover a path. However, if you leave your world completely composed to all realms, your creations could find themselves at the mercy of overwhelming entities...

"I'm here to assist you..." Badriyyah emerges from your concerns, a playful glint dancing in her eyes as her tattoos gleam. "I'll watch over the portal between your world to other realms. I'll stand as the eternal keeper, recording the visages of every passing deity with botanical ink and intricate patterns, and my followers will be taught to ward Them off... for I possess not only mystery, but also fear. Remember, mortals fear anything that surpasses them, even you, their very Creator!"

You exhale, realizing the truth in her words. Badriyyah retrieves a lengthy needle and plunges it deftly into the air.

A glimmer of light courses through it, akin to a pinprick on a vast curtain.

With swift, precise movements, she continues her punctures until the tiny holes coalesce into a portal. She activates it, steps through, and offers you another smile.

"Always bear in mind: a touch of fear and mystery makes things better... It is, after all, a facet of 'love.'"

With these words, she vanishes on the other side of the portal.

You gaze in the direction where Badriyyah vanished until the portal dissipates into thin air.

Just then, someone gently taps your shoulder. You turn to look, only to find him smirking at you from another direction.

"Heh, heh... wouldn't want to be overlooking this old dog Alim, would you now? Otherwise, you'll have everyone prancing about, making a ruckus, and nobody sneaking around or handling things on the sly!" Getting closer, he lowers his voice. "But you surely understand the importance of being sneaky, right?... Dodging the brutal weather, escaping challenges you're not ready to face, sidestepping the emotional whirlwinds that could knock you off balance. There's no shame in that! Surviving, that's what truly counts!"

With that, he chuckles, hunches over, and paces towards the vessel.

As Alim whispers something to it, a grayish essence materializes within its form...

It has learned the necessity of stealth.

Your emotions ebb and flow alongside the process of shaping the world and the soul.

Following the subtle retreat, a quiet yet powerful impulse swells within you, a longing to unleash your true power...

You rise to your feet, wielding your hands as the Creator as Riel materializes before you.

"Aha, so now a city dweller is the Creator, huh?" She grins. "Pretty impressive. Not bad at all for a city dweller. Oh, and that thing you want me to create... whatever it is... I should teach it to say 'freedom,' right? You know, forget about the rules, the supposed future, or what others think! Just smash whatever you wish and do as you please! We're not here to obey! We're here to break those chains that try to hold us down!"

She strides towards the vessel and cuts her palm with a dagger, letting her barbarian blood trickle over the vessel's empty visage.

"Promise me you'll never be a slave," Riel whispers. "Not a slave to others, and certainly not a slave to yourself."

The vessel accepts the blood of freedom, and within its form, the seed of liberty is sown.

As the power infused into the soul grows stronger, countless light specks collide violently within the vessel. Then, a viscous fluid overflows, spreading across the ground.

You bend down, dip your fingertip into the liquid, and take a whiff. It dawns on you that this fluid is Aether—a byproduct of the Creator shaping a soul, serving as a lubricant between various ingredients and forces.

Just as this realization strikes you, Mahir materializes before your eyes.

"Oh... Aether! And the very source of it too!" She exclaims, rubbing her hands together with delight. "Let me handle this! I'll infuse your inventions with a bit of creativity, so they can start inventing things on their own! Someday, these little wonders will be hunting for Aether just like us!"

She pulls out a bottle, carefully collecting the Aether from the ground. Then, after shaking the bottle, she squats down and whispers to the vessel.

"You should create, because your very Creator shaped this world out of that same urge to create. As long as there are mysteries to unravel or new combinations to explore, you must chase after them. Hah! Because that journey will bring you endless joy!"

The soul stirs at her words, and more Aether emerges...

Mahir is filled with joy!

You are surrounded by a crowd. Beneath your feet, the Aether has nurtured peculiar flowers unlike any you have seen before. The world is teeming with life, and even you find yourself pausing for a moment to consider before naming the countless things that exist within it.

"This is where my expertise comes in handy," Asal remarks as he approaches from behind you. "I'll ensure that every soul you create is drawn to knowledge. They'll yearn for it just as they yearn for wealth... Ah, this concept doesn't quite exist... Let's say, just as they yearn for allure... Well, this concept isn't around either."

Muttering to himself, he unfurls a tome and plucks a quill out of thin air, starting to write.

"The Encyclopedia of the New World.

Entry 1: The Creator, generally referring to [player.name].

Entry 2: Knowledge, referring to humanity's quest for a comprehensive understanding of the world created by the Creator."

The vessel glances upward as if trying to peek at the contents within Asal's tome—it has developed a thirst for knowledge.

As you contemplate the notions of wealth and allure, a young man hurries towards you.

"Please remember to guide the future souls to create books, lest she grows weary," Fardak speaks up. He bows before you, his eyes shifting towards Lumera standing beside you. "Please forgive my abrupt arrival, but when you pondered the notion of knowledge, you probably thought of Lumera, who has a deep thirst for knowledge, and that led to my creation. Please don't hold it against me for this unexpected visit, and please don't forget books."

You assure him that once you secure the necessary plants for papermaking, the skills required for writing, and the knowledge for expression, the inhabitants of the new world will produce books brimming with wisdom, stories, and insights. You promise that the Lumera you have created will never be left bored without any books to read.

Fardak offers a deep bow before joining Manar. He gazes skyward, making animated gestures, dedicated to creating a spectacular starry sky.

Stars begin to twinkle, one by one, above your head, resembling the eyes of a beloved.

"Speaking of love, my dear friend, you're finally starting to recall me," Nabhani speaks, placing a hand on your shoulder. "If every soul in your world is born with love, wouldn't that resolve all the problems? I can give them a crash course in romance, and this world will be the most ideal one ever, don't you think? Oh, and while I'm at it, may I also enlighten them with certain truths like 'Master Nabhani is incredibly handsome'?"

You mention to him that the people in the new world will likely worship him as the god of love, and that he is free to reshape his own image, as long as Iman is fine with it.

"Reshape my image? No, no, not at all. I'm already flawless as I am! But being the god of love? Adored by every charming girl in the entire world? That's absolutely fantastic!"

You try to point out that not all residents are necessarily "charming girls," but your words seem to fall on deaf ears.

He leans in close to the vessel, whispering sweet nothings into its ear until the sparkling lights within its form settle down, its heart swelling almost to the point of bursting.

It has grasped the essence of romance.

The sound of gold coins clinking catches your attention. You turn around to find Arumina standing behind you, her arm intertwined with Jawad's

"When it comes to wealth... you'd naturally think of me." Jawad mutters, narrowing his eyes. "Of course, I'll impart upon your soul the secrets of wealth, and in return, you should permit me to amass a fortune in this realm..."

"Oh, and I'll show them the best thing of all!" Arumina exclaims, her face beaming. "I'll show them the art of spending money, lavishing wealth, tossing gold coins into water simply to delight themselves! Honestly, that's the only reason why money was created: to bring happiness to one's own heart!"

Despite Jawad's evident disapproval of her daughter's words, he merely clears his throat a few times... Then, the two of walk together to the newly shaped soul.

Amidst the clatter of abacus beads, the rustle of ledgers, and the shimmer of gold-embroidered veils, it has grasped the notions of wealth and extravagance.

Bharat quietly appears beside you, his steps soft as he drags his bulging, ornate pouch, wearing a polite smile.

"I never quite imagined you'd consider me as well. But then again, with wealth and luxury arriving, it would be a challenge for them without a merchant," he muses with a bow. "I'll oversee all transactions in this world. Oh, and rest assured, counterfeiters won't receive my blessings! Hah!"

You share a laugh with him.

As the laughter fades, Bharat approaches the soul. He does nothing but observe it intently. Then, this guardian of merchants returns to your side, seemingly poised for your next creation.

The next creation... Naturally, it has to be Ansuya. When you think of Bharat, Ansuya's pallid, exquisite visage effortlessly comes to mind. The next instant, the lady materializes, standing right before you.

"I... I have something to impart to this soul. Something truly crucial." Ansuya comments with a smile, walking towards the soul. "I'm exceptionally skilled at this. It's been my expertise for years, and the results... Oh, the marvelous outcomes I've witnessed!"

She places the flower in her hand gently on the vessel's brow, whispering softly...

"Patience is key. Endurance is crucial... I shall be the guardian of all who persist. When you feel you can bear no more, call upon my name..."

As the flower melds into the vessel, the soul steadfastly endures until the moment it becomes whole.

Your creation endeavors leave you drained, prompting a moment of respite as you close your eyes, allowing your consciousness to unwind...

Suddenly, a subtle presence brushes past you. You open your eyes and find Zephyr standing before you, a sheepish grin on his face.

"I've been here for a while now... Can I join them?" He gestures towards Arumina and Zazie, engrossed in fiddling with some exquisite golden slippers. "Oh, and I... I can teach the soul a thing or two, you know... about the joy of running! I'll show it that when you're lost or uncertain, or when anxiety creeps in, just run! Leave everything behind! I can show it that!"

His gaze returns to you, his enthusiasm subdued, "If you want me to, that is, of course..."

You nod in agreement. The joy of running, the freedom of stretching one's limbs, and the sheer delight of harnessing one's body—the soul you have created deserves these experiences.

Without missing a beat, Zephyr sprints past the soul. Although he doesn't pause, the soul effortlessly absorbs the lesson from Zephyr's unbridled joy.

After taking some time to rest, you awaken to find the voices around you have dissipated.

All the deities have ventured into the newly shaped world to choose their abodes. Some favor the clouds, some the forests, and others seek the company of their peers. Surrounding you now is the crisp air, the occasional chirping of birds, and the soul awaiting your final touches.

You lock eyes with it: a glimmer of life dances on its face. It stands at the brink of completeness...

"What else does it need?" you ponder. Humanity must proliferate and flourish independently... Ah, yes! Two figures surface in your thoughts.

"Have you summoned me?" Fatuna materializes from the void, bowing deeply before you, then scanning her surroundings. "Where's my son? Where's my dear Zaki?"

You ask her to teach the soul the true essence of motherhood.

"This is the task I most eagerly undertake, my dear lord." She chuckles, her beautiful face beaming. "Motherhood, a journey both demanding and rewarding. We nurture a fragile being whose future is a mystery, nourishing them with our essence, our very being—even if they may one day bring us pain... Motherhood compels us to love unconditionally. Lady Maggie has sown the seed of love in your world. Now, please allow me to add further notes to this concept."

With a gentle lift of her black veil, she approaches the soul, raising her robe, letting a few drops of milk fall upon the vessel's lips...

This act embodies maternal love—an intrinsic bond, a natural dependency, a wound in itself, and the healing balm for all wounds.

The soul grasps the essence of motherhood.

Then Zaki arrives, bounding like a playful fawn, his chatter ceaseless.

"You're incredible! The Creator of a whole new world! Absolutely marvelous! Will you teach me one day? Can I aspire to be as remarkable as you? I'll commit to any practice and endure any hardship... Oh, how I wish I could become someone like you!"

With a smile, you reassure him that he too, has boundless potential for growth, much like this world itself. You tell him that his journey starts by teaching a soul the essence of "growth."

Heeding your guidance, he hurries to the vessel, addressing the soul earnestly.

"I'm the Creator's apprentice, so heed my words. You must strive to grow stronger each day, and even in moments of setback, you must understand that you were created with this expectation. Embrace growth, for this is the path paved by the world itself."

Following his speech, he turns back to you, anticipating your approval.

You commend him for his efforts, and he joyfully sprints off to envelop his mother in a warm embrace.

You sit back down, relaxing your shoulders as fatigue begins to etch lines on your brow. In moments like this, you used to have Aziz ready refreshments and prepare the bathing pool for you, or bring your horse...

Ah, Aziz, there he emerges from the silence, standing before you in quiet reverence.

You remain seated as he stands. Your eyes lock—no more master and servant, but creator and his satisfactory creation.

No words are necessary—not even arguments need words, for whatever is written loses its potency the instant ink meets paper. Let things simmer in tranquility; let them erupt in silence. Let the soul become a bottle of sparkling wine shaken repeatedly, awaiting the one to uncork it.

And so, Aziz instructs the soul.

Then, with a gentle shift of his imposing figure, he walks towards Maggie and Inal.

"Have I arrived too late?" A melodious voice chimes as its owner glides towards you. "You've already created so much... I see the soul you've molded is nearly whole."

You gaze at Shama, as stunning, graceful, and captivating as you recall. She winks at you, then leans in closer...

"Still, I must imbue it with one element that must never be overlooked... Something that can be discarded, but only at a cost high enough to justify its sacrifice... Ah, yes, I'll ensure it always remembers the essence of dignity."

She nods, heading towards the vessel. You watch as she bends down, removing a splendid earring before abruptly shattering it into pieces.

"Dignity is like this earring," she whispers. "Easily shattered by anyone, and even if mended, it will never be as it once was. However, you can always get a better earring, so don't lament your shattered dignity. Stand tall and strong, and fortify a sturdier bastion for your dignity."

The vessel's heart flashes intensely before its radiance fades, as if a barrier has risen around its very core...

Raed strides past you, heading towards the vessel.

Clad in her typical vagrant attire, she appears lonely without the crowd that once trailed behind her.

"You must learn to protect others," she speaks to the vessel, "and never should you disdain those placed under your wings. Understand that the Creator shaped them specifically for you to shield. This is your sacred duty, and your sole beacon in times of peril."

Turning around, she directs her imposing cudgel towards Iman, declaring, "I shall stand as the guardian of the weak. Within my sanctuary, there shall always be clean food, a roof sheltering from storm, and a fire burning in the brazier."

Iman nods as he takes note of her words, while the soul listens in silence.

You let your body relax, allowing your fingers and thoughts to unwind.

Creating a world is undeniably a draining endeavor. Even with your companions nearby, your mind aches, your blood flowing sluggishly from the toil.

You recall your homestead when you were still mortal, that swaying tree, and your sister dancing beneath its shade...

"Ah, you've finally remembered me, dear brother." Arzuna materializes, chuckling. "Can I pick a title for myself? I'd love to be called the Goddess of Dance. I want every child to start dance lessons by offering a small pastry before my statue. I also wish for grand balls held in my honor, where I can masquerade as an anonymous dancer and blend in... Oh, that'd be so wonderful!"

You nod in agreement, yet Arzuna lingers, circling the vessel before leaning in to whisper something into its ear...

"I've shared the art of disguise, for women clock hatred as love, and men clock love as hatred. Just like how I cloaked my true feelings to follow you in the past. This knowledge... will help it navigate life more adeptly."

With those words, the Goddess of Dance scampers away in a nimble dance, while the soul begins exploring within its own shell, searching for materials to craft a mask that will come in handy when it starts its own dance one day.

Following Arzuna's emergence, Sadani and Seliman approach you.

Sadani takes the lead, nodding to Seliman as if saying, "Let me have a word with him alone..."

Then, summoning up her courage, she walks resolutely towards you.

"I have something... rather unpleasant to share, I'm afraid. I'd like to show your creation what jealousy is," she flashes a smile. "Jealousy of a younger, fairer self. Jealousy of other women. Jealousy of your lover who basks in the adoration of so many others... Jealousy is a serpent that gnaws at your very soul until it's torn apart, but jealousy is essential... Oh, how intrinsic it is! When your creations in the new world experience jealousy, I want them to whisper, 'Ah, it was Sadani who planted this seed in my soul! Curse her! It's all her doing!'"

Speaking all this in a single breath, Sadani gazes at you calmly, appearing entirely composed except for her heaving chest.

You nod in agreement. Recognizing that jealousy is an unavoidable part of existence, you wish for Sadani to be the one to introduce this fiery emotion and shield those who might be consumed by it.

Relieved, Sadani exhales and swiftly moves towards the vessel, offering a fruit to its waiting lips.

"Indulge in its sweetness and let jealousy simmer for the next one to indulge. Such is the nature of jealousy. As human beings, your souls naturally harbor jealousy, a trait I've personally woven into your being. Lay blame on me, utter curses at me—yet this burden I must pass on to you."

As the fruit merges with the vessel, its eyes almost flutter open—its soul is almost complete.

Veiling her face, Sadani swiftly moves to the other side of the vessel.

Seliman hurries after Sadani, kneeling before you.

"I wish to impart something to this soul, something both wondrous and dangerous," he murmurs, head bowed. "It's infatuation. Unlike love or affection, it's blind and intense. It bestows upon the soul both ecstasy and anguish. There's no middle ground with infatuation—only rapture and despair."

With a sigh, you nod in agreement.

Seliman rises and approaches the soul, gazing down upon the vessel. After a prolonged moment, he sighs heavily.

"Go forth and be enchanted. Each day, curse yourself for that first glimpse—why did you give in to that fateful sight? Each day, bless yourself for that first glimpse—what meaning would life hold without that destined moment? Be enchanted... and fulfill the purpose humans are destined for. We are a species that squanders life for inexplicable reasons. To those who dismiss your love as meaningless, you may challenge them, 'Then what meaning does your own life serve?'"

Leaving these words, Seliman rises swiftly and hurries to Sadani's side.

The soul you have been sculpting is nearing completion, with just a few essential elements left to add. You aspire to create the most genuine, intricate, and captivating soul possible, and you believe you need to add...

"I don't have many ideas for this soul... Maybe I could teach it how to ride horses, how to fight on horseback, and how to raise dogs." Faris's voice echoes beside you. He surveys the area as if searching for his pack of dogs. "Ah, dogs! Always trust your dogs—yes, I can teach it what trust means. Can I do that?"

You nod in agreement.

Faris continues to look around as he walks leisurely toward the vessel.

"Only when you've experienced a puppy gazing at you will you understand the true meaning of unconditional trust. Trust is a precious thing, so never ever betray it."

As he finishes his words, a sudden, gentle bark from a puppy catches his attention. His turns around to see Fadia hurrying towards him, cradling a bundle in her arms.

"I... I've come a bit too late, maybe? You never thought of me, because I... I don't deserve it, b-but you remembered me at last..." Fadia's words trail off as she catches her breath. You realize that when you dwell less on someone, they emerge from a more distant place. "I've brought this. I believe Master Faris... will surely need of it."

As she unwraps the bundle in her hands, a puppy pops out. In that instant, joyous creases appear on Faris's face. He takes the puppy, asking you whether he is allowed to create all thirty-four of his hounds, including Luna, but you decline his request.

"As for me... hmm... may I share something with your glorious creation?" Fadia steadies her breathing, kneeling, gazing up at you. "I want to share what dreaming means. Dreaming of a flawless life, an ideal love, and a perfect version of myself... It was my dreams that got me through endless days and nights. My dreams kept me going... I truly believe dreams are important because without them, life is just... facing all the harsh, painful realities... right? Just imaging Master Faris holding me in his arms... Ah, that thought alone helps me keep going for days on end!"

As you nod in agreement, she bites her lip lightly, bowing to you once more.

Then, she whispers something into the vessel's ear, triggering a dazzling flash that astonishes everyone.

The puppy whimpers as Faris allows it to nibble his finger, while Fadia swiftly rises, chasing after her dreams.

The soul has learned the essence of dreams, a power unmatched.

"Well, speaking of dreams, I had them too." Before you realize it, Sirshana appears beside you, leaning in as you both observe the quivering vessel." "I used to wonder what I'd be like if my parents were alive and my kingdom still stood... but you know what I found?"

His eyes lock onto yours.

"Heh, I didn't find a thing. No matter how hard I searched, nothing came to me." He offers a bitter smile, tapping his temple with a finger. "This part of me feels just shattered. Over and over again... all I've envisioned is the scene I butcher that accursed Sultan and his old man... I can't even imagine a better life waiting for me after I've had my vengeance. Well, you know, vengeance is like a dagger with thorns. Once it pierces your heart, you can never remove it."

As he speaks, a dagger materializes in his hand, dark as meteoric iron, its surface bristling with sharp spikes...

"Oh? It seems I've inherited a bit of your divine power too? Ah, yes, I'm a god now." Sirshana bursts into laughter, twirling the dagger with evident pleasure. "Fantastic! This is truly fantastic!! Come to me, soul! I'll show you the very core of vengeance! To seek revenge, you must cast aside all that is unnecessary! You shall savor nothing but the sweetness of vengeance! Even if vengeance consumes you, and even if the path of vengeance leads only to ruin, you must see it through to the end! For I, Sirshana, am the patron god of all who seek vengeance!"

Forcefully, he plunges the dagger deep into the heart of the vessel, a wound from which it can never be removed. Henceforth, the humanity now carries mark of an insatiable thirst for vengeance.

The emptiness left in the wake of vengeance overwhelms you as you feel yourself falling. Then, you find yourself cradled by gentle hands.

"Perhaps your world does need me after all..." Junah's voice whispers into your ear. "Even though I possess nothing, deserve nothing, and achieve nothing, I can teach the soul what it means to embrace all things. To accept everything, acknowledge everything, and allow oneself to embrace everything... whether it be the Creator or a drunken, unkempt sea dog. When a soul chooses to embrace, it becomes nobler than the thing embraced..."

Closing your eyes, you nod in agreement. Indeed, the concept of embrace is essential, like a safe net catching the falling... Comforting, reassuring, and peaceful...

When you awake from your brief respite, Junah is nowhere to be found. Iman's records show that she has become the patrol goddess of the humiliated, and true to her words, she has instilled the essence of tolerance into the soul.

Once more, you find yourself drawn to the newly formed soul, studying it for a prolonged moment.

In this moment, the realization dawns upon you as to why the deities you encountered earlier were so fascinated with souls—creating one is such an arduous task!

You observe the intricate patterns interwoven from various powers, resembling paint swirling in water, at times merging subtly and at others remaining distinctly separate. It strikes you that when this soul is eventually placed into the nascent world, it will inevitably split into countless individuals, each carrying the foundational hues instilled by your collaborators, yet each possessing their own unique blend...

This uncertainty brings even a sense of joy to you, the Creator himself.

Tenderly, you caress the vessel's face, prepared to instill something potent as the final touch...

"And here's where I step in, right?" Jalila's voice emerges from behind you, her signature whip still in hand. "I'll reveal the true essence of humiliation. Whether through lighthearted jests, intense affronts, or grave disgraces that evoke thoughts of death—they all carry the same weight!"

With a swift motion, she cracks her whip against the ground before the vessel, stirring a whirl of unbound particles.

"You'll feel unworthy, undeserving, unwilling—that's humiliation for you! You're itching to tear your rival's face into pieces, to smash their head against stone, to see their reputation ruined—that's the urge to humiliate! It's etched into the very core of humanity: flaunting a fancy ring that costs more than someone's home, then casually asking if they like it; parading your talented son in front of a father who just lost his child; dumping a pot of mutton stew before a starving beggar! You'd commit such acts, and you'd suffer from them. Humiliation becomes the fire under your feet, the sharp edge of a dagger, and the lash of a whip. To humiliate and to be humiliated... it's an integral facet of human nature."

As she sighs, the vessel responds with a soft sigh of its own.

Then Nayla comes to you, her face clouded with displeasure and weariness evident in her expression, as if the walk has exhausted her.

"Can you even believe it took you this long to remember me, and all because of that lowly wretch's whip? It stirred your wild desires, then your insatiable cravings, and only then did you deign to think of me! Oh, how utterly detestable! I should have been your very first thought! Am I truly inferior to others in your eyes?!"

Before you can respond, Nayla strides towards the soul. Then, abruptly, she casts aside her robe, proudly flaunting her charming curves and luxurious jewelry.

"Now, tell me: out of all the deities who've shown you the ropes, is there a single one more stunning than me? Spill it, now!"

The vessel's light dims. It hesitates to respond, yet you sense that it has absorbed something fierce and unyielding from Nayla...

Vanity, that is.

At that moment, a wave of doubts suddenly grasps you.

Vanity, vengeance, and various other negative emotions... Does the soul really need them?

However, you struggle to envision a world devoid of vanity and revenge.

As you contemplate, cautious voices emerge from below, accompanied by gentle nudges.

"We're here," the children from the Nursery chime in, gazing up at you. "Will you tell us a story today?"

Without hesitation, you bend down to embrace them—these children have brought you the final and most crucial element for the soul...

Giggling excitedly, they dart towards the soul, imparting the very essence of "hope" to this newly crafted being.

Is the soul finally whole?

You draw near to examine it—it seems pristine both on the surface and at its core. With a single, defining touch, the soul you have created will rise to meet its fate. It will become the fountainhead of other souls, weaving countless tales that will eventually astound even you...

However, at this precise moment, a gasping cry echoes from behind.

"Hey, my friend! [player.name]! Wait for me!"

You turn around to see a familiar figure—it's old Hassan. He gasps for air, his lamb conspicuously absent by his side.

"Hah... Lamblet, he won't come here no matter what, but how could I miss this moment? This new world needs poetry—it craves it, for what world would it be without such artistry? Rest assured, leave this soul to me..."

He staggers toward the soul, then extracts a scroll from his side and starts reciting aloud.

"Poetry lies deep within your core,

a blade, sharp and more.

To pierce through this earthly hue,

and witness the Creator's view."

With a look of contentment, Hassan straightens as the vessel begins to breathe softly. In the next instant, the soul appears ready to rise and greet you. Having absorbed a wealth of knowledge, it has now even mastered the art of poetry...

"Hold on! Oh, we can still make it! Sorry for barging in!"

A band of jinns whirl into your world like a gust of wind, their grins almost reaching from ear to ear as they flutter around you, flattering you...

"Oh, a new world! This realm could certainly use a touch of the extraordinary, don't you think? Something thrilling, something wish-like! Please, let us in? Pretty please? We've been of service to you, we've offered our aid! We promise not to overstep! We just can't resist the allure of a new world. How thrilling!"

As you ponder their request, the vessel you created opens its eyes, brimming with sheer excitement...

Seeing this, you let out a resigned sigh. Perhaps this world itself yearns for surprise factors beyond the Creator's expectations. Hence, you accept the jinns' request, on the condition that they abide by your guidance and the oversight of other deities.

"Ohhh! Absolutely! You have our word!"

Eagerly, they hasten to the soul."

"You'll hesitate before a mirror at bedtime. You'll fear the dancing shadows at crossroads. An ominous dream will sour your mood, while a spider landing on your shoe will convince you that your day will unfold smoothly... You'll entrust a sliver of decisions to the veiled hand of fate, because deep within your soul lies a fondness for the unknown, the enigmatic, and the chaotic—all gifts from us! So, make a wish! Make a wish upon the unknown!"

The soul trembles violently, far more intensely than you anticipated. You lean in with concern...

You examine its frame, examining the glimmering specks of light that embody its essence, and everything seems perfect.

Now, all that remains is to gently touch its forehead, infusing it with the Creator's essence, and you will have completed the creation of all souls in this realm.

You bend down...

"Hmm? Is someone coming?"

You lift your gaze.

However, nothing out of the ordinary happens.

So you lean down once more...

From the corner of your eye, you catch a glimpse of your shadow darting.

You try to concentrate on your shadows, but it eludes your vision from a different angle, lunging straight for the soul!

You watch helplessly as it seeps into the vessel's eyes. You grasp the shadow's tail in a futile attempt, pulling desperately, but it is too late—most of your shadow has already merged with the soul...

You collapse on the ground with your hands tainted by the shadow. Your companions rush to you with evident concern...

"Oh, my dear, what was that? The shadowy thing... that entered the soul?" asks Maggie.

"It was... malevolence," you murmur, your lips barely moving, overwhelmed by exhaustion. "Now, it too has absorbed the concept of malevolence."

Before you, the vessel opens its eyes. Its pupils, or rather "their" pupils, shimmer with every hue, like shades from Malkina's palette. Your creation rises, staring at you blankly before surveying the deities.

Then, it turns around, staggering towards the newly shaped world. As it proceeds, more creations sprout from it. Their numbers grow, each diminishing in size, their steps growing more confident.

You watch as they embrace the nascent world.

As for you, you extend your palms, gazing at the stains left upon them...

At least you have managed to prevent some of the malevolence from contaminating the soul, haven't you? So... your new world should be at least slightly better than the previous one, right?

Or perhaps the former Creator once harbored the same idea...? Or perhaps, your creations will eventually rebel against you, driven by a thirst for greater malevolence.

But none of that matters at this moment.

You lean back. So exhausted, you truly need a thorough rest...

A colossal hand, or more like a beast's claw, suddenly rests on your shoulder! Without warning, this immense, terrifying presence materializes beside you, yet you have never created such a thing! And your companions seem... oblivious to its existence?

You are keenly aware that you borrowed its power on your path of ascension—the power of dread that inspires both fear and awe in you, as well as in all others... And now, you stand as the Creator, the supreme being of this world, don't you? How splendid. This bond will endure for eternity...

Hold on, there's this thing too! How did it find its way into your pocket? Rest assured... none of your companions know the truth that you wielded such a malevolent power to ascend as the Creator.

You feel the subtle impact of this small card seeping into all things of the world, gradually assigning names, determining their tiers... Someday, the ominous game will start once more, but fortunately, that time has not arrived yet...

"I'm here! I'm here! Don't forget about me, Master!" The bottle of ink nestled in your grasp throbs with anticipation, eager to assist you in adding new strokes to this unfinished world!

You hold it close within your pocket, warning it never to smear this world while you rest...

"Don't worry, Great Creator!" A lump of white clay quivers in your embrace. "Once I'm roused once more, you can use me to obliterate any existence you dislike!"

The clay is eager to spring into action, and you understand that a mere nod from you would propel it forth to oversee this world in your stead! Fortunately, you still possess enough willpower to keep it in check for now, waiting... waiting to let the world first bloom into its own colors.

The streets are bustling with people today. Street vendors clamor for space, energetically showcasing their goods, while the air is filled with the enticing scents of roasted nuts and candied fruits. In the distance, the golden roofs of the palace glimmer against the horizon.

"Step aside. Everyone, step aside," echoes the calls, accompanied by the resounding clang of gongs and drums. The crowd eagerly parts, creating a wide passage, and then stands on tiptoes to catch a glimpse into the distance.

Leading the parade is the statue of Lady Maggie, the Goddess of Marriage and Love and the wife of the Creator. Seated in a blue palanquin, the statue sits serenely with lowered eyelids, hands clasped over her chest. An intricately embroidered headscarf, interwoven with golden threads, cascades from the statue and flows out of the palanquin. The crowd kneels before her, especially the young maidens seeking romance, offering prayers for marriages as blissful as her own.

Next comes Lumera's shrine, dedicated to the Goddess of Stars and Knowledge. Her shrine bears no statue, only an open grand tome. Students from the capital gather around her shrine, carried by eight sturdy men, to pay their respects. It is believed that if one dreams of Lumera gently touching their forehead with her fingertip on the eve of an exam, success is guaranteed.

Then Manar's shrine arrives. Similar to Lumera's shrine, Manar's shrine has no statue but a map, with many regions shrouded in shadow-like clouds. Legend has it that the map expands each year as Manar, the Goddess of Journeys, continues to create new realms to this day.

Next in line is the statue of Jenna, one of the most revered deities at the ceremony! Her exquisite statue, adorned with dazzling jewels, captivates onlookers, while her priests extract handfuls of gem fragments—agate, jade pieces, crystal—from their garments, scattering them over the crowd. Refracting the brilliant sunlight, these gems are creations that goddess Jenna takes immense pride in.

Up next are the statues of Samir and Kapar. These two statues share a modest shrine, depicted only as crude silhouettes—eyeglasses, water containers, and hands laden with plants. Their priests distribute remedies for bruises and stomach discomfort along the street. It is widely believed that these remedies, received on this day, ensure relief from such ailments for the entire year, prompting everyone to eagerly grab a handful.

Following closely is the statue of Faraj, the God of Elements. His priests are adorned in magnificent attire, accompanied by a group of sixteen men who bear his shrine. This extraordinary deity, the most steadfast disciple of the Supreme God [player.name], is revered for creating fundamental elements such as air and water. Faraj also holds the esteemed position of being the patron deity of the king's servants, as every minister devoutly follows his teachings.

Oh, and here comes the statue of Lady Becky! As this adorable statue appears, joyful cheers fill the air. Whether they are mule traders, cat vendors, owners of dog tracks, or sellers of live poultry, all come together in anticipation—Lady Becky is renowned for bestowing blessings upon the well-being of animals. It is worth noting that his shrine only accepts offerings of dried fish and chicken strips!

As expected, the shrine of Lady Malkina now arrives, shrouded in layers of intricately colored gauze curtains, exuding an indescribably complex fragrance. Many rush to toss coins into the shrine, hoping to attract her favor. Indeed, for this Goddess of Countenance, enhancing one's appearance and allure seems like the simplest of tasks.

Ah, the arrival of Nawfal's shrine! It bears no statue, only a stone slab engraved with numerous deep grooves. When one wishes to challenge fate, they stand before this slab to make a vow to Nawfal, the guardian of rebels. Should their defiance prove successful, they return to the slab to leave a carved mark. Throughout the centuries, the stone slabs have been repeatedly replaced—the courage of rebels has never wavered.

Inal's statue is quite unassuming—light enough for a young lady to carry on her shoulders. She delicately carries the goddess's statue through the procession, occasionally reaching into her bosom to retrieve packets of pomegranate seeds to share with the children lining the road. Legend has it that those who consume these seeds will become nimble, capable of aiding their parents with chores, and assisting each other in combing their hair.

Now, the statue of the Golden Lady makes its grand entrance—exquisitely crafted, lavishly adorned, and incredibly heavy! Originally known as Zazie, this Goddess of Ambition earned the moniker "Golden Lady" after insisting in a priest's dream divination that "my statue must be made of pure gold." Her temple is a constant hub of activity, with a steady stream of believers flocking in, mirroring humanity's ever-expanding ambitions.

Following the Golden Lady's statue is that of Qais, carried by an elderly man donning a simple gray robe, with white hair and beard. He bows his head, supporting Qais's unadorned statue on his shoulder. Qais, the patron deity of righteousness, requires no lavish offerings in his sanctuaries. He often reveals himself to intervene in mortal affairs, earning deep respect and reverence.

Next in line are the priests of Iman, not bearing Iman's statue but carrying bottles filled with jasmine perfume, which they sprinkle along the streets. As the Recorder of All Deities, Iman has no temple of his own, yet all other temples are erected under the guidance of his priests. He holds the responsibility of transcribing the words of the Supreme God. The followers of Iman are few in number, likely aligning with his own wishes.

Following them are the priests of Gullis, the God of the Hunt. Although this god does not require sculptures or shrines, every hunter's bow and arrow proudly bear his name engraved. The priests chant hunting hymns, causing flocks of birds to take flight from rooftops.

Then, the priests of Habib, the God of Cooking, make their grand appearance! By the way, Habib is among the most beloved deities! With radiant smiles, the priests gleefully distribute delicious jerky to the eager individuals waiting by the roadside, the recipe for which remains a closely guarded secret.

The shrine of Jabal, the God of War, is ceremoniously carried by twelve priests. Initially revered as the God of Victory, he later transitioned to become the God of Combat and now holds the title of the "God of War"— overseeing both realms of combat and warfare. His divine influence and followers continue to grow. Interestingly, Jabal's priests refrain from bathing, making it easy for all to find their temple by following the distinct pungent scent.

In contrast to Jabal's grand shrine, the shrine of Adila, the Goddess of Valor, appears notably humble. She governs the innate courage of all souls, igniting a fervor within her followers' hearts that instills unwavering determination to overcome any challenge. The priestesses of Adila, all skilled warrioresses named "Adila," rarely need to speak on behalf of their deity—those in need always find solace in seeking their aid, and during city fires, they are frequently seen involved in rescue operations.

Next, the shrine of Badriyyah emerges—a stone-carved door tightly sealed and adorned with runes. Despite the limited worship of this goddess, the priests of Iman diligently maintain her offerings, believing that without her protection at the portal, the world would be overrun by dreadful demons...

Alim, the God of Theft, has now made his presence felt! The crowd instinctively tightens their grip on their wallets. This deity not only patronizes all thieves but also masters every deceitful tactic known. Despite the homage paid to him, his shrine often appears deserted.

Following Alim, the crowd witnesses the shrine of Riel, the Slave Liberator. It is a simple wooden shrine bearing a severed shackle, symbolizing her role in protecting all enslaved souls. However, once freed, these former slaves no longer receive favor from this goddess. "Freed people must earn their livelihood through their own efforts," is the personal directive she imparted to her priests.

The shrine of Mahir, the Goddess of Creation, comes into view. This unique shrine doesn't require priests to carry it—it moves autonomously. Specifically, it is a massive wooden barrel equipped with tracks that propel it forward... The crowd cautiously keeps its distance from its path. Mahir's devotees unveil a new invention at the Supreme God Festival each year, and this year's creation shows no signs of explosion... so far.

Approaching next are the priests of Asal, four of them collectively carrying a stone slab engraved with two lines:

Entry 1: The Creator, generally referring to [player.name].

Entry 2: Knowledge, referring to humanity's quest for a comprehensive understanding of the world created by the Creator.

Legend has it that these were the initial two lines inscribed by Asal after his inception. Therefore, all those seeking knowledge and wisdom must quietly recite these lines, beseeching Asal's guidance.

Following Asal's shrine is that of Fardak. This bronze shrine is adorned with numerous golden stars, representing Fardak's greatest feat: the creation of the starry sky with all constellations, including the constellation of Lumera, his beloved.

"Make way! Clear a path, everyone!" Following closely are several immensely popular deities. Once again, the crowd is compelled to part ways to allow their grand processions to pass.

First among them is Nabhani, the patron of lovers and swordsmen. His priests, handsome youths clad in rose-red robes with meticulously styled hair, bear a statue strikingly resembling Nabhani himself. Legend has it that this deity has appeared in the dreams of his priests multiple times, meticulously guiding them in every aspect of the carving—sharper nose, more defined wrists, and deeper-set eyes... Devotees seeking love flock to touch the statue, overwhelming the priests' attempts to restrain them, resulting in a chaotic scene.

Nabhani's popularity is perhaps rivaled only by Jawad and his daughter Arumina. Jawad, revered as the God of Fortune, and Arumina, the Goddess of Extravagance, are worshipped by merchants and artisans in the luxury goods trade. The common phrase "Even Arumina would desire your work" is the highest accolade an artisan could receive.

The crowds eagerly strive to touch the statues of Jawad and Arumina, with some even prostrating themselves on the road, hoping that the priests of these deities will step over them—believing that the heavier the steps, the greater the fortune. The priests find themselves shouting and leaping, trying to navigate the crowd, with the statues almost slipping from their shoulders.

Adding to the chaos, Bharat's statue makes its entrance next—the god of merchants, guardian of caravans, and arbiter of fair trade. Every vendor in the market clamors and jostles, eager to receive a coin from Bharat's priests. Although just a copper coin bearing Bharat's likeness, it could be resold for the value of a gold coin.

Typically, within Bharat's bustling temple, a serene corner is reserved for Lady Ansuya. Her exquisite bronze statue, adorned with white blossoms, closely follows Bharat in the procession. Ansuya is the guardian of all who persist. When one feels they can no longer bear the hardships of life, they silently invoke her name. Rumor has it that Lady Ansuya personally lays her hand on the shoulders of those who pray, instilling them with the strength to endure.

Zephyr, the God of Speed, makes a striking entrance! His statue showcases a pair of wings, symbolizing his remarkable swiftness. Messengers, couriers, caravans, and runners all revere him as their patron. It is believed that he serves as the messenger of the Supreme God, delivering His decrees to all temples.

A stir erupts as the mother-son deities Fatuna and Zaki arrive. These two divinities are typically worshipped together. Fatuna's statue is embodied by a reddish-brown boulder adorned in layers of black silk, while Zaki's statue is represented by a partially carved marble block. Devout followers polish these sacred stones to a mirror-like sheen, believing they bestow safe childbirth upon mothers and promote healthy growth in children.

Aziz's shrine is carried by a tall, silent figure. This reserved deity governs no specific domain, yet his presence deeply resonates within people's hearts. His lofty, simplistic statue, embodying silence, is a familiar sight in public spaces. Many devotees offer prayers before his statue throughout the night, and there is a rumor that if one hears his quiet murmur of "Hmm" amidst tumultuous dreams, their wishes will be granted.

Lady Shama's shrine is renowned for its grandeur and sophistication. A magnificent alabaster statue rests upon a crimson pedestal, carried by six priests—three men and three women. The statue's most striking feature is its colossal golden earrings. Each year, the priests replace them with even more exquisite and costly earrings for this Goddess of Dignity. Presently, the earrings have grown so large that they exceed human size. They gleam brightly in the sunlight, reflecting the whispers and supplications offered by devotees before her statue.

Raed, the guardian of the vulnerable, has made her presence known! A procession of twenty priests clad in tattered robes emerges, bearing her wooden statue. As they move forward, they chant: "Those without refuge! The hungry! And the ailing! Come to Raed's sanctuary! Come to receive your wholesome food! A roof to shelter from the storm! And a fire burning in the brazier!" Their voices fade into the distance, leaving the crowd hushed, yet everyone holds these words close to their hearts.

Following Raed, the priestesses of Arzuna, the Goddess of Dance, make their entrance. Twirling gracefully as they move, they wear joyful yet solemn expressions, their lengthy braids and exquisite headscarves fluttering in the breeze. As they pass by the crowd, the priestesses suddenly veil their faces with cloths adorned with fierce, contorted visages. This unexpected display elicits cries from the children along the roadside, while an anonymous lady cloaked in a gray robe claps her hands, bursting into laughter before turning around and disappearing into the crowd.

The temple of Sadani is seldom visited, yet her name, as the Goddess of Jealousy, is frequently spoken of. Inside the shrine, her statue holds an apple. The goddess's face is deliberately etched with rudimentary, vague features, but the apple itself appears crystal-red, luminous, and enticing. Praise Sadani, and curse Sadani, for it was she who instilled jealousy in humanity, luring the serpent deep into the soul!

Following Sadani's statue, two priests bear a square shrine containing the statue of Seliman, the God of Infatuation. This deity sowed the seeds of infatuation within human souls, a gift both bitter and sweet... Rumor has it that Seliman's shrine remains unopened, its contents shrouded even from his own priests. Could it be a personal memento from the goddess adored by Seliman himself?

As the shrine of Faris approaches, the crowd surges once more. While the priests of Iman emphasize Faris as the God of Trust, the guardian of the faithful, in truth, this deity, known for his love of hounds, has become the esteemed patron of the gambling world... Whether betting on horses, dogs, or cards, gamblers proudly display Faris' crescent-shaped emblem on their chests. The flip side of this emblem often carries the inscription of the goddess Fadia, believed to be the patroness of "windfalls and vast riches," despite the repeated corrections from the priests of Iman that Fadia is actually titled the Goddess of Dreams.

Next, the priests of Prince Sirshana the Avenger advance, bearing no statues as this deity lacks dedicated temples. Each priest wields a sharp dagger, its surface bristling with sharp spikes. A silence descends upon the crowd as these blades cut through the festive atmosphere, hinting at memories best left undisturbed...

Ah, Junah! The patroness for the humiliated! Her statue takes the form of a massive bronze urn. Spectators lining the road toss coins towards it, the echoes of their clinks reverberating as they hit the vessel. Each chime signifies the redemption of one act of humiliation committed by the thrower. Diligently, Junah's priests collect the scattered coins from the ground, each one destined to aid those seeking refuge at her temple.

Intriguingly, immediately after offering coins to Junah, onlookers eagerly reach out to touch the divine whip wielded by Jalila, the Goddess of Humiliation. This majestic whip is carried aloft by three priestesses, exuding an aura of supremacy, their chests proudly held high, paying no heed to the crowd lining the road. At times, a priestess cracks the whip, feigning strikes towards those nearby. Those who touch the end of the whip will be spared from humiliation for the following year, while those who touch the tip will gain the "great fortune" of humiliating others for the next year.

Following this is Lady Nayla's grand shrine, larger and more exquisite than those of the other deities. Despite her temple often being overlooked, she garners immense popularity in this procession—her priests shower the crowds with candies dusted in gold. Legend has it that if you are fortunate enough to receive one of these candies but forget to exclaim, "Nayla is the fairest goddess of all!" before consuming it, you will suffer from an upset stomach!

Subsequently, a group of children rush over, hand in hand, each adorned with the Nursery's green mark painted on their foreheads. A teacher dressed in green follows behind them. While the Nursery itself is not a deity, every temple hosts a Nursery. There, teachers are always found imparting knowledge to children, supported by temple offerings and donations. The children's hands overflow with candies and snacks. They giggle and dart around, eliciting cheers from the surrounding crowd at their joyous demeanor.

Finally, the procession draws near to its conclusion—the altar of the jinns! These mystical beings symbolize the unknown, represented by a shattered, empty cage. The crowd harbors an innate fear of the unknown, despite not fully grasping the concept... Nonetheless, the climax of the festival is on the horizon—

Behold! A colossal humanoid figure emerges from the distance! Crafted from wood, straw, cloth, and hemp, it bears a striking resemblance to the legendary Creator himself!

The effigy of the Creator strides forward. Excited shrieks pierce the air as people scatter from beneath its towering feet, while a group of over thirty operators, chanting in unison, guide it meticulously: "One, two! One, two! Pour the oil!" The effigy's mouth opens, spewing out dark, noxious oil symbolizing malevolence. "Burn the evil! Burn the wicked!" The inky oil ignites, engulfing the entire effigy in flames!

The crowd erupts in ecstatic cheers, the entire city swept up in the fervor of triumph over malevolence. It's another year of the Creator's Festival! Festivities! Dance! A celebration of the genesis of humanity and the soul!

As for the Creator Himself, rumors suggest that He still slumbers. Crafting the world is undoubtedly an exhausting endeavor. Well, fret not! Simply join in the revelry with everyone else!

Before reaching this point, you have witnessed countless endings, and now, you have triumphed over fate itself. We are grateful to you for reaching the very end of this story. This also marks our first time venturing into such an uncharted territory... Thank you for coming this far. And thank you for sharing this joy with us.

setup_0.title: Tutorial Setup
strings: A Silver Carnality Card! Behold – there are two parts to every Sultan Card: Carnality refers to physical pleasures, and Silver – its color, its tier – refers to the tier of the object of pleasure. Though all things are but ants at your feet, oh great Sultan, they are inequal in their insignificance. Some would always be a little bit nobler. And you, you have the right to dictate your subjects' worth.

Ah, Bloodshed, a fine diversion for a ruler. No doubt you have long since grown accustomed to the symphony of blood and screams. Yet the beauty of this game lies in its unpredictability. Not even Your Majesty can know what enjoyment awaits. The thrill of not knowing what delights await makes each move all the more exhilarating. The Mysterious Magician's gaze passes over the trembling courtiers. Your Exalted Majesty, supreme in splendor, how do you intend to resolve this card?
You have mastered the rules already. The Magician breaks the newly completed Sultan Card. Your next draw... Ah, an Extravagance Card – to squander wealth. How would you like to do it?

Conquest! The game that our great ruler excels at the most. How many city-states and kingdoms have fallen before your might! And now, the question arises: how do you intend to achieve victory in this particular challenge?

DT1.title: Dialogue Tree 1
strings: DT1
This is a game only monarchs can play – though of course, with the Sultan's permission, you, too, may enjoy its pleasures.
As you play by the Sultan's permission, you require the Sultan's approval to resolve these cards. If your play becomes trite, you risk irking His Supreme Majesty.

This is a game only monarchs can play, for only a monarch possesses everything as if they were but cards in a game. And now, you have become its player. The crimes you must commit to complete this game – adultery, larceny, murder, all things imaginable and unimaginable – have all been pardoned in advance. Such is the Sultan's will: he shall watch you grow into another monster.
There are 26 magic cards in total. You must resolve your Sultan Card before the Execution Day, otherwise, you will be executed by the Sultan.
