DT5.title: Dialogue Tree 5
strings: DT5

I am but a humble steward of the Sultans – the exalted monarchs who have proven themselves worthy to partake in this game. My role is to ensure the game runs smoothly for our august players. Now, I am at your service as well. It is my deepest hope that you, too, will find this game... most entertaining.

This game is still in development. In this playtest version, though a Total Triumph is yet unattainable, you may still explore the world and the stories hidden within by resolving as many Sultan Cards as possible.
In certain storylines, you do not need to resolve all Sultan Cards to reach a Fine Finale.

DT6.title: Dialogue Tree 6
strings: DT6

In the Sultan's Game, there are four types of cards, corresponding to four types of tasks that must be completed. Each task is divided into four tiers, corresponding to the difficulty of completion. When you receive a Sultan Card, whether by choice or not, you must complete the depicted task within [sudan_life_time] days. Otherwise... well, I shall wish you a swift and painless decapitation.

Verily, in this world, everything has its tier, be it people, things, or Sultan Cards. Gold, Silver, Bronze, and the lowly Stone... These cards will accept sacrifices of their own tier or higher, but not vice versa. For instance, you may slay a Silver-tiered slave to resolve a Bronze Sultan Card. In some cases, a card's tier may change... that is something for you to discover yourself.
There are four types of Sultan Cards, all of which are the Sultan's favorite "games". Which one would you like to hear about first?

Oh, Carnality! Who doesn't love the carnal pleasures, except for those cowardly prudes worrying about "consequences"? You can make love with anyone to fulfill this card's demand: men, women, men and women... or be even more creative. But do take note. Typically, the same person can only be used to resolve the Carnality Cards once. The Sultan didn't put you through this game to encourage fidelity, ha!

Only the weak rule with order. Our Sultan, whose strength is without equal, rules with fear. Bloodshed is one of his favorite pastimes. This card calls for a blood sacrifice. Cast your gaze towards loves ones, innocents, enemies – the only thing that matters is whether they are of the right tiers.

Compared to other Sultan Cards, Conquest is perhaps less entertaining. But it is part of what being a Sultan entails. Just think about it – how vast his land, how exalted his name! Military victories and sufficiently challenging adventures are both forms of conquest recognized by the cards.

Extravagance means more than just spend money. It is to misspend, to waste, to squander what others hold dear. The higher the tier of the card, the more lavish the spending must be. Fortunately, in His Majesty's realm, there are plenty of ways to tastefully throw away one's wealth.

Rest assured, to make the game more enjoyable, the merciful Sultan has absolved you of all crimes you must commit to complete this game, be it adultery, larceny, or murder. Naturally, the victims will still curse and haunt you, and those who vie for the Sultan's favor will ostracize you in envy. But this is exactly the kind of drama the Sultan loves, wouldn't you say?

To survive, you may want to delay resolving a Sultan Card for as long as possible, since as soon as one is resolved, you must draw the next. But beware, though it may seem favorable to delay receiving the next task, opportunities are oft fleeting. Acumen and judgment will go a long way.

Joining the Sultan's Game does not affect your regular duties, such as Managing the Estate. As a noble, you need only pay the slightest attention to domestic matters to reap rich rewards. And forget not your status as a courtier. Don't make yourself a stranger at court. Make yourself seen, or at least make sure the Sultan's Palace is not filled with only enemies.
A strange, supernatural smoke obscures her visage. It is impossible to see through, try though you might. All you get is a glimpse of her lips, curled up in a smirk.

DT7.title: Dialogue Tree 7
strings: DT7
The Sultan's Game has four kinds of cards, each with four tiers... They represent challenges you must complete after drawing them. Worry not, magic ensures that cheating is impossible.

You noticed! In this world, everything has its tier, be it people, things, or Sultan Cards. The Game grants you the power to perceive them all: Gold, Silver, Bronze, and the lowly Stone... So that the game is more forgiving, these cards will accept sacrifices of their own tier or higher, but not vice versa. For instance, in most cases, you may slay a Silver-tiered slave to resolve a Bronze Sultan Card.
There are four types of Sultan Cards, each with a different way to be resolved... Which one would you like to hear about?

To lie with women, with men, or any other arrangement your imagination conjures – any such unions is suffice to fulfill the Carnality Card's demand. A simple matter, truly, for one of your... boundless creativity.

But there is a wrinkle to consider. The same companion cannot be reused to resolve multiple Carnality Cards, at least not without elevating their station or employing more... inventive methods.
To satisfy a Bloodshed Card, you need only slay a person of appropriate tier, or... perhaps some other intelligent beings. Delightfully straightforward, with the fewest restrictions.
Military victories and sufficiently difficult adventures can all qualify as successful conquests.

The Extravagance Card calls for extravagant spending. Construct opulent estates, host revels of unparalleled splendor, or indulge in pursuits gloriously impractical... This is a game for people who know how to live large.

Rest easy, for the Sultan has graciously pardoned any and all transgressions you might undertake in the name of this game. Murder, rape, and pillage – they are all within the scope of your newfound rights. 

Naturally, your victims will remember. Their bitterness may fester, their vengeance may stalk you, and the dangers of such actions remain ever-present.

But dwell not on trivialities. Embrace this extraordinary privilege. Savor the game.

If survival is your sole concern, you might consider delaying the resolution of a Sultan Card to gather resources and strengthen your position.

However, a word of caution: some opportunities to resolve Sultan Cards are fleeting. Prudence is admirable, but endless procrastination? Might prove costly.

In principle, nothing need change in your routine, Your Grace. May I humbly suggest that you continue your diligence in Managing the Estate? Wealth is, after all, the backbone of success in this grand endeavor. Yet, you remain a loyal servant of the Sultan. So do not neglect the court, my lord. Attend, flatter, and charm as only you can. After all, The Grand Game, too, is part of the Sultan's Game.
Her smile carries a hint of danger, yet it adds a unique allure

DT8.title: Dialogue Tree 8
strings: DT8
The Sultan’s Game is reserved for monarchs and monarchs only. Kings and Emperors vie to exhaust their cards with the utmost speed. And I am the witness to all their splendor and ambition.

Ah, you’ve noticed it! The Sultan’s Game has granted you the power to see everything in its proper tier – Gold, Silver, Bronze, and Stone. Even the Sultan Cards bow to this hierarchy, nestled neatly within these four ranks.

Now, resolving a Sultan Card typically demands a character or item of matching caliber. Bronze for Bronze, Silver for Silver.

But given your... unique predicament, I had a quiet word with the Sultan. A subtle nudge to ensure that, should you wield a higher-tier piece, it can serve to settle a lesser card. For instance, you might sacrifice a Silver target to satisfy a Bronze Bloodshed Card.
There are four types of Sultan Cards, each with a different way to be resolved... Which one would you like to hear about?

To lie with women, with men, or any other arrangement your imagination conjures – any such unions is suffice to fulfill the Carnality Card's demand. A simple matter, truly, for one of your... boundless creativity.

But there is a wrinkle to consider. The same companion cannot be reused to resolve multiple Carnality Cards, at least not without elevating their station or employing more... inventive methods.
To satisfy a Bloodshed Card, you need only slay a person of appropriate tier, or... perhaps some other intelligent beings. Delightfully straightforward, is it not? Enjoy it.

In its purest form, the Conquest Card calls for victories upon the battlefield. Yet, understanding the nuances of your reign... hunts, daring exploits, and even ventures of a more adventurous nature may also suffice to fulfill its demands. Opportunities to resolve Conquest Cards are rare. Your Majesty will need to pursue them with diligence.

The Extravagance Card demands gold, but gold alone is not enough. It must be spent in a manner befitting your grandeur. Construct opulent estates, host revels of unparalleled splendor, or indulge in pursuits gloriously impractical... The banal act of shopping can hardly qualify as extravagance.

Consequences? Oh, Your Majesty, surely you jest. A monarch such as yourself holds dominion over all. This Game demands no price from one of your station, nor does it impose limits upon how you may rise to its challenges – it is, after all, merely a pastime for those of supreme power. Rather, is it not so that bloodshed, conquest, carnality, and extravagance are freedoms reserved for sovereigns alone? Play, indulge, throw away your worries! Who could possibly deny you?

The Game imposes no limits on time, yet every moment you spend will be etched into its annals – an eternal record for countless rulers yet to come. They will measure themselves against your legacy, vying to surpass it.

Your Majesty, your attention brings me great honor. However, the powerful magic of this game shields me. Neither the blades of your armies nor the might of your enchanted ring can so much as graze me. But worry not. I shall remain ever at your side, day and night. You will have plenty of time to pursue such endeavors... For now, though, might we return to the matter of the game? Perhaps, when the day comes that you complete it...
Her smile carries a hint of danger, yet it adds a unique allure
